NPC: You didn't complete your mission yet!

NPC: Please tell me you have the plasma! I am in deep shit if more stuff fries this month!

Your response: Don't worry! I have a full cartouche of it.

NPC: This is great news! I knew I could count on you. I will refill the plasma personally and can look around a little while I'm at it. I've had it up to here with all those acts of sabotage.

Your response: I'm sure of that.

NPC: I advise you to keep concentrating on your Construction skill, but you should also learn some fighing skills, otherwise you're dead meat when somebody attacks you. I will have more stuff to do for you later. See you later then.

NPC: There you are again... Great! Would you mind taking some work off me? You would help me a lot...

Your response: I have too much work myself at the moment.

Your response: Always at your service.

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: You've probably already guessed it. Originally, I wanted to put in the cooling plasma myself and look around while being there but I just have too many other things on my hands. I'm sure you realise how urgent the matter is. Plase take back the cartouche of cooling plasma and finish the job for me.

Your response: Okay... I will do that. But where is the reactor?

NPC: The reactor is at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1573)... please, hurry.

NPC: O V E R H E A T I N G   A T   7 8   P E R C E N T
T E N D E N C Y :    I N C R E A S I N G
E M E R G E N C Y   S H U T D O W N   N O T   O P E R A T I O N A L
P L E A S E   R E P L A C E   C O O L I N G   P L A S M A   C A R T O U C H E

Your response: And in we go...

NPC: C O O L I N G   P L A S M A   C A R T O U C H E   N O T   F O U N D
P L E A S E   R E P E A T

NPC: O V E R H E A T I N G   A T   7 2   P E R C E N T
T E N D E N C Y :    D E C R E A S I N G

Your response: Hmmm? Where do these strange guys come from? The ones who sabotaged this baby, no doubt... you guys just wait, I will finish you right here!

NPC: O V E R H E A T I N G   A T   6 5   P E R C E N T
T E N D E N C Y :    D E C R E A S I N G

NPC: O V E R H E A T I N G   A T   4 5   P E R C E N T
T E N D E N C Y :    D E C R E A S I N G

NPC: T H A N K   Y O U   F O R   U S I N G   C O O L I N G   P L A S M A   P U M P   G L - 3 2 F

NPC: You didn't finish your job!

NPC: From what I hear, everything is running smoothly again. You solved everything very well. Any problems?

Your response: Not really problems. Some bastards seemed to sabotage the machine and attacked me. I got them to reconsider, though.

NPC: Great. You do not know to what faction they belonged, do you? Too bad... well, I am gonna find out. But as you see, it is important to be able to defend yourself sometimes. You will not be able to just construct your stuff and live peacefully, this world is not peaceful. Anyway, I am more than satisfied with your performance.

Your response: Thanks, but really, it wasn't all that hard.

NPC: No need to be so humble. You did great, and I want to reward you. Here - take this new construction tool, I am sure it will be of good uses for you. I have other matters that require my attention now. We will surely meet again. Until then, keep my advice in mind and I wish you best of luck. Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

entries.title: Mission 2: New cooling fluid
entries.description: Use the Plasma pump in the Construction Facility (PEPPER SEC-3), to produce some new cooling fluid. Bring a unit of cooling fluid to Mr. Jones.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

POSSIBLE PREREQUISITES
• Complete Mission 1: Replacement part acquisition
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Plasma Pump
• Collect Construction Grease
• Collect Cooling Plasma
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 2,000 credits
• 2,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Good to see you! Did you get settled in yet? The apartment is no palace of course, but if you make yourself useful, things could change. Speaking of which - I have a problem that will require a dependable person to handle it...

Your response: I'm out of time at the moment.

Your response: Oh, I am a very dependable person!

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Great! That's what I like to hear. We have a problem with one of our construction facilities - details later. At the moment, I need a replacement part for a cooling liquid pump. The problem is, that I cannot find one of these parts anywhere and time is short.

Your response: And now I am supposed to search for that part myself?

NPC: Not exactly. You're not supposed to search for it, you're supposed to construct one. I will give you this blueprint and you will construct it... you know how that works.

Your response: To be honest... not really.

NPC: Then I will explain. If you look at the properties of the blueprint, you will see what you need to construct the part. If you have all construction parts together, put your construction tool and the blueprint into your processor window and start the process. This might take a while, since you are not very experienced yet.

Your response: Okay... I think I'll manage. But I do not have any construction parts...

NPC: Then you need to buy or find them. It's a very simple machine, so the parts should be easy to find. You should go out and look for a tech shop. You can get almost anything in those. To make your search easier for one, you should use your Nav-Ray to find a shop and back here. Look in the Trader Categories for chemicals.

Your response: Whoa, information overflow. But I think I'll make it.

NPC: Of course you will. You just need to hurry up a little, I need that part as soon as possible.

NPC: Come back when you finished your job!

NPC: Are you done? Oh, I see you managed to construct the part. I am so thankful.

Your response: Man, do my feet hurt...

NPC: I will make it worth your while later. In the meantime, you should train your Construction skills, so you will be able to handle more complex gadgets later.

Your response: Thanks for the tip. I will keep that in mind.

NPC: No need to thank me. Come back later and I will have more stuff for you to do.

NPC: Thank god you're here! Say, are you free to do something for me at the moment?

Your response: Not at the moment, sorry...

Your response: I have time...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great. I have a problem... You remember the part you constructed for me. Well, the technician who was supposed to take it and plug it in has not shown up yet and the problem keeps getting bigger.

Your response: What is the problem, then?

NPC: The replacement part you constructed is for a cooling liquid pump, as I told you. In one of our construction facilities, a reactor was sabotaged and is in danger of overheating. Usually, this shouldn't be a problem. We had numerous cases of sabotage in the past, but this time, it is a problem.

Your response: Let me guess: The cooling mechanism went offline, and the thing is in danger of lighting up like a five year old christmas tree.

NPC: It's not that bad. The cooling mechanism is okay, but it is out of cooling plasma. And the only machine that can produce cooling plasma that is close enough is disfunctional, as you know. You constructed the replacement part yourself. But still, the damn technician didn't show up to plug the replacement part in and get the plasma production going again.

Your response: And now I am supposed to handle the repairs?

NPC: Yes, please! Here, take the replacement part - time is short. When you have repaired the plasma pump, take one cartouche and bring it to me. Don't forget Construction Grease for the repair. And hurry! The plasma pump is at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1567) ... use your Nav-Ray to get there as quickly as possible.

entries.title: Mission 3: Starting it up
entries.description: With these materials, we should be able to start up the Reactor in Reactor Room (PLAZA SEC-1) again. Make sure that it's fully functional.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

POSSIBLE PREREQUISITES
• Complete Mission 2: New cooling fluid
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Reactor
• Defeat 3 × Saboteur
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 3,000 credits
• 3,000 experience

NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Good to see you! Did you get settled in yet? The apartment is no palace of course, but if you make yourself useful, things could change. Speaking of which - I have a problem that will require a dependable person to handle it...

Your response: I'm out of time at the moment.

Your response: Oh, I am a very dependable person!

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Great! That's what I like to hear. We have a problem with one of our construction facilities - details later. At the moment, I need a replacement part for a cooling liquid pump. The problem is, that I cannot find one of these parts anywhere and time is short.

Your response: And now I am supposed to search for that part myself?

NPC: Not exactly. You're not supposed to search for it, you're supposed to construct one. I will give you this blueprint and you will construct it... you know how that works.

Your response: To be honest... not really.

NPC: Then I will explain. If you look at the properties of the blueprint, you will see what you need to construct the part. If you have all construction parts together, put your construction tool and the blueprint into your processor window and start the process. This might take a while, since you are not very experienced yet.

Your response: Okay... I think I'll manage. But I do not have any construction parts...

NPC: Then you need to buy or find them. It's a very simple machine, so the parts should be easy to find. You should go out and look for a tech shop. You can get almost anything in those. To make your search easier for one, you should use your Nav-Ray to find a shop and back here. Look in the Trader Categories for chemicals.

Your response: Whoa, information overflow. But I think I'll make it.

NPC: Of course you will. You just need to hurry up a little, I need that part as soon as possible.

NPC: Come back when you finished your job!

NPC: Are you done? Oh, I see you managed to construct the part. I am so thankful.

Your response: Man, do my feet hurt...

NPC: I will make it worth your while later. In the meantime, you should train your Construction skills, so you will be able to handle more complex gadgets later.

Your response: Thanks for the tip. I will keep that in mind.

NPC: No need to thank me. Come back later and I will have more stuff for you to do.

NPC: Thank god you're here! Say, are you free to do something for me at the moment?

Your response: Not at the moment, sorry...

Your response: I have time...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great. I have a problem... You remember the part you constructed for me. Well, the technician who was supposed to take it and plug it in has not shown up yet and the problem keeps getting bigger.

Your response: What is the problem, then?

NPC: The replacement part you constructed is for a cooling liquid pump, as I told you. In one of our construction facilities, a reactor was sabotaged and is in danger of overheating. Usually, this shouldn't be a problem. We had numerous cases of sabotage in the past, but this time, it is a problem.

Your response: Let me guess: The cooling mechanism went offline, and the thing is in danger of lighting up like a five year old christmas tree.

NPC: It's not that bad. The cooling mechanism is okay, but it is out of cooling plasma. And the only machine that can produce cooling plasma that is close enough is disfunctional, as you know. You constructed the replacement part yourself. But still, the damn technician didn't show up to plug the replacement part in and get the plasma production going again.

Your response: And now I am supposed to handle the repairs?

NPC: Yes, please! Here, take the replacement part - time is short. When you have repaired the plasma pump, take one cartouche and bring it to me. Don't forget Construction Grease for the repair. And hurry! The plasma pump is at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1567) ... use your Nav-Ray to get there as quickly as possible.

entries.title: Mission 1: The blood sample
entries.description: A functionary seems to have been poisoned. Mr. Jones wants you to obtain a blood sample from Hermann Schmidt in PLAZA SEC-1.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Hermann Schmidt
• Collect Blood sample
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 1,000 credits
• 1,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: There you are. Got the feeling for your new environment yet? If you have some time, I have an important task that needs to be done by somebody and I thought you could help me with that. Are you free?

Your response: I don't have much time at the moment, sorry.

Your response: Sure, I am available.

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Great. This is the deal: A member of our faction got in the crossfire a little. To be specific: there are many people who want him dead. He told us that he has been feeling very strange for a few days and we suspect that he's been poisoned.

Your response: And what am I supposed to do?

NPC: Well, he is hiding out, and we do not want to attract attention by sending one of our known members to help him. That's where you feature. Nobody knows you yet, and it won't blow his cover. Just get a blood sample from him and bring it to me.

Your response: Um... yes... but if he is hiding out, how am I supposed to find him?

NPC: He goes by the name %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7145) and hides at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1)... You might not know this place good enough yet to find that yourself. Just use your Nav-Ray as a help, it shouldn't be a problem to find it then.

Your response: Good, how does he know he can trust me?

NPC: No matter what he says, reply with ´opposite ends meet´ - the password we agreed on. Good luck and be quick.

NPC: I don't know you, what do you want from me?

Your response: Uhh... Opposite ends meet.

NPC: Oh, does... did Jones send you? Any news... somehow, this isn't fun at all anymore!

Your response: Yes, Jones sent me. I'm supposed to get a blood sample from you.

NPC: Nothing else? Just to get a blood sample? ...well... okay. Here, take it.

Your response: Thanks, I will give it to Jones immediately.

NPC: When will he talk to me again? I really don't feel good, and I am scared shitless, okay?

Your response: I cannot tell you anything else, but I think Jones knows what he's doing.

NPC: I certainly hope so. Later then...

NPC: What's it? You already have the blood sample!

NPC: You did not finish your mission!

NPC: There you are. You found %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7145)? Do you have the blood sample?

Your response: Yes, I have it. He seemed very scared. Maybe you should hurry. I don't think he is too well.

NPC: I'm doing all I can do. You did your job very well, by the way, and I am grateful for that. I might have use for you again soon. Until then you should train your Passive Psi-Use skills. This will be very useful to help others or yourself in the future.

Your response: Thanks for the tip. I'll keep that in mind.

NPC: Of course, least I can do. Good luck in your training

NPC: Good thing you're here... Please tell me you have some time right now to do me a little favour.

Your response: I have too many other important matters to attend to.

Your response: Well, I have time...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: That's great. You remember the faction member you got the blood sample from? Well, our labs could not find anything extraordinary in it, but that doesn't mean much. We do not have the necessary equipment to find all modern poisons, viruses or nanites in existance.

Your response: Well, I do not have such equipment either, as you might notice...

NPC: I know that, silly. You're supposed to bring the blood sample to an external laboratory and get it analyzed by %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7146). He is already informed and is waiting for you. Be nice to him, he is always under a lot of stress.

Your response: Good, I just give him the blood and come back here, right?

NPC: It would be nice if you could wait for the result and bring it here with you. You know how urgent this is. %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7146) is at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1571) - should you not be able to find that, just use your Nav-Ray again.

NPC: What can I do for you? If it is not important, I'm gonna ask you to leave, I have much work.

Your response: Jones sent me about a blood analysis.

NPC: Aw geez, yeah... Put the sample somewhere on my table, will you?

Your response: Umm... not to be rude, but the whole matter is very urgent and I am supposed to take the analysis result right with me.

NPC: Who does Jones think he is? There are other people who want me to do stuff, too. Geez - give it to me, but you're gonna have to do me a favour.

Your response: What kind of favour?

NPC: If I am supposed to analyze this right now, you need to give my three loved ones their daily injections. They're late as it is.

Your response: What kind of injections?

NPC: Over there are the three cages. And I am gonna give you three needles, to give the little ones all they need. Remember: Norbert gets the red needle, Skippy gets the green one and Alina gets the blue one. Just remember that. Here, take them and shake a leg.

Your response: Yeah well but how do I know which one of your pets...

NPC: ...You're still here? Chop chop, the little ones are waiting! My goodness, does everyone else just dawdle?

NPC: Woof... woof... pant... yipe...

NPC: Yipe... howwwwl... argh...

NPC: Yipe... howwwwl... argh...

NPC: Squee? SQUEEEEEEEEE! Squeaaargh...

NPC: Squee? SQUEEEEEEEEE! Squeaaargh...

Your response: (Green needle)

Your response: (Blue needle)

NPC: Hsssssssssssssssssssssssssss.........

NPC: Hsssssssssssssssssssssssssss.........

NPC: Hsssssssssssssssssssssssssss.........

NPC: You didn't give their injections to my loved ones. Do that already!

NPC: You didn't give their injections to my loved ones. Do that already!

NPC: Ah, there you are. What took you so long? Did you at least do it?

Your response: Uh... yeah... I guess you could say that I did it, yes...

NPC: And, how are my loved ones? I hope Alina wasn't too much of a pain, you know how these little mischiefs can be... hehehe...

Your response: Superb... hehe... yeah.... They're all splendid...mhm...

NPC: I'm pleased to hear that. Thanks a bunch. You saved me a lot of trouble, thanks a lot. Here, I've analysed your sample, you can take it back to Jones.

Your response: I'm already on my way... enjoy!

NPC: Cya next time.

NPC: What are you still doing here? I thought you were in a hurry??

NPC: You did not finish your mission!

NPC: Ah, back again. Did everything work out? Do you have the analysis?

Your response: Yes, it worked out, more or less. Here, take it.

NPC: Great. Thanks a lot. I will give that analysis to our labs, they will tell us what's wrong. In the meantime, I advise you to train your Passive Psi-Use skills further and maybe also learn some basic fighting skills. Imagine you could help anyone, but get blown out of your shoes by a little wind.

Your response: Thanks, I think I would have done that anyway.

NPC: Come back later, there will be more to do.

NPC: There you are. Glad that I found you. I have work for you...

Your response: I have too much work myself at the moment, sorry

Your response: Sounds fine, I am almost bored.

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: I think I can cure your boredom. It's about that analysis result you brought me. Or what we could conclude from it, to be precise. %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7145) was poisoned indeed. Or maybe poisoned is not the right word. His blood is infected with specially built nanites. Your guess is as good as mine why anyone would go to that much trouble. Maybe he is just the guinea pig.

Your response: I'm not really familiar with nanites...

NPC: You don't need to be. I know somebody who is. He already got the mission from us and should be ready with a solution for our problem in time when you arrive. You're gonna find %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7150) at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1565). Be a little careful with him, he is a little mentally unstable.

NPC: Hee hee... yes, of course... that'll work out just fine... hee hee...

Your response: Um... excuse me? Am I interrupting you?

NPC: Oh! Gosh, you scared me... Don't sneak up on me like that.

Your response: Um... who did you just talk to?

NPC: Talk to? I'm alone at my table. Who am I supposed to talk to?

Your response: But you just... ah... nevermind. Jones sent me about the analysis of %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7145)...

NPC: Yes...

Your response: Yes... What?

NPC: What? Oh, sorry. Did you say something?

Your response: This is gonna be a good one. I am here because Mr. Jones sent me. He wants a solution for the nanite problem of %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7145)...

NPC: Nanites... yes... small critters... heehee... I can help with small critters. But I need poison glands.

Your response: What? Poisonglands? What the hell for, this is tech stuff!

NPC: I know tech stuff too, yes! But I need the glands of the little critters!

Your response: Have you gone bonkers? You're supposed to come up with a solution for the nanite problem. I'm not much of a techie, but I can tell that spider glands are not gonna be of much use.

NPC: Yesyes... the small critters. A solution will be easy with the green poisonglands. Everything will be fine... fine fine...

Your response: I think batshit would be more your league... Oh well. I'll get you green poisonglands, if you really want them. Useless as they may be. How many do you want and where do I get them?

NPC: Oh yay! Tiny Small Spideyspiders... everywhere... sewers or dark sidestreets... yes.... I want three... no, better make that four... or... bring me five, even... heehee... yes, I want five...

Your response: It's useless and I know it's useless but I am gonna get you 5 green poison glands, since it is obviously impossible to get you to work any other way...

NPC: Good, good. What are you talking about? Oh yes! Yes, get me the poison glands. Then we will see.

NPC: Umm what? Oh yes! You do not have the poison glands!! If I only knew... Oh yeah! Come back when you have them!

NPC: Ah, there you are. Where did you go all of a sudden? I wanted to give you the solution for the nanite problem you asked me about.

Your response: Here are your green poison glands... no questions, please.

NPC: My what? Why are you carrying that disgusting stuff around? Are you nuts?

Your response: I said no questions... just give me the stuff and I'll be on my merry little way...

NPC: You're weird, maybe you should get some counseling. But here - take it and then go.

Your response: I'm gonna do exactly that... thanks...

NPC: Now where was I? Ah, nevermind. Just go!!

NPC: Do I know you?! Oh! Aren't you... uh... just go already!

NPC: *cough* ... *cough* There you are. I already missed you... Any news from Jones? Anyone at all out there who gives a damn about me?

Your response: No worries. We have the solution. There are nanites in your body, that's why you feel so bad.

NPC: Nanites? This explains why the poison tests were all negative...

Your response: Exactly And I have the solution that will kill the nanites.

NPC: No, you don't...

NPC: Oh god, finally... Thank you so much. I'll inject it into me at once.

NPC: Thank you again! I'm feeling much better.

NPC: You did not finish your mission!

NPC: %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7145) already contacted me. He got his nanite injection and is already feeling a lot better. You did a really great job. A man owes you his life.

Your response: Yeah well, now my feet hurt and I had to swat spiders.

NPC: I don't want to let you go unrewarded. Take this psi module. It will be of good service to you. But like you saw with the spiders, a strong mind alone cannot always help you and sometimes you need to resort to force. You should not forget to train your fighting abilities at least a little bit, to be able to get by out there. Spiders are by far not the worst that you will come across.

Your response: Thanks for the tip, I will keep that in mind. And thank you for the psi module.

NPC: You're welcome. You did so much for our faction that we will surely meet again. Good luck until then. I now have other matters to attend to. Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

entries.title: Mission 2: The analysis
entries.description: Mr. Jones wants you to get a full analysis of the blood sampe from Dr. Fleming in Biological Research Laboratory (PLAZA SEC-3). If Dr. Fleming needs anything, help him out. Bring the results back to Mr. Jones.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

POSSIBLE PREREQUISITES
• Complete Mission 1: The blood sample
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Dr. Fleming
• Talk to Dog
• Talk to Rat
• Talk to Snake
• Talk to Dr. Fleming
• Collect Analysed blood sample
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 2,000 credits
• 2,000 experience

NPC: Ah, there you are. Where did you go all of a sudden? I wanted to give you the solution for the nanite problem you asked me about.

Your response: Here are your green poison glands... no questions, please.

NPC: My what? Why are you carrying that disgusting stuff around? Are you nuts?

Your response: I said no questions... just give me the stuff and I'll be on my merry little way...

NPC: You're weird, maybe you should get some counseling. But here - take it and then go.

Your response: I'm gonna do exactly that... thanks...

NPC: Now where was I? Ah, nevermind. Just go!!

NPC: Do I know you?! Oh! Aren't you... uh... just go already!

NPC: *cough* ... *cough* There you are. I already missed you... Any news from Jones? Anyone at all out there who gives a damn about me?

Your response: No worries. We have the solution. There are nanites in your body, that's why you feel so bad.

NPC: Nanites? This explains why the poison tests were all negative...

Your response: Exactly And I have the solution that will kill the nanites.

NPC: No, you don't...

NPC: Oh god, finally... Thank you so much. I'll inject it into me at once.

NPC: Thank you again! I'm feeling much better.

NPC: You did not finish your mission!

NPC: %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7145) already contacted me. He got his nanite injection and is already feeling a lot better. You did a really great job. A man owes you his life.

Your response: Yeah well, now my feet hurt and I had to swat spiders.

NPC: I don't want to let you go unrewarded. Take this psi module. It will be of good service to you. But like you saw with the spiders, a strong mind alone cannot always help you and sometimes you need to resort to force. You should not forget to train your fighting abilities at least a little bit, to be able to get by out there. Spiders are by far not the worst that you will come across.

Your response: Thanks for the tip, I will keep that in mind. And thank you for the psi module.

NPC: You're welcome. You did so much for our faction that we will surely meet again. Good luck until then. I now have other matters to attend to. Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

entries.title: Mission 3: The anti-poison
entries.description: Have Lewis Moore in Research Laboratory (VIAROSSO SEC-3) produce the anti-poison. Bring it to Hermann Schmidt in PLAZA SEC-1 and finally return to Mr. Jones.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

POSSIBLE PREREQUISITES
• Complete Mission 2: The analysis
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Lewis Moore
• Collect 5 × Green Poisongland
• Talk to Lewis Moore
• Collect Anti-Nanites
• Talk to Hermann Schmidt
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 3,000 credits
• 3,000 experience

entries.title: Mission 1: The Password
entries.description: Obtain the password from Elliot Emons in PEPPER SEC-3. Afterwards bring the data from the Databank in the Small Database Link (PLAZA SEC-1) to Mr. Jones.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Elliot Emons
• Collect Data fragment
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 1,000 credits
• 1,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Oh, nice to see you. Got accommodated yet? I have a little something that needs to be done. Are you interested in helping me and your faction out a little?

Your response: I have no time right now.

Your response: Of course.

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Great... This is the deal: We need some data from a database, and a direct access would be too risky. That's why I want you go 'go in' and get that data for me. You need to get the password from... an informed person, though.

Your response: I basically just arrived, I can hardly find my shoes right now. How am I gonna find all this?

NPC: No Problem. The name of your contact is %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7161) and he is at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(7)... he will tell you where to find the database.

Your response: Yes, but how do I find him? I don't know the way...

NPC: Use your Nav-Ray. It should be easy to find the guy with that.

Your response: Okay... and when I have the data, I come back here to you, right?

NPC: Exactly - good luck.

NPC: Who are you? I don't know you.

Your response: Jones sent me for a password.

NPC: Ah, the netrunner, Jones wanted to send to me. You're late...

Your response: Sorry, I was trying to hurry up.

NPC: Hey, it's allright - I just don't have much time because I have other matters to attend. Anyway, the password is 'Silverfuture06# ...good luck.

Your response: Wait! Jones told me you could tell me where the database is.

NPC: You're a true blue youngblood, huh? The database is at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1583) - use your Nav-Ray to find the net access port.

NPC: The database is at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1583) - use your Nav-Ray to find the net access port, remember that the password is 'Silverfuture06#!

NPC: D A T A S E R V E R   ´ S I L - P 5´
PASSWORD:

Your response: SILVERFUTURE60

Your response: SILVERFEATURE06

Your response: SILVERFUTURE06

Your response: GOLDENFUTURE06

NPC: PASSWORD REJECTED

NPC: PASSWORD ACCEPTED

Your response: (Start Download...)

NPC: DOWNLOAD COMPLETE

NPC: ACCESS DENIED

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: You're back. Did everything work out?

Your response: Yes, it did. I have your data...

NPC: Hmmm... this data is encoded. Another problem that needs solving... First, thanks a lot.

Your response: No problem, glad I could help.

NPC: Good, because I might soon have another job for you. Until then, you should train your Hacking skills so you'll be able to crack even better security systems.

NPC: There you are. As if I called you... great. Do you have the free ressources to help me a little?

Your response: My ressources are limited right now, sorry.

Your response: At your service...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: It's about the data you downloaded for me. They need to be decoded by our mainframe. Then you need to upload the data onto the account 'Silverdivision' from a different terminal.

Your response: First things first... where do I decode the data and where do I upload it?

NPC: You decode the data at a special terminal in a stealthed %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1462). The access panel for the database is located in Pepper Park Sec-1. Don't forget your hacktool to hack into the database! And watch out for those Intrusion Countermeasure Daemons. You're not tough enough yet to mess with them!

Your response: Good, and then?

NPC: The node where you need to upload the decoded data is at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1585)... it is possible that you will meet resistance in form of some firewall bots, since it is not part of our network. Be prepared.

NPC: PLEASE SELECT DESIRED FUNCTIONALITY

Your response: (Decode data)

NPC: PLEASE INSERT DATA FOR DECODING

Your response: (Enter Data)

NPC: DATA DECODING STARTED
PROGRESS: 24 PERCENT

Your response: ... Hmmm ...

NPC: PROGRESS: 62 PERCENT

Your response: ... this is taking forever ...

NPC: PROGRESS: 87 PERCENT

Your response: ... oh man ...

NPC: PROGRESS: 100 PERCENT
DECODING FINISHED

NPC: DECODING NOT ACCESSIBLE. SYSTEM RECALIBRATION IN PROGRESS

NPC: SESSION TERMINATED : DATA NOT ENCODED!

NPC: SUPERNODE X363KST02 - 2
PLEASE SELECT DESIRED FUNCTIONALITY

Your response: (Upload data to net account)

NPC: SUPERNODE X363KST02 - 2
PLEASE ENTER ACCOUNTNAME

Your response: Silverdecision

Your response: Silverdivision

Your response: Goldendivision

Your response: Silverdivisor

NPC: SUPERNODE X363KST02 - 2
ACCOUNT NOT FOUND - SESSION TERMINATED

NPC: SUPERNODE X363KST02 - 2
UPLOAD COMPLETE - SESSION TERMINATED

NPC: SESSION TERMINATED

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: That was quick... did you send the data?

Your response: Yes, I did... easy as ever.

NPC: Nice to see that you enjoy browsing through the net. But remember that there is a real world out here, where you might not be as strong as you are in there. You should also train some basic combat skills, to be able to defend yourself in the real world. You will never be as strong as a real fighter, but it is important not to ignore your body.

Your response: Thanks for the tip, I will get to training right away.

NPC: Very good. Come back later, I will have more stuff for you to do.

NPC: Hello... you look like you want to help me out a little again.

Your response: Not at the moment.

Your response: Sure, shoot.

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: That's good... it's not much. You need to go to %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7161) at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(7) again and give him the password to the database you uploaded the data to. He will probably give you something for me then.

Your response: And what is the password?

NPC: The password is 'Quicksilver7' ...keep it well. If it wasn't so important, we could have sent it through the net.

NPC: Ah, the youngblood again... what's up?

Your response: I'm supposed to give you the password for the server with the decoded data.

NPC: Oooohh... yess... of course... gimme, gimme!

Your response: Well... the password is 'Quicksilver7'...

Your response: It's 'Quicksilver7'! I remembered it this time!

NPC: Hehehehe... thanks, youngblood - nice doggie.

Your response: Uh... yes... you're welcome... Jones told me, you have something for him?

NPC: Oh yes, I almost forgot... I do have something for him. Your body in a bag, you stupid idiot.

Your response: Uh... Excuse me? What...

NPC: Shut it - you played your part nicely and Jones didn't notice a thing. It never even occured to him, that I could be a double agent. Yeah well... he is surely gonna notice when he finds his newest pet chopped up into parts in his mail... Hehehe...

NPC: You didn't finish your mission. Come back when you did.

NPC: You look a little beaten... where have you been? What's wrong?

Your response: I was just delivering the password and then I had to off your stupid contact person! That's wrong!

NPC: What the fried f..! Why?! Have you lost your mind? Our clients will hold me responsible and have my ass!

Your response: Calm down... whoever those clients were - they wanted to screw us over! He was a double agent and worked for the other side. Whoever that other side is...

NPC: Oh shits... and you finished him before he could get his hands on the data? You did a great service to us. If this material in its decoded form had fallen into the wrong hands, many people would have had problems. Really, you helped us a lot.

Your response: I didn't have much of a choice... the man tried to kill me!

NPC: Take this TL90 Hacktool as a token of my appreciation and the appreciation of our faction - it will surely be of as much help to you as you were to our faction. Furthermore, you should keep training your Hacking skill. But as you saw, it is essential to be able to also defend yourself in the real world.

Your response: Thank you...

NPC: I have other matters to attend now and leave you to yourself. If you keep training hard, you can get hired by a clan community. They always need good hackers. Good luck in your further way. We will surely meet again. Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

entries.title: Mission 2: Decoding the data
entries.description: Mr. Jones wants you to take care of decoding the data. Use the Decryption Terminal in the stealthed Low Sec Storage Database which you can access in Pepper Park Sec-1. Don't forget your hacktool to hack into the database! After that load the data up at the Terminal in Upload Station (VIAROSSO SEC-1).

One time

1

POSSIBLE PREREQUISITES
• Complete Mission 1: The Password
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Decryption Terminal
• Collect Unprotected data
• Talk to Upload Terminal
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 2,000 credits
• 2,000 experience

NPC: Good, because I might soon have another job for you. Until then, you should train your Hacking skills so you'll be able to crack even better security systems.

NPC: There you are. As if I called you... great. Do you have the free ressources to help me a little?

Your response: My ressources are limited right now, sorry.

Your response: At your service...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: It's about the data you downloaded for me. They need to be decoded by our mainframe. Then you need to upload the data onto the account 'Silverdivision' from a different terminal.

Your response: First things first... where do I decode the data and where do I upload it?

NPC: You decode the data at a special terminal in a stealthed %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1462). The access panel for the database is located in Pepper Park Sec-1. Don't forget your hacktool to hack into the database! And watch out for those Intrusion Countermeasure Daemons. You're not tough enough yet to mess with them!

Your response: Good, and then?

NPC: The node where you need to upload the decoded data is at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1585)... it is possible that you will meet resistance in form of some firewall bots, since it is not part of our network. Be prepared.

NPC: PLEASE SELECT DESIRED FUNCTIONALITY

Your response: (Decode data)

NPC: PLEASE INSERT DATA FOR DECODING

Your response: (Enter Data)

NPC: DATA DECODING STARTED
PROGRESS: 24 PERCENT

Your response: ... Hmmm ...

NPC: PROGRESS: 62 PERCENT

Your response: ... this is taking forever ...

NPC: PROGRESS: 87 PERCENT

Your response: ... oh man ...

NPC: PROGRESS: 100 PERCENT
DECODING FINISHED

NPC: DECODING NOT ACCESSIBLE. SYSTEM RECALIBRATION IN PROGRESS

NPC: SESSION TERMINATED : DATA NOT ENCODED!

NPC: SUPERNODE X363KST02 - 2
PLEASE SELECT DESIRED FUNCTIONALITY

Your response: (Upload data to net account)

NPC: SUPERNODE X363KST02 - 2
PLEASE ENTER ACCOUNTNAME

Your response: Silverdecision

Your response: Silverdivision

Your response: Goldendivision

Your response: Silverdivisor

NPC: SUPERNODE X363KST02 - 2
ACCOUNT NOT FOUND - SESSION TERMINATED

NPC: SUPERNODE X363KST02 - 2
UPLOAD COMPLETE - SESSION TERMINATED

NPC: SESSION TERMINATED

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: That was quick... did you send the data?

Your response: Yes, I did... easy as ever.

NPC: Nice to see that you enjoy browsing through the net. But remember that there is a real world out here, where you might not be as strong as you are in there. You should also train some basic combat skills, to be able to defend yourself in the real world. You will never be as strong as a real fighter, but it is important not to ignore your body.

Your response: Thanks for the tip, I will get to training right away.

NPC: Very good. Come back later, I will have more stuff for you to do.

NPC: Hello... you look like you want to help me out a little again.

Your response: Not at the moment.

Your response: Sure, shoot.

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: That's good... it's not much. You need to go to %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7161) at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(7) again and give him the password to the database you uploaded the data to. He will probably give you something for me then.

Your response: And what is the password?

NPC: The password is 'Quicksilver7' ...keep it well. If it wasn't so important, we could have sent it through the net.

NPC: Ah, the youngblood again... what's up?

Your response: I'm supposed to give you the password for the server with the decoded data.

NPC: Oooohh... yess... of course... gimme, gimme!

Your response: Well... the password is 'Quicksilver7'...

Your response: It's 'Quicksilver7'! I remembered it this time!

NPC: Hehehehe... thanks, youngblood - nice doggie.

Your response: Uh... yes... you're welcome... Jones told me, you have something for him?

NPC: Oh yes, I almost forgot... I do have something for him. Your body in a bag, you stupid idiot.

Your response: Uh... Excuse me? What...

NPC: Shut it - you played your part nicely and Jones didn't notice a thing. It never even occured to him, that I could be a double agent. Yeah well... he is surely gonna notice when he finds his newest pet chopped up into parts in his mail... Hehehe...

NPC: You didn't finish your mission. Come back when you did.

NPC: You look a little beaten... where have you been? What's wrong?

Your response: I was just delivering the password and then I had to off your stupid contact person! That's wrong!

NPC: What the fried f..! Why?! Have you lost your mind? Our clients will hold me responsible and have my ass!

Your response: Calm down... whoever those clients were - they wanted to screw us over! He was a double agent and worked for the other side. Whoever that other side is...

NPC: Oh shits... and you finished him before he could get his hands on the data? You did a great service to us. If this material in its decoded form had fallen into the wrong hands, many people would have had problems. Really, you helped us a lot.

Your response: I didn't have much of a choice... the man tried to kill me!

NPC: Take this TL90 Hacktool as a token of my appreciation and the appreciation of our faction - it will surely be of as much help to you as you were to our faction. Furthermore, you should keep training your Hacking skill. But as you saw, it is essential to be able to also defend yourself in the real world.

Your response: Thank you...

NPC: I have other matters to attend now and leave you to yourself. If you keep training hard, you can get hired by a clan community. They always need good hackers. Good luck in your further way. We will surely meet again. Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

entries.title: Mission 1: The Mole
entries.description: Go to the PLAZA SEC-2 and get Gilbert McQueen to tell you who the contact person is.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Gilbert McQueen
• Talk to Fidel Bartlett
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 1,000 credits
• 1,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Ah, hello! How are you feeling in your new home? I have a small problem at the moment, and I cannot handle it myself right now. Could you help me with it?

Your response: Not right now, sorry.

Your response: Sure, I'll do that.

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Here's what it's about: The routes of our... not entirely legal transports have been checked too often lately. That got our attention. But now we heard from an external source, that we have a mole in our middle who has been mouthing off about things he is not even supposed to know.

Your response: And how am I supposed to find him?

NPC: You're not supposed to find him. %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7172) will tell you what to do. He can be trusted, and at the moment, he knows more than I do.

Your response: Okay... but where do I find %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7172)?

NPC: He is at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(2)... use your Nav-Ray to get there, if you don't know the way.

NPC: Hey... how's it hangin'?

Your response: Jones sent me... it's about the... mole.

NPC: Ah... yo - aight. How the old pimp be doin'? Gotta give 'im a call later. Eh... whatever... I heard from %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7173) that he knows who's the piece-a-shit. But the old sucker talks a lotta bull, if he's not with some bitch or drinkin' till his noodle won't stand up anymore, he's slappin' his smuggler homeboys around.

Your response: Sounds like a swell fella. Where do I find him?

NPC: Yo, where could that be? At %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1575) of course. Look at PEPPER SEC-3 for the entrance. But watch yer back. These smugglers are packin' heat...

NPC: You can find the Smuggler Caver in PEPPER SEC-3!

NPC: Who are you? If you want shit, I'm all out of it and waiting for the next delivery.

Your response: No - I'm here because %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7172) sent me. He said you knew more about the mole who rats out the routes.

NPC: Yes, I know... Shit - sure I know who's behind that.

Your response: Would you be willing to tell me?

NPC: Hehehe... sure!... course... um... you don't have some booze for me, do ya?

Your response: No, I don't, and now please tell me who's the mole or Mr. Jones might be very disappointed.

NPC: Aw crap... why didn't you say that Jones wants to know... hehehe... stupid old f...! I'm gonna send Jones a message over the net with the name. Got a couple of questions about that last payment for him anyway...

Your response: Okay... but don't forget it... I don't want to have to come back.

NPC: Yeah yeah... same to you. Now piss off!

Your response: I will... by the way, anyone ever told you that lighting a fire in a closed environment is a bad idea? - really bad for your health!

NPC: GET YOUR ASS OUT!!!

NPC: GET YOUR ASS OUT!!!

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Smells like a fire in here... Oh... you're back. I already have news from %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7173), the dirty bastard. You did your job very well.

Your response: It's a little smelly down at the smugglers...

NPC: I'll try and find out the mole's position. Until then, you should train your Tech-Combat skills. It's a rough world out there and nobody is gonna wrap you in silk. Come back later - I will have more stuff for you to do.

NPC: Great! I need a helping hand! How does a little action sound?

Your response: Not at the moment...

Your response: Action sounds fun... What is it?

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: We located the mole... He is just a small fish though, and I want you to interrogate, then terminate him. Will you do that?

Your response: Do pigs honk?.. What's the name of the guy and where do I find him?

NPC: His name is %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7174) and he is at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1561)... but please be careful when you go there. I don't know what else could be crawling in this region... Just use your Nav-Ray again to get there.

NPC: Who are you and what do you want from me? I don't know you!

Your response: Shut your face! I'm the one asking questions here.

NPC: But I...

Your response: Tell me why you little maggot rat out our smuggling routes! On whose payroll are you?

NPC: W... what? Me? Are you pulling my leg? Who said that? Bartlett, that jerkface? But he's the one who's snitching on everyone just to get a little profit from it. I found out about that mess and that's why he wants to see me dead since weeks. Or what did you think why I am hiding out here where he can't find me?

Your response: So Bartlett is the traitor? And he got Jones to send a bounty hunter after you, because he couldn't find you? A likely story...

NPC: But it's the truth, man!!! Do I look like I am under the protection of some third party who wants to buy my infos?

Your response: Allright already. I believe you. I couldn't stand that ugly bastard anyway.

NPC: Please take care of him. I want to leave this dump, but with him out there, I can't.

Your response: Yeah well, I'm gonna report everything to Jones and we will see what's gonna happen. See you soon...

NPC: Okay, hurry.

NPC: Jones is waiting!

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: I knew you are the right person for the job! Did you off him? What did he say?

Your response: No, he's still alive. He's not the mole.

NPC: What? But who is it then?

Your response: Bartlett is the mole. And because he wasn't able to find the guy himself, he put up a wrong trail for us.

NPC: Fidel Bartlett! I bet he did it because some of his payments were a little late. The disgusting pig will just drink it all up anyway. Good thing he didn't suspect us to talk to %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7174) first.

Your response: Yes, I guess he thought we would just kill him.

NPC: Come back later - I need to think. Until then, you can keep training on your Tech-Combat skills. You will soon have use for your abilities - rest assured of that!

NPC: Back already? You can hardly wait to put the lights of that bastard out, right?

Your response: I have to do something else first...

Your response: You can say that again...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Very good. But do not kill the pig right away, okay? %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7173) is most assuredly still at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1575) - go there. Ask him how he wants to compensate us for all that trouble... we're businessmen after all. If he tries to resist, get rid of him... will be fine by me then.

NPC: Hey, the little jerkface is back. What do you want?

Your response: Answers... You thought you could lead us to a wrong trail but that plan doesn't seem to have worked...

NPC: What are you saying?

Your response: That you are the mole who has been selling our transports!

NPC: Hawhaw... smart little jerkface... and now?

Your response: Jones is willing to listen to your suggestions on how you could recompensate us.

NPC: Jones the asshole can kiss my hairy smelly ass!

Your response: Is that your suggestion? I don't think he is gonna be satisfied with that one...

NPC: No, he's not. I don't give two shits. What is he gonna do? I'm just leaving.

Your response: I cannot allow that...

NPC: Hawhawhaw... and what is the little jerkface gonna do about it? Kill me? Yeah right - GUYS! KILL THAT JERKFACE!

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Is that blood on your jacket?

Your response: Could be...

NPC: So the diplomatic way didn't work out, huh?

Your response: You could say that, yes.

NPC: It's okay. That mess needed to be cleaned up. You did a very good job. I wanna give you something as a reward.

Your response: Thanks... I would have killed him for free, though.

NPC: You have proven to be invaluable. That should not go unrewarded. Take this stealth tool... it will surely be of great service to you. Here, take it.

Your response: Wow... thanks, I'm surely gonna have use for that...

NPC: You have proven to be invaluable. That should not go unrewarded. Take this stealth tool... it will surely be of great service to you. Here, take it.

Your response: Wow... thanks, I'm surely gonna have use for that...

NPC: I now have other things to do. Other matters require my attention. Keep training and you might be one of the big ones someday. Thank you again in the name of our faction. We will surely meet again. Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

NPC: I now have other things to do. Other matters require my attention. Keep training and you might be one of the big ones someday. Thank you again in the name of our faction. We will surely meet again. Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

entries.title: Mission 2: Ask first, then shoot
entries.description: Question Anton Childers in the Lost Outskirt (PEPPER SEC-1) and eliminate him if he is guilty. %SHOWONTARGETSUCCESS(0, Report the treason to Mr. Jones.)
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

POSSIBLE PREREQUISITES
• Complete Mission 1: The Mole
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Anton Childers
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 2,000 credits
• 2,000 experience

entries.description: Obtain all the information you can from Tom Carpenter in PEPPER SEC-2. Make sure he'll never talk to anyone else when you're done with him.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

POSSIBLE PREREQUISITES
• Complete Mission 1: Torture
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Tom Carpenter
• Defeat Tom Carpenter
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 2,000 credits
• 2,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Good to see you... Feeling at home yet? I hope you like it. There is a small problem I have to handle and I thought it would be good if I could put your abilities to use here. Can you spare some time?

Your response: At the moment, I am forced to decline.

Your response: Of course I can.

Your response: I don't need your help Mr. Jones, I'm doing fine on my own. Thanks for the offer though!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Great... Let me tell you about the problem. Lately, there have been a lot of incursions by a radical society and they are gaining power. We already have the psychos, drug freaks, syndicates, Gentanks, sects and religious fanatics... we can't tolerate radicals right now.

Your response: You want me to wipe them out?

NPC: That is our final goal. We need to find out where they hide first, though.

Your response: And how am I gonna find out?

NPC: A few of your believing friends caught a prostitute from the red light district, who has been trafficking with these radicals. You should interrogate her a little... by force if necessary.

Your response: Okay, I can do that. What next?

NPC: Well... she knows of us and she could talk... make sure that she can not.

Your response: Yeah, I can do that, too. Where to I find the believers who found her?

NPC: You'll find her at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1563)... use your Nav-Ray to get there.

NPC: Argh... who the hell are you sick bastards? What do you want from me... I didn't do nothing wrong...

Your response: I'm asking the questions here. Who we are is none of your business.

NPC: Let me down. Whoever you are, you got the wrong girl!

Your response: I guess we will see about that... I want to ask you some questions.

NPC: Piss off, you sick fuck!

Your response: Tsk tsk tsk... we won't get far that way. You do not mind me giving you a little electric shock to soften that tongue of yours now do you...

NPC: No no, I will tell you everything! I'll do anything you want!

Your response: Much better... what do you know about the radicals, who have been increasing in numbers lately?

NPC: What? Who? I know nothing... I don't know who you mean.

Your response: You're pretty much asking me to hurt you...

NPC: Shit! Please... if... if I tell you... something. They... they will kill me....

Your response: And what do you think I will do if you don't?

NPC: Allright... ...I... there is this guy ...who... he stops by from time to time... has much... much money... and wants really sick... stuff for it... please... please let me go...

Your response: One thing after another... What's his name?

NPC: I can't tell you that... I don't know his name...

Your response: Sorry, but I do not believe you... do I have to... ?

NPC: Allright ...Zoid... people... they... they call him... Zoid... I don't... know anything else, honest...

Your response: See, that wasn't so hard... why make it hard for yourself. Thank you.

NPC: Hey... wait... wait up... I wanna go... let go of me...

Your response: Oh yeah... I entirely forgot... I will tell one of these fine folks to let you down...

NPC: Yeah right... fuck off, you sick motherfucker!

Your response: Goodbye... though I doubt that...

NPC: ... ... ...

NPC: Let me go!!!

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: There you are. Were you successful?

Your response: Of course.

NPC: And? What can you report?

Your response: She used to have a punter named Zoid, who has connections to the radicals.

NPC: Hmmm... that's a street name... no normal mother calls her child Zoid. I'll try and find out who's behind that identity. You did a good job. I will have use for you soon again. Until then, you should train your Aggressive Psi-Use abilities... you will surely need those later.

NPC: I already awaited you. There is more work. Are you ready?

Your response: Not at the moment...

Your response: Sure thing...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great... I found out who's behind the name Zoid. His real name is %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7186) and if my sources are correct, he should be at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(6). Go there, look for him and ask him for the location of the radicals.

Your response: Just ask him?

NPC: It wouldn't be bad to start wiping out the group with him first... Come back to me when everything is finished.

NPC: Yes? Can I help you somehow?

Your response: Yes, by telling me about the organisation you work for.

NPC: W...what? Who sent you?

Your response: Who sent me is of secondary importance. Primarily, you should be worried about your health and well-being, and tell me immediately where this radical organisation is located.

NPC: Sh... Shit... I... I... didn't do... anything. What do you want?

Your response: Answers... I want answers.

NPC: O...okay... but please don't hurt me. The guys are laying low at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1559)... I do their accounting but I have nothing to do with their actions...

Your response: See, that wasn't that hard.

NPC: G... good... May I go now?

Your response: Oh yes... no, I cannot have you leave, sorry...

NPC: ARGH!

NPC: I told you everything!

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Did you find %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7186) yet?

Your response: Yes, he was there.

NPC: And what did he have to tell?

Your response: He spilled the beans that the radicals are located at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1559).

NPC: Very good... now we can finally wipe them all out, knowing where they are.

Your response: Should I do that?

NPC: No, not yet. Let me get some information about their strength first. Until then you should keep training your Aggressive Psi-Use... you should report back in due time.

NPC: Great. You always appear at the right moment. Can you handle something of smaller scale for me?

Your response: Not right now, sorry.

Your response: I can handle bigger-scaled things, too.

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Then it is time to give these bastards a beating where it hurts. I had a few checks run to see if the radicals are in fact located at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1559) and they do.

Your response: So what should I do?

NPC: You should go in, and go in hard. Kill at least five of them. This, and the previous death of their accountant, should show them who's the boss and that they should pull back on their actions a little.

Your response: Then I'll go to %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1559) to kick some ass.

NPC: You go and do that.

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: You look a little beat. I hope you made the corks pop.

Your response: Oh yes... I sure did.

NPC: Great... I hope we will not hear from these suckers for some time. You did a fantastic job. Not that I awaited anything else. Take this APU-Module with my thanks... It will be of good service to you.

Your response: Thanks a lot...

NPC: I now have other matters to attend and wish you good luck. You did a great job for your faction and we will surely meet again... Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

entries.title: Mission 3: Death
entries.description: Eliminate all the radicalist members that are currently in Ghost District (PEPPER SEC-1).
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

POSSIBLE PREREQUISITES
• Complete Mission 2: Extortion
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Defeat 5 × Radical
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 3,000 credits
• 3,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Good to see you... Feeling at home yet? I hope you like it. There is a small problem I have to handle and I thought it would be good if I could put your abilities to use here. Can you spare some time?

Your response: At the moment, I am forced to decline.

Your response: Of course I can.

Your response: I don't need your help Mr. Jones, I'm doing fine on my own. Thanks for the offer though!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Great... Let me tell you about the problem. Lately, there have been a lot of incursions by a radical society and they are gaining power. We already have the psychos, drug freaks, syndicates, Gentanks, sects and religious fanatics... we can't tolerate radicals right now.

Your response: You want me to wipe them out?

NPC: That is our final goal. We need to find out where they hide first, though.

Your response: And how am I gonna find out?

NPC: A few of your believing friends caught a prostitute from the red light district, who has been trafficking with these radicals. You should interrogate her a little... by force if necessary.

Your response: Okay, I can do that. What next?

NPC: Well... she knows of us and she could talk... make sure that she can not.

Your response: Yeah, I can do that, too. Where to I find the believers who found her?

NPC: You'll find her at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1563)... use your Nav-Ray to get there.

NPC: Argh... who the hell are you sick bastards? What do you want from me... I didn't do nothing wrong...

Your response: I'm asking the questions here. Who we are is none of your business.

NPC: Let me down. Whoever you are, you got the wrong girl!

Your response: I guess we will see about that... I want to ask you some questions.

NPC: Piss off, you sick fuck!

Your response: Tsk tsk tsk... we won't get far that way. You do not mind me giving you a little electric shock to soften that tongue of yours now do you...

NPC: No no, I will tell you everything! I'll do anything you want!

Your response: Much better... what do you know about the radicals, who have been increasing in numbers lately?

NPC: What? Who? I know nothing... I don't know who you mean.

Your response: You're pretty much asking me to hurt you...

NPC: Shit! Please... if... if I tell you... something. They... they will kill me....

Your response: And what do you think I will do if you don't?

NPC: Allright... ...I... there is this guy ...who... he stops by from time to time... has much... much money... and wants really sick... stuff for it... please... please let me go...

Your response: One thing after another... What's his name?

NPC: I can't tell you that... I don't know his name...

Your response: Sorry, but I do not believe you... do I have to... ?

NPC: Allright ...Zoid... people... they... they call him... Zoid... I don't... know anything else, honest...

Your response: See, that wasn't so hard... why make it hard for yourself. Thank you.

NPC: Hey... wait... wait up... I wanna go... let go of me...

Your response: Oh yeah... I entirely forgot... I will tell one of these fine folks to let you down...

NPC: Yeah right... fuck off, you sick motherfucker!

Your response: Goodbye... though I doubt that...

NPC: ... ... ...

NPC: Let me go!!!

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: There you are. Were you successful?

Your response: Of course.

NPC: And? What can you report?

Your response: She used to have a punter named Zoid, who has connections to the radicals.

NPC: Hmmm... that's a street name... no normal mother calls her child Zoid. I'll try and find out who's behind that identity. You did a good job. I will have use for you soon again. Until then, you should train your Aggressive Psi-Use abilities... you will surely need those later.

NPC: I already awaited you. There is more work. Are you ready?

Your response: Not at the moment...

Your response: Sure thing...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great... I found out who's behind the name Zoid. His real name is %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7186) and if my sources are correct, he should be at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(6). Go there, look for him and ask him for the location of the radicals.

Your response: Just ask him?

NPC: It wouldn't be bad to start wiping out the group with him first... Come back to me when everything is finished.

NPC: Yes? Can I help you somehow?

Your response: Yes, by telling me about the organisation you work for.

NPC: W...what? Who sent you?

Your response: Who sent me is of secondary importance. Primarily, you should be worried about your health and well-being, and tell me immediately where this radical organisation is located.

NPC: Sh... Shit... I... I... didn't do... anything. What do you want?

Your response: Answers... I want answers.

NPC: O...okay... but please don't hurt me. The guys are laying low at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1559)... I do their accounting but I have nothing to do with their actions...

Your response: See, that wasn't that hard.

NPC: G... good... May I go now?

Your response: Oh yes... no, I cannot have you leave, sorry...

NPC: ARGH!

NPC: I told you everything!

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Did you find %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7186) yet?

Your response: Yes, he was there.

NPC: And what did he have to tell?

Your response: He spilled the beans that the radicals are located at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1559).

NPC: Very good... now we can finally wipe them all out, knowing where they are.

Your response: Should I do that?

NPC: No, not yet. Let me get some information about their strength first. Until then you should keep training your Aggressive Psi-Use... you should report back in due time.

NPC: Great. You always appear at the right moment. Can you handle something of smaller scale for me?

Your response: Not right now, sorry.

Your response: I can handle bigger-scaled things, too.

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Then it is time to give these bastards a beating where it hurts. I had a few checks run to see if the radicals are in fact located at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1559) and they do.

Your response: So what should I do?

NPC: You should go in, and go in hard. Kill at least five of them. This, and the previous death of their accountant, should show them who's the boss and that they should pull back on their actions a little.

Your response: Then I'll go to %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1559) to kick some ass.

NPC: You go and do that.

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: You look a little beat. I hope you made the corks pop.

Your response: Oh yes... I sure did.

NPC: Great... I hope we will not hear from these suckers for some time. You did a fantastic job. Not that I awaited anything else. Take this APU-Module with my thanks... It will be of good service to you.

Your response: Thanks a lot...

NPC: I now have other matters to attend and wish you good luck. You did a great job for your faction and we will surely meet again... Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!
