entries.title: Mission 1: The ransom exchange
entries.description: Bring the ransom money to Alexander Pelletier in VIAROSSO SEC-2. Return to Mr. Jones once it's done.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Alexander Pelletier
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 1,000 credits
• 1,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: There you are. You're coming just at the right moment. Do you have the time to do something for me?

Your response: I have other things to do at the moment.

Your response: Yes, I do.

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Great. Here's the deal: One of our scientists went missing some time ago. Yesterday, we got a notice by a group who apparently has taken him captive. He is an essential part of our research division and we cannot afford any delays on the current projects.

Your response: And what am I supposed to do?

NPC: The kidnappers didn't ask for horrendous amounts, so we decided to give them what they want. Your job is the delivery of this briefcase.

Your response: And where should I take this briefcase?

NPC: Bring it to a %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7194) at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(4)... probably not his real name, but who cares. If you don't know how to get there, use your Nav-Ray to show you the way.

NPC: If you don't have something important to say, buzz off.

Your response: Jones sent me to deliver this briefcase.

NPC: Oh... that's why you're here. Very good - Jones made the right decision. Give me the briefcase and his scientist will soon be home free again.

Your response: Here, take it.

NPC: Ah... exactly what we wanted to have. You did your job very good...

Your response: I'm gonna go back to Jones and tell him you received your delivery.

NPC: You do that...

NPC: I guess Jones is waiting..

NPC: Come back when you finished your job!

NPC: Did you find the contact person and give him the briefcase?

Your response: Yes, I have... he seemed satisfied and said he would let our scientist go.

NPC: What? Wasn't he there and came with you?

Your response: Ahm... no... I just gave him the briefcase. Nobody else was there.

NPC: Damn... we agreed to something different. But let's hope for the best, that they will let our man go anyway.

Your response: I'm sorry, but you didn't tell me that.

NPC: I'ts okay. You didn't know. I'll surely have more to do for you soon. Until then, you should train your Aggressive PSI-Use skills a little. Come back to me later.

NPC: Good thing you're back. We have a little situation and I need your help.

Your response: I don't have the time to help at the moment.

Your response: What can I help you with?

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Our scientist %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7195), who should have been released, was not delivered to us. I already feared as much, but unfortunately I was right. Luckily we put a little tracker into the briefcase and could find its location.

Your response: And I'm supposed to go in there and get our guy out?

NPC: Exactly! He is at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1561)... A little unclear environment, you shouldn't go too far. I can't say what dangers will await you there. %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7195) should be near the center. I cannot be more precise, sorry.

Your response: I think that should be enough. Do I get there with the Nav-Ray too?

NPC: Yes, the Nav-Ray will also show the way to %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1561)... While you free %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7195), I will try to find out who is behind this entire affair. Good Luck...

NPC: Lost your key, bastard? So you need to climb over the fence? I told you guys a hundred times now, that I am not gonna break this code - you can break my other leg, it won't help. So piss off!

Your response: Psssst... Jones sent me. I'm here to free you...

NPC: What? Oh son of a - finally! ... SHIT! They saw you... behind you!

NPC: There are still kidnappers alive!!! Help me!!!

NPC: Whew... that was close... I would like to help you, but my leg is broken. The bastards shattered it. So I won't be able to get outta here. Leave me behind and tell Jones, that Zoomer is the head of these kidnappers. He knows who that is. I can't get out here and I think it's better that I still play the prisoner.

NPC: Come back when you finished your job!

NPC: You're back... but where is %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7195)?

Your response: Still there... his leg is broken and he can't move. I'm supposed to tell you, that Zoomer is the kidnapper.

NPC: Zoomer? Dammit... the bastard! First he steals highly secret faction data and runs off with it and now he kidnaps %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7195)... I need to think... Come back later. Until then, you should train your Passive PSI-Use skills. You should try to find a good balance between your aggressive and your passive PSI skills, which of course depends on what works out best for you... Good luck and come back soon.

NPC: It is time for a swift kick in the ass of some choice people. Are you ready?

Your response: Not yet...

Your response: Sure!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Okay, great! Zoomer, the head of the kidnappers in reality goes by the name of %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7197)... He used to work for us, but one day he broke into our servers and took off with very sensible data, to sell it to the highest bidder. And trust me: There are people who will bid A LOT for that. He doesn't seem to have been able to decode the data so he caught one of our scientists to force him to do that.

Your response: He told me that he didn't help them...

NPC: True... that's why he wanted a decoder from us in exchange for our man, he knew of his importance for us. The decoder we gave him can't even handle that much data, which he surely must have noticed by now...

Your response: But then everything's good, right?

NPC: Not exactly. %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7197) can still be dangerous to us. We must find out who he intended to sell the data to, and then we need to wipe him out.

Your response: And you want me to do that...

NPC: Oh yeah. Go back to %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1561) and look for the bastard. He should be around somewhere. The briefcase is near a water source of some sorts. It is likely that %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7197) will be there, too. If you found him, do not kill him at once, get the information from him first. Then you should get rid of the trash. You should know how to do that by now...

NPC: Who are you? You're not with my men...

Your response: Damn straight. Jones sent me... I think you know why.

NPC: Hehehehe... the old bastard finally got wise, huh?

Your response: Yes he did... And now tell me who you wanted to sell your data to or I'll be forced to open a can of whoopass on you.

NPC: Hehehe... oh look how I'm shaking... hahahaa... you'll get nothing from me and it would be of no use for you anyway, because you're not gonna get out of this one alive... GUYS! Put this maggot back into the dirt!

NPC: You're supposed to take %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7197) to the dumpster. What are you doing here? Go do your job!

NPC: Come back when you finished your job!

NPC: You look a little shaken... what happened?

Your response: Let's just say, %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7197) wasn't entirely defenseless.

NPC: So you killed him. What did he say?

Your response: Besides 'hahaha' and 'hehehe' not much...

NPC: That's too bad... but cannot be changed I guess. You did your job well... we can get our scientist back without a problem and the danger of our data falling into the wrong hands is banished, too.

Your response: Thanks, it was hard work...

NPC: I really have to thank you a lot. You were of great service to your faction and that shouldn't go unrewarded. I was recently able to aquire two new Psi-Module types, and I would like to give you one. You will surely love them. It is a special attack module and a defense module. Which one do you want?

Your response: Attack is the best defense. I want the attack module.

Your response: I cannot fight when I'm dead. I'm taking the defense module.

NPC: As you wish. Here, take the module. You should keep going for that direction then, to maximize your abilities. I will now leave you to yourself and wish you the best of luck on your way. We will surely meet again. Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

NPC: As you wish. Here, take the module. You should keep going for that direction then, to maximize your abilities. I will now leave you to yourself and wish you the best of luck on your way. We will surely meet again. Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

entries.title: Mission 2: Hostage Rescue
entries.description: Make sure the hostage is released. Prof. Dr. Lenard is being held in Lost Outskirt (PEPPER SEC-1).
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

POSSIBLE PREREQUISITES
• Complete Mission 1: The ransom exchange
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Prof. Dr. Lenard
• Defeat 3 × Kidnapper
• Talk to Prof. Dr. Lenard
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 2,000 credits
• 2,000 experience

entries.title: Mission 3: The Mastermind
entries.description: Mr. Jones has located the leader. Make that Lars Cervantes in the Lost Outskirt (PEPPER SEC-1) knows why you're killing him.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

One time

DIFFICULTY
1

POSSIBLE PREREQUISITES
• Complete Mission 2: Hostage Rescue
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Lars Cervantes
• Defeat Lars Cervantes
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 3,000 credits
• 3,000 experience

entries.title: Mission 1: The Dig Site
entries.description: Mr. Jones wants you to pick up a relic that Emmet Hill found in Digging Site (PEPPER SEC-2).
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Emmet Hill
• Collect Relic
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 1,000 credits
• 1,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Ah, good to see you. How are you? Looked around a little? I have a little job that needs to be done and I do not have the time to take care of the matter myself. Could you do that for me?

Your response: Not right now, sorry...

Your response: What is it, then?

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Great... It's about this. We found a hefty lot of old technology below the city and... well... started to dig everything out.

Your response: You're digging below the city for old stuff?

NPC: Yes... exactly. You might think it's weird, but that's how it is. It doesn't matter though. One of our foremen down there, %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7215), found something he can't make anything of. He said it could be of interest to me and he would like to send it to me. He didn't do that until now though and I don't have the time to go down there myself.

Your response: And now I'm supposed to get it for you?

NPC: That would be great, yes... You will find %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7215) at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1557)... Tell him that I sent you and he will give you the relic.

Your response: Yes, but where is that and how do I get there?

NPC: Just use your Nav-Ray... It will show you the direct way. But be careful down there. There are some creatures who like the warmth and the humidity, but not intruders down there.

Your response: I'll take care. Bye...

NPC: Come back soon!

NPC: Who are you? I'm busy. If it isn't important, then buzz off. This area is restricted.

Your response: Jones sent me... I'm supposed to get something for him.

NPC: Jones? What does he want?

Your response: You wanted to give him something, but didn't. Now I'm supposed to get it.

NPC: Oh shit... yes... I entirely forgot. The little relic I found a few days ago. Here, take it. I don't know if it might be dangerous. That's why I didn't touch it yet.

Your response: Thank you. I'll take it to Mr. Jones.

NPC: Okay... Sorry again for the work but we have a lot to do down here and everyone but me called in sick again. You just forget some things over that...

Your response: No worries... Goodbye.

NPC: Goodbye.

NPC: Why are you still here? You have the relic already...

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: You're filthy... was it that bad down there?

Your response: Just some critters. No problem... I have your relic.

NPC: Great, show me... ...hmmm... it's sort of crusty... can't see anything.

Your response: %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7215) said it might be dangerous.

NPC: Oh... then I guess I'll hand it down to our lab, they should analyze it.

Your response: Do that... it's probably safer.

NPC: I thank you for your time. I'll surely have more stuff for you to do later. Until then, you should train your Research skills. Then you can soon be of real value for our research division. You have the potential, I think.

Your response: Thanks for the tip... bye.

NPC: Goodbye...

NPC: Good thing you're back. I have something important for you to do.

Your response: I have important stuff to do myself right now.

Your response: Just tell me what it is.

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: It's about the relic you fetched for me. You remember that, right? Well, I wanted to give it to our lab, but they are overworked already, plus they have a vermin problem.

Your response: And what can I do?

NPC: Well, you could make use of your abilities for me and analyze the thing yourself.

Your response: Okay, but how do I do that?

NPC: You need multiple things for that. First, your research tool of course and an empty datacube ... plus you need the item you want to analyze of course. The relic in this case. Then, for higher quality items you need some research substance. You should have a tool and a datacube, and you get the relic from me. You can buy the research substance from any tech trader in the city.

Your response: Okay. And when I have everything, what do I do?

NPC: Then you put first the relic, then the research tool into your processor window and start the process. When it's done, you should get a blueprint from the item.

Your response: I see... and what do I do with that?

NPC: This blueprint can be used by engineers to reproduce the analyzed item. But you should take the blueprint to %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7216) at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1571).

Your response: Allright. So I make a blueprint of the relic and take it to %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7216)... will do.

NPC: I'm sure you'll manage!

NPC: Welcome and a good day. What makes you come to our little zoo?

Your response: Uhm... I bring you the blueprint of the relic, that...

NPC: Which blueprint do you mean? Do your work first, and then disturb me again!

NPC: ...Ah yes... sure! Jones told me he would send somebody. Give it to me. I'm fed up to take care of these uglies from my colleague over there. If he has no time for them, he should hold less study objects.

Your response: What kind of research do you do he...

NPC: ...Oh! Lots of things. Most of it is critter related... but I don't like them. I rather have lifeless objects... of course you could turn those critters into lifeless ones too, but I think that would break his heart... hehehe...

Your response: Okay, I will go back to...

NPC: ...Yes! Go ahead and do that... with my greetings to Jones. I will give him a call, as soon as I have run the blueprint through our database.

Your response: Then good luck and enjoy...

NPC: Thanks!

NPC: Sorry but I'm busy.

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Hey, there you are. That was quick. Got everything done?

Your response: Yes, I did everything. %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7216) will contact you, as soon as he has the first data from his database check.

NPC: Great. I really wonder what it could be. You're making yourself really useful. I will surely have use for you again. Keep concentrating on your research abilities, but remember that you also need to be able to defend yourself in the rough world out there. A little training of your combat skills might be in order, too. You should learn how to handle a handgun.

Your response: I'm no big fan of violence, but I'll heed your advice. Thanks.

NPC: You're welcome...

NPC: Great... here you are again. You're just in time. Are you free at the moment?

Your response: Not really...

Your response: Of course...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: I have a report from the blueprint analysation. The relic doesn't seem to be dangerous. It used to draw its energy from a battery, but it is drained since quite some time. So all we need to do is research the battery and see what it does.

Your response: I understand... give it to me and I'll have it researched.

NPC: You're reading my thoughts... hahaha... Go to %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1573) and have it reloaded at the %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7217). It could be a little chaotic over there. We had a few attacks we are looking into right now. So you have to be careful.

Your response: No problem... what's the worst that could happen?

NPC: Just pay attention and you'll be fine!

NPC: P L E A S E   S E L E C T   F U N C T I O N A L I T Y
1   -   R E A C T O R   E M E R G E N C Y    S H U T D O W N
2   -   R E A C T O R   S E L F T E S T

4   -   S P E C I F Y   O U T P U T
5   -   L O A D   O B J E C T
6   -   T O G G L E   R E P A I R   M O D E

Your response: (Load Object)

NPC: S C A N N I N G   O B J E C T   T O   L O A D   .  .  .
.  .  .  .S C A N   C O M P L E T E
L O A D I N G   O B J E C T  .  .  .
.  .  .  L O A D I N G   C O M P L E T E

Your response: Oh, the suspense...

NPC: **After the relic was loaded it starts to make weird beeping noises and the display says 'Feed me!'**

Your response: Uh... what?

NPC: **The relic beeps again: 'Feed me!'**

Your response: How am I supposed to do that, you POS!?

NPC: **The relic beeps again: 'Feed me!'**

Your response: Screw this... let Jones handle this mess...

NPC: END

NPC: A N A L Y S I S   M O D E   -   R E Q U E S T   C A N   N O T   B E   P R O C E S S E D

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: The glow on your face tells me you got it to run.

Your response: If my face is glowing, it's from your reactor. The thing is garbage.

NPC: Where is the relic? I need that!

NPC: Why? Show me... what does it do?

Your response: It beeps and the 2D-display says 'feed me'... great, huh?

NPC: Hmmm... too bad... Who builds such things?

Your response: How should I know? It seems to be worthless, though.

NPC: Yes, I agree... You can keep it. We get a lot of this stuff from our digging sites. You still did a great job. It could have been something special. I don't want to let you go unrewarded and give you this advanced Research Tool... it will surely be of good use to you. If you keep concentrating on your Research skills, you will be able to do a lot with that.

Your response: Thanks, I could never have afforded that.

NPC: No problem. You're welcome - You did a great service to your faction. I now have other matters to attend and wish you the best of luck on your future. We will surely meet again.

Your response: Yes, I hope so. Goodbye!

NPC: Goodbye! Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

entries.title: Mission 2: First Analysis
entries.description: Mr. Jones requires more information about the relic. Analyse the relic and show your results to Prof. Dr. Whitley in Biological Research Laboratory (PLAZA SEC-3).
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

POSSIBLE PREREQUISITES
• Complete Mission 1: The Dig Site
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Use a tradeskill on Relic
• Talk to Prof. Dr. Whitley
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 2,000 credits
• 2,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Ah, good to see you. How are you? Looked around a little? I have a little job that needs to be done and I do not have the time to take care of the matter myself. Could you do that for me?

Your response: Not right now, sorry...

Your response: What is it, then?

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Great... It's about this. We found a hefty lot of old technology below the city and... well... started to dig everything out.

Your response: You're digging below the city for old stuff?

NPC: Yes... exactly. You might think it's weird, but that's how it is. It doesn't matter though. One of our foremen down there, %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7215), found something he can't make anything of. He said it could be of interest to me and he would like to send it to me. He didn't do that until now though and I don't have the time to go down there myself.

Your response: And now I'm supposed to get it for you?

NPC: That would be great, yes... You will find %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7215) at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1557)... Tell him that I sent you and he will give you the relic.

Your response: Yes, but where is that and how do I get there?

NPC: Just use your Nav-Ray... It will show you the direct way. But be careful down there. There are some creatures who like the warmth and the humidity, but not intruders down there.

Your response: I'll take care. Bye...

NPC: Come back soon!

NPC: Who are you? I'm busy. If it isn't important, then buzz off. This area is restricted.

Your response: Jones sent me... I'm supposed to get something for him.

NPC: Jones? What does he want?

Your response: You wanted to give him something, but didn't. Now I'm supposed to get it.

NPC: Oh shit... yes... I entirely forgot. The little relic I found a few days ago. Here, take it. I don't know if it might be dangerous. That's why I didn't touch it yet.

Your response: Thank you. I'll take it to Mr. Jones.

NPC: Okay... Sorry again for the work but we have a lot to do down here and everyone but me called in sick again. You just forget some things over that...

Your response: No worries... Goodbye.

NPC: Goodbye.

NPC: Why are you still here? You have the relic already...

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: You're filthy... was it that bad down there?

Your response: Just some critters. No problem... I have your relic.

NPC: Great, show me... ...hmmm... it's sort of crusty... can't see anything.

Your response: %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7215) said it might be dangerous.

NPC: Oh... then I guess I'll hand it down to our lab, they should analyze it.

Your response: Do that... it's probably safer.

NPC: I thank you for your time. I'll surely have more stuff for you to do later. Until then, you should train your Research skills. Then you can soon be of real value for our research division. You have the potential, I think.

Your response: Thanks for the tip... bye.

NPC: Goodbye...

NPC: Good thing you're back. I have something important for you to do.

Your response: I have important stuff to do myself right now.

Your response: Just tell me what it is.

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: It's about the relic you fetched for me. You remember that, right? Well, I wanted to give it to our lab, but they are overworked already, plus they have a vermin problem.

Your response: And what can I do?

NPC: Well, you could make use of your abilities for me and analyze the thing yourself.

Your response: Okay, but how do I do that?

NPC: You need multiple things for that. First, your research tool of course and an empty datacube ... plus you need the item you want to analyze of course. The relic in this case. Then, for higher quality items you need some research substance. You should have a tool and a datacube, and you get the relic from me. You can buy the research substance from any tech trader in the city.

Your response: Okay. And when I have everything, what do I do?

NPC: Then you put first the relic, then the research tool into your processor window and start the process. When it's done, you should get a blueprint from the item.

Your response: I see... and what do I do with that?

NPC: This blueprint can be used by engineers to reproduce the analyzed item. But you should take the blueprint to %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7216) at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1571).

Your response: Allright. So I make a blueprint of the relic and take it to %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7216)... will do.

NPC: I'm sure you'll manage!

NPC: Welcome and a good day. What makes you come to our little zoo?

Your response: Uhm... I bring you the blueprint of the relic, that...

NPC: Which blueprint do you mean? Do your work first, and then disturb me again!

NPC: ...Ah yes... sure! Jones told me he would send somebody. Give it to me. I'm fed up to take care of these uglies from my colleague over there. If he has no time for them, he should hold less study objects.

Your response: What kind of research do you do he...

NPC: ...Oh! Lots of things. Most of it is critter related... but I don't like them. I rather have lifeless objects... of course you could turn those critters into lifeless ones too, but I think that would break his heart... hehehe...

Your response: Okay, I will go back to...

NPC: ...Yes! Go ahead and do that... with my greetings to Jones. I will give him a call, as soon as I have run the blueprint through our database.

Your response: Then good luck and enjoy...

NPC: Thanks!

NPC: Sorry but I'm busy.

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Hey, there you are. That was quick. Got everything done?

Your response: Yes, I did everything. %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7216) will contact you, as soon as he has the first data from his database check.

NPC: Great. I really wonder what it could be. You're making yourself really useful. I will surely have use for you again. Keep concentrating on your research abilities, but remember that you also need to be able to defend yourself in the rough world out there. A little training of your combat skills might be in order, too. You should learn how to handle a handgun.

Your response: I'm no big fan of violence, but I'll heed your advice. Thanks.

NPC: You're welcome...

NPC: Great... here you are again. You're just in time. Are you free at the moment?

Your response: Not really...

Your response: Of course...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: I have a report from the blueprint analysation. The relic doesn't seem to be dangerous. It used to draw its energy from a battery, but it is drained since quite some time. So all we need to do is research the battery and see what it does.

Your response: I understand... give it to me and I'll have it researched.

NPC: You're reading my thoughts... hahaha... Go to %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1573) and have it reloaded at the %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7217). It could be a little chaotic over there. We had a few attacks we are looking into right now. So you have to be careful.

Your response: No problem... what's the worst that could happen?

NPC: Just pay attention and you'll be fine!

NPC: P L E A S E   S E L E C T   F U N C T I O N A L I T Y
1   -   R E A C T O R   E M E R G E N C Y    S H U T D O W N
2   -   R E A C T O R   S E L F T E S T
3   -   S P E C I F Y   F E E D
4   -   S P E C I F Y   O U T P U T
5   -   L O A D   O B J E C T
6   -   T O G G L E   R E P A I R   M O D E

Your response: (Load Object)

NPC: S C A N N I N G   O B J E C T   T O   L O A D   .  .  .
.  .  .  .S C A N   C O M P L E T E
L O A D I N G   O B J E C T  .  .  .
.  .  .  L O A D I N G   C O M P L E T E

Your response: Oh, the suspense...

NPC: **After the relic was loaded it starts to make weird beeping noises and the display says 'Feed me!'**

Your response: Uh... what?

NPC: **The relic beeps again: 'Feed me!'**

Your response: How am I supposed to do that, you POS!?

NPC: **The relic beeps again: 'Feed me!'**

Your response: Screw this... let Jones handle this mess...

NPC: END

NPC: A N A L Y S I S   M O D E   -   R E Q U E S T   C A N   N O T   B E   P R O C E S S E D

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: The glow on your face tells me you got it to run.

Your response: If my face is glowing, it's from your reactor. The thing is garbage.

NPC: Where is the relic? I need that!

NPC: Why? Show me... what does it do?

Your response: It beeps and the 2D-display says 'feed me'... great, huh?

NPC: Hmmm... too bad... Who builds such things?

Your response: How should I know? It seems to be worthless, though.

NPC: Yes, I agree... You can keep it. We get a lot of this stuff from our digging sites. You still did a great job. It could have been something special. I don't want to let you go unrewarded and give you this advanced Research Tool... it will surely be of good use to you. If you keep concentrating on your Research skills, you will be able to do a lot with that.

Your response: Thanks, I could never have afforded that.

NPC: No problem. You're welcome - You did a great service to your faction. I now have other matters to attend and wish you the best of luck on your future. We will surely meet again.

Your response: Yes, I hope so. Goodbye!

NPC: Goodbye! Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

entries.title: Mission 3: New Energy
entries.description: Mr. Jones has been informed that the relic can be activated. You are to go to the Recharge Station in the Reactor Room (PLAZA SEC-1) to proceed with the activation. %SHOWONTARGETSUCCESS(0, Bring the strange object to Mr. Jones.)
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

POSSIBLE PREREQUISITES
• Complete Mission 2: First Analysis
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Recharge Station
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 3,000 credits
• 3,000 experience

Your response: And now I'm supposed to get it for you?

Your response: Yes, but where is that and how do I get there?

NPC: Just use your Nav-Ray... It will show you the direct way. But be careful down there. There are some creatures who like the warmth and the humidity, but not intruders down there.

Your response: I'll take care. Bye...

NPC: Come back soon!

NPC: Who are you? I'm busy. If it isn't important, then buzz off. This area is restricted.

Your response: Jones sent me... I'm supposed to get something for him.

NPC: Jones? What does he want?

Your response: You wanted to give him something, but didn't. Now I'm supposed to get it.

Your response: Thank you. I'll take it to Mr. Jones.

NPC: Okay... Sorry again for the work but we have a lot to do down here and everyone but me called in sick again. You just forget some things over that...

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: You're filthy... was it that bad down there?

Your response: %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7215) said it might be dangerous.

NPC: Oh... then I guess I'll hand it down to our lab, they should analyze it.

Your response: Do that... it's probably safer.

NPC: I thank you for your time. I'll surely have more stuff for you to do later. Until then, you should train your Research skills. Then you can soon be of real value for our research division. You have the potential, I think.

Your response: Thanks for the tip... bye.

entries.title: Mission 1: Delivery Problems
entries.description: Mr. Jones wants you to find out why the last delivery still hasn't arrived. Find Rob Floran. He's supposed to be in the Smugglers Cave (PEPPER SEC-3). Report to Mr. Jones when you're back.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Rob Floran
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 1,000 credits
• 1,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: There you are. Does this place feel like home yet? I have a little something that needs to be done and I had you in mind for that. Can you help me out?

Your response: Not at the moment...

Your response: Sure, no problem...

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Great... It is about a... well... not entirely legal shipment I am expecting. Nothing special, you shouldn't worry about that. The shipment didn't arrive yet, even though it should have, though. I don't want to wait any longer. Usually, the guy is reliable.

Your response: And what am I supposed to do about that?

NPC: Go to %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7223) and ask him about it. The two hang out a lot, and if somebody knows where the shipment is, then it's him.

Your response: And where do I find him?

NPC: He is at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1575) of course...

Your response: Allright... but how do I get there?

NPC: Use your Nav-Ray system. It will show you the right way. And take a flashlight with you. It is damn dark out there.

Your response: Okay... I will check things out. Bye...

NPC: I am depending on you!

NPC: Yo hey... whassup, man?

Your response: Um... Jones sent me...

NPC: Word... what's he want?

Your response: He's looking for a shipment which should have reached him by now, but didn't. He said you could know where it is?

NPC: Shit man, no go. My buddy took the new route and not the old one as always, but he been disappearing. Jones should know where that is. Always the same... let him look after the guy himself.

Your response: You being his buddy he sure doesn't seem to be much of your concern, huh?

NPC: Piss off and deal with your own probs! Kiss my ass, man!

NPC: What next?

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Man, you're dirty. I hope you didn't get lost down there?

Your response: Not too much. But %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7223) didn't know either where the shipment is. He said, his buddy would have taken the new route. Somehow, this guy seems strange.

NPC: The guys down there are all a little nuts. Never mind them. The new route, huh? Hmmm... not many people know it. I will have that checked. Thank you. I will get back at you later. Until then, you should train your Barter skill, so you can get real good prices at haggling later.

Your response: Thanks for the tip... see you.

NPC: See you too.

NPC: Great - you came at the right moment. Can you spare some time?

Your response: Not right now...

Your response: Of course...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: It's about my shipment. %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7224), the guy who should deliver it, was nowhere to be found. We looked for him on the entire route and narrowed it down to one single place.

Your response: ...That I should go to to look for him...

NPC: Great! You're reading my thoughts. %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7224) could only be at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1557)... If he's not there either, he will probably have taken off with the shipment and we will never find him. Use your Nav-Ray to get there and be careful. It's possible that some dangers await you.

NPC: *cough* *cough* ... who... who are you? Did you... come to finish the job? *cough*

Your response: Finish? No... Jones sent me... he's been looking for you since quite some time.

NPC: He is a little *cough* too late for that. I'm dying here and I *cough*... don't think anything can stop that...

Your response: But what... what the hell happened?

NPC: My boss... the dirty maggot... *cough* he mugged me and... *cough* took everything... *cough*... he could never stand me... but... but I didn't think it would go *cough* ...this far...

Your response: Jones mugged you here?!?

NPC: *cough* ... Bull! Not Jones... he is... allright *cough* ...I meant the boss of the smugglers...

Your response: And he has the shipment for Jones now, yes?

NPC: If... if... he didn't... sell them... to someone, he should still *cough* ...have them...

Your response: And what should I do now?

NPC: Shit, how should I know *cough* ... go to... Jones and tell him... he will know *cough* what... what to do. Now... *cough* piss off... and let me... die in peace... nothing ... *cough* will help me now... anyway...

Your response: One could come to believe you want to die. I'll go to Jones, he will send you help.

NPC: Argh... yes, man! Do whatever you want...

NPC: Get help for me, damn!

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Could you find anything out?

Your response: Yes, in %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1557), there is a lot of critters and I also found %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7224). He is hurt badly... You should send a medic down there immediately.

NPC: Oh crap... I will do that immediately. Did you talk to him?

Your response: Yes, I did... he said, his boss mugged him and took the shipment.

NPC: His boss, yes? Hmmm... I guess I need to think some things over. Come back later, and I will have further jobs for you. Since you might have noticed that it can be essential to be able to defend yourself, you should train your combat abilities a little.

NPC: It's payback time. Are you ready for that?

Your response: Not yet...

Your response: Yes, I am...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great... To make it short: I'm sending you to get my delivery back from the boss of the smugglers. His name is %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7225) and he currently hangs out at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1575). If you tell him we know who did that and that I'm sending you, he will surely give in and hand over the shipment. If he doesn't do that... well... then handle the situation at your discretion. This is your perfect opportunity to earn some respect down there.

Your response: Allright... I'll be more than happy to 'handle' the situation...

NPC: I'm trusting you!

NPC: *belch* ... who are you supposed to be and what do you want?

Your response: A shipment you have in your possession...

NPC: What kind of shipment? Not doing anything at the moment...

Your response: And what about the shipment you took from your man yourself which was destined for Mr. Jones?

NPC: Hehehe... oh THAT shipment. No problem *smack* ... here, take it, and say hello from me... hehehe...

Your response: Uh... well... thanks...

NPC: You're welcome... hehehe...

Your response: I'll uh... go back to Jones then. And tell him you said hello...

NPC: You're not supposed to say hello to Jones from me...

Your response: What? Who else then?

NPC: Hehehe... to the devil, you stupid naive little brat! Did you really think I would just let you waltz in and outta here?!? GO BOYS!!! There's a bug to squat here!

NPC: Get lost! You have no business here!

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: You look a little beat... had some problems?

Your response: I guess you could say that... I had to kill the bastard and half of his ugly crew, to get your delivery back.

NPC: Hmmm... serves the bastard right. Unfortunately, my buyer for the goods took off.

Your response: What's that supposed to mean? I did all this for naught?

NPC: Uh... no... of course not. You showed your faction your value and your abilities. I don't want to leave that unrewarded. Just keep the delivery and sell it yourself. Plus, I want to give you this bartering implant. It increases your Barter skills...

Your response: Yay... thank you... that's a nice recompensation for the trouble.

NPC: I hope so. You can get that implant put in by a runner, just ask around. It shouldn't be hard to find somebody who can do that. You should also keep training your barter and combat skills. You saw how rough the world out there can be.

Your response: I'll do that...

NPC: I have to say goodbye for now. Other people await me. We will surely meet again though. Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

POSSIBLE PREREQUISITES
• Complete Mission 1: Delivery Problems
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Ern Logan
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 2,000 credits
• 2,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: There you are. Does this place feel like home yet? I have a little something that needs to be done and I had you in mind for that. Can you help me out?

Your response: Not at the moment...

Your response: Sure, no problem...

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Great... It is about a... well... not entirely legal shipment I am expecting. Nothing special, you shouldn't worry about that. The shipment didn't arrive yet, even though it should have, though. I don't want to wait any longer. Usually, the guy is reliable.

Your response: And what am I supposed to do about that?

NPC: Go to %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7223) and ask him about it. The two hang out a lot, and if somebody knows where the shipment is, then it's him.

Your response: And where do I find him?

NPC: He is at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1575) of course...

Your response: Allright... but how do I get there?

NPC: Use your Nav-Ray system. It will show you the right way. And take a flashlight with you. It is damn dark out there.

Your response: Okay... I will check things out. Bye...

NPC: I am depending on you!

NPC: Yo hey... whassup, man?

Your response: Um... Jones sent me...

NPC: Word... what's he want?

Your response: He's looking for a shipment which should have reached him by now, but didn't. He said you could know where it is?

NPC: Shit man, no go. My buddy took the new route and not the old one as always, but he been disappearing. Jones should know where that is. Always the same... let him look after the guy himself.

Your response: You being his buddy he sure doesn't seem to be much of your concern, huh?

NPC: Piss off and deal with your own probs! Kiss my ass, man!

NPC: What next?

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Man, you're dirty. I hope you didn't get lost down there?

Your response: Not too much. But %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7223) didn't know either where the shipment is. He said, his buddy would have taken the new route. Somehow, this guy seems strange.

NPC: The guys down there are all a little nuts. Never mind them. The new route, huh? Hmmm... not many people know it. I will have that checked. Thank you. I will get back at you later. Until then, you should train your Barter skill, so you can get real good prices at haggling later.

Your response: Thanks for the tip... see you.

NPC: See you too.

NPC: Great - you came at the right moment. Can you spare some time?

Your response: Not right now...

Your response: Of course...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: It's about my shipment. %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7224), the guy who should deliver it, was nowhere to be found. We looked for him on the entire route and narrowed it down to one single place.

Your response: ...That I should go to to look for him...

NPC: Great! You're reading my thoughts. %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7224) could only be at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1557)... If he's not there either, he will probably have taken off with the shipment and we will never find him. Use your Nav-Ray to get there and be careful. It's possible that some dangers await you.

NPC: *cough* *cough* ... who... who are you? Did you... come to finish the job? *cough*

Your response: Finish? No... Jones sent me... he's been looking for you since quite some time.

NPC: He is a little *cough* too late for that. I'm dying here and I *cough*... don't think anything can stop that...

Your response: But what... what the hell happened?

NPC: My boss... the dirty maggot... *cough* he mugged me and... *cough* took everything... *cough*... he could never stand me... but... but I didn't think it would go *cough* ...this far...

Your response: Jones mugged you here?!?

NPC: *cough* ... Bull! Not Jones... he is... allright *cough* ...I meant the boss of the smugglers...

Your response: And he has the shipment for Jones now, yes?

NPC: If... if... he didn't... sell them... to someone, he should still *cough* ...have them...

Your response: And what should I do now?

NPC: Shit, how should I know *cough* ... go to... Jones and tell him... he will know *cough* what... what to do. Now... *cough* piss off... and let me... die in peace... nothing ... *cough* will help me now... anyway...

Your response: One could come to believe you want to die. I'll go to Jones, he will send you help.

NPC: Argh... yes, man! Do whatever you want...

NPC: Get help for me, damn!

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Could you find anything out?

Your response: Yes, in %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1557), there is a lot of critters and I also found %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7224). He is hurt badly... You should send a medic down there immediately.

NPC: Oh crap... I will do that immediately. Did you talk to him?

Your response: Yes, I did... he said, his boss mugged him and took the shipment.

NPC: His boss, yes? Hmmm... I guess I need to think some things over. Come back later, and I will have further jobs for you. Since you might have noticed that it can be essential to be able to defend yourself, you should train your combat abilities a little.

NPC: It's payback time. Are you ready for that?

Your response: Not yet...

Your response: Yes, I am...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great... To make it short: I'm sending you to get my delivery back from the boss of the smugglers. His name is %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7225) and he currently hangs out at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1575). If you tell him we know who did that and that I'm sending you, he will surely give in and hand over the shipment. If he doesn't do that... well... then handle the situation at your discretion. This is your perfect opportunity to earn some respect down there.

Your response: Allright... I'll be more than happy to 'handle' the situation...

NPC: I'm trusting you!

NPC: *belch* ... who are you supposed to be and what do you want?

Your response: A shipment you have in your possession...

NPC: What kind of shipment? Not doing anything at the moment...

Your response: And what about the shipment you took from your man yourself which was destined for Mr. Jones?

NPC: Hehehe... oh THAT shipment. No problem *smack* ... here, take it, and say hello from me... hehehe...

Your response: Uh... well... thanks...

NPC: You're welcome... hehehe...

Your response: I'll uh... go back to Jones then. And tell him you said hello...

NPC: You're not supposed to say hello to Jones from me...

Your response: What? Who else then?

NPC: Hehehe... to the devil, you stupid naive little brat! Did you really think I would just let you waltz in and outta here?!? GO BOYS!!! There's a bug to squat here!

NPC: Get lost! You have no business here!

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: You look a little beat... had some problems?

Your response: I guess you could say that... I had to kill the bastard and half of his ugly crew, to get your delivery back.

NPC: Hmmm... serves the bastard right. Unfortunately, my buyer for the goods took off.

Your response: What's that supposed to mean? I did all this for naught?

NPC: Uh... no... of course not. You showed your faction your value and your abilities. I don't want to leave that unrewarded. Just keep the delivery and sell it yourself. Plus, I want to give you this bartering implant. It increases your Barter skills...

Your response: Yay... thank you... that's a nice recompensation for the trouble.

NPC: I hope so. You can get that implant put in by a runner, just ask around. It shouldn't be hard to find somebody who can do that. You should also keep training your barter and combat skills. You saw how rough the world out there can be.

Your response: I'll do that...

NPC: I have to say goodbye for now. Other people await me. We will surely meet again though. Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

entries.title: Mission 3: Recovery
entries.description: Mr. Jones wants you to recover the supplies. Dispatch of Travis Dreadd if the need arises. He should still be around the Smugglers Cave (PEPPER SEC-3).
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

POSSIBLE PREREQUISITES
• Complete Mission 2: The Supplier
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Travis Dreadd
• Defeat Travis Dreadd
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 3,000 credits
• 3,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: There you are. Does this place feel like home yet? I have a little something that needs to be done and I had you in mind for that. Can you help me out?

Your response: Not at the moment...

Your response: Sure, no problem...

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Great... It is about a... well... not entirely legal shipment I am expecting. Nothing special, you shouldn't worry about that. The shipment didn't arrive yet, even though it should have, though. I don't want to wait any longer. Usually, the guy is reliable.

Your response: And what am I supposed to do about that?

NPC: Go to %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7223) and ask him about it. The two hang out a lot, and if somebody knows where the shipment is, then it's him.

Your response: And where do I find him?

NPC: He is at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1575) of course...

Your response: Allright... but how do I get there?

NPC: Use your Nav-Ray system. It will show you the right way. And take a flashlight with you. It is damn dark out there.

Your response: Okay... I will check things out. Bye...

NPC: I am depending on you!

NPC: Yo hey... whassup, man?

Your response: Um... Jones sent me...

NPC: Word... what's he want?

Your response: He's looking for a shipment which should have reached him by now, but didn't. He said you could know where it is?

NPC: Shit man, no go. My buddy took the new route and not the old one as always, but he been disappearing. Jones should know where that is. Always the same... let him look after the guy himself.

Your response: You being his buddy he sure doesn't seem to be much of your concern, huh?

NPC: Piss off and deal with your own probs! Kiss my ass, man!

NPC: What next?

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Man, you're dirty. I hope you didn't get lost down there?

Your response: Not too much. But %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7223) didn't know either where the shipment is. He said, his buddy would have taken the new route. Somehow, this guy seems strange.

NPC: The guys down there are all a little nuts. Never mind them. The new route, huh? Hmmm... not many people know it. I will have that checked. Thank you. I will get back at you later. Until then, you should train your Barter skill, so you can get real good prices at haggling later.

Your response: Thanks for the tip... see you.

NPC: See you too.

NPC: Great - you came at the right moment. Can you spare some time?

Your response: Not right now...

Your response: Of course...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: It's about my shipment. %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7224), the guy who should deliver it, was nowhere to be found. We looked for him on the entire route and narrowed it down to one single place.

Your response: ...That I should go to to look for him...

NPC: Great! You're reading my thoughts. %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7224) could only be at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1557)... If he's not there either, he will probably have taken off with the shipment and we will never find him. Use your Nav-Ray to get there and be careful. It's possible that some dangers await you.

NPC: *cough* *cough* ... who... who are you? Did you... come to finish the job? *cough*

Your response: Finish? No... Jones sent me... he's been looking for you since quite some time.

NPC: He is a little *cough* too late for that. I'm dying here and I *cough*... don't think anything can stop that...

Your response: But what... what the hell happened?

NPC: My boss... the dirty maggot... *cough* he mugged me and... *cough* took everything... *cough*... he could never stand me... but... but I didn't think it would go *cough* ...this far...

Your response: Jones mugged you here?!?

NPC: *cough* ... Bull! Not Jones... he is... allright *cough* ...I meant the boss of the smugglers...

Your response: And he has the shipment for Jones now, yes?

NPC: If... if... he didn't... sell them... to someone, he should still *cough* ...have them...

Your response: And what should I do now?

NPC: Shit, how should I know *cough* ... go to... Jones and tell him... he will know *cough* what... what to do. Now... *cough* piss off... and let me... die in peace... nothing ... *cough* will help me now... anyway...

Your response: One could come to believe you want to die. I'll go to Jones, he will send you help.

NPC: Argh... yes, man! Do whatever you want...

NPC: Get help for me, damn!

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Could you find anything out?

Your response: Yes, in %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1557), there is a lot of critters and I also found %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7224). He is hurt badly... You should send a medic down there immediately.

NPC: Oh crap... I will do that immediately. Did you talk to him?

Your response: Yes, I did... he said, his boss mugged him and took the shipment.

NPC: His boss, yes? Hmmm... I guess I need to think some things over. Come back later, and I will have further jobs for you. Since you might have noticed that it can be essential to be able to defend yourself, you should train your combat abilities a little.

NPC: It's payback time. Are you ready for that?

Your response: Not yet...

Your response: Yes, I am...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great... To make it short: I'm sending you to get my delivery back from the boss of the smugglers. His name is %NPC_NAMEFROMID(7225) and he currently hangs out at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1575). If you tell him we know who did that and that I'm sending you, he will surely give in and hand over the shipment. If he doesn't do that... well... then handle the situation at your discretion. This is your perfect opportunity to earn some respect down there.

Your response: Allright... I'll be more than happy to 'handle' the situation...

NPC: I'm trusting you!

NPC: *belch* ... who are you supposed to be and what do you want?

Your response: A shipment you have in your possession...

NPC: What kind of shipment? Not doing anything at the moment...

Your response: And what about the shipment you took from your man yourself which was destined for Mr. Jones?

NPC: Hehehe... oh THAT shipment. No problem *smack* ... here, take it, and say hello from me... hehehe...

Your response: Uh... well... thanks...

NPC: You're welcome... hehehe...

Your response: I'll uh... go back to Jones then. And tell him you said hello...

NPC: You're not supposed to say hello to Jones from me...

Your response: What? Who else then?

NPC: Hehehe... to the devil, you stupid naive little brat! Did you really think I would just let you waltz in and outta here?!? GO BOYS!!! There's a bug to squat here!

NPC: Get lost! You have no business here!

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: You look a little beat... had some problems?

Your response: I guess you could say that... I had to kill the bastard and half of his ugly crew, to get your delivery back.

NPC: Hmmm... serves the bastard right. Unfortunately, my buyer for the goods took off.

Your response: What's that supposed to mean? I did all this for naught?

NPC: Uh... no... of course not. You showed your faction your value and your abilities. I don't want to leave that unrewarded. Just keep the delivery and sell it yourself. Plus, I want to give you this bartering implant. It increases your Barter skills...

Your response: Yay... thank you... that's a nice recompensation for the trouble.

NPC: I hope so. You can get that implant put in by a runner, just ask around. It shouldn't be hard to find somebody who can do that. You should also keep training your barter and combat skills. You saw how rough the world out there can be.

Your response: I'll do that...

NPC: I have to say goodbye for now. Other people await me. We will surely meet again though. Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

entries.title: Mission 1: Female corpses in the sewers
entries.description: Mr. Jones asked you to inquire about the prostitution murders in the Dirty Sewer (PLAZA SEC-4).
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Corpse
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 1,000 credits
• 1,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Ah, there you are. Got a feeling for your new home yet? I have a little problem you could help me solve.

Your response: I don't have the time right now.

Your response: Then tell me what it is.

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself. Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: A strange killer is on the loose lately. He takes girls from the streets and soon after they are found dead in the canals. Things cooled down for a bit, but now new corpses were found and many girls are missing.

Your response: And what should I do about that?

NPC: I want you to check the sewers for clues. We need to bring this to an end. Go to %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1581) and look for traces.

Your response: Will do, but how do I get there?

NPC: Just use your Nav-Ray system. It should show you a direct way. But be careful when you go down there. Many things are nesting there that don't dare to enter the streets.

Your response: I'll get by...

NPC: I'm relying on you!

NPC: (You search the body and find a note with the word 'Starlet' on it.)

Your response: Hmmm... maybe Jones knows something about that...

NPC: END

NPC: Examining the corpse you found nothing.

NPC: You did not finish your mission!

NPC: You stink like you have been down there very long. Did you find anything?

Your response: As a matter of fact, I did... I found a womans body and she had a note with the word 'Starlet' on it in her hand. Know anything about that?

NPC: I have no idea, but I will do some research. You did a good job and I will soon have use for you again. Until then, you should train your Heavy Weapon skills. You have seen how important it can be, to be able to defend yourself.

Your response: Okay, thanks for the tip... I'll do that.

NPC: Very good.

NPC: Just in the right moment. I have more stuff for you to do.

Your response: Not now...

Your response: What is it?

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: It's about the word you found on the note from the womans body. 'Starlet' is the name of a prostitute from the city. I want you to visit her and question her. She will know more.

Your response: Where do I find her?

NPC: She usually hangs out at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(7) ... a very good lead. Do not screw this one up...

NPC: Hey Baby, how can I do you?

Your response: At the moment, you could tell me why a dead prostitute in the sewers had a note with your name on it in her hand.

NPC: What? But... how... you found Claudia? She's dead, too? Oh fuck... shit...

Your response: Yes, she is, I'm sorry. But please tell me what you know so this stops!

NPC: I... I can't... they will kill me...

Your response: Who will kill you, Starlet? Tell me, please...

NPC: These religious nutcases... they catch us, ask us questions about some bullshit and then they kill most of us... or worse...

Your response: What religious nutcases?

NPC: The Inquisition nutcases... oh... shit... now see what you did... here they come... they watched us... they will surely kill us... Damn!!!

Your response: We'll see who will kill who...

NPC: Get 'em!!

NPC: There are still some alive!!! Help me!!!

NPC: Damn... that was close... you're pretty strong...

Your response: Just doing my job. So these were the Inquisitors?

NPC: Yes, they have a central somewhere here... where they gather and take their prisoners and stuff...

Your response: I'll go to Jones, he will find something out. Thanks for the help and... good luck...

NPC: You're so strong!!! Thanks!

NPC: I told you everything!

NPC: You did not finish your mission!

NPC: That was quick. Did you find Starlet?

Your response: Yes, that and much more.

NPC: Then don't make me drag it outta your nose and tell me already.

Your response: It's not one single killer but an entire group. They are the Inquisitors, who pull girls from the streets. They have some kind of central here.

NPC: Yes, I heard of those. Dangerous people... I'll see if I can find out where they are. In the meantime, you should keep training your Heavy Weapons skills... come back later.

NPC: Are you ready to kick some asses?

Your response: Maybe later...

Your response: That sounds like fun...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: It's about the Inquisitors. We found out their location. They are at %NPC_WORLDFROMID(1563).

Your response: And now I am supposed to go there?

NPC: Exactly... go there and kill some of these sons of bitches. That should show them who is the boss, and after that, they will hopefully leave the girls alone. I doesn't look good when bloated bodys swim around everywhere.

Your response: It will be my pleasure to massacrate the bastards.

NPC: Then go there and do it!

NPC: You did not finish your mission!

NPC: Ah, there you are. Did you do as I told you?

Your response: Yes, I offed the wankers.

NPC: Very good... I didn't expect anything but good work from you. You really paid off. I thank you... Your work shouldn't go unrewarded. Starlet wanted to thank you and sent you a girl... just for you. I hope you are into women... hahaha... I want to thank you too and I have this weapon for you, which you will surely put to good use.

Your response: Wow... that's like birthday... thank you.

NPC: You're welcome. I must attend other stuff now and leave you to yourself. I wish you all the best on your further way. I'm sure that we will meet again someday. And don't forget to keep training on your Heavy Weapons skills, and you will be one of the greats in no time!

Your response: Thanks for everyone and goodbye.

NPC: Good bye, and take care. Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

POSSIBLE PREREQUISITES
• Complete Mission 1: Female corpses in the sewers
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Starlet
• Defeat 3 × Inquisitor
• Talk to Starlet
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 2,000 credits
• 2,000 experience

entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

POSSIBLE PREREQUISITES
• Complete Mission 2: A strong lead
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Defeat 3 × Inquisitor
• Talk to Mr. Jones

REWARDS
• 3,000 credits
• 3,000 experience

entries.title: Mission 1: Pest Control
entries.description: Mrs. Jones wants to see how you work where nobody is watching. Put down %OBJECTIVE_COUNT(cull_cave) of whatever crawls around CANYON CAVE 2, then report back to her.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mrs. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

OBJECTIVES
• Defeat 8 × Denizens of Very Easy Canyon dungeons
• Talk to Mrs. Jones

REWARDS
• 1,000 credits
• 1,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: You don't have the skills I am looking for. No offense.

NPC: You are past the point where I can teach you anything, comrade. You earned your spurs without me. Go keep our cause alive. Shall I clear out of your quarters?

Your response: Yes. Thanks anyway, Jones.

NPC: Fair enough. I will not waste a veteran's bunk space. The mission terminals will keep you busy - remember that the work never ends. Watch yourself out there.

NPC: Let's get one thing out of the way, first: 'Jones' isn't my real name. And don't tell me yours, or I'd have to kill us both. And believe me: I can. Now, what am I supposed to make of you? The City would have us believe that killers do it for a fee. I am looking for people who do it for a cause. So I wonder: Which are you?

Your response: I joined the cause, not the mercs, didn't I?

Your response: Hold that thought, I'll be right back.

Your response: I don't. Please go away.

NPC: Offer remains open, the work never ends. Find me before you outrank it, though: I don't recruit past level /25.

NPC: Are you quite sure? If I am gone, I am gone for good.

Your response: Yes, I am sure. Bye, already.

Your response: Uh, come to think of it, can we take this from the top?

NPC: Last chance. No changing your mind afterwards.

Your response: Geez. Are you going, or should I?

Your response: You know what? I just did.

NPC: Alright then. Remember that the work never ends. Watch yourself out there.

NPC: That says much less than you think it does. But no matter. We're gonna find out together, anyway. And step one is to see how you work where nobody is watching: In a dark cave. Canyon Cave 2, to be exact. Put down eight of whatever crawls around in there. It's the honest test of a killer.

Your response: Killing vermin in a cave tests my skills as a killer? What do you expect to gain by watching me do that?

NPC: I didn't say anything about your skills. And neither will I be watching you do it. What I will be watching, though, is your attitude about it, and how you behave once you're back. So get going. Canyon Cave 2, eight creepy crawlies.

NPC: Do you honestly want me to report that you came back before the task was finished? Get going!

NPC: So, tell me, honestly: Were you bothered at all by killing those beasts?

Your response: Why would I be bothered by exterminating some pests?

NPC: This is the correct attitude towards a cave full of pests. And it would be the entirely wrong attitude about a person. The difference between those two will determine how good you are at your job. The City will send its goons to kill anyone without ever thinking twice about it. As soon as we do the same, we become just like them. Get back to me soon.

NPC: Last time, I asked you to exterminate a cave full of pests. Wanna learn how the movement picks its targets?

Your response: I'm especially interested in who does the picking.

Your response: Yes, but... hang on.

NPC: I'll be here.

NPC: There's a regular in our bar. Wren Halasz is the name, drinks in there pretty much every evening, talks a lot and listens a lot. Knows all the regulars on a first name basis, and also knows which ones of them have quietly made their peace with the City. Something the movement calls various things, from collaboration to treason. Not a definition anyone in that bar got to vote on.

Your response: What exactly do you mean? Do the drinkers in there know they are being sorted?

NPC: Of course they don't, that's the whole point. Neither does Halasz, for that matter, and we'd like you to keep it that way. Just buy a round, and listen to what is being said.

NPC: Yes? I am trying to enjoy my beer, thank you very much. But I assume you want something from me.

Your response: Not really. Jones told me that you could use a friendly ear. Let me buy you a drink.

NPC: Jones? Oh, alright, I like her, so I'll like you, especially if you're buyin'. Let me tell you about this bar, and the people walking in and especially out of here. Those who walk out, who still believe in anything, and those- well, those who don't.

Your response: You can tell the difference, simply by watching how they walk out of here?

NPC: If they can still walk, that is. There are those that never complain, and always have something to sell, you know, under the table. Take Tomas, for example. Tomas Bierko. He's quite decent to people, never complains about anything. I'll be damned if he actually believes anything. Those who believe are the ones with loud opinions or spectacular breakdowns. He'd never show either.

Your response: Let's be honest, here. You do realize what just happened, don't you? Why I am here, and what is gonna happen now?

NPC: Please. I am not dense. Of course I know. Doesn't mean that I want to know, or that I am proud of it. Just... don't do it right in front of me, okay?

NPC: (Wren makes a very conscious effort not to notice you again.)

NPC: Wren Halasz in our bar. Don't make me ask again.

NPC: Which name did she land on?

Your response: Tomas Bierko. Really nice guy, apparently. Never complains, gets on well with everybody.

NPC: Bierko. Yeah, I know him. He moves goods here from the City, and does well doing it. His smuggling means that the people he feeds would rather keep him. Getting rid of him would cost us dearly. But leaving him be would incur an even greater cost, an ideological one. And that is a price we can't afford. His fate is decided. Get back to me, and you're gonna seal it.

NPC: I'm not gonna beat around the bush, not gonna soften it for you. This is not a cave full of vermin, but a person, in a room full of people who like him. Are you up to the task?

Your response: If that is what it takes.

Your response: I'll need to think about that, if I'm honest.

NPC: That's a good sign. I won't accept such a task being done half-heartedly. You need to believe.

NPC: Bierko is sitting in the same bar Wren Halasz sits in. Do it right there, do not take him to some back alley. The movement does not hide what it decides.

Your response: Wren specifically asked me not to do it in front of her. What should I expect to happen after... the deed?

NPC: What do you think is gonna happen? They're gonna hate you for it, for a while. Especially Wren. But they're gonna turn back to their drinks. That is the cost you will have to pay for your conviction. No sense in me sugar-coating it.

NPC: Ah, a new face! Welcome, friend!

Your response: You betrayed the movement, Tomas. And I am here to put an end to that.

NPC: I see. You want to know what I think? What I did means that people around here stay fed who would otherwise go hungry. Yes, I'm being paid by the City, and I use this money to help the people around here. So tell me: Who exactly have I betrayed?

Your response: I have no answer for you. All I can tell you is that your fate has been decided.

NPC: Right. At least you're being honest about it. Can you say the same about the people who sent you?

NPC: ...

NPC: Don't pretend it is done. It isn't, so get a move on.

NPC: The deed is done. You were asking me, now I am asking you: How did the room react?

Your response: Initially, they were curious. Then they got the hint, and started looking away. Wren was trying very hard to leave her own body.

NPC: Doesn't feel glamorous, does it? It's not supposed to, and I'm not going to congratulate you for it. This is the part the City never has to live with. We do - and that's what makes this movement stronger than them, not weaker.

Your response: I just executed the guy who helped a lot of our families survive. Are we truly better off, now?

NPC: Yes. We are. I can say that without any doubt in my heart, and still, I can be honest about the cost that this will entail. These kinds of decisions are supposed to be hard. Your beliefs are what help guide you through them. The movement will prevail, but only if it doesn't cozy up to the fascist oppressors it seeks to overthrow.

Your response: I guess I can live with that.

NPC: Good. I'm gonna send a rifle your way. You've earned it. Keep your Rifle Combat skill well trained, you're gonna need it. Pay those terminals a visit, the Canyon has lots of missions on offer. Remember that the work never ends. Watch yourself out there.
