 149      jones_m1_offer:
 150        say:
 151          - "Ah, runner. Welcome to Tech Haven - your new home. I have a task that I need assistance with, if you are interested."
 152        answer:
 153          jones_m1_welcome:
 154            - "I'm interested, how can I help?"
 155          jones_m1_later:
 156            - "I'm sorry, I don't have time right now. Another time?"
 157          jones_dismiss:
 158            - "I'm not interested in your tasks - please leave."
 159  
 160      jones_m1_later:
 161        say:
 162          - "Very well, I will remain here for a while. (Return before level /25 to resume.)"
 163  
 164      jones_dismiss:
 165        say:
 166          - "Are you sure about that?"
 167        answer:
 168          jones_dismiss_confirm:
 169            - "Yes, I am!"
 170          start:
 171            - "Actually, no. I'll give it a try."
 172  
 173      jones_dismiss_confirm:
 174        say:
 175          - "Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services."
 176        answer:
 177          jones_leave:
 178            - "I did think about it. Now please leave me alone."
 179          start:
 180            - "Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered."

 182      jones_m1_welcome:
 183        say:
 184          - "First: Although Tech Haven is a dedicated technocracy, I do want to assure you that you are welcome here."
 185        answer:
 186          jones_m1_no_grudge:
 187            - "Reassuring - I thought you'd look down on a PSI Monk."
 188  
 189      jones_m1_no_grudge:
 190        say:
 191          - "We are reasonable and logical - we learned difficult lessons from your predecessors, but we do not hold those experiences against you personally."
 192        answer:
 193          jones_m1_settlers:
 194            - "Fine - what about this task you mentioned?"
 195  
 196      jones_m1_settlers:
 197        say:
 198          - "We have an agreement of sorts with settlers in the area. We trade equipment made here for supplies they bring in from the outside world. However, we have reason to believe they are attempting to spread an alien influence within Tech Haven."
 199        answer:
 200          jones_m1_resources:
 201            - "What sort of influence are you referring to?"
 202  
 203      jones_m1_resources:
 204        say:
 205          - "We're unsure at the moment. They have been limiting key resources - releasing them only when we agree to supply weapons - something which they have not previously requested."
 206        answer:
 207          jones_m1_volume:
 208            - "Protecting yourself in the wastes isn't suspicious."
 209  
 210      jones_m1_volume:
 211        say:
 212          - "No, but the frequency and volume is. We need to ensure that they are not distributing them to Neocron - or to any other unsavoury party"
 213        answer:
 214          jones_m1_briefing:
 215            - "Okay, and where do you recommend I start looking?"
 216  
 217      jones_m1_briefing:
 218        do:
 219          - offer_mission: th_inquisitor.mission1
 220        say:
 221          - "Go ahead and speak with Declan Swan inside the Fallen Angels Tech Core. He's their primary handler and might be able to give you some insight on where to begin looking."
 222        resume_at: jones_m1_return
 223  
 224      declan_greeting:
 225        say:
 226          - "Yes? How can I help? Keep it brief."
 227        answer:
 228          declan_demands:
 229            - "Jones sent me about the unusual demands being made by local traders."
 230  
 231      declan_demands:
 232        say:
 233          - "Ah yes... that. They've begun to request weapons, ammunition, clothing, and other supplies. All in much larger volumes than a settlement of their size could require."
 234        answer:
 235          declan_influx:
 236            - "Do you have any idea why that is?"
 237  
 238      declan_influx:
 239        say:
 240          - "I only asked once, and their response was quite disagreeable. I understand that they are expecting an influx of new occupants in the near future."
 241        answer:
 242          declan_lieutenant:
 243            - "I wonder where they might be coming from. There are only so many folks in the wastes."
 244  
 245      declan_lieutenant:
 246        say:
 247          - "Honestly, I couldn't say. We've left them encamped outside the city as a precaution, but I understand one of their lieutenants is currently outside the Command Centre, waiting for a meeting."
 248        answer:
 249          declan_thanks:
 250            - "Thanks for the info, Declan."
 251  
 252      declan_thanks:
 253        do:
 254          - complete_objective: talk_to_declan
 255        say:
 256          - "You should head back to Jones and let her know about this..."
 257        resume_at: declan_jones_waiting
 258  
 259      declan_jones_waiting:
 260        say:
 261          - "Mrs. Jones is waiting!"
 262

 265          - goto: jones_m1_report
 266            when:
 267              objective_done:
 268                objective: talk_to_declan

 272        say:
 273          - "Come back once you've spoken with Declan."
 274  
 275      jones_m1_report:
 276        say:
 277          - "Welcome back - did Declan give you anything useful?"
 278        answer:
 279          jones_m1_debrief:
 280            - "Not really. He thinks that the traders are preparing for a sudden settlement expansion."
 281        resume_at: jones_m1_debrief
 282  
 283      jones_m1_debrief:
 284        say:
 285          - "Peculiar. I'm not aware of any groups in the area which would be large enough to require this amount of equipment. What else did he say?"
 286        answer:
 287          jones_m1_done:
 288            - "One of their leaders is currently in front of the Fallen Angels Tech Core, waiting for a meeting."
 289

 291        do:
 292          - set_flag:
 293              flag: th_inquisitor
 294              value: 1
 295          - complete_objective: report
 296        say:
 297          - "Ah yes, I seem to remember hearing about that. Let me check on the reason for the meeting - speak to me again in a moment."
 298  
 299      jones_m2_offer:
 300        say:
 301          - "Am I right to assume you wish to continue with your mission?"
 302        answer:
 303          jones_m2_briefing:
 304            - "Let's do this!"
 305          jones_m2_later:
 306            - "I've got other things to do. Speak soon?"
 307  
 308      jones_m2_later:
 309        say:
 310          - "Very well, I shall wait here for you."
 311  
 312      jones_m2_briefing:
 313        do:
 314          - offer_mission: th_inquisitor.mission2
 315        say:
 316          - "It appears that the leader of the wastelanders is about to enter a meeting to negotiate further trade with Tech Haven. I want you to question him first, then return to me. You should find him near the Fallen Angels Tech Core entrace, in Tech Haven Sec-2."
 317        resume_at: jones_m2_return
 318

 320        say:
 321          - "Make it quick, I'm heading in there soon."
 322        answer:
 323          lieutenant_what_to_you:

 329        answer:

 332

 336        answer:

 343        answer:

 346

 349          - "You're deluded pal, I never said..."
 350        answer:

 363        do:
 364          - attack
 365        say:
 366          - "..."

 384        say:
 385          - "There was talk of a commotion outside the Fallen Angels Tech Core - was that you?"
 386        answer:
 387          jones_m2_debrief:
 388            - "Yes, I met with the wastelander - he's not supplying the equipment to people... but to something else entirely!"
 389        resume_at: jones_m2_debrief
 390  
 391      jones_m2_debrief:
 392        say:
 393          - "Yes, mutants... a reconnaissance crew picked up a mutant camp in the hills outside of Tech Haven - they're using Tech Haven equipment."
 394        answer:
 395          jones_m2_done:
 396            - "Wow... pretty stupid to bring them along, huh?"
 397  
 398      jones_m2_done:
 399        do:
 400          - set_flag:
 401              flag: th_inquisitor
 402              value: 2
 403          - complete_objective: report
 404        say:
 405          - "That's what happens when you let people raise children in an irradiated wasteland... but that's beside the point. We need to deal with them. Speak with me when you're ready."
 406  
 407      jones_m3_offer:
 408        say:
 409          - "Are you ready to hit those mutants?"
 410        answer:
 411          jones_m3_briefing:
 412            - "Sure, might as well finish this."
 413          jones_m3_later:
 414            - "I'll come back to you"
 415  
 416      jones_m3_later:
 417        say:
 418          - "Very well, I shall wait here for you"
 419  
 420      jones_m3_briefing:
 421        do:
 422          - offer_mission: th_inquisitor.mission3
 423        say:
 424          - "Okay, then head out of Tech Haven Sec-3 into F_07, down the ramp and head straight. Once you have killed 5 Mutant Scouts, come back to report to me."
 425        resume_at: jones_m3_return
 426  
 427      jones_m3_return:
 428        do:
 429          - goto: jones_m3_report
 430            when:
 431              objective_done:
 432                objective: kill_scouts
 433          - goto: jones_m3_not_done
 434  
 435      jones_m3_not_done:
 436        say:
 437          - "Wipe out the mutants and come back here."
 438        resume_at: jones_m3_return
 439  
 440      jones_m3_report:
 441        say:
 442          - "I take it you got them all?"
 443        answer:
 444          jones_m3_debrief:
 445            - "I sure did!"
 446  
 447      jones_m3_debrief:
 448        say:
 449          - "Good. That's at least one potential danger removed."
 450        answer:
 451          jones_m3_done:
 452            - "What about the other mutants that have already been armed?"
 453  
 454      jones_m3_done:
 455        do:
 456          - set_flag:
 457              flag: th_inquisitor
 458              value: 3
 459          - complete_objective: report
 460          - give_item:
 461              item: 8580
 462              quality: 150
 463              slots: 3
 464          - remove
 465        say:
 466          - "Experience tells us that they'll mainly stay in the hills. Perhaps this time, we need to pay them a visit. Before I go - take this as a reward for your assistance."

entries.title: Mission 1: Abducted!
entries.description: Talk with Susan Yang, near the stairway to the Fallen Angels Tech Core. She has a package for Mrs. Jones.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mrs. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Susan Yang
• Talk to Mrs. Jones

REWARDS
• 1,000 credits
• 1,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself.

NPC: Ah, runner. Welcome to Tech Haven - your new home. I'm looking for someone to assist me in an urgent matter, are you interested?

Your response: I'm interested, how can I help?

Your response: I'm sorry, I don't have time right now. Another time?

Your response: I'm not interested in your tasks - please leave.

NPC: Very well, I will remain here for a while. (Return before level /25 to resume.)

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: I'm glad to hear this. We've had word that a member of Tech Haven's research team, Jason Wang, has been kidnapped.

Your response: Really? What were the demands?

NPC: Mainly, the blueprints his team was working upon. Secondly, a sum of credits in the form of precious metals.

Your response: What do you need me to do?

NPC: We're happy to release the credits, but not the blueprints. We're hoping the metals might buy some time for us to consider our next step.

Your response: Okay - tell me where I need to go.

NPC: Take this package and give it to Susan Yang who should be waiting near the stairway to the Fallen Angels Tech Core - the kidnappers requested that she handle the drop. Don't get any funny ideas about keeping the contents - we've placed tracking nanites on them.

NPC: I'm waiting for a courier from Jones!

NPC: Do you have the package from Jones?

Your response: Yes, it's right here.

NPC: Thank you for this. Return to Jones - she might have further instructions for you.

NPC: Mrs. Jones is waiting!

NPC: Go and take the package to Susan Yang.

NPC: Excellent. Susan is going to act as an intermediary - she'll pass the package onto the kidnappers.

Your response: Why did they ask for her specifically?

NPC: She's his wife - perhaps the figured she was less likely to try and trick them - since her husband's life is on the line. Speak with me in a moment, I'm starting up the tracking software.

NPC: Am I right to assume you wish to continue with your mission?

Your response: Let's do this!

Your response: I'll come back to you

NPC: Very well, you know where to find me

NPC: The tracking beacon seems to have stopped.

Your response: Want me to go and check it out?

NPC: Well... you look like you can take care of yourself, so that might not be a bad idea. The signal has stopped inside Energy Core 2. Head down and scout it out - but stay out of trouble.

NPC: (It looks like the body has been here for a few days. It appears he's been shot in the face making identification difficult, but the name tag on his chest says 'Yang, J'. The package is beside the body - opened, but the contents are still there. You should return to Jones.)

NPC: (You can't find anything else here.)

NPC: Go and check out The Energy Core and come back to me.

NPC: You got nothing for me...?

NPC: Well, did you find our man?

Your response: I can't be 100 percent, but I'm pretty sure I found his body in the Energy Core. Looked like he'd been dead for a couple of days.

NPC: Hmm - this isn't right. If his body has been there for days, then that's before his wife reported the kidnapping. This doesn't sit right at all.

Your response: They also left behind the metals. They opened the package, but then abandoned it. What do we do now?

NPC: I've just received some cleaned up security footage from the Scientists' apartment prior to the kidnapping. Speak with me in a moment, and we'll see what it tells us.

NPC: Are you ready for your last task?

Your response: Sure, might as well finish this.

Your response: I'll come back to you.

NPC: Very well, I shall wait here for you.

NPC: We've analyzed the footage. It begins several days before the kidnapping was reported and shows Jason and Susan Wang leaving together.

Your response: Go on.

NPC: Following them on the camera, we could see Susan leads Jason to the Energy Core. She sends him in first, before drawing a pistol and following him.

Your response: Holy shit! She was in on it?!

NPC: So it would appear. I need you to go and apprehend Susan Yang. I think we need to take her into custody and question her thoroughly.

NPC: Oh, hello, I wasn't expecting to see you again.

Your response: I need you to come with me and answer some questions about your husband's murder.

NPC: Murder? What do you mean? Why do you need to speak with me?

Your response: We have footage of you leading Jason into the Energy Core with a pistol. I found a body down there - I'm assuming it's his.

NPC: (Susan is silent for a few seconds, then sighs and looks at the ground.) I had to do it. I had to get away from him.

Your response: What do you mean?

NPC: Jason was a horrible man. He mistreated me - badly. I was going to leave him.

Your response: So why the 'kidnapping' - why the request for the blueprints?

NPC: Honestly, I thought his research might be worth something - I was going to use it to buy my way into Neocron. The other stuff was just a diversion to keep everyone busy.

Your response: I think I understand. You have my sympathy, if this is true, but I still need to take you in.

NPC: I don't regret it... killing him, I mean. But I'm sorry for this...

NPC: ...

NPC: Come back once you have spoken with Susan Yang, Runner.

NPC: Did you take Susan Yang into custody?

Your response: No, she's dead.

NPC: Unfortunate, what happened?

Your response: She admitted that the kidnapping was a cover-up. She wanted to take the blueprints and sell them to the City, in order to make a new life for herself. When I told her I still need to take her in, she drew a gun at me.

NPC: Self-defense, then. I'll feed this back to management. Speaking of - they have authorised me to present you with a gift for your services.

Your response: What is it?

NPC: I have two PSI modules, and you can choose which one you would like - offensive or defensive.

Your response: I'll take the offensive module please

Your response: I'll take the defensive module please

NPC: Are you sure you would like the offensive PSI module?

Your response: Yes, please.

Your response: Let me choose again, please!

NPC: Okay, here you are then! Thank you for your service. I imagine we may meet again in the future.

NPC: Are you sure you would like the defensive PSI module?

Your response: Yes, please.

Your response: Let me choose again

NPC: Here you are then! Thank you for your service. I imagine we may meet again in the future.

Mrs. Jones

One time

1

• Complete Mission 1: Abducted!

REWARDS
• 2,000 credits
• 2,000 experience

entries.details:
CONTACT
Mrs. Jones

REPEAT
One time

1

• Complete Mission 2: Abducted!
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Susan Yang
• Defeat Susan Yang
• Talk to Mrs. Jones

REWARDS
• 3,000 credits
• 3,000 experience

entries.title: Mission 1: Mutant Intelligence!
entries.description: Find Doctor Maisee Wong in Tech Haven Sec-2, near the admin circle.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mrs. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Maisee Wong
• Collect Mutant chip package
• Talk to Mrs. Jones

REWARDS
• 1,000 credits
• 1,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself.

NPC: Hello Runner, I am Mrs. Jones. I represent the Administration of Tech Haven. I understand that you are a Scientist. Would you be interested in some work?

Your response: I'm not interested in your tasks - please leave.

Your response: I'm sorry, I don't have time right now. Another time?

Your response: I'm interested, how can I help?

NPC: Very well, I will remain here for a while. (Return before level /25 to resume.)

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Tech Haven is the last true bastion of human intellect in the world. We are united by a single goal - the survival of human kind. To achieve that goal, sometimes we need to take less orthodox measures.

Your response: What do you mean?

NPC: We've received reports of Mutants in the wastelands which appear to be communicating rapidly over long distances. We don't believe they have the technology to build normal communication equipment. We're concerned they may have developed another way to communicate.

Your response: Do you mean something like telepathy?

NPC: We don't know at the moment. Our Scouts have recovered a few mutants from the wastes. Their bodies are currently in a lab at the Tech Haven Administration area - being dissected by Doctor Maisee Wong. Go and see if you can be of assistance to their efforts.

NPC: Ah, you must be the Runner that Jones sent - she just contacted me to say that you were coming.

Your response: Jones mentioned that you might need assistance with an autopsy?

NPC: No, not exactly. We've done the majority of it already - but we did find something you might be able to assist with.

Your response: Yeah, of course - how can I help?

NPC: We pulled similar-looking implants out of a number of the mutants. They're too badly damaged for us to send them straight to the technical engineers for testing. So I think we're going to have to involve a researcher to see if they can figure it out. Take it back to Mrs. Jones. I'm sure she'll know someone suitable for the job.

NPC: Mrs. Jones is waiting!

NPC: You need to speak with Dr Wong.

NPC: I need this package!

NPC: Ah Runner, that was quick. Did Doctor Wong have any work for you?

Your response: She needs a researcher to investigate an implant pulled from the mutants.

NPC: Alright, I'll see who's available. Speak with me again in a moment.

NPC: Alright, are you ready to proceed?

Your response: Of course - what's next?

Your response: Not right now, I will be back though.

NPC: Very well, you know where to find me.

NPC: Well, it appears the usual research team I use is unavailable, but I know a suitable alternative. You're going to do it.

Your response: Oh, okay. What do I need to do?

NPC: It's simple enough, make a blueprint of the Mutant Implant, and speak with me when you're done.

NPC: Come back once you've researched the chip.

NPC: Good work. I didn't doubt you were capable.

Your response: Thanks, what now?

NPC: I'm just waiting for confirmation of which technicians need the blueprint. Speak with me again in a minute.

NPC: Alright Runner, I just need you to transport these schematics now.

Your response: Sure, I've got time.

Your response: I have other things to do. I will be back though.

NPC: Very well, you know where to find me.

NPC: I've taken the liberty of encrypting the schematics to this datacube, to ensure the data remains secretive. Take it to Tech Haven Sec-2 and give it to Rees Jamison - he's usually found near the Gene Replicators there.

NPC: Sorry. Can't talk. Waiting for some important research data.

NPC: Ah great, you've got the schematics?

Your response: Sure, Mrs. Jones encrypted them and stored them on this datacube for you.

NPC: Yeah, she's always so careful - especially with things like this. I'll take it from here. You head back to your apartment and speak with Mr Jones again.

NPC: Go speak with Mrs. Jones, at your apartment.

NPC: Take the schematics to Rees Jamison at Tech Haven Sec-2.

NPC: I take it you already delivered the data?

Your response: Yeah, of course. What's next?

NPC: At the moment, nothing from me - but I think we'll be seeing each other again in the future. Until then, take this as a token of gratitude from Techhaven.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Mrs. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

POSSIBLE PREREQUISITES
• Complete Mission 1: Mutant Intelligence!
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Use a tradeskill on Mutant chip
• Talk to Mrs. Jones

REWARDS
• 2,000 credits
• 2,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself.

NPC: Hello Runner, I am Mrs. Jones. I represent the Administration of Tech Haven. I understand that you are a Scientist. Would you be interested in some work?

Your response: I'm not interested in your tasks - please leave.

Your response: I'm sorry, I don't have time right now. Another time?

Your response: I'm interested, how can I help?

NPC: Very well, I will remain here for a while. (Return before level /25 to resume.)

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Tech Haven is the last true bastion of human intellect in the world. We are united by a single goal - the survival of human kind. To achieve that goal, sometimes we need to take less orthodox measures.

Your response: What do you mean?

NPC: We've received reports of Mutants in the wastelands which appear to be communicating rapidly over long distances. We don't believe they have the technology to build normal communication equipment. We're concerned they may have developed another way to communicate.

Your response: Do you mean something like telepathy?

NPC: We don't know at the moment. Our Scouts have recovered a few mutants from the wastes. Their bodies are currently in a lab at the Tech Haven Administration area - being dissected by Doctor Maisee Wong. Go and see if you can be of assistance to their efforts.

NPC: Ah, you must be the Runner that Jones sent - she just contacted me to say that you were coming.

Your response: Jones mentioned that you might need assistance with an autopsy?

NPC: No, not exactly. We've done the majority of it already - but we did find something you might be able to assist with.

Your response: Yeah, of course - how can I help?

NPC: We pulled similar-looking implants out of a number of the mutants. They're too badly damaged for us to send them straight to the technical engineers for testing. So I think we're going to have to involve a researcher to see if they can figure it out. Take it back to Mrs. Jones. I'm sure she'll know someone suitable for the job.

NPC: Mrs. Jones is waiting!

NPC: You need to speak with Dr Wong.

NPC: I need this package!

NPC: Ah Runner, that was quick. Did Doctor Wong have any work for you?

Your response: She needs a researcher to investigate an implant pulled from the mutants.

NPC: Alright, I'll see who's available. Speak with me again in a moment.

NPC: Alright, are you ready to proceed?

Your response: Of course - what's next?

Your response: Not right now, I will be back though.

NPC: Very well, you know where to find me.

NPC: Well, it appears the usual research team I use is unavailable, but I know a suitable alternative. You're going to do it.

Your response: Oh, okay. What do I need to do?

NPC: It's simple enough, make a blueprint of the Mutant Implant, and speak with me when you're done.

NPC: Come back once you've researched the chip.

NPC: Good work. I didn't doubt you were capable.

Your response: Thanks, what now?

NPC: I'm just waiting for confirmation of which technicians need the blueprint. Speak with me again in a minute.

NPC: Alright Runner, I just need you to transport these schematics now.

Your response: Sure, I've got time.

Your response: I have other things to do. I will be back though.

NPC: Very well, you know where to find me.

NPC: I've taken the liberty of encrypting the schematics to this datacube, to ensure the data remains secretive. Take it to Tech Haven Sec-2 and give it to Rees Jamison - he's usually found near the Gene Replicators there.

NPC: Sorry. Can't talk. Waiting for some important research data.

NPC: Ah great, you've got the schematics?

Your response: Sure, Mrs. Jones encrypted them and stored them on this datacube for you.

NPC: Yeah, she's always so careful - especially with things like this. I'll take it from here. You head back to your apartment and speak with Mr Jones again.

NPC: Go speak with Mrs. Jones, at your apartment.

NPC: Take the schematics to Rees Jamison at Tech Haven Sec-2.

NPC: I take it you already delivered the data?

Your response: Yeah, of course. What's next?

NPC: At the moment, nothing from me - but I think we'll be seeing each other again in the future. Until then, take this as a token of gratitude from Techhaven.

Mrs. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

POSSIBLE PREREQUISITES
• Complete Mission 2: Mutant Intelligence!
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Rees Jamison
• Talk to Mrs. Jones

REWARDS
• 3,000 credits
• 3,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself.

NPC: Hello Runner, I am Mrs. Jones. I represent the Administration of Tech Haven. I understand that you are a Scientist. Would you be interested in some work?

Your response: I'm not interested in your tasks - please leave.

Your response: I'm sorry, I don't have time right now. Another time?

Your response: I'm interested, how can I help?

NPC: Very well, I will remain here for a while. (Return before level /25 to resume.)

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Tech Haven is the last true bastion of human intellect in the world. We are united by a single goal - the survival of human kind. To achieve that goal, sometimes we need to take less orthodox measures.

Your response: What do you mean?

NPC: We've received reports of Mutants in the wastelands which appear to be communicating rapidly over long distances. We don't believe they have the technology to build normal communication equipment. We're concerned they may have developed another way to communicate.

Your response: Do you mean something like telepathy?

NPC: We don't know at the moment. Our Scouts have recovered a few mutants from the wastes. Their bodies are currently in a lab at the Tech Haven Administration area - being dissected by Doctor Maisee Wong. Go and see if you can be of assistance to their efforts.

NPC: Ah, you must be the Runner that Jones sent - she just contacted me to say that you were coming.

Your response: Jones mentioned that you might need assistance with an autopsy?

NPC: No, not exactly. We've done the majority of it already - but we did find something you might be able to assist with.

Your response: Yeah, of course - how can I help?

NPC: We pulled similar-looking implants out of a number of the mutants. They're too badly damaged for us to send them straight to the technical engineers for testing. So I think we're going to have to involve a researcher to see if they can figure it out. Take it back to Mrs. Jones. I'm sure she'll know someone suitable for the job.

NPC: Mrs. Jones is waiting!

NPC: You need to speak with Dr Wong.

NPC: I need this package!

NPC: Ah Runner, that was quick. Did Doctor Wong have any work for you?

Your response: She needs a researcher to investigate an implant pulled from the mutants.

NPC: Alright, I'll see who's available. Speak with me again in a moment.

NPC: Alright, are you ready to proceed?

Your response: Of course - what's next?

Your response: Not right now, I will be back though.

NPC: Very well, you know where to find me.

NPC: Well, it appears the usual research team I use is unavailable, but I know a suitable alternative. You're going to do it.

Your response: Oh, okay. What do I need to do?

NPC: It's simple enough, make a blueprint of the Mutant Implant, and speak with me when you're done.

NPC: Come back once you've researched the chip.

NPC: Good work. I didn't doubt you were capable.

Your response: Thanks, what now?

NPC: I'm just waiting for confirmation of which technicians need the blueprint. Speak with me again in a minute.

NPC: Alright Runner, I just need you to transport these schematics now.

Your response: Sure, I've got time.

Your response: I have other things to do. I will be back though.

NPC: Very well, you know where to find me.

NPC: I've taken the liberty of encrypting the schematics to this datacube, to ensure the data remains secretive. Take it to Tech Haven Sec-2 and give it to Rees Jamison - he's usually found near the Gene Replicators there.

NPC: Sorry. Can't talk. Waiting for some important research data.

NPC: Ah great, you've got the schematics?

Your response: Sure, Mrs. Jones encrypted them and stored them on this datacube for you.

NPC: Yeah, she's always so careful - especially with things like this. I'll take it from here. You head back to your apartment and speak with Mr Jones again.

NPC: Go speak with Mrs. Jones, at your apartment.

NPC: Take the schematics to Rees Jamison at Tech Haven Sec-2.

NPC: I take it you already delivered the data?

Your response: Yeah, of course. What's next?

NPC: At the moment, nothing from me - but I think we'll be seeing each other again in the future. Until then, take this as a token of gratitude from Techhaven.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Mrs. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

OBJECTIVES
• Talk to Yuki Dering
• Collect Crate ID chip
• Talk to Mrs. Jones

REWARDS
• 1,000 credits
• 1,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself.

NPC: Ah, runner. Welcome to Tech Haven - your new home. I've been set to help your integration into our community - are you interested in a task?

Your response: I'm interested, how can I help?

Your response: I'm sorry, I don't have time right now. Another time?

Your response: I'm not interested in your tasks - please leave.

NPC: Very well, I will remain here for a while. (Return before level /25 to resume.)

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Glad to hear it. As you're likely aware, Tech Haven is situated quite comfortably in a mountain range, half way between the Dome of York and Neocron City.

Your response: Uh huh.

NPC: Although this affords us security and a necessary amount of solitude, it means we rely on outsiders to obtain items we just simply don't have access to.

Your response: Yeah, I bet. Go on.

NPC: One of those issues is keeping stock of our assets - which is what I need you for today.

Your response: Alright - what do you want me to do?

NPC: Head over to Tech Haven Sec-1 and speak with Yuki Dering near the Rokkwear Shop. She deals with logistics and is often commenting on the lack of help.

NPC: Look, I'm sorry but I've got way too much do to right now, I can't stop to make small talk.

Your response: Actually, that's why I'm here, Mrs. Jones said you might need some help?

NPC: Well, I've got a shipment of biological specimens which seems to have gone missing between here and the labs. You could find out where they've gone.

Your response: Okay, where do I start?

NPC: Well, luckily we tag all the crates when they come in to us, and I heard that the Administration has access to some kind of tracking device. If you take this ID chip back to Mrs. Jones, she probably has the tools to track it for us.

NPC: Mrs. Jones is waiting!

NPC: You need to go and speak with Yuki Dering. Come back when you have.

NPC: Welcome back - did you manage to help Yuki out?

Your response: Yeah - still working on that. She gave me an ID chip and said you might be able to track a shipment?

NPC: Heh heh. It seems some of Tech Haven's secrets aren't as well kept as the Administration would like - don't go spreading this information about.

Your response: So are you gonna help out?

NPC: I'll take a look - speak with me again in a moment.

NPC: Alright. I think I have the location of the crate. Head to Energy Core 1 and check it out. And make sure you take a weapon, it might not be safe down there.

NPC: (It appears that the case is empty. Next to it is a dead body, it is still warm.)

Your response: Might be worth having a quick search and see if there are any clues...

NPC: (Where would you like to search?)

Your response: I'll search his shirt.

Your response: I'll search his trousers.

Your response: I'll search his boots.

NPC: (You search through his shirt pockets but there's nothing interesting.)

Your response: Better search somewhere else.

NPC: (Nothing here but a Milky Ren wrapper.)

Your response: Better search somewhere else.

NPC: (You pull off his boots and give them a shake - a piece of paper falls out. Looks like the details for this drop. There's a name here, you should take this to Jones.)

NPC: ...

NPC: Go and locate that crate, then come back here...

NPC: Do not come back empty-handed!

NPC: Did you recover the crate?

Your response: No, someone beat me to it. The crate was empty and they left a body behind.

NPC: Dammit. Alright - I'll call in a few favours and see if I can get an ID on the body.

Your response: No need - I searched it and found the details of the drop.

NPC: You're kidding, right? Well, that's... convenient.

Your response: Isn't it just - here, see if this means anything to you

NPC: Alright, give me a moment to look into this and then speak with me again.

NPC: Alright - I've tracked down the name for you. Head to Co-Dees Sushi Bar in Tech Haven Sec-2 and speak with Pietr Dior. See what you can find out from him. You have my authority to take him into custody if need be.

NPC: Yeah? What do you want?

Your response: Got a few questions about you about a stolen shipment and a body.

NPC: Yeah? And what makes you think I'd know anything about it?

Your response: Your name was on a note found on the body.

NPC: Stupid sonuva... that doesn't prove anything - you've got nothing on me.

Your response: Then you won't mind if I take you in for Administration to question you then.

NPC: Yeah, that's not going to happen, pig. Eat this!

NPC: ...

NPC: Go and speak with Pietr Dior at the bar, Runner.

NPC: Did you get anything out of Pietr?

Your response: Nothing - he pulled a pistol and so I put him down.

NPC: Interesting reaction. I think there's more to it that just that one guy - leave it with me, I'm going to pass on the details to security to look into this further.

Your response: Alright - what do you need me to do?

NPC: I'd say you've done enough for now. You've done good though.

Your response: Thanks! Anytime!

NPC: I realise this wasn't what you were expecting to be doing, so here, take this as a thank you. You take care for now, I'm sure I'll be speaking to you again in the future.

entries.title: Mission 1: Puppet Master!
entries.description: Go and finish off five drones at the Drone Racetrack, speak to Mrs. Jones afterwards.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Mrs. Jones

REPEAT
One time

DIFFICULTY
1

OBJECTIVES
• Defeat 5 × Assault Drone
• Talk to Mrs. Jones

REWARDS
• 1,000 credits
• 1,000 experience
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself.

NPC: Ah, there you are. Welcome to Tech Haven. I've been reading your notes, and it appears that you are quite handy in a fight. I have something for you, if you're interested?

Your response: I'm interested, how can I help?

Your response: I'm sorry, I don't have time right now. Another time?

Your response: I'm not interested in your tasks - please leave.

NPC: Very well, I will remain here for a while. (Return before level /25 to resume.)

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Good. Now, you've been in MC5 for some time, and I want to make sure none of your motor-functions are impaired. We've set up some training bots in the Drone Racetrack - go and kill 5 of them.

Your response: Are you sure I shouldn't start on sewer rats or something?

NPC: Very funny. Get going.

NPC: Go and finish off the drones, and then we'll talk!

NPC: Welcome back runner. That was better than a sewer, wasn't it.

Your response: Marginally. What's next?

NPC: Well, your biometrics appear fine - so we'll try you with something a little more challenging. Speak with me again in a moment.

NPC: Alright, are you ready to proceed?

Your response: Of course - what's next?

Your response: Not right now, I will be back though.

NPC: Very well, you know where to find me.

NPC: I've had a report that's come in - apparently one of our prototype droids has gone on a rampage and killed a technical team. I don't have an available security team, so I'm sending you in instead.

Your response: Alone?

NPC: Yes - I wouldn't send you if I didn't think you could take care of the matter. Head to Energy Core 2 and put down the Malfunctioning Droid, then return to me.

NPC: Destroy the Malfunctioning Droid and return to me.

NPC: Well done - I told you that you could handle it.

Your response: It was nothing, really.

NPC: I've got a feeling that the droid attacking the engineer team wasn't an accident, so I've asked for the logs to be checked. Speak with me again in a moment.

NPC: Alright, are you ready to proceed?

Your response: Of course - what's next?

Your response: Not right now, I will be back though.

NPC: Very well, you know where to find me.

NPC: It appears that my gut instinct was correct. The logs show that the routines controlling the Droid's targeting matrix were altered just prior to the attack.

Your response: What? Who would do that?

NPC: One of the members of the technical team, Jeorj Sorik, managed to escape the attack unharmed. He's currently at Tech Haven Sec-3 - near the Runner Housing blocks. I'd start with him.

NPC: Something I can help you with?

Your response: Jeorj Sorik? I'm investigating the Droid attack which killed your colleagues.

NPC: Uh, yeah... tragic that... just sorta comes out of nowhere, you know?

Your response: Yeah - any idea what caused it?

NPC: Nah, no idea who reprogrammed them.

Your response: Funny... how did you know they had been reprogrammed? That information isn't public knowledge...

NPC: Ah well... You see - the thing is... Oh fuck it. This is what you get for sticking your nose in!

NPC: ...

NPC: Don't come back until you have spoken with Jeorj Sorik.

NPC: Well, did you get anywhere with Jeorj?

Your response: Yes and no. I started questioning him, but he attacked me before I got anything useful.

NPC: Hmm, well, if nothing else we know we were on the correct track.

Your response: What happens now?

NPC: I'll get this assigned to an investigation team - so they can look into it properly. You've been a great help today, and I have a little weapon to help you on your way.

Your response: Seriously? Fantastic!

NPC: Well, giving you this benefits Tech Haven as a whole. Make good use of it, Runner!

CONTACT

REPEAT

Other conditions may also apply.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself.

NPC: Ah, there you are. Welcome to Tech Haven. I've been reading your notes, and it appears that you are quite handy in a fight. I have something for you, if you're interested?

Your response: I'm interested, how can I help?

Your response: I'm sorry, I don't have time right now. Another time?

Your response: I'm not interested in your tasks - please leave.

NPC: Very well, I will remain here for a while. (Return before level /25 to resume.)

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Good. Now, you've been in MC5 for some time, and I want to make sure none of your motor-functions are impaired. We've set up some training bots in the Drone Racetrack - go and kill 5 of them.

Your response: Are you sure I shouldn't start on sewer rats or something?

NPC: Very funny. Get going.

NPC: Go and finish off the drones, and then we'll talk!

NPC: Welcome back runner. That was better than a sewer, wasn't it.

Your response: Marginally. What's next?

NPC: Well, your biometrics appear fine - so we'll try you with something a little more challenging. Speak with me again in a moment.

NPC: Alright, are you ready to proceed?

Your response: Of course - what's next?

Your response: Not right now, I will be back though.

NPC: Very well, you know where to find me.

NPC: I've had a report that's come in - apparently one of our prototype droids has gone on a rampage and killed a technical team. I don't have an available security team, so I'm sending you in instead.

Your response: Alone?

NPC: Yes - I wouldn't send you if I didn't think you could take care of the matter. Head to Energy Core 2 and put down the Malfunctioning Droid, then return to me.

NPC: Destroy the Malfunctioning Droid and return to me.

NPC: Well done - I told you that you could handle it.

Your response: It was nothing, really.

NPC: I've got a feeling that the droid attacking the engineer team wasn't an accident, so I've asked for the logs to be checked. Speak with me again in a moment.

NPC: Alright, are you ready to proceed?

Your response: Of course - what's next?

Your response: Not right now, I will be back though.

NPC: Very well, you know where to find me.

NPC: It appears that my gut instinct was correct. The logs show that the routines controlling the Droid's targeting matrix were altered just prior to the attack.

Your response: What? Who would do that?

NPC: One of the members of the technical team, Jeorj Sorik, managed to escape the attack unharmed. He's currently at Tech Haven Sec-3 - near the Runner Housing blocks. I'd start with him.

NPC: Something I can help you with?

Your response: Jeorj Sorik? I'm investigating the Droid attack which killed your colleagues.

NPC: Uh, yeah... tragic that... just sorta comes out of nowhere, you know?

Your response: Yeah - any idea what caused it?

NPC: Nah, no idea who reprogrammed them.

Your response: Funny... how did you know they had been reprogrammed? That information isn't public knowledge...

NPC: Ah well... You see - the thing is... Oh fuck it. This is what you get for sticking your nose in!

NPC: ...

NPC: Don't come back until you have spoken with Jeorj Sorik.

NPC: Well, did you get anywhere with Jeorj?

Your response: Yes and no. I started questioning him, but he attacked me before I got anything useful.

NPC: Hmm, well, if nothing else we know we were on the correct track.

Your response: What happens now?

NPC: I'll get this assigned to an investigation team - so they can look into it properly. You've been a great help today, and I have a little weapon to help you on your way.

Your response: Seriously? Fantastic!

NPC: Well, giving you this benefits Tech Haven as a whole. Make good use of it, Runner!

entries.title: The cleansing of the Shaman Remains
entries.description: Sorcha Nox wants you to kill a Kri'nakh Shaman in one of the Swamp Caves. You should also keep all the 'Kri'nakh Poisonglands' you might loot from the creatures in these caves.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Sorcha Nox
Location clue: Sorcha Nox, Swamp Sector F03 WID 2103

REPEAT
One time

OBJECTIVES
• Defeat 1 × Kri'nakh Shaman
    Note: That's one Kri'nakh Shaman dead, good job! Return to Sorcha Nox in Swamp Sector F03
• Talk to Sorcha Nox
    Note: Collect 5x Kri'nakh Poisonglands, 1x Immunosupressive Toxins, 10x Plant Fibers, 1x Fucoxanthin and 1x Gibberllin. Return to Sorcha Nox afterwards.
• Collect 5 × Kri'nakh Poisongland
• Collect 1 × Immunosuppressive Toxins
• Collect 10 × Plant Fibers
• Collect 1 × Fucoxanthin
• Collect 1 × Gibberllin
• Talk to Sorcha Nox

REWARDS
• Swamp Shaman Remains
entries.conversation:
NPC: You've got exactly 10 seconds to get the hell out of here before things get really uncomfortable for you!

Your response: Stop the counting and relax! It's me again.

Your response: HOLD ON! I've been looking for you.

NPC: ...9!

Your response: Relax! I need your help!

Your response: Okay, fine then.

NPC: ...8!

Your response: I'm willing to pay for it!

NPC: You think I can be bought? ...3!

Your response: If you help me, I'll do you any favor you want!

NPC: ... ANY favor? Fine, you've got another 10 seconds. This time to explain why you're here and what you want from me.

Your response: I found an item out in the swamps and heard you're the only one who can help me with it.

NPC: What kind of item? I doubt there's anything out here that could be interesting or even valuable.

Your response: Here, see for yourself.

Your response: Then I'd rather keep it.

NPC: You've got nothing? Nothing at all? Was that all a lie? This time the countdown starts at 5... 4...

NPC: Holy shit! This thing is completely contaminated with shaman toxin! Here, take it back. Found it, you say? You don't just 'find' something like this. Where did you get it?

Your response: Well, 'found' might be an understatement. I...

NPC: ...gutted a Swamp Shaman after killing it?

Your response: I... I... it's not what it looks like!

NPC: I damn well hope it's EXACTLY what it looks like!

Your response: I'm sorry... wait, what did you just say?

NPC: That I hope you nailed one of those filthy beasts. What do you think I'm doing out here? I research these swamp creatures. Their toxins, their poison glands, their antidotes, everything.

Your response: Yeah, but...

NPC: They're hardly going to hand over their bodies voluntarily, are they? I kill them and cut them open so I can study them.

Your response: Oh okay, that explains the rumor that you're the expert on my... item.

NPC: I'm the only one who can decontaminate that thing for you. It won't be easy though. Every shaman has its own unique toxin signature, but it's doable.

Your response: So you'll help me?

NPC: Remember your promise to do me ANY favor? I certainly hope so, because one hand washes the other, right?

Your response: Uh yeah, so what is this favor about?

NPC: My work here doesn't exactly make me friends with the creatures inhabiting these swamps. I hunt and kill them, and they fear and hate me. Lately, they seem to be organizing and planning something against me.

Your response: -continue-

NPC: Their leaders, the Kri'nakh Shamans, hide in the underground caves throughout the swamps and rule over all swamp creatures from there.

Your response: -continue-

NPC: If I'm going to stay here, we need to put a stop to their schemes and attacks against me. One of their leaders has to die!

Your response: We are supposed to kill a Kri'nakh Shaman? Have you gone insane?

NPC: No, not we, YOU! That's the deal. I decontaminate your item, and in return, you get rid of my little shaman problem.

Your response: I don't think I can do that.

NPC: Then you better learn fast! You can find the Kri'nakh in any Swamp Cave around these swamp sectors. How you do it is up to you, but you should probably bring someone along to help.

Your response: Okay, I'll try.

Your response: No, count me out. Before you start counting again: I'm already leaving!

NPC: Kill a Kri'nakh Shaman. If you loot any 'Kri'nakh Poisonglands' from the creatures in the cave, keep them! We'll likely need them for the decontamination later.

Your response: OK.

NPC: Before you go, leave the remains with me. I'll examine them and prepare them for decontamination. Just remember, once you do this, there's no turning back!

Your response: Alright, a deal's a deal!

Your response: I'm supposed to trust you with this thing without knowing if I can even kill the shaman? Forget it!

NPC: If you don't want to give me the item, get lost! 5... 4...

NPC: Get moving, or do I need to start counting again?

NPC: Get lost!

NPC: Not a single Kri'nakh Shaman is dead! Don't try to double cross me! You'll find them strictly inside the underground Swamp Caves.

NPC: Not bad at all, %PLAYER_NAME. The death of one of their leaders clearly shocked the swamp creatures, and they've called off their attacks on me for now.

Your response: So I fulfilled my end of the deal!

NPC: Yes, you did. In the meantime, I took a closer look at the shaman remains. I'm going to need a few materials for the decontamination process!

Your response: What exactly do you need? I'll see what I can do!

NPC: It's crucial that you listen carefully now and remember what I need. One wrong ingredient and the chance to decontaminate these remains is gone.

First, we need 5x Kri'nakh Poisonglands, which hopefully you already gathered during your trip to the Swamp Caves.

Your response: 5x Kri'nakh Poisonglands, okay.

NPC: To weaken the effects of the toxin during the process, I need 1x Immunosuppressive Toxins. You'll have to kill carnivorous swamp plants for those.

Your response: 1x Immunosuppressive Toxins from the plants.

NPC: You can find all the other ingredients on the plants in these swamp sectors as well: 10x Plant Fibers, 1x Fucoxanthin, and 1x Gibberllin.

Your response: Okay, let me double check everything: 5x Kri'nakh Poisonglands, 1x Immunosuppressive Toxins, 10x Plant Fibers, 1x Fucoxanthin, and 1x Gibberllin.

NPC: Well, you're smarter than I thought. That's correct, but don't come back until you have all the ingredients. Hurry up! If the shaman's remains start rotting here, there's nothing more I can do for you.

Your response: I'm on my way!

NPC: You better be back soon!

NPC: About damn time. The carcass is starting to rot and stink up the place! Do you have what I asked for? Let's start with the Kri'nakh Poisonglands.

Your response: I couldn't move any faster! Yes, here they are.

NPC: Let's see what you got.

NPC: Okay, these look good.

Your response: What do you need next?

NPC: 5x Kri'nakh Poisonglands. It can't be that hard. Try again...

NPC: How about the Immunosuppressive Toxins? They're one of the most critical parts of the decontamination.

Your response: Who would've thought plants could be so dangerous? It wasn't easy, but I've got what you need.

NPC: Let's see what you got.

NPC: Okay, good work.

Your response: What do you need next?

NPC: 1x Immunosuppressive Toxins. They're just plants! It can't be that hard. Try again...

NPC: Let's get to the easiest part. Plain Plant Fibers shouldn't have been a problem.

Your response: You'd think so... but when the plants fight back and attack you, it's a whole different story.

NPC: Let's see what you got.

NPC: Stop whining! At least you managed to gather enough fibers.

Your response: What do you need next?

NPC: 10x Plant Fibers. It can't be that hard. Try again...

NPC: Just 2 more items and you've actually gathered everything. Let's start with Fucoxanthin.

Your response: No problem.

NPC: Let's see what you got.

NPC: Looks right. Good work.

Your response: Now there's only one thing left, right?

NPC: 1x Fucoxanthin. It can't be that hard. Try again...

NPC: Yeah, the last ingredient I need is Gibberllin. Do you have that too?

Your response: Here it is. I really hope that's everything now.

NPC: Let's see what you got.

NPC: I really didn't think you'd manage to gather everything. Maybe I underestimated you.

Your response: Where do we go from here?

NPC: Seriously? Failing right before the finish line? You're missing 1x Gibberllin.

NPC: Now I'll combine everything and extract a solution to soak the shaman's remains in. That should neutralize its toxin.

Your response: -continue-

NPC: Alright, looking good. Now we just wait a moment for the toxin to dissipate from the cells.

Your response: -continue-

NPC: Done. That worked better and faster than expected. I might even be able to use the result for my research to develop a general antidote against shaman toxins.

Your response: Who would've thought. Maybe you should reconsider your whole countdown routine with visitors. One or two of them might actually turn out useful to you...

NPC: You're walking on thin ice! Do you want your shaman carcass back now or what?

Your response: Yes, absolutely.

NPC: Here, take it. Do whatever you want with it. Nail it to a piece of wood and put it on display somewhere...I couldn't care less. Just get out of my face!

NPC: Oh, %PLAYER_NAME... I was hoping you were finally gone.

Your response: I'm back! I was hoping we could keep our new friendship going.

NPC: You cannot maintain what doesn't exist! What do you want?

Your response: I really felt a spark between us... Alright then, let's get straight to the point.

NPC: Go ahead!

Your response: Well, I killed more Swamp Shamans and guess what? I found another one of those...items!

NPC: You killed more Swamp Shamans and now you want me to decontaminate more remains? Why should I do that?

Your response: Exactly! I thought you'd be glad I killed more of those... what did you call them last time?...filthy beasts?

NPC: Well, yes I am, but...

Your response: Come on! I'll do you another favor and you'll just do the decontamination thing once again. Remember? A deal is a deal!

NPC: In fact, the last shock among the swamp creatures didn't last long. They are attacking me on a regular basis again. Maybe it's time to kill another one of their leaders.

Your response: Seriously? You want me to kill a Kri'nakh Shaman AGAIN?

NPC: Yes! Before you go, leave the remains with me. I'll examine them and prepare them for decontamination. Just remember, once you do this, there's no turning back!

Your response: Alright, a deal's a deal!

Your response: You know what? I'm just not going to do that again!

NPC: If you don't want to give me the item, get lost! 5... 4...

NPC: Get moving, or do I need to start counting again?

NPC: Get lost!

NPC: Not a single Kri'nakh Shaman is dead! Don't try to double cross me! You'll find them strictly inside the underground Swamp Caves.

NPC: Well done, %PLAYER_NAME. The swamp tribe is in shock again.

Your response: So I, once again, fulfilled my end of the deal!

NPC: Yes, you did. The toxin signature of the shaman you killed this time is different though. Therefore, the ingredients I'll need for the decontamination will be slighty different as well.

Your response: What exactly do you need? I'll see what I can do!

NPC: I'll still need the basic stuff: 5x Kri'nakh Poisonglands, 1x Immunosuppressive Toxins and 10x Plant Fibers.

But instead of Fucoxanthin and Gibberllin you have to find 1x Protoxylem and 1x Auxin.

Your response: 5x Kri'nakh Poisonglands, 1x Immunosupressive Toxins, 10x Plant Fibers PLUS 1x Protoxylem and 1x Auxin.

NPC: That's correct, but don't come back until you have all the ingredients. Hurry up! If the shaman's remains start rotting here, there's nothing more I can do for you.

Your response: I'm on my way!

NPC: You better be back soon!

NPC: You already know the drill: let's start with the Kri'nakh Poisonglands.

Your response: Yes, here they are.

NPC: Let's see what you got.

NPC: Okay, these look good.

Your response: What do you need next?

NPC: 5x Kri'nakh Poisonglands. It can't be that hard. Try again...

NPC: How about the Immunosuppressive Toxins? They're still one of the most critical parts of the decontamination.

Your response: It wasn't easy, but I've got what you need.

NPC: Let's see what you got.

NPC: Okay, good work.

Your response: What do you need next?

NPC: 1x Immunosuppressive Toxins. They're just plants! It can't be that hard. Try again...

NPC: Let's get to the easiest part. Plain Plant Fibers shouldn't have been a problem.

Your response: You'd think so... but these plants are still fighting back like crazy!

NPC: Let's see what you got.

NPC: Stop whining! At least you managed to gather enough fibers.

Your response: What do you need next?

NPC: 10x Plant Fibers. It can't be that hard. Try again...

NPC: Just 2 more new items and you've once again gathered everything. Let's start with Protoxylem.

Your response: No problem.

NPC: Let's see what you got.

NPC: That looks good.

Your response: That means, there is only Auxin left now, right?

NPC: 1x Protoxylem. It can't be that hard. Try again...

NPC: Yeah, the last ingredient I need is Auxin. I guess you have that too?

Your response: Here it is.

NPC: Let's see what you got.

NPC: That's it. I'll proceed with the decontamination in a second.

Your response: That sounds good.

NPC: Seriously? Failing right before the finish line? You're missing 1x Auxin.

NPC: The toxin is already dissipating from the cells...almost finished.

Your response: There you go! That was a lot faster than last time. You are getting better at it, don't you? Skill comes with practice!

NPC: Careful my friend. The ice you are standing on is still pretty thin!

Your response: Hah! You just said it. You called me a friend! I knew... okay okay, PUT THE WEAPON AWAY!

NPC: Here, take your shaman remains. And I WILL SHOOT YOU if you ever dare to come back to me!

Your response: Thank you very much, I might still come back though!

NPC: You better run now!

entries.title: Cleaning more Shaman Remains
entries.description: Sorcha Nox wants you to kill a Kri'nakh Shaman in one of the Swamp Caves. You should also keep all the 'Kri'nakh Poisonglands' you might loot from the creatures in these caves.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Sorcha Nox
Location clue: Sorcha Nox, Swamp Sector F03 WID 2103

REPEAT
Repeatable

POSSIBLE PREREQUISITES
• Complete The cleansing of the Shaman Remains
Other conditions may also apply.

OBJECTIVES
• Defeat 1 × Kri'nakh Shaman
    Note: That's one Kri'nakh Shaman dead, good job! Return to Sorcha Nox in Swamp Sector F03
• Talk to Sorcha Nox
    Note: Collect 5x Kri'nakh Poisonglands, 1x Immunosupressive Toxins, 10x Plant Fibers, 1x Fucoxanthin and 1x Gibberllin. Return to Sorcha Nox afterwards.
• Collect 5 × Kri'nakh Poisongland
• Collect 1 × Immunosuppressive Toxins
• Collect 10 × Plant Fibers
• Collect 1 × Protoxylem
• Collect 1 × Auxin
• Talk to Sorcha Nox

REWARDS
• Swamp Shaman Remains

NPC: You've got exactly 10 seconds to get the hell out of here before things get really uncomfortable for you!

Your response: Stop the counting and relax! It's me again.

Your response: HOLD ON! I've been looking for you.

NPC: ...9!

Your response: Relax! I need your help!

Your response: Okay, fine then.

NPC: ...8!

Your response: I'm willing to pay for it!

NPC: You think I can be bought? ...3!

Your response: If you help me, I'll do you any favor you want!

NPC: ... ANY favor? Fine, you've got another 10 seconds. This time to explain why you're here and what you want from me.

Your response: I found an item out in the swamps and heard you're the only one who can help me with it.

NPC: What kind of item? I doubt there's anything out here that could be interesting or even valuable.

Your response: Here, see for yourself.

Your response: Then I'd rather keep it.

NPC: You've got nothing? Nothing at all? Was that all a lie? This time the countdown starts at 5... 4...

NPC: Holy shit! This thing is completely contaminated with shaman toxin! Here, take it back. Found it, you say? You don't just 'find' something like this. Where did you get it?

Your response: Well, 'found' might be an understatement. I...

NPC: ...gutted a Swamp Shaman after killing it?

Your response: I... I... it's not what it looks like!

NPC: I damn well hope it's EXACTLY what it looks like!

Your response: I'm sorry... wait, what did you just say?

NPC: That I hope you nailed one of those filthy beasts. What do you think I'm doing out here? I research these swamp creatures. Their toxins, their poison glands, their antidotes, everything.

Your response: Yeah, but...

NPC: They're hardly going to hand over their bodies voluntarily, are they? I kill them and cut them open so I can study them.

Your response: Oh okay, that explains the rumor that you're the expert on my... item.

NPC: I'm the only one who can decontaminate that thing for you. It won't be easy though. Every shaman has its own unique toxin signature, but it's doable.

Your response: So you'll help me?

NPC: Remember your promise to do me ANY favor? I certainly hope so, because one hand washes the other, right?

Your response: Uh yeah, so what is this favor about?

NPC: My work here doesn't exactly make me friends with the creatures inhabiting these swamps. I hunt and kill them, and they fear and hate me. Lately, they seem to be organizing and planning something against me.

Your response: -continue-

NPC: Their leaders, the Kri'nakh Shamans, hide in the underground caves throughout the swamps and rule over all swamp creatures from there.

Your response: -continue-

NPC: If I'm going to stay here, we need to put a stop to their schemes and attacks against me. One of their leaders has to die!

Your response: We are supposed to kill a Kri'nakh Shaman? Have you gone insane?

NPC: No, not we, YOU! That's the deal. I decontaminate your item, and in return, you get rid of my little shaman problem.

Your response: I don't think I can do that.

NPC: Then you better learn fast! You can find the Kri'nakh in any Swamp Cave around these swamp sectors. How you do it is up to you, but you should probably bring someone along to help.

Your response: Okay, I'll try.

Your response: No, count me out. Before you start counting again: I'm already leaving!

NPC: Kill a Kri'nakh Shaman. If you loot any 'Kri'nakh Poisonglands' from the creatures in the cave, keep them! We'll likely need them for the decontamination later.

Your response: OK.

NPC: Before you go, leave the remains with me. I'll examine them and prepare them for decontamination. Just remember, once you do this, there's no turning back!

Your response: Alright, a deal's a deal!

Your response: I'm supposed to trust you with this thing without knowing if I can even kill the shaman? Forget it!

NPC: If you don't want to give me the item, get lost! 5... 4...

NPC: Get moving, or do I need to start counting again?

NPC: Get lost!

NPC: Not a single Kri'nakh Shaman is dead! Don't try to double cross me! You'll find them strictly inside the underground Swamp Caves.

NPC: Not bad at all, %PLAYER_NAME. The death of one of their leaders clearly shocked the swamp creatures, and they've called off their attacks on me for now.

Your response: So I fulfilled my end of the deal!

NPC: Yes, you did. In the meantime, I took a closer look at the shaman remains. I'm going to need a few materials for the decontamination process!

Your response: What exactly do you need? I'll see what I can do!

NPC: It's crucial that you listen carefully now and remember what I need. One wrong ingredient and the chance to decontaminate these remains is gone.

First, we need 5x Kri'nakh Poisonglands, which hopefully you already gathered during your trip to the Swamp Caves.

Your response: 5x Kri'nakh Poisonglands, okay.

NPC: To weaken the effects of the toxin during the process, I need 1x Immunosuppressive Toxins. You'll have to kill carnivorous swamp plants for those.

Your response: 1x Immunosuppressive Toxins from the plants.

NPC: You can find all the other ingredients on the plants in these swamp sectors as well: 10x Plant Fibers, 1x Fucoxanthin, and 1x Gibberllin.

Your response: Okay, let me double check everything: 5x Kri'nakh Poisonglands, 1x Immunosuppressive Toxins, 10x Plant Fibers, 1x Fucoxanthin, and 1x Gibberllin.

NPC: Well, you're smarter than I thought. That's correct, but don't come back until you have all the ingredients. Hurry up! If the shaman's remains start rotting here, there's nothing more I can do for you.

Your response: I'm on my way!

NPC: You better be back soon!

NPC: About damn time. The carcass is starting to rot and stink up the place! Do you have what I asked for? Let's start with the Kri'nakh Poisonglands.

Your response: I couldn't move any faster! Yes, here they are.

NPC: Let's see what you got.

NPC: Okay, these look good.

Your response: What do you need next?

NPC: 5x Kri'nakh Poisonglands. It can't be that hard. Try again...

NPC: How about the Immunosuppressive Toxins? They're one of the most critical parts of the decontamination.

Your response: Who would've thought plants could be so dangerous? It wasn't easy, but I've got what you need.

NPC: Let's see what you got.

NPC: Okay, good work.

NPC: 1x Immunosuppressive Toxins. They're just plants! It can't be that hard. Try again...

NPC: Let's see what you got.

NPC: Stop whining! At least you managed to gather enough fibers.

NPC: 10x Plant Fibers. It can't be that hard. Try again...

NPC: Just 2 more items and you've actually gathered everything. Let's start with Fucoxanthin.

NPC: Let's see what you got.

NPC: I really didn't think you'd manage to gather everything. Maybe I underestimated you.

NPC: Alright, looking good. Now we just wait a moment for the toxin to dissipate from the cells.

Your response: I think I heard enough now, thanks. I really want to get home now.

NPC: Can't you see I have my own problems right now?!

NPC: What're you looking at?

Your response: That glider of yours, to be perfectly honest. How did it end up there?

Your response: Lorcan sent me over. Anything I can help you with?

NPC: Talk to that monk gal now, she looked like she could use some help.

Your response: I'll go talk to her now.

Your response: Actually, I'm busy right now.

NPC: Why are you back here?

NPC: What're you looking at?

Your response: That glider of yours, to be perfectly honest. How did it end up there?

Your response: Lorcan sent me over. Anything I can help you with?

Your response: Deal! But how do I get junk?

Your response: I can't do that right now.

Your response: Uh... could you give me a pointer on how to fight?

Your response: Right. Will any junk do?

Your response: Funny. Okay, I guess I'll manage. Will any junk do?

NPC: Suit yourself.

Your response: This is awesome! I'll never run out of ammo, med kits or boosters!

NPC: Thanks! Those Entrails will do nicely.

Your response: You said you'd teach me how to recycle, now...

NPC: I need two Entrails! You don't have them!

NPC: Get me two Entrails. Then we'll talk.

Your response: Yes, I have it right here.

Your response: Sounds simple enough. Will any kind of junk work?

Your response: I'll go talk to her now.

Your response: Actually, I'm busy right now.

NPC: Go ahead, then. And thanks for your help.

NPC: Talk to that monk gal now, she looked like she could use some help.

NPC: I flew over that hill too fast and got stuck between these trees. Damn thing won't budge.

Your response: Maybe we can get it free together, the both of us?

NPC: Nah. The controls are shot anyway. Just waiting for it to recall.

Your response: What do you mean, 'recall'?

Your response: So, why are you waiting here by its side, if it would automatically recall anyway?

Your response: How pathetic is that.

Your response: Good advice, thanks. Any way I can help you, to return the favor?

Your response: Woah, wait, what? I don't know how to do that!

Your response: I'll get back to you on that.

Your response: Okay then. Let's do this.

Your response: I need a cannon.

Your response: Can I get a drone, instead?

Your response: None, but I'd like a psi module.

Your response: Just something so I can melee.

NPC: There you go! You did it!

Your response: This is so cool! Way better than that bought one!

Your response: What do I need for that?

  33              "facility, and I secretly interrupted your process.", 2636)

  38              "anthem and happily volunteer for a suicide mission right now. I just wish I could've stopped it sooner. " ..
  39              "At least some of your memories would have survived, then.", 2637)
  40          ANSWER("Then I suppose I should thank you. But why would they do this? Who are they, anyway?", 50)
  41

  49              "spilled the CEO's coffee. Maybe you were a drifter, and you spoiled the balcony view of some rich " ..
  50              "brat. Doesn't really matter. If it were something really bad, you'd be dead. You're not, so there you " ..
  51              "have it.", 2639)
  52          ANSWER("Ugh, I feel really sick. And my head, it hurts so bad...", 70)

  56              "being delicate when they do this. Hence, the headache. The sickness is a side effect of all the " ..
  57              "medication they pumped into you.", 2640)
  58          ANSWER("A brain implant? What kind of brain implant?", 80)

  63              "attacked by them. It's how they try to enforce their little utopia.", 2641)

  69              "your weakened state, you would be easy prey to all kinds of scum. Get home first, regroup, talk to " ..

  83              "Chief with finding out who it is. But so far, I haven't. Heh heh.", 2644)

  88              "Base Commander. Tell him how happy you are and how much you are looking forward to live and die for " ..
  89              "the city of Neocron, no matter if that's where you live or not. After that, one thing is bound to " ..

entries.conversation:
NPC: You again? We got enough chips for now. Thanks for stopping by!

NPC: Good morning, Runner. I have already been notified that you passed the procedure successfully. Congratulations.

Your response: Procedure? What procedure?

NPC: Good morning, Runner. Please proceed directly to the GenReplicator and leave us.

Your response: I want to know what you people are doing here! Where am I?! ... ohhh ... my head ... I can hardly remember anything, just that there was this bright light ....

NPC: Ehh ... let's move on... What do you want?

Your response: Hmmm ... I was told I could get money to use the GenReplicator here.

Your response: I need a few things. Do you sell anything here?

NPC: Right. That is so. However, if you could spare us a bit of your time, you could do us, and especially our Chief Technician -hehehe- a big favor.
Besides, it would be best for you to stick around and get used to the R.P.O.S. and reacquaint yourself with everything. Once you leave, you won't be able to come back here.

Your response: Sorry, but I want to get home.

Your response: Sure. I'd be glad to be of use.

NPC: I'm glad you're so willing to help. We are currently experiencing problems with the surveillance installation.
It seems like a virus has infected it. At the moment we don't know how to fix the problem.

Your response: That sounds like a problem for a specialist. What can I do?

NPC: Some of these installations are prototypes. They contain revolutionary chips we need to recover. You should secure four of them and hand them over to the Chief Technician.
That's it. Security personnel is responsible for this facility and can't take care of our problem.

Your response: Sounds good. I'll see what I can do.

NPC: Excellent. Report to the Chief Technician over there. He can fill you in on the details.

NPC: Our Chief Technician is waiting!

NPC: I understand. If you want to leave, go ahead. In that case, though, I can't give you any money.

Your response: Hey, you should have told me that earlier. If that's the case, I'd be glad to help.

Your response: Nice methods. But I refuse to be blackmailed. Adios.

NPC: No problem. The GenReplicator is in the small building in front of the Command Unit. You only have to use it, select your apartment, and press the TELEPORT button. I wish you a productive day.

NPC: No problem. What do you need?

NPC: I'm not allowed to give you any information. I'd be sorry to have to trigger the alarm.

Your response: Huh?! What?! I want to know what's going on here!!

NPC: Please leave before I call Security!

NPC: What?!

Your response: The Admin sent me here. I wanted some more specific info about your problem.

Your response: Here, I have what you wanted.

NPC: Leave me alone! I'm under a lot of pressure and I have to work here. If you want to learn something, talk to the Admin over there!

NPC: Finally! Maybe we can finally proceed now. Thank you, I have to get back to work now.

Your response: Wait a minute! You're supposed to give me some money.

NPC: I need 4 chips! 4 Prototype AMC5 Processors. Not any less. Go and get them.

NPC: Yes, yes. Here's your money. Now get lost and keep your mouth shut. The GenRep is in the small building in front of the Command Unit, it will bring you into your apartment. Good luck.

NPC: Problem! Yeah, you could say that. The bots have gone crazy, we can't control them anymore.
They are equipped with a brand new sensorial chip. A prototype. One would think a sensorial chip can't be very dangerous. But the bots are totally out of control. I need those chips back!

Your response: Yeah, that's what the Admin said. How dangerous are these bots?

NPC: Well, it's the newest model of this type.
The exact designation is: AREA MC5-SECURITY SYSTEM BOT. Note their status, the models you're supposed to eliminate have the status MALFUNCTIONING.
You should talk to the Security Chief before leaving. He should be able to tell you more about their strengths.

Your response: I'll do that. Do you have a tip where I should start looking for them?

NPC: As far as I know, most units escaped to the border areas of -Area MC5-. They like to get into the Energy Production Units to satisfy their energy needs.
The chips aren't optimized in that particular field. But you'll have to find them yourself.

Your response: Ok. I'll get to work.

NPC: The chips are labeled 'Prototype AMC5 Processor'. I hope you're successful. Take care.
