entries.details:
CONTACT
Bright 'n' Clean / Coordinator

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Prototype AMC5 Processor

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• The GenReplicator system has been developed for this purpose. The GenReps offer several functions: fist of all they allow you to clone yourself. Your gene code has to be saved at an appropriate station first. All activated GenReps appear in a list that lets you choose your destination. This system has been modified in this sector though: You are automatically cloned at the central station without choice. Additionally, this GenRep here can not be activated. This has been done to prevent you from coming back to this sector later.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Not yet! We need to move slowly before they realize something!

NPC: Yo man.

Your response: Long live Reza, long live the City Administration. How are you?

NPC: Yo man.

Your response: Oh my head! I feel funny... so light...

NPC: Hehe. Looks like you resisted the process ... excellent.

Your response: What process are you talking about?

NPC: -Area MC5- is a MindControl Program run by Reza. He grabs dissidents and criminals and has them brainwashed here. Then he has a LawEnforcer chip implanted in them, thinking he can bend a society of mindless dummies to his will.

Your response: But that's bull. Brainwashing! There is no such thing!!

NPC: Oh, really? Well then, tell me about yourself. Who are you? What do you do? What are your strengths?

Your response: Ummmm ...

NPC: See! You're like a piece of unwritten paper, like a grown-up kid. You have to learn everything from scratch. Hehe. But we're working on it...

Your response: What do you mean? Who are you?

NPC: We're part of a secret alliance fighting Reza's oppressive regime. We infiltrated this place under the cover of a cleaning company. We've already managed to infect their system with a small, wonderfully effective virus. Therefore, they fail from time to time when trying to politically adjust their 'patients'. And now the prototype chip is out of control. Hehehe. All thanks to us!

Your response: Wow. Cool!

NPC: -Area MC5- is, in fact, a technological masterpiece. BioTech Systems did an amazing job. In the room in which you woke up, they not only perform brainwashings, but also extract all of the important data from people's brains and archive it.

Your response: Does that mean I can be healed? I mean, if the data is still there ...

NPC: We haven't found a way to do that yet. You probably noticed how extremely well the inner installations are guarded. It's not easy to get in there, even as cleaning company.

Your response: I see.

NPC: But we're able to see who you are, what you are!

Your response: Cool! Would you like to tell me something about me?

NPC: I will. But before I will help you, you have to help us, deal?

Your response: Sounds fair! What do you need?

Your response: Hmmm ... I'd rather not be. I better get away from here before they catch me again.

NPC: Apparently they not only erased your memory but also cut off your balls. Run away then, you pussy!

NPC: As we just learned from an informant, the Chief Technician added the prototype chip to the SecBots on his own. That could cost him his head because the bots are doing whatever they feel like at the moment. Hehehehe. He's triying to get a hold of four of these chips right now.

Your response: What can I do about that?

NPC: Eliminate some of the SecBots and bring four of these chips to our technician over there. We will then ... hehe ... modify them and get them to the Chief Technician of -Area MC5-. Are you in?

Your response: Sure! After what they did to me ...

NPC: That's the spirit. They'll never know what hit them. We'll sabotage the whole facility. You should be prepared, though. Those bots are pretty tough.

Your response: Can you give me a few specific tips about the bots?

NPC: The exact designation is: AREA MC5-SECURITY SYSTEM BOT. Take a note of their status, the models you're supposed to eliminate have the status MALFUNCTIONING. You should really get used to everything first and work on your skills. The bots use laser weapons. If you don't have a ranged weapon, try to corner them and hack them to pieces. They have trouble with corners.

Your response: Ok. But do you think I can do this on my own?

NPC: Well, yes. But if you meet other people, try to form a team. There is a function for teams in your R.P.O.S. I'm confident you'll manage. Teaming not only speeds up learning, but people can also complement each other.

Your response: But I'll have to work on my skills regardless?

NPC: Absolutely. If you want to earn the money, you'll have to. But that way you'll earn more cash. You get money for each enemy you eliminate. What's more, you can loot their remains. Simply target them and press 'USE'. Our Stuffy here also looks for weapon parts. Talk to him. I'm sure he'll want to buy some.

Your response: Will do. Where can I find the bots?

NPC: They like to get into the Energy Production Units to satisfy their energy needs. The chips aren't optimized in that particular field. But you'll have to find them yourself.

Your response: Ok. I won't disappoint you.

NPC: Good to know!

Your response: But I'd need a few general tips about combat. My memory kinda failed me..

NPC: Sure, I forgot. The most important thing is to have your weapon ready. When you go out to hunt, drag the weapon you want to use to one of the slots on the right side of your R.P.O.S. and activate it with the appropriate number.

Your response: All right.

NPC: Just aim at what you want to hit, and you're ready to roll. When using ranged weapons, you have to wait for the aiming reticule to shrink to give you a reasonable chance of scoring a hit. But when you get to the city, don't run around with a drawn weapon - the CopBots don't like that at all. You should always beware of them.

Your response: Okay. But what if I die, despite all these good tips...?

NPC: The GenReplicator system has been developed for this purpose. The GenReps offer several functions: fist of all they allow you to clone yourself. Your gene code has to be saved at an appropriate station first. All activated GenReps appear in a list that lets you choose your destination. This system has been modified in this sector though: You are automatically cloned at the central station without choice. Additionally, this GenRep here can not be activated. This has been done to prevent you from coming back to this sector later.

Your response: Wow. And that was only the first point??

NPC: Right. Now let's get to the second point: There's a catch though if you removed your Law Enforcer Chip, one of the most valuable items you carry is dropped into a belt you cannot recover with this service. Only one of your items can be completely safe, if it is placed into the quickbelt slot marked with a little lock.

Your response: Can people steal my stuff?

NPC: People can hack your belt and steal it, yes! But let's move on to the second point: As the principle is rather similar, a Teleporter function has been based on the cloning function. You can teleport yourself from one GenRep to another for a sum of money, if the GenRep has been activated by you. The GenRep in your apartment is activated by default, so you can always get there, even if you never activated a GenRep. That's it for the GenRep's functions.

Your response: Oh boy. This thing is amazing. I think I'm ready now. Four chips you said?

NPC: Indeed! Talk to our Technician if you got the chips!

NPC: You're the guy with the chips?

Your response: Indeed!

NPC: I need the chips!

NPC: Nice. With this we'll prepare a nice surprise for them. Yep. Now we'll finally get them.

Your response: - Give Chips -
What do you have in mind?

NPC: Didn't you talk to the boss? I want 4 chips. I can't do anything with less.

NPC: Hehehe. We'll modify these and smuggle them into the complex. When they install them... we'll see. Hehehe.

Your response: Cool. This brainwashing program has to be stopped!

NPC: Talk to our Coordinator! He will reward you!

NPC: Well, you're back. Time to reward you!

Your response: Yeah!

NPC: You gave the chips to our Technician?

NPC: Let me download your NCPD files! Remember: We can only see your profession and Name!

Your response: You told me, yes..

NPC: What the fu..? Your file seems to be broken!

NPC: You again? Good job last time, but there is nothing you can do for me at the moment.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Matts Info
• Secret Info

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Matts Info
• Secret Info

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• It's not that hard to find if you know where to look for it. Be careful nontheless since its heavily guarded. Have a look around sector J08.

• Didn't I say sector J08 or something?

• Just talk to him. I am sure he will tell you something about how great Neocron is. All of their spies have been bombarded with Propaganda for so long that they have no choice but to repeat it over and over again. The location is somewhere in sector F02. Make sure the spy doesn't leave the swamp alive.

• Probably you already noticed the imminent alliance with Dome of York, right? I thought so. Well, I know a place deep in the Wastelands. There you can find a semi secret outpost of Dome of York. I've already been there so I'm not lying to you. No shit.

• That's not your problem. But it certainly is not as conspicuous out here in the Wastelands. We won't make the same mistakes we did in 2578 over and over again.

• The many different factions that populate Neocron and the Wastelands are the perfect nourishment for chaos. And chaos, Runner, is our friend. The Tsunami, Black Dragon, Twilight Guardian, Crahn and even the Fallen Angels belong to those who see past the clever lies of Neocron. But there are still many undecided individuals who change their faction as often as their implants.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Probably you already noticed the imminent alliance with Dome of York, right? I thought so. Well, I know a place deep in the Wastelands. There you can find a semi secret outpost of Dome of York. I've already been there so I'm not lying to you. No shit.

Your response: I don't quite get what you are aiming at. What's so special about it?

NPC: I'm telling you, they aren't planning no picnic there. If I had a little bit more courage I'd have taken them up on their offer. They are looking for Runners like you and they are offering good credits. Unfortunately our own faction doesn't have any jobs available right now. For the moment at least.

Your response: Of course, they are giving me credits for nothing, sure thing. Now tell me, where is the catch?

NPC: Well, their tasks don't sound too simple to me. Killing Runners, espionage and stuff like that. That's nothing for me but if you feel up for something like that...

Your response: Maybe I will check it out soon. What is the exact location of the outpost?

NPC: It's not that hard to find if you know where to look for it. Be careful nontheless since its heavily guarded. Have a look around sector J08.

NPC: Didn't I say sector J08 or something?

NPC: What is your designation?!

Your response: I have heard about this unoffical Dome of York outpost and I'll be damned if I'm not able to use this information for my advantage.

NPC: Your assumption is correct. Did you come to accept a job from us?

Your response: That depends. First I want to know what you plan to achieve by those missions. You must aim for something, some sort of bigger scheme maybe?

NPC: I'm sure you do. Opportunistic Runners like you only ever work for their own advantage. But rest assured. Dome of York has been wise enough to apply more promising strategies in our fight against Neocron. The goal is to cripple the invidious enemy. The goal is to dismantle the vital organs of that beast until Neocron is unable to lead any coordinated action at all. Apart from that there might be a lot of money in it for you.

Your response: That sounds good and believe it or not, I'll be as happy as you are to see Neocron in ruins.

NPC: Then it's settled. We have certain tasks for motivated Runners. But I'm warning you, it won't be that easy. And think about it hard, you would do Dome of York a big favor and we never let down our allies.

Your response: By the way, I've noticed that there is a general present here. Doesn't he have anything more useful to do?

NPC: Fool! The presence of the general only shows how important this is for us. If you are lucky you may even receive a mission from the general himself. He is a great man and he carries the burden of being responsible for the big decisions.

Your response: Interesting, but why not invite the Runners into the Dome of York?

NPC: That's not your problem. But it certainly is not as conspicuous out here in the Wastelands. We won't make the same mistakes we did in 2578 over and over again.

Your response: Very well, you bought me.

NPC: We have discovered the true identity of one of Rezas spies. Unfortunately he managed to escape into the swamps where we lost his trail. The exits of the swamp are under 24hour surveillance which means he cannot escape that way. It should be clear that we want him dead.

Your response: And how do you suppose I should recognise him? There aren't many people out in the swamps but still more than I'd like to.

NPC: Just talk to him. I am sure he will tell you something about how great Neocron is. All of their spies have been bombarded with Propaganda for so long that they have no choice but to repeat it over and over again. The location is somewhere in sector F02. Make sure the spy doesn't leave the swamp alive.

NPC: You will never get me.

NPC: Oh boy, am I glad to see somebody like you. You got something to eat for me, please?

Your response: Who are you?

NPC: I am a loyal citizen of Neocron and I... I got lost in the swamp. Wait.. You came to kill me, right?

Your response: Why do you say that? Do you have a reason to fear for you life?

NPC: With all that time I spent here in the swamp I did have some time to think. I can't see a solution, drones are sweeping the swamps and make it impossible for me to flee. I am running low on food and my internal implants are running out of power.

Your response: So you are a spy from Neocron? And you escaped into the swamps? How stupid is that?

NPC: You will see, Neocron will triumph over all of you. But my life is in your hand now. I am just asking you for a last favor. Take this data, it contains all of my acquired information. Get it to Kev Critter at the Blakkmist Garbage Dump and you'll get a reward for it. It's not yet too late for you to choose the right side in this conflict.

NPC: You almost did it. I know why you are here. Kill me if you can.

NPC: First you have to find the spy in F02 and eliminate him.

NPC: Acceptable effort, Runner. This spy shouldn't be able to betray us any longer. He sneaked into our dome and committed some heinous murders before we were able to discover him. But in the end he probably wouldn't have been able to do us any lasting harm.

Your response: Good, now back to my reward.

Your response: Indeed, he was a looser, he even gave all his spy data to me before I executed him.

NPC: It seems, as if you don't have his data after all.

NPC: Excellent, for this service we are willing to pay you a bonus. Another example of how retarded the supporters of Neocron are. But now to the next mission.

Your response: What about the specs?

NPC: The many different factions that populate Neocron and the Wastelands are the perfect nourishment for chaos. And chaos, Runner, is our friend. The Tsunami, Black Dragon, Twilight Guardian, Crahn and even the Fallen Angels belong to those who see past the clever lies of Neocron. But there are still many undecided individuals who change their faction as often as their implants.

Your response: There will always be turncoats. What are you trying to say?

NPC: There is a high ranking scientist living in exile in Point Red. He obviously had his fill of the intrigues Neocron is based upon. It is an ideal opportunity to try and get some information about the technology of Neocron. You may use all means at your disposal to get this information. Matt Tronstett is his name.

NPC: The many different factions that populate Neocron and the Wastelands are the perfect nourishment for chaos. And chaos, Runner, is our friend. The Tsunami, Black Dragon, Twilight Guardian, Crahn and even the Fallen Angels belong to those who see past the clever lies of Neocron. But there are still many undecided individuals who change their faction as often as their implants.

Your response: There will always be turncoats. What are you trying to say?

NPC: There is a high ranking scientist living in exile in Point Red. He obviously had his fill of the intrigues Neocron is based upon. It is an ideal opportunity to try and get some information about the technology of Neocron. You may use all means at your disposal to get this information. Matt Tronstett is his name.

NPC: I don't buy anything from tramps.

NPC: Why isn't it possible to just reverse gravity or at least switch it off temporarily? That is a problem I am working on for some time now but the answer eludes me.

Your response: Is that a trick question? Listen, you are Matt Tronstett, a scientist from Neocron, right?

NPC: Yes, although I don't have a lot of connections to Neocron any longer. All they are interested in is weapons and power. Why, I ask you, is nobody ever trying to make the Wastelands inhabitable again? Or maybe I should have chosen the Fallen Angels right from the start as my favourite faction.

Your response: Now that you don't belong to the scientists of Neocron any longer you surely could tell me something about the newest technologies they have at their disposal, right?

NPC: Now I know what you aim for. I fear I still have to disappoint you there. If I ever choose to give away that knowledge I would have some bounty hunters after me in an instant. Maybe if you had some information about Dome of York technology.

Your response: I could surely organise some money. Would that be a better basis for negotiations?

Your response: I've got some information right here about secret Dome of York data. It was given to me by one of Neocrons spies. Maybe you are interested in an exchange?

Your response: If you don't give me what I want, death will come to you even sooner.

NPC: It would certainly be a better basis. But believe me, you cannot possibly get your hands on that much money.

NPC: Get me some data about Dome of York, that's the only way I'll cooperate. Either this or you better tell the person who told you to visit me.

NPC: Under these circumstances I would be willing to do an exchange of data. Now give me that Dome of York data.

NPC: You won't get anywhere with threats. And you don't look like the type of Runner who would kill somebody in cold blood.

NPC: We have already had a deal. I can't give you more than that.

NPC: I don't have more to say.

NPC: You can find Matt Tronstett in Point Red. Get what you can and hand over the results to me.

NPC: This information would have been very important for us. So I can't give you any more credits for this assignment. I hope you are still content. We will have another task ready as soon as everything calms down a little. (next mission at Level 30)

NPC: Thank you for the good work. These technical specifications will help us with our research. As soon as everything calms down a bit we will have another task ready for you. (next mission at Level 30)

NPC: You can find Matt Tronstett in Point Red. Get what you can and hand over the results to me.

NPC: This information would have been very important for us. So I can't give you any more credits for this assignment. I hope you are still content. We will have another task ready as soon as everything calms down a little. (next mission at Level 30)

NPC: Sorry, the dump is closed.

NPC: Yes? You got something for the dump?

Your response: Maybe, I've got a package with information from somebody called Hamil.

NPC: Bought! How is the old bastard?

Your response: Let's just say this is gonna be his last package.

NPC: What a shame. But maybe you are keen on taking his position, eh?

Your response: Forget it. I am only interested in the money.

NPC: Alright, alright. Here, here is some money for your trouble.

entries.title: Anbdragon 02
entries.description: Quest-related dialogue from the game files.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• DoY ID Cube
• Document Package
• Vehicle Energypack - Hover Technology Only

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• DoY ID Cube
• Document Package

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• For time being you can try and get some more credits out of that outpost from Dome of York.  Sector J08 but you probably still know that.

• Just a moment. This is bad news. The report talks about spies in the Wastelands. Increasing numbers. That could be dangerous for us at the moment. Our secret projects must not be uncovered. Runner, kill one CityAdmin and one Tangent Runner. Only Runners, no guards and no CopBots either. We need to divert their attention to something else. I will hand out the very same instructions to other Runners as well.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: For time being you can try and get some more credits out of that outpost from Dome of York.  Sector J08 but you probably still know that.

NPC: I remember you, that was some good work back then. Dome of York ist grateful for your efforts. If you are interested you can help us to advance even further in our plans. We have dozens of scientists working day and night to come up with new technology.

Your response: Interesting, what kind of new technology are we talking about?

NPC: That is still Top Secret. And this kind of information will not be available anytime soon. But we discovered that Neocron is in the possession of technology that can be used as energy source for our projects.

Your response: And I am supposed to get that technology?

NPC: Exactly. Neocron uses it to power their vehicles. I am talking about vehicle Energypacks. Go and get 10 of them. We will still entrust other Runners with the very same mission in order to have enough of that energy in the end.

Your response: There is still the question about the payment.

NPC: Indeed. The same as usual, we will discuss it later on once you acquired these items.

NPC: Acquire those vehicle energypacks from somewhere. 10 of them will be sufficient.

NPC: Do you have the objects? Excellent. Of course this is only the first part of the mission. Did I forget to mention that? I am sorry.

Your response: That is nice, that is real nice. I want my money now.

NPC: I am sorry. The regulations are very strict in these cases. And believe me, there is nothing more strict in Dome of York than the military. You have no choice but to accomplish the other part of the mission if you still want the money.

Your response: Very well, you convinced me. What do I have to do next?

NPC: We have a source of information within the Neocron city walls who is giving us constant information. He is pretty well known and delivers to anyone who can match his price. That means you can often find Tsunami, Black Dragon, Crahn and Twilight Guardian lurking around him.

Your response: What is his name? Maybe I already heard of him.

NPC: His name is Benjamin but that's probably only a fake name. He provides us with a report every second day. Your task will be to retrieve that report. HE is waiting in Industrial 02. You might encounter other Runners there as well, Benjamin is a very busy person. Take this as a token so that he can recognise you.

NPC: Can't you just leave me alone? I'm trying to enjoy some sythetic wine here. Go away!

NPC: Aha, the messenger from Dome of York changes often as I see.

Your response: What is that supposed to mean?

NPC: Well, Dome of York trusts nobody, not even their allies. They don't feel responsibility for anybody but themselves. That's how I feel about it at least.

Your response: Alright, now what information do you have this time?

NPC: The CityAdmin despises Crahn, Tsunami and Black Dragon even more than before. There are rumours about Reza having sudden fits of rage. Why? I don't know, but I have accumulated all I could get about it.

Your response: Good, then give that information to me and I'll be on my way.

NPC: Here you are and be careful on your way since it is getting very dangerous recently.

NPC: Ask the people who give you that mission. I am not giving reward to anybody.

NPC: Benjamin can be found in one of the industrial sectors. He will give you a report which you will hand over to me.

NPC: Good work. Hand over the report to me now.

Your response: Do I get my reward now or is there more?

NPC: Just a moment. This is bad news. The report talks about spies in the Wastelands. Increasing numbers. That could be dangerous for us at the moment. Our secret projects must not be uncovered. Runner, kill one CityAdmin and one Tangent Runner. Only Runners, no guards and no CopBots either. We need to divert their attention to something else. I will hand out the very same instructions to other Runners as well.

Your response: What about my payment, then?

NPC: You will receive it without delay once you have done this last part. We might even have a bonus for your efforts.

NPC: One CityAdmin Runner and one Tangent Runner are your targets. Get to work.

NPC: Now you only need to find one CityAdmin Runner. Afterwards you will get your payment.

NPC: Now you only have one Tangent Runner left to kill.

NPC: Well done. You seem to be rather experienced with this kind of job. Maybe General Babel will have an additional task for you in due time. (next mission at level 45)

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Ceres Cyborg Chip

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Cypherhelmet
• TG RayGun Rifle

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• True and at the same time our Cyborgs carry that name. Neocron even managed to reproduce some of them. We need somebody to check whether or not their Cyborg parts are identical to ours. Go to sector C12 and get some parts from one Y Trooper Replicant Cyborgs. Afterwards we will see where all this leads us to.

• Good work, soldier. It will be Runners like you who we will have to thank for our victory in the end. While we have these parts analysed you could help us with the Neocron plague in the Wastelands. They are disturbing our projects and are on the verge of discovering our secret projects. Take care of one BioTech and one ProtoPharm Runner, it will serve as an example and will prevent them to continue sniffing for our secrets. Kill them and then return. Hopefully we will know more by then. If you fulfill our expectations you  will receive some additional equipment.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: You should really know whom to talk to by now. Maybe you can even talk to the General there and get a task.

NPC: I have reports that you have already proven your worth on the field of honour, soldier. Congratulations. Do you already know about the Ceres plans? And do you already know that Neocron stole them from behind our backs?

Your response: I thought the Ceres plans incorporate all knowledge of the known world.

NPC: True and at the same time our Cyborgs carry that name. Neocron even managed to reproduce some of them. We need somebody to check whether or not their Cyborg parts are identical to ours. Go to sector C12 and get some parts from one Y Trooper Replicant Cyborgs. Afterwards we will see where all this leads us to.

NPC: The targets are in C12 and you should have a look out for the Y. Trooper Replicant Cyborgs. Take those parts from the Cyborgs and get the hell outta there.

NPC: We need those Y. Trooper Replicant Cyborg parts for analysis.

NPC: Good work, soldier. It will be Runners like you who we will have to thank for our victory in the end. While we have these parts analysed you could help us with the Neocron plague in the Wastelands. They are disturbing our projects and are on the verge of discovering our secret projects. Take care of one BioTech and one ProtoPharm Runner, it will serve as an example and will prevent them to continue sniffing for our secrets. Kill them and then return. Hopefully we will know more by then. If you fulfill our expectations you  will receive some additional equipment.

Your response: This job better be worth it.

NPC: If that is your only concern then rest assured. Carry on with your duty.

NPC: We agreed on one ProtoPharm and one BioTech Runner each. Now get to work.

NPC: Find a BioTech Runner and flatline him. That's all and afterwards you will get your payment.

NPC: One ProtoPharm Runner still has to be flatlined for you to earn the reward.

NPC: A shame that you are no child from Dome of York. You would have a brilliant career. Those Cyborg parts you brought in are almost identical to ours. Only minor things are different. They removed the autonomous control processor for example. That means their Cyborgs cannot make decisions on their own like ours can.

Your response: That means they are bad copies?

NPC: True. They are no match for our superior troops. But I do not doubt for a minute that they now have much more knowledge about our war technology. They probably already have weapons that work specifically against our units.

Your response: Neocron would never surrender without a fight, that much is clear.

NPC: That is the reason why we utilize different strategies. One of them is to equip Runner with our weapons. That way even individual Runner can make a move against the CityAdmin. And you cannot predict where the next attack will happen with so many individual units.

Your response: Sounds interesting, but I was promised some equipment as well if you remember.

NPC: Yes and you will receive some. One weapon with our newly developed technology and one armor. The weapon uses standard ammunition. Dome of York thanks you for your cooperation. Regard it as an extra reward.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Matts Info
• Secret Info

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Matts Info
• Secret Info

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• It's not that hard to find if you know where to look for it. Be careful nontheless since its heavily guarded. Have a look around sector J08.

• Didn't I say sector J08 or something?

• Just talk to him. I am sure he will tell you something about how great Neocron is. All of their spies have been bombarded with Propaganda for so long that they have no choice but to repeat it over and over again. The location is somewhere in sector F02. Make sure the spy doesn't leave the swamp alive.

• Probably you already noticed the imminent alliance with Dome of York, right? I thought so. Well, I know a place deep in the Wastelands. There you can find a semi secret outpost of Dome of York. I've already been there so I'm not lying to you. No shit.

• That's not your problem. But it certainly is not as conspicuous out here in the Wastelands. We won't make the same mistakes we did in 2578 over and over again.

• The many different factions that populate Neocron and the Wastelands are the perfect nourishment for chaos. And chaos, Runner, is our friend. The Tsunami, Black Dragon, Twilight Guardian, Crahn and even the Fallen Angels belong to those who see past the clever lies of Neocron. But there are still many undecided individuals who change their faction as often as their implants.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Probably you already noticed the imminent alliance with Dome of York, right? I thought so. Well, I know a place deep in the Wastelands. There you can find a semi secret outpost of Dome of York. I've already been there so I'm not lying to you. No shit.

Your response: I don't quite get what you are aiming at. What's so special about it?

NPC: I'm telling you, they aren't planning no picnic there. If I had a little bit more courage I'd have taken them up on their offer. They are looking for Runners like you and they are offering good credits. Unfortunately our own faction doesn't have any jobs available right now. For the moment at least.

Your response: Of course, they are giving me credits for nothing, sure thing. Now tell me, where is the catch?

NPC: Well, their tasks don't sound too simple to me. Killing Runners, espionage and stuff like that. That's nothing for me but if you feel up for something like that...

Your response: I understand now. Maybe I will check it out soon. What is the exact location of the outpost?

NPC: It's not that hard to find if you know where to look for it. Be careful nontheless since its heavily guarded. Have a look around sector J08.

NPC: Didn't I say sector J08 or something?

NPC: What is your designation?!

Your response: I have heard about this unoffical Dome of York outpost and I'll be damned if I'm not able to use this information for my advantage.

NPC: Your assumption is correct. Did you come to accept a job from us?

Your response: That depends. First I want to know what you plan to achieve by those missions. You must aim for something, some sort of bigger scheme maybe?

NPC: Opportunistic Runners like you only ever work for their own advantage. But rest assured. Dome of York has been wise enough to apply more promising strategies to our fight against Neocron. The goal is to cripple the invidious enemy. The goal is to dismantle the vital organs of that beast until Neocron is unable to lead any coordinated action at all. Apart from that there might be a lot of money in it for you.

Your response: That sounds good and believe it or not, I'll be as happy as you are to see Neocron in ruins.

NPC: Then it's settled. We have certain tasks for motivated Runners. But I'm warning you, it won't be that easy. And think about it hard, you would do Dome of York a big favor and we never let down our allies.

Your response: By the way, I've noticed that there is a general present here. Doesn't he have anything more useful to do?

NPC: Fool, the presence of the general only shows how important this is for us. If you are lucky you may even receive a mission from the general himself. He is a great man and he carries the burden of being responsible for big decisions.

Your response: Interesting, but why not invite the Runners into the Dome of York?

NPC: That's not your problem. But it certainly is not as conspicuous out here in the Wastelands. We won't make the same mistakes we did in 2578 over and over again.

Your response: Very well, you bought me.

NPC: We have discovered the true identity of one of Rezas spies. Unfortunately he managed to escape into the swamps where we lost his trail. The exits of the swamp are under 24hour surveillance which means he cannot escape that way. It should be clear that we want him dead.

Your response: And how do you suppose I should recognise him? There aren't many people out in the swamps but still more than I'd like to.

NPC: Just talk to him. I am sure he will tell you something about how great Neocron is. All of their spies have been bombarded with Propaganda for so long that they have no choice but to repeat it over and over again. The location is somewhere in sector F02. Make sure the spy doesn't leave the swamp alive.

NPC: You will never get me.

NPC: Oh boy, am I glad to see somebody like you. You got something to eat for me, please?

Your response: Who are you?

NPC: I am a loyal citizen of Neocron and I... I got lost in the swamp. I am certain that you came to kill me, right?

Your response: Why, do you have a reason to fear for you life?

NPC: With all that time I spent here in the swamp I did have some time to think. I can't see a solution, drones are sweeping the swamps and make it impossible for me to flee. I am running low on food and my internal implants are running out of power.

Your response: So you are a spy from Neocron? And you escaped into the swamps? How stupid is that?

NPC: You will see, Neocron will triumph over all of you. But my life is in your hand now. I am just asking you for a last favor. Take this data, it contains all of my acquired information. Get it to Kev Critter at the Blakkmist Garbage Dump and you'll get a reward for it. It's not yet too late for you to choose the right side in this conflict.

NPC: You almost did it. I know why you are here. Kill me if you can.

NPC: First you have to find the spy in F02 and eliminate him.

NPC: Acceptable effort, runner. This spy shouldn't be able to betray us any longer. He sneaked into our dome and committed some heinous murders before we were able to discover him. But in the end he probably wouldn't have been able to do us any lasting harm.

Your response: Good, now back to my reward.

Your response: Indeed, he was a looser, he even gave all his spy data to me before I executed him.

NPC: It seems, as if you don't have his data after all.

NPC: Excellent, for this service we are willing to pay you a bonus. Another example of how retarded the supporters of Neocron are. But now to the next mission.

Your response: What about the specs?

NPC: The many different factions that populate Neocron and the Wastelands are the perfect nourishment for chaos. And chaos, Runner, is our friend. The Tsunami, Black Dragon, Twilight Guardian, Crahn and even the Fallen Angels belong to those who see past the clever lies of Neocron. But there are still many undecided individuals who change their faction as often as their implants.

Your response: There will always be turncoats. What are you trying to say?

NPC: There is a high ranking scientist living in exile in Point Red. He obviously had his fill of the intrigues Neocron is based upon. It is an ideal opportunity to try and get some information about the technology of Neocron. You may use all means at your disposal to get this information. Matt Tronstett is his name.

NPC: The many different factions that populate Neocron and the Wastelands are the perfect nourishment for chaos. And chaos, Runner, is our friend. The Tsunami, Black Dragon, Twilight Guardian, Crahn and even the Fallen Angels belong to those who see past the clever lies of Neocron. But there are still many undecided individuals who change their faction as often as their implants.

Your response: There will always be turncoats. What are you trying to say?

NPC: There is a high ranking scientist living in exile in Point Red. He obviously had his fill of the intrigues Neocron is based upon. It is an ideal opportunity to try and get some information about the technology of Neocron. You may use all means at your disposal to get this information. Matt Tronstett is his name.

NPC: I don't buy anything from tramps.

NPC: Why isn't it possible to just reverse gravity or at least switch it off temporarily? That is a problem I am working on for some time now but the answer eludes me.

Your response: Is that a trick question? Listen, you are Matt Tronstett, a scientist from Neocron, right?

NPC: Yes, although I don't have a lot of connections to Neocron any longer. All they are interested in is weapons and power. Why, I ask you, is nobody ever trying to make the Wastelands inhabitable again? Or maybe I should have chosen the Fallen Angels right from the start as my favourite faction.

Your response: Now that you don't belong to the scientists of Neocron any longer you surely could tell me something about the newest technologies they have at their disposal, right?

NPC: Now I know what you aim for. I fear I still have to disappoint you there. If I ever choose to give away that knowledge I would have some bounty hunters after me in an instant. Maybe if you had some information about Dome of York technology.

Your response: I could surely organise some money. Would that be a better basis for negotiations?

Your response: I've got some information right here about secret Dome of York data. It was given to me by one of Neocrons spies. Maybe you are interested in an exchange?

Your response: If you don't give me what I want, death will come to you even sooner.

NPC: It would certainly be a better basis. But believe me, you cannot possibly get your hands on that much money.

NPC: Get me some data about Dome of York, that's the only way I'll cooperate. Either this or you better tell the person who told you to visit me.

NPC: Under these circumstances I would be willing to do an exchange of data. Now give me that Dome of York data.

NPC: You won't get anywhere with threats. And you don't look like the type of Runner who would kill somebody in cold blood.

NPC: We have already had a deal. I can't give you more than that. You should return to the person who gave you this mission.

NPC: I don't have more to say.

NPC: You can find Matt Tronstett in Point Red. Get what you can and hand over the results to me.

NPC: This information would have been very important for us. So I can't give you any more credits for this assignment. I hope you are still content. We will have another task ready as soon as everything calms down a little. (next mission at Level 30)

NPC: Thank you for the good work. These technical specifications will help us with our research. As soon as everything calms down a bit we will have another task ready for you. (next mission at Level 30)

NPC: You can find Matt Tronstett in Point Red. Get what you can and hand over the results to me.

NPC: This information would have been very important for us. So I can't give you any more credits for this assignment. I hope you are still content. We will have another task ready as soon as everything calms down a little. (next mission at Level 30)

NPC: Sorry, the dump is closed.

NPC: Yes? You got something for the dump?

Your response: Maybe, I've got a package with information from somebody called Hamil.

NPC: Bought! How is the old bastard?

Your response: Let's just say this is gonna be his last package.

NPC: What a shame. But maybe you are keen on taking his position, eh?

Your response: Forget it. I am only interested in the money.

NPC: Alright, alright. Here, here is some money for your trouble.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• DoY ID Cube
• Document Package
• Vehicle Energypack - Hover Technology Only

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• DoY ID Cube
• Document Package

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• For time being you can try and get some more credits out of that outpost from Dome of York.  Sector J08 but you probably still know that.

• Just a moment. This is bad news. The report talks about spies in the Wastelands. Increasing numbers. That could be dangerous for us at the moment. Our secret projects must not be uncovered. Runner, kill one CityAdmin and one Tangent Runner. Only Runners, no guards and no CopBots either. We need to divert their attention to something else. I will hand out the very same instructions to other Runners as well.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: For time being you can try and get some more credits out of that outpost from Dome of York.  Sector J08 but you probably still know that.

NPC: I remember you, that was some good work back then. Dome of York ist grateful for your efforts. If you are interested you can help us to advance even further in our plans. We have dozens of scientists working day and night to come up with new technology.

Your response: Interesting, what kind of new technology are we talking about?

NPC: That is still Top Secret. And this kind of information will not be available anytime soon. But we discovered that Neocron is in the possession of technology that can be used as energy source for our projects.

Your response: And I am supposed to get that technology?

NPC: Exactly. Neocron uses it to power their vehicles. I am talking about vehicle Energypacks. Go and get 10 of them. We will still entrust other Runners with the very same mission in order to have enough of that energy in the end.

Your response: There is still the question about the payment.

NPC: Indeed. The same as usual, we will discuss it later on once you acquired these items.

NPC: Acquire those vehicle energypacks from somewhere. 10 of them will be sufficient.

NPC: Do you have the objects? Excellent. Of course this is only the first part of the mission. Did I forget to mention that? I am sorry.

Your response: That is nice, that is real nice. I want my money now.

NPC: I am sorry. The regulations are very strict in these cases. And believe me, there is nothing more strict in Dome of York than the military. You have no choice but to accomplish the other part of the mission if you still want the money.

Your response: Very well, you convinced me. What do I have to do next?

NPC: We have a source of information within the Neocron city walls who is giving us constant information. He is pretty well known and delivers to anyone who can match his price. That means you can often find Tsunami, Black Dragon, Crahn and Twilight Guardian lurking around him.

Your response: What is his name? Maybe I already heard of him.

NPC: His name is Benjamin but that's probably only a fake name. He provides us with a report every second day. Your task will be to retrieve that report. HE is waiting in Industrial 02. You might encounter other Runners there as well, Benjamin is a very busy person. Take this as a token so that he can recognise you.

NPC: Can't you just leave me alone? I'm trying to enjoy some sythetic wine here. Go away!

NPC: Aha, the messenger from Dome of York changes often as I see.

Your response: What is that supposed to mean?

NPC: Well, Dome of York trusts nobody, not even their allies. They don't feel responsibility for anybody but themselves. That's how I feel about it at least.

Your response: Alright, now what information do you have this time?

NPC: The CityAdmin despises Crahn, Tsunami and Black Dragon even more than before. There are rumours about Reza having sudden fits of rage. Why? I don't know, but I have accumulated all I could get about it.

Your response: Good, then give that information to me and I'll be on my way.

NPC: Here you are and be careful on your way since it is getting very dangerous recently.

NPC: Ask the people who give you that mission. I am not giving reward to anybody.

NPC: Benjamin can be found in one of the industrial sectors. He will give you a report which you will hand over to me.

NPC: Good work. Hand over the report to me now.

Your response: Do I get my reward now or is there more?

NPC: Just a moment. This is bad news. The report talks about spies in the Wastelands. Increasing numbers. That could be dangerous for us at the moment. Our secret projects must not be uncovered. Runner, kill one CityAdmin and one Tangent Runner. Only Runners, no guards and no CopBots either. We need to divert their attention to something else. I will hand out the very same instructions to other Runners as well.

Your response: What about my payment, then?

NPC: You will receive it without delay once you have done this last part. We might even have a bonus for your efforts.

NPC: One CityAdmin Runner and one Tangent Runner are your targets. Get to work.

NPC: Now you only need to find one CityAdmin Runner. Afterwards you will get your payment.

NPC: Now you only have one Tangent Runner left to kill.

NPC: Well done. You seem to be rather experienced with this kind of job. Maybe General Babel will have an additional task for you in due time. (next mission at level 45)

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Ceres Cyborg Chip

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Cypherhelmet
• TG RayGun Rifle

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• True and at the same time our Cyborgs carry that name. Neocron even managed to reproduce some of them. We need somebody to check whether or not their Cyborg parts are identical to ours. Go to sector C12 and get some parts from one Y Trooper Replicant Cyborgs. Afterwards we will see where all this leads us to.

• Good work, soldier. It will be Runners like you who we will have to thank for our victory in the end. While we have these parts analysed you could help us with the Neocron plague in the Wastelands. They are disturbing our projects and are on the verge of discovering our secret projects. Take care of one BioTech and one ProtoPharm Runner, it will serve as an example and will prevent them to continue sniffing for our secrets. Kill them and then return. Hopefully we will know more by then. If you fulfill our expectations you  will receive some additional equipment.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: You should really know whom to talk to by now. Maybe you can even talk to the General there and get a task.

NPC: I have reports that you have already proven your worth on the field of honour, soldier. Congratulations. Do you already know about the Ceres plans? And do you already know that Neocron stole them from behind our backs?

Your response: I thought the Ceres plans incorporate all knowledge of the known world.

NPC: True and at the same time our Cyborgs carry that name. Neocron even managed to reproduce some of them. We need somebody to check whether or not their Cyborg parts are identical to ours. Go to sector C12 and get some parts from one Y Trooper Replicant Cyborgs. Afterwards we will see where all this leads us to.

NPC: The targets are in C12 and you should have a look out for the Y. Trooper Replicant Cyborgs. Take those parts from the Cyborgs and get the hell outta there.

NPC: We need those Y. Trooper Replicant Cyborg parts for analysis.

NPC: Good work, soldier. It will be Runners like you who we will have to thank for our victory in the end. While we have these parts analysed you could help us with the Neocron plague in the Wastelands. They are disturbing our projects and are on the verge of discovering our secret projects. Take care of one BioTech and one ProtoPharm Runner, it will serve as an example and will prevent them to continue sniffing for our secrets. Kill them and then return. Hopefully we will know more by then. If you fulfill our expectations you  will receive some additional equipment.

Your response: This job better be worth it.

NPC: If that is your only concern then rest assured. Carry on with your duty.

NPC: We agreed on one ProtoPharm and one BioTech Runner each. Now get to work.

NPC: Find a BioTech Runner and flatline him. That's all and afterwards you will get your payment.

NPC: One ProtoPharm Runner still has to be flatlined for you to earn the reward.

NPC: A shame that you are no child from Dome of York. You would have a brilliant career. Those Cyborg parts you brought in are almost identical to ours. Only minor things are different. They removed the autonomous control processor for example. That means their Cyborgs cannot make decisions on their own like ours can.

Your response: That means they are bad copies?

NPC: True. They are no match for our superior troops. But I do not doubt for a minute that they now have much more knowledge about our war technology. They probably already have weapons that work specifically against our units.

Your response: Neocron would never surrender without a fight, that much is clear.

NPC: That is the reason why we utilize different strategies. One of them is to equip Runner with our weapons. That way even individual Runner can make a move against the CityAdmin. And you cannot predict where the next attack will happen with so many individual units.

Your response: Sounds interesting, but I was promised some equipment as well if you remember.

NPC: Yes and you will receive some. One weapon with our newly developed technology and one armor. The weapon uses standard ammunition. Dome of York thanks you for your cooperation. Regard it as an extra reward.

Make sure the spy doesn't leave the swamp alive.

• Probably you already noticed the imminent alliance with Dome of York, right? I thought so. Well, I know a place deep in the Wastelands. There you can find a semi secret outpost of Dome of York. I've already been there so I'm not lying to you. No shit.

• That's not your problem. But it certainly is not as conspicuous out here in the Wastelands. We won't make the same mistakes we did in 2578 over and over again.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Probably you already noticed the imminent alliance with Dome of York, right? I thought so. Well, I know a place deep in the Wastelands. There you can find a semi secret outpost of Dome of York. I've already been there so I'm not lying to you. No shit.

Your response: I don't quite get what you are aiming at. What's so special about it?

NPC: I'm telling you, they aren't planning no picnic there. If I had a little bit more courage I'd have taken them up on their offer. They are looking for Runners like you and they are offering good credits. Unfortunately our own faction doesn't have any jobs available right now. For the moment at least.

Your response: Of course, they are giving me credits for nothing, sure thing. Now tell me, where is the catch?

NPC: Well, their tasks don't sound too simple to me. Killing Runners, espionage and stuff like that. That's nothing for me but if you feel up for something like that...

Your response: I understand now. Maybe I will check it out soon. What is the exact location of the outpost?

NPC: It's not that hard to find if you know where to look for it. Be careful nontheless since its heavily guarded. Have a look around sector J08.

NPC: Didn't I say sector J08 or something?

NPC: What is your designation?!

Your response: I have heard about this unoffical Dome of York outpost and I'll be damned if I'm not able to use this information for my advantage.

NPC: Your assumption is correct. Did you come to accept a job from us?

Your response: That depends. First I want to know what you plan to achieve by those missions. You must aim for something, some sort of bigger scheme maybe?

NPC: Opportunistic Runners like you only ever work for their own advantage. But rest assured. Dome of York has been wise enough to apply more promising strategies to our fight against Neocron. The goal is to cripple the invidious enemy. The goal is to dismantle the vital organs of that beast until Neocron is unable to lead any coordinated action at all. Apart from that there might be a lot of money in it for you.

Your response: That sounds good and believe it or not, I'll be as happy as you are to see Neocron in ruins.

NPC: Then it's settled. We have certain tasks for motivated Runners. But I'm warning you, it won't be that easy. And think about it hard, you would do Dome of York a big favor and we never let down our allies.

Your response: By the way, I've noticed that there is a general present here. Doesn't he have anything more useful to do?

NPC: Fool, the presence of the general only shows how important this is for us. If you are lucky you may even receive a mission from the general himself. He is a great man and he carries the burden of being responsible for big decisions.

Your response: Interesting, but why not invite the Runners into the Dome of York?

NPC: That's not your problem. But it certainly is not as conspicuous out here in the Wastelands. We won't make the same mistakes we did in 2578 over and over again.

Your response: Very well, you bought me.

NPC: We have discovered the true identity of one of Rezas spies. Unfortunately he managed to escape into the swamps where we lost his trail. The exits of the swamp are under 24hour surveillance which means he cannot escape that way. It should be clear that we want him dead.

Your response: And how do you suppose I should recognise him? There aren't many people out in the swamps but still more than I'd like to.

NPC: Just talk to him. I am sure he will tell you something about how great Neocron is. All of their spies have been bombarded with Propaganda for so long that they have no choice but to repeat it over and over again. The location is somewhere in sector F02.  Make sure the spy doesn't leave the swamp alive.

NPC: You will never get me.

NPC: Oh boy, am I glad to see somebody like you. You got something to eat for me, please?

Your response: Who are you?

NPC: I am a loyal citizen of Neocron and I... I got lost in the swamp. I am certain that you came to kill me, right?

Your response: Why, do you have a reason to fear for you life?

NPC: With all that time I spent here in the swamp I did have some time to think. I can't see a solution, drones are sweeping the swamps and make it impossible for me to flee. I am running low on food and my internal implants are running out of power.

Your response: So you are a spy from Neocron? And you escaped into the swamps? How stupid is that?

NPC: You will see, Neocron will triumph over all of you. But my life is in your hand now. I am just asking you for a last favor. Take this data, it contains all of my acquired information. Get it to Kev Critter at the Blakkmist Garbage Dump and you'll get a reward for it. It's not yet too late for you to choose the right side in this conflict.

NPC: You almost did it. I know why you are here. Kill me if you can.

NPC: First you have to find the spy in F02 and eliminate him.

NPC: Acceptable effort, runner. This spy shouldn't be able to betray us any longer. He sneaked into our dome and committed some heinous murders before we were able to discover him. But in the end he probably wouldn't have been able to do us any lasting harm.

Your response: Good, now back to my reward.

Your response: Indeed, he was a looser, he even gave all his spy data to me before I executed him.

NPC: It seems, as if you don't have his data after all.

NPC: Excellent, for this service we are willing to pay you a bonus. Another example of how retarded the supporters of Neocron are. But now to the next mission.

Your response: What about the specs?

NPC: The many different factions that populate Neocron and the Wastelands are the perfect nourishment for chaos. And chaos, Runner, is our friend. The Tsunami, Black Dragon, Twilight Guardian, Crahn and even the Fallen Angels belong to those who see past the clever lies of Neocron. But there are still many undecided individuals who change their faction as often as their implants.

Your response: There will always be turncoats. What are you trying to say?

NPC: There is a high ranking scientist living in exile in Point Red. He obviously had his fill of the intrigues Neocron is based upon. It is an ideal opportunity to try and get some information about the technology of Neocron. You may use all means at your disposal to get this information. Matt Tronstett is his name.

NPC: It would certainly be a better basis. But believe me, you cannot possibly get your hands on that much money.

NPC: Get me some data about Dome of York, that's the only way I'll cooperate. Either this or you better tell the person who told you to visit me.

NPC: Under these circumstances I would be willing to do an exchange of data. Now give me that Dome of York data.

NPC: You won't get anywhere with threats. And you don't look like the type of Runner who would kill somebody in cold blood.

NPC: We have already had a deal. I can't give you more than that.  You should return to the person who gave you this mission.

NPC: I don't have more to say.

NPC: You can find Matt Tronstett in Point Red. Get what you can and hand over the results to me.

NPC: Sorry, the dump is closed.

NPC: Yes? You got something for the dump?

Your response: Maybe, I've got a package with information from somebody called Hamil.

NPC: Bought! How is the old bastard?

Your response: Let's just say this is gonna be his last package.

NPC: What a shame. But maybe you are keen on taking his position, eh?

Your response: Forget it. I am only interested in the money.

NPC: Alright, alright. Here, here is some money for your trouble.

• Document Package

• Just a moment. This is bad news. The report talks about spies in the Wastelands. Increasing numbers. That could be dangerous for us at the moment. Our secret projects must not be uncovered. entries.conversation:
NPC: For time being you can try and get some more credits out of that outpost from Dome of York.  Sector J08 but you probably still know that.

NPC: I remember you, that was some good work back then. Dome of York ist grateful for your efforts. If you are interested you can help us to advance even further in our plans. We have dozens of scientists working day and night to come up with new technology.

Your response: Interesting, what kind of new technology are we talking about?

NPC: That is still Top Secret. And this kind of information will not be available anytime soon. But we discovered that Neocron is in the possession of technology that can be used as energy source for our projects.

Your response: And I am supposed to get that technology?

NPC: Exactly. Neocron uses it to power their vehicles. I am talking about vehicle Energypacks. Go and get 10 of them. We will still entrust other Runners with the very same mission in order to have enough of that energy in the end.

Your response: There is still the question about the payment.

NPC: Indeed. The same as usual, we will discuss it later on once you acquired these items.

NPC: Acquire those vehicle energypacks from somewhere. 10 of them will be sufficient.

NPC: Do you have the objects? Excellent. Of course this is only the first part of the mission. Did I forget to mention that? I am sorry.

Your response: That is nice, that is real nice. I want my money now.

NPC: I am sorry. The regulations are very strict in these cases. And believe me, there is nothing more strict in Dome of York than the military. You have no choice but to accomplish the other part of the mission if you still want the money.

Your response: Very well, you convinced me. What do I have to do next?

NPC: We have a source of information within the Neocron city walls who is giving us constant information. He is pretty well known and delivers to anyone who can match his price. That means you can often find Tsunami, Black Dragon, Crahn and Twilight Guardian lurking around him.

Your response: What is his name? Maybe I already heard of him.

NPC: His name is Benjamin but that's probably only a fake name. He provides us with a report every second day. Your task will be to retrieve that report. HE is waiting in Industrial 02. You might encounter other Runners there as well, Benjamin is a very busy person. Take this as a token so that he can recognise you.

NPC: Can't you just leave me alone? I'm trying to enjoy some sythetic wine here. Go away!

NPC: Aha, the messenger from Dome of York changes often as I see.

Your response: What is that supposed to mean?

NPC: Well, Dome of York trusts nobody, not even their allies. They don't feel responsibility for anybody but themselves. That's how I feel about it at least.

Your response: Alright, now what information do you have this time?

NPC: The CityAdmin despises Crahn, Tsunami and Black Dragon even more than before. There are rumours about Reza having sudden fits of rage. Why? I don't know, but I have accumulated all I could get about it.

Your response: Good, then give that information to me and I'll be on my way.

NPC: Here you are and be careful on your way since it is getting very dangerous recently.

NPC: Ask the people who give you that mission. I am not giving reward to anybody.

NPC: Benjamin can be found in one of the industrial sectors. He will give you a report which you will hand over to me.

NPC: Good work. Hand over the report to me now.

Your response: Do I get my reward now or is there more?

NPC: Just a moment. This is bad news. The report talks about spies in the Wastelands. Increasing numbers. That could be dangerous for us at the moment. Our secret projects must not be uncovered. Runner, kill one CityAdmin and one Tangent Runner. Only Runners, no guards and no CopBots either. We need to divert their attention to something else. I will hand out the very same instructions to other Runners as well.

Your response: What about my payment, then?

NPC: You will receive it without delay once you have done this last part. We might even have a bonus for your efforts.

NPC: One CityAdmin Runner and one Tangent Runner are your targets. Get to work.

NPC: Now you only need to find one CityAdmin Runner. Afterwards you will get your payment.

NPC: Now you only have one Tangent Runner left to kill.

NPC: Well done. You seem to be rather experienced with this kind of job. Maybe General Babel will have an additional task for you in due time. (next mission at level 45)

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• True and at the same time our Cyborgs carry that name. Neocron even managed to reproduce some of them. We need somebody to check whether or not their Cyborg parts are identical to ours. Go to sector C12 and get some parts from one Y Trooper Replicant Cyborgs. Afterwards we will see where all this leads us to.

• Good work, soldier. It will be Runners like you who we will have to thank for our victory in the end. While we have these parts analysed you could help us with the Neocron plague in the Wastelands. They are disturbing our projects and are on the verge of discovering our secret projects. Take care of one BioTech and one ProtoPharm Runner, it will serve as an example and will prevent them to continue sniffing for our secrets. Kill them and then return. Hopefully we will know more by then. If you fulfill our expectations you  will receive some additional equipment.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: You should really know whom to talk to by now. Maybe you can even talk to the General there and get a task.

NPC: I have reports that you have already proven your worth on the field of honour, soldier. Congratulations. Do you already know about the Ceres plans? And do you already know that Neocron stole them from behind our backs?

Your response: I thought the Ceres plans incorporate all knowledge of the known world.

NPC: True and at the same time our Cyborgs carry that name. Neocron even managed to reproduce some of them. We need somebody to check whether or not their Cyborg parts are identical to ours. Go to sector C12 and get some parts from one Y Trooper Replicant Cyborgs. Afterwards we will see where all this leads us to.

NPC: The targets are in C12 and you should have a look out for the Y. Trooper Replicant Cyborgs. Take those parts from the Cyborgs and get the hell outta there.

NPC: We need those Y. Trooper Replicant Cyborg parts for analysis.

NPC: Good work, soldier. It will be Runners like you who we will have to thank for our victory in the end. While we have these parts analysed you could help us with the Neocron plague in the Wastelands. They are disturbing our projects and are on the verge of discovering our secret projects. Take care of one BioTech and one ProtoPharm Runner, it will serve as an example and will prevent them to continue sniffing for our secrets. Kill them and then return. Hopefully we will know more by then. If you fulfill our expectations you  will receive some additional equipment.

Your response: This job better be worth it.

NPC: If that is your only concern then rest assured. Carry on with your duty.

NPC: We agreed on one ProtoPharm and one BioTech Runner each. Now get to work.

NPC: Find a BioTech Runner and flatline him. That's all and afterwards you will get your payment.

NPC: One ProtoPharm Runner still has to be flatlined for you to earn the reward.

NPC: A shame that you are no child from Dome of York. You would have a brilliant career. Those Cyborg parts you brought in are almost identical to ours. Only minor things are different. They removed the autonomous control processor for example. That means their Cyborgs cannot make decisions on their own like ours can.

Your response: That means they are bad copies?

NPC: True. They are no match for our superior troops. But I do not doubt for a minute that they now have much more knowledge about our war technology. They probably already have weapons that work specifically against our units.

Your response: Neocron would never surrender without a fight, that much is clear.

NPC: That is the reason why we utilize different strategies. One of them is to equip Runner with our weapons. That way even individual Runner can make a move against the CityAdmin. And you cannot predict where the next attack will happen with so many individual units.

Your response: Sounds interesting, but I was promised some equipment as well if you remember.

NPC: Yes and you will receive some. One weapon with our newly developed technology and one armor. The weapon uses standard ammunition. Dome of York thanks you for your cooperation. Regard it as an extra reward.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Probably you already noticed the imminent alliance with Dome of York, right? I thought so. Well, I know a place deep in the Wastelands. There you can find a semi secret outpost of Dome of York. I've already been there so I'm not lying to you. No shit.

Your response: I don't quite get what you are aiming at. What's so special about it?

NPC: I'm telling you, they aren't planning no picnic there. If I had a little bit more courage I'd have taken them up on their offer. They are looking for Runners like you and they are offering good credits. Unfortunately our own faction doesn't have any jobs available right now. For the moment at least.

Your response: Of course, they are giving me credits for nothing, sure thing. Now tell me, where is the catch?

NPC: Well, their tasks don't sound too simple to me. Killing Runners, espionage and stuff like that. That's nothing for me but if you feel up for something like that...

Your response: I understand now. Maybe I will check it out soon. What is the exact location of the outpost?

NPC: It's not that hard to find if you know where to look for it. Be careful nontheless since its heavily guarded. Have a look around sector J08.

NPC: Didn't I say sector J08 or something?

NPC: What is your designation?!

Your response: I have heard about this unoffical Dome of York outpost and I'll be damned if I'm not able to use this information for my advantage.

NPC: Your assumption is correct. Did you come to accept a job from us?

Your response: That depends. First I want to know what you plan to achieve by those missions. You must aim for something, some sort of bigger scheme maybe?

NPC: Opportunistic Runners like you only ever work for their own advantage. But rest assured. Dome of York has been wise enough to apply more promising strategies to our fight against Neocron. The goal is to cripple the invidious enemy. The goal is to dismantle the vital organs of that beast until Neocron is unable to lead any coordinated action at all. Apart from that there might be a lot of money in it for you.

Your response: That sounds good and believe it or not, I'll be as happy as you are to see Neocron in ruins.

NPC: Then it's settled. We have certain tasks for motivated Runners. But I'm warning you, it won't be that easy. And think about it hard, you would do Dome of York a big favor and we never let down our allies.

Your response: By the way, I've noticed that there is a general present here. Doesn't he have anything more useful to do?

NPC: Fool, the presence of the general only shows how important this is for us. If you are lucky you may even receive a mission from the general himself. He is a great man and he carries the burden of being responsible for big decisions.

Your response: Interesting, but why not invite the Runners into the Dome of York?

NPC: That's not your problem. But it certainly is not as conspicuous out here in the Wastelands. We won't make the same mistakes we did in 2578 over and over again.

Your response: Very well, you bought me.

NPC: We have discovered the true identity of one of Rezas spies. Unfortunately he managed to escape into the swamps where we lost his trail. The exits of the swamp are under 24hour surveillance which means he cannot escape that way. It should be clear that we want him dead.

Your response: And how do you suppose I should recognise him? There aren't many people out in the swamps but still more than I'd like to.

NPC: Just talk to him. I am sure he will tell you something about how great Neocron is. All of their spies have been bombarded with Propaganda for so long that they have no choice but to repeat it over and over again. The location is somewhere in sector F02. Make sure the spy doesn't leave the swamp alive.

NPC: You will never get me.

NPC: Oh boy, am I glad to see somebody like you. You got something to eat for me, please?

Your response: Who are you?

NPC: I am a loyal citizen of Neocron and I... I got lost in the swamp. I am certain that you came to kill me, right?

Your response: Why, do you have a reason to fear for you life?

NPC: With all that time I spent here in the swamp I did have some time to think. I can't see a solution, drones are sweeping the swamps and make it impossible for me to flee. I am running low on food and my internal implants are running out of power.

Your response: So you are a spy from Neocron? And you escaped into the swamps? How stupid is that?

NPC: You will see, Neocron will triumph over all of you. But my life is in your hand now. I am just asking you for a last favor. Take this data, it contains all of my acquired information. Get it to Kev Critter at the Blakkmist Garbage Dump and you'll get a reward for it. It's not yet too late for you to choose the right side in this conflict.

NPC: You almost did it. I know why you are here. Kill me if you can.

NPC: First you have to find the spy in F02 and eliminate him.

NPC: Acceptable effort, runner. This spy shouldn't be able to betray us any longer. He sneaked into our dome and committed some heinous murders before we were able to discover him. But in the end he probably wouldn't have been able to do us any lasting harm.

Your response: Good, now back to my reward.

Your response: Indeed, he was a looser, he even gave all his spy data to me before I executed him.

NPC: It seems, as if you don't have his data after all.

NPC: Excellent, for this service we are willing to pay you a bonus. Another example of how retarded the supporters of Neocron are. But now to the next mission.

Your response: What about the specs?

Your response: There will always be turncoats. What are you trying to say?

• Just a moment. This is bad news. The report talks about spies in the Wastelands. Increasing numbers. That could be dangerous for us at the moment. Our secret projects must not be uncovered.
