entries.conversation:
NPC: For time being you can try and get some more credits out of that outpost from Dome of York.  Sector J08 but you probably still know that.

NPC: I remember you, that was some good work back then. Dome of York ist grateful for your efforts. If you are interested you can help us to advance even further in our plans. We have dozens of scientists working day and night to come up with new technology.

Your response: Interesting, what kind of new technology are we talking about?

NPC: That is still Top Secret. And this kind of information will not be available anytime soon. But we discovered that Neocron is in the possession of technology that can be used as energy source for our projects.

Your response: And I am supposed to get that technology?

NPC: Exactly. Neocron uses it to power their vehicles. I am talking about vehicle Energypacks. Go and get 10 of them. We will still entrust other Runners with the very same mission in order to have enough of that energy in the end.

Your response: There is still the question about the payment.

NPC: Indeed. The same as usual, we will discuss it later on once you acquired these items.

NPC: Acquire those vehicle energypacks from somewhere. 10 of them will be sufficient.

NPC: Do you have the objects? Excellent. Of course this is only the first part of the mission. Did I forget to mention that? I am sorry.

Your response: That is nice, that is real nice. I want my money now.

NPC: I am sorry. The regulations are very strict in these cases. And believe me, there is nothing more strict in Dome of York than the military. You have no choice but to accomplish the other part of the mission if you still want the money.

Your response: Very well, you convinced me. What do I have to do next?

NPC: We have a source of information within the Neocron city walls who is giving us constant information. He is pretty well known and delivers to anyone who can match his price. That means you can often find Tsunami, Black Dragon, Crahn and Twilight Guardian lurking around him.

Your response: What is his name? Maybe I already heard of him.

NPC: His name is Benjamin but that's probably only a fake name. He provides us with a report every second day. Your task will be to retrieve that report. HE is waiting in Industrial 02. You might encounter other Runners there as well, Benjamin is a very busy person. Take this as a token so that he can recognise you.

NPC: Can't you just leave me alone? I'm trying to enjoy some sythetic wine here. Go away!

NPC: Aha, the messenger from Dome of York changes often as I see.

Your response: What is that supposed to mean?

NPC: Well, Dome of York trusts nobody, not even their allies. They don't feel responsibility for anybody but themselves. That's how I feel about it at least.

Your response: Alright, now what information do you have this time?

NPC: The CityAdmin despises Crahn, Tsunami and Black Dragon even more than before. There are rumours about Reza having sudden fits of rage. Why? I don't know, but I have accumulated all I could get about it.

Your response: Good, then give that information to me and I'll be on my way.

NPC: Here you are and be careful on your way since it is getting very dangerous recently.

NPC: Ask the people who give you that mission. I am not giving reward to anybody.

NPC: Benjamin can be found in one of the industrial sectors. He will give you a report which you will hand over to me.

NPC: Good work. Hand over the report to me now.

Your response: Do I get my reward now or is there more?

NPC: Just a moment. This is bad news. The report talks about spies in the Wastelands. Increasing numbers. That could be dangerous for us at the moment. Our secret projects must not be uncovered. Runner, kill one CityAdmin and one Tangent Runner. Only Runners, no guards and no CopBots either. We need to divert their attention to something else. I will hand out the very same instructions to other Runners as well.

Your response: What about my payment, then?

NPC: You will receive it without delay once you have done this last part. We might even have a bonus for your efforts.

NPC: One CityAdmin Runner and one Tangent Runner are your targets. Get to work.

NPC: Now you only need to find one CityAdmin Runner. Afterwards you will get your payment.

NPC: Now you only have one Tangent Runner left to kill.

NPC: Well done. You seem to be rather experienced with this kind of job. Maybe General Babel will have an additional task for you in due time. (next mission at level 45)

CONTACT

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE

• TG RayGun Rifle

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• True and at the same time our Cyborgs carry that name. Neocron even managed to reproduce some of them. We need somebody to check whether or not their Cyborg parts are identical to ours. Go to sector C12 and get some parts from one Y Trooper Replicant Cyborg. Afterwards we will see where all this leads us to.

• Good work, soldier. It will be Runners like you who we will have to thank for our victory in the end. While we have these parts analysed you could help us with the Neocron plague in the Wastelands. They are disturbing our projects and are on the verge of discovering our secret projects. Take care of one BioTech and one ProtoPharm Runner, it will serve as an example and will prevent them to continue sniffing for our secrets. Kill them and then return. Hopefully we will know more by then. If you fulfill our expectations you  will receive some additional equipment.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: You should really know whom to talk to by now. Maybe you can even talk to the General there and get a task.

NPC: I have reports that you have already proven your worth on the field of honour, soldier. Congratulations. Do you already know about the Ceres plans? And do you already know that Neocron stole them from behind our backs?

Your response: I thought the Ceres plans incorporate all knowledge of the known world.

NPC: True and at the same time our Cyborgs carry that name. Neocron even managed to reproduce some of them. We need somebody to check whether or not their Cyborg parts are identical to ours. Go to sector C12 and get some parts from one Y Trooper Replicant Cyborg. Afterwards we will see where all this leads us to.

NPC: The targets are in C12 and you should have a look out for the Y. Trooper Replicant Cyborgs. Take those parts from the Cyborgs and get the hell outta there.

NPC: We need those Y. Trooper Replicant Cyborg parts for analysis.

NPC: Good work, soldier. It will be Runners like you who we will have to thank for our victory in the end. While we have these parts analysed you could help us with the Neocron plague in the Wastelands. They are disturbing our projects and are on the verge of discovering our secret projects. Take care of one BioTech and one ProtoPharm Runner, it will serve as an example and will prevent them to continue sniffing for our secrets. Kill them and then return. Hopefully we will know more by then. If you fulfill our expectations you  will receive some additional equipment.

Your response: This job better be worth it.

NPC: If that is your only concern then rest assured. Carry on with your duty.

NPC: We agreed on one ProtoPharm and one BioTech Runner each. Now get to work.

NPC: Find a BioTech Runner and flatline him. That's all and afterwards you will get your payment.

NPC: One ProtoPharm Runner still has to be flatlined for you to earn the reward.

NPC: A shame that you are no child from Dome of York. You would have a brilliant career. Those Cyborg parts you brought in are almost identical to ours. Only minor things are different. They removed the autonomous control processor for example. That means their Cyborgs cannot make decisions on their own like ours can.

Your response: That means they are bad copies?

NPC: True. They are no match for our superior troops. But I do not doubt for a minute that they now have much more knowledge about our war technology. They probably already have weapons that work specifically against our units.

Your response: Neocron would never surrender without a fight, that much is clear.

NPC: That is the reason why we utilize different strategies. One of them is to equip Runner with our weapons. That way even individual Runner can make a move against the CityAdmin. And you cannot predict where the next attack will happen with so many individual units.

Your response: Sounds interesting, but I was promised some equipment as well if you remember.

NPC: Yes and you will receive some. One weapon with our newly developed technology and one armor. The weapon uses standard ammunition. Dome of York thanks you for your cooperation. Regard it as an extra reward.

entries.description: Quest-related dialogue from the game files.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Matts Info
• Secret Info

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Matts Info
• Secret Info

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• It's not that hard to find if you know where to look for it. Be careful nontheless since its heavily guarded. Have a look around sector J08.

• Didn't I say sector J08 or something?

• Just talk to him. I am sure he will tell you something about how great Neocron is. All of their spies have been bombarded with Propaganda for so long that they have no choice but to repeat it over and over again. The location is somewhere in sector F02. Make sure the spy doesn't leave the swamp alive.

• Probably you already noticed the imminent alliance with Dome of York, right? I thought so. Well, I know a place deep in the Wastelands. There you can find a semi secret outpost of Dome of York. I've already been there so I'm not lying to you. No shit.

• That's not your problem. But it certainly is not as conspicuous out here in the Wastelands. We won't make the same mistakes we did in 2578 over and over again.

• The many different factions that populate Neocron and the Wastelands are the perfect nourishment for chaos. And chaos, Runner, is our friend. The Tsunami, Black Dragon, Twilight Guardian, Crahn and even the Fallen Angels belong to those who see past the clever lies of Neocron. But there are still many undecided individuals who change their faction as often as their implants.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Probably you already noticed the imminent alliance with Dome of York, right? I thought so. Well, I know a place deep in the Wastelands. There you can find a semi secret outpost of Dome of York. I've already been there so I'm not lying to you. No shit.

Your response: I don't quite get what you are aiming at. What's so special about it?

NPC: I'm telling you, they aren't planning no picnic there. If I had a little bit more courage I'd have taken them up on their offer. They are looking for Runners like you and they are offering good credits. Unfortunately our own faction doesn't have any jobs available right now. For the moment at least.

Your response: Of course, they are giving me credits for nothing, sure thing. Now tell me, where is the catch?

NPC: Well, their tasks don't sound too simple to me. Killing Runners, espionage and stuff like that. That's nothing for me but if you feel up for something like that...

Your response: I understand now. Maybe I will check it out soon. What is the exact location of the outpost?

NPC: It's not that hard to find if you know where to look for it. Be careful nontheless since its heavily guarded. Have a look around sector J08.

NPC: Didn't I say sector J08 or something?

NPC: What is your designation?!

Your response: I have heard about this unoffical Dome of York outpost and I'll be damned if I'm not able to use this information for my advantage.

NPC: Your assumption is correct. Did you come to accept a job from us?

Your response: That depends. First I want to know what you plan to achieve by those missions. You must aim for something, some sort of bigger scheme maybe?

NPC: Opportunistic Runners like you only ever work for their own advantage. But rest assured. Dome of York has been wise enough to apply more promising strategies to our fight against Neocron. The goal is to cripple the invidious enemy. The goal is to dismantle the vital organs of that beast until Neocron is unable to lead any coordinated action at all. Apart from that there might be a lot of money in it for you.

Your response: That sounds good and believe it or not, I'll be as happy as you are to see Neocron in ruins.

NPC: Then it's settled. We have certain tasks for motivated Runners. But I'm warning you, it won't be that easy. And think about it hard, you would do Dome of York a big favor and we never let down our allies.

Your response: By the way, I've noticed that there is a general present here. Doesn't he have anything more useful to do?

NPC: Fool, the presence of the general only shows how important this is for us. If you are lucky you may even receive a mission from the general himself. He is a great man and he carries the burden of being responsible for big decisions.

Your response: Interesting, but why not invite the Runners into the Dome of York?

NPC: That's not your problem. But it certainly is not as conspicuous out here in the Wastelands. We won't make the same mistakes we did in 2578 over and over again.

Your response: Very well, you bought me.

entries.description: Quest-related dialogue from the game files.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• DoY ID Cube
• Document Package
• Vehicle Energypack - Hover Technology Only

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• DoY ID Cube
• Document Package

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• For time being you can try and get some more credits out of that outpost from Dome of York.  Sector J08 but you probably still know that.

• Just a moment. This is bad news. The report talks about spies in the Wastelands. Increasing numbers. That could be dangerous for us at the moment. Our secret projects must not be uncovered. Runner, kill one CityAdmin and one Tangent Runner. Only Runners, no guards and no CopBots either. We need to divert their attention to something else. I will hand out the very same instructions to other Runners as well.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: For time being you can try and get some more credits out of that outpost from Dome of York.  Sector J08 but you probably still know that.

NPC: I remember you, that was some good work back then. Dome of York ist grateful for your efforts. If you are interested you can help us to advance even further in our plans. We have dozens of scientists working day and night to come up with new technology.

Your response: Interesting, what kind of new technology are we talking about?

NPC: That is still Top Secret. And this kind of information will not be available anytime soon. But we discovered that Neocron is in the possession of technology that can be used as energy source for our projects.

Your response: And I am supposed to get that technology?

NPC: Exactly. Neocron uses it to power their vehicles. I am talking about vehicle Energypacks. Go and get 10 of them. We will still entrust other Runners with the very same mission in order to have enough of that energy in the end.

Your response: There is still the question about the payment.

NPC: Indeed. The same as usual, we will discuss it later on once you acquired these items.

NPC: Acquire those vehicle energypacks from somewhere. 10 of them will be sufficient.

• Good work, soldier. It will be Runners like you who we will have to thank for our victory in the end. While we have these parts analysed you could help us with the Neocron plague in the Wastelands. entries.conversation:
NPC: You should really know whom to talk to by now. Maybe you can even talk to the General there and get a task.

NPC: I have reports that you have already proven your worth on the field of honour, soldier. Congratulations. Do you already know about the Ceres plans? And do you already know that Neocron stole them from behind our backs?

Your response: I thought the Ceres plans incorporate all knowledge of the known world.

NPC: True and at the same time our Cyborgs carry that name. Neocron even managed to reproduce some of them. We need somebody to check whether or not their Cyborg parts are identical to ours. Go to sector C12 and get some parts from one Y Trooper Replicant Cyborg. Afterwards we will see where all this leads us to.

NPC: The targets are in C12 and you should have a look out for the Y. Trooper Replicant Cyborgs. Take those parts from the Cyborgs and get the hell outta there.

NPC: We need those Y. Trooper Replicant Cyborg parts for analysis.

NPC: Good work, soldier. It will be Runners like you who we will have to thank for our victory in the end. While we have these parts analysed you could help us with the Neocron plague in the Wastelands. They are disturbing our projects and are on the verge of discovering our secret projects. Take care of one BioTech and one ProtoPharm Runner, it will serve as an example and will prevent them to continue sniffing for our secrets. Kill them and then return. Hopefully we will know more by then. If you fulfill our expectations you  will receive some additional equipment.

Your response: This job better be worth it.

NPC: If that is your only concern then rest assured. Carry on with your duty.

NPC: We agreed on one ProtoPharm and one BioTech Runner each. Now get to work.

NPC: Find a BioTech Runner and flatline him. That's all and afterwards you will get your payment.

NPC: One ProtoPharm Runner still has to be flatlined for you to earn the reward.

NPC: A shame that you are no child from Dome of York. You would have a brilliant career. Those Cyborg parts you brought in are almost identical to ours. Only minor things are different. They removed the autonomous control processor for example. That means their Cyborgs cannot make decisions on their own like ours can.

Your response: That means they are bad copies?

NPC: True. They are no match for our superior troops. But I do not doubt for a minute that they now have much more knowledge about our war technology. They probably already have weapons that work specifically against our units.

Your response: Neocron would never surrender without a fight, that much is clear.

NPC: That is the reason why we utilize different strategies. One of them is to equip Runner with our weapons. That way even individual Runner can make a move against the CityAdmin. And you cannot predict where the next attack will happen with so many individual units.

Your response: Sounds interesting, but I was promised some equipment as well if you remember.

NPC: Yes and you will receive some. One weapon with our newly developed technology and one armor. The weapon uses standard ammunition. Dome of York thanks you for your cooperation. Regard it as an extra reward.

entries.title: Biotech 01
entries.description: Quest-related dialogue from the game files.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Packet with Test Results

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Packet with Test Results

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Excellent. You can find the CityAdmin employee in the Plaza district 02. A meeting was arranged in one of the local restaurants. Please return here once you are finished to give me a small report.

• Did you already complete the interview? He should be somewhere in the Plaza district.

• Most of the time these test implants are tested on mutants or certain critters in the Wastelands. These are then closely monitored over a certain time. That means that BioTech implants are a safe choice.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Ahh, I was already informed that new runners would join BioTech. We always welcome worthy additions to our own ranks.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Normal procedures would demand that the Director of Operations welcomes you personally but he is currently engaged in an important meeting with Seymour Jordan. You will understand that he cannot just cancel that meeting.

Your response: That is a pity but I do understand it. What kind of tasks await me, now that I am working for BioTech?

NPC: That is the way we like it, concise and straight to the point. You will already have received your appartement key from BioTech. In exchange we are only expecting loyalty and that you take care of a select number of special assignments. But more about that later. You have certainly chosen the right faction with BioTech, congratulations.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: First I should maybe tell you something about the company background. BioTech was involved in many different projects since its founding in the year 2638. Currently the focus is almost exclusively on the development and production of various implants.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: This does not mean that BioTech is a stranger to spaceship construction, medicine or weapons. To be precise, the first interstellar spaceship named the Avenger was developed and built by BioTech.

Your response: Yes, I have heard about that.

NPC: Back to the present. We had a request from the CityAdmin for an interview with one of our latest additions to the crew. They are doing a survey and need to ask a few questions. This would probably not take very long and BioTech would even be prepared to give you a small compensation...

Your response: That sounds good, I believe I can do that.

Your response: I am sorry but that won't be possible for the moment.

NPC: Excellent. You can find the CityAdmin employee in the Plaza district 02. A meeting was arranged in one of the local restaurants. Please return here once you are finished to give me a small report.

NPC: You can always change your mind if you want to.

NPC: Hello, you have been sent by BioTech I assume?

Your response: Yes. And I assume that you are from the CityAdmin.

NPC: Very good, my name is Thompson. I fear I have a tight schedule, so let us start straightaway, shall we? I would like to point out however, that this conversation will be recorded. Almost everything in Neocron is recorded one way or the other in any case but I still have to mention it.

Your response: That is rather unsettling if really everything is being recorded.

NPC: Rest assured that there are still places where CityAdmin has no eyes or ears. Even if Mr Reza would probably like to change that.

Your response: Alright. Then lets start straightaway. What was this interview all about?

NPC: I am compiling a survey about the general behaviour of citizens. It will show a comparison between different factions and point out relevant results.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But you can imagine that this is a really huge task for one person alone. I am not even sure whether or not our conversation will ever be published or presented to an audience. I need some answers from you however to complete this task.

Your response: If that is all, just ask...

NPC: Okay. Why did you choose to join BioTech in the first place? Was it the professionalism of the company, was it the size or was it something else?

Your response: I think it was something of everything and I am more than just interested for the products of BioTech.

NPC: Thank you. Have you already had some negative experiences with BioTech? Did other employees maybe behave strangely or suspicious?

Your response: No, not that I know of. But I do not think that usually happens.

NPC: Do you already have relationships or even close relationship to one or more BioTech employees? Or are you for example already engaged in an affair with a BioTech employee?

Your response: Please give me a break, what has that got to do with anything?

NPC: Let us try another question then. Do you know about BioTech employees that have connections to criminal elements?

Your response: I believe this has gone too far now. Your questions have nothing to do with the survey or any statistic anymore. You are just trying to get company specific info from me.

NPC: Careful, Runner. CityAdmin has no need whatsoever to question somebody like you. CityAdmin is above all criticism. After all this interview is on a totally voluntary basis.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Let me correct myself. Once you have agreed to this interview you will receive a comment in your file when you abort the interview.

Your response: Damn! But what is the purpose of these questions then? Is that your method of uncovering criminal elements in society? I, for one, don't think that I will answer any more question.

NPC: Didn't you hear of the rumours lately? There are accusations against employees of BioTech that they did not conform with the law. There already have been a couple of executions.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Of course these criminals have earned that kind of punishment. After all they worked against the great system that is Neocron.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: CityAdmin only tries to get a detailed image of the current situation. BioTech is just as vulnerable to dubious characters like every other company.

Your response: But that have only been rumours, or not?

NPC: It does not matter here whether or not it was only rumours. But since you have refused to answer all my questions and therefore questioned my authority and the authority of the CityAdmin this will go into your citizen file.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Furthermore be warned! The CityAdmin loves its citizens but in exchange for that it is expected of a citizen to follow the rules. If those rules are compromised there is only one punishment, Death. And in your case, Runner, you have barely escaped that fate.

Your response: But I have not done anything...

NPC: To question the authority of a CityAdmin employee is more than enough... now go before you will really get yourself in trouble here.

NPC: I do not have more to say. Go back to BioTech, as I am sure you might want to report everything.

NPC: Did you already complete the interview? He should be somewhere in the Plaza district.

NPC: A productive day, Runner.

Your response: Yes, that would have been nice. But instead I had to waste my time speaking to that CityAdmin employee.

NPC: Calm down and don't speak like that about the CityAdmin. After all they protect everything here in Neocron.

Your response: Bah! But then there is only one penalty for almost everything. Death!

NPC: Stop it right now... there is nothing you can do to change the system anyway. Accept it.

Your response: This will not be easy but I have always been a survivor. The CityAdmin cannot really throw me off course.

NPC: Good, what do you remember from the interview? What did excite you so much?

Your response: It began very slow, but then questions would become ever so specific about the company and private relations. In time I realised that the questions only tried to find out more about the situation of BioTech.

NPC: Are you certain? That is strange... Was it mentioned, why these questions have been asked?

Your response: He said something about rumours about BioTech that popped up recently.

NPC: Rumours! Yes, I have heard of them. But I would not have thought that they have already reached the CityAdmin. Although I have heard some bits and pieces about it.

Your response: These rumours are real? But why then are they so dangerous that the CityAdmin would dispatch some CopBots?

NPC: Well, the NCPD and the CityAdmin will want to make certain that Neocron is secure. That's why they follow every rumour. Rumours that could damage Neocron. In such a case the NCPD usually only watches the person in question for some time before they rush in.

Your response: That seems to be only sensible, I mean, you can't execute somebody because of his belief.

NPC: Oh, I almost forgot. There is another task to do if you feel up to it. It is a small delivery for ProtoPharm, our most important cooperation partner for the construction of implants. BioTech makes constant improvements to their palette of implants and ProtoPharm is helping in a tight cooperation.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: The chemicals that are produced by ProtoPharm are very important to prevent and control certain anti reactions of the body. If those chemicals were not effective enough there would be symptoms like the ejection of the implant from the body, heavy flue, cramps and it could even lead to insanity.

Your response: I never knew that implants could be that dangerous.

NPC: Exactly that is what I am talking about! Through the cooperation with ProtoPharm they are not dangerous at all. Every implant is thoroughly tested before it is introduced to the market.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Most of the time these test implants are tested on mutants or certain critters in the Wastelands. These are then closely monitored over a certain time. That means that BioTech implants are a safe choice.

Your response: It would seem that I have chosen the right faction then. I am ready to do the delivery now.

NPC: Glad to hear that. If you are ready you can deliver this package to a ProtoPharm employee at their HQ in Viarosso 2. It contains rows of numbers that represent the results from tests with mutants. Just visit me again after your delivery and I will see to your payment.

NPC: I am sorry Runner. I have too much work on my hands. Come back later.

NPC: A productive day. What do you want? If you require ProtoPharm products please refer to a trader.

Your response: No, I am here because I have a delivery. Test results from BioTech implants to be precise.

NPC: I see. Then just hand me the package and I will confirm the delivery. I have not yet seen your face. You have just began to work for BioTech, right?

Your response: Yes, very perceptive. But I am getting used to the situation.

NPC: I am pleased to hear that. There has always been a good cooperation with BioTech. A productive day.

NPC: You have already delivered the package. If you still need something please see a trader or return to your company. I am very busy.

NPC: You have not yet delivered the package to ProtoPharm. Hurry and then come back for your payment.

NPC: Ah, there you are. The delivery has been confirmed. Here is your reward that is granted to you by company regulation 318. And remember, the more sympathy you have within the ranks of BioTech the better the chance to receive more important tasks.

NPC: Go away

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Important Info-Datacube
• Paratemol Forte

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Important Info-Datacube
• Paratemol Forte

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• That is the right attitude. I suggest you visit Black Lily in Pepper Park 02. She is very close to the source of rumours. She could know more about it than I do. Go now.

• I...well, I got it from a few contact persons in Pepper Park and the neighbourhood.

• Pepper Park? That cesspit of corruption? Well, we will see, if this information is any good. I am of the opinion that only shit and violence ever comes out of there. I strongly advise you to keep your distance from that area! There is only trouble.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: I have already heard about your ambitious endeavours to get more renown within BioTech. Well, it seems to work for the moment. I was instructed to offer you another task. You might remember the rumours about BioTech that abounded in Neocron.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Well, this time they also appeared in the network and they raise heavy accusations against two BioTech directors. It is unknown, where these rumours come from and that is the reason why we need more information.

Your response: I understand. That is my task then, right?

Your response: If this is supposed to be a mission I will have to deny it, I am sorry.

NPC: Yes, not alone though. We already have sent out several Runners with the order to investigate into the rumours. And you will have exactly the same order. These informations are naturally not easy to acquire and that is why you need to utilize rather uncommon methods.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: There is a Tsunami contact person that agreed to give us some information. But it is not certain if the Tsunami know anything about it at all. If you get your hands on something interesting, best report it to McMillan. He is one of the directors of operation here at BioTech and was informed about everything.

Your response: Ok, I have understood everything so far. Where exactly can I find this Tsunami contact?

NPC: He is in the Industrial district 02. But be careful out there since it is pretty dangerous. The name of the contact is Hontoka.

NPC: Rethink your decision. You can always come back for the mission.

NPC: Meet up with Hontoka in the Industrial district 02. Once you have what you need, be sure to visit McMillan right here in the HQ.

NPC: Ho, Runner. What's up?

Your response: A productive day. I am coming from BioTech. Man, this really is a dirty neighbourhood.

NPC: That doesn't suit you, does it? Well, there are those who have to live here. Myself, I am lucky, I am just visiting. Some people just have more luck than others.

Your response: Let's get back to business, shall we? You know why I am here?

NPC: Yes.BioTech is scared of the images of some ghosts. Although those images are just the mirror of the reality. they show how BioTech looks on the inside, or don't they?

Your response: I doubt that very much. BioTech is a honorable company and has nothing to hide.

NPC: Only a fool would talk about things he has not seen for himself. Who can say whether these stories are real or not? I will not judge on this but I am on your side. These rumours are not very productive for certain deals...

Your response: Is that so? Then you can surely tell me what you know about those rumours.

NPC: I know that some of those stories are fiction, created to cause mayhem. But I also know that every page has two sides to it.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Meaning that certain stories about BioTech having contacts to the underworld or even about secret experiments on humans are not really fiction.

Your response: You are joking, BioTech would never do experiments of this kind.

NPC: Oh, BioTech would never do that, that is true. Such a thing is only ever done by an employee of BioTech. Most have their own motivation. The search for power, money or even fear are very strong motivations. But never the company itself.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: It is always the individual person that does something like that. There are contacts to the Tsunami for example and sometimes even cooperations. They are denied officially of course. Just as well there are disgusting experiments on humans. Some of which are even partially legal by existing laws.

Your response: There are always people who are committing such monstrous acts. I will not be drawn further into this discussion. I want to know if there are indications about who is spreading these rumours.

NPC: You are walking the way that leads to the goal but you do not have an eye for the flower at the side of the way. How can you reach the goal if you do not see the whole picture, if you do not see everything? No, I do not know more about it. But think about who would do something like that? Who would want to damage BioTech?

Your response: A good question. I don't know it at the moment, but I will find out.

NPC: That is the right attitude. I suggest you visit Black Lily in Pepper Park 02. She is very close to the source of rumours. She could know more about it than I do. Go now.

NPC: You will not be able to get more information from my side. But once you have what you came for, give it to your superiors.

NPC: Well, how about it? Oh my, you look exhausted. You have probably planned something else already, dont you?

NPC: I am sure I could give you all that you could wish for. Or even more.

Your response: No thanks. Not now. I have spoken to Hontoka. He advised me to ask you about rumours.

NPC: Rumours are fascinating, don't you think?

Your response: Everybody should decide that on his own. Do you know by any chance who is behind all these rumours that are spread throughout the network?

NPC: You mean those accusations? Maybe I know something. these stories are very amusing. I could spend days to just download them off the net.

Your response: Does that mean you know something and you are just keeping it from me? Do you expect something in return or are you just not prepared to tell me?

NPC: Don't be that sensitive, of course I know something about it. It is difficult to spread that many rumours in the net and not to leave any trace at all. But you have already guessed that I would like you to do me a little favor.

Your response: If it is not too much I am prepared to give you something in return for the information.

NPC: I am sure we will get along nicely. I want you to bring me three Paratemol forte drugs. You know it is not that easy with a job like that. Sometimes you feel like cowering in some corner and dying.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But drugs help to get over these periods... at least for a time. They numb your feelings. I can imagine how you think about me now... everybody thinks like that.

Your response: It is not fair that you suffer like that. But life has never been fair ... I will get you those drugs.

NPC: Thanks. Here is your datacube. Maybe somebody from your company might be interested in it. A director maybe?

NPC: Thank you, please bring me three of those Paratemol Forte drugs. It's those cylinders with the red pills. In exchange for that I will give you a datacube with the informations you wanted.

NPC: Thank you, please bring me three of those Paratemol Forte drugs. It's those cylinders with the red pills. In exchange for that I will give you a datacube with the informations you wanted.

NPC: Come on. I really need those pills.

NPC: Come on. Can't you count till 3?

NPC: Come on. Can't you count till 3?

NPC: Thanks. Here is your datacube. Maybe somebody from your company might be interested in it. A director maybe?

NPC: I have already given you every information that I have. Take it back to your company or wherever you came from and give it to your directors.

NPC: At the moment I have not time for you. But you could speak to another employee. Only come to me if you have real important information.

NPC: Ahh, a new face. It is always a pleasure to welcome another ambitious Runner in our ranks. I hope you are content with everything you experienced so far?

Your response: Of course, everything fits so well together and is organized professionally. But...

NPC: Yes, I knew you would be content. Nobody has ever regretted it to join our company. The best company of all of Neocron. I was informed about those horrible rumours in the network.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: It is cruel and evil enough to create these rumours in the first place. These people have obviously no idea how that hurts all of us.

Your response: I believe those people know very well what they do. They obviously want to hurt BioTech.

NPC: I guess its those punks again, these Anarchy Breed! Or those up to no goods, the Twilight Guardian. I cannot stand both of them. It is already past time somebody did something against them. Did you find anything out?

Your response: Yes, I have. I have received a datacube with some interesting information. Although I have not had the chance to examine them any closer.

NPC: You have really found something? Very good, go on and give it to me. I will follow it up and have the data analysed. Good work! Where did you get this information?

Your response: I...well, I got it from a few contact persons in Pepper Park and the neighbourhood.

NPC: Pepper Park? That cesspit of corruption? Well, we will see, if this information is any good. I am of the opinion that only shit and violence ever comes out of there. I strongly advise you to keep your distance from that area! There is only trouble.

Your response: I will keep it in mind.

NPC: Alright then! Since you did your job, and did it well, BioTech gives you 5000 Credits as payment. It will be transferred to your account presently. Maybe we have another mission for you once we sifted through this information. A productive day, Runner.

NPC: Go away

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Mutant-Implant

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Mutant-Implant

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Well, there is not much I know about the people who spoke to me. I only know that they forwarded my information over a networking station in the Wastelands. It is situated somewhere near the old ruins.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: BioTech would like to offer you a new task. It is related to the content of the datacube that you organised for us. It was quite revealing. It contained several code names of persons who apparently received information regarding BioTech directly from BioTech sources.

Your response: That means there is somebody who gives away all these secrets? I thought these rumours were only that, simple rumours. I would not have thought they were true.

NPC: Those stories are not true! They have been strongly modified to inflict more damage to BioTech.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But we still have not found a proper trail to track down a specific person. That means that we do not know who gives all these informations away. Especially since it probably is not only one person.

Your response: What can we do against that?

Your response: I cannot accept the task at the moment.

NPC: It is a very complex procedure but the plan is to closely follow every movement of the persons in question. That is were we need your help. BioTech would like you to meet a certain Andressa in the Chez Sypher restaurant where she can be found very often. She works in our research lab and some of her activities have been quite suspicious to say the least.

Your response: No problem but what am I supposed to do then? Should I just ask her if she is giving away compromising information about BioTech?

NPC: No, that would be foolish. You should try to convince her to give away  vital information to you. Just offer 50000 Credits as reward for example. I mean, you don't really have to pay it after all.

Your response: What happens to her if she gives away that information?

NPC: I believe with all the fuss that happened lately she will just be stripped of her ranks. To fire her would only cause unnecessary attention to these cases.

Your response: Alright, I'll do it.

NPC: She can be found in this district. She likes to spend her lunch break at Chez Sypher. Report everything to Mr McMillan back here.

NPC: That's a pity. Make sure to call us if you decide to do it after all.

NPC: I thought you already have your assignment?!Visit Andressa right on the backside of the BioTech building.

NPC: Yes? I am really trying to enjoy my meal here. Make it short.

Your response: You work with BioTech, right?

NPC: Yes, that is true. Why do you want to know this?

Your response: How should I put it... I am very interested in BioTech and I was wondering if you would happen to know something about them? Something like rumours or dirty secrets...

NPC: Who do you think I am? I am not working there as a spy!

Your response: Are you sure? There could be a hefty sum in it for you. About 50000 Credits if the information is worth it.

NPC: 50000? That is a pretty high sum. But how do I know if I can trust you? How can I be sure that you are not trying to fool me?

Your response: You cannot be sure. Will you accept the deal? Yes or no.

NPC: ... I am not falling for this ancient trick. I don't believe that you are after informations about BioTech, am I right? I believe that you are after those who spread all these rumours over the network.

Your response: Not at all, not at all... or do you know anything about that? Do you know who is behind all this? And what do you know about it?

NPC: Well, I already assumed that BioTech would dig up the truth one day. I am sure I will not get away unscathed. I mean you have been sent by BioTech to question me, I assume.

Your response: That depends...

NPC: Ok, I'll tell you something. I know that my job at BioTech is in danger and thats why I will tell you all that I know about it. At least that might lessen my punishment for giving away all this information.

Your response: That sounds acceptable. Please continue...

NPC: It all began a few month ago. I was sitting here enjoying my lunch, as always and somebody started a conversation with me. He offered to give me a lot of money for vital information about BioTech. At first I was skeptical but then my greed for the money overwhelmed me.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: I had serious doubts about it. Many colleagues at work are very nice and the atmosphere is good as well. But I really wanted that money and I could not resist the offer in the end. That is how I told them about the few secrets I knew about some BioTech members.

Your response: I could have deducted that much myself. Could you be a little bit more specific?

NPC: Well, there is not much I know about the people who spoke to me. I only know that they forwarded my information over a networking station in the Wastelands. It is situated somewhere near the old ruins.

Your response: Can you tell me where exactly that station was?

NPC: Yes, it is either the ancient Yucida village or the ancient Loba Village. I really do not know more about it. Even the person who spoke to me did notsay his name. He did not even register on any terminal. But maybe that network station is your best trail.

Your response: I will investigate into that ...

NPC: Good luck with your investigation.

NPC: Have you already checked the ancient villages?

NPC: Get lost! Don't you see that I am busy?

NPC: You want to talk to me?

Your response: Yes, that's right. this is a networking station, right?

NPC: A small one but after all it is mine. I am earning my money lending it to clients. Most of the time these clients need channels which are not covered by any law. Maybe you are interested in renting my rig?

Your response: Not really, no. I am much more interested in getting a list of people who used your rig lately...

NPC: You will understand that I cannot do that. My clients are relying on me to keep their secrets secrets.

Your response: It would be very important for me, you know.

NPC: Let me think. There might be something you can do. Out here there are a lot of mean and ugly creatures and mutants. I have not slept well in days because of them. If you can get rid of them I might tell you what you want to know.

Your response: If you insist we do it that way.

NPC: very good. Just kill five of those mutant corporals. Maybe then I will be able to sleep well again.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Strangely enough these mutants out here are all equipped with implants of some kind. I believe that's what makes them so aggressive. I have a whole pile of those chips but I have no use for them.

NPC: I have watched you closely... you have not yet killed five mutants.

NPC: Very nice, do you hear that? No crying or roaring any more... I'll give you one of these implants first. BioTech is written on it. But I don't know what that means exactly. I have also had a look at my files in the meanwhile but I could not find the information. Well, I guess my hard drives are just a big mess... tehehe.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But I could just send them out to you. Where should I send it to?

Your response: Send it simply to BioTech. It will reach me sooner or later.

NPC: BioTech, huh? I don't mind. I'll send you the information on who used this station as soon as I can.

NPC: I am not that fast. Calm down. You have to give me a little bit more time. Why don't you already go back to your company and wait there?

NPC: Would you please be patient? I do not have time at the moment. Thank you.

NPC: I am sorry, but I am very busy at the moment. Let's make this short. You might recall those rumours that appeared all over the net? They have lessened considerably, they seem to be getting less and less.

Your response: I have done an investigation for BioTech. I found out that a certain Andressa sold compromising information about BioTech.

NPC: That is at least some kind of improvement. The less people give away vital information, the less negative publicity there will be.

Your response: I also visited a networking station that was used for the transfer of these BioTech rumours. The owner has assured me to send a list of persons to BioTech. The list contains details about persons who recently used the station.

NPC: Excellent, good work.

Your response: There is something else. I have been given this microchip. It is implanted in many mutants in the vicinity of that networking station. It seemed to make the mutants more aggressive. Could it be that BioTech experiments on these mutants?

NPC: But of course. After the law every mutant is of less worth than an animal. You can do with them whatever you want.

Your response: But they have been humans once, too... !!

NPC: Where did you leave that implant? you will have to give it to me if you want me to do something about it.

NPC: Yes, I hear that far too often, Runner, but I don't make the rules. I am just trying to not to break them. Just give me that microchip and I will have the information in there analyzed.

Your response: Good, I will make myself available as soon as the list arrives from the network station.

NPC: Of course, here is a reward of 10000 credits. Keep yourself in good shape.

entries.conversation:
NPC: There are bad news. The amount of compromising material has dramatically increased. To be honest, some employees have already been strongly affected. It is about high time that all this ends soon.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: The owner of the networking station, a certain Beckert, did send us information. We now have a list of people who rented that station. That is why we need you for another assignment. If you are ready, that is.

Your response: Of course, after all I am a member of BioTech just as you are and it is just as well my business.

Your response: I don't think I can do this job.

NPC: I am glad to hear that. The list highlights one person who had access to the network station at that specific time. It is a certain Grand who can be found in Outzone 01.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: We have contacted CityAdmin and it appears that he is well known to the authorities as a prominent hacker. He doesn't belong to any faction and would do everything for money.

Your response: That does not sound very comforting. How does that help us?

NPC: You have to find a way to force him to reveal who is behind all this. And he can possibly undo what damage he already did.

Your response: I am already on the way. What methods should I use?

Your response: What should I do if I have to kill someone to complete the mission?

NPC: That is up to you. Use all methods that you have at your disposal. After that you can inform McMillan about the progress of the current situation.

NPC: Regrettable. Especially this job would have been of a special importance. But I don't want to force you.

NPC: Good luck with your task. Did you already visit that Hacker in the Outzone 01?

NPC: Find the Twilight Guardian Contact in Pepper Park 3 and kill him.

Your response: Pepper Park 3, got it.

NPC: Good luck with your mission. Use whatever means you think are necessary.

NPC: Yes? Who's there?

Your response: Are you Grand?

NPC: That depends...

Your response: Let's cut straight to the point. I know that you are Grand.

NPC: Very well. I am Grand. What about it?

Your response: I know that you rented the networking station in the desert near some ancient ruins. Whom did you rent that station for?

NPC: Hah! It should be obvious for such a clever guy like you, shouldn't it?

Your response: Come on. Tell me. It can't be that difficult.

NPC: You know something? I believe you are bluffing and that's why I will tell you something... Both Tangent and Twilight Guardian are involved. Even if both have different goals. Now don't bother me any longer, I still have to put a few files on the network. Hahaha.

Your response: You are obviously not taking me serious enough. I want to know precisely who is behind all this and you should not upload any more of this rubbish.

NPC: Who would prevent me from doing that? You?! Excuse me if I laugh. I have never before heard of you and then you come here and ask questions that I would not even tell a CopBot if he threatened me with his gun.

Your response: It seems that I have to resort to other methods. To show you how serious I am I will kill one of your Twilight Guardian friends. And after that... it will be your turn, understood?

NPC: Haha, good luck. I doubt that you could even kill one of the Twilight Guardian Contacts in Pepper Park 3. Go and show me I'm wrong, and I'm willing to tell you more.

NPC: Did you give up already on your plan? Thought so. Killing a Twilight Guardian, even if it is only a Contact, is no easy task for an arrogant BioTech ...

NPC: You again!? Oh man, I would not have thought you capable of something like that. Pretty harsh to kill somebody because of that.

Your response: I hope you got the message?

NPC: Yeah, alright, alright... Twilight Guardian and Tangent are diefinitively into this. But still... I don't know who started it in the first place. I am sorry. You have to understand that I do this because of the money. At some point I must have lost the righteous way...

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: After I had saved enough money for a flight to Irata III there were no new spaceships in construction, all of a sudden. And they lost the contact as well. I have lost all my dreams and ideals back then. Now I do what I do best and try to get along.

Your response: I am not interested in your whining. Oh yes, take these rumours out of the net.

NPC: Calm down, no need to get excited. I have to warn you that I can only take my own files off the net.

Your response: Does that mean, that there are other hackers with the same mission?

NPC: Yes, at least a dozen I assume... but I don't know a single one of them.

Your response: Then at least delete your own files. I don't mind if there are consequences involved for you.

NPC: I hope that was all you need...

NPC: I am already deleting my data... don't push me. Go back to wherever you came from.

NPC: Did you already do something against these rumours? Weren't you supposed to visit that guy in the Ouzone 01?

NPC: This is a crying shame, these rumourmongers! This whole incident is slowly but surely robbing us of important employees. Those liars! But it seems to me that people like to believe in a lie rather than the truth.

Your response: Yes, but the first step to resolving this whole issue has already been done. I was able to track down a hacker who put some of the rumours on the net.

NPC: Did you at least kill him for his evil deeds?

Your response: No, what are you thinking? He would never have been able to undo his work.

NPC: Well, you have done it again. You really are a worthy addition to BioTech. Could you find out who is hiding behind all this? Who is holding the strings?

Your response: I could only dicover that Tangent as well as the Twilight Guardian seem to be involved.

NPC: Tangent! It's so obvious! We were fools. It is so obvious that Damion Jordan, the CEO of Tangent, wants to damage BioTech as much as possible.You know that the father of Seymour and Damion is forcing the competition between the two through a sort of contest where the winner gets it all, right? Meaning that the winner gets both BioTech and Tangent.

Your response: In this case it looks more like a cruel joke to me.

NPC: Yes, Damion is using every dirty trick! He is not even refraining from such a malicious campaign of lies and rumours. But you, you have earned a break. A forced break but nonetheless time to relax and enjoy life. there are still a few things to sort out before BioTech is able to figure out the right tactic to use as a counter attack.

Your response: Very well, I will try to improve on my abilities in the meanwhile.

NPC: And because you did BioTech a big favor you have earned a little extra. 20000cr.

CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Warbotmicrochip

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• BioTech M.O.V.E.O.N. CPU

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Did you already visit Grand in the Outzone 01?

• There is a special kind of Warbot in the Wastelands. They have special network ID codes printed on their microchips.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: It is not acceptable any longer. Every day there is a new flood of rumours reaching the net, trying to disrupt BioTech as a whole. But we can do nothing against so many individual hackers.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: BioTech decided to determine who is pulling the strings in this. Once we found him these rumours will soon stop flooding the network. A creature without its head is a dead creature, it was always like that and it will always be like that.

Your response: I'll gladly try my best for BioTech. Where do I start?

Your response: If you think about me, I cannot do it at the moment...

NPC: It seems that this hacker, Grand is his name I think, is suited for what we have in mind. Visit him again. Motivate him to find out who started all this. Who has declared open war on us.

Your response: I believe that will be a piece of cake.

NPC: You can offer him a small sum of 10000 Credits as compensation. It could help to support his motivation. Of course this will be sponsored by the company. Good luck.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: If the hacker should be succesful be sure to meet McMillan as well. He will discuss the next steps with you.

NPC: But it would have been very important to Biotech. Well, whatever you mean. But you are letting BioTech down this time, really.

NPC: Did you already visit Grand in the Outzone 01?

NPC: Not again!! I thought I was finally free of you!!

Your response: There is still a little something you have to do...

NPC: I have already told you all I know! What on earth could you want form me again?

Your response: Simple. We need to know who is behind all these rumours. And you, you will find out who the culprit is.

NPC: I have strong objections... I won't be exploited...

Your response: BioTech plans to award you 10000 Credits if you agree to help us. Still not interested?

NPC: Those 10000 will really be mine? well, maybe I can do something. But it won't be easy.

Your response: That would really have surprised me if something turned out to be easy.

NPC: Once I have the 10000 I can begin the search for the persons that is responsible for the rumours. This will take a while but I believe I can do it. Although I might still need a few tools.

Your response: What kind of tools?

NPC: There is a special kind of Warbot in the Wastelands. They have special network ID codes printed on their microchips.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: If I use those IDs nobody will be able to track me since it appears as if a Warbot is browsing the net. It is a certain fail safe for me.

Your response: If that really is necessary, I will do it. Every day there is more and more rubbish about BioTech entering the net so we need to hurry. Where can I find this WarBot?

NPC: That is easy. Just go the Wasteland zone i 07. There you will find not only a production facility, Emmerson factory I believe was its name, but also these WarBots. Get me one of those Microchips. But I fear that you cannot take it without disabling one of them first. Good luck!

NPC: Without the number code I will be caught in no time. You better get me one.

NPC: Thanks. But this can take a while now. I will transmit the results directly to BioTech, ok? I really hope this is the last time that I see you.

NPC: It will still take a while. The more I am being disturbed the longer it will take. You can just as well wait at your company.

NPC: Please speak to me only if you know something of importance.

NPC: You must have forgotten something. I am almost certain.

NPC: There you are. You are really getting famous throughout BioTech. And with your help we will ban that ghost that is haunting us.

Your response: Grand, the hacker, has agreed to pin down the person who is behind all of this. He will transmit his findings directly to BioTech. But that could still take some time.

NPC: Very good, very good. As soon as we know who started all this we will need your help again. But we should speak about that once it is about time to act. For now you are being awarded 30000 credits for your invaluable service. And in addition this implant might come in handy in the next mission. Get into shape, you might need it...

NPC: You already have your reward! Leave me alone!

NPC: You have done everything for me. What do you want? Leave me alone!

entries.description: Quest-related dialogue from the game files.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Go and see McMillan. He sounded very excited when he asked for you.

NPC: I believe you should really meet with McMillan.

NPC: Do you really think I am just standing here to tell you bullshit?? If I repeat something TWO times, I MEAN it!!!

NPC: Finally we have the rumourmonger himself. It is the director of operations at Tangent Technologies. We are so close to resolving this whole sad chapter. But that is only possible with your help.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: For this job we need somebody who is utterly loyal to BioTech and also very experienced at what he does. Our choice was obvious, you fulfill all these criteria. I believe you can be entrusted with this mission.

Your response: I feel honored and will try to do my best.

NPC: In order to close this chapter as fast as possible Seymour Jordan himself has authorized drastic measures. We simply cannot wait for the CityAdmin to take action against him.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: That is the reason why he should be killed. That should be a very strong warning to those who are involved. But for that we need an absolute loyal runner like you.

Your response: Alright, I will kill the director of operations of Tangent for the sake of BioTechs wellfare.

NPC: You are really admirable. You can find him in his favourite restaurant in Via Rosso Sec-3, but there is a catch. If you succeed we cannot give you any more missions. You surely understand why since you will be infamous throughout Neocron. But you will always be a member with a high esteem here at BioTech.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: To make certain you succeed BioTech developed a special implant that combines several powers and will support you in the assassination. This implant is not available through vendors but you already got it for free. Good luck.

NPC: You are supposed to flatline the Tangent Director of Operations.

NPC: Congratulations, this warning will hopefully be strong enough for Tangent. You have done a great service for BioTech. At the end I would also like to give you these 100,000 Credits personally as a reward. It was authorized straight from the top. Good luck on your way into the future and think about founding a clan to further support BioTech as excellent as you already did.

NPC: Sorry, but I am busy now. Leave me alone!

• No remorse and no mercy! That is bad for business, understand? Now that you know the most important rule you could make a delivery for us. Manuel is one of our street dealers and he ran low on drugs. You will get a fresh bundle to him in Pepper Park Sector 2. After that you get straight back to me. entries.conversation:
NPC: If you think being with us is an easy way to money and power, forget it. You gotta work hard like every single one of us. Competition is tough to say the least.

Your response: Very well. Then tell me what exactly you guys do around here. I am not going to work for somebody I don't know.

NPC: You will see, Runner. It would probably be best though if you learned a little more respect first. People would take you more seriously, you know? Why don't you frickin newcomers have any manners at all?!

Your response: No reason to insult me, I understand what you are saying.

NPC: Alright, alright. It's not that I am trying to get rid of you or something. But who am I to know whether you are a Tsunami infiltrator or not. That's the reason why you will have to prove yourself to us first. Even before I can answer those questions of yours.

Your response: Don't worry, I'm prepared for everything.

NPC: If that's really your attitude you have a bright future in front of you. However, you should always keep the first rule in your mind because if you don't, you will go down fast.

Your response: I am listening...

NPC: No remorse and no mercy! That is bad for business, understand? Now that you know the most important rule you could make a delivery for us. Manuel is one of our street dealers and he ran low on drugs. You will get a fresh bundle to him in Pepper Park Sector 2. After that you get straight back to me. Unless of course you want to talk to some people here first. Maybe Leone or Lucky? They're both rather powerful. Make sure however that you keep your hands off Lucy, ok? You better talk to Leone or Lucky instead, would benefit you more I think.

NPC: Yes? What is it? Are you here to try some real sweet drugs? Come on, I can get you anything you want. I can even get you something special.

Your response: No, thanks. Here is a delivery of drugs for you. It's some kind of test job for me, you know?

NPC: This is lame, this is real lame. If you're going to get me that delivery, that's ok. But if you haven't got it, where's the point in telling me about it?

NPC: Test? Whatever. I'd prefer a big fat bundle of money really. It's a tough job here. If I do this for another twenty years I think I will die.

Your response: Twenty years? That is a long time. You must surely know a lot about things here, eh?

NPC: Sure I do. After all I grew up around here. Some free advice, make sure you avoid the Tsunamis on the street unless you have the advantage. You should try and make friends with Leone and Lucky since they are pulling the strings around here. Apart from the really powerful persons of course. You will be lucky to ever lay an eye on Gecko at all. Most of the time he is seen with his girl, Lucy. Don't make the mistake and fall for that bitch, she is already promised to Gecko ... and Lucky might have something against it as well. But listen, I have a favor to ask.

Your response: Something else? I thought I have already given the delivery to you.

NPC: I know but I am living through a nightmare right now. Nobody wants to buy anything and I am low on credits. I haven't eaten anything in days because of this crap. Please, I need some money. Come on, 1000 would be enough. Please, I really need it.

Your response: Ok, but that's all you will get from me.

Your response: There is no way I am giving you any money, you hear me? Look after yourself or nobody will.

NPC: Runner, you just didn't get it, didn't you?  Hahaha. You better join the Fallen Angels or something because they can't cope with the rough life out here either. You've failed the test, loser.

NPC: It sure takes a lot to withstand my whining. Congratulations, you have passed the test. We are always looking for merciless bastards like you.

NPC: I am sorry but you won't get a second chance from me. Maybe you can try again? Ask the person who sent you.

NPC: Go to the Wiseguy who sent you in the first place. Tell him that you passed the test.

NPC: Sorry, you gotta speak to Manuel first. If he sends you away you might have to try again from the beginning.

NPC: Well done, you have passed the test. It seems you did remember the first rule.

Your response: Yes, great. Do I get some kind of reward now or what?

NPC: You think you are clever, don't you? I'll give you 1000 credits but only because I am such a nice person. Do something with it! The better you are the further you'll get. If you really are clever you can grab loads of credits with us. Most people don't get there, though. Once you feel stronger you can come back for another assignment. Newcomers like you can't do squat for us at the moment. (next mission at level 20)

NPC: You don't look very familiar. So, you are new with the Black Dragon? What a pity. Maybe we should continue our neat conversation until you are rich and powerful for example.

Your response: Manuel told me about you. I have great ambitions and I will reach my goals. Just wait and see.

NPC: You wouldn't believe how often I had to listen to similar bullshit. If you really mean it try to get Gecko as a friend. He is the right hand of Trond and he is very powerful. Maximilian Trond is more like a God you can pray to. You'll be lucky if you ever even lay an eye on him. See you later, Runner.

NPC: I wish I could talk more with people. If only Gecko wouldn't be so damn jealous.

NPC: Why are you disturbing me? I don't have time to waste on a nobody like you. I have no intention of ending up like Wan Tokai. Mainly because he is dead.

Your response: Rest assured, I won't be a nobody forever. But who is Wan?

NPC: You don't even know Wan Tokai a.k.a. the Dragon? The single one person who gave his name for the Black Dragon? Runner, you are still far from being interesting to me. You better leave now.

NPC: Do I need to repeat myself? You have to play according to the rules or you will die. Do you get it?

NPC: A new face?! And what is your business with me? I have never heard of you before. I will certainly not giving out something for free. But keep in mind that drugs and appartements are always generating money. A wise man would try and get some experience with our business.  And if you're just looking for a job, ask one of the Wiseguys around.

NPC: Improve on yourself and then we will see.

• Since we lost a considerable amount of drugs you have to find a way to keep our contract with the Crahn. They expect a delivery of a dozen Destrosol Forte. The contact person is a monk named Mercurus. Probably he'll be hanging out somewhere on the upper levels of Pepper Park Sector 3. This is a one time chance so don't disappoint me.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Damn Tsunamis. I assume you already have made some experience with those bastards?

Your response: Some. They have never had friendly intentions, though.

NPC: Small surprise. After all they are our arch enemies. Only yesterday they roughed up some of our dealers. Bastards! Whatever, Leone's got something for you. You know the drill, he is already waiting for you. He'll be waiting in the HQ.

NPC: Leone is usually in the HQ, I'm sure you'll find him there.

NPC: It seems as if this is your lucky day. I'll give you a chance to prove your worthiness. Our dealers were roughed up by a very aggressive Tsunami Clan named Monsun. And all our dealers wanted was to sell a few drugs to the Tsunami girls. Is that too much to ask?

Your response: So what? Why should that interest me?

NPC: Don't you have a brain or something? If you want to be successful with us you should choose your words a little bit more carefully. Now do what I'll tell you.

Your response: No reason to get excited, I'm all ears. What is my task?

NPC: Since we lost a considerable amount of drugs you have to find a way to keep our contract with the Crahn. They expect a delivery of a dozen Destrosol Forte. The contact person is a monk named Mercurus. Probably he'll be hanging out somewhere on the upper levels of Pepper Park Sector 3. This is a one time chance so don't disappoint me.

Your response: No problem, just give me those drugs and I'm on my way.

NPC: Didn't I just say that we don't have them in stock?

Your response: Sure you did but normally...

NPC: Get back here once you delivered the drugs to Mercurus. I don't care where you get them from! I didn't say it was as easy as stealing candy from a child. I don't have more to say. Mercurus is expecting 12 Destrosol Forte and maybe you can get them from Lucky or some other dumb shit.

NPC: I don't have time now. Even I need to do something on occasion.

NPC: I've got something you might be interested in.

Your response: I can't really imagine what that might be.

NPC: 12 Destrosol Forte to be precise. All nicely wrapped up in a bundle. Interested?

Your response: How could you have known that? I need exactly this kind of drug for a small job.

NPC: I have my information. But listen, I'll give these drugs to you for free and in return you owe me a favor for later. I won't wait forever for your decision. Well?

Your response: Very well, I accept.

Your response: No way, I know this is a trap.

NPC: Great. I believe that both of us will benefit from this.

NPC: I have already handed the drugs over to you. What do you want more?

NPC: As you wish. Return if you have changed your mind. I am certain you will accept my offer.

NPC: I thought we had a deal!? Keep to your word, you and your Black Dragon, or you will suffer the consequences.

NPC: I thought we had a deal!? Keep to your word, you and your Black Dragon, or you will suffer the consequences.

NPC: Tell me, friend or foe?

Your response: I have something for you from the Dragons. Drugs to be precise.

NPC: Very well! I already suspected you of using it for yourself. Now we can finally continue our experiments... but... but this is only 12 Destrosol Forte and we agreed on 16. Where did you leave the rest?

Your response: Nobody told me there would have to be 16. A dozen were stated in the agreement.

NPC: How nice. I bet you have taken the rest for yourself, junkie. You will get me the last four as well or this will have consequences.

NPC: We agreed on another four Destrosol Forte, understood?

NPC: Very well, our relation to the Black Dragon will remain favorable after all. Thank you. Now you can return to your boss and tell him we received the delivery.

NPC: If we need more we will contact you again. You can return to where you came from.

NPC: Get back here once you have delivered the drugs to Mercurus. And maybe you can trick Lucky into giving you something first.

NPC: It seems that you succeeded, eh? You have already improved your standing within the Black Dragon with this. I hope you are thankful that I offered this chance to you.

Your response: Of course but I'd be more interested in some credits if you know what I mean.

NPC: You ungrateful bastard, my thanks don't seem to be enough for you, eh? Well then, here you have 2000 credits. Your work isn't worth a penny more. To be precise you are already overpaid as it is. If you want another job go to one of the Wiseguys.(next mission at level 30)
