entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Video Records

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Video Records

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Of course I do. I know a close friend of Lucky who is always hanging out somewhere in Industrial Sector 2. His name is Carlos. I would only need somebody to rob him of his belongings and we would have our evidence. I am speaking of video records that show him and Lucy. That pig stole it from me before I was able to show it to Gecko.

• You can find Carlos in Industrial Sector 2. All you need to do is to get hold of his material. Look for possible video recordings.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Listen, this is the chance of your lifetime. You better take care and behave yourself. Talk to Lucky here at the HQ. He told me it's all about your friend Leone. Don't ask me what this is all about, I've got no idea.

NPC: Lucky would like to talk to you. I would jump on this opportunity. Take advantage of it.

NPC: Welcome my very special friend. I hope you enjoyed your spare time since they are over now.

Your response: I would say that depends on my reward.

NPC: It's a very simple task. Probably you have already noticed that Leone is a pig, didn't you? He is devious and treacherous even to his own clan. It is about high time we did something against that. And that is why I need your help.

Your response: So, you don't want to dirty your own fingers, am I right?

NPC: Don't forget, doing me a favour would be beneficial for you. Things would be a lot easier when you have to deal with me. Never forget that I have a lot of influence here.

Your response: I always keep to my promises. What do I need to know now?

NPC: Good, very good. You know, he prepared a devious video that he wanted to show to Gecko in order to bring me in miscredit. Now I want you to put that fat pig on ice. Make sure you talk to him before you do it and forward a warm greeting from myself. I don't want you to return unless your work is finished.

NPC: I hope you didn't forget that you will have to kill Leone. Be sure to tell him who wants him dead before you kill him.

NPC: I don't want anything to do with such a run down Runner like you. Leave me alone.

NPC: You are annoying me, Runner. I don't have the slightest use for such an amateur like you.

Your response: I know exactly how you think about me, but I was sent by Lucky.

NPC: Lucky? What... what could he want from me?

Your response: He forwards a warm greeting to you and wants to see you cold. Cold, dead and in the gutter to be precise.

NPC: Me? Don't make me laugh, he would never do something like this. He's always talking but there's nothing behind it.

Your response: I would like to do Lucky a little favour...

NPC: Lucky didn't send you to me just to tell me that, didn't he? Is that supposed to mean...

Your response: Isn't it obvious you pig, I am here to kill you!

NPC: This can't be real, right? This is a bad joke, right?

Your response: Do I look like a joker to you?

NPC: No, by god this cannot be. Wait, wait, I don't want to die. Don't do it, please.

Your response: Pleading for his life rather then defend your honour. What kind of Black Dragon are you? Give me one reason not to waste you right here, right now.

NPC: Because, because... I could help you to get powerful with the Dragons. I can arrange for Gecko to be in dept to you. How about it? We work together and get rid of Lucky, eh? What do you think?

Your response: Tell me more, at the moment I don't see how this can work.

NPC: Simple, Lucy... she's got an affair with Lucky... and Gecko doesn't know about it. We could surely take advantage of that. We can get some evidence and give it to Gecko.

Your response: That sounds like a plan. I hope for your sake that you know where the evidence is.

NPC: Of course I do. I know a close friend of Lucky who is always hanging out somewhere in Industrial Sector 2. His name is Carlos. I would only need somebody to rob him of his belongings and we would have our evidence. I am speaking of video records that show him and Lucy. That pig stole it from me before I was able to show it to Gecko.

Your response: And you think that I should do that? Hmmpf seems to me that you are just using me to save your ass. How are you going to get Gecko indebted to me?

NPC: First things first, you'll see. Listen, it would look too suspicious if I was to visit that guy. Obviously you will need to down him since I don't believe that he will part with his stuff voluntarily. Once you return with the stuff we got something we can present to Gecko...

NPC: You are boring me, why don't you go and play with somebody else?

NPC: You are boring me, come back when you have something that might interest me.

NPC: You are boring me, why don't you go to the Pussy Club and see whether I'm there.

NPC: If you have something that is of interest for me then tell me.

Your response: Oh, let me just say that Gecko would be disappointed if he knew about your affair with Lucky.

NPC: You are trying to trick me, aren't you? I bet you cannot back up your outrageous claims, can you?

Your response: Oh, but I can. I've got some recent video clips and I believe that should be sufficient. Really hot footage, the lighting could be better tough.

NPC: I see, it can't be helped and it seems that you won your little game. How much?

Your response: That is better. I would ask a mere 10000 for them. A fair price, don't you think?

NPC: Alright, but the video is mine. I see, this video is the real thing. I'm afraid to think what might have happened if Gecko would have gotten hold of it.

NPC: You can find Carlos in Industrial Sector 2. All you need to do is to get hold of his material. Look for possible video recordings.

NPC: You can find Carlos in Industrial Sector 2. All you need to do is to get hold of his material. Look for possible video recordings.

NPC: Very good, very good. Hand the video over to me. Now we have something real in our hands. I will forward it to Gecko and I am certain that it will not fail to impress. Just you wait and see.

Your response: I just changed my mind. I think I might find another person who is interested in this as well. Especially Lucy might be more interested in order to not let these records fall into the wrong hands.

NPC: You goddamn son of a bitch! You cheat me?! Well, you won't get any missions from me any longer.

NPC: Yes, what do you want from me? Something important? Do you have something to say?

Your response: No, no, it's nothing.

NPC: So you are one of those pathetic people with no initiative whatsoever?

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Very well, we will talk about Leone later on. First you will proceed to work against the Tsunami. Kill two of their Pimps in Pepper Park 1, since they are responsible for it all. Now go.

• Go and make sure those people leave their accomodations. The representative Pain should wait somewhere in Outzone 1.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Listen. Lucky knows that you cheated him. I'd say you are screwed which is why I don't understand why he wants a personal conversation with you. You just seem to be one lucky bastard. If it was up to me you'd be floating down the river face down.

NPC: Lucky won't wait forever. But go on and try his patience.

NPC: Why do you do this to me, eh? I thought we were friends. You were supposed to flatline Leone and what are you doing? Nothing.

Your response: Something else came up.

NPC: That is no excuse. You should be grateful that I did not make up my mind yet. But there is something more important right now. Those damned Monsun Tsunamis have proven to be a lot of trouble. People don't want to clear their accomodations. It's all a bloody mess and I'm not sure if I could solve it all by myself.

Your response: Maybe I could help you there. Of course only for a fee...

NPC: Very well, we will talk about Leone later on. First you will proceed to work against the Tsunami. Kill two of their Pimps in Pepper Park 1, since they are responsible for it all. Now go.

NPC: You haven't done your job yet.

NPC: Well done. This will hopefully stop some Tsunami plans dead in the tracks. It's all about time and if we gain some time because of this it's worth it.

Your response: Those Tsunamis were no match for me, it was a walk in the park.

NPC: Good, then you will have no problems with this assignment. Go and visit the representative of the housing association Pain, and show him the real meaning of pain. I believe you know what to tell him. No, better yet kill him straightaway! Without a conversation. That never fails to impress.

Your response: You know exactly how to make my day Lucky, consider it done.

NPC: Go and make sure those people leave their accomodations. The representative Pain should wait somewhere in Outzone 1.

NPC: As long as the representative of the associations still breathes there is no way I can get my hands on those accomodations. And I really need them, do you understand? You know what you have to do.

NPC: You are already finished? What a nice coincidence. Do you know what I heard while you were away?

Your response: No, but I am sure you will tell me in a second.

NPC: You have allied yourself with Leone and you blackmailed me. Now Gecko is mad at me and that is all your fault. You know that I have been very patient with you. But God knows this is too much.(next mission at level 40)

Your response: Is this supposed to be a threat?

NPC: ...

NPC: Have you been sent by the Black Dragon in order to finally make the agreed payment?

Your response: Ahh, basically I was sent...

NPC: Very good, this entire dispute was going on for too long and we want to end it as soon as possible.

Your response: This is all very well and dandy but Lucky sent me to kill you.

NPC: You will regret this if you do, the association will fight on even if I'm killed.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Leone would like to speak to you. You are already rather famous but you better be careful, to be famous is not always preferable. Watch your tongue, Lucky can be angered real quick as drugged as he is.

NPC: Why don't you just finish the job Leone gave you?

NPC: I don't like, didn't like you the first time you put a foot in my office. But I can still appreciate the value of a useful tool. In short Gecko would like you to do him a favour. As you know Lucky had an affaire with Lucy and Gecko doesn't seem to be too thrilled about this. Since he is a man of the old school he wants to give Lucky a warning before there are any consequences.

Your response: Yes, damn this honour amongst thieves, eh?

NPC: You will visit Lucky and you will make it very clear to him that Lucy is Gecko's girl, understood? You can rough him up a little after you have delivered the message. After all he should understand the message. After that you get the reward from me so you better be a little bit more grateful than the last time. I told you I would fix you a favour with Gecko.

NPC: Did you forward the message to Lucky?

NPC: Wait, who are you? Never seen you before. Wait, yes, I... no, lost it. My head feels as if its stuffed with cotton. What's happening?

Your response: Didn't you learn not to take too many drugs?

NPC: What? The drug delivery has arrived already? Naw, Regie would've informed me. Right? Hell of a lot of raw material. That'll help me.

Your response: Lucky, do you listen to what I say at all?

NPC: Sorry, did you say something? I think I swallowed too many drugs. I don't feel my legs anymore. What do you...

Your response: Maybe I should pay a visit to this Regie guy and get me a little of the drugs Lucky was talking about.

NPC: Regie? He's usually somewhere in Pepper Park Sector 3. My head hurts, ohhh. I am sure he can help you. I need to rest for now, sorry.

NPC: Regie can be found in Pepper Park Sector 3. Are you an angel?

NPC: I'm not here for my personal enjoyment, you know. I have an important job to do that benefits all of us. I am responsible to keep the drugs flowing.

NPC: Hey, what's up, Runner? Did you get lost?

Your response: Very funny. I am coming from Lucky. He is filled to bursting with drugs again.

NPC: That sounds like Lucky alright. But I can't do anything against that. Is that all or did you actually want to tell me something important.

Your response: I am supposed to get the newest delivery of drugs straight to Lucky.

NPC: Oh, you're here for the drugs, are you? No, I don't have them any longer, you're too late.

Your response: What is that supposed to mean?! Drugs don't just vanish into thin air. Talk to me!

NPC: You think I am stupid or something? Of course they didn't just vanish, I just said that the drugs are gone. Sometimes the drugs, or rather the raw material, gets lost on the transport. Mutant raids, lost cargo and the like. But that's not nearly all.

Your response: There's more?

NPC: And once the material gets to Pepper Park it happens sometimes that the Tsunamis start a little raid.

Your response: Tsunamis again? How do you get rid of those at all? Where did they go?

NPC: I have no idea. After all I wasn't there when it happened. One of our guys told me that it was Myaki Hung. He is a well known pimp and also a Monsun clan member. Whay do you ask?

Your response: I will get those drugs back. Isn't it obvious?

NPC: Those drugs belong to Lucky. Think about that before you steal them back from those extremist Monsun Tsunami.

Your response: Lucky is full of crack at the moment, he won't say anything anytime soon. I will bring the drugs to Lucy anyway, not Lucky.

NPC: You can try giving them to Lucy, but I for one think they're gonna kill you. If you want my advice... Kill Hung first and then take his stuff. You can find him in Pepper Park Sector 1. Be careful though, that's Tsunami turf.

NPC: Forgot where to find Hung? You can usually find him in Pepper Park Sector 1.

NPC: Hey stupid, can you try to remember? You can find Hung in Pepper Park Sector 1, now beat it!

NPC: Leave Tsunami territory at once or you'll suffer a lot of pain. Is that clear?

NPC: Ahh, you have already acquired a questionable reputation. You better keep your distance, understood?

NPC: What do you want here? I have heard a lot about your accomplishments recently.

Your response: And what have you heard for example?

NPC: For example that your next move is totally incalculable. I like that kind of a person. Tell me what you want with me.

Your response: I have an offer. I would suggest that I hand over this package of drugs to you and you pay me a certain sum in return. Interested?

NPC: That sounds intriguing but where did you get these drugs from? Usually they don't lie around on the streets you know. And ... what kind of sum are you talking about?

Your response: I am a reasonable person, we can talk about that. But it should be at least 50000.

NPC: The drugs seem to be alright. I'll take it and if you ever find more drugs you can come back to me. I'll certainly take them.

Your response: Excellent, I had hoped for something like this.

NPC: Sorry, but without the drugs there is no deal.

NPC: I will also inform you about a way how you could get your hands on even more credits. But it's not yet time. I will tell the Wiseguys once it is time. (next mission at level 45)

• We would be in need of a few kidneys for some special experiments we are conducting. We don't care where the kidneys come from either way. I hope you grasped my suggestion? entries.conversation:
NPC: It is time. Lucy asked me to tell you that she wants to speak to you. But be careful, Gecko doesn't like it if somebody is talking to his girlfriend.

NPC: Did you talk to Lucy?

NPC: Ahh, my favourite Runner. I hope you could enjoy your spare time and that you are ready to get rich.

Your response: I got no objections to being rich.

NPC: Listen. The Monsun Clan successfully raided our convoys time and time again. Usually they killed everybody who tried to stop them and sacked all the goods. Considering all the raids they made they must have amassed an enormous amount of drugs by now. It would seem logical that they store the drugs somewhere.

Your response: I see. So you are talking about a drug El Dorado.

NPC: Yes. It is a treasure that only waits to be found by us. Imagine what we could win through this.

Your response: We would be rich... Count me in. When do we start?

NPC: As soon as you are ready. I have some support from the ranks of the Crahn. Maybe they could help you with finding the location we are looking for.

Your response: What do I need you for if I am doing everything myself anyway?

NPC: Let's assume for a moment that you find the drugs. Whom would you give them to? What would you do with them? Your only choice is to sell them to me. After all Leone and Lucky are both rather angry at you presently. I will pay you a fair price, trust me.

Your response: I see, it seems that you have thought about everything. Where should I start with my search?

NPC: Mercurus assured me that the Crahn seers would at least be able to reveal a trace. Something we can follow up. I suggest you visit them first. Nobody knows much about them but it is certain that they do have a talent in seeing things that have not yet happened. As soon as you find something bring it to me.

NPC: Crahns followers are not here for your enjoyment.

NPC: I remember that we met before. I hope Crahn has finally enlightened you. Speak up now, what is your business here.

Your response: I was promised that your seers could reveal something of importance to me. Some kind of lead to a special storage place of the Monsun Clan. That particular place where they are storing all their stolen drugs. All drugs that have ever been stolen by them.

NPC: I understand. So you want our help, the help of our seers, in order to find these drugs? And you think that the seers are not busy enough already? Don't you think our seers have something more important to attend to?

Your response: I don't know about your problems but I still need your help.

NPC: If you need the help of our seers then you will have to help us first. Our seers can only help you if you take a load of their shoulders. Long story short, acquire something that is of value for us.

Your response: And what would that be?

NPC: We would be in need of a few kidneys for some special experiments we are conducting. We don't care where the kidneys come from either way. I hope you grasped my suggestion? There is only a slight inconvenience since we require kidneys from Fallen Angel Members from the Tech Haven entrance. Two kidneys would be sufficient I would say.

Your response: Are you saying that I am supposed to just grab a Fallen Angels Member, gut him and then steal his kidney?

NPC: Do you have a problem with that?

Your response: No, no, if it serves to get me closer to my goals I will get you those two kidneys.

NPC: Good, make sure you only attack employees and no Runner. Runners usually already carry some kind of virus or radiation disease and that makes them useless for our test purposes.

NPC: We need those kidneys as part of our experiments. What are you waiting for?

NPC: Excellent. I have asked one of our seers while you were busy. It seems that he was aware that you would bring us the desired kidneys and thus he presented me with the answer to your question. Since we now have our kidneys I can tell you what you desire to know.

Your response: That's what I was hoping for.

NPC: Look for a person named Chang. You will find him in the Secret Passage 2. He holds the key to your search.

Your response: That is all I get?

NPC: Yes and now go. I don't have any more time to waste on you.

NPC: Look for Chang in the Secret Passage 2. He will hold the key to your quest.

NPC: I have nothing to do with you, Runner.

NPC: I don't care who you are, I just don't enjoy talking to somebody like you.

Your response: You certainly know where the Monsun have stored all their stolen drugs, don't you?

NPC: Runner, you don't know squat. Tsunamis have no interest in drugs whatsoever.

Your response: I have a very reliable source so don't try to trick me. Do I have to beat the crap out of you first before you answer me?

NPC: Let me tell you something. Don't get involved in Tsunami business. Guys, kill him good.

NPC: You are trying my patience. I think I will have to solve this problem all by myself.

NPC: This is no place to be for someone like you. Get lost!

NPC: My god, I hope you didn't get my key? Damn that would cost my head.

Your response: You mean this one?

NPC: Ha, you will never get the key! I will take care of that!

NPC: How did you get the key from me?! Give it back! NOW!

NPC: First we need to know where the stolen drugs are stored. Talk to Mercurus. He can help us with the Crahn seers.

NPC: Do it exactly as you were told.

NPC: Do you want to be rich or dead?

NPC: Respect my friend. You have come across something big. Will you give the key to me?

Your response: First I want to know how many drugs we are talking about.

NPC: I suspect about a few million credits worth of drugs. But I would need to see the stuff myself first. The key is at least pointing us directly to the storage place. That much I am sure off.

Your response: Good, then the question of my reward is clear. Two million should be enough and I will give you the key.

NPC: Very funny, where do you suggest I should take that sum from? No, I have another proposition to make.

Your response: I am listening.

NPC: I will get you access to one of our hideouts, ok? Talk to the Storage Boss.

Your response: Clearly not as good as money but I could live with that. Do I get any other tasks?

NPC: No, or at least not directly from me. Gecko could get jealous. And since you have some bad blood between yourself and Lucky and Leone you won't get any more from them either. I suggest you build up your own name. Create something that will shake the foundations of the earth. I wish you the best of luck. Maybe you can start by founding a clan.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Welcome to the CityAdmin. To join us was possibly the best choice you ever did. CityAdmin is the biggest official institution for the safety of the citizens of Neocron. And everything thanks to Lioon Reza.

Your response: Since I now belong to the CityAdmin I thought I could get some sort of employment.

NPC: I was just about to get there. As a loyal member of the CityAdmin it is expected of you that you accept certain paid assignments. You are free to accept these assignments but who would reject a request of the one institution that is responsible for the wellfare of every person in Neocron?

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: After all the CityAdmin is working for the citizens unlike the previous dictatorship of the psi monks. At that time every thought was controlled by them and the people lived in virtual slavery. Many people forget who freed them from all that.

Your response: But is it that different today? I mean, you can be executed for uttering the wrong word.

NPC: Don't continue. I'll give you a good advice since you are new here. There are no rumours about the CityAdmin, you either accept it or you don't. This is especially true about Reza. If you don't heed my warning you might be punished with death rather sooner than later. And all that just because you could not keep your mouth shut.

Your response: I understand. I will consider your advice. Then tell me what is important about the CityAdmin?

NPC: Well. As I have stated earlier, Reza has freed the people from the cruel dictatorship of the psi monks after more than one hundred years of rulership. That happened in the year 2724 as far as I recall. That was also the begin of a new era of freedom.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: The psi monks owe it to the generosity of Lion Reza that they are still allowed to live in the city. Apart from that many new improvements were made so that the citizens would have an easier time. For example the law was simplified.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Nowadays everybody knows what he may or may not do. The success can be seen in Plaza or ViaRosso, there the criminality equals zero.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: And all of this despite the great difficulties after so many people left with the great trek in the search for Irata III. At that time criminality increased dramatically. It is only thanks to the CopBots  that there is still order within the city.

Your response: Do you know what happened to the people who joined the great trek? I mean after the contact to Irata III broke off?

NPC: That is easy to answer. The great trek is a long way from reaching Irata II. The efforts of the CityAdmin is concentrated on the safety and wellfare of the citizens of Neocron.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But enough of those old stories. There is a delivery to be made to the NCPD. And once you are already there you might also be able to help the NCPD a little. Neocron is big and there is always plenty to do.

Your response: Good, I will deliver this package. What does it contain?

Your response: I don't think I am ready for that yet.

NPC: It contains some evidence in the form of drugs that are registered in connection with a crime. If you want to know more, I am sure you can get more information at the NCPD. Good luck with your first assignment for the CityAdmin.

NPC: If you think so. Please return if you are ready.

NPC: You have forgotten the package. Make sure I get it soon.

NPC: Hello, Runner. I hope you have the package? good, you have to understand that there is a chaos here at the moment. That normally doesn't mean anything but it is even more chaotic than usually.

Your response: Here you are. Why all the fuss?

NPC: You haven't heard it yet? Yesterday a high ranking CityAdmin member was killed in the early morning hours. Imagine it, a murder of a CityAdmin member. Surely you understand now why everything is somewhat chaotic here.

Your response: A murder in such a high position? Is there already a suspect?

NPC: The evidence is not what I would call revealing. Plus there are no witnesses. The only ones that were in the vicinity officially were the CopBots. Apart from that some drugs have been secured on site. You have just delivered them here, by the way.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: The possibilities are just so many at the moment. It could have been the Black Dragon because of the drugs that were found. But it could also have been the Tsunamis, maybe a dancer or even the Twilight Guardian scum.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: That means we just have too many trails to follow and too few to really investigate. That's whats causing all the chaos here. By the way, you have just started with the CityAdmin, right?

Your response: Yes, that is about right.

NPC: I believe you have made a good choice. the Cityadmin is a very safe and well paid employer. Of course you have to be familiar with all the rules and regulations. If you have nothing else to do at the moment you could do the NCPD a little favor.

Your response: If I can help just say a word. I am ready for it.

Your response: I am sorry but I have something urgent coming up.

NPC: I admire that attitude. There is a dancer who occasionally had contact to Defries. Defries is the victim of the murder. It is highly improbable that she is connected to the murder but we have to check out every loose end as well. There are so many of them that we can use every help we can get.

Your response: No problem. I can help you out on this one. Where can I meet her?

NPC: She should be somewhere in Pepper Park. Her name is Black Lily. Afterwards you can come back and give me a short report about her statement. Then you are already finished here.

NPC: If you change your mind, come back any time.

NPC: Hey, I bet I could fulfill your most secret desires. How about it?

Your response: Later maybe. Right now I'm here for a different reason. Yesterday a murder happened and you are a known acquaintance of the victim.

NPC: A murder? That's a good joke. Half of all the people I ever knew are dead. You have to be a little bit more precise.

Your response: His name was Defries and he worked at the CityAdmin. He was a pretty important person.

NPC: Oh yes, I know that guy. But why should I talk to you about my private life?

Your response: The NCPD sent me. Isn't that reason enough?

NPC: That is a good joke. When the NCPD questions me usually an officer and a CopBot are present. Sometimes even one of those creepy psi monks. I have heard they can read your mind. But you, you don't even have a badge or an ID card.

Your response: I admit that is strange. But they must have forgotten to get me one in the first place with all that chaos around. I am really coming from the NCPD.

NPC: Why don't you give me a motivation of some sort? I believe 300 would be a good motivation. Maybe then I will be able to tell you more...

Your response: Figures you'd want something in return, here is the money. But the information should better be worth it.

NPC: Nice try, but you don't even have enough money.

NPC: Thats something you will have to decide for yourself. Thank you. Yes, I have known that Defries guy. Damn pervert! I am glad he got what he deserved. But I'm sure that's not the kind of information you are after.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: I tell you that even the CityAdmin had got some stinking rats on the inside. And Defries was certainly no exception. I know he bought drugs from the Black Dragon and without his pills he would have been totally impotent.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: If you ask me about potential enemies I tell you that he had too much money to have real personal enemies. I mean, he could pay his way out of anything.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: If you want my opinion, somebody wanted to attack the CityAdmin directly and Defries was only a convenient target.

Your response: Thats not much to work with. Thank you anyway.

NPC: It was a pleasure and hey, if you ever change your mind about my offer... I'll be waiting here for you.

NPC: Not at the moment please, leave me be. Go back to your precious NCPD.

NPC: Did you already visit Black Lily in Pepper Park 02?

NPC: There you are. What did she say about the murder?

Your response: I don't think she liked Defries particularly well. She thinks that the murder was not aimed at Defries in the first place but rather at CityAdmin. It is not much, but it could still help...

NPC: Alright. We might target a surveillance drone at her. But her theory is close to what we already assumed. Thank you that you lifted a little work off my shoulders. I still have to prepare a few reports now.*sigh*

Your response: Very well, I will have to return to the CityAdmin anyway to confirm the delivery.

NPC: A productive day, Runner.

NPC: I am sorry but those reports are still taking my full attention. Why don't you go back to the CityAdmin as you wanted to?

NPC: Did you visit the NCPD?

NPC: Took longer than expected, eh? What took you so long?

Your response: Don't worry, the package was delivered in time. As you suggested earlier I did offer the NCPD a helping hand. Although I doubt my help did actually change much.

NPC: Really? I mean, of course that is a good reason for coming late. The 1000 credits for this delivery have already been transferred to your account. Come back once you have proven to be loyal to the CityAdmin. At that time I believe we might have a new assignment for you.

NPC: Go away

CONTACT

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Empty Datacube

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• That is very arrogant and would cost your life within the boundaries of Neocron. You are lucky to be in the Wastelands. And after all it was you who destroyed everything! Your dictatorship almost ruined Neocron! It was our luck that Reza freed us of that cruel situation.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Something came up again. Do you remember the murder of Defries? Well, its seems that this was not supposed to be the end. There was another murder of a CityAdmin employee of a similar rank to Defries.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: I hope this will not spread even further. In any case, the NCPD has allocated all available forces to the investigation of this case.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: It does not seem that easy to solve this mystery, since all investigations usually stop in a dead end. Come on, it cannot be possible that there are so many enemies of the CityAdmin to justify such a lengthy investigation...

Your response: I believe you underestimate that.

NPC: The main enemy is the Twilight Guardian. They constantly try to disrupt the authority of the CityAdmin, but that is nothing new. Apart from the Twilight Guardian there is only Crahn, Tsunami and the Black Dragon left.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But Tsunami and Black Dragon are too occupied with their own business and their rivalry. And Crahn is only a remnant of their broken government. They still mourn their loss of power.

Your response: But you underestimate the personal motivations that could lead people to despise the CityAdmin.

NPC: I believe you are wrong there, the CityAdmin is fully supported by its citizens. Some citizens even control Neocron together with Reza. But that is not why I wanted to speak with you. The NCPD is very taxed at the moment.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: That is why the CityAdmin decided to allow Runners to investigate into that as well and thus help the NCPD. Information about various contacts have been forwarded to me and I have subsequently assigned the appropriate resulting missions to several Runners.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Unfortunately those Runners who volunteer for such a task or who are qualified enough are a rare breed. That is why I thought about you.

Your response: You are telling me that I am not qualified enough?! And now you are asking me because you have no other Runners left?!!

NPC: My reasoning is not subject to a debate. Even if you do not seem to accept it, there are Runners that are better suited for such a job than you are. I did not want to express it in such a harsh manner, however.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: If you decide not to follow up this assignment I will of course have to make a note in your file. You should have learned to control your temperament by now.

Your response: Alright, I am cool. What is the assignment all about?

Your response: I am not yet in the mood for another task.

NPC: NCPD has informed us that a certain contact person of the Tsunamis with the name of Hontoka is interested in selling information to us. It could be important for the murder case but since the information is offered by a Tsunami I do not know how reliable it will be. I doubt it to be honest.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But the CityAdmin would not be where it is today if it did not take all possibilities into consideration. You can find him in the Industrial district 02. If you get enough information talk to officer Jenna afterwards. I assume you already met her.

NPC: Focus on the assignment. Hontoka is still waiting in Industrial 02 for you. If you have enough information go and visit the NCPD.

NPC: Why don't you rest a little and come back when you feel that you are ready for a new assignment.

NPC: Are you the contact person form the CityAdmin?

Your response: Yes, I was told you have information for us. I hope it will pay off to make this long trip just to meet you.

NPC: I believe it will. Do you really think I would meet you in a place like this if it wasn't?

Your response: Alright, what have you got?

NPC: Not so fast!! I think I can expect some kind of compensation for this information since it might help to solve a murder. It should be worth something.

Your response: Who told you about the murder?

NPC: That is common knowledge by now. The walls in Neocron have eyes and ears even if many of them are from Reza and his CityAdmin.

Your response: Reza is not what we are discussing here. Concentrate on the topic. What do you want for it then?

NPC: Hehee. That is the beauty about it. I just want an Empty Datacube. Small and unimportant. Then I will tell you what I know. Don't keep me waiting too long.

NPC: Hurry and bring an Empty Datacube to me.

NPC: Do you have it?

Your response: Yes, take it and then tell me your story,

NPC: Datacubes are very fascinating. You can track them back to every individual owner, did you know that? Hehee. That was also an invention of the CityAdmin to keep a closer eye on their citizens.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But I shall tell you what information I gathered. There is supposed to be a meeting between Crahn and Twilight Guardian and I believe you should closely follow their movements.

Your response: Could that be a little bit more precise?

NPC: Alright, Runner. Visit Father Morpheus in the Crest Village. I have heard the meeting is about the exchange of information. Even if that is only partially true. Do you want to know what they really exchange?

Your response: Don't keep me in suspense, tell me.

NPC: Crahn is selling information about important CityAdmin employees. Guess what this information is used for...

Your response: The murder...

NPC: Not bad, a CityAdmin Runner with a brain and who can use it. Visit Father Morpheus. He will not be pleased to be visited by a CityAdmin but you might get some more information. And now get lost, it would not look good if I was seen talking to a CityAdmin.

NPC: Father Morpheus can be found in Crest Village. I don't have more to say, so bugger off!

NPC: I have no wish to speak to you.

NPC: Hrmph. What do you desire?

Your response: You are Father Morpheus, yes? I have a few questions.

NPC: Who are you to assault me with your questions?

Your response: I am from CityAdmin. That should be reason enough for you to answer my question.

NPC: You still have much to learn and I feel the chaos in your mind. The CityAdmin? A Runner of the CityAdmin would not visit a Father of the Crahn faction unless he hopes to gain something from that. Maybe I will have what you desire already here.

Your response: Very well. Is it true that Crahn has records about CityAdmin employees?

NPC: Everybody makes a mental note of somebody he met, why shouldn't we do that too? Yes, we have information about you. Crahn has given us the gift to catch the most secret thoughts out of the very heads of other people.

Your response: You are even admitting it! Isn't there anything left that hasn't got Crahn fingerprints all over it? Have you given this information to the Twilight Guardian?

NPC: What if I say yes? Will there be an uproar from the CityAdmin? Will they annihilate us and the Twilight Guardian? I don't think so. Maybe I could help you better if I better understood what precisely you want.

Your response: Don't play dumb with me! The two CityAdmin employees that were killed in cold blood are already known everywhere.

NPC: That proves nothing! It only proves that even CityAdmin employees are not invincible but mortal, like the rest of us. Was that everything? CityAdmin?

Your response: You don't seem to like the CityAdmin very  much.

NPC: I only see how Reza is ruining Neocron. Everything that was carefully created by us is systematically destroyed. Everything within Neocron is getting worse each day.

Your response: That is very arrogant and would cost your life within the boundaries of Neocron. You are lucky to be in the Wastelands. And after all it was you who destroyed everything! Your dictatorship almost ruined Neocron! It was our luck that Reza freed us of that cruel situation.

NPC: How naive. You really believe that Reza is your saviour? Back when the psi monk government was still operational everything was in order. It was only when Reza and his CityAdmin took over that everything started going downhill. The Outzone was the first to fall. At one time the Outzone was a striving and lively place full of busy people.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Today it is a monument to the unbelievable incapability of the government and therefore Reza himself.

Your response: Don't twist the facts! Who committed all these heineous experiments on humans?! Who held the citizens of Neocron under slave like conditions?! You! You bitching Crahn! Do you know what I think about your Crahn? I give a shit on Crahn! Without that asshole everything would be better!

NPC: ENOUGH! To insult Crahn can only be revenged with your blood!

NPC: I am busy at the moment.

NPC: I have already been informed that you would help us once more with the investigation. Welcome on board. Could you find anything useful through the contact you were given?

Your response: It was a dead end. The only thing I got is that Crahn is selling information about CityAdmin employees to Twilight Guardian.

NPC: They did what?

Your response: Yeah, they sold information about CityAdmin employees to the Guardians.

NPC: We knew that they have extensive information about us but we did not know that they are selling it . This alliance between Crahn and Twilight Guardian should have been taken more serious right from the beginning.

Your response: There is an alliance between those two? How can that be?

NPC: Yes, there is an alliance. It is fragile but is kept together through their common goal I assume. In this case it is to get rid of the current government. I only have to think about it and I get dizzy.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: At that time my parents have suffered strongly under the Crahn government. Another reason why I am working with the NCPD today. The reason why I would rather die before allowing Crahn to rule Neocron again.

Your response: But that is crazy, how would these two small groups ever be able to do that?

NPC: Compare them with a virus which infests a healthy human. The virus is small in relation to the human but it will still kill him good.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Like two different kind of virus that you battle with appropriate methods. Don't fool yourself, they are a danger for Neocron. But what am I talking, there is so much to do. Here are your 5000 credits. Keep in shape, I am sure we could use your service again.

NPC: Go away

entries.description: Quest-related dialogue from the game files.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Packet with Hacker List
• Synthetic Wine Plus

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Packet with Hacker List

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Yes, exactly, you have a keen mind. That is exactly what we need. Your assignment is to see a certain Elias, he can be found near the Tech Haven entrance in sector E 07. Ask him about possible connections between the Fallen Agnels and the stolen CopBot.

• I thought you wanted to investigate the case about the lost CopBot? You should visit Elias in sector E 07 and report any news to the NCPD.

• Yes, but there is also something that many people do not know. There is a certain number of CopBots that vanish from the streets of Neocron each year. There are even reports about Amok CopBots in the Wastelands. CopBots that run crazy.

• Very true. Especially because you are so unsophisticated. But maybe you can manage to track down a certain Cole. It is said he lives near the black market in the Outzone 01. I do not know if that is true but if you manage to find him I strongly advise you not to trust him too much.

• Ask somebody else about it, the Fallen Angels have got nothing to do with that. But maybe that Ethan Cole in Outzone 01

• That would be too easy now, wouldn't it? No, it is not quite that easy. Bring me about twenty bottles of this synthetic Wine Plus and then we will see. That kind of stuff is hard to come by here in the Outzone. And hurry.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: The NCPD still has its hands full closely investigating these murders. But there is still the safetey of Neocron that cannot be neglected.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: We decided to give an ambitious Runner a task that would suit him. I believe you already had the opportunity to have a closer look at the CopBots on the streets?

Your response: Yes, they are very impressive.

NPC: Yes, but there is also something that many people do not know. There is a certain number of CopBots that vanish from the streets of Neocron each year. There are even reports about Amok CopBots in the Wastelands. CopBots that run crazy.

Your response: Unthinkable! What ever would happen if a CopBot freaked out on the streets of Neocron?

NPC: Do not worry. The CopBot system is very effective in dealing with these issues. But there is also a different situation. Some CopBots are stolen before they are activated. That happens very rarely and usually it only takes hours to solve these crimes.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But... in this case it was only discovered that a CopBot was missing when it was supposed to be switched on. That happened about two month ago and there is not a single clue to its whereabouts.

Your response: How do you normally deal with these situations?

NPC: There is a small radio probe that is hidden inside the CopBot. It sends out a signal to the HQ as soon as the CopBot is activated. But this time it has not been activated or the radio probe was removed.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: If that is the case it must have been executed by some kind of hacking genius. Even our hackers can only do it with some special equipment.

Your response: Well, but where can you find such a hacker? ...maybe ...the Fallen Angels!!

NPC: Yes, exactly, you have a keen mind. That is exactly what we need. Your assignment is to see a certain Elias, he can be found near the Tech Haven entrance in sector E 07. Ask him about possible connections between the Fallen Agnels and the stolen CopBot.

Your response: Tell me more.

Your response: I am not yet ready for another task.

NPC: Once you are done give Officer Jenna a report of the situation. Thank you in advance from the CityAdmin.

NPC: Come back when you have prepared yourself.

NPC: I thought you wanted to investigate the case about the lost CopBot? You should visit Elias in sector E 07 and report any news to the NCPD.

NPC: I don't have time for something like that. I am very busy.

Your response: It won't take long. I was sent by the CityAdmin.

NPC: Then you are supposed to be the operative? Can't be that important if they just send a simple Runner.

Your response: You have been informed about the stolen CopBot I assume?

NPC: Yes, indeed. I was told how very important that is for the CityAdmin. Even if I do not fully understand it, one CopBot more or less doesn't cut the mustard.

Your response: That might be your opinion. Do the Fallen Angels have a CopBot from the CityAdmin in their possession?

NPC: Very amusing. I fear I have to disappoint you there, the Fallen Angels security turrets are far more effective and do not cost as much in production as your precious CopBots. CopBots are inferior in comparison to the security turrets. Why would they need a CopBot then?

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: I have also had a look at their registry and I can assure you that no Fallen Angel member is involved in anything that could be related to such a case.

Your response: It seems I stumbled into another dead end then.

NPC: Wait. I have said that no member would do something like that. But there are quite a few ex-members who are capable enough to do something like that.

Your response: That is much better! Then tell me please where I can find those ex-members...

NPC: That won't be easy. The Fallen Angels do not store the files of ex-members and therefore they will have no idea where they can be found. But it might be a good shot to have a look into the more dubious areas. They might have good contacts to the various underground movements.

Your response: That is easier said than done. It would take me years to find the right place and person to get the information I want.

NPC: Very true. Especially because you are so unsophisticated. But maybe you can manage to track down a certain Cole. It is said he lives near the black market in the Outzone 01. I do not know if that is true but if you manage to find him I strongly advise you not to trust him too much.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: That traitor did work for the Angels at one point. He nicked a lot of important data when he went. They are still trying to repair the damage he did.

Your response: Thank you, I will have a look at that area.

NPC: Be careful and remember that we are not involved in this in any way.

NPC: Ask somebody else about it, the Fallen Angels have got nothing to do with that. But maybe that Ethan Cole in Outzone 01

NPC: Get lost, Runner!

NPC: Hello, and who might you be? A curious Runner?

Your response: Ethan Cole? That's you, right?

NPC: That depends on who you are. I am very allergic to certain hostile people.

Your response: I can understand that. It's just the time we live in I suppose.

NPC: Well, tell your tale, what is it you want from me?

Your response: I was told that you know your way around the underground of Neocron.

NPC: With a little patience and of course the brain of a genius it is really very easy. So, yeah, I know my way around here.

Your response: I need a list of hackers who operate from the underground. They possibly are ex-Fallen Angels.

NPC: Ahh, yes, I rememember the name of the Fallen Angels from somewhere...

Your response: Save your breath, Cole! I exactly know about your history with the Fallen Angels.

NPC: Yes, really? Then I can drop my charade I suppose. It would probably suit you best if I could give you a list straightaway, wouldn't it?

Your response: Of course, that would be best...

NPC: That would be too easy now, wouldn't it? No, it is not quite that easy. Bring me about twenty bottles of this synthetic Wine Plus and then we will see. That kind of stuff is hard to come by here in the Outzone. And hurry.

NPC: I won't tell you anything without that wine that you promised me.

NPC: That's about time. Give it to me!

Your response: Here you are but don't forget about our deal...

NPC: Yes, yes, don't worry. Nice, that wine is exactly the taste I was expecting...

Your response: We had an agreement and I did my part...

NPC: I don't usually give a damn about agreements but since I am such a generous person I will still give you that list. Now go out of my sight!

NPC: I thought I told you that I don't want to be seen with you. Don't you have to report this to somebody in the NCPD?

NPC: No news? What a shame.

NPC: If this isn't our most ambitious freelancer. What news do you have for us?

Your response: I went to great length just to get some information about potential hackers. That was quite a chase.

NPC: Did it pay off at least?

Your response: I don't know. I've got a list with many names but I did not really want to do your job of checking that list. Go on and take it.

NPC: Yes, such a list would have been really helpful. It's a shame that you don't have one.

NPC: Let me have a look. Yes, some of those names sound familiar. But some of those certainly have nothing to do with hacking. That much is clear that it will take some time to work through all those names.

Your response: Did you get your hands on something useful in the meanwhile?

NPC: That depends... we could not follow up the murder cases but we have a statement from the Twilight Guardian where they take credit for the murders. But that does not help us much since CityAdmin is at war with the Twilight Guardian anyway. It is not your problem, however.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: First of all, here is your payment. 8000 credits. It will take some time until we have some news. Keep in shape because you can never know when we might need your help again. If you feel prepared you can ask one of the human resource directors now and then.

NPC: Go away

entries.title: Cityadmin 04
entries.description: Quest-related dialogue from the game files.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Important Datacube
• Snake Minion Teeth

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Important Datacube

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: A problem surfaced that is directly related to you, I fear. A datacube was found, a datacube with propagande material from the Twilight Guardian.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: That fact alone would not be very exceptional. But this datacube has been tracked back to you. You know what that means.

Your response: But that cannot be! I would never...

NPC: Calm down. I have not notified a CopBot yet, did I? But you will surely understand that something like that would result in the execution of the owner of that datacube?

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Propaganda like that is prohibited within Neocron.

Your response: Yes but somebody must have set me up! I have only given one person a datacube recently. He must be the one who did it!!

NPC: CityAdmin is fully aware of the fact that somebody could try and trick one of our employees. Standard procedure is to give the person in question a time limit to prove his innocence.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: I know that you have really had some accomplishments recently and that's why I am willing to give you some extra time. You should start to collect evidence right now because you don't have an eternity left.

Your response: But how? I don't even know where I could start!

NPC: You should start where you have lost that datacube or where you have given it away. Here is the datacube with the propaganda material.

Your response: It must have been that Hontoka guy in the Industrial district 02. I have given him a datacube.

NPC: It's up to you now. CityAdmin can't afford to follow up every case like this one. If you cannot prove your innocence you are guilty.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Go and get some hard evidence or suffer the consequences.

NPC: I fear you don't have enough time left for a break. But that is your choice.

NPC: Hey, I know you! I already wondered where you would end up.

Your response: I have one or two questions about the datacube I gave you.

NPC: A work of genius, isn't it? You will be hunted by CopBots very soon now and they will do the whole job. I don't even have to get involved myself that way.

Your response: That means you did it! Why are you trying to ruin me? What do you really want? I bet you are even involved with those murders.

NPC: I would not go that far. You just asked the wrong questions at the wrong time. That's all.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: I have done it as a favor for some friends of mine. It's all very simple don't you think?

Your response: You will pay for this! I will get my revenge.

NPC: Hahahaa. I would love to see that. Hunted by the CopBots and you are planning to fight the Tsunami? Very bold. Your only hope seems to be an old Runner at the Blakkmist Garbage dump in F_09.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Very amusing. But you won't get that far because I decided to do another favor for my friends. I will kill you and there won't be any problems any longer.

Your response: What does that mean? How is the Blakkmist Garbage Dump going to help me?

NPC: That is not of importance any longer. Die !

NPC: Are you still not dead?!

NPC: Not another one of those beggars. Get lost...leave me alone.

NPC: It is a rare occasion to be visited by a Runner from Neocron these times.

Your response: Please, it is important, I need your help.

NPC: Have you seen that?! That stupid, son of a bitch mosquito! Well, but there are even meaner mosquitos out there. Especially those giant ones that come from the swamps in the west.

Your response: Would you please listen to me?

NPC: I am listening! But it is always the same! If I get a visitor he will most certainly want something from me. Please, please, I need this or that... or something like, I really need your help or similar bull shit. I am sick of it.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: In any case, the life out here is not paradise. Some people think I am just waiting here to help them.

Your response: No, I did not want to appear like that. But you really are my only hope I have left, it seems.

NPC: I am not going to repeat myself! I am sick of it! Piss off...

Your response: Oh no, I am not going to be put off that easily. I am going to wait here. I am going to wait until you are going to help me.

NPC: Hrmph

Your response: I will wait.

NPC: Oh, all right you stupid city Runner! But if I am supposed to help you then you have to help me as well.

Your response: Of course, but how?

NPC: Well, I am experimenting with various drugs, after all the nights out here can get incredibly lonely. Just get the following two things for me. I am going to need them for these experiments.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: ... let's see, yes, Snake Minion Teeth, that sounds good. They can be found under some ruins in the desert. Ancient Yucida Village I think it was. And after that...

Your response: Just a moment! That already seems to be tough enough, don't you think?

NPC: Aww, what the heck... Then just get me two of those Minion Teeth. Not more not less! Then I will see what I can do for you. If you don't manage to get them on your own, try to get some friends to help you. Or somebody might sell them to you.

NPC: Where are my Snake Minion Teeth? You can find them in the ruins below the Ancient Yucida Village. If you don't manage to get them on your own, try to get some friends to help you. Or somebody might sell them to you.

NPC: You have returned. What a surprise...

Your response: What did you think? That you send me down into that snake pit and never see me again?

NPC: I can't say that thought never crossed my mind.

Your response: Alright, but now you have to help me...

NPC: Yes, that's the agreement. I will help you. Tell me your problem.

Your response: To make it short, I have a problem because the content of a specific datacube that was in my possession is illegal data. The problem is that I face execution although that data is not even mine...

NPC: Yeah, extracting data on the basis of its creation time isn't fashionable any longer. That means that your ID is still on the Datacube but it is not your data on the cube, right?

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: It'll be hard to prove your innocence with the datacube alone.

Your response: I need to prove that I did not copy that data onto the cube.

NPC: It's difficult but not impossible. I could try to extract the original ID of the person that copied the data onto the cube. But only if you really didn't do it.

Your response: I didn't, I just want to get back to normal again. What would I do with Twilight Guardian propaganda material anyway?

NPC: You sure? There are piles of propaganda cubes in circulation.

Your response: Yes, I am sure.

NPC: Unfortunately I need the datacube so that I can help you.

NPC: Alright, I believe I can extract the data in such a way that the creation time is displayed. Give the cube to me and wait here.

Your response: Here you are, please continue.

NPC: Just a moment. What? There is some hidden data on here. Now I have a copy of all the data that is saved on the cube. I will send the results to the authorities. It was Cityadmin, right?

Your response: Of course the CityAdmin...

NPC: Of course. I am sending the results to the Cityadmin. Since they will show that you cannot have created them in the first place it should prove your innocence. But wait until the files have been sent before you visit the CityAdmin. Good luck, Runner.

NPC: I have already done what you wanted me to do. Go now. You will have to talk to somebody in the CityAdmin HQ.

NPC: You dare to come back here? Did you forget that you are a criminal at the moment. Quick! Go and see that guy in Industrial 02 before somebody recognizes you.

NPC: I am glad that you found the way back. About half an hour ago we received proof of your innocence.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: That means that you are a free citizen again. The CopBots will not come after you.

Your response: I am glad that all this is over now.

NPC: I am sorry but it had to be. But we still want you as a freelance investigator of the murders. The investigation is still running, after all.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: We cannot give you a special assignment at the moment so you should really take a break and enjoy your newly found freedom.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: As a small compensation for all the trouble you will receive 10000 credits. You can use them whatever way you want. For a vacation for example.

NPC: Go away

entries.title: Cityadmin 05
entries.description: Quest-related dialogue from the game files.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Are you already following the hackers trail? You might want to visit that Cole in Outzone sector 01 again.

• The other one, Simmons, is a damned coward! As I remember it he lives in Pepper Park. He usually hangs out at the Red Pepper Bar in Pepper Park 02.

• Didn't you want to see the hackers? Grand and that Simmons guy in Pepper Park 02.

• It is your task to kill three Twilight Guardian Contact Persons in Pepper Park. No Runners.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: I have a confirmation from the NCPD now. There are only two possible target persons that could have been the mysterious hackers. They have been determined with the help of your list.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: I suggest, since you have organised the list in the first place that you will also help to track down the hacker.

Your response: Very well, what I started I am going to finish.

Your response: I fear I am not ready yet for such an endeavour.

NPC: Glad to hear that. CityAdmin depends on Runners with willpower like yours. You should talk with the contact person who gave you the list in the first place first. He might know even more about the individual persons since he compiled that list.

Your response: You mean this annoying Ethan Cole, am I right?

NPC: Possible. Remember that this hacker will most likely not have worked alone. And I also have some bad news, I fear.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Another murder was committed since the last time. The investigations are thoroughly stuck even though every new trail is closely examined.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Maybe you should concentrate on finding this hacker and the stolen CopBot first. So, don't worry too much about the murders at the moment.

Your response: That's fine with me. Consider it done.

NPC: Good luck.

NPC: Don't rest too long, though, unless another murder happens.

NPC: Are you already following the hackers trail? You might want to visit that Cole in Outzone sector 01 again.

NPC: Welcome again, CityAdmin. How can I be of service to you today?

Your response: How about dropping your sarcasm?

NPC: Yes, sir! Hey, what do you expect? I am living here like a dog between mutants and outlaws. Compared to those I am speaking with an angels tongue.

Your response: Can we skip to more important things? I need information again...

NPC: Why is it always the case that people can never seem to get enough? They always want more and more. What do you want this time?

Your response: I need more information about two of those persons on that list you gave me.

NPC: No problem! But first I need something for myself. As always. You can say what you want, but I am not selling myself below price.

Your response: What is it this time?

NPC: Simple. You are CityAdmin, right? I lost a small sum when I gambled three days ago. Since I could not pay my dept straightaway these bastards almost clubbed me to death.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: I have always been of the opinion to repay my depts on equal terms. For their stupidity they will pay dearly. But since I do not exactly know their names any longer their faction has to bleed for them. The Twilight Guardian.

Your response: I am supposed to kill for you?!

NPC: Yeah, you got a problem with that? Twilight Guardian are like rats. Once in a while you can step on a few of them. Best if you kill five of those bastards.

Your response: What?! So many!? I am really supposed to kill five Twilight Guardian? No, maybe three but not more. That is my last word.

NPC: Alright then, three it is. But no information before the job isn't done. Go and kill some of these bitches, take the time to find three of their Contact Persons... Now go.

Your response: Could you be a little bit more precise about who should be flatlined?

NPC: You have not yet killed three of them.

NPC: Brilliant. That suits those suckers well. Well done! I would not have thought that you are that good in flatlining. The two names you are looking for are Grand and Simmons. One of them is living just around the corner in this district.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: The other one, Simmons, is a damned coward! As I remember it he lives in Pepper Park. He usually hangs out at the Red Pepper Bar in Pepper Park 02.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Both are elite hackers as I remember it... I wish you a lot of fun, Runner.

NPC: Didn't you want to see the hackers? Grand and that Simmons guy in Pepper Park 02.

NPC: It is your task to kill three Twilight Guardian Contact Persons in Pepper Park. No Runners.

NPC: Get lost, no time, must hack!!

NPC: Are you shitting me? You just invited yourself or what?

Your response: I am coming from the CityAdmin...

NPC: Stupid Admin! Piss off or I'll...

NPC: I... I am eating at the moment, if it pleases you?!

NPC: He...Hello? W...what can I do for you?

Your response: Are you Mr Simmons?

NPC: Y...yes, that's m... me, why?

Your response: I am coming from the CityAdmin and it has taken me a long time to find you.

NPC: Heavens! What could you want from me? I... I don't possess anything of value.

Your response: I know from a reliable source that you are a hacker.

NPC: Me?... Me a hacker? I... what should I say? Possibly...

Your response: Then it was you who stole the CopBot and modified it! Admit it!

NPC: I knew it, I knew it, I admit it! But don't hurt me. I have modified the CopBot so that it kills all these CityAdmin employees.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: I have removed the radio probe and then I reprogrammed it with the help of a modified Law Enforcer. It runs completely autonomous now.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: It was all carefully planned by the Twilight Guardian! They forced me to participate. I could not resist! Please believe me!

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: They wanted to slowly wear down the CityAdmin through constant murders. They wanted to corner the CityAdmin that way.

Your response: You have just made a confession that would suffice to guarantee your total annihilation. I am certain of that. You surely know what awaits you, don't you?

NPC: No, please! I will do everything, just... just don't kill me! I don't have a Genrep clone! ... I know! Here! I'll give you 10000 credits, ok?

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: And... and I can modify you a Law Enforcer so that it has the features of an implant that improves your skills. Alright? Please have mercy with me, don't tell the NCPD.

Your response: You really seem to be a poor loser, if you really were forced to do it.

NPC: Please, I will do everything, really everything...

Your response: Alright but I will still need your help to find that stolen CopBot.

NPC: Yes, I can do that, no problem! I can localize the position of the CopBot. Once you are done with it, I will modify that Law Enforcer for you.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But I will still need some time to determine its exact location.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: As I said, it works totally autonomous and the calculation of his position will be difficult. Please be patient.

Your response: Very well. I will grant you a few days. By then you should have localized its exact position. But before I visit you again I will probably visit a Human Resource Director first.

NPC: I will do my very best. Thank you very much.

NPC: Go away

• You can find him in F 03 in the Wastelands. It is some kind of swamp land. The program probably chose it for the CopBot to remain undetetected. That was programmed into his main memory

• Amazing... wait ... I have a satellite picture here from the F 03 sector. You are right, the CopBot is there. Did you disable it? It looks rather destroyed.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Those investigations seem to take longer than you originally planned, don't they? At least there are no new murders to report at the moment. Keep on top of it, though.

Your response: Don't worry, I will determine the exact position of the stolen CopBot.

NPC: Does that mean you have a clue?

Your response: I think I have. I still need to visit a ... ahem ... contact person who will reveal the exact location to me.

NPC: Good luck.

NPC: I thought you have a clue that you can follow up. You should visit Jenna at the NCPD once you have more information.

NPC: H...Hello, I have located the CopBot like you said.

Your response: What are you waiting for? Tell me where it is.

NPC: You can find him in F 03 in the Wastelands. It is some kind of swamp land. The program probably chose it for the CopBot to remain undetetected. That was programmed into his main memory

Your response: Good, I will take care of that.

NPC: Good luck... I'll wait here... to enhance the Law Enforcer... when you come back.

NPC: But, where did you leave the Law Enforcer of the CopBot?

NPC: That was really fast! Do you have the Law Enforcer?

Your response: Yes, but I prefer to keep it as proof for the whole incident.

NPC: Please, give it back to me. It is important for me.

Your response: I don't understand why this implant is so important to you.

NPC: Very well, keep this cursed thing. But I beg you, don't give me away to the NCPD. They'll surely kill me for this.

Your response: I need to tell them at least who committed the murders.

NPC: But that wasn't me. That means you don't need to tell them about me. Please do me this last favor.

Your response: I will think about it, Goodbye.

NPC: Good luck then.

NPC: Do you still want something? But I already have given you everything.

NPC: I am sorry but I don't have time at the moment. Work is not getting less.

NPC: Did you already find out anything new?

Your response: Let me put it this way, I solved the murders and also the stolen CopBot case. The murders will stop.

NPC: You have solved the murders? No, I can't believe you, you must be joking!

Your response: Yes, if I tell you. The stolen CopBot was reprogrammed to kill all these people.

NPC: Really? That would at least explain, why we could not find any suspect.

Your response: Yes and it all happened according to the plans of the Twilight Guardian. You have guessed as much and now I have proof. This modified Law Enforcer.

NPC: Without proof this story sounds a little bit too fantastic, don't you think?

NPC: But what did they hope to achieve through those murders? And where is the CopBot now?

Your response: The Twilight Guardian wanted to slowly wear down the CityAdmin with all these murders and they came close to reaching that goal. The CopBot can be found in the swamps in sector F 03.

NPC: Amazing... wait ... I have a satellite picture here from the F 03 sector. You are right, the CopBot is there. Did you disable it? It looks rather destroyed.

Your response: Yes, I wanted to ensure that it is the right one. I would not want to report wrong facts.

NPC: Then you have really earned the reward for this. NCPD and CityAdmin awarded 50000 credits for the person who could solve this crime. Now this money belongs to you.

Your response: Thank you, it was a pleasure.

NPC: You can really take some time off now and maybe you should found a new clan and support the CityAdmin with it.

Your response: I will think about it... Oh yes, before I forget. The hacker who did all this is visiting Roccos Seafood in Pepper Park rather often, his name is Simmons. It's your decision what to do with him. After all he committed these crimes.

Your response: Then I wish you goodbye.

NPC: Good luck with your future. For the arrest of the hacker you have earned another reward of 30000 credits. Since you have accomplished much for the CityAdmin it was decided to give you this PowerArmor. It was developed by using CopBot technology and is only awarded to truly loyal citizens. But if you were them we expect you to behave accordingly and carry on your duties.

NPC: Good luck with your future career, Since you have accomplished much for the CityAdmin it was decided to give you this PowerArmor. It was developed by using CopBot technology and is only awarded to truly loyal citizens. But if you were them we expect you to behave accordingly and carry on your duties.

NPC: Go away
