entries.title: Citymerc 01
entries.description: Quest-related dialogue from the game files.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Medicine Package

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• A&W Street Model Gun
• Powerbooze Gold

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Alright. Lets take it one little baby step at a time. Have a look around and think about it. Think about yourself and whether or not you want to spend your future with us. Oh, before I forget. You could do me a favor and deliver this package of medicine to the platoon leader Marcel. His guys have been wounded in their last mission. You can find him in sector 3 of the Military Base. Try one of the various storage halls. Don't ask me why but he seems to like it down there.

• Did you already deliver the medicine to Marcel in sector 3 of the Military Base?

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Welcome here with the CityMercs. I hope you have thrown all your memories of your old life overboard because with the CityMercs you start from scratch. You will only meet people here who would sell their soul for what they do here. Old Cajun would reinforce that if he had enough time to welcome every new recruit. He is the leader here but everybody just calls him the Eye.

Your response: Understood. When do I start?

Your response: I don't feel prepared for such a big decision yet.

NPC: Don't be so hasty. There will still be some time until you may wear a red ribbon. We will see if you are suitable at all for us. Nowadays we almost only ever get recruits from the city. Slackers mostly. Usually they quit already after the first week.

Your response: Is life with the Mercs really that hard?

NPC: Don't worry, once you passed the first few weeks it will get much easier for you. And who knows, maybe you might live to wear one of the Black Ribbons.

Your response: Sorry, but that does not sound very reassuring.

NPC: Alright. Lets take it one little baby step at a time. Have a look around and think about it. Think about yourself and whether or not you want to spend your future with us. Oh, before I forget. You could do me a favor and deliver this package of medicine to the platoon leader Marcel. His guys have been wounded in their last mission. You can find him in sector 3 of the Military Base. Try one of the various storage halls. Don't ask me why but he seems to like it down there.

Your response: Very well, if I have to. What if I made up my mind?

NPC: You can tell me about your decision once you finished the delivery. You can also ask any Recruitment Officer for news and missions. News cannot be kept secret here anyway, if you know what I mean.

NPC: It's your decision. Come back once you really mean it.

NPC: Hey, what are you doing down here? You better take care not to get lost. Could well be that something might happen to you down here.

Your response: What is that supposed to mean? Do you want to threaten me?

NPC: Why do you always assume the worst? No, I am not threatening you, but you could stumble upon a few creatures that can give you a lot of trouble. Nevertheless, I have never seen you here before.

Your response: That doesn't come as a surprise for since I am rather new here. I have a medicine delivery for the wounded in your Platoon.

NPC: That really was about time. I mean they are not badly injured but they want to be in top shape when they get their Red Ribbon.

Your response: What is this Red Ribbon you are talking about?

NPC: Ha, you really seem to very new here. The Red Ribbon is some kind of award that is only given if you were wounded in battle. Only if you have such a Red Ribbon you may choose yourself a unique call sign that belongs to you only.

Your response: Could I get one of those as well?

NPC: No. Not yet, at least. You will still have the Rookie test before you and you need to have the White Ribbon before you get the red one.

Your response: I would like to know more about it.

NPC: Please ask somebody else, alright? I don't feel like telling you everything the CityMercs stand for. Especially now that Cajun decided NOT to attack the Fallen Angels. I don't want to waste my time on something like this. This will all take a turn for the worse. You will see it.

Your response: Why attack the Fallen Angels? But why?

NPC: Because they have opposed Tangent and Tangent pays us for this job. But Cajun, the Eye, seems to have a soft spot for those Fallen Angels. It's about high time that something changes. Now, get this medicine to Eljena. She is bound to be around here somewhere in this area. Go quickly.

NPC: If you really want to be a CityMerc mercenary then you have to show a little bit more discipline. My platoon can be found right here in this area.

NPC: I can barely wait to finally get the Red Ribbon. But what are you looking for?

NPC: Come, here is something to drink. We have reason to celebrate.

Your response: Ahem, I am supposed to get some medicine to you.

NPC: Where is the medicine?

NPC: Very good, now I am confident that I will be fine when I receive the Red Ribbon. Marcel will be proud of us.

Your response: Is Marcel a good leader?

NPC: Yes, indeed he is. He is always concentrated and never looses sight of his target. On the other hand he is rather cold and uncaring. But I guess you have to be like that in such a position. Maybe it is connected to what happened a few months ago.

Your response: A few months ago? What happened back then?

NPC: Somehow Marcel managed to really anger Cajun. I have heard that he disobeyed a direct order. For that he was thrown into the hole. He was supposed to apologize after three days but once he was released from the prison he did not apologize to Cajun. He was barely able to stand upright because the hole is very small and doesn't give you much opportunities to move. Cajun was outraged and ordered him to be imprisoned for three additional days.

Your response: Six days? That is rather harsh.

NPC: That is exactly what some of us thought. Many did pity him. Even the Eye soon regretted his initial anger. But even though he was only released after the full six days. Otherwise Cajun would have lost some reputation if he would have released him early. But Marcel did not need to apologize any longer. He did gain a lot of sympathy with the Mercs on that day. I have said enough, it is time for my medicine.I just hope these Nanobots go a little bit easier on me this time. You can report that you delivered the medicine.

NPC: Thank you again for the medicine.

NPC: Did you already deliver the medicine to Marcel in sector 3 of the Military Base?

NPC: Did you make a decision?

Your response: Yes, I want to join the CityMercs.

NPC: A wise decision. Be sure to prepare yourself as good as possible and give us a call once you are ready for the first test. Just go to one of our Recruitment Officers once you are ready. Then you only have to pass the Rookie test and you will be one of us. Here, you can use these credits for your training. (next mission at level 20)

entries.conversation:
NPC: This is no place for civilians.

Your response: I have decided to join the CityMercs. I have trained hard so that I can become a Rookie.

NPC: Really? Then I do hope that you know your way around weapons since there is no other way to become a Rookie than through weapons. I am sure you are already excited about this. Alright, I won't let you wait no longer.

Your response: Please carry on. I am ready.

Your response: I'd rather train a little more.

NPC: In order to become a Rookie you need to fight against three persons. It took some time but we have some suitable enemies for you. The first one is Frederick, another Rookie wannabe like you. Then there is Claudia and Erik, they already are with us. You just need to beat them in a fair fight and you will be a CityMerc Rookie. Come back to me once you have won the fight. They usually hang out in sector 3 of this base.

NPC: You should really think about what you want first.

NPC: You can find your opponents in sector 3 of the Military Base. Come back to me after you have defeated them all.

NPC: Hello. Are you here for the Rookie test? I already had to wait two days for a chance to fight and prove myself.

Your response: Why do you want to join the CityMercs?

NPC: Not again. I lost again. Now I'll have to wait two more days before I can try again. This sucks.

NPC: Well, my father happens to be a Black Ribbon here with the Mercs and he wants me to achieve the same. I have already tried this test three times and always I failed. But enough of this, are you ready?

NPC: If you are ready for the fight. I am right here. Just attack me.

NPC: Hey, Runner, good luck because against me you can use it. I can still recall my Rookie test and that one was not easy, I tell you.

Your response: Who are you?

NPC: I can't believe you beat me. Still, good luck to you.

NPC: What a stupid question. I am Claudia and at least I am already a Rookie. Now, lets get this behind us, shall we?

NPC: You should make a decision.

NPC: I'll give you some free advice. Claudia is a tough one. Not easy to beat. Yes, yes, I know she is just a woman but don't be fooled by appearances here. Tank women are equally strong as Tank men. Take care. I mean, not that I would make it easy on you.

NPC: Well, the fact that you won just shows that I need more training.

NPC: What are you waiting for? Bring it on.

NPC: You have to pass the Rookie test in order to achieve anything with the Mercs. You can find your opponents in sector 3 of the Military Base. Come back to me after you have defeated them.

NPC: You have to pass the Rookie test in order to achieve anything with the Mercs. You can find your opponents in sector 3 of the Military Base. Come back to me after you have defeated them.

NPC: You have to pass the Rookie test in order to achieve anything with the Mercs. You can find your opponents in sector 3 of the Military Base. Come back to me after you have defeated them.

NPC: You did it, eh? How do you feel? Your wounds will heal soon and then you can enjoy being one of us.

Your response: I feel honoured. What is my job then? Do I get to fight soon?

NPC: Ha, you'll have to wait some time for that yet. We always take good care of our new entries and before you carry a White Ribbon you will at best observe some combat. For the moment you should celebrate. The platoon leader Marcel would also like to congratulate you personally. You can find him in sector 3 of the Military Base. Good luck for the future.

NPC: Marcel in the Military Base sector 3 would like to congratulate you. He is a well known platoon leader and has got a lot of influence here with the Mercs.

NPC: I am sure you will soon be a CityMerc judging from your looks. But you still have to pass the Rookie test.

NPC: I am sure you will soon be a CityMerc judging from your looks. But you still have to pass the Rookie test.

NPC: I am sure you will soon be a CityMerc judging from your looks. But you still have to pass the Rookie test.

NPC: Erik told me how you managed your fight. You did it and now you are one of us. But don't assume you can take on the whole world now. There is still much to learn. Don't let yourself be discouraged, though, I would enjoy seeing you in my platoon once you are ready.

Your response: I was told I need to get a White Ribbon first.

NPC: Yes, that is true. There, my platoon bought a few bottles of wine for you to celebrate. Take it as a gift. Now just take care not to dishonour us, train hard and I am sure there will be more to do for you very soon. Here is your first payment, use it as you see fit. 4000 credits. (next mission at level 30)

entries.conversation:
NPC: Ahh, a brand new Rookie. There is a job for you and I don't accept no as an answer. You know what comes now?

Your response: I assume I will get my White Ribbon now?

NPC: You really think it's that easy? Let me tell you something. To receive a White Ribbon is an honour. As Rookie you do already belong to the CityMercs but with a White Ribbon you will truly belong to the family. It should really be worth something for you.

Your response: I will see what I can do. Where can I start?

Your response: I'd rather train some more. I don't feel properly prepared for the next step.

NPC: Very good. You better look for Mitchell first, he can be found just outside the Military Base in the Wastelands. His job is to observe the movements of Warbots and their likes and to warn us if there is any danger. Basically he is already a Black Ribbon but he seems to be more comfortable out there in the Wastelands.

Your response: I thought there were three missions where I am supposed to observe. What about the other ones?

NPC: I am sorry but i only have this one. But I can ask Marcel to organise something. It seems to me as if he really keeps an eye on you. He surely knows some other possibilities. Still, visit Mitchell first since I have already informed him about your visit.

NPC: You can find Mitchell outside the Military Base. Afterwards Marcel in sector 3 of the Military Base might have more for you.

NPC: Nice, I assume you'll get back to me once you feel up to the challenge.

NPC: Finally. I was already expecting your visit. Alright now, listen, I will tell you about my job out here and in return you can do me a little favor. Does that sound fair?

Your response: Just a moment, wasn't I supposed to be an observer only?

NPC: Don't give me that kind of bullshit. I have been with the Mercs for so long and trust me I know my way around here. If I just as much as  raise my voice you will never get that White Ribbon you are after. Understood?

Your response: Understood. Very well, I am here to learn anyway, right?

NPC: Exactly. Now listen. Out here it's always fifty fifty. Just one wrong step and you can find yourself splattered all over the landscape. You got to differentiate between those dangers that kill you outright and those that only injure you.

Your response: How can I do that?

NPC: Let me explain. If you ever see something hovering in the air above you I would start to run because you don't really want to know how a Hoverbomber deals with the likes of us. Also take care not to run into big robots like the Warbots since they carry long range weaponry that can blast you to pieces. Even some big animals can be very dangerous.

Your response: I had no idea that it is that dangerous.

NPC: Unfortunately that is just the beginnning. But I have told you enough for this time. Now I would like you to do me a little favor. It's only a small one. Look, I've got a daughter who lives inside Neocron, you know, that big city with these tall towers and buildings. I haven't seen her in ages and that is why you will meet her and give her my regards. Tell her that I still live and care for her, ok?

Your response: In Neocron?!! You know that it is on the other side of the Wastelands?

NPC: Yes, of course, it's only a stone's throw away from here. If you want you could go to Marcel first and get your next assignment. If you are lucky it will take you straight to Neocron and you might as well meet my daughter then. But you better behave yourself, she's got an honourable job with the CityAdmin. She lives somewhere in Pepper Park and likes to call herself Rose.

NPC: I was informed that Mitchell expects your visit first.

NPC: Strange person, that Mitchell, don't you agree? I almost think that the radiation in the Wastelands must have burned his brain. You still need some observation missions, right?

Your response: I want to finally earn myself the White Ribbon.

NPC: Your dedication is admirable. Now, you know that the CityMercs are neutral. They always have been. We are hired to solve problems that people cannot solve alone. Because of that and because we always take pride in our pofessionality we have many friends. Many of them come from Neocron and I am talking mainly about the companies since they can afford our services. Does that sound clear?

Your response: That is basic knowledge, of course I know about that.

NPC: Good, but it still is important to remember. The only ones we don't have good connections to are the Black Dragon and the Twilight Guardian. It's a long story and I will spare you the details. Oh, and the Anarchy Breed are our enemies as well of course. Almost everyone is their enemy.

Your response: How do you keep contact to the various Neocron factions?

NPC: We have all modern means of communication. For example our high tech intelligence center in our HQ. The HQ is in the Military Base Sec-2. Gerard works there, but he also likes to hang out at the Black Ribbon Bar in the HQ. After you visited him you can return for your last observation mission.

NPC: Don't waste my time.

NPC: Nice to see somebody coming to the Military Base. Tell me, what takes you all the way down here?

Your response: Marcel sends me. I want to earn my White Ribbon and I am supposed to observe what you are doing here.

NPC: That's fine with me but at the moment there is not much to do. Do you know any news? Are we attacking the FallenAngels now or not? There was quite some fuss about that issue the last time I was at the Military Base.

Your response: What do you mean?

NPC: Well, you know, ever since the Fallen Angels attackes Tangent with their hackers we are supposed to attack the Fallen Angels.

Your response: Yes, I have heard about that. There is still trouble because of that. Cajun himself decided not to attack the Fallen Angels.

NPC: Everything is settled then? The Eye will know what is best for us.

Your response: But there are still many who would rather support Marcel. Marcel is the opinion that we should attack the Fallen Angels.

NPC: But that would mean that there are two different opinions. I hope they will sort this out soon. I don't like the idea of returning to the Military Base just to stumble into a war between brothers.

Your response: At the moment everything is still calm. What about it? I was supposed to observe what you are doing here.

NPC: Hmm, right. I am responsible to serve as go-between for those that would like to contact the CityMercs and to take care of local problems. There really is not more to my job. It only ever gets exciting around here if the Black Dragon and the Tsunami wage their personal street wars. Thats about all there is.

Your response: Thank you. One more question, do you know where I could find a certain Rose?

NPC: Rose? Yes, but what is your business with her?

Your response: Mitchell is her father and he asked me to visit her. She is supposed to visit at the CityAdmin and she lives somewhere here in the Pepper Park.

NPC: Ha, that is a good one. No my friend, she can be seen around the Black Dragon HQ, also she isn't a Black Dragon. I have no idea what she does there but she certainly does not work for the CityAdmin. I could have a talk with her if you want.

Your response: That would be good because I need the approval from her father to receive a White Ribbon.

NPC: Alright, there isn't much to do at the moment anyway. Come back later, I will have a talk with her in the meanwhile.

NPC: I am sorry but I did not yet have the opportunity to speak to her. Give me a little bit more time.

NPC: I was able to speak to her. She asked me to forward this package to her father. Her father is not supposed to know that she works as a dancer now.

NPC: It would be best if you went back to talk to Mitchell and Marcel.

NPC: Visit Gerard at the Black Ribbon Bar in the HQ.

NPC: Ok, I've got a confirmation from Gerard. Now you have already finished two observation missions. For the last one I've got something special. Gerome and his partner established an encampment near one of the entrances to Tech Haven, in G 07 to be precise. I have ordered them to hold that position until we have an opportunity to attack the FallenAngels.

Your response: Just a moment, I thought the eye doesn't want us to attack them.

NPC: The eye is old and not as sharp as he used to be. He forgot where we have our strength. I have almost as many followers as he has. Why should I care what he does? I am not the one who plans to break with tradition. Now be on your way.

NPC: Did you see my daughter? Have you already heard something about Rose yet?

NPC: Ahh, you have returned. How is my daughter? Thank you for the package.

Your response: I don't think she is in a good position. She does not work with the CityAdmin any longer. She can be seen around dubious company. To be honest, I think she has a job as a dancer now.

NPC: What? If that is a lie, I promise that I will...

Your response: I assure you Sir, it is the truth.

NPC: All that time she doesn't say a single word. It is about high time that I have a serious discussion with her. Get lost, I need to think, I need some time... alone. Come back later.

NPC: Thank you that you told me about it. Here take these credits for your trouble.

NPC: I will vote for you, that much is certain.

NPC: Soldier, this is a dangerous area. I suggest you leave.

NPC: Soldier, where is your White Ribbon?

Your response: I don't yet have one but I hope to once I completed this assignment.

NPC: I need reinforcements and they send me a Rookie. A useless Rookie.

Your response: I did not choose to be an observer, I would gladly help you right now.

NPC: No, that is unacceptable. I am sorry, I did not want to get excited. Those Warbots and all those critters out here are almost too much for only the two of us. And still no sign of a Fallen Angel, the only persons we ever see are a rare few Runner.

Your response: What could I do out here as an observer?

NPC: To be honest, there is nothing you can do out here. I don't question the orders from Marcel but your appearance here is not necessary. I will give you my vote nontheless. It's already a good sign that you made it alive through the Wastelands. I hope to see you again, and next time you will have your White Ribbon. Go and see Marcel now for further instructions.

NPC: I would like to have some holidays now. You know, the Pepper Park offers a few nice options to spend quality time. Ah what am I talking about? The only thing out here are mutants and dust. Be sure to tell the HQ to send somebody as replacement to us.

NPC: Gerome can be found near one of the entrances to Tech Haven in G07. Visit me again after you visited him.

NPC: Congratulations. You have really earned the White Ribbon. You have completed three observational missions. I hope you can appreciate the honour connected to a White Ribbon. Now you represent the future of the CityMercs. We stand and fall with the Fallen Angels. Every time I award a White Ribbon I have to think about a very brave White Ribbon named Arthur. It is a tradition to tell his story. Do you want to hear it?

Your response: Of course Sir

NPC: Arthur was a very frail Rookie when he started with us. But only within a few months he could match every other CityMerc. He did not draw much attention to himself, though. His time came once he received the White Ribbon. Together with a few other Mercs he guarded a convoy of machinery parts. I don't remember for which client that was. One night they camped sheltered by a mountain cliff since it already rained all day. They did not cover much ground on that day.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Suddenly a grenade exploded in the middle of the camp and injured all three out of four Mercs. Only Arthur did not incur any injury. It was an attack by the Anarchy Breed and there were only two choices for Arthur now. He could've fled but instead he decided to stay and gain a little time for his friends so that they could flee. He took on a dozen Anarchy Breed in order to save his comrades.

Your response: Did he survive?

NPC: He went down in the firefight but his friends lived on to tell his tale. That, my friend was a true White Ribbon. That is what all this is about so take care not to bring shame onto it. Train hard since now the dangerous work begins for you. Talk to one of the Recruitment Officers as soon as you are ready. (next mission at level 35)

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Important Info-Datacube

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• I think there is. Marcel has organised something. Tangent is the client as I am lead to believe. You should find Gerome at the entrance to the Fallen Angel Tech Haven. He should be able to tell you more about it. I will contact the Black Ribbons and tell them that you are on that case.

• If you want this assignment then you better take care of it. Gerome can be found in front of one of the entrances to Tech Haven. G 07 to be precise.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: I see, you have already achieved the rank of a White Ribbon. But I have already heard voices that say Marcel just made it too easy for you. I will not judge on this, though.

Your response: I feel prepared for a little action. Is there something for me to do?

Your response: I am sorry but I still have important tasks to do.

NPC: I think there is. Marcel has organised something. Tangent is the client as I am lead to believe. You should find Gerome at the entrance to the Fallen Angel Tech Haven. He should be able to tell you more about it. I will contact the Black Ribbons and tell them that you are on that case.

NPC: If you want this assignment then you better take care of it. Gerome can be found in front of one of the entrances to Tech Haven. G 07 to be precise.

NPC: It is your decision but since you are a CityMerc you also have a certain responsibility.

NPC: Ahh, I remember you. And this time you finally have the White Ribbon. You already know what this operation is about?

Your response: A contract with Tangent as far as I know. That's all I know.

NPC: That is true so far. We were already able to locate the target. Nicolas fled to the Tawkeen Village in C_06. Of course that won't help him much. The assignment is to confront him with force. Weapon use is recommended since the target is assumed to be armed and very dangerous. He carries a Datacube that you are to bring to Marcel, understood?

Your response: Yes. Do I get any backup?

NPC: Backup? It is only one target! How much support did you think about? A whole platoon maybe? Hello! We are in no position to send that many Mercs after just one target. Well, of course you can feel free to get some help. You should be aware however that you inflict most of the damage. That way you can ensure that the Datacube the target carries will not be damaged in the process. Good luck.

NPC: Do you know why everybody likes to hire the CityMercs? Because we are precise and professional. Now go and do your job. After you retrieved the datacube from in C_06, bring it to Marcel in the Military Base.

NPC: Beat it, I cannot risk to be found here.

NPC: I am busy, don't you have something else to do?

NPC: I am busy, don't you have something else to do?

NPC: Did you enjoy your first mission as a White Ribbon? Gerome informed me that he assigned you to this assignment.

Your response: I want an explanation right now. The datacube states that it belonged to a Fallen Angel. I attacked a Fallen Angel.

NPC: Yes? What about it?

Your response: The Eye does not want us to attack them.

NPC: Ok, listen. There are two possibilities here. There is Cajun and there is me. If you are not content with how I deal with things you can join Cajun any time. Don't speak about this again in my vicinity. Understood?

Your response: Sir, yes Sir!

NPC: It would be a shame to see such a talented White Ribbon go to waste just because he decided to join the wrong side. Apart from that you should better prepare yourself for the next mission. It will certainly not get easier. But I have also some good news for you. Since you have been wounded in a mission you qualify for the Red Ribbon. The next time you will already belong to the big boys. (next mission at level 40)

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Powerbooze Gold

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• It seems you have made your homework. Basically yes, but we will only a send single soldier each and hit them where it hurts. Your task will be to kill one Twilight Guardian Contact Person in Pepper Parks 3 and one Black Dragon Contact by their secret faction office in Pepper Park. That would give us enought time to plan a proper counter attack and should increase the time they need to react upon us.

• Don't forget, one one Twilight Guardian Contact Person in Pepper Parks 3 and one Black Dragon Contact by their secret faction office in Pepper Park. After that you should speak with Marcel.

• I thought you were supposed to kill one Twilight Guardian Contact Person in Pepper Parks 3 and one Black Dragon Contact by their secret faction office in Pepper Park. Come back once the task is accomplished.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: This time it is for real, soldier. It seems as if all our old enemies have left their hiding holes only to give us some trouble. Of course this is unacceptable, something needs to be done.

Your response: Whoever threatens us should better prepare for retaliation. You can count on me.

Your response: I have something important to do first.

NPC: Very good, good to hear. The problem is that they utilize some kind of Guerrilla tactics. Every time we concentrate our forces to give them a devastating blow their troops just melt away. That is why we will beat them with their own tactics, even if they might expect that.

Your response: That means small platoons attack their sensitive spots.

NPC: It seems you have made your homework. Basically yes, but we will only a send single soldier each and hit them where it hurts. Your task will be to kill one Twilight Guardian Contact Person in Pepper Parks 3 and one Black Dragon Contact by their secret faction office in Pepper Park. That would give us enought time to plan a proper counter attack and should increase the time they need to react upon us.

Your response: Consider it done. Something else I should keep in mind?

NPC: Nothing special, just try to stay away from weak targets as runners or such. Hit them where it hurts. Once you have done that Marcel wanted to see you personally.

NPC: If it is really necessary. But be quick about it, our enemies will not rest just because of us.

NPC: Don't forget, one one Twilight Guardian Contact Person in Pepper Parks 3 and one Black Dragon Contact by their secret faction office in Pepper Park. After that you should speak with Marcel.

NPC: I thought you were supposed to kill one Twilight Guardian Contact Person in Pepper Parks 3 and one Black Dragon Contact by their secret faction office in Pepper Park. Come back once the task is accomplished.

NPC: I thought you were supposed to kill one Twilight Guardian Contact Person in Pepper Parks 3 and one Black Dragon Contact by their secret faction office in Pepper Park. Come back once the task is accomplished.

NPC: You are already being celebrated as the Red Ribbon who received his rank faster than anybody before and I admit that you deserve it. That is exactly the kind of soldier that we need for the future. There will be great changes in the future. But enough of this, hereby I award the Red Ribbon to you. It stands for the courage and the dedication that you have displayed.

Your response: Thank you, I will try to honour it. But what did you mean with great changes?

NPC: Since you have been somewhat busy lately you might have missed the changes that have happened. Congratulations, you have really put quite a scare into the enemy ranks, together with our other brave comrades. In the meanwhile we have not been idle either. Everything is changing. I have now many CityMercs supporting me. I believe the Eye will have to give way for somebody else soon.

Your response: You aren't planning to fight Cajun, are you?

NPC: Only if it is really necessary. I am a CityMerc with dedication and I will try everything to preserve the Mercs as they have always been. But it will take some more time until we can raise our voices. Take a rest. I am counting on you for the next time.(next mission at level 45)

entries.title: Citymerc 06
entries.description: Quest-related dialogue from the game files.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Tangent Speed Gun

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• We really need you to challenge Marcel in sector 3 of the Military Base to a duel. Otherwise the Base will never come back to normal.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Glad to have you back. Marcel seems out of his mind. He wants to revolt against the Eye only because the Eye decided not to attack the Fallen Angels. He wants to split up the Mercs but he doesn't see that this might well be then end for all of us.

Your response: Yes, I have heard about that.

NPC: You could help us. We are supporting Cajun. Help us to clear up this mess. It is widely known that Marcel has closely followed your career. He trusts you to a certain degree but nobody else would even get close to him.

Your response: What do you expect from me?

Your response: I cannot change it now, sorry.

NPC: It sounds tough but you are supposed to challenge him to a duel. It is a tradition that he cannot possibly refuse. The winner can take over as the leader of the platoon after that. Eljena, a Red Ribbon of Marcels platoon agreed to help us. She has some important additional information for you. If you succeed come back here and I tell you how it continues. Good luck, if you should fail it could have tragical consequences.

NPC: This is not the right time to turn your back on us. Think again.

NPC: Hello, you must be here to listen to what I have to say against Marcel, right?

Your response: Yes, you wanted to give me important information. What is it?

NPC: I wish I could just hate Marcel, everything would be easier then. But I cannot. He is an earnest and courageous soldier. He just chooses the way that appears to be best for him. But I cannot allow him to guide the CityMercs into their doom. Yes, I've got something that I wanted to give to you.

Your response: Give to me? You have some sort of item for me?

NPC: There was a secret delivery from Tangent. It was only one package but I believe it was meant for Marcel. As I risked a peek I could see a weapon in it. I did not know that kind of model and I do not know if it is effective or not. Still, I will hand it over to Cajuns supporter once you win the duel. Then they can personally hand the weapon over to you.

Your response: Why don't you give it to me right now? I could certainly use it against Marcel.

NPC: No chance. Marcel deserves a fair fight. Marcel himself rejected the weapon since he did not want to use a superior weapon than his platoon. He did not want to put himself above us. Good luck. In secret I wish Marcel would just join Cajun again.

NPC: I don't have more to say. I will hand over the weapon to the Mercs that support the Eye. Don't ask me to wish you any more luck. I don't know. I really don't know what the best course of action would be. Maybe Marcel would like to talk to you after the fight one more time.

NPC: I am currently planning something big. Visit me later and you will have all my attention.

NPC: The face of the CityMercs as we know it will never be the same again. Let me guess, you are here because you want to join us.

Your response: I don't think so. I am challenging you to a duel.

NPC: I already thought something like that. Even though I have opened all doors for you. Even though I have practically led you by the hand you are now fighting me. Somehow that is sad. Don't you see that I am just trying to create something better?

Your response: I just see what you do wrong. This is no way that leads to improvements, this way leads to death.

NPC: If that is what you think you are already a of the Eye. There is no point in continuing our conversation. I will fight you but I don't like it. I have put great expectations in you. If you win, I want to tell you one last thing afterwards.

Your response: Let's fight, Marcel! No more talking!

NPC: As you wish!

NPC: Don't try to deceive me. The fight is over when one of us is down in the dirt.

NPC: Well, you have won the duel. I would ask you to take my place but I realize that that was never your plan. I know that much now. But traditions are holy to me and you have beaten me with honour to tradition. I surrender. I will not pursue my goals any longer and I will accept Cajun as leader once more. I will not, however, explain why I did what I did. But if you want to know more then you can visit Gerome and ask him why I did all this.

NPC: Leave me be. I am certain I will survive.

NPC: I am busy. Sorry about that.

NPC: Tell me then? Why are you here? You have no reason? Well, I don't have any time to waste on you.

NPC: That was a good piece of work back then with the Fallen Angels.

Your response: That's not why I am here. I have won a duel against Marcel and he is abandoning his plans now.

NPC: You defeated Marcel? I cannot believe it. He was right all along.

Your response: What do you mean he was right?

NPC: Didn't it appear strange to you that you got to the Red Ribbon so fast? Didn't you notice that Marcel helped you all the way? That he supported you wherever it was possible?

Your response: I... No, I did not know that. Why should he do something like that?

NPC: Marcel is a CityMerc from head to toe. But he saw that the CityMercs became weak. The strength they got from the community ran dry. Every platoon fought for itself. It was all about the single platoons. Marcel thought about a courageous plan, he devised a way to bring the Mercs back together.

Your response: What? He wanted to bring them back together? But wasn't his plan to split them?

NPC: Don't you see that people only work together if there is a danger that threatens all of them? Marcel wanted to open their eyes. I do admit that he went a little overboard with his scheme. Good luck nonetheless, whichever way you choose. Go home now and tell them what you did.

NPC: Come on, I've got other things on my mind. Although I pity Marcel. Now you can return and tell all the others.

NPC: We really need you to challenge Marcel in sector 3 of the Military Base to a duel. Otherwise the Base will never come back to normal.

NPC: Congratulations. You cannot begin to comprehend how much that means to us all. Now the CityMercs will not split in half. You deserve more than just thanks and a few credits to be honest but more is just not possible right now. Cajun could not attend to congratulate you personally since he engaged in a fight with the Black Dragons. He only took his platoon, one of these days he will get himself killed.

Your response: And what about myself? What does the future hold for me?

NPC: It would be nice if we could employ Marcel again. He gathered many followers and we cannot risk upsetting them too much. That is why you should get some distance to the Base. Marcel wil certainly not forget all that happened and he might want to take revenge on you. It would be best if you found your own clan. If you do we will be able to support each other and you don't need to work right here. It was agreed to give you some resources for your clan.

Your response: Eljena mentioned that she would hand over a special kind of weapon to you.

NPC: That is true, I almost forgot. It seems to be a rather powerful chain gun. A prototype directly from Tangent. Admittedly I am a little bit jealous. Go on and take it. Now you only need to decide what you want to do for yourself. I salute you.

• Cole waits for you in Pepper Park Sector 3.

• Well, well... now that you got everything you wanted you are showing your real face. If you really believe that you can fight against the Fallen Angels with a stiletto, you should be prepared for a surprise. I for one will not regret it if your body is found decaying in the wastelands.

entries.conversation:
NPC: As I can see you have worked hard to prove your loyalty to our order. In the name of the holy Crahn I hereby thank you for your dedication. If you want to further serve the order we would now be ready to assign more complex missions to you. Are you ready for this challenge?

Your response: Yes, sister. I wholly submit my body and my soul to the wellfare of Crahn.

Your response: I am sorry but I am not yet ready for such an assignment.

NPC: Then let us proceed... Mark Cole, an ex-member of the Fallen Angels has informed us that he has an item of great importance and value. He did not say what kind of object he was referring to. The order is not sure whether or not Cole is trustworthy and we do not want Cole to develop an aloofness.

Your response: He is not even one of us, why would any father stoop as low as to visit him?

NPC: True, that is why the order decided not to send a high ranking brother to him. But since we still need to find out about this object, I ask you to get it from Cole and deliver it to Father Manus right here in the monastery. So that Father Manus will be able to examine it more closely.

Your response: Who exactly is Mark Cole and who are the Fallen Angels?

NPC: Cole worked for the Fallen Angels for a long time. The Fallen Angels are an association of scientists who live in exile out in the Wastelands. Their base of operations, a Mekka of sin, is Tech Haven. The relationship between the Brotherhood and the Fallen Angels is strained because of some unfortunate events, but that doesn't mean we aren't interested in cooperating with former Tech Haven scientists.

Your response: Doesn't Cole work for them any more? What happened?

NPC: In contrary to what he said, Cole was banished from the ranks of the Fallen Angels after he tried to sell details of their secret projects.

Your response: Ok, so where exactly can I find Cole?

NPC: Cole waits for you in Pepper Park Sector 3.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Afterwards, give the item to Father Manus and pass on my best regards. His work is an inspiration for all of us. Can we rely on you to accept this assignment?

Your response: Yes,... I will not disappoint Crahn.

NPC: May your mission be guarded by the holy Crahn.

NPC: Return here once you feel that you could stand up to the challenge.

NPC: You are the young monk the brotherhood informed me of? Why doesn't father Manus come himself?

Your response: Please Cole... I haven't got much time. Give me the object that is supposed to be so very valuable.

NPC: Not so fast my young friend... Since I am no longer a member of the Fallen Angels, life got pretty dangerous for me. The Angels will obviously plan to kill me as they assume that I could sell their scientific secrets, that I still have from my time in their labs.

Your response: I am not interested in your problems. I thought you were supposed to give me an allegedly valuable object? Anything else is not of interest to me.

NPC: Please understand... I am totally broke and can't even afford a simple weapon. The object I have is very valuable for the brotherhood but totally useless for me. Bring me a simple weapon... a stiletto... then I will hand over the object to you.

Your response: Very well... I will bring you your stiletto. Wait here for me.

NPC: Where else could I go? The killers of the Fallen Angels are lurking everywhere. Only here I feel halfway safe.

NPC: Go and get me that knife...quickly!

NPC: Ok great, give me the knife... here take this trash. Now get lost... otherwise you might be seen with me. I am already curious what this great Father Manus of yours is going to do with this rubbish.

Your response: Well, well... now that you got everything you wanted you are showing your real face. If you really believe that you can fight against the Fallen Angels with a stiletto, you should be prepared for a surprise. I for one will not regret it if your body is found decaying in the wastelands.

NPC: Yes, yes, yes... now bugger off already.

NPC: Get lost. I don't want to be seen with you. Don't you have to give the item to somebody?

NPC: I do not have the time to speak to young monks.

NPC: Welcome, young monk. The order already informed me of your arrival. Did you meet Cole?

Your response: Yes, but I still have something important to do. I am sorry.

Your response: Oh yes I did... he is a very mean contemporary.

NPC: Yes, he is a fool... and a traitor... Did he give you his ominous object?

Your response: Yes Father, but I don't know what it is. It looks like metal and somehow feels warm to the touch.

NPC: Let me have it.

Your response: Of course, here it is. Take it.

NPC: But, where is the object? Without the object we cannot do anything.

NPC: Interesting... this object is Tacholytium. A warm and moderately radioactive metal. If you look at it in the dark you will notice that it even glows very slightly. That is also the reason why our ancestors have preferred to use this material.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: ...at that time, when we lived below the earth for generations after the great light, many strange machines of the ancient Psi Monks were constructed from Tacholytium. I will probably have to study some of the older records in order to fully grasp the meaning of this item.

Your response: Does that mean that this object is worth something after all?

NPC: Patience, young monk, is a virtue. I will retire to the archive in order to fully answer your question. Until then I should better lock this away safely. It is entirely possible that it is the key for something of great importance.

Your response: So shall it be. Thank you Father.

NPC: May Crahn bless your journey.

NPC: I am sorry but I am already on my way into the archive. Please return to the main office.

NPC: Don't forget to meet Cole.

NPC: May I point you to your assignment? The mission is not yet accomplished. Mark can be found in Pepper Park Sector 3. Don't forget that Father Manus is waiting for you as well.

NPC: Welcome home, young monk. Father Manus already told me of your successful mission and the strange object. That was good work. Especially how you interacted with Cole. I know that he is a very difficult and impertinent person.

Your response: Crahn has granted me patience.

NPC: As a reward you will receive these 2000 credits. I would suggest that you invest this money in your PSI equipment.

Your response: Thank you Sister. I will consider your suggestion.

NPC: If you further train your skills I might soon have another special task for you. May Crahn bless you. You should go out amongst the people to train the use of your PSI-powers. (next mission at level 20)

entries.conversation:
NPC: May Crahn bless you, young monk. As I can see you have trained thoroughly... the order is ready to accept you into a higher circle. I believe the time has come to charge you with another new important task. Are you ready for this new challenge?

Your response: Yes Sister. It is still my wish to serve Crahn as best as I can.

Your response: Please give me some more time, Sister.

NPC: Ok then... in the old days when Shirkan and Neopha Kansil preached the word of Crahn in the streets of Neocron. When the city was under the control of our fathers, a small upstart group of scientists managed to escape our grasp.

Your response: I think I read about this somewhere.

NPC: As you know, I am speaking about the Fallen Angels. The very group that journeyed into the Wastelands in the year of 2633 in order to erect the Tech Haven laboratory there.

Your response: Yes Sister, I have thoroughly studied the history of Neocron and of our order.

NPC: The history books do not tell the whole truth, young monk. In the eyes of a Neocron citizen the Fallen Angels are a harmless group of scientists... but we Monks know the truth.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: The Fallen Angels are child murderers and thieves. Within the confines of secret laboratories they conduct abhorrent experiments on humans, the details of which I will spare you.

Your response: But I thought the Fallen Angels are solely for the good of humanity...

NPC: Silence! ... Never believe the lying propaganda of the Angels. Only the Brotherhood of Crahn knows the way of the light... It is evil enough that the Fallen Angels conduct their dark experiments before the very eyes of the public.

Your response: So they are only pretending?

NPC: ... but the worst for our order is that their work is based on our research. The Fallen Angels would never have developed the NeuroLink System if their leader Thomas Cooper would not have taken a generous helping of our research documents.

Your response: Oh Sister, tell me how I can help the order in this.

NPC: Well, we will have an eye for an eye! Our high Brother Gabriel succeeded in infiltrating the Fallen Angels, to be recognized as one of them after years of meticulous planning. He has worked for them for the last two years in Tech Haven and has become a trusted right hand of Sylvia Bennet.

Your response: I understand that I am supposed to go and meet him. Where can I find him?

NPC: He should already have returned from the Angels, meet him in Pepper Park 3. He will hand a holodisc over to you which contains important research data about the Fallen Angels. Father Manus will be waiting for you to deliver the holodisc to him. He should be here in the Crahn Monastery.

Your response: Thus it shall be.

NPC: Take care not to draw any attention. There could be Fallen Angels in the vicinity. They must not see that Brother Gabriel has a link to us. Walk in the light of Crahn.

NPC: You should better prepare yourself and come back later.

NPC: This task is not going to solve itself, you know? You were supposed to meet Brother Gabriel in Pepper Park 3 and get that holodisc to Father Manus here at our monastery.

NPC: *ARGH* Finally you come ... Brother...

Your response: What happened to you, Brother Gabriel?

NPC: The Angels... *ARGH* I am injured... quick... I need a Medical Kit, quickly!

NPC: *ARGH*

Your response: Here, take this Medical Kit and tell me what happened.

NPC: Thank you... ahhh. That is better.

Your response: Come on... do you have the holodisc that I am supposed to bring to Father Manus?

NPC: No... I have only just managed to get here in great pain. It seems, as if Sylvia Bennet has discovered that I am no Fallen Angel but a disciple of Crahn.

Your response: Why do you think that?

NPC: A masked Runner from the Fallen Angels ambushed me. He stabbed me several times with a stiletto and then stole the holodisc and vanished. I have failed. The wrath of Crahn is certain to fall on me.

Your response: Don't worry, Brother. I will tell nobody about your failure... But it certainly is troublesome. The data from the holodisc was very important for the Brotherhood.

NPC: I know, I know... but wait... the robber thought I was dead and said something about getting it to ProtoPharm ... something about El Farid ... and that the people there would be delighted to get their hands on that disc. After that he kicked me in the face and I must have fallen unconscious.

Your response: Hmmm... But it does not make sense. If it was a member of the Fallen Angels why would he bring the disc to ProtoPharm?

NPC: Maybe there is a secret alliance between ProtoPharm and the Angels... An alliance we did not know of? If you are quick you might still get to the holodisc before it is beyond our grasp.

Your response: But how? Where can I get it back?

NPC: He will most likely give it to a contact. Try your luck in Outzone Sector 3. I know only of one person who does dealings with Neocron's corporations for those not welcome in the city. He is called Raymon I don't know... it might be a long shot but its worth a try.

Your response: It seems I will have to take a trip to Outzone Sector 3.

NPC: Look for Raymon and attack him, he will not part with the disc voluntarily. After that you can search him for the disc. But be careful, he might be armed.

Your response: You should rest now Brother... I will take care of this now.

NPC: May Crahn show you the way.

NPC: Did you manage to find Raymon in Outzone Sector 3? If you already have the disc, deliver it to Father Manus in our monastery.

NPC: Where is the Holodisc from Brother Gabriel? Did you meet him in Pepper Park 3?

NPC: Where is the Holodisc from Brother Gabriel? Did you meet him at Pepper Park 3?

NPC: Ahhh... my young friend. Welcome. Did you receive the holodisc from Brother Gabriel?

Your response: Not from Brother Gabriel... but yes, I have it. It is yours now, Father.

NPC: Where is the holodisc?

NPC: Thank you. The Brotherhood has learned to rely on you and your dedication. If I can do something for you one day, don't hesitate to let me know about it.

Your response: Thank you Father, I will do that. Did you come across any news about the object made out of Tacholytium?

NPC: Yes, I almost forgot about it. Within our archive there was another item made from the same material. I found it in a rather dusty old crate. Its size is almost identical to your fragment but the design is different.

Your response: What could that mean?

NPC: It is almost as if those two fragments are connected in some way. I still do not know the importance of these items but every slither of information I have gathered so far, points to these fragments being very valuable.

Your response: Thank you for your time, Father.

NPC: The order has authorized me to award you 4000 credits for completing this task. Invest the money wisely and perfect your skills.

Your response: I will, with the help of Crahn.

NPC: We have another assignment for you but it is sure not to be any easier than the previous ones... When you are ready, speak with your Registrar. Go in peace and may Crahn bless you. (next mission at level 30)

NPC: If you don't have any deals for me then beat it, freak.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Corytium

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Where else would this good-for-nothing person be? He is still in the vicinity of Pepper Park 3 and tries to sell his supposedly important information to the highest bidder.

• Calvin Grimwood of the Breed and Drakkhan Helios of the Angels are going to meet in the Outzone Sector 4.

• I regret that I have no more information for you, monk! Drakkhan and the others are in Outzone Sector 04. And be sure to get the Corytium to Maxime in Viarosso 2, or it will all be in vain.

• Didn't you have a task to complete? Mark Cole is still waiting in Pepper Park 3.

• You are talking in riddles... Ah, before I forget: Father Manus found another fragment near Gaya Mine in the Wastelands.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: You are slowly becoming one of the most indispensable members of our order, young monk. The council has decided to officially accept you into the Blue Circle of our Brotherhood.

Your response: Thank you, Sister. I will fulfill my duties with the help of Crahn.

NPC: This means that you will be charged with missions that are regarding internal affairs of the order. You have to treat those missions with confidentiality.

Your response: I feel honoured, Sister. How can I serve the order this time?

Your response: I don't yet feel that I am enlightened enough, Sister.

NPC: Our friend, Mark Cole, has informed the council that he supposedly has information, about a secret meeting between the Fallen Angels and representatives of the Anarchy Breed.

Your response: A secret meaning? What can this mean?

NPC: There have been rumours about an alliance between those two factions for a long time, but until now we could not get any details about the state of their negotiations. Meet Cole and listen to what he has to say.

Your response: Where do I meet Cole?

NPC: Where else would this good-for-nothing person be? He is still in the vicinity of Pepper Park 3 and tries to sell his supposedly important information to the highest bidder.

Your response: Very well.

NPC: But be careful... you know, that he is an unpleasent fellow. May Crahn bless your mission.

NPC: Then go forth and work with that goal in mind. If you feel prepared we will offer you the same mission once more.

NPC: If it isn't my favorite Monk. How is Brother Gabriel? I heard he survived quite an insidious ambush.

Your response: How do you know about that attack? Neither he nor I told anyone about it.

NPC: I earn my money by knowing things others want to know. A little knifefight in the subway is not something somebody would pay for however.

Your response: Damn it... it was you. Then you tried to sell the holodisc to Neocron?! But this time you have gone too far. You are going to be chased down and tortured to death by the order for this attack. Until you drown in your own blood.

NPC: Pah... as rash as always, young monk. I don't really think that Brother Gabriel could indentify the Runner who attacked him.

Your response: The Brotherhood has other ways.

NPC: But guess whose fingerprints are all over the stiletto used for the attack? Thank you so much for the weapon. It is always good to be able to defend yourself in this dark city.

Your response: You are a frickin lying snake.

NPC: Why so hostile? The most important thing is that Brother Gabriel is well again, isn't it? The order would not be thrilled by the prospect, that a young talented monk is really an assassin.

Your response: I warn you, if you are planning to...

NPC: I suggest that this whole little event remains our little secret... but that is not why you're here, is it?

Your response: I cannot understand how the order is doing business with a man like you. But that decision is not my responsibility... I was told you had some information about a meeting, between the members of the Anarchy Breed and the Fallen Angels?

NPC: I have... in fact.

Your response: And? ... Come on Cole, don't make me ask for it, otherwise this young talented monk could turn out to be the assassin you would make him. To be honest, I would enjoy to see your entrails splattered over the wall behind you.

NPC: Alright... in the interest of our new found friendship I will make an exception and give you some information without something in exchange.

Your response: I am waiting! Get to the point already.

NPC: Calvin Grimwood of the Breed and Drakkhan Helios of the Angels are going to meet in the Outzone Sector 4.

Your response: Why? What is the reason for this meeting?

NPC: Drakkhan is going to give Calvin a small vial with a liquid metal named Corytium. Supposedly the substance fortifies PSI when ingested. The Fallen Angels want to help the Breed that way to become more autonomous and offensive.

Your response: Could this by any chance have anything to do with the rumoured alliance?

NPC: Yes, the handover of the corytium is more or less the foundation stone for a joint alliance. However, the factions do not yet trust each other very much... and if the handover of the Corytium fails, this would set back the negotiations between the Breed and the Angels by months.

Your response: This plan bears your mark. I can almost hear the hiss of a snake from your mouth.

NPC: A simple thank you would have been sufficient... but I am not yet finished. The most important thing is still to come. If you should succeed in getting the Corytium in your possession then you should bring it to Maxime in Viarosso 2. She'll make sure that it reaches Tangent.

Your response: Tangent? Why Tangent?

NPC: Don't you read the Neocronicle? Tangent has no Corytium whatsoever and they barely have knowledge about PSI controlled weaponry at all.

Your response: That would make them interested in the substance, true. But how does that help us?

NPC: Alright, I will explain it to you. If the Anarchy Breed is informed that their Corytium is seemingly being given to their arch enemy Tangent they will loath the Angels for that.

Your response: Now it all becomes clear.

NPC: This in turn would greatly encumber the alliance between the Breed and the Angels, an aliance that is dreaded so much by the Brotherhood of Crahn. Then you my young monk, will once more be the hero of the day.

Your response: I don't know what to say... it is incredible how much malice and trickiness is hidden inside your sick brain. But somehow I like that plan. Now tell me, what are you getting out of this?

NPC: Oh, rest assured, I won't be empty handed after this. But you should better think about your own welfare. It won't be easy. Drakkhan and Calvin will certainly not appear at the meeting without an escort. You will have to slaughter them all before you can take the Corytium from either one of them.

Your response: That should not be a problem.

NPC: I know you are exactly the kind of Runner for that job... Have fun with it and Goodbye.

NPC: I regret that I have no more information for you, monk! Drakkhan and the others are in Outzone Sector 04. And be sure to get the Corytium to Maxime in Viarosso 2, or it will all be in vain.

NPC: Piss off!

NPC: Well, well... a monk of the Blue Circle. Your reputation got here ahead of you. What can I do for you?

Your response: I need somebody reliable to make a delivery for me. A substance that is meant for Tangent.

NPC: You don't have the substance with you.

NPC: Then you are the one I have been waiting for. Don't worry, your little delivery will be safe with me. Trust me, I got a lot of experience in this.

Your response: Make sure Tangent believes that the delivery is from the Fallen Angels.

NPC: Very well, is there something special about the substance?

Your response: It's called Corytium, you don't need to know any more.

NPC: So, Cole is getting his share the usual way?

Your response: Cole, the sneaky bastard. I knew he would make some kind of profit out of this. He must have planned all this right from the start.

NPC: You should settle this with him. I have no part in this. But your delivery will be sent as an express delivery.

NPC: I believe that everything important has already been said. Don't you have to get back to your HQ?

NPC: Didn't you have a task to complete? Mark Cole is still waiting in Pepper Park 3.

NPC: Holy Crahn. How did you pull that one off? Brother Gabriel has just reported to me that there obviously are serious differences between Anarchy Breed and the Fallen Angels.

Your response: It wasn't easy.

NPC: The threatening alliance of those two factions should be off the table with this for now. How can our order thank you for what you did?

Your response: Don't thank me... thank Cole. He had this hellish brilliant plan. I was only the tool which executed the plan in the name of Crahn.

NPC: Don't be so modest... how can it be that such an old snake like Cole is concocting something useful?

Your response: Sometimes a snake is exactly what you need in order to quickly resolve a situation.

NPC: You are talking in riddles... Ah, before I forget: Father Manus found another fragment near Gaya Mine in the Wastelands.

Your response: Did he have some news on the purpose of the items?

NPC: I am supposed to inform you that he seems to be on the brink of solving this riddle. He will contact you as soon as he knows exactly what those fragments are.

Your response: We already have three fragments now... It is about time that I understand their meaning.

NPC: I would like to suggest you prepare yourself for the intiation into the Red Circle of the order. For this you have to further improve your skills before I can charge you with the next special run.

Your response: I will prepare myself presently.

NPC: Here are 6000 credits that you should invest in your gear. Return to me once you have improved enough. May Crahn bless you. Goodbye, young monk.(next mission at level 35)

NPC: This is a private meeting, piss off!

CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Tacholytium Fragment 2

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Father Manus was unable to find out anything new about those relics of yours. Unfortunately we only have a limited library here, that's why he decided to ask for Father Agnus' help. Agnus is one of the few loyal Crahn followers who decided to stay in the old Abbey in the Outzone sectors of Neocron. After he compared the relics with some of our oldest recorded inscriptions, he stumbled across something new about them. He was very excited when he told me about it. But you better speak to him yourself. Go to the Abbey in Outzone Sector 9 and meet him there.

• I have already done that. I have sent a group of five monks under the leadership of brother Harkon into the Wastelands to a place where I suspect there is another fragment. The group, however, was attacked by a gang of Tsunami Syndicate. They were robbed and then killed.

• I am certain of that, Brother. Let us talk about the relics once more. In the middle East of the Wastelands there is a mine, the Gaya Mine. This is where I sent the Brothers led by Brother Harkon.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Father Manus was unable to find out anything new about those relics of yours. Unfortunately we only have a limited library here, that's why he decided to ask for Father Agnus' help. Agnus is one of the few loyal Crahn followers who decided to stay in the old Abbey in the Outzone sectors of Neocron. After he compared the relics with some of our oldest recorded inscriptions, he stumbled across something new about them. He was very excited when he told me about it. But you better speak to him yourself. Go to the Abbey in Outzone Sector 9 and meet him there.

Your response: Thank you for the message, I will quickly be on my way.

NPC: May Crahn bless you.

NPC: Ah, finally you have arrived. I was expecting you.

Your response: I was informed that you have news about the Tacholytium fragments?

NPC: Yes, that is true. As I suspected earlier their origin reaches back to the time when our ancestors still lived below the earth and concentrated their efforts exclusively on improving their telekinetic powers.

Your response: And? What were you able to determine?

NPC: Show some patience. The power of the Tacholytium is derived directly from the earth, the so called Gaya. Gaya is the sum of all powers that toil on our earth.

Your response: Then it contains that very same energy?

NPC: Every material that was compressed by the enormous energy of the great light, together with other elements is carrying Gaya. This is exactly the case for Tacholytium as well.

Your response: Does that mean that items made of Tacholytium can transfer the power of Gaya to a human being?

NPC: Not directly. But every PSI atuned being can empower his telekinetic powers with the help of Tacholytium. Used in the right way it works like a PSI amplifier.

Your response: Holy Crahn, then my three artefacts are even more powerful and valuable than I dared to dream.

NPC: Yes, but in their current form they are useless. They need to be assembled first. However my studies indicate that you lack at least two other fragments before you can assemble a Gaya PSI amplifier.

Your response: Where could I find the missing fragments? Please, Father Agnus, help me in my search.

NPC: I have already done that. I have sent a group of five monks under the leadership of brother Harkon into the Wastelands to a place where I suspect there is another fragment. The group, however, was attacked by a gang of Tsunami Syndicate. They were robbed and then killed.

Your response: Holy Crahn... that is terrible. We should revenge this crime.

NPC: I had hoped that you would suggest that. As you know, we strictly return the same revenge. But since Crahn has unlimited patience to wait for the right moment, it would be sufficient to only release one of the guilty souls. And when more and more die doubt and fear will eat away at them.

Your response: So be it, I will serve my Brothers and deliver one of the official representives of the Tsunami Syndicate to Crahn's will?

Your response: I do not feel up to such a challenge, Father.

NPC: It is important that you only kill the Tsunami Syndicate Pimps which are guilty of blasphemia. Don't kill kids or their Runners, those poor souls will face Crahn's grace sooner or later.

Your response: So be it. May the will of Crahn be executed.

NPC: You can also have comrades that support you in this task. But take care that you inflict the most damage against the Tsunami Syndicate Pimps. Once you have killed two Tsunami Syndicate Pimps return here so that we can talk some more about the relics. May Crahn bless your weapons and lead your soul.

NPC: It was your idea to revenge our Brothers in the first place and thus you should be the one to carry it out. Two Tsunami Syndicate Pimps must be killed by your hands.

NPC: Good work my young Brother. The order has accepted your entry into the Red Circle of the monks. That also means that you can speak to me from now on as Brother.

Your response: Thank you Brother Agnus. I will prove to be worthy of my rank and not bring disgrace to it.

NPC: Then you have to continue your training first. But come back as soon as possible.

NPC: I am certain of that, Brother. Let us talk about the relics once more. In the middle East of the Wastelands there is a mine, the Gaya Mine. This is where I sent the Brothers led by Brother Harkon.

Your response: Then that is the place where another relic can be found?

NPC: Somewhere in the mazelike mine an old Warbot Titan can be found, from the old war at the time of Neopha Kansil. Legends say that the Warbot Titan is invincible and the inhabitants of the old Yucida village called him the Guardian of Gaya in awe

Your response: What shall I do? Do I have to fight against the Warbot?

NPC: I am quoting the Legends of the ancient Yucida people: The iron guardian of the mine possesses a heart of glowing metal, which gives him the temperament and the strength of a wild dragon.

Your response: Is there more?

NPC: And despite its metallic appearance it seems to be warm as if it is connected to the earth itself. ... If my theory is correct this heart is one of the missing fragments that you are still missing.

Your response: But how can I fell a supposedly invincible Warbot?

NPC: You probably cannot. But certainly you can disable him for a while. And then you can take his heart.

Your response: But what if I can't defeat him on my own?

NPC: You can also take some comrades with you to help you along. But you have to do most damage to the Warbot because he won't yield his Tacholytium heart otherwise.

Your response: I understand, Brother.

NPC: Then visit the Gaya mine to fulfill your destiny. Come back to me once you have the heart of the Warbot Titan. May Crahn bless your mission.

NPC: You don't have the substance with you.

NPC: Where have you left the heart of the guardian, Brother? Is it still in the Gaya Mine?

NPC: Welcome, Brother. I see that you carry with you the heart of the guardian of Gaya. It seems that there is not one foe left that could withstand your immense power. I will gladly keep the heart safe until you need it.

Your response: It was a hard and exhausting fight. But Crahn gave me strength.

NPC: You are not only becoming one of our most valued members but also one of our strongest weapons. I have suggested to the council to raise you into the Black Circle.

Your response: You honour me.

NPC: But until I can expect an answer the coast of the Midworld Ocean will still see a few dozen low tides and high tides.

Your response: Thank you Brother Agnus. I value your respect.

NPC: For your vengance over the deaths of the Brothers under the leadership of Brother Harkon the order has awarded you these 10,000 credits. Take the fruits of your work and improve your gear and your skills. Go in the light of Crahn.(next mission at level 40)

NPC: Go away

NPC: Zzzzt...

CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Black Crystal 1

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• The Monks of the Black Circle excell in their wisdom but also especially in their power and strength. A monk of the Black Circle must be able to survive even in the darkest and most dangerous areas of the Wastelands.

• And thus it shall be... The trial consists of several tasks. The goal of the trial is to retrieve the two crystals of the Fathers of Crahn and carry them to the place of their origin. The ancient Yucida Village in the North of the Wastelands.

• The first crystal is protected by a giant mutant named Veskulus in the so called Crystal Caves. The entrance to these caves can be found in the Wastelands in D 07.
