entries.conversation:
NPC: Welcome, Brother. The council contacted me and asked how I would evaluate you. I have heard that Father Agnus has suggested you for the Black Circle. Judging from your heoric deeds I would not be surprised if you would be accepted into this circle soon.

Your response: Thank you for your praise, Sister. It is true that the light of Crahn has shone on me in the past few months.

NPC: It is told like that throughout the order. Well... if you want to be accepted into the Black Circle then you have to complete a trial from a Father of the Black Circle.

Your response: I am ready for this trial. Tell me more.

Your response: I don't feel that I am worthy enough.

NPC: The Monks of the Black Circle excell in their wisdom but also especially in their power and strength. A monk of the Black Circle must be able to survive even in the darkest and most dangerous areas of the Wastelands.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Go to Father Morpheus, you can find him in the ruins of Crest Village. He will give you your task and send you on your pilgrimage. May Crahn bless your trial.

NPC: Then you should better prepare yourself.

NPC: You should talk to Father Morpheus at Crest village.

NPC: You are the young monk from the Red Circle, the one the whole order is talking about?

Your response: Greetings, Father Morpheus. These stories within the order are more than exaggerated.

NPC: Modesty, my son is an important prerequisite to be accepted into the Black Circle. At least I can already confirm that you have this one. But we still need to find out how your knowledge and courage is faring.

Your response: Please, Father Morpheus... give me the honour of letting me face your trial.

Your response: I am sorry but I don't feel that I can face your trial quite yet.

NPC: And thus it shall be... The trial consists of several tasks. The goal of the trial is to retrieve the two crystals of the Fathers of Crahn and carry them to the place of their origin. The ancient Yucida Village in the North of the Wastelands.

Your response: Where can I find these crystals?

NPC: The first crystal is protected by a giant mutant named Veskulus in the so called Crystal Caves. The entrance to these caves can be found in the Wastelands in D 07.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: The second one is in the possession of a giant reaper named Galopticus. It lives near Catlock Bay with its pack.

Your response: And once I have all crystals? I am supposed to bring them to the Ancient Yucida Village and give them to whom?

NPC: Yes... give the crystals to Father Tesara. He has waited decades for the return of these crystals to the ancient ruins. He once was the guardian of the black crystals but they were stolen from him and he was exiled.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Only if you succeed in bringing those crystals back to him, will he be rehabilitated and recognised as one of us again.

Your response: I will try my very best not to disappoint you.

NPC: On your way through the Wastelands you will encounter many dangers. Do not fear because only a few creatures should be a danger to such a powerful monk like you are.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: If you succeed in this task then return to me so that I can give you the blessing of the Black Circle.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Brother Agnus has reported to me that you are very interested in Gaya energy. I believe I have some interesting information for you... Walk forth and may the light of Crahn follow you wherever you go.

NPC: Return once you believe you are ready.

NPC: Leave me be. I am searching the loneliness.

NPC: Greetings, mighty monk of the Red Circle. What business brings you here?

Your response: Greetings, Father Tesara. I bring to you the two black crystals of the Fathers of Crahn.

NPC: No... can I really believe that? The crystals were lost many decades ago. How was it possible for you to find them?

Your response: Finding them was no problem as Father Morpheus named the locations where they could be found. It was more difficult as the crystals were guarded by some monsterous creatures.

NPC: I knew that Morpheus would not let me down in these hard times. He must have looked for the hiding places of the crystals over many years, before he sent a brave monk like you to recover them. How can I ever thank you?

Your response: Your rehabilitation into the Black Circle will be enough of a reward for me. But I have to leave you at once as Father Morpheus is expecting me at the old Crest Village... and it's a long way. Farewell, Father Tesara.

NPC: May Crahn bless your courage. My eternal thanks to you. Farewell my Son.

NPC: Thank you again. May Crahn be with you. Father Morpheus is surely awaiting you at Crest village.

NPC: You should bring the two crystals to Father Tesara. One can be found with the Giant Mutant Veskulus in the Crystal Caves, the other with the Giant Reaper Galopticus near Catlock Bay.

NPC: It seems that the stories about you were not exaggerated after all. You have completed the trial brilliantly, my young Brother.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Hereby I bless your path and your spirit. From now on you are a member of the Black Circle. You have reached the highest decoration that can be reached within the Brotherhood.

Your response: I feel honoured, Brother Morpheus. I will prove that I am worthy of my rank... At the beginnning of the trial you said that you have information regarding the energy of the earth, Gaya. Can you tell me something about it?

NPC: Gaya is a power that flows through everybody and everything. It is the basis of telekinesis, meaning the PSI powers. Monks with strong PSI powers are aware of Gaya and can even resurrect the dead.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Whoever understands and controls Gaya will always be in balance with his fellow humans and the environment.

Your response: Why can only monks control this PSI energy so well?

NPC: It is a good question my young Brother. Rarely are there any others who can control this power. But as you know, our ancestors lived below the earth after the great light. They lived there for centuries.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: In complete darkness and isolation they concentrated on their inner powers. Without the distraction of light and without optical impulses they had to rely on their other senses.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: At some point they will simply have felt the power of the earth and will have interacted with it.

Your response: Was that the time in which our ancestors have understood to use the compressed elements of the earth?

NPC: You mean the Tacholytium, right? Yes, I remember. Father Agnus asked me to tell you that he has the final relic. It seems to be the last missing fragment to your PSI amplifier.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: A powerful tool. You should always take care that it does not fall into false hands.

Your response: Many thanks, Father. Finally I have all five fragments. If only I could assemble it. It is imperative that I find an old construction blue print of the PSI amplifier.

NPC: I fear I cannot help you with that. But I am sure that the solution to your problem will not be far away. Walk in the light of Crahn my young Brother.(next mission at level 45)

NPC: Go Away

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Gaya-Blueprint
• Latekulus Blue Poisongland

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Gaya Tacholytium Gauntlet

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Kev is running a second hand junk shop in the Wastelands at Blakkmist Creek. Officially his business is a garbage dump, you will find him there at Blakkmist Garbage Dump.

• Well, it is very lonely out here in the Wastelands and the nights are long. From time to time I mix myself some drugs to make it more comfortable.

• Some of the most valued ingredients however are hard to get but it should be no problem for such a powerful Black Circle monk, to bring something to me from the dangerous parts of the Wastelands.

• I have already told you more than I wanted to. Mark Cole can usually be found in Pepper Park 3.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Welcome oh Father of the Black Circle. Father Agnus has informed me that you have five Tacholytium relics in your possession by now.

Your response: It was only possible through the help I received from Father Manus and Father Agnus.

NPC: Before I forget, Father Agnus is certain that Kev Critter still possesses a construction plan, which should allow you to assemble the PSI amplifier out of the fragments.

Your response: That is good news. Where can I find this Kev Critter?

NPC: Kev is running a second hand junk shop in the Wastelands at Blakkmist Creek. Officially his business is a garbage dump, you will find him there at Blakkmist Garbage Dump.

Your response: Is there anything else you can tell me about him?

NPC: Critter is a foolish old man who can turn into a clever fox if he smells a good deal.

Your response: He wouldn't be the first.

NPC: So be careful and don't let him see how much you want the blueprint. You will only raise the price for it. Father Agnus will certainly help you once you have the blueprint.

Your response: Thank you, I will heed your advice. May Crahn be with you.

NPC: Thank you Father. Good luck with your mission.

NPC: Didn't you want to visit Kev Critter at the Blakkmist garbage dump? If  you have everything you need then you should go and ask Father Agnus to help you with the construction of the artifact.

NPC: Oh, oh... a Father of the Black Circle. This does not bode well.

Your response: Greetings, have no fear.

NPC: The last time a group of high ranking Brothers turned up here they vandalized everything.

Your response: Did they find anything?

NPC: The leader of that group, I believe his name was Harkon, turned really nasty when they did not find what they were looking for.

Your response: Brother Harkon was here? I assume he searched for an item made of Tacholytium?

NPC: Tacholytium... yes, exactly. It seems there is high demand for this substance. I heard that group lead by Harkon was attacked by a gang of Tsunamis.

Your response: Yes, you can find heretics in every corner of this world these days.

NPC: It almost seems as if the Tsunami Syndicate are also looking for the stuff.

Your response: This affair with the Tsunami Syndicate has already been taken care of.

NPC: Yes, I heard about that. And that is exactly what I do not understand. What kind of sacred order are you if you will use any method to achieve your goal?

Your response: Silence! Be careful not to insult the order. I did not come here to discuss the means the order utilizes.

NPC: I almost thought as much. But tell me, why did you come to me, Father?

Your response: I require a blueprint from you. I was told that you have the blueprint of a Gaya PSI amplifier.

NPC: I have always been able to extract almost every blueprint from my old microdiscs. But I don't want money from you.

Your response: That is very nice of you. I will praise your generosity. Then give the blueprint to me already.

NPC: No, no, no... I only said, I don't want any money from you. Get me something else.

Your response: After all that I have heard about you, I would have been surprised if you would just give me that blueprint. What shall I get for you then?

NPC: Well, it is very lonely out here in the Wastelands and the nights are long. From time to time I mix myself some drugs to make it more comfortable.

Your response: Talk! I haven't got all day.

NPC: Some of the most valued ingredients however are hard to get but it should be no problem for such a powerful Black Circle monk, to bring something to me from the dangerous parts of the Wastelands.

Your response: Tell me what you want. I don't have all day.

NPC: I need the blue poison gland of the PSI-Spider Latekulus.

Your response: Tell me where I can find it and I will get it for you.

NPC: The PSI-Spider is often seen near Point Red. Usually by himself.

Your response: Good. You will wait right here.

NPC: Deliver that gland to me and I will give you the blueprint.

Your response: Say, you could not have thought up something more difficult now, could you?

NPC: This is a vital ingredient for a Tearson Booster and you are an experienced Father of the Black Circle, it should be easy for you to get that ingredient.

Your response: If it was that easy to get, you would already have it.

NPC: I am not willing to discuss it. Either you get that ingredient or I will not make the deal. Come back once you have it.

NPC: You wanted to get me something, remember?

NPC: You have been gone for a long time, Father. I was certain something nasty had happened to you and I would not be seeing you again.

Your response: What does that mean? I have the ingredient for your drug,

NPC: It's too late. I have sold the only Blueprint and the microdisc to somebody else. Maybe you should be a little bit faster next time?

Your response: You are joking old man. A shot from my gun will teach you to keep your promises.

NPC: Not so fast... maybe you can get a copy from the buyer of the microdisc?

Your response: Who bought the disc? Tell me!

NPC: First give me the ingredient... and promise by your honour to the Black Circle that you will not lay hands on me.

Your response: I will give the ingredient to you but if I should not succeed to get my hands on the blueprint, I will visit you again... and then I will turn you and your damn garbage dump to dust.

NPC: It seems I have no choice. Well... the buyer was a certain Mark Cole.

Your response: Mark! This triple crossing snake...

NPC: You know him?

Your response: Oh yes. He is well known to the order.

NPC: Then you already know where you can find him. Go now... and I hope we never see each other again.

NPC: I have already told you more than I wanted to. Mark Cole can usually be found in Pepper Park 3.

NPC: What a surprise. Quick, go away or somebody will see you talking to me.

NPC: No, I don't believe this. We haven't seen each other in a long time, old friend.

Your response: We have never been friends, Mark. I think you are mistaking me for one of your snakes.

NPC: As I see you have now been accepted into the Black Circle. Congratulations! That tattoo of the circle is quite impressive.

Your response: Let's get straight to the point. You have a Blueprint from Kev Critter and a microdisc. Give that blueprint to me and I will vanish. Don't give it to me ... and you will vanish. Forever.

NPC: You are threatening me? How unnecessary. Do you think I got that Blueprint to have it framed and hung on the wall above my bed? It was a paid mission from the Tsunami Syndicate.

Your response: You had no idea that I was after this blueprint?

NPC: I don't know what's up with that item but judging by the price the Syndicate paid me for it, it seems to be something very valuable.

Your response: Mark, this was the last time that you will have encumbered my work. Prepare for your death.

NPC: If you attack me Father Agnus will have that stiletto on his desk by tomorrow. The one that Brother Gabriel was attacked with. I have taken special precautions.

Your response: Brother Agnus is of the Red Circle and I am of the Black Circle. They will not believe him, if he would accuse me. However since I don't need any inconveniences right now, I will spare you if you tell me where I can find the Blueprint.

NPC: Hmmmm... you seem to be very determined. Very well. I have given it to Taylor Gomez. I don't know if he still has it but this is the only chance to recover it.

Your response: Where can I find this Taylor?

NPC: Taylor works in the secret Tsunami Faction Office. Your best chance to get him is when he is leaving the Faction Office through the Secret Passage out back. However you will need to get the Blueprint out of the lions den.

Your response: So be it. Mark, I hope that you stay clear of my assignments in the future. If our paths should cross again I will shoot first and then talk to you. Understood?

NPC: Yes. I have certainly no wish to end up like Drakkhan Helios or Calvin Grimwood. Hurry now, I don't know how long Gomez will have that disc with him or how long he will still be in the secret Tsunami Faction Office.

NPC: I thought I already told you that if you want that Tacholytium thing, you have to kill Taylor Gomez in the Secret Tsunami Faction Office.

NPC: I am sorry, Father, I have no time at the moment.

NPC: I am sorry, Father, I have no time at the moment.

NPC: I was already informed that you are on the trail of the PSI amplifier blueprint.

Your response: Yes and I already have it here. Now I only need your help with the assembly.

NPC: But what is this? You don't have the blueprint. Shame over you to play evil tricks with me.

NPC: Really?! You have the Blueprint, Brother? That is an amazing deed.

Your response: Yes, here it is. Have a look.

NPC: Then it will be easy to construct a PSI amplifier out of it. Give me a moment, there we go...

Your response: Thank you for your help.

NPC: It is a pleasure to help such a well known Father like you. Here is the PSI amplifier! Take it and go with the blessing of Crahn.

NPC: You've already done all you can.

NPC: Piss off Runner! This is our territory!

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Yes, exactly. The Black Dragon aim to dominate the real estate market and the only way to achieve that is to disable Diamond. We already had to decrease our efforts in the Pepper Park Area since the Black Dragon threaten our clients. Even Eric Danmund himself, the head of Diamond has declared a state of emergency.

• The first client can be found in Plaza 02, he agreed to a meeting in Gariots Diner. The other one can be found in ViaRosso 03. If you still have time after that you should really visit the NCPD and report back to me with the results of your work.

• Always be nice and friendly. One client is waiting in Plaza 02 and the other one in ViaRosso 03. You will find them in one of the various restaurants on location.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Ahh, welcome at Diamond. We have closely followed your progress so far and some people here were very impressed. To say the least. It was decided to give you an assignment that requires a certain skill.

Your response: I am pleased to hear that.

Your response: Before I accept such an assignment I believe I should prepare myself better.

NPC: As you might already know we face certain difficulties because of these unpredictable Black Dragons. They are ruthless criminals who would refrain from nothing to reach their goals. Ever since Diamond was privatised in 2746 the Black Dragons were the most serious threat we had to deal with.

Your response: Why? What do they want? Diamond only trades in real estate.

NPC: Yes, exactly. The Black Dragon aim to dominate the real estate market and the only way to achieve that is to disable Diamond. We already had to decrease our efforts in the Pepper Park Area since the Black Dragon threaten our clients. Even Eric Danmund himself, the head of Diamond has declared a state of emergency.

Your response: This is bad, but I thought you wanted to tell me about my assignment.

NPC: Of course but I thought you should have some background knowledge. Too many people don't know that almost all apartements and shops are property of Diamond. Except for the problems with the Black Dragons. It has become even worse recently. They already have forced some of our clients away from us. Diamond would like you to visit two persons who want to cancel their contracts with us. You should try and convince them to rethink their decision. Obviously the Black Dragon have something to do with this. After you convinced them you could go to the NCPD and make sure that they are aware of the problem with the Black Dragon.

Your response: Where can I find those two persons? I will give it my best shot.

NPC: The first client can be found in Plaza 02, he agreed to a meeting in Gariots Diner. The other one can be found in ViaRosso 03. If you still have time after that you should really visit the NCPD and report back to me with the results of your work.

NPC: Please do so. Always be prepared. Come back once you think you have sufficiently prepared yourself.

NPC: Hello, are you the Diamond representative?

Your response: Yes, sorry if I am late but I was only just prepared for this meeting.

NPC: Then you do not yet know what these bastards have done to us?

Your response: No, I am sorry.

NPC: They busted open the door after they disabled our alarm system. Pointing their guns at us they forced us into a corner of our apartement while they emptied our drawers and cabinets. They piled all our clothing on a table and ignited it. We had to patiently stand by and watch them burn all our clothing, my daughter cried and cried and there was nothing I could have done. After they finally went they threatened us to return if we would not leave our apartement.

Your response: That is horrible. Have you already contacted the NCPD?

NPC: Yes and they told me they were powerless. The described ruffians don't appear in any CityAdmin file. I am sorry but the only thing I can do under these circumstances is to cancel the contract with Diamond. My little daughter Jasmin doesn't leave her mother for even a second without bursting into tears.

Your response: I understand. Under these circumstances everybody would act like that. But if you ever change your mind again you know that Diamond is there.

NPC: Thank you for the offer. We have always had good experiences with Diamond, but I cannot continue like this.

NPC: My decision is set. I cannot change it for the sake of my child.

NPC: Don't disturb me. Our meeting is not till later and I'm busy at the moment.

NPC: You must be the representative from Diamond, right?

Your response: Yes I am, and I am here to try and persuade you to become a Diamond Real Estate client again.

NPC: Then try your luck although I think it will be in vain. I will not continue my contract with Diamond.

Your response: I respect your decision but I would like to hear the reasons you have.

NPC: I don't really want to speak about it since it is of a more personal nature.

Your response: I assure you that every precaution is being taken against these ruffians, if they were responsible in this case.

NPC: Every possible precaution?! That is not enough! How do you expect to prevent things like this in the future?!

Your response: I am sure our security experts will take care if it.

NPC: What do you think can those security experts of yours do against six massive Tanks storming your apartement and forcing you to swallow the whole content of your Cryofridge?!! I still need to take pills because of this incident! Well, now you see what I mean. Content?

Your response: You are right, that is wrong. Best I visit the NCPD personally.

NPC: Go on and try it but the NCPD didn't help me in the first place. Their HQ can be found here in Viarosso 03, I talked to a certain Jenna. The contract is cancelled in any case. Sorry.

NPC: I do not believe I will change my opinion. Good day to you.

NPC: Please refer to an employee for questions.

NPC: State your intentions, citizen.

Your response: I am coming from Diamond and wanted to report that our clients are being harrassed by ruffians who force them to abandon their homes. By force I might add.

NPC: Yes, we have been informed about this in several cases. 36 to be precise. But we still lack vital information to pursue this further. I am sorry.

Your response: What? That many? And you are telling me that all those people cannot give you enough detail on the criminals? What am I supposed to think of this?

NPC: The descriptions of the criminals do not appear in any of our files. According to our files they do not even exist. They are simply not registered in Neocron. The NCPD suspects the Black Dragon to be behind this but up to this point only a few preventive executions were executed.

Your response: Preventive executions? But the NCPD...

NPC: I am sorry, citizen. Everybody is doing his best here. I cannot tell you more.

NPC: The NCPD tries to maintain peace within Neocron. The NCPD always works 110 percent. Therefore you can return to Diamond and rest assured that we will take care of it sooner or later.

NPC: Always be nice and friendly. One client is waiting in Plaza 02 and the other one in ViaRosso 03. You will find them in one of the various restaurants on location.

NPC: There you are again. That was pretty fast. You seem to be a very determined person.

Your response: Determined might be an overstatement. The clients were forced from their property by Ruffians.

NPC: Have you been able to convince them to come back to Diamond?

Your response: Unfortunately not and it is no coincidence. These persons really have suffered and even the NCPD is confronted with a riddle.

NPC: Very unsettling news. I will have to forward them to the superiors. Mr Danmund should hear about this. You have not exactly successfully accomplished your assignment, nontheless Diamond forwards these 1000 Credits to you. If you so desire you can improve on your skills and visit us again for a new mission later on. (next mission at level 20)

entries.conversation:
NPC: A productive day to you. I believe you might be interested in doing something for Diamond again, yes?

Your response: You have guessed right. I think I have prepared myself well.

Your response: To be honest, I believe I am not ready yet.

NPC: That is good. The threat posed by these gangs of criminals is growing and growing. Of course every single one of them was sent by the Black Dragon, there is no doubt about it. Mr. Danmund has therefore prepared a contract between us and the CityMercs for the protection of our apartements. A meeting was arranged near an abandoned broadcasting station in the Wastelands.

Your response: That was direly needed. It can't go on like this.

NPC: Precisely... we still need some documents for this meeting, though. There are two copies to be collected from the CityAdmin. They have been checking them for loopholes in the contract.

Your response: I am on my way.

NPC: Very well, don't forget to return these documents to me. There is a CityAdmin employee in %NPC_WORLD(0) who should have prepared everything for you.

NPC: Don't waste any time.

NPC: Welcome at the CityAdmin, what can I do for you?

Your response: I am here in behalf of Diamond. I am supposed to pick up some important documents.

NPC: One moment please... yes, your ID has been accepted. That is a horrible story that happens there with Diamond. Of course CityAdmin tries to offer as much support as possible. Especially because of the shared history that binds Diamond and CityAdmin.

Your response: What do you mean?

NPC: Well, Diamond was a division of the CityAdmin before it was given to private hands. But the CityAdmin is still very much interested in seeing a successful Diamond.

Your response: Glad to hear that the CityAdmin actually cares about us. I still need those documents very much if you don't mind.

NPC: Right. A contract with the CityMercs, right? I wish you good luck.

NPC: I thought you wanted to get those documents back to Diamond?

NPC: You are supposed to visit an employee from the CityAdmin in their HQ in Plaza 1. These documents are vital, I don't want to repeat myself.

NPC: Glad to see that you are back already. While you have been away some disturbing news reached us. The CityMerc delegation has been scattered by the Twilight Guardian and that is why the meeting cannot take place as planned. We have not been prepared for this eventuality. Unfortunately.

Your response: What now? What can be done? Are there other ways?

NPC: Yes, although you can imagine the fuss at the headquarters, Diamond still has an alternative route.

Your response: Well, I am listening.

NPC: The high ranking employees that were supposed to meet the CityMercs cannot risk to travel all the way to the Military Base. It would be much safer if we used a contact person.  We know a person who lives in B_07 at Point Red and who is suitable for this. It was planned to hire a Runner who would stealthily go to Point Red and hand over the documents to the contact person.

Your response: Why hire somebody when I can do the job just as well?

NPC: I admit, we haven't thought of that. Mainly because we don't want to send any member out into the dangerous Wastelands. But if you are really interested we could at least give the reward to you. The reward that was meant for the Runner initially.

Your response: Good, it should not be too difficult, Point Red is not too far away from the safe walls of Neocron.

NPC: Good luck, the contact person is a certain Matt Tronstett. He is a rather weird scientist who worked for NEXT. Because of a strange reason known only to him he prefers to live in the Wastelands in Point Red in B_07. Good luck, I will tell  him immediately to expect your arrival some time soon.

NPC: Sorry, whatever it is I am not interested. Leave me alone.

NPC: Ho, Runner. What would somebody like you do in this wilderness?

Your response: An important assignment. I have a package for you Mr Tronstett.

NPC: Ahh, I understand. Many people are looking for the protection of the CityMercs nowadays. Too many if you ask me. It won't be long and they will be rich. Very rich.

Your response: I hope they are worth their money.

NPC: You can count on that, Runner. There is no one who is tougher than the CityMercs. Where they are involved perfection rules.

Your response: I feel glad to hear that. Please take care that these documents reach their goal.

NPC: Of course, I know what I am doing. As a scientist you have to act professional after all. Good luck on your way back. I will hand over the contract once the CityMercs come by and visit me again.

NPC: Don't worry, I will hand over the documents personally. You can go back to Diamond and reassure your people that everything is being taken care of.

NPC: Did you already give the documents to Matt Tronstett in Point Red?

NPC: Congratulations, I have already received a confirmation. Now, we just have to wait whether or not the CityMercs accept the contract. You have done a good job and of course you are entitled to the reward. 4000 credits. Improve your skills and we will certainly want your expertise for a later job once more. (next mission at level 30)

• In case you should succeed Diamond will offer a bonus to you. Good luck. His name is Simmons and he can be found in Pepper Park 02. A meeting was arranged in one of the restaurants there. There are not too many of them, I am sure you will find your way.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Welcome back. There have been some developments while you were away. The Black Dragon won't give us a break and until the contract with the CityMercs is beginning to take effect we are loosing more and more clients. New is that some people now believe they could take advantage of our current situation.

Your response: Can it be? They are just waiting like carrion birds it seems.

NPC: Some independent real estate merchants are taking advantage of the opening we provide to sell their apartements at a higher price. That is of course an unbearable situation.

Your response: I can easily imagine that this is damaging for the business. But what can be done against it?

NPC: Diamond wants to interest those real estate dealers in Diamond. By doing so we would not only have more vendors and apartements but also get rid of some unwanted competition.

Your response: That sounds logical, though it might cost a lot. Is there a job for me related to this?

Your response: If this is supposed to be a mission for me, then I have to turn it down for the moment.

NPC: I was just about to offer you to try and convince one of those freelance vendors to join our ranks. The payment is subject to discussion.

Your response: I can give it a try at least. Usually those kind of freelancers are not easily convinced.

NPC: In case you should succeed Diamond will offer a bonus to you. Good luck. His name is Simmons and he can be found in Pepper Park 02. A meeting was arranged in one of the restaurants there. There are not too many of them, I am sure you will find your way.

NPC: It is your decision but these assignments won't be available forever.

NPC: Are you from Diamond?

Your response: If you are Simmons, yes. I am supposed to have a meeting with you. I hope you can spare a little time.

NPC: Are you sure that you are from Diamond?

Your response: You seem to be very sceptical. I assure you that I am the one you are expecting.

NPC: Very well, I always have the feeling as if somebody is following me. Every night you can hear the Plasma rifle blasts and the screams here in Pepper Park. I am telling you if you are not constantly on the watch you might just as well commit suicide.

Your response: Don't forget there are still the Genreps.

NPC: You mean I should have myself cloned after my death ? Think again. Imagine you are dying in a small side alley, lying in a pile of rubbish. And now your genetical information is cloned. Now I ask you, did your very self transfer itself to your clone? I ask you, are you the clone or isn't it more true that the real you died in that smal side alley and that the clone is just a mirror image taking your place?

Your response: It would be worth to think about it.

NPC: That's why I tried to take a harmless job. Real Estate. But real estate only sounds harmless, yet nowadays it is a war I say. I am seeing Black Dragons everywhere, ready to kill me. Tsunami are just as bad, only that they don't deal in real estate.

Your response: That's exactly why I am here. Diamond wants to propose a deal.

NPC: A deal? For me? Is this some kind of trap?

Your response: No, not at all. Diamond is very interested in hiring you.

NPC: Me? I am supposed to work for Diamond? That is impossible at the moment, really.

Your response: That's a shame but if you should change your mind...

NPC: Wait! I have changed my mind! I will accept your offer... under one condition!

Your response: That sounds promising. Tell me about your condition.

NPC: Well, there is... a small problem with certain people. I am in trouble at the moment.

Your response: Do you need money? I am sure that Diamond...

NPC: No, no, it's not the money. Or yes, it is the money but I am in dire need of help. If you help me, I will join Diamond, alright? I am desperate!

Your response: Why? What do you need my help for?

NPC: It is... it is my wife. She was kidnapped by some mean looking guys. Black Dragon to be sure. Their leader was a certain Max, I don't know any more about it. They threatened to kill her if I did not hand over all the apartement keys I have. It is horrible, I feel paralyzed, I can't eat. I wouldn't know what to do if something would really happen to her.

Your response: Unbelievable. Of course I will do my very best to support you. Just tell me what I can do.

NPC: I have a friend who keeps some keys safe for me. But since the kidnappers have given me an ultimatum I cannot get to all keys in time. Would you collect the keys from my friend? I will tell him that he should give the keys to you.

Your response: Where exactly can I find him?

NPC: Don't be alarmed, I know he is a little strange. He is Anarchy Breed and waits in front of the Neocron city gates in A_08. His name is Crazy Dillan. I will wait here for your return, please hurry.

NPC: Give me all your money. No, wait, I will get it myself.

NPC: Jo, Runner! What a suprise, got any money to spare or should I take it myself? I am warning you, I have genrepped myself already about 10 times or more... I have no fear of death.

Your response: Easy. Simmons sent me.

NPC: Why didn't you say so in the first place? Its a shame what happened to his girl. If those bastards ever turn up in my territory I would give em hell, right here and now.

Your response: Whoever it may be, they certainly are totally ruthless.

NPC: Then what are you waiting for? Take these keys and make your way back to Simmons in Pepper Park 2. This is not one of those crazy games, Runner, this is the real thing.

NPC: Hurry, Runner! This is important, Simmons already waits for you.

NPC: Please, I really need those keys. Crazy Dillan already waits in front of the main Neocron city gates in A_08.

NPC: Good, good, you have the keys? Then I suggest you visit this Max Delavare guy at the Outzone Sector 5 buildings. A terrible place, very dangerous but I don't make the rules here. Would you do that for me?

Your response: Just a moment, why don't you go yourself? After all it is your wife.

NPC: I... let me put it this way... I have had some bad experiences in the Outzone.

Your response: Bad experiences?! Pull yourself together, this is your wife!

NPC: ALLRIGHT!! I AM SCARED LIKE SHIT!! Are you content now? Did you have enough? Then please go to Max Delavare and free my Cathrine from these bastards.

Your response: Very well, I will do it. But don't forget our agreement.

NPC: Thank you, thank you very much. You are a big help here. I will stay here and wait for the return of both of you.

NPC: Leave me alone, scum! Get lost!

NPC: What do you want, Runner? Did you get lost or are you the messenger?

Your response: I am supposed to hand over the keys to you and lead Cathrine away from here.

NPC: Ahh, he finally decided to pay us, eh? He, I bet he is already wetting himself. But I do have to admit, she was rather cute... Now hand over the keys or otherwise I will have to kill you.

Your response: Just a moment, what do you mean by *was*? What did you do to her?

NPC: Now, don't get all prissy about it, you can find her somewhere in the Industrial Sector 1. Here is an ID cube we found with her. Now hand over the keys!

Your response: No, as long as I don't have a proof of Cathrine being alive you won't get anything.

NPC: Get the hell out of my face.

NPC: Fuck off

NPC: Please meet up with Max and bring back my Cathrine. At least find out about her whereabouts. A sign, an item, no matter what...

NPC: Don't frighten me. Where is Cathrine?

Your response: I cannot fully understand it myself. I could only find this datacube with some kind of notes from her.

NPC: Dear god! No, no, no ... how can this happen?

Your response: I am sorry. I believe I best leave you alone for now...

NPC: My poor Cathrine... what can I do now?... What?...

NPC: My poor Cathrine... what can I do now?... What?...

NPC: Leave me alone. I can't speak to you at the moment... not to anybody. Go back to your company.

NPC: Try to convince Simmons to join the ranks of Diamond. You can find him in Pepper Park 02.

NPC: Ah, there you are again. Have you been able to convince him?

Your response: I don't want to talk about this. That man has endured too much already.

NPC: It seems to be a tough time for all of us. Very well, maybe we can try it later again. Diamond will then give you another chance. Maybe you should train your persuasion skills some more. (next mission at level 35)

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Documents about Black Dragon Criminal Activity

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Documents about Black Dragon Criminal Activity

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• He didn't say anything about that. But he specifically asked for you and was convinced that he could do something against the Black Dragon. And those bastards are giving us a lot of trouble recently. He needs your help, though. Seeing that he joined us because of your influence you did earn the bonus for convincing him. It is 8000 Credits, you'll get it once you completed this assignment. But don't waste your time, you can find him in the Pepper Park 02 area again.

• Very good. Kill a Black Dragon Contact. You might get lucky at the Secret Black Dragon Faction Office in Pepper Park. How you deal with him is up to you. But don't make it too easy for him.

• Did you meet Simmons already? If he really can help Diamond it is worth a try. He is waiting in Pepper Park 02.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: If you feel ready, now is the chance to give it another go. I would advise you to visit Simmons once more. Thanks to your efforts he decided to come to Diamond after all. He seemed very determined and knew what he wanted.

Your response: Did he get over the loss of his wife so fast?

Your response: I am sorry, but I don't yet feel ready for another assignment.

NPC: He didn't say anything about that. But he specifically asked for you and was convinced that he could do something against the Black Dragon. And those bastards are giving us a lot of trouble recently. He needs your help, though. Seeing that he joined us because of your influence you did earn the bonus for convincing him. It is 8000 Credits, you'll get it once you completed this assignment. But don't waste your time, you can find him in the Pepper Park 02 area again.

NPC: It is your decision. Be sure to check back once you changed your mind.

NPC: I did not yet have the opportunity to extend my thanks to you. Even though I suffered a great loss, you still have done me a favor. And I am not about to simply forget that,

Your response: I am sorry that there wasn't more I could do.

NPC: That is no problem. It was not your fault. The only one responsible for this cruelty are the Black Dragons.

Your response: I wouldn't have thought that you would get over this loss so fast.

NPC: Well, the only choice is to continue the life, right? Even if my wife meant more to me than I am able to express in words. I can't just stop and refuse to live, just wait until I die is not an option.

Your response: That sounds right, but you...

NPC: Maybe I did not get over this loss as good as you thought I did. I have another request for you and in exchange I am willing to provide information against the Black Dragon.

Your response: I have already been informed that you need my help. What exactly do you need my help for?

NPC: Kill them.

Your response: I don't understand.

NPC: Kill any one of those bastards. They are evil incarnated and don't deserve anything less. All of them. All shall suffer for what they did to my Cathrine.

Your response: I understand that your pain must be unbearable but is this the right way?

NPC: Really? What am I supposed to do then? Ask the CityAdmin to help me with my revenge? You can't be serious. No, my goal is to bring about the downfall of the Black Dragon. Even if I should die in the process. Then I would at least be reunited with my loved one.

Your response: If it helps to give Diamond a break and at the same time give you some peace of mind I will try it.

NPC: Very good. Kill a Black Dragon Contact. You might get lucky at the Secret Black Dragon Faction Office in Pepper Park. How you deal with him is up to you. But don't make it too easy for him.

Your response: Understood, I will try my best.

NPC: Come back once you killed one of them. Until then I should have something for Diamond, I believe.

NPC: Why haven't you killed that Black Dragon bastards yet? Don't you think they deserve it?

NPC: Well done. The first step has been taken. While you provided a handy diversion I was able to acquire some names and some compromising material. That is my contribution for Diamond which will damage the Black Dragon considerably. After all, that is what I am aiming for.

Your response: Don't keep me in suspense, what do you have for me?

NPC: Here, take it and get it to Officer Jenna at the NCPD. They will be able to use these names. Soon, those persons won't find a single safe spot in the whole city of Neocron.

Your response: Good, I hope that will give Diamond the direly needed break.

NPC: Bring these documents to the NCPD and hand them over to officer Jenna. Afterwards Diamond might have need of your services. I suggest you go back to the Human Resource Director who sent you in the first place.

NPC: Give the documents to the NCPD. After that you can visit the Human Resource Director at Diamond again.

NPC: I have no time, citizen. Leave this installation.

NPC: I am representing the law and order here. Make it short, citizen.

Your response: I have information concerning suspicious persons. I thought you could take care of them.

NPC: These informations seem to reflect the data from our files. Thanks to your input it will be much easier to actually find and execute those criminals. Thank you very much. If you have more information like that you should not refrain from handing it over to us.

NPC: If you don't plan on further helping the efforts of the NCPD I advise you to leave the building.

NPC: Did you meet Simmons already? If he really can help Diamond it is worth a try. He is waiting in Pepper Park 02.

NPC: You have done a great job in recruiting that Simmons. He turned out to be very resourceful. Even now he already delivered a heavy blow to the Black Dragon. Although I have no idea how he got the necessary information. I am lead to believe that he's got some kind of personal grudge against them.

Your response: Oh, believe me when I say it is a very personal grudge.

NPC: Still you have earned yourself a reward. 15000 credits. Your performance was very convincing. Especially impressive was your dedication to even risk your own head for the sake of Diamond. That was very convincing if you ask me.

Your response: I am just doing my job. And maybe a little extra.

NPC: Keep up the good work. If you continue to train as hard as you did we will be able to give you assignments more often. But for now you can take a few days off and relax for a while. (next mission at level 40)

NPC: Go away

Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• PEPPER PARK - Small Apartment
• Temporary Alliance proposal

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• PEPPER PARK - Small Apartment
• Temporary Alliance proposal

POSSIBLE COST
• 30,000 credits (depends on choice)

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• It is agreed then. Visit Hontoka in the Industrial Sector 02. He will give you an item that I need very much for what I do. Return it to me as fast as you can. Understood?

• It is an apartment key of a Pepper Park accomodation. Now, get the key to Foster and stop annnoying me.

• Must be the Wastelands. I am looking for a Pepper Park apartement.

• Today must be your lucky day. I only have one apartement in stock and it does seem to be a Pepper Park apartement. Out here, something like this can get pretty expensive, though. It is very rare, to say the least. I have heard that it once belonged to the Black Dragon but of course this is only a rumour.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Since you obviously seem to be a natural we would like to assign a new task to you. The losses we incur each day because of this Black Dragon scum do not allow us to loose any more clients. Many employees fear for their job and I am not an exception.

Your response: Is it really that bad? I have not experienced any of this in the last time.

Your response: I have urgent other matters to attend to.

NPC: Then you are one of the few lucky guys that have not been affected by these incidents. The Black Dragon are trying to force our clients away. They are using a mixture of violence and threats. We now know their overall tactics.

Your response: Why then is it so difficult to prevent all this?

NPC: The Twilight Guardian are the ones who do the dirty work for the Dragons. This is also the reason why they never can be tracked to the Dragons. We have no hard evidence for this and the NCPD is doing the best they can in any case.

Your response: I hope we did not loose too many people.

NPC: That is our very real problem right now. To be honest, everything around here is on the verge of breaking down. Our clients are running away and nobody wants to buy Diamond estates any more. I don't want to alarm you but this is exactly the reason why we need every help we can get.

Your response: But what about the contract with the CityMercs?

NPC: If that contract would already be in effect the situation would be totally different. But because of a clause in the contract it cannot take effect yet. That's why we are mobilizing all forces at our disposal.

Your response: It seems I should really do my part in preserving Diamond as we know it. What will be my job then?

NPC: You should visit Foster in ViaRosso 03. I have a note here that you already dealt with that person once, right?

Your response: Yes, but he already quit his contract with Diamond. He had some really bad experiences.

NPC: Well, well... good that you already know him. We want you to give him an incentive to have a contract with us again. Do, whatever you deem necessary. Remember that Diamond really needs you.

NPC: Return once you believe you can muster enough interest for Diamond again. I wonder where you have lost your dedication.

NPC: Yes, I have decided to talk to you once more. Don't ask me why. Now that you are here you can explain to me why I should change my mind.

Your response: I can tell you that we are working hard on this problem.

NPC: Don't give me that kind of bullshit. I want to hear if anything changed at all. Don't give me this corporate propaganda.

Your response: So, you really want to know how the situation is? Diamond is on the defensive and trying to compensate for the losses that have been incurred.

NPC: Ha, I thought that not everything is as fine and dandy like you want to make me believe. What you really want to say is that you have no arguments to convince me?

Your response: Diamond has a contract with the CityMercs. Only this contract hasn't taken effect yet. But it surely can't be that long any more.

NPC: Your goal is to convince me to come back to Diamond, right? I have a proposition for you. I happen to have a few contacts with the Tsunami and as you might know, they are not close to the Black Dragon. If you help me I will come back to Diamond and buy another Diamond apartement.

Your response: Even though you did not specify your proposition yet it already sounds tempting.

NPC: I am preparing something special for Tsunami. Their task is to provide all parts that I need and in exchange I am using my inventive brain for their sake. But it seems that they could not provide me with all the parts that I need for this task. That's why I need you. Are you willing to organize something for me?

Your response: If you are going to renew your contract with Diamond, sure.

NPC: It is agreed then. Visit Hontoka in the Industrial Sector 02. He will give you an item that I need very much for what I do. Return it to me as fast as you can. Understood?

NPC: You have no business here, get lost.

NPC: This is a dangerous area, Runner. Why don't you return to the safety of Neocron? Get lost.

Your response: You can't tell me what to do. Foster is sending you greetings. I suppose you know who I am talking about.

NPC: Foster? Yes, I have heard of that name, why?

Your response: I am supposed to get something from you and deliver it back to him. Simple. He did not want to meet you personally.

NPC: And he thought he can just send an errand boy? Unfortunately its not as easy as our mutual friend imagined. I am sure he did not tell you that I was only supposed to tell him where he could get the item?

Your response: Of course not. This means I am supposed to organize whatever it is?

NPC: You seem to be a really smart person. From me you will only get the whereabouts of the item. There is a certain merchant in Tawkeen Village in C_06. Her name is Pat. There you will get what you need. It may not come cheap however.

Your response: Sure, now I only need to know what exactly I am looking for.

NPC: It is an apartment key of a Pepper Park accomodation. Now, get the key to Foster and stop annnoying me.

NPC: Ahh, I am awfully sorry but I am out of goods at the moment. Though the next delivery should be confirmed in a second.

NPC: A new customer, what can I do for you? You know, I dont often get customers out here. But when somebody decides to buy here he usually buys a lot.

Your response: Must be the Wastelands. I am looking for a Pepper Park apartement.

NPC: Today must be your lucky day. I only have one apartement in stock and it does seem to be a Pepper Park apartement. Out here, something like this can get pretty expensive, though. It is very rare, to say the least. I have heard that it once belonged to the Black Dragon but of course this is only a rumour.

Your response: Do you know more about it? And what is the price?

NPC: The rumour says that the Black Dragon produced some of their drugs in there until there was a massacre. The rooms are supposedly still full of drug dust and abandoned pills. That might be the reason why it is so sought after. The entrance is still closed because an attack from the Tsunami severely damaged the building but apart from that everything is still fine.

Your response: Can you use it at all? I mean, it does sound as if it is pretty wrecked.

NPC: Of course. The apartement is still very much intact. That is why I only want 30000 for it.

Your response: 30 000 ?! Are you crazy? That is way too much for a run down Pepper Park apartement.

Your response: Alright, I will take it even if it is much too expensive.

NPC: My prices don't change. Not even if you scream and shout at me. Either you buy it or not.

NPC: Go away! Or are you interested in buying this apartment?

Your response: Yes, even if it is much too expensive.

Your response: No way, too expensive. This is daylight robbery!

NPC: Without credits you don't get anything.

NPC: Well, this is the key. Enjoy it.

NPC: I have already given everything to you that I have in stock.

NPC: You are supposed to visit Hontoka in Industrial 02 and get the key for me. Otherwise our agreement ends here.

NPC: Ahh, I did not think you could do it. After all you have been gone for quite a while now.

Your response: Yes, it has taken some time. Now I would really like to know what this apartement is all about.

NPC: I am sorry but the only person who could tell you about it is Hontoka. But I will certainly buy a Diamond apartement as agreed. If you want I can arrange a meeting with Hontoka. I believe he will be surprised that you were able to acquire the key.

NPC: Thank you for your help. You can tell Diamond that they have regained one customer. Hontoka is also waiting for you to speak with him.

NPC: What about the apartement key for Foster? Go and ask Pat in the Tawkeen Village.

NPC: Foster informed me about you. You are woking for Diamond for quite some time, don't you?

Your response: Yes, now tell me about this apartement. Pat did mention something but it was not very clear.

NPC: Alright. I will tell you. The apartement in question was a production facility for some special drugs of the Black Dragon. These drugs are very addictive and at the same time they contain a kind of poison. They tried to hand it out to many Tsunami dancers. Once you are addicted to that stuff the poison will kill you surely.

Your response: The Black Dragon seem to be involved everywhere.

NPC: Yes, indeed. We could only solve the problem by initiating an attack against the building with the drugs inside. There were many losses on both sides but when the smoke was gone Tsunami was victorious. The key was lost, though. You only just found it again.

Your response: How is Foster involved in all this?

NPC: He will analyse the drug traces left in that apartement. Hopefully he will be able to tell us the ingredients. I cannot say more about it. I already said too much.

Your response: Very well but you mentioned something about a proposition?

NPC: The Black Dragon were very active recently and I dont believe they have already exhausted their ressources. They are trying to wear us down through their constant attacks. I wager it is the same with Diamond. I don't know about your situation but I hear that Diamond is being pushed into the defensive every day.

Your response: How do you know that? Is it really already common knowledge?

NPC: The truth is, it is even worse. More importantly Tsunami and Diamond now have a common enemy. That would make us ... allies, at least for the time beeing. I have spoken to Veronique and other Tsunamis. Tsunami is proposing a temporary alliance with Diamond until the time the Black Dragon don't pose a serious threat any longer.

Your response: An alliance with the Tsunami?! Unthinkable! You are something like criminals after all...

NPC: Think about it and you will come to the conclusion that it will be the best for both our factions. Get this package to your superior at Diamond. It contains the proposals that I just told you about. I think that should be sufficient. Good luck.

NPC: Get this package to Diamond now!

NPC: You are supposed to try and convince Foster in ViaRosso 03 to sign a contract with Diamond again.

NPC: I am sorry but in order to assess the proposed alliance between Diamond and Tsunami we really need the proposal.

NPC: You have taken your time I have to say. Did it pay off at least?

Your response: I was able to convince Foster to choose a Diamond apartement again. But there is more. Here are some documents from the Tsunami. They are interested in a temporary alliance.

NPC: A temporary alliance with the Tsunami? Very funny. We are a renowned company and not some run down criminals.

Your response: Wouldn't it be better if criminals kill criminals? I mean, it's none of my business but the situation is really looking bad for us.

NPC: What has it come to? Can it be that the Tsunami are our last chance? I don't know what I should believe. I will hand this proposal on to the people in charge. It will certainly take some time until an answer can be expected, though. But once we have an answer I want you as a messenger. Keep in shape. A reward of 20000 should make it easier on you. (next mission at level 45)

NPC: Go Away

entries.conversation:
NPC: I now have a definitive response from Eric Danmund himself. He seems to have declared a state of emergency and is willing to cooperate with the Tsunami. This is all Top Secret and you are only hearing this since you have earned our trust. Nobody outside the company may get any info about this special operation and if you get caught we will deny any knowledege of your existance. Are you ready to free Diamond from this plague that is Black Dragon?

Your response: You can bet on that.

NPC: I didn't expect anything less of you. First you should bring these documents to your Tsunami contact person. I hope you still know who he is?

Your response: Certainly, I met him in the Industrial sector 02. I am on my way.

NPC: Then keep in mind that your task will not only be the delivery. You will be directly involved as our inside person on the job. You are to help until the CityMercs contract kicks in. Diamond hopes you will succeed.

NPC: Didn't you get the permission from Diamond?

NPC: Look who is there. Did the allmighty Danmund finally reach a decision?

Your response: Sarcasm doesn't suit you but your proposal was accepted. It was agreed to cooperate with you.

NPC: I am glad to hear that since without this special cooperation the future would look bleak. Not only for us but also for Diamond. I just don't feel comfortable when I have to depend on other people. Meaning I am not exactly excited about this temporary cooperation. There are already some plans but it would be prudent if you would lend us a helping hand.

Your response: I have been prepared for this.

NPC: Good, good. Foster analysed the components of this poison drug. ProtoPharm turned out to be producing many of these components. We did secure much of it after that attack on their production facility but that doesn't tell us what they planned to do with all these chemicals.

Your response: Obviously they expected to sell it to someone they don't like.

NPC: That would be too easy. But I don't know what exactly they are planning. That is why we need you. Most Tsunami operatives are known throughout Neocron. More like infamous. But you are not and that is why you are going to visit the ProtoPharm labs and ask a few questions there. The person to ask is Gregory Parkins. Understood?

Your response: Yes, but what kind of questions should I ask?

NPC: Ask how much of this Neuralgon was actually sold and where it was delivered to. If he does not want to tell you, you might have to use your brain and think of something. Try to do a small favor for him.

Your response: Great, this doesn't sound like an easy job. But I will surely try.

NPC: Meet with Gregory Parkins at the ProtoPharm Lab in Plaza 02. Afterwards you can find me back here. I will tell you how we continue with the plan. I cannot give away too much detail on it just now.

NPC: This area is off limits. Leave immediately.

Your response: Ahh, sorry, I thought this was the annual meeting of the Wine Connaisseurs.

Your response: I would like to know more about Neuralgon.

Your response: What can you tell me about Neuralgon?

NPC: Didn't I tell you that this area is off limits?

NPC: Ahh, of course this is something different. How did you know that I like wine?

Your response: Such a great scientist is known all over Neocron.

NPC: I feel honored, thank you very much.

Your response: You are welcome. I am very interested in buying some of this Neuralgon.

NPC: Neuralgon? You have chosen an unfortunate time. All Neuralgon has been sold. There is nothing left and it will probably take some time until we have produced enough of it again.

Your response: Yes, yes, I have heard about that. You delivered it to... ahhh... What was the name of that location again?

NPC: It was delivered to the Industrial Area 01 but I don't know what these chemicals were used for. Neuralgon is often used to increase the absorbtion rate of certain medicine. The medicine is integrated into the organism faster.

Your response: Thank you, this is all very interesting. Have a nice day.

NPC: Thank you for the wine.

NPC: Thanks once more for the wine

NPC: How dare you? This is off limits. Leave immediately.

NPC: Oh boy, every child knows that the meeting takes place in ViaRosso. Since I consider myself a connaisseur myself I should know. I'm especially looking forward to the new synthetic wine plus samples they will offer. Can't wait to taste the delicious flavor of synthetic wine plus again. Now go before I inform the security.

NPC: Look for Gregory Parkins in the ProtoPharm Lab. The entrance is in Plaza 02.

NPC: Then go on and tell me what you found out.

Your response: A lot of Neuralgon was transported to the Industrial Area 01. It was all the Neuralgon ProtoPharm had in stock.

NPC: Really? What do they need all this Neuralgon for? Surely they can't produce that much of these poisenous drugs.

Your response: It must be something different. I think I should visit that Industrial Zone 01. Maybe I will be able to find something.

NPC: Sure, at the moment I am rather busy preparing for one stage of ourplan. Diamond mainly sent you and a lot of money. This means we got to do most of this on our own. Be sure to report any news, ok? A worker there should know something, they usually know a lot. His name is Fergusson.

NPC: Don't touch anything.

NPC: Aye, what can I do for you, Runner?

Your response: I just wanted to have a look around. Maybe you can answer a few questions?

NPC: Aye, that I can do. But don't you want to give something to a poor worker like me? Otherwise I might just swallow important information.

Your response: I have understood, here you have 1000 credits. What can you tell me about a substance called Neuralgon?

NPC: Sorry, my memory is a little fuzzy at the moment. Maybe it would help if you really had any money.

NPC: I remember that some stuff called like that was delivered here and then brought to some place else. It was quite a few crates. Looked expensive. Did I already mention that I like credits very much?

Your response: Right, another 1000 credits. Here you are.

NPC: Sorry, my memory is a little fuzzy at the moment. Maybe it would help if you really had any money.

NPC: Some suspicious looking guys came by for the delivery. I saw that one of them had a Black Dragon tatoo on his neck. One of them sneered that they would make sure to distribute all the stuff to the whole city. And should I tell you something else? That's 1000 once more.

Your response: Please continue. After all you do cost me enough as it is.

NPC: Sorry, my memory is a little fuzzy at the moment. Maybe it would help if you really had any money.

NPC: I believe they are planning something major. And its going to affect the whole city.

Your response: Great, that was a lot of bullshit and little real information. Goodbye.

NPC: Good luck and a productive day.

NPC: I have already told you all there is to say. I have to continue my work, excuse me.

NPC: Look for Fergusson in the Industrial sector. We are not on holidays here, the Black Dragon won't allow us any mistake.

NPC: Don't be stupid, if it wasn't for me we would never have allied against the Black Dragon. Of course I am not merely standing here. Somebody has to coordinate the various operatives. Be sure to get back to me once you secured this drug.

NPC: It is urgent! They will poison us all if we don't take care. Look for the secret entrance in the Bum Asylum or the secret entrance to the secret Black Dragon HQ. Well, not that secret, actually, Pepper Park 03.

NPC: Everything is under control. It was a close call but at the end we deserved to win. Good luck for your career.

NPC: This is important. We cannot allow the Black Dragons to harass us any longer. Visit Hontoka in Industrial 02.

NPC: We have already heard of your success. This was indeed good work. The Tsunami Syndicate is applying a strong pressure on the Black Dragons at the moment and tomorrow the contract with the CityMercs is going to take effect. As a small reward we will award you 100 000 credits. Also we would like to give you an additional storage space where you can deposite some of your additional goods. Good luck with whatever ventures you are planning for the future.

NPC: Go away

entries.details:
CONTACT
Storage Boss

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Black Dragon APARTMENT

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: I am sorry but you don't belong to our faction. Please don't waste my time. Unless you plan to join our faction?

NPC: For the good work you've done we would like to reward you with this apartment.

Your response: Thank you.

NPC: I'm pretty sure I've already given you the keys to your apartment. Have you lost them already?

NPC: You think you can get a reward before you're finished?

NPC: Goodbye!

entries.conversation:
NPC: I am sorry but you need to finish your running mission before i can offer you a new one.

NPC: I am sorry but you don't belong to our faction. Please don't waste my time. Unless you plan to join our faction?!

Your response: That's why I am here. I would like to join your faction.

Your response: I'm not interested. Goodbye.

NPC: I am sorry but you have already done everything for us that we can offer. You still could support us by founding a clan yourself.

NPC: You are not yet experienced enough, come back after you have trained some more. (next mission at level 10)

NPC: You are not yet experienced enough, come back after you have trained some more. (next mission at level 20)

NPC: You are not yet experienced enough, come back after you have trained some more. (next mission at level 30)

NPC: You are not yet experienced enough, come back after you have trained some more. (next mission at level 40)

NPC: You are not yet experienced enough, come back after you have trained some more. (next mission at level 45)

NPC: I am sorry but you have already done everything for us that we can offer. You still could support us by founding a clan yourself.

NPC: Go and see McMillan. He sounded very excited when he asked for you.

NPC: It is not acceptable any longer. Every day there is a new flood of rumours reaching the net, trying to disrupt BioTech as a whole. But we can do nothing against so many individual hackers.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: There are bad news. The amount of compromising material has dramatically increased. To be honest, some employees have already been strongly affected. It is about high time that all this ends soon.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: BioTech would like to offer you a new task. It is related to the content of the datacube that you organised for us. It was quite revealing. It contained several code names of persons who apparently received information regarding BioTech directly from BioTech sources.

Your response: That means there is somebody who gives away all these secrets? I thought these rumours were only that, simple rumours. I would not have thought they were true.

NPC: I have already heard about your ambitious endeavours to get more renown within BioTech. Well, it seems to work for the moment. I was instructed to offer you another task. You might remember the rumours about BioTech that abounded in Neocron.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Ahh, I was already informed that new runners would join BioTech. We always welcome worthy additions to our own ranks.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Normal procedures would demand that the Director of Operations welcomes you personally but he is currently engaged in an important meeting with Seymour Jordan. You will understand that he cannot just cancel that meeting.

Your response: That is a pity but I do understand it. What kind of tasks await me, now that I am working for BioTech?

NPC: That is the way we like it, concise and straight to the point. You will already have received your appartement key from BioTech. In exchange we are only expecting loyalty and that you take care of a select number of special assignments. But more about that later. You have certainly chosen the right faction with BioTech, congratulations.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: First I should maybe tell you something about the company background. BioTech was involved in many different projects since its founding in the year 2638. Currently the focus is almost exclusively on the development and production of various implants.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: This does not mean that BioTech is a stranger to spaceship construction, medicine or weapons. To be precise, the first interstellar spaceship named the Avenger was developed and built by BioTech.

Your response: Yes, I have heard about that.

NPC: Back to the present. We had a request from the CityAdmin for an interview with one of our latest additions to the crew. They are doing a survey and need to ask a few questions. This would probably not take very long and BioTech would even be prepared to give you a small compensation...

Your response: That sounds good, I believe I can do that.

Your response: I am sorry but that won't be possible for the moment.

NPC: Excellent. You can find the CityAdmin employee called Thompson in the Plaza district 02. A meeting was arranged in one of the local restaurants. Please return here once you are finished to give me a small report.

NPC: You can always change your mind if you want to.

NPC: Well, this time they also appeared in the network and they raise heavy accusations against two BioTech directors. It is unknown, where these runours originate from and that is the reason why we need more information.

Your response: I understand. That is my task then, right?

Your response: If this is supposed to be a mission I will have to deny it, I am sorry.

NPC: Yes, not alone though. We already have sent out several Runners with the order to investigate into the rumours. And you will have exactly the same order. These informations are naturally not easy to acquire and that is why you need to utilize rather uncommon methods.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: There is a Tsunami contact person that agreed to give us some information. But it is not certain if the Tsunami know anything about it at all. If you get your hands on something interesting, best report it to McMillan. He is one of the directors of operation here at BioTech and was informed about everything.

Your response: Ok, I have understood everything so far. Where exactly can I find this Tsunami contact?

NPC: He is in the Industrial district 02. But be careful out there since it is pretty dangerous. The name of the contact is Hontoka.

NPC: Rethink your decision. You can always come back for the mission.

NPC: Meet up with Hontoka in the Industrial district 02.

NPC: Those stories are not true! They have been strongly modified to inflict more damage to BioTech.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But we still have not found a proper trail to track down a specific person. That means that we do not know who gives all these informations away. Especially since it probably is not only one person.

Your response: What can we do against that?

Your response: I cannot accept the task at the moment.

NPC: It is a very complex procedure but the plan is to closely follow every movement of the persons in question. That is were we need your help. BioTech would like you to meet a certain Andressa in the Chez Sypher restaurant where she can be found very often. She works in our research lab and some of her activities have been quite suspicious to say the least.

Your response: No problem but what am I supposed to do then? Should I just ask her if she is giving away compromising information about BioTech?

NPC: No, that would be foolish. You should try to convince her to give away  vital information to you. Just offer 50000 Credits as reward for example. I mean, you don't really have to pay it after all.

Your response: What happens to her if she gives away that information?

NPC: I believe with all the fuss that happened lately she will just be stripped of her ranks. To fire her would only cause unnecessary attention to these cases.

Your response: Alright, I'll do it.

NPC: She can be found in this district. She likes to spend her lunch break at Chez Sypher. Report everything to Mr McMillan back here.

NPC: That's a pity. Make sure to call us if you decide to do it after all.

NPC: I thought you already have your assignment?!Visit Andressa right on the backside of the BioTech building.

NPC: The owner of the networking station, a certain Beckert, did send us information. We now have a list of people who rented that station. That is why we need you for another assignment. If you are ready, that is.

Your response: Of course, after all I am a member of BioTech just as you are and it is just as well my business.

Your response: I don't think I can do this job.

NPC: I am glad to hear that. The list highlights one person who had access to the network station at that specific time. It is a certain Grand who can be found in Outzone 01.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: We have contacted CityAdmin and it appears that he is well known to the authorities as a prominent hacker. He doesn't belong to any faction and would do everything for money.

Your response: That does not sound very comforting. How does that help us?

NPC: You have to find a way to force him to reveal who is behind all this. And he can possibly undo what damage he already did.

Your response: I am already on the way. What methods should I use?

Your response: What should I do if I have to kill someone to complete the mission?

NPC: That is up to you. Use all methods that you have at your disposal. After that you can inform McMillan about the progress of the current situation.

NPC: Regrettable. Especially this job would have been of a special importance. But I don't want to force you.

NPC: Good luck with your task. Did you already visit that Hacker in the Outzone 01?

NPC: Find the Twilight Guardian Contact in Pepper Park 3 and kill him.

Your response: Pepper Park 3, got it.

NPC: Good luck with your mission. Use whatever means you think are necessary.

NPC: BioTech decided to determine who is pulling the strings in this. Once we found him these rumours will soon stop flooding the network. A creature without its head is a dead creature, it was always like that and it will always be like that.

Your response: I'll gladly try my best for BioTech. Where do I start?

Your response: If you think about me, I cannot do it at the moment...

NPC: It seems that this hacker, Grand is his name I think, is suited for what we have in mind. Visit him again. Motivate him to find out who started all this. Who has declared open war on us.

Your response: I believe that will be a piece of cake.

NPC: You can offer him a small sum of 10000 Credits as compensation. It could help to support his motivation. Of course this will be sponsored by the company. Good luck.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: If the hacker should be succesful be sure to meet McMillan as well. He will discuss the next steps with you.

NPC: But it would have been very important to Biotech. Well, whatever you mean. But you are letting BioTech down this time, really.

NPC: Did you already visit Grand in the Outzone 01?

NPC: I am rather busy. Please move on.

NPC: I am pleased to hear that. According to this data you are on a respectable status. Very well, the faction fee will be 300 000 credits.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• No remorse and no mercy! That is bad for business, understand? Now that you know the most important rule you could make a delivery for us. entries.title: Epiccityadmin
entries.description: Quest-related dialogue from the game files.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Important Datacube
• Package with Drugs

POSSIBLE COST
• 300,000 credits (depends on choice)

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Nowadays everybody knows what he may or may not do. The success can be seen in Plaza or ViaRosso, there the criminality equals zero.

• Yes, but there is also something that many people do not know. There is a certain number of CopBots that vanish from the streets of Neocron each year. There are even reports about Amok CopBots in the Wastelands. CopBots that run crazy.

• Yes, exactly, you have a keen mind. That is exactly what we need. Your assignment is to see a certain Elias at the Tech Haven in E_07 and to ask him about possible connections between the Fallen Agnels and the stolen CopBot.

• I thought you wanted to investigate the case about the lost CopBot? You should visit Elias in Tech Haven and report any news to the NCPD.

• Are you already following the hackers trail? You might want to visit that Cole in Outzone sector 01 again.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
