NPC: I am sorry but you don't belong to our faction. Please don't waste my time. Unless you plan to join our faction?!

Your response: That's why I am here. I would like to join your faction.

Your response: I'm not interested. Goodbye.

NPC: You have already done more than enough for the CityAdmin. But you could still found a clan and support us with it.

NPC: I fear you are not qualified enough, return once you have acquired more experience. (next mission at level 10)

NPC: You have already done more than enough for the CityAdmin. But you could still found a clan and support us with it.

NPC: Those investigations seem to take longer than you originally planned, don't they? At least there are no new murders to report at the moment. Keep on top of it, though.

Your response: Don't worry, I will determine the exact position of the stolen CopBot.

NPC: I have a confirmation from the NCPD now. There are only two possible target persons that could have been the mysterious hackers. They have been determined with the help of your list.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: A problem surfaced that is directly related to you, I fear. A datacube was found, a datacube with propagande material from the Twilight Guardian.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: The NCPD still has all hands full closely investigating these murders. But there is still the safetey of Neocron that cannot be neglected.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Something came up again. Do you remember the murder of Defries? Well, its seems that this was not supposed to be the end. There was another murder of a CityAdmin employee of a similar rank to Defries.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Welcome to the CityAdmin. To join us was possibly the best choice you ever did. CityAdmin is the biggest official institution for the safety of the citizens of Neocron. And everything thanks to Lioon Reza.

Your response: Since I now belong to the CityAdmin I thought I could get some sort of employment.

NPC: I was just about to get there. As a loyal member of the CityAdmin it is expected of you that you accept certain paid assignments. You are free to accept these assignments but who would reject a request of the one institution that is responsible for the wellfare of every person in Neocron?

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: After all the CityAdmin is working for the citizens unlike the previous dictatorship of the psi monks. At that time every thought was controlled by them and the people lived in virtual slavery. Many people forget who freed them from all that.

Your response: But is it that different today? I mean, you can be executed for uttering the wrong word.

NPC: Don't continue. I'll give you a good advice since you are new here. There are no rumours about the CityAdmin, you either accept it or you don't. This is especially true about Reza. If you don't heed my warning you might be punished with death rather sooner than later. And all that just because you could not keep your mouth shut.

Your response: I understand. I will consider your advice. Then tell me what is important about the CityAdmin?

NPC: Well. As I have stated earlier, Reza has freed the people from the cruel dictatorship of the psi monks after more than one hundred years of rulership. That happened in the year 2724 as far as I recall. That was also the begin of a new era of freedom.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: The psi monks owe it to the generosity of Lion Reza that they are still allowed to live in the city. Apart from that many new improvements were made so that the citizens would have an easier time. For example the law was simplified.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Nowadays everybody knows what he may or may not do. The success can be seen in Plaza or ViaRosso, there the criminality equals zero.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: And all of this despite the great difficulties after so many people left with the great trek in the search for Irata III. At that time criminality increased dramatically. It is only thanks to the CopBots  that there is still order within the city.

Your response: Do you know what happened to the people who joined the great trek? I mean after the contact to Irata III broke off?

NPC: That is easy to answer. The great trek is a long way from reaching Irata II. The efforts of the CityAdmin is concentrated on the safety and wellfare of the citizens of Neocron.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But enough of those old stories. There is a delivery to be made to the NCPD in Viarosso 3. And once you are already there you might also be able to help the NCPD a little. Neocron is big and there is always plenty to do.

Your response: Good, I will deliver this package. What does it contain?

Your response: I don't think I am ready for that yet.

NPC: It contains some evidence in the form of drugs that are registered in connection with a crime. If you want to know more, I am sure you can get more information at the NCPD. Good luck with your first assignment for the CityAdmin.

NPC: If you think so. Please return if you are ready.

NPC: I hope this will not spread even further. In any case, the NCPD has allocated all available forces to the investigation of this case.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: It does not seem that easy any longer to solve this mstery since all investigations usually stop in a dead end. Come on, it cannot be possible that there are so many enemies of the CityAdmin to justify such a lengthy investigation...

Your response: I believe you underestimate that.

NPC: The main enemy is the Twilight Guardian. They constantly try to disrupt the authority of the CityAdmin, but that is nothing new. Apart from the Twilight Guardian there is only Crahn, Tsunami and the Black Dragon left.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But Tsunami and Black Dragon are too occupied with their own business and their rivalry. And Crahn is only a remnant of their broken government. They still mourn after their lost power.

Your response: But you underestimate the personal motivations that could lead people to despise the CityAdmin.

NPC: I believe you are wrong there, the CityAdmin is fully supported by its citizens. Some citizens even control Neocron together with Reza. But that is not why I wanted to speak with you. The NCPD is very taxed at the moment.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: That is why the CityAdmin decided to allow Runners to investigate into that as well and thus help the NCPD. Informations about various contacts have been forwarded to me and I have subsequently assigned the appropriate resulting missions to several Runners.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Unfortunately those Runners who volunteer for such a task or who are qualified enough are a rare breed. That is why I thought about you.

Your response: You are telling me that I am not qualified enough?! And now you are asking me because you have no other Runners left?!!

NPC: My reasoning is not subject to a debate. Even if you do not seem to accept it, there are Runners that are better suited for such a job than you are. I did not want to express it in such a harsh manner, however.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: If you decide not to follow up this assignment I will of course have to make a note in your file. You should have learned to control your temperament by now.

Your response: Alright, I am cool. What is the assignment all about?

Your response: I am not yet in the mood for another task.

NPC: NCPD has informed us that a certain contact person of the Tsunamis with the name of Hontoka is interested in selling information to us. It could be important for the murder case but since the information is offered by a Tsunami I do not know how reliable it will be. I doubt it to be honest.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But the CityAdmin would not be where it is today if it did not take all possibilities into consideration. You can find him in the Industrial district 02. If you get enough information talk to officer Jenna afterwards. You have already met her, I assume?

NPC: Focus on the assignment. Hontoka is still waiting in Industrial 02 for you. If you have enough information go and visit the NCPD.

NPC: Why don't you rest a little and come back when you feel that you are ready for a new assignment.

NPC: We decided to give an ambitious Runner a task that would suit him. I believe you already had the opportunity to have a closer look at the CopBots on the streets?

Your response: Yes, they are very impressive.

NPC: Yes, but there is also something that many people do not know. There is a certain number of CopBots that vanish from the streets of Neocron each year. There are even reports about Amok CopBots in the Wastelands. CopBots that run crazy.

Your response: Unthinkable! What ever would happen if a CopBot freaked out on the streets of Neocron?

NPC: Do not worry. The CopCot system is very effective in dealing with these issues. But there is also a different situation. Some CopBots are stolen before they are activated. That happens very rarely and usually it only takes hours to solve these crimes.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But... in this case it was only discovered that a CopBot was missing when it was supposed to be switched on. That happened about two month ago and there is not a single clue to its whereabouts.

Your response: How do you normally deal with these situations?

NPC: There is a small radio probe that is hidden inside the CopBot. It sends out a signal to the HQ as soon as the CopBot is activated. But this time it has not been activated or the radio probe was removed.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: If that is the case it must have been executed by some kind of hacking genius. Even our hackers can only do it with some special equipment.

Your response: Well, but where can you find such a hacker? ...maybe ...the Fallen Angels!!

NPC: Yes, exactly, you have a keen mind. That is exactly what we need. Your assignment is to see a certain Elias at the Tech Haven in E_07 and to ask him about possible connections between the Fallen Agnels and the stolen CopBot.

Your response: Tell me more.

Your response: I am not yet ready for another task.

NPC: Once you are done give officer Jenna a report of the situation. Thank you in advance from the CityAdmin. The Fallen Angels are neutral to us which means that they should cooperate.

NPC: Come back when you have prepared yourself.

NPC: I thought you wanted to investigate the case about the lost CopBot? You should visit Elias in Tech Haven and report any news to the NCPD.

NPC: That fact alone would not be very exceptional. But this datacube has been tracked back to you. You know what that means.

Your response: But that cannot be! I would never...

NPC: Calm down. I have not notified a CopBot yet, did I? But you will surely understand that something like that would result in the execution of the owner of that datacube?

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Propaganda like that is prohibited within Neocron.

Your response: Yes but somebody must have set me up! I have only given one person a datacube recently. He must be the one who did it!!

NPC: CityAdmin is fully aware of the fact that somebody could try and trick one of our employees. Standard procedur is to give the person in question a time limit to prove his innocence.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: I know that you have really had some accomplishments recently and that's why I am willing to give you some extra time. You should start to collect evidence right now because you don't have an eternity left.

Your response: But how? I don't even know where I could start!

NPC: You should start where you have lost that datacube or where you have given it away. Here is the datacube with the propaganda material.

Your response: It must have been that Hontoka guy in the Industrial district 02. I have given him a datacube.

NPC: It's up to you now. CityAdmin can't afford to follow up every case like this one. If you cannot prove your innocence you are guilty.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Go and get some hard evidence or suffer the consequences.

NPC: I fear you don't have enough time left for a break. But that is your choice.

NPC: I suggest, since you have organised the list in the first place that you will also help to track down the hacker.

Your response: Very well, what I started I am going to finish.

Your response: I fear I am not ready yet for such an endeavour.

NPC: Glad to hear that. CityAdmin depends on Runners with willpower like yours. You should talk with the contact person who gave you the list in the first place first. He might know even more about the individual persons since he compiled that list.

Your response: You mean this annoying Ethan Cole, am I right?

NPC: Possible. Remember that this hacker will most likely not have worked alone. And I also have some bad news, I fear.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Another murder was committed since the last time. The investigations are thoroughly stuck even though every new trail is closely examined.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Maybe you should concentrate on finding this hacker and the stolen CopBot first. So, do not worry too much about the murders at the moment.

Your response: That's fine with me. Consider it done.

NPC: Good luck.

NPC: Don't rest too long, though, unless another murder happens.

NPC: Are you already following the hackers trail? You might want to visit that Cole in Outzone sector 01 again.

NPC: Does that mean you have a clue?

Your response: I think I have. I still need to visit a ... ahem ... contact person who will reveal the exact location to me.

NPC: Good luck.

NPC: I thought you have a clue that you can follow up. You should visit Jenna at the NCPD once you have more information.

NPC: I am rather busy. Please move on.

NPC: I am pleased to hear that. According to this data you are on a respectable status. Very well, the faction fee will be 300 000 credits.

Your response: That's a pretty hefty sum.

NPC: You better go now, we don't want scum like you in our faction.

NPC: If you don't want to spend the money we will know for certain how serious you were with your plans. If you pay you will also show your dedication towards our faction.

Your response: Very well, I will pay.

Your response: Forget it, I am not going to spend that much money for this kind of crap.

NPC: A wise decision!

Your response: *click*

NPC: You're a member of a clan... You can't change your faction, when you're in a clan!

NPC: It's a shame that you don't have enough money to pay for your entry, don't you think?

NPC: Welcome at the CityAdmin.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Medicine Package

POSSIBLE COST
• 300,000 credits (depends on choice)

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Alright. Lets take it one little baby step at a time. Have a look around and think about it. Think about yourself and whether or not you want to spend your future with us. Oh, before I forget. You could do me a favor and deliver this package of medicine to the platoon leader Marcel. His guys have been wounded in their last mission. You can find him in sector 3 of the Military Base. Try one of the various storage halls. Don't ask me why, but he seems to like it down there.

• In order to become a Rookie you need to fight against three persons of our choosing. It took some time but we have some suitable enemies for you. The first one is Frederick, another Rookie wannabe like you. Then there is Claudia and Erik, they already are with us. You just need to beat  them in a fair fight and you will be a CityMerc Rookie. They can all be found in Military Base Sector 3. Come back to me once you have won the fight.

• Very good. You better look for Mitchell first, he can be found just outside the Military Base in the Wastelands. His job is to observe the movements of Warbots and their likes and to warn us if there is any danger. Basically he is already a Black Ribbon but he seems to be more comfortable out there in the Wastelands.

• You can find Mitchell outside the Military Base. Afterwards Marcel in Military Base Sector 3 might have more for you.

• I think there is. Marcel has organised something. Tangent is the client I am lead to believe. You should find Gerome at the entrance to the Fallen Angel Tech Haven in G_07. He should be able to tell you more about it. I will contact the Black Ribbons and tell them that you are on that case.

• If you want this assignment then you better take care of it. Gerome can be found in front of one of the entrances to Tech Haven in G_07.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

POSSIBLE COST
• 300,000 credits (depends on choice)

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Father Manus was not able to find out anything new about those relics of yours. Unfortunately we only have a limited library right here, that's why he decided to ask father Agnus's help. Agnus is one of the few loyal Crahn followers who decided to stay in the old monastery in the Outzone near Neocron. After he compared the relics with some of our oldest recorded inscriptions he was able to determine something new about it. He was very excited when he told me about it. But you better speak to him yourself. Go to the old abbey in the Outzone and meet him there.

• Cole did work for the Fallen Angels a long time. The Fallen Angels are an association of scientists who live exiled in the Wastelands. Their base of operations, a Mekka of sin, is Tech Haven. The relationship between the brotherhood and the Fallen Angels is strained because of some unfortunate events, but that doesn't mean that we aren't interested in cooperating with former Tech Haven scientists.

• Cole waits in Pepper Park 3.

• May I point you to your assignment? The mission is not yet accomplished. Mark can be found in Pepper Park 3. And don't forget that Father Manus is waiting for you as well.

• As you know, I am speaking about the Fallen Angels. The very group that journeyed into the Wastelands in the year of 2633 in order to errect the Tech Haven laboratory there.

• Well, we will have an eye for an eye. Our high brother Gabriel succeeded to infiltrate the Fallen Angels and to be recognized as one of them after years of meticulous planning. He worked for them the last two years in Tech Haven and has become a trusted right hand of Sylvia Bennet.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.

He did not say what kind of object he was referring to. The order is not sure whether or not Cole is trustworthy and we do not want that Cole develops an aloofness.

Your response: He is not even one of us, why would any father stoop as low as to visit him?

NPC: But since we still need to find out about this object I ask you to get it from Cole and deliver it to Father Manus right here in the monastery. So that Father Manus will be able to examine it more closely.

Your response: Who exactly is Mark Cole and who are the Fallen Angels?

NPC: Cole did work for the Fallen Angels a long time. The Fallen Angels are an association of scientists who live exiled in the Wastelands. Their base of operations, a Mekka of sin, is Tech Haven. The relationship between the brotherhood and the Fallen Angels is strained because of some unfortunate events, but that doesn't mean that we aren't interested in cooperating with former Tech Haven scientists.

Your response: Doesn't Cole work for them any longer? What happened?

NPC: In contrary to what he said, Cole was banished from the ranks of the Fallen Angels after he tried to sell secret science projects of the Angels.

Your response: Where can I find Cole exactly?

NPC: Cole waits in Pepper Park 3.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Afterwards, give Father Manus my best regards. His work is an inspiration for all of us. Would you like to accept this assignment?

Your response: Yes, ... I will not disappoint Crahn.

NPC: May your mission be guarded by the holy Crahn.

NPC: May I point you to your assignment? The mission is not yet accomplished. Mark can be found in Pepper Park 3. And don't forget that Father Manus is waiting for you as well.

NPC: Return here once you feel that you could stand up to the challenge.

NPC: Ok then... in the old days when Shirkan and Neopha Kansil still preached the word of Crahn in the streets of Neocron and the city was under the control of our fathers a small upstart group of scientists  managed to escape our grasp.

Your response: I think I read about this somewhere.

NPC: As you know, I am speaking about the Fallen Angels. The very group that journeyed into the Wastelands in the year of 2633 in order to errect the Tech Haven laboratory there.

Your response: Yes father, I have thoroughly studied the history of Neocron and of our order.

NPC: The history books do not tell the whole truth, young monk. In the eyes of a Neocron citizen the Fallen Angels are a harmless group of scientists... but we PSI Monks know the truth.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: The Fallen Angels are child murderers and thieves. Within the confines of secret laboratories they conduct abhorrent experiments on humans, the details of which I will spare you.

Your response: But I thought the Fallen Angels are solely for the good of humanity...

NPC: Quiet! ... Never believe the lying propaganda of the Angels. Only the Brotherhood of Crahn knows the way of the light... It is evil enough that the Fallen Angels conduct their dark experiments before the very eyes of the public.

Your response: So they are only pretending?

NPC: ... but the worst for our order is that their work is based on our research. The Fallen Angels would never have developed the NeuroLink System if their leader Thomas Cooper would not have taken a generous helping of our research documents.

Your response: Oh sister, tell me how I can help the order in this.

NPC: Well, we will have an eye for an eye. Our high brother Gabriel succeeded to infiltrate the Fallen Angels and to be recognized as one of them after years of meticulous planning. He worked for them the last two years in Tech Haven and has become a trusted right hand of Sylvia Bennet.

Your response: I understand that I am supposed to go and meet him. Where can I find them?

NPC: He should already have returned from the Angels, meet him in Pepper Park 3. He will hand a holodisc over to you which contains important research data about the Fallen Angels. Father Manus will be waiting for you to deliver the holodisc to him. He should be in the Crahn Monastery.

Your response: Thus it shall be.

NPC: Take care not to draw any attention. There could be Fallen Angels in the vicinity. They must not see that brother Gabriel has contact to us. Walk in the light of Crahn.

NPC: You should better prepare yourself and come back later.

NPC: This task is not solving itself, you know? You were supposed to meet Gabriel in Pepper Park 3 and get the item you get to father Manus at our monastery.

NPC: This means that you will be charged with missions now that are regarding internal affairs of the order. You have to treat those missions with confidentiality.

Your response: I feel honoured, sister. How can I serve the order this time?

Your response: I don't yet feel that I am enlightened enough, father.

NPC: Our friend, Mark Cole, has informed the council that he supposedly has information about a secret meeting between the Fallen Angels and the representatives of the Anarchy Breed.

Your response: A secret meaning? What can this mean?

NPC: There have been rumours about an alliance between those two factions for a long time, but until now we could not get any details about the state of their negotiations. Meet Cole and listen to what he has to say.

Your response: Where do I meet Cole?

NPC: Where should this good-for-nothing person be? He is still in Pepper Park 3 and tries to sell his supposedly important information to the highest bidder.

Your response: Very well.

NPC: But be careful... you know, that he is an unpleasent fellow. May Crahn bless your mission.

NPC: Then go forth and work with that goal in mind. If you feel prepared we will offer you the same mission once more.

NPC: May Crahn bless you.

NPC: It is told like that in the whole order. Well... if you want to be accepted into the black circle then you have to complete a trial from a father of the black circle.

Your response: I am ready for this trial. Tell me more.

Your response: I don't feel that I am worthy enough.

NPC: The PSI monks of the black circle excell in their wisdom but also especially in their power and strength. A monk of the black circle must be able to survive even in the darkest and most dangerous areas in the Wastelands.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Go to father Morpheus, you can find him in the abandoned ruins of Crest Village. He will give you your task and send you on your pilgrimage. May Crahn bless your trial.

NPC: Then you should better prepare yourself.

NPC: You should talk to father Morpheus in the Crest village.

NPC: He is certain that the old Kev Critter still possesses a construction plan which should allow you to assemble the PSI amplifier out of the fragments.

Your response: These are good news. Where can I find this Kev Critter?

NPC: Kev is running a second hand metal shop in the Wastelands at the Blakkmist Creek. Officially his business is a garbage dump. You can meet him at the Blakkmist garbage dump.

Your response: Is there anything else you can tell me about him?

NPC: Critter is a foolish old man who can turn into a clever fox if he smells a good deal.

Your response: He wouldn't be the first.

NPC: So be careful and don't let him see how much you want the construction plan. You will only unnecessarily raise the price for it. Father Agnus will certainly help you once you have the blueprint.

Your response: Thank you, I will heed your advice. May Crahn be with you.

NPC: Thank you father. Good luck with your mission.

NPC: Didn't you want to visit Kev Critter at the Blakkmist garbage dump?

NPC: I am rather busy. Please move on.

NPC: I am pleased to hear that. According to this data you are on a respectable status. Very well, the faction fee will be 300 000 credits.

Your response: That's a pretty hefty sum.

NPC: You better go now, we don't want scum like you in our faction.

NPC: If you don't want to spend the money we will know for certain how serious you were with your plans. If you pay you will also show your dedication towards our faction.

Your response: Very well, I will pay.

Your response: Forget it, I am not going to spend that much money for this kind of crap.

NPC: A wise decision!

Your response: *click*

NPC: You're a member of a clan... You can't change your faction, when you're in a clan!

NPC: It's a shame that you don't have enough money to pay for your entry, don't you think?

NPC: Welcome in the ranks of the Brotherhood.

• Don't forget to be friendly. You can find the clients in Plaza 02 and ViaRosso 03. They will probably wait in one of the Restaurants there.

• That is good. The threat posed by these gangs of criminals is growing and growing. Of course every single one of them was sent by the Black Dragon, there is no doubt about it. Your response: I have urgent other matters to attend to.

Your response: I am sorry, but I don't yet feel ready for another assignment.

New is that some people now believe they could take advantage of our current situation.

Your response: Can it be? They are just waiting like carrion birds it seems.

NPC: A productive day to you. I believe you might be interested in doing something for Diamond again, yes?

Your response: You have guessed right. I think I have prepared myself well.

Your response: To be honest, I believe I am not ready yet.

NPC: Ahh, welcome at Diamond. We have closely followed your progress so far and some people here were very impressed. To say the least. It was decided to give you an assignment that requires a certain skill.

Your response: I am pleased to hear that.

Your response: Before I accept such an assignment I believe I should prepare myself better.

NPC: As you might already know we face certain difficulties because of these unpredictable Black Dragons. They are ruthless criminals who would refrain from nothing to reach their goals. Ever since Diamond was privatised in 2046 the Black Dragons were the most serious threat we had to deal with.

Your response: Why? What do they want? Diamond only trades in real estate.

NPC: Yes, exactly. The Black Dragon aim to dominate the real estate market and the only way to achieve that is to disable Diamond. We already had to decrease our efforts in the Pepper Park Area since the Black Dragon threaten our clients. Even Eric Danmund himself, the head of Diamond has declared a state of emergency.

Your response: This is bad, but I thought you wanted to tell me about my assignment.

NPC: Of course but I thought you should have some background knowledge. Too many people don't know that almost all appartements and shops are property of Diamond. Except for the problems with the Black Dragons. It has become even worse recently. They already have forced some of our clients away from us. Diamond would like you to visit two persons who want to cancel their contracts with us. You should try and convince them to rethink their decision. Obviously the Black Dragon have something to do with this. After you convinced them you could go to the NCPD and make sure that they are aware of the problem with the Black Dragon.

Your response: Where can I find those two persons? I will give it my best shot.

NPC: The first client, Thompson, can be found in Plaza 02, he agreed to a meeting in Gariots Diner. The other one, Foster, can be found in ViaRosso 03. If you still have time after that you should really visit the NCPD in Viarosso 3, talk to Jenna, and report back to me with the results of your work.

NPC: Don't forget to be friendly. You can find the clients in Plaza 02 and ViaRosso 03. They will probably wait in one of the Restaurants there.

NPC: Please do so. Always be prepared. Come back once you think you have sufficiently prepared yourself.

NPC: That is good. The threat posed by these gangs of criminals is growing and growing. Of course every single one of them was sent by the Black Dragon, there is no doubt about it. Mr. Danmund has therefore prepared a contract between us and the CityMercs for the protection of our appartements. A meeting was arranged near an abandoned broadcasting station in the Wastelands.

Your response: That was direly needed. It can't go on like this.

NPC: Precisely... we still need some documents for this meeting, though. There are two copies to be collected from the CityAdmin HQ in Plaza 1. They have been checking them for loopholes in the contract.

Your response: I am on my way.

NPC: Very well, don't forget to return these documents to me. The CityAdmin employee should have prepared everything for you.

NPC: Don't waste any time.

NPC: Some independent real estate merchants are taking advantage of the opening we provide to sell their appartements at a higher price. That is of course an unbearable situation.

Your response: I can easily imagine that this is damaging for the business. But what can be done against it?

NPC: Diamond wants to interest those real estate dealers in Diamond. By doing so we would not only have more vendors and appartements but also get rid of some unwanted competition.

Your response: That sounds logical, though it might cost a lot. Is there a job for me related to this?

Your response: If this is supposed to be a mission for me, then I have to turn it down for the moment.

NPC: I was just about to offer you to try and convince one of those freelance vendors to join our ranks. The payment is subject to discussion.

Your response: I can give it a try at least. Usually those kind of freelancers are not easily convinced.

NPC: In case you should succeed Diamond will offer a bonus to you. Good luck. His name is Simmons and he can be found in Pepper Park 02. A meeting was arranged the Red Pepper Bar there.

NPC: It is your decision but these assignments won't be available forever.

NPC: He didn't say anything about that. But he specifically asked for you and was convinced that he could do something against the Black Dragon. And those bastards are giving us a lot of trouble recently. He needs your help, though. Seeing that he joined us because of your influence you did earn the bonus for convincing him. It is 8000 Credits, you'll get it once you completed this assignment. But don't waste your time, you can find him in the Pepper Park 02 area again.

NPC: It is your decision. Be sure to check back once you changed your mind.

NPC: Then you are one of the few lucky guys that have not been affected by these incidents. The Black Dragon are trying to force our clients away. They are using a mixture of Violence and Threats. And we now know their overall tactics.

Your response: Why then is it so difficult to prevent all this?

Your response: I hope we did not loose too many people.

NPC: That is our very real problem right now. To be honest, everything around here is on the verge of breaking down. Our clients are running away and nobody wants to buy Diamond estates any more. I don't want to alarm you but this is exactly the reason why we need every help we can get.

NPC: You better go now, we don't want scum like you in our faction.

NPC: If you don't want to spend the money we will know for certain how serious you were with your plans. If you pay you will also show your dedication towards our faction.

Your response: Very well, I will pay.

Your response: Forget it, I am not going to spend that much money for this kind of crap.

Your response: No. I have no interest in that. Until later...

NPC: I am sorry but the only other way you could help us is to found a new clan and support us.

Your response: This is not fair. Grimm should be banned. I almost got killed because of hihs scheming.

NPC: Constantine informed me that she would like to speak to you. The topic she says is a person you only know too well.

Your response: I will visit her immediately.

Your response: It just isn't possible at the moment...

NPC: Grimm in the Tech Core would like to talk to you. He sounded rather excited and already looked for you all over the place. But he did not want to tell us what this is all about. Maybe you know what this is all about.

Your response: No. I have not the slightest idea.

Your response: I still have some urgent matters to attend to...

NPC: Your registration process is completed. Here is your ID Cube.

Your response: IC Cube? What is it good for?

NPC: Welcome to the Fallen Angels. there are only a few formalities left. Please be patient you will receive your ID cube later on. Officially you now belong to us. the Fallen Angels. In addition to the membership you receive some new duties since we are not out here to just daydream our life away. If you already feel comfortable you could already accept a task.

Your response: Of course. After all that is exactly why I joined the Fallen Angels in the first place.

NPC: I am pleased to hear that. As you probably know. every member of the Fallen Angels is a scientist to a certain degree. But because we did not yet fully analyse your qualities we cannot give you a suitable assignment just yet. It would be best if you would be willing to accept a small delivery job in the meanwhile. Sylvia Bennet released the latest test results on the various projects of our research. There wasn't time yet to hand them all out. however. Would you be willing to deliver one set of documents for us?

Your response: Alright. even if I am not usually keen on these kind of jobs. Where should I bring it to?

Your response: I don't believe I am ready for something like that just now.

NPC: Much of the research here is focused into discovering a way to return radioactivity and the environment back to a healthy level. Basically anything you can think of is being researched down there. You can have a good look around on your way there. Fallen Angel installations are always worth a look.

Your response: Don't worry. I will make sure that this is delivered safely.

NPC: View this as an opportunity for quick money. Deliver the package to Grimm in the Tech Core and extend my greetings to him.

NPC: Then just return once you feel more comfortable here.

NPC: It contains all your personal information and confirms your official affiliation with the Fallen Angels. Of course there is also a second copy of your personal data. Let's talk about something of more important. Judging from the analysis of your personal data the Scientist Council decided to assign an independent research project to you.

Your response: A research project for me? Thank you. but what does that mean? And what do I have to do with it?

Your response: I don't think I am suited for that task. Not yet. I am sorry.

NPC: You will get a project that you will have to research on your own. The list of projects you can choose from is limited. though. After all the project should comply with the greater goals of the Fallen Angels. At least you will get the help of a personal assistant who will lend you a hand now and then.

Your response: That sounds very good. But where should I start?

NPC: Grimm from the has been given the relevant information from the Scientist Council. He will inform you about who will be your personal assistant. Good luck. Your research results will decide over your future rank here with us.

NPC: It's alright. if you don't feel up to this task.

NPC: You better visit him soon. I hope it was nothing serious.

NPC: Did you already visit Grimm in the Tech Core? It sounded pretty important.

NPC: As you wish but I am sure that Grimm will not be pleased.

NPC: Apart from that there are no real news.

NPC: Hmm. all right but just don't let her wait too long...

NPC: Didn't you want to speak to Constantine in the Tech Core?

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Packet with Contracts

POSSIBLE COST
• 300,000 credits (depends on choice)

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• NEXT would like to offer you to test drive one of our experimental vehicle. Mason might have already mentioned it to you. You can fetch the keys for the vehicle from the technician Benji at the desert race track in sector G 11. Your task is to do extensive tests of the vehicle in the surrounding desert.

• Ahh, you are back. I fear we do not have another official assignment for you. But I wanted to ask you if you could go and check on old Torben in the Pepper Park subway station. He didn't want to talk to me but I know he has a problem if he doesn't pick up his work again soon.

• It is called Tech Haven, am I right?

• Yes. Some people would even call it the technical paradise. Why? Well, you will be able to see that for yourself when you get there. It can be found in the Wastelands in E_07 and has a very interesting historical background. But I don't want to bore you with old stories. NEXT wants you for a meeting with a certain Elias from the Fallen Angels. He should wait in one of the entrances to Tech Haven.

• Good luck and take care when crossing the Wastelands, it might be dangeorous.

• Have you already met Elias at Tech Haven?

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.

NPC: There is another opportunity to do something for NEXT. It is not easy to explain because opinions vary greatly amongst the citizens of Neocron. Many opinions regarding the Fallen Angels are based on lies and prejudices which rarely are based on facts that really speak against them.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: From Hoverbikes over subways to  spaceships even, all are produced by NEXT. But in order to remain at the top of this market we are obliged to have good business connections to every other company. Would you want to help us with that or do you still need time to make yourself feel at home?

Your response: CONTINUE

The head of NEXT, Craig Diggers, is determined to reanimate the spaceship projects.

Your response: Does he have a special reason to be so determined?

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Have you already delivered that package to the BioTech Director of Operations in Viarosso 1?

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE

entries.conversation:
NPC: I am sorry but you don't belong to our faction. Please don't waste my time. Unless you plan to join our faction?!

Your response: That's why I am here. I would like to join your faction.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Important Packet for NExT
• Package with Alcohol

POSSIBLE COST
• 300,000 credits (depends on choice)

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Please wait until I am finished talking. The small task for you is to visit NEXT, Daimond Real Estate and the Pepper Park. Pepper Park is quite an infamous and dirty area. Take care in those districts.

• You have also mentioned the Pepper Park, what is the story behind that?

• It is not that important . Visit a person named Figaro in Pepper Park 03. He will provide you with a package that you should bring back here. Is that clear so far?

• Matt Tronstett is his name. According to our latest information he lives at Point Red in the Wastelands. You know, sector B_07.

• Have you convinced Tronstett already? He lives in Point Red in B_07 in the Wastelands.

• There is no law in the Wastelands so be careful. Don't stay too long out there or you might catch a nasty mutation. If you find out anything interesting just come back here and report to me.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: I am sorry but you need to finish your running mission before i can offer you a new.

NPC: I am sorry but you don't belong to our faction. Please don't waste my time. Unless you plan to join our faction?!

Your response: That's why I am here. I would like to join your faction.

Your response: I'm not interested. Goodbye.

NPC: I am sorry but the only means of supporting us now  is to found a clan and support us with it.

NPC: You are not experienced enough, return after you have trained some more. (next mission at level 10)

NPC: You are not experienced enough, return after you have trained some more. (next mission at level 20)

NPC: You are not experienced enough, return after you have trained some more. (next mission at level  30)

NPC: You are not experienced enough, return after you have trained some more. (next mission at level  35)

NPC: You are not experienced enough, return after you have trained some more. (next mission at level  40)

NPC: You are not experienced enough, return after you have trained some more. (next mission at level  45)

NPC: I am sorry but the only means of supporting us now  is to found a clan and support us with it.

NPC: You are already near to famous here at Tangent. I even heard somebody talk about you out on the streets.

Your response: Thanks, but I am only doing my job.

NPC: Something unforeseen happened last night. Our laboratory was sabotaged and some sub systems of our network have been hacked. Luckily Chester Cohor was able to scan the ID of the hackers before everything went down.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: A message was sent to your contact person from BioTech in which we announced our interest in the blueprint of the prototype. We have of course tried to match his price but...

Your response: He rejected your offer? The blueprint is sold already?

NPC: What a strange coincidence that you would come right when we need you. The beam weapon project is progressing in big steps. A test run has already been made to see the effects it has on various materials. It is all very convincing. Only that alone is not sufficient for Tangent.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: There are good news. The CityAdmin decided to commission a new kind of beam weapon. Naturally Tangent is one of the main contenders for that assignment.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Welcome Runner! We are always pleased to see a new face around here. Tangent has always been rather close to their people. Of course in a special way.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: We supply everybody with the means to create his own reality. As you might have noticed I am speaking about the weapons that Tangent produces. I mean you can imagine that they are very popular especially here within Neocron. Even I have a Tangent Assault Rifle stowed away in my appartement.

Your response: I am glad to finally belong to a faction which deals realistically with the people. No bullshit about peace and freedom.

NPC: Of course, that is one of our highest goals. Every client is very important and many campaigns are running which serve to raise consumer interest in our products.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But Tangent is mainly concerned about the different aspects of weapon production. Maybe I should tell you something about the background of the company first? Just to give you a short overview.

Your response: I was just about to ask you about that.

NPC: Tangent Technologies came into existence in the year 2748. At that time it split from its mother company BioTech since Tangent has grown too much to still be only a part of BioTech.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Since then Tangent has constantly surpassed its mother company on many levels. The CityAdmin gave many lucrative commissions to Tangent because Tangent's focus was always the specialisation in weapon products.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: By selling weapons to the general public of Neocron a new and constant stream of income was secured as well. And even though BioTech uses every means at its disposal to force us from that leading position Tangent is still ever progressing and looking for higher goals.

Your response: BioTech is actively trying to encumber the efforts of Tangent?

NPC: Yes, in fact, they even resort to violence at times. Officially they will deny that of course. But they have contacts to the Tsunami and invest immense sums just so that they take actions against Tangent.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But these foolish attempts cannot prevent Tangent from reaching its goals. Speaking of which, you are certainly ready to do a task for Tangent aren't you?

Your response: Yes, of course. And I almost thought I don't need to do anything for that Appartement that you gave me.

NPC: Oh, rest assured, the Appartement is totally yours now. Tangent is only considering this first assignment as a favor. You will be paid a small compensation for it.

Your response: It is always pleasant to work for payment. What is the assignment about?

Your response: I don't feel up to such a challenge at the moment.

NPC: It is rather easy. For such a big company like Tangent it is important of course to maintain imprtant relations that keep the big projects running.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: The most important partners are NEXT and Diamond Real Estate. NEXT is cooperating because after all they want to equip their vehicles with our weapon systems.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Of course, that this is in our interest is quite obvious. Diamond Real Estate on the other hand has certain contracts with us to provide their estates with security systems.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: The relation to Diamond has been long and enjoyable. It reaches back quite a while.

Your response: Yes, I have expected such kind of contracts to exist. Isn't it also true that Tangent is providing the weapons for the CopBots?

NPC: Indeed. Of course the CityAdmin has chosen Tangent to care about the equipment of the CopBots. After all Tangent is the biggest independent producer of weapons. This is not only rather lucrative but it is also a task that requires us to deal with it in a responsible way. A lot could go awry if Tangent made the wrong choices.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Tangent is especially concerned about the efficiency of their weapons. The CopBots are supposed to accomplish their tasks as smooth as possible after all. So that the citizens of Neocron can sleep well and safe.

Your response: Very impressive. But you wanted to say something more about the assignment, didn't you?

NPC: Please wait until I am finished talking. The small task for you is to visit NEXT, Daimond Real Estate and the Pepper Park. Pepper Park is quite an infamous and dirty area. Take care in those districts.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: First of all you visit the NEXT director of operations at the NEXT HQ and deliver these important documents. They closely analyze how effective Tangent weapon systems are used in conjunction with the hover technology.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Afterwards please go to the Diamond HQ hand over the other delivery to the real estate broker there.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: It contains an assortment of spirits. Remember that you always have to secure your relations through little gifts.

Your response: You have also mentioned the Pepper Park, what is the story behind that?

NPC: It is not that important . Visit a person named Figaro in Pepper Park 03. He will provide you with a package that you should bring back here. Is that clear so far?

Your response: But of course, I am just the curious kind of guy.

NPC: Curiosity is a blessing if it is not overused. But too much of it can inflict great damage. Go now and don't forget to return the package that you will get to Mazzaro here in the HQ.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Otherwise he will be in a rather bad mood and we really don't want that to happen...

NPC: Then take your time. Prepare yourself and come back once you are ready.

NPC: You should really take this assignment a little bit more serious if you want to become a somebody within Tangent. The broker should be in the DRE HQ.

NPC: Albeit we cannot understand why both BioTech and Tangent have been chosen for the final consideration. It is quite obvious that Tangent has all the necessary knowledge right here.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: I mean, Tangent's only purpose is after all the production and invention of weapons. However the CityAdmin decided to take BioTech into consideration for this project.

Your response: But BioTech should pose no problem for Tangent. Tangent has the advantage in this game.

NPC: Very true. Everybody knows that. BioTech must have used dirty tricks to be offered this kind of deal in the first place.

Your response: When will it be decided who gets the commission?

NPC: Within a limited time frame both companies are to come up with a prototype of the planned beam weapon. The better prototype gets the deal. But I would not count on a fair competition.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: If all this is arranged by BioTech I am certain they already have prepared a sneaky plan.

Your response: Doesn't Tangent have effective mechanisms to deal with such an event?

NPC: BioTech is welcome to try it. They will get what they deserve. For this project Damion Jordan himself expressed a wish that a retired beam expert should join the development team.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: The problem is that the expert already retired about half a year ago. Since you have already completed your first run and showed us that you are loyal to Tangent I thought you could try to convince that expert to come back and work for us again.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: You are supposed to present him an offer he cannot refuse. The offer to be part of the team again. You might have to use your negotiation skills for this one.

Your response: I could at least try it. Where can I find that expert?

Your response: I cannot take this assignment, I fear.

NPC: Matt Tronstett is his name. According to our latest information he lives at Point Red in the Wastelands. You know, sector B_07.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: If you were able to convince him you can see Mazzaro and report to him.

NPC: It would be an important task but you do not have to do it.

NPC: Have you convinced Tronstett already? He lives in Point Red in B_07 in the Wastelands.

NPC: Knowledge is required. Information on the progress of BioTech developments. For this purpose we need a reliable Runner like you to conduct some investigation into that direction.

Your response: Investigation? What kind of investigation?

NPC: Tangent has various methods to get required information. There are many contact persons who would sell their own mother for money. Enough of them to directly play into our hands.

Your response: Isn't spying illegal?

NPC: Spying? You obviously still haven't learnt that Tangent only does what every other company does as well. Which is exactly the reason why Tangent is still in business.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: You can't really be so innocent to believe that other companies don't use the same methods, right? This task is important for the company. And as far as I am concerned you are either for or against Tangent. I would not advise you to be against Tangent.

Your response: I did not want to seem insulting, sorry. It's just...

NPC: Look around and you'll see two possibilities. Either you belong to a powerful faction or... you should decrease your life expectancy accordingly. The contact person for this task can be found at the Catlock Bay in E_12.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: You can offer him up to 10000 credits if you think the information is worth it. He is a Tsunami with the name of Gruber Zakashi. Be on your guard.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: There is no law in the Wastelands so be careful. Don't stay too long out there or you might catch a nasty mutation. If you find out anything interesting just come back here and report to me.

NPC: It is your choice. If you change your mind just come back here.

NPC: Not that, no. I believe he knows that this is a big and powerful company. Tangent would have been able to match any price he could want. No, he expressed that he wanted a different method of payment.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: He said that he still has some unfinished business with the Fallen Angels. It would seem that they refused to hire him on grounds that he is not qualified enough.

Your response: That is not too uncommon. Even Tangent has a bad relationship with the Angels.

NPC: Indeed. But the Fallen Angels were not forced to hack the Tangent system in the first place. That caused quite a chaos and now they are only getting their just reward. I'll come straight to the point. We want you to match the price of the contact person.

Your response: What exactly do I have to do then?

Your response: I cannot do that at the moment. I am sorry.

NPC: It is very simple. Even if we normally do not resort to such actions. You meet up with Max Delavare whom you can find in Outzone Sector 5. He is very experienced when it comes to things like this.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: You tell him that he is supposed to kill 10 Fallen Angels members. That was easy, wasn't it? But tell him not to kill the weak ones, only a little bit more experienced ones.

Your response: If it serves Tangent, I will do it. After all the Fallen Angels attacked in the first place. But I have my doubts.

NPC: You won't get far with that attitude. You have to be willing to walk over some dead bodies for Tangent, now and then. Come on. What do you expect? Tangent produces weapons.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: And for what? Certainly not to blow holes into the sky. The company is worth more than a pesky few mutated Fallen Angels.

Your response: Alright. I already said I'd do it. But I don't believe that a blueprint is ever worth a human life.

NPC: Don't worry about that and leave the moral issues for Tangent. Meet with Max Delavare in Outzone Sector 5. He is Black Dragon. After you have picked up the blueprint Mazzaro wants to talk to you.

NPC: As you wish. but don't count on Tangent always having an assignment for you.

NPC: You have your mission. Go to Max Delavare in the Outzone Sector 5 and tell him to kill those Fallen Angel guys. Then you can get that Blueprint from Benjamin Kaine in Industrial 02.

NPC: It doesn't come as a surprise that the hackers turn out to be BioTech employees. The problem is that we do not have any evidence for this due to the fact that the relevant data blocks have been damaged by the sabotage. Our research and development was set back a couple of days as well.

Your response: That BioTech uses such methods could have been anticipated.

NPC: That may very well be but you underestimate the complexity and fragility of such systems and test rigs. Even the slightest distortion can cause maximum damage. In addition the network was still being reconfigured after the Fallen Angels hack attack. Because of that it was more vulnerable than usual.

Your response: What consequences will this have? Did Tangent already decide on a proper response? I mean, some kind of response must follow.

NPC: Yes, you are right and the consequence has already been decided. BioTech will be attacked directly by us. As a warning of course. Since you have proven your competence with these kind of missions Tangent has chosen you for this task.

Your response: It's not as if I chose to do these kind of assignments. But I will do it.

Your response: I do not believe I can do this.

NPC: Something else I just remembered. The Tsunami seem to have been involved as well. You should speak to Figaro in Pepper Park 03 again since we will also untilize our connections to the Black Dragon in this case. If BioTech uses the help of the Tsunami we will certainly not go into this without the Black Dragon. You should decide the course of action that the Black Dragon should take against BioTech. Listen to what they can do and choose the appropriate response.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: There is more. Your contact person, Benjamin Kaine, insisted on talking only to you. He said that he prefers the devil that he already knows. It seems that he was able to nick one part of the prototype beam weapon and now he is willing to sell it to us.

Your response: Can you be a little bit more precise and tell me whom I should kill?

NPC: The word of your accomplishments spread fast. There is much to do so don't waste any time. First you should visit Figaro and after you have flatlined one BioTech member Benjamin is already waiting for you.

NPC: If you change your mind, don't hesitate to contact us.

NPC: You already have the assignment specs.Give instructions to Figaro, kill two BioTech guys and then visit Benjamin in the Industrial district 02.

NPC: It is your task to kill one BioTech Employee. It should NOT be a Runner.

Your response: And I can really flatline any BioTech employees I want to?

NPC: No, only one single BioTech Employee. Otherwise the kill cannot be accepted. You should try your luck somewhere in Viarosso 1.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Modesty doesn't suit you at all. You can be proud about what you achieved. But of course that is not the reason why we need you here at the moment.

Your response: I expected as much, is there an emergency?

NPC: Not exactly. It's all about the final test run of the beam weapon. Everything is sorted out and the last readings will soon be done. But despite all our efforts BioTech somehow managed to get their weapon to a similar state in production.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Tangent cannot afford to loose in a direct competition. Especially with BioTech as competitor. That's why we will actively try to do something against them. As small as the chance is for them to rival our weapon.

Your response: And you assumed that I would do it? Alright, what does Tangent have in mind?

NPC: The final testrun must be disrupted at all costs. Didn't you receive some compromising material from your contact last time? If that is the case you should use it now. There is no better time.

Your response: Yes, I have certain compromising material about a scientist named Andressa. I believe she will be somewhere in the vicinity of the BioTech headquarters in Viarosso 1.

NPC: Then use that knowledge, everything that damages BioTech is good for Tangent.

NPC: Hurry, the time is running away.

NPC: I am rather busy. Please move on.

NPC: I am pleased to hear that. According to this data you are on a respectable status. Very well, the faction fee will be 300 000 credits.

Your response: That's a pretty hefty sum.

NPC: You better go now, we don't want scum like you in our faction.

NPC: If you don't want to spend the money we will know for certain how serious you were with your plans. If you pay you will also show your dedication towards our faction.

Your response: Very well, I will pay.

Your response: Forget it, I am not going to spend that much money for this kind of crap.

NPC: A wise decision!

Your response: *click*

NPC: You're a member of a clan... You can't change your faction, when you're in a clan!

NPC: It's a shame that you don't have enough money to pay for your entry, don't you think?

NPC: Welcome at Tangent. I am certain you will never want to leave again.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Important Packet for Diamond

POSSIBLE COST
• 300,000 credits (depends on choice)

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Expect something in return from her and bring it to Jester in Pepper Park 1, he is working for us as well. At least sometimes. He is a freelancer. Now do what you are told to do. Sometimes he hangs out in one of the various pubs.

• Is it really that difficult? Go to Viarosso 2, deliver the package to Maxime, get another one in return and bring it to Jester in Pepper Park 1. After that report to Taylor Gomez in Secret Passage 2.

• h, yes. Its not that difficult. She can be found at the Red Pepper Bar in Pepper Park 2. That is the designated meeting place. After you have delivered the package visit Taylor Gomez in Secret Passage 2.

• You have your assignment. Get the package from Jester to Leila at the Red Pepper Bar in Pepper Park 2 and then report back to Taylor Gomez.

• After that you should see Raymon in Outzone 3, he has contacts to ProtoPharm and he likes money very much which is the reason why we could convince him so easily to work with us. He should be able to make the murder look like it was done by the Black Dragon. Hand the weapon from Gil to him and then go and kill that stupid ProtoPharm Mr. Cook guy at the meeting place in the Outzone 3.

• Get the plan rolling. Meet the Anarchy Breed outside the Neocron city gates in A_08 and then Raymon in Outzone 3. Make sure to report back to Taylor afterwards.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.

NPC: I am sorry but you need to finish your running mission before i can offer you a new.

NPC: I am sorry but you don't belong to our faction. Please don't waste my time. Unless you plan to join our faction?!

Your response: That's why I am here. I would like to join your faction.

Your response: I'm not interested. Goodbye.

NPC: Your only way to further support us is to found a clan of your own.

NPC: You're not good enough for this job, come back once you are better at what you do. (next mission at level 10)

NPC: Your only way to further support us is to found a clan of your own.

NPC: We still have not sorted this situation. You can take some vacation in the meantime.

Your response: I guess I should visit Jester again and clear the whole situation myself. If you want something done then do it yourself.

NPC: Tsunami members where the loyalty is in question are still not wanted until this whole mess is cleaned up.

Your response: That is a pity. I guess I will have to rely on Leila s offer after all.

NPC: There are more and more rumours about spies in our own ranks. The rumours are spreading and nothing we do seems to be able to prevent dissent in our own ranks. People do not trust each other, I mean, not that they did before. It was even brought to Veronique's attention and her reply was a white list for all Tsunami members that are as loyal as it gets.

Your response: What does that mean for me?

NPC: There is some vital information about the deal between Black Dragon and ProtoPharm. We know where it will take place and we know when it will take place. Still, disrupting the deal alone will do us no good since then the deal will just take place sometime else. We need to kill the ProtoPharm representative and make it look as if it was the Black Dragon who killed them.

Your response: Yes, but how can we do that. It is not as if Proto Pharm is that stupid not to be able to differentiate between Black Dragon and Tsunami.

Your response: I do not feel up to another challenge today.

NPC: This is a coincidence, you arrived just when we needed you. We have some trouble with the Black Dragon scum. There was an open conflict in front of Club Veronique. They dared to attack with firearms. We had them running in no time but it sure was a powerful message. They attacked us on our own ground. It is time to do something about that. Are you ready to do more for Tsunami?

Your response: These Black Dragons are very bold. I would volunteer to kill some of those rats myself if that is what you want.

Your response: It does not suit me right now. I cannot help you at the moment.

NPC: You are new here, right? Come closer over here, we need to talk.

Your response: I am all yours.

NPC: We always appreciate a new loyal member. Tsunami is a great organisation as you will find out. We offer much to our members but keep in mind that Tsunami is also a rather competitive environment. Do you feel up to a little competition?

Your response: Of course I will do my very best.

NPC: Then you surely understand that if I would trust everybody just like that, I'd be dead by now. That means, I do not trust you. I cannot trust you, not right now that is. We will have to prove your worthiness somehow.  Something that shows where your loyalties are.

Your response: I have not the slightest doubt that I am loyal to your cause.

NPC: It should be easy enough. We don't want to waste you in the process of your first assignment now, do we?  Still, if you don't even make it past this assignment you are out. It really is that simple. So keep yourself in a good shape.

Your response: Aye, I am no looser. You will realize that soon enough.

NPC: You should already know that the head of Tsunami is Veronique Duchamps. She is pulling all the strings and she is as vicious as it gets.If anything big is going on you can bet that she is already involved behind the curtains. Since she has got so many deals and relations to take care of she needs an errand boy once in a while.

Your response: I understand. So, what do I have to do?

NPC: Its a simple delivery, so don't screw it up. Bring this package to Maxime, it's for Eric Danmund himself. You can find her in Viarosso 2.

Your response: Come on, thats a piece of cake. Consider it already done.

NPC: Expect something in return from her and bring it to Jester in Pepper Park 1, he is working for us as well. At least sometimes. He is a freelancer. Now do what you are told to do. Sometimes he hangs out in one of the various pubs.

NPC: Is it really that difficult? Go to Viarosso 2, deliver the package to Maxime, get another one in return and bring it to Jester in Pepper Park 1. After that report to Taylor Gomez in Secret Passage 2.

NPC: No, it is not time for that just now. Since you have proven your loyalty to us already there is another assignment that you will be entrusted with. It is important for our move to know as much as possible about the plans of the Black Dragon. But before Tsunami plans the next move we will have a small revenge on the Black Dragon.

Your response: How big is the threat?

NPC: The current situation is seeing battles between Tsunami and Black Dragon every day. They are forcefully trying to push into our market. They are threatening our clients and dancers likewise. We cannot allow this to continue. We will teach those bastards that Tsunami never yields. Not even an inch of its turf.

Your response: But what can be done other than killing them off?

NPC: We have managed to get a disguised member as a spy into the Black Dragon hierarchy. Her name is Leila. You will bring a small package to her and then she will cause some chaos from within the ranks of the Black Dragon.

Your response: And where do I get that from?

NPC: The package you are supposed to bring Leila is still in the hands of Jester. Get the package from him and then give it to Leila. It should be quite a surprise for them once they find out what happened. Be sure to tell Leila that the implant is targeted at either Gecko or Trond himself, the leader of the Black Dragon. Now go.

Your response: Where can I find Leila?

NPC: h, yes. Its not that difficult. She can be found at the Red Pepper Bar in Pepper Park 2. That is the designated meeting place. After you have delivered the package visit Taylor Gomez in Secret Passage 2.

NPC: Tsunami is not offering you these assignments out of gratitude. That you reject such a mission tells us alot about your loyalty to Tsunami.

NPC: You have your assignment. Get the package from Jester to Leila at the Red Pepper Bar in Pepper Park 2 and then report back to Taylor Gomez.

NPC: We have some friends with the Anarchy Breed. Mainly because they like our Clubs so much. I am sure that they might still have a few weapons that were used by the Black Dragon. Those weapons can be used to trick ProtoPharm. Be sure to see Happy Gil in A_08 outside the Neocron Gates.

Your response: Don't worry, I know how to deal with that kind of people.

NPC: After that you should see Raymon in Outzone 3, he has contacts to ProtoPharm and he likes money very much which is the reason why we could convince him so easily to work with us. He should be able to make the murder look like it was done by the Black Dragon. Hand the weapon from Gil to him and then go and kill that stupid ProtoPharm Mr. Cook guy at the meeting place in the Outzone 3.

NPC: Its your choice but you are aware that Tsunami does not appreciate slackers.

NPC: Get the plan rolling. Meet the Anarchy Breed outside the Neocron city gates in A_08 and then Raymon in Outzone 3. Make sure to report back to Taylor afterwards.

NPC: That list contains the names of the people that really can be trusted.This means that lots of small members are held at a certain distance, you included. I know, you did prove to be amongst those who did do a lot for Tsunami recently. I could get you on that list maybe, but it would require another test of loyalty. Just to be really sure about your intentions.

Your response: This is plain bullshit, I have already proven my worth more than once. I don't have to take this shit.

Your response: I have proven my worth. If I need to do it again, I will do it.

NPC: Officially that is true, but there is certainly a leak within Tsunami. Your last mission was not the only indication for insider information. I know that you put your life in danger there, but with all those genrep copies nowadays that could prove to be too small a price to be counted for your loyalty. There is the option of running an errand for a higher ranking member in order to improve your loyality even more and get onto that white list.

Your response: Just great. You really are dissing the wrong guy here.

NPC: If you are loyal, then you will persist. If not, we don't need you anyway. Go to Taylor Gomez in Secret Passage 2. He told me earlier that he has a mission for you. It seems he is one who thinks you are loyal to Tsunami.

NPC: Not a wise choice. Tsunami is not some club you can just exit or join any time you like. Keep that in mind.

NPC: I do not know if Gomez will wait forever to give you this assignment.

NPC: Excuse me now. This situation requires that I have my full attention to it.

NPC: Do not force me to call security. Go and visit that Leila you were talking about.

NPC: Pretty big words if you ask me, but if you can clear the situation Tsunami certainly would be grateful.

NPC: I am rather busy. Please move on.

NPC: I am pleased to hear that. According to this data you are on a respectable status. Very well, the faction fee will be 300 000 credits.

Your response: That's a pretty hefty sum.

NPC: You better go now, we don't want scum like you in our faction.

NPC: If you don't want to spend the money we will know for certain how serious you were with your plans. If you pay you will also show your dedication towards our faction.

Your response: Very well, I will pay.

Your response: Forget it, I am not going to spend that much money for this kind of crap.

NPC: A wise decision!

Your response: *click*

NPC: You're a member of a clan... You can't change your faction, when you're in a clan!

NPC: It's a shame that you don't have enough money to pay for your entry, don't you think?

NPC: Tsunami welcomes you.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Cashcube

POSSIBLE COST
• 300,000 credits (depends on choice)

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Donnovan informed me about the whereabouts of the Neokorps meeting. It is somewhere in sector A06 at the coast. Sorry, I can't remember numbers very well. It is your job to walk the leader of the Neokorps to the afterlife. After you have been there you can get a small payment to the contact person. You know better where to find that guy. Apart from that Tovall wanted to speak to you alone after you have accomplished all this. Understood?

• You'll go with my blessing then. Jade already awaits you in the Outzone. Show em, and show em good.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
