entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Documents
• Documents from Grimm

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Documents
• Documents from Grimm

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Well I have seen a fair share of the world already and I can only confirm that no place in Neocron is comparable to Tech Haven. There is just so much more technology utilized here. And right here where you stand is the heart of everything. There are so many varied electronical and mechanical gadgets and machinerie that anybody who uses this place for research or construction gets a huge advantage. This is the place where our biggest inventions come to fruition. Even if much research work goes to waste here as well.

• I don't know more about the history of the Angels than can be found in the official database. It is told in a few minutes anyway. While the PSI monks still ruled some scientists decided to try and transform earth into the blue planet it once was. They fled from the slavery of the PSI monks 2633 and laid the foundation for a new home here in Tech Haven. At that time the leader was Thomas Cooper and he is all but a legend today. The goal of the Fallen Angels is still the same, though. I guess great deeds just take a little longer.

• The people that can be found here with us are mostly people that want to change something without having to resort to weapons. Or they did not want to suffer the all present fear of Neocron and the Wastelands any longer. I know some people who are spending all their life here just looking for a way to improve the quality of living with the radioactivity in the environment. At the moment Sylvia Bennett is the head of the Scientist Council. She is a good leader if you ask me. Albeit the only one I have experienced so far. The other members of the Scientist Council are changing constantly and I can't be bothered to remember all their names. And I never even saw the System Administrator either. There are many rumours about her, though. Especially about her.

• I will tell you a secret but you have to keep your mouth shut about it, ok?  There have been some sightings in the Wastelands of gigantic unknown flying objects. This is very unsettling.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Welcome to the club, there are only a few formalities left. Please be patient you will receive your ID cube later on. Officially you now belong to us, the Fallen Angels. In addition to the membership you receive some new duties since we did not come out here to just daydream our life away. If you already feel comfortable you could already accept a task.

Your response: Of course. After all that is exactly why I joined the Fallen Angels in the first place.

NPC: I am pleased to hear that. As you probably know, every member of the Fallen Angels is a scientist to a certain degree. But because we did not yet fully analyse your qualities we cannot give you a suitable assignment just yet. It would be best if you would be willing to accept a small delivery job in the meanwhile. Sylvia Bennet released the latest test results on the various projects of our research. There wasn't time yet to hand them all out, however. Would you be willing to deliver one set of documents for us?

Your response: Alright, even if I am not usually keen on these kind of jobs. Where should I bring it to?

Your response: I don't believe I am ready for something like that just now.

NPC: There is a special Science Laboratory section here. Much of the research is focused on discovering a way to return radioactivity and the environment back to a healthy level. Basically anything you can think of is being researched down there. You can have a good look around on your way there. All Fallen Angels installations are worth a look.

Your response: Don't worry, I will make sure that this is delivered safely.

NPC: Just view it as quick money. Deliver the package to Grimm and extend my greetings to him. He can be found in the Tech Core.

NPC: Then just return once you feel more comfortable here.

NPC: What are you doing down here?! This area is off limits to civilians. Its only for scientists and constructors.

Your response: I was ordered to deliver these documents to your hands.

NPC: Very clever to appear before me without those documents that you supposedly have for me.

NPC: Really? What are you waiting for then? Hand it over already.

Your response: Here you are.

NPC: I expected something like this, reports, reports, reports. As if I did not have more than enough work on my hands. Wait a second while I flick through these documents. You might be able to deliver another package when you go back. You could talk to Constantine here in the meanwhile.

NPC: Maybe we could talk later?

NPC: I have already noticed that you have spoken to Grimm. Don't worry about it. He is always in a bad mood and doesn't like to talk much. He believes he was destined for something better. It's a shame that he is stuck down here with the research job of his, isn't it? My name is Constantine and I am working here as technical Assistant. Pleased to meet you.

Your response: I am rather new here. That might be the reason why they only gave me this delivery job. Tell me, what is so special about this lab?

NPC: Well, everything down here is equipped with the latest in technology and even the walls contain strands of fiber optical cables as thick as your leg. Despite all this amazing technology down here we would still be in need of much better equipment for the tasks that we want to accomplish.

Your response: But surely it must be an interesting job nontheless.

NPC: Unfortunately I do not belong to the science team directly so I wouldn't know personally. I still hear lots, though. My responsibility is to analyse the various test results and record them. All informations are collected here at this point. I you are interested in something, just ask.

Your response: I would be very interested in the technology down here.

Your response: Can you tell me more about the history of the Fallen Angels?

Your response: I would like to know more about the people who live and work here.

NPC: Well I have seen a fair share of the world already and I can only confirm that no place in Neocron is comparable to Tech Haven. There is just so much more technology utilized here. And right here where you stand is the heart of everything. There are so many varied electronical and mechanical gadgets and machinerie that anybody who uses this place for research or construction gets a huge advantage. This is the place where our biggest inventions come to fruition. Even if much research work goes to waste here as well.

Your response: I have no problems believing you. I wish I had that much equipment.

NPC: No problem, the Fallen Angels had offered this facility to any member for free. The idea behind it was to speed up the research process.

Your response: I still have more questions.

NPC: Of course, if you want to know something, just ask me.

Your response: I would be very interested in the technology here.

Your response: I would be interested in the history of the Fallen Angels.

Your response: I would like to know more about the people who live and work here.

Your response: I think that's all for the moment. Thank you very much.

NPC: I don't know more about the history of the Angels than can be found in the official database. It is told in a few minutes anyway. While the PSI monks still ruled some scientists decided to try and transform earth into the blue planet it once was. They fled from the slavery of the PSI monks 2633 and laid the foundation for a new home here in Tech Haven. At that time the leader was Thomas Cooper and he is all but a legend today. The goal of the Fallen Angels is still the same, though. I guess great deeds just take a little longer.

Your response: At least the Fallen Angels are going the right direction. If I think about those other selfish factions a shiver runs down my spine. They are too caught up with themselves to see what they should be doing. Anyway, I still have more questions.

NPC: The people that can be found here with us are mostly people that want to change something without having to resort to weapons. Or they did not want to suffer the all present fear of Neocron and the Wastelands any longer. I know some people who are spending all their life here just looking for a way to improve the quality of living with the radioactivity in the environment. At the moment Sylvia Bennett is the head of the Scientist Council. She is a good leader if you ask me. Albeit the only one I have experienced so far. The other members of the Scientist Council are changing constantly and I can't be bothered to remember all their names. And I never even saw the System Administrator either. There are many rumours about her, though. Especially about her.

Your response: What kind of rumours? Why did nobody see her?

NPC: I don't know. Hey, I am only a very small number here. The rumours are saying that she is a small child, a child with the brain of a grown person, or a mutant. Personally, I don't want to believe anyone of these since I respect the work she does.

Your response: It seems she does her job very well. She is known to be one of the best hackers in all of Neocron. Anyway, I still have some questions left.

NPC: If you want to start a research project of your own, I could make a few suggestions here and there. Well, it seems as if Grimm is finished. Good luck.

NPC: I have to resume my work. Did you already speak to Grimm?

NPC: I will tell you a secret but you have to keep your mouth shut about it, ok?  There have been some sightings in the Wastelands of gigantic unknown flying objects. This is very unsettling.

NPC: I have not yet read all the reports. Talk to Constantine or do something else but don't bother me.

NPC: Decisions, decisions, decisions. It's always the same. If I would control this whole apparatus some things would definitely change. And you my friend, I am considering to have you searched since you might want to smuggle vital information out of here.

Your response: That is ridiculous, I have only talked to Constantine.

NPC: And that is supposed to be an Alibi? Whatever. Nobody is heeding my commands anyway. Take these documents back to the Personal Director.

NPC: I did not give these documents to you so that you could build a paper hat out of it! Bring them back to the Personal Director.

NPC: Grimm can be found in the Tech Core . He is waiting already for these reports.

NPC: You carry with you the missing correction data from Professor Grimm?

Your response: I don't know what I have here but it is certainly from Grimm. He is not a nice person, though.

NPC: Yes, that might be but he is a dedicated and hard worker. We are quite aware of the fact that he is unsuitable for a command position. But don't mention it while he is around. Still, the faster you increase your knowledge the faster we will be able to hand out a new assignment to you. (next mission at level 20)

entries.conversation:
NPC: Your registration process is completed. Here is your ID Cube.

Your response: ID Cube? What is it good for?

NPC: It contains all your personal information and confirms your official affiliation with the Fallen Angels. Of course there is also a second copy of your personal data. Let's talk about something of more important. Judging from the analysis of your personal data the Scientist Council decided to assign an independent research project to you.

Your response: A research project for me? Thank you, but what does that mean? And what do I have to do with it?

Your response: I don't think I am suited for that task. Not yet. I am sorry.

NPC: You will get a project that you will have to research on your own. The list of projects you can choose from is limited, though. After all the project should comply with the greater goals of the Fallen Angels. At least you will get the help of a personal assistant who will lend you a hand now and then.

Your response: That sounds very good. But where should I start?

NPC: Grimm from the Reactor Area 1 has been given the relevant information from the Scientist Council. He will inform you about who will be your personal assistant. Good luck. Your research results will decide over your future rank here with us.

NPC: Grimm will be able to give you some more information. You can find him at the Tech Core.

NPC: It's alright, if you don't feel up to this task.

NPC: You again, I hope you have a valid reason for disturbing my work.

Your response: Of course. You are supposed to help me in order to start my own independent research project.

NPC: They have really given you an independent research project? It took me three long years to get my hands on one of these. Show me your ID Cube, I simply cannot believe this.

Your response: I don't mind. It has been approved by the Scientist Council.

NPC: This is outrageous, this must be a mistake. I will personally see to the culprit who did this.

Your response: Listen now, I have been given this task by a Personal Director and I Don't see any reason at all why I shouldn't start straightaway.

NPC: Alright, you want a project and that's what you are going to get. But don't presume that I will take any part in it. I am assigning Constantine as your personal assistant. Try to use this opportunity, although I believe you will fail miserably.

Your response: Believe whatever you want. Goodbye.

NPC: Just make one mistake, one little mistake and it is Game Over for you, understand?!

NPC: Remember that I will keep an eye on you all the time.

NPC: Maybe we could arrange a meeting later on?

NPC: I haven't seen you in a while. Have you already been assigned to a department?

Your response: Yes, I have gotten an independent research project.

NPC: Really? It is rare that such a task is given to a newcomer. You must be pretty skilled then.

Your response: Nothing to brag about. I hoped, now that you have been assigned to me as technical assistant, you could help me out a little.

NPC: Does this mean that we work together on this science project? I have to admit I am a little jealous. I hope Grimm did not hear about this.

Your response: I fear that he was the one who assigned you as technical assistant for me.

NPC: That is no good. I bet he is now brooding of jealousy. I don't think I would like to face him now.

Your response: Yes, he does not seem to like me. But lets get back to where we left off.

NPC: Agreed. The autonomous science projects are always chosen from a Pool of certain projects. These projects will be needed on the long run and therefore they are researched first. Did you already choose one?

Your response: No, not yet at least.

NPC: That must mean that you can still choose one. which one do you choose? At the moment there are two possible projects. A radioactive field dampener and a DNA Resequencer which can correct mutated cells.

Your response: Not easy since they are both very intriguing projects. Maybe it would be easier for me if I knew how they will play together with the higher goal Tech Haven is aiming at.

NPC: I'll explain it to you. By now it is no longer a secret in any case. We will develop a terraformer. It will be able to make our dream of a blue planet true again. But it will still be many decades until it will be finished.

Your response: If that is the case I choose the DNA Resequencer.

Your response: I choose the Field Dampener as research project then.

NPC: Fine with me since the main workload is on your shoulders anyway. That reminds me of a way how the research process could be made easier. If you are interested to follow up a side project.

Your response: Tell me more about it.

NPC: Fine with me since the main workload is on your shoulders anyway. That reminds me of a way how the research process could be made easier. If you are interested to follow up a side project.

Your response: Tell me more about it.

NPC: We have the Blueprint of an implant which greatly increases your science skills and the ability to think more logical. With such an implant this should be a piece of cake, shouldn't it?

Your response: Yes, this sounds very promising. But where is the catch?

NPC: The catch is that the design is not yet finalised and that we would still need to invest some work into it. Different departments worked on and off that project in the past. I still believe it would be worthwhile to invest some more work into it.

Your response: I will follow your suggestion even if that means that work has to go into this project.

NPC: Thank you. If you feel up to it you could start doing something for that project straightaway. Another member has ordered a certain chemical from ProtoPharm especially for this project. Of course all of this is not official since many factions from Neocron are very suspicious of the Fallen Angels. Unfortunately that other member is ill, now we need a replacement. Maybe you could fetch the chemical from the a ProtoPharm employee?

Your response: Ahh, I bet you have planned this all along. First you convince me to work on that implant blueprint and then you get me to fetch this chemical that we need for it, right? But I will do it nontheless, would interest me anyway what ProtoPharm is working on.

NPC: Excellent. Just talk to Rick Boujard in the El Farid village. He should be able to hand you the chemical. I can then forward it for you if you want.

NPC: this is a security area, please leave immediately.

NPC: Hey, Runner! You can't just stroll in here!

Your response: I am supposed to meet a certain Mr Boujard in here. It's all about a certain deal.

NPC: Why didn't you say so in the first place? I have already awaited your arrival. The meeting was supposed to be about three hours ago.

Your response: Unfortunately one of my colleagues suddenly got very ill. I am just a replacement.

NPC: This is very strange to be sure. Can you confirm your identity? I mean I already received the payment but it is a rare chemical after all.

Your response: I fear not, it all happened too fast. But if I wasn't who I claim to be, how could I know about that chemical?

NPC: That is right. Well then, here you are. I hope it helps with your Fallen Angel project.

Your response: What do you mean by that?

NPC: You are not from the Fallen Angels? How very stupid of me. Just forget whatever I just said.

Your response: This is really smelling fishy now.

NPC: Don't worry. I have nothing against the people from the Fallen Angels. And you do have the chemical, right? Then just leave this place, alright?

NPC: Go on, leave! I don't think everybody has to know that we have dealings with each other...

NPC: You should ask Rick Boujard for the chemical. He can be found in the El Farid village.

NPC: Did you manage to get the chemical? It can be found with a certain Rick Boujard in the El Farid village.

NPC: Nice to see you again, I hope your journey was calm and safe. Do you have the chemical?

Your response: Of course that is the first thing you ask. Yes, I do have the chemical.

NPC: The Bio department will be overjoyed to finally have a sample of this chemical.

Your response: Why is that?

NPC: ProtoPharm is the only company that produces this chemical. Officially they did not want to sell it to us. They possibly have some prejudices against us like many other Neocron factions.

Your response: That reminds me, Mr Boujard knew that I was from the Fallen Angels.

NPC: That really is strange. But what could they do now? After all we have the chemical now. Don't worry too much about it. The Scientist Council did grant you the first research funds. 10000 credits. They can't offer more at the moment or so they say. I am sorry.

Your response: Then I'll have to make do with this. Thank you anyway. Can't we begin with research straightaway?

NPC: That would be nice but no. I still have to collect the various data from the different departments before we can start. Why don't you take some time off? You can research or increase your skills on your own for a while. Don't forget to visit a Personal Director now and then since i will inform them about my progress.(next mission at level 30)

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Chemical Concentrate
• Whiteflash

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Chemical Concentrate

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Spare me your whining, this is unforgiveable! But simply to expel you from the Fallen Angels wouldn't bring Paul back into the living world. That is why I am offering you not to tell the Scientist Council that it was you who brought the contaminated chemical into Tech Haven and you are going to acquire the same chemical again. We still need to make more research with the help of that chemical.

• I have an offer right here. This really is a coincidence. His name is Max and the location is the Outzone Sector 5. Well, this does not sound very promising. Very dangerous and hard to find. I would counsel against it but it seems to be the only option at the moment.

• Then I will just have to be careful. Outzone you said? Wish me luck.

• Did you already meet Max in the Outzone Sec-5?

• Yes, Kaboxorid. It is offered by a certain Mark Cole.  Seems to be the last possibility although it is not the nearest location either. He can be found in Pepper Park 3, at least judging from the announcement.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Grimm in the Tech Core would like to talk to you. He sounded rather excited and already looked for you all over the place. But he did not want to tell us what this is all about. Maybe you know what this is all about.

Your response: No, I have not the slightest idea.

Your response: I still have some urgent matters to attend to...

NPC: You better visit him soon. I hope it was nothing serious.

NPC: Did you already visit Grimm here in the Tech Core? It sounded pretty important.

NPC: As you wish but I am sure that Grimm will not be pleased.

NPC: Who?

Your response: You wanted to talk to me about something?

NPC: If this is not our grand scientist himself. Previously I have already thought bad of you but now its even worse than I thought.

Your response: What is this all about? I have no idea at all what you are talking about.

NPC: Don't pretend to be dumber than you are. The chemical that you acquired for my science department was contaminated! It is your fault that a loyal co-worker of mine died in a laboratory explosion! You, sir, are a moron!

Your response: But how can that be? I did not know, I brought the chemical directly to this place.

NPC: Spare me your whining, this is unforgiveable! But simply to expel you from the Fallen Angels wouldn't bring Paul back into the living world. That is why I am offering you not to tell the Scientist Council that it was you who brought the contaminated chemical into Tech Haven and you are going to acquire the same chemical again. We still need to make more research with the help of that chemical.

Your response: I feel sorry for Paul. Of course I will try to get a pure version of the chemical. Even if I don't know where to start. Maybe I should ask Constantine about it...

NPC: Don't look at me. How should I know where you originally organized this chemical? As far as I know only the ProtoPharm Labs offer this chemical. Maybe you should try your luck there. Once you have the chemical, bring it to me, understood? Otherwise the Scientist Council will know about the contaminated chemical in no time.

NPC: One moment, I am currently downloading something important...

NPC: Ahem... you are a little bit early. I still don't have all the information for the research. We cannot begin with it just yet.

Your response: No need to worry. I am not here because of the research. Do you remember the chemical that I organized?

NPC: Sure, the Bio department was very thankful for it.

Your response: Thats the one. I need to know where else I could get this chemical from. I thought you might know a possibility?

NPC: Basically ProtoPharm is the only one distributing this chemical.

Your response: That is not an option. I don't trust them any longer.

NPC: Ahh... well, I could theoretically have a look around the black market. But you never know what you get.

Your response: The essential thing is to get my hands on the chemical.

NPC: I have an offer right here. This really is a coincidence. His name is Max and the location is the Outzone Sector 5. Well, this does not sound very promising. Very dangerous and hard to find. I would counsel against it but it seems to be the only option at the moment.

Your response: Then I will just have to be careful. Outzone you said? Wish me luck.

NPC: Take care. You should better take a few Medipacks with you. Maybe I will have more when you return. I'll keep looking... be sure to check back here afterwards, alright? Good luck.

NPC: Get lost Runner! This is not the right area for somebody like you.

NPC: Speak up, what is your business here? I dont't have time all day.

Your response: I am here because of your offer. You know, that special chemical.

NPC: How do I know that you are the right Runner for such a deal? Show me your ID Cube.

Your response: What has that got to do with anything? I just want to buy something from you.

NPC: I need to know if you got enough credits for the shit, right? So I need your ID Cube, right? Hand it over.

Your response: Alright, here it is.

NPC: Nice. That explains a lot. I have already waited for you my friend. I have been paid, and paid well by the Crahn order to crush you. Don't move and I promise it won't hurt. Not much anyway.

NPC: Die!

NPC: Did you already meet Max in the Outzone Sec-5?

NPC: I am glad to see you back here in one piece. I would never visit such a dangerous area myself.

Your response: And you are doing the right thing. This Max guy wanted to kill me. As if he already knew that I would be coming there.

NPC: Are you certain? I mean, how should he know about that?

Your response: I have no idea but he said something that Crahn is behind all this.

NPC: Crahn! Unbelievable! Wherever a Fallen Angel is in trouble it is surely because of Crahn. It doesn't seem to be enough for them that we spent decades working for them as slaves.

Your response: It was a close cut. I almost would've fallen victim to them. Isn't there anybody else who sells this chemical?

NPC: But since you already seem to have the chemical in your possession you should hand it over to Grimm.

NPC: Damn! I almost forgot in all this uproar. Shortly after you went another offer came up through the black market.

Your response: Are you sure it is the chemical I am looking for?

NPC: Yes, Kaboxorid. It is offered by a certain Mark Cole.  Seems to be the last possibility although it is not the nearest location either. He can be found in Pepper Park 3, at least judging from the announcement.

Your response: Thank you Constantine, you are a great help.

NPC: Thanks, take care. Hopefully this is not another trap.

NPC: I am not receiving anybody at the moment, get lost.

NPC: Ahh, I hope that you bring good news.

Your response: I am no messenger, I am more interested in the chemicals that you offer.

NPC: Well, I would consider that good news. Then let's get down to business. You want Kaboxorid, I want to profit from that. Here is the deal. You get me something with which I can do proper business and I will give you this worthless fluid shit. If you don't like it, beat it.

Your response: No, no, that is perfect. What do you want?

NPC: Give me something valuable. Drugs would be good but not the cheap stuff. It took me more time than I care to admit to get this chemical from ProtoPharm. The drug Whiteflash would be just fine I think. I would already have a customer for that as well. Three packages of Whiteflash and you get the chemical, is that a deal? Now go and get it for me.

NPC: Is this really so difficult? I only need a little bit of this Whiteflash drug.

NPC: Well done. You seem to be worth something after all. Not like those crazy Fallen Angels scum. I was lucky to leave them when there was still time. You'd mean they would fall over their own feet cause they have their noses up in the clouds. Here is your chemical. Good luck with this junk.

NPC: I don't feel like doing more business with you today. Just go back wherever you came from.

NPC: Don't turn up here without this chemical. A pure sample, mind!

NPC: You!? But how can that be? I thought I took every precaution...

Your response: What? What are you talking about?

NPC: Alright, then I have to change my plan. If you did not get the chemical because of your unbelievable incompetence I will have to inform the Council of the contamination.

Your response: Save your speech for somebody else. I got almost killed but I do have your chemical.

NPC: Really?! Surely there is a trick behind this. Give it to me.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Grimm's ID Cube

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Destrosol
• Whiteflash
• X-Strong

POSSIBLE COST
• 500 credits (depends on choice)
• 5,000 credits (depends on choice)

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Look for Figaro in the Pepper Park 3 area. He can possibly tell you more about it.

• Well, at least something. Maybe this plays together with what I found out. According to the schedule Grimm has recently left Tech Haven several times.

• What about the data that Grimm took with him when he left Tech Haven?

• This really already took long enough. And I failed to directly access the NCPD data files but I was lucky and found a video from the Sherman Bay sector. According to the ID Fargo Miles is on that video, although I can't be one hundred percent sure.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Constantine informed me that she would like to speak to you. The topic she says is a person you only know too well.

Your response: I will visit her immediately.

Your response: It just isn't possible at the moment...

NPC: Apart from that there are no real news.

NPC: Hmm, all right but just don't let her wait too long...

NPC: Didn't you want to speak to Constantine in Tech Core?

NPC: Finally. I urgently wanted to speak to you about Grimm. All this bad luck recently can't just be pure coincidence.

Your response: You're damn right it can't. You can be sure that something is wrong here.

NPC: What does this mean? Tell me about it.

Your response: Well, when I met the ProtoPharm employee he accidentally said that I am coming from the Fallen Angels.  But where should he know that from? Later on the chemical I got from him turned out to be contaminated. And there is more.

NPC: I am beginning to understand what you mean.

Your response: Before this Max brute almost killed me he told me that he was paid by Crahn to do so. But the question is, why did he have a good look at my ID Cube first, before attacking me?

NPC: So it was a trap after all. He had to make sure that it is really you. He wanted to make sure that you are the right person.

Your response: Right! And the only other person, apart from you, that knew about me looking for this chemical was Grimm.

NPC: This sounds all too convincing but just because Grimm is being unfriendly to you it doesn't condemn him. He is unfriendly to almost anybody. But if it really was him he must have left some kind of traces.

Your response: True, but I'll be damned if I knew where to start looking.

NPC: Maybe you could get some additional information from Rick Boujard. You might just have to be very convincing.

Your response: It's at least worth a try. If this helps to prevent further interruptions it'll definitely be worth it.

NPC: In the meanwhile I will try to gather some information from the net, ok? Be sure to return later and tell me what you found out.

NPC: This is as far as you get! What are you thinking? This is a restricted area.

NPC: I don't have time just now. How did you get in here? Wait... somehow you look familiar.

Your response: Yes, I certainly do. Remember? I am the one who got that chemical from you.

NPC: It's you! What do you want from me? I thought you already had the chemical. End of story.

Your response: Did you know that the chemical I got from you was contaminated?

NPC: I don't have a clue what you are talking about. I'm sorry. I have given a perfectly pure chemical to your hands. It's non of my business what you did to it afterwards.

Your response: Who contaminated the chemical? Who ordered you to turn my life into a mess?

NPC: What do you think I am doing here all day? Do you really think it is my job to cheat people like you?

Your response: I only know that the chemical was contaminated. And I finally want to know who is behind all this.

NPC: Alright, let me tell you something. I would be willing to tell you from whom I got that chemical in the first place against a small fee. Lets say about 5000 credits? Acceptable enough?

Your response: Alright, that's all I want to know, anyway.

NPC: First, I want my money.

NPC: It was a certain Black Dragon Dealer. His name was Figaro. Rather suspicious kind of guy. He gave me that chemical and some instructions but I believe the chemical was still pure at that point. I can't be sure of course.

Your response: I don't understand how a ProtoPharm employee has to buy chemicals from a Black Dragon.

NPC: I don't have to, it was part of a deal and it got me some money. That's all I am prepared to tell you.

NPC: Look for Figaro in the Pepper Park 3 area. He can possibly tell you more about it.

NPC: Hey Runner, I would really like to help you out on this one. But I haven't got that many drugs left.

NPC: Hey, Runner! You really look as if you need some drugs. How 'bout it?

Your response: Right you are. What can you offer today?

Your response: No, I'm not here to get myself drugged.

NPC: That is a shame. I was just beginning to like you. Now get lost, somebody who doesn't want to buy my drugs is suspicious to me.

NPC: I've only got the best of the best. X-Strong in case you ever wanted to pay back your arch enemy in style. Or maybe you want to be real fast, then your choice would be Whiteflash. If however you are one of those brainiacs and have trouble with your concentration you should really try Destrosol. True, that stuff is usually best for PSI Monks but I guarantee that you will feel as fresh as never before.

Your response: I'll take Whiteflash.

Your response: I'll take X-Strong.

Your response: I'll take Destrosol.

NPC: No money, no pleasure.

NPC: Excellent choice. I'll give it to you for a special price since we just met. And if you ever need some more of it I think you know where to find me.

Your response: Since we are friends now, you might be able to answer a small question for me, eh?

NPC: No money, no pleasure.

NPC: Excellent choice. I'll give it to you for a special price since we just met. And if you ever need some more of it I think you know where to find me.

Your response: Since we are friends now, you might be able to answer a small question for me, eh?

NPC: No money, no pleasure.

NPC: Excellent choice. I'll give it to you for a special price since we just met. And if you ever need some more of it I think you know where to find me.

Your response: Since we are friends now, you might be able to answer a small question for me, eh?

NPC: But of course, I am always trying to help my friends. What do you want to know?

Your response: How should I put it... I've got a friend at ProtoPharm. You might know him actually, Rick Boujard is his name.

NPC: Yes, that does ring a bell. What is it with him?

Your response: He got a very special delivery from you and now he needs more of that stuff. He already gave everything away he got in the first place.

NPC: Sorry, Runner, no can do. That was a once in a lifetime delivery from Tangent. Some kind of guy named Miles got it for me. Don't ask why they gave it to me with the instruction to hand it over to Rick. They did pay well, however. But I could get you some other drugs if you want to.

Your response: Thanks, I'd rather try out the ones I just got. See you around.

NPC: Ok, if you ever need some drugs again...

NPC: I'm sorry friend, I don't have any drugs left.

NPC: Did you already follow the trace from Rick Boujard in the El Farid village?

NPC: I already wondered if something happened to you. Did you find out anything?

Your response: Well, at least I know now that the chemical originates from Tangent.

NPC: Do you have proof for this or is it just idle speculation?

Your response: No, I only know the name of the messenger. It is a certain Fargo Miles.

NPC: Well, at least something. Maybe this plays together with what I found out. According to the schedule Grimm has recently left Tech Haven several times.

Your response: I fail to see how this would help us.

NPC: I am coming to that. I caught two emails that were sent to Tangent and Crahn. Luckily Grimm seemed to have totally forgotten to delete the system history log. The emails give away a location where Grimm deposited some compromising Data.

Your response: This means that Grimm forwarded information to Crahn and Tangent? Then it is true after all. That is why I encountered resistance at every other step I made.

NPC: Yes, this must be how it happened. But we base it all on assumptions only. The emails are not very forthcoming as evidence either. We don't even know where this mysterious deposite location might be.

Your response: That means this is a dead end...

Your response: What about surveillance videos that could help us?

Your response: What about the data that Grimm took with him when he left Tech Haven?

NPC: This means we will have to give up. It's a shame.

NPC: What do you mean?

Your response: Well, the CityAdmin or NCPD in Neocron must have some kind of surveillance videos for Fargo Miles. If we are lucky they will show him picking up the deposited information. Then we would know where that location is.

NPC: Will be done in a second. You can come back in a few minutes. Until then I will hopefully have something.

NPC: No way, the logs have all been deleted by now.

Your response: He must have planned this through very thoroughly.

NPC: This really already took long enough. And I failed to directly access the NCPD data files but I was lucky and found a video from the Sherman Bay sector. According to the ID Fargo Miles is on that video, although I can't be one hundred percent sure.

Your response: Does it show the locaction we are looking for? Anything that would help us?

NPC: Hmm, I thought I recognized some satellite dishes. Fargo did enter a building and took something from a security box which he opened with a code. But the video clip ends there. There certainly is something in that box.

Your response: Sherman Bay you are saying? I think I have to go there personally.

NPC: Good luck. I think I have reached the limit for what I can do with the help of the net. I have already tried everything. But be sure to tell me what you found out, ok?

NPC: We need more information. Have you already visited Rick Boujard?

NPC: Did you already look at Sherman Bay?

NPC: Already back? Have you been successful?

Your response: Indeed, we have been right all the time. Grimm sold me to Crahn and Tangent. It's all on this Datacube.

NPC: Then we finally have the evidence that we need to stop his evil doings. I'll forward the cube for you to the council.

Your response: Here you are. I hope now this whole chapter will be closed.

NPC: I believe the council will still need some time to evaluate our information and reach a decision. We nee to wait and since I am not willing to start the research program until all this is settled you should take some time out and study on your own. (next mission at level 40)

entries.description: Quest-related dialogue from the game files.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• BLUEPRINT- 30 TB Capacity:
• Plastat Alloy

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Element T

POSSIBLE COST
• 10,000 credits (depends on choice)

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• You have a weak attitude, soldier. Just wait until CopBots run down the doors of Tech Haven. Then you will see that we cannot let Reezasdictatorship continue to fester like a cancer. We need to crush it now and build a glorious new foundation for a bright future.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: There have been a few decisions on the treacherous information that you have handed in about Grimm. The council did thoroughly review the data and decided to put Grimm under 23 hour surveillance and strip him of his ranks.

Your response: This is not fair, Grimm should be banned. I almost got killed because of his scheming.

NPC: Yes, almost. But since there was no greater damage and the information that he passed along was only of a very general nature it was decided to give him another chance.

Your response: It seems I have no choice but to accept this ruling.

NPC: But there are also good news. 35,000 Credits have been approved for your research project. Your assistant also asked me to inform you that the necessary preparations are all set up and ready. You can start your research right away.

Your response: Alright, I will see to it.

Your response: Hmmm, I will only be able to do that later on.

NPC: Good luck.

NPC: That is your decision.

NPC: Didn't you want to talk to the assisstant Constantine?

NPC: A productive day to you. Haven't seen you in a while. You have received my message? We now have all relevant data that we need for the project.

Your response: Yes, I was informed. After all I am already waiting long enough for the research to finally begin.

NPC: Very good. I have all data that the Biological department collected about this project but we still need one or two things.

Your response: I thought something like that would happen. There is no reason to wait any longer. Please continue.

NPC: We still need a Blueprint of a Hacking CPU 2. It has a very sensible internal structure that would be excellent for our purposes. The advantage is that this kind of CPU already exists.

Your response: Hmm, very well. What if I wasn't that good in doing research?

NPC: Then you could simply talk to another Runner who is better in doing research. There are enough of them here at the Fallen Angels. But I wasn't finished yet.

Your response: There is even more?

NPC: Unfortunately. We still need some mineral that only the Twilight Guardian possess. After all they keep some pretty important mines occupied and have much of the minerals mined there in stock.

Your response: Is it something special that we require?

NPC: Well, we need a certain metal alloy that can act as semi conductor. At the moment we can only produce this alloy through recycling it from other elements. For this you need the Element T that you can get from the Twilight Guardian. They only sell it in small quantities, though. Then you will also need Trisol which should be commonly available.

Your response: That is clear so far. Maybe I should get the Blueprint first.

NPC: That would be prudent. Once you have it I can forward it for you to the Bio department. I can clue you in again on the ingredients for the semi conductor, afterwards.

NPC: didn't you want to get the Blueprint of a Hacking CPU 2 first?

NPC: Good work! the only thing that is left now is the semi conductor alloy. It can be recycled from Trisol and the Element T. This element can only be acquired from the Twilight Guardian. Feng is responsible for the sales of the Element T. He might seem a little bit fanatic at times but at heart he is a good and reliable fellow.

Your response: Good, I will get it and after this the research Implant can finally be completed.

NPC: I will prepare everything back here. The Constructors in the Bio department are already waiting impatiently. However you should be careful since the way to the Twilight Guardian Canyon is very dangerous.

NPC: Hey, soldier, you should make yourself useful. Don't just stare at me!

NPC: Hey, you, soldier!

Your response: Me? I am just here to talk to you about...

NPC: In this time deeds count more than words and every second that we hesitate means a victory for this dictator Reeza. We need to act immediately!

Your response: But I only need the Element T from you.

NPC: If that is the case tell me, are you against or for Reeza?! Where are your loyalties?

Your response: Luckily I don't have much to do with him since I am a Fallen Angel. Of course I don't like what he does to Neocron.

Your response: I think, Reeza does a pretty good job...

NPC: Whaat?! You dare to utter this here, in Twilight Guardian territory!! Get lost or I will strangle you personally.

NPC: You have a weak attitude, soldier. Just wait until CopBots run down the doors of Tech Haven. Then you will see that we cannot let Reezasdictatorship continue to fester like a cancer. We need to crush it now and build a glorious new foundation for a bright future.

Your response: Well, about that Element T again...

NPC: You are lucky that you are Fallen Angel, otherwise I wouldn't give you any Element T in a thousand years. But since our mutual relationship was always very successful I will give you some for the special price of 10,000 per sample. Deal?

Your response: This is alot, really. But if there is no other way.

NPC: Even if we are allied that doesn't mean that we will just get you Fallen Angels everything you want. Come back once you have enough money.

NPC: That's good. With that money you make sure that both our goals for a better Neocron becomes reality one little step after the other.

NPC: You can always enlist with us and join the fight against the cruel schemes from Reeza.

NPC: Do you have the Element T already? You can get it from Feng in the Twilight Guardian canyon in E 13. You need to recycle it with Trisol to get the special alloy we need.

NPC: The construction team is just waiting for the parts. Are you ready?

Your response: Yes, I've got everything. The semi conductor wasn't too easy to get but I have it.

NPC: Do you have the Element T already? You can get it from Feng in the Twilight Guardian canyon in E 13. You need to recycle it with Trisol to get the special alloy we need.

NPC: Excellent! This might take a while. Come back in about an hour. Maybe they are finished until then.

NPC: I am sorry but they still did not confirm the completion of the construction process. It seems to take some more time than estimated. Check back later.

NPC: Finally it is done. Here is some more approved money for the research. 50,000 credits. Come back once you are ready for the final stage, alright? (next mission at level 45)

entries.conversation:
NPC: I think you should visit Constantine again. The final stage of your project seems to be well underway. After all you are directing this project, right?

Your response: I wish but Constantine really is doing much of the work. There's barely something left for me.

NPC: For only once in my life I want to have such a job. Good luck anyway. Maybe you should also know that the Scientist Council will award you a bonus if you manage to finish your project.

NPC: You should really brief Constantine on the final stage of your research project.

NPC: I hope you are prepared? Now everything depends on you. I can only give you some items that are required for that project. Although some are still missing I have tried to organise as much material as I can but at some point I had to stop.

Your response: I am sure it'll be sufficient to complete the project.

NPC: I am relieved to hear that but I still have one bad message for you. You have to get a vital item from Grimm himself.

Your response: That should be fine, I think I can handle that.

NPC: Somehow this is very strange, only recently he tried to have you eliminated. But enough of this. From these elements you have to recycle the right materials in order to construct the final product. Depending on what you chose to research in the first place. You can get the blueprint with the help of Grimm. I can provide you with Solantium and Meritium but you still have to get your hands on three units of Arillium. Once you succeeded you can visit the Personal Director and hand over the project to him.

NPC: Did you already speak to Grimm? If you finished your project the personal director is already waiting for it.

NPC: Get lost, I just don't have the nerve to talk to you right now.

NPC: Oh, this is great! You are the last person I would want to talk to. Do you know that you destroyed my career?!

Your response: That is entirely your own fault. You shouldn't have committed treason in the first place.

NPC: It simply wasn't fair. It's all so very simple for you. I had to work hard and long and now you just take everything away. Everything that I ever had. And now, to top it all off they force me to cooperate with you.

Your response: Let's make it short. I don't have the desire to speak to you either.

NPC: Yes, I am supposed to help you but I am not going to move a single finger until you're done with your part of the work. You better start straightaway.

Your response: But one moment. What do I need exactly for the Blueprints?

NPC: Tsk, tsk. Am I supposed to teach you the basics of electronics right from the beginning? Do you know anything at all? What kind of project are you working on anyway?

Your response: I am trying my luck with the Field Dampener.

Your response: The Gene Resequencer is my goal.

NPC: For the Field Dampener you will need the Blueprint of a Heavy Deflector Belt and a Vehicle Energypack Blueprint. Come back to me when you have both.

NPC: For the Gene Resequencer you will need the Blueprint of a Construction Coordinator v. 2.0 and a Vehicle Energypack Blueprint. Come back to me when you have both.

NPC: Didn't I say Heavy Deflector Belt Blueprint and Vehicle Energypack Blueprint?

NPC: Didn't I say Heavy Deflector Belt Blueprint and Vehicle Energypack Blueprint?

NPC: Well, this was about time. But I don't think much of you anyway. Hand over these Blueprints.

Your response: Here you are but now you better do your part as well.

NPC: I would really enjoy to just teach you a lesson but I will do my duty as I always did. Come back in a short while.

NPC: With this Blueprint it should be no problem to complete your project. I simply cannot believe that I am aiding YOU of all people.

NPC: I have already given you more than I ever saw myself cabapble of, leave!

NPC: Didn't I say Construction Coordinator v. 2.0 Blueprint and Vehicle Energypack Blueprint??

NPC: Didn't I say Construction Coordinator v. 2.0 Blueprint and Vehicle Energypack Blueprint??

NPC: This was about time. But I did expect you to be this late. Hand over the Blueprints to me.

Your response: Here you are and now it is your turn.

NPC: I would really enjoy to just teach you a lesson but I will do my duty as I always did. Come back in a short while.

NPC: With this Blueprint it should be no problem to complete your project. I simply cannot believe that I am aiding YOU of all people.

NPC: You should really talk to Constantine about the final stage of your project.

NPC: What can I do for you?

Your response: I have finished my research project and now I wanted to hand it over to you.

NPC: Ahh, really? This is good news. One more step towards the Terraform project. You have really done a good job here. I personally would offer you much more compensation but at the moment most resources are bound in various projects.

Your response: That is no problem, I will just have to make do with whatever I get.

NPC: What project did you complete then?

Your response: The Radioactivity Field Dampener...

Your response: The Gene Resequencer...

NPC: I am sorry but you should at least have it with you.

NPC: In any case we are very pleased to have such a fine and talented Runner on our ranks. You really have earned your bonus. 100 000 credits it is as a reward for your excellent work.

Your response: Excellent, when do I start with the next project?

NPC: I am sorry but you should at least have it with you.

NPC: In any case we are very pleased to have such a fine and talented Runner on our ranks. You really have earned your bonus. 100 000 credits it is as a reward for your excellent work.

Your response: Excellent, when do I start with the next project?

NPC: Ah, you are very eager, right? But I fear this is not so easy. At the moment we have real difficulties to find work for all the new members. I would recommend that you found your own clan and support Tech Haven that way.

Your response: Then I will have to look for work on my own?

NPC: Yes, that is right. But you will always have a place here with the Fallen Angels. Good luck for your further career.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Welcome at NEXT, we are always excited about new members. I hope your appartement is acceptable? As you probably already know NEXT is concerned with every means of transportation there is. Almost all kind of vehicles you can see in and around Neocron were assembled in the assembly halls of NEXT.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: From Hoverbikes over subways to spaceships even, all are produced by NEXT. But in order to remain at the top of this market we are obliged to have good business connections to every other company. Would you want to help us with that or do you still need time to make yourself feel at home?

Your response: I believe I am ready to help NEXT in their endeavours.

Your response: At the moment I would say I need more time to have a look around.

NPC: Excellent. We need people like you. At the moment your assignment is related to a grand project between us and BioTech. Of course BioTech is not the only company we have ralations to. Right at the front there is also Tangent and the CityAdmin.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: You could probably argue that the CityAdmin is indeed more a company than anything else. Well, anyway, the long term goal of the project I was talking about is to open up a gate to the stars again, Irata III to be precise. The head of NEXT, Craig Diggers, is determined to reanimate the spaceship projects.

Your response: Does he have a special reason to be so determined?

NPC: Mr Diggers suffered a terrible accident back then. It was his dream to accompany the great Trek to Irata III. But instead he lost his legs because of an accident on his way to the spaceships. He missed the chance to join the Trek. After that accident he was not able to shake off the longing for Irata III.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: His legs were replaced by artificial ones and you might already have guessed by whom. Yes, BioTech! That might also be the reason why a new spaceship program is developed in cooperation with them. Mr Diggers is possibly still feeling obliged to BioTech.

Your response: A spaceship program with BioTech? I thought BioTech was only developing implants and organic mechanisms.

NPC: Yes, that is the general assumption nowadays but the truth is that BioTech deals with many different science projects. The best example is Tangent. Tangent was the former weapon department of BioTech. Only later on it got big enough to split from BioTech and become independent. But now back to business.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: These documents are copies of already signed contracts for BioTech. They are probably already waiting for them. By delivering these contracts you will not only do us a favour but you will also demonstrate to us your determination to get something done from start till end. This could mean the beginning of a wonderful career. Don't forsake yourself now.

Your response: Good, i will take this assignment. Where do I have to go?

NPC: You will directly adress the director of operations in the Via Rosso 1. You should find him without trouble. Oh, and yes, before I forget, meet Mr Mason after you have delivered the documents. He is vice director of NEXT and can be found here in the building. Good luck.

NPC: Then take some time and come back once you are ready.

NPC: Have you already delivered that package to the director of operations in the Via Rosso 1? Once you did that you can speak to Mr Mason right here in the building.

NPC: Are you supposed to deliver the documents from NEXT to us? But where is that delivery then?

NPC: I was already informed that these documents would arrive here any moment. Do you have them with you? Then just hand them over to me.

Your response: Here you are, these documents will probably secure the contract between BioTech and NEXT.

NPC: Yes, indeed. This mutual agreement should enable us to create a superior spaceship design compared to previous iterations. Of course it will still be a long way until we reach that goal.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: For such a big project it is compulsory for companies to cooperate. A spaceship consists of so many various technologies that no single company can hope to complete such a project on its own.

Your response: I can imagine that. Goodbye.

NPC: Goodbye. Always keep a stiff upper lip as I am sure there is still something heading towards Neocron in the future. I am sure of that.

NPC: I have already received the documents and now, if you'll excuse me, I'll have to go back to work. Maybe you should go back to your company as well.

NPC: Please come back a little bit later. I just don't have the time at the moment. Maybe you still have something else to do.

NPC: I believe we have not met yet. I am Mason and the vice director of the NEXT HQ. Our paths will probably cross on a regular basis in the future. How can I help?

Your response: I have delivered important documents to the BioTech HQ. It had something to do with a cooperation between NEXT and BioTec

NPC: Right, I remember. Haven't these documents been delivered already? That was about high time then. You seem to have delivered them just in time it seems. I believe that is worth a little bonus. How about 2000 credits?

Your response: Thank you, it was a pleasure.

NPC: There is always enough work here at NEXT. We have managed to get a good reputation after many years of hard work. Back when NEXT was founded in the year 2723 to this year and day. But besides nurturing our good reputation there are of course many other important tasks to complete.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: I suggest that you come back to NEXT after you have demonstrated your loayalty to NEXT. Because then NEXT can give you some more interesting assignments. Be certain to adress a Human Resource Director since it is their responsibility. Goodbye Runner.(next mission level 20)

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Package with Special Controlchip

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Package with Special Controlchip

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• It is called Tech Haven, am I right?

• Yes. Some people would even call it the technical paradise. Why? Well, you will be able to see that for yourself when you get there. It can be found in the Wastelands and has a very interesting historical background. But I don't want to bore you with old stories. NEXT wants you for a meeting with a certain Elias from the Fallen Angels. He should wait at one of the entrances to Tech Haven.

• Good luck and take care when crossing the Wastelands, it might be dangeorous.

• Have you already met Elias at the Tech Haven entrance in e 07?

• Can you tell me a little bit more about Tech Haven? It looks like quite an impressive structure.

• *sigh* Alright. Tech Haven was built from scratch for the purposes of the Fallen Angels. That was in the year 2633, if I remember correctly. But since the Angels were forced to move to the Dome, Tech Haven has become a independent trading outpost adminstrated by a pure business-orientated splinter group of the Fallen Angels.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: There is another opportunity to do something for NEXT. It is not easy to explain because opinions vary greatly amongst the citizens of Neocron. Many opinions regarding the Fallen Angels are based on lies and prejudices which rarely are based on facts that really speak against them.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: The Fallen Angels have a rather strained relationship to the CityAdmin. It is a shame that they have such an immense Know-how that many could profit from but in reality few people actually do. But NEXT is different in that we only evaluate the potential and the actions of the organization in question. We do not take rumours or prejudice into consideration. That means that the Fallen Angels are an opportunity for us.

Your response: Yes, but what really is your point? Are there connections between NEXT and the Fallen Angels?

NPC: That is exactly the point, officially we do not have any connections to them. But despite the general opinion about the Fallen Angels we have no intention of wasting valuable resources on research that we could simply acquire from the Fallen Angels. NEXT has to proceed carefully with these deals, however. If the fact that we occasionally deal with the Fallen Angels would surface it would mean a great loss to our reputation.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: NEXT is aware of the risks involved but still tries to maintain a certain level of contact to the Fallen Angels. Only recently an exchange of information was arranged but we were still looking for the right person who could be trusted with such an assignment.

Your response: That means that you have found the right person? You mean that I am the right person?

Your response: If you think about me, I do not have time at the moment I fear.

NPC: Very perceptive. You seem to have a great career ahead of you. So you already know where the Fallen Angels facility can be found?

Your response: It is called Tech Haven, am I right?

NPC: Yes. Some people would even call it the technical paradise. Why? Well, you will be able to see that for yourself when you get there. It can be found in the Wastelands and has a very interesting historical background. But I don't want to bore you with old stories. NEXT wants you for a meeting with a certain Elias from the Fallen Angels. He should wait at one of the entrances to Tech Haven.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: We have been told that he has the authority to speak for the Fallen Angels. Even as he is making quite a secret about his faction association due to the current political situation. Listen to what he has to say. He will also provide you with a control chip that you should bring back to Mr Mason. You will already have met him, am I right?

Your response: Yes. I am on my way then.

NPC: Good luck and take care when crossing the Wastelands, it might be dangeorous.

NPC: It was worth a try. Come back if you feel ready for an assignment.

NPC: Have you already met Elias at the Tech Haven entrance in e 07?

NPC: I have expected your arrival. At least they were nice enough to inform me at all. Wait a second, you don't look very official to me.

Your response: It is irrelevant how I am dressed. I am here as a representative from NEXT.

NPC: I expected to be able to talk to a proper NEXT employee here. At least. You seem to be only a simple Runner.

Your response: If that is how you see me it is your problem. It seems to me as if you have no choice but to talk to me.

NPC: If that is necessary. Do you have at least the required expertise to understand what we will be talking about?

Your response: Don't worry. I am well prepared. If you believe that I am not qualified, I will personally see to it that this exchange will be delayed for a few months. That is a promise.

NPC: Alright, alright. Then let's begin. But should I talk to you about the Cryo technology first? Yes, I think we will start with Cryo technology. I hope you already know what that is. Do you?

Your response: Of course, that is really basic stuff. It enables you to stay asleep almost indefinitely, right?

NPC: Yes, it is especially useful in spaceships and is already known for quite some time. But now the Fallen Angels laboratories have even managed to improve the Cryo techonology.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: In the end there are now several advantages to our method. Persons who wake from a long Cryo sleep do not suffer any longer from frostburn or similar illnesses for example. NEXT will probably be interested in our research into Cryo technology.

Your response: Yes, especially since NEXT is involved in space travel research and various projects. But I have no authority to agree to that exchange.

NPC: Yes, I assumed something like that. Regarding the current political situation we rather wait a little bit longer to play safe. You NEXT guys are so predictable. Well, I have forwarded the relevant data to the NEXT labs. Decide whenever you want.

Your response: I was instructed to expect a control chip that you agreed to give to NEXT. Did I misunderstand something there?

NPC: No, in fact, that is the original purpose of this meeting. The Fallen Angels have completed the prototype of a new kind of control chip. It functions more efficient and some problems that occured with the previous model have been eliminated. It should fit in nicely with the rest of the experimental vehicle. Take the chip and don't loose it somewhere. The payment is already agreed upon. Probably the usual method.

Your response: What kind of experimental vehicle?

NPC: I believe it is still labelled top secret. I shouldn't tell you any more about it. Good luck then.

Your response: Can you tell me a little bit more about Tech Haven? It looks like quite an impressive structure.

NPC: *sigh* Alright. Tech Haven was built from scratch for the purposes of the Fallen Angels. That was in the year 2633, if I remember correctly. But since the Angels were forced to move to the Dome, Tech Haven has become a independent trading outpost adminstrated by a pure business-orientated splinter group of the Fallen Angels.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: This splinter group tries to cover their direct associations by always stating that they are only interested in making credits. But the secret Fallen Angels Faction Office deep in the Tech Haven cores speaks for their true motives. If you want to know more about Tech Haven feel free to contact one of the administrative employees around here. I have no time any longer. No, to be honest, I am tired of telling you about Tech Haven. Please go back to Neocron now.

NPC: Listen, there is a lot to do here. You should rather try and mind your own business. Go back to your company.

NPC: You were tasked to bring that control chip to me. So, simply get it and hand it over to me.

NPC: Have you received the control chip?

Your response: Yes, although the Fallen Angels contact person was a rather aloof character.

NPC: Yes, that sounds like Elias. But as long as they constantly deliver quality products I don't really mind. This control chip will enable our vehicles to react even faster to possible dangers for the vehicle. It will also make controlling the vehicle as comfortable as never before. I personally believe that the future is with vehicles, not with Irata III like Mr Diggers envisions.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: We have everything we will ever need right here, we just have to take it. And this whole Irata III bullshit only means that humanity gets another chance at turning another paradise into a radioactive wasteland.

Your response: But isn't it possible that Irata III is really as wonderful as everybody says?

NPC: Let me tell you something. Irata III might be the most wonderful place there ever was and yet I say the future is here. Apart from that, I don't believe that humanity deserves to get their hands on another blue planet I believe we have everything we need. And if we don't manage to persist here and now it would only be a matter of time until Irata III would suffer the same destiny. That is all I have to say about that.

Your response: You seem to be rather bitter.

NPC: Bitter? It happened too long ago already. I cannot feel bitter about it anymore I guess. Back then my eyes were opened to the reality. I don't really want to talk about it any longer. NEXT will have need of you in the future. Prepare yourself and if you feel ready come back. Here are 5000 credits as reward.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Ahh, you are back. I fear we do not have another official assignment for you. But I wanted to ask you if you could go and check on old Torben in the Pepper Park subway station. He didn't want to talk to me but I know he has a problem if he doesn't pick up his work again soon.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: I mean, after all this is a company and not the wellfare. NEXT cannot afford to pay mechanics who don't do their work. That's why I am asking you to meet him and figure out if he needs help. He was one of the guys who built the subway in the first place. One of the pioneers if I may say so.

Your response: Alright, I will have a look.

Your response: I really cannot do it at the moment. I am sorry.

NPC: Thank you in advance. He likes to visit Garriots Diner there.

NPC: Maybe you will change your mind later on.

NPC: Could you please help Torben? You can find him in the Pepper Park subway station usually.

NPC: Hey! Do I know you? And I was beginning to think that this was a place where you are alone with your trouble.

Your response: That is exactly the reason why I am here.

NPC: What? To be alone with your troubles?

Your response: No, not really. I come from NEXT. They are all wondering why you have stopped doing your work. NEXT could decide to fire you if this continues.

NPC: How do you like the subway? I like it a lot. It is very soothing with the gentle hissing and swaying of the hovercabs.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: It all looked quite different back when we started to build it in the first place. Rain water would prevent access to some support tubes, gigantic boulders would have to be removed and one time some mutants errected a barricade in one of the tubes. We had to kill time for two whole months until the NCPD could solve the problem. Ha, those were the days.

Your response: Somehow I get the feeling that you are avoiding my questions.

NPC: NEXT has always paid for the work. And paid good. Even when Mr Diggers sold all his shares of the company and caused a major hubbub the payments continued.

Your response: Look, I know you have a problem and I am prepared to help but that is only possible with your DAMN COOPERATION!!

NPC: ...

Your response: I am sorry but it had to be said.

NPC: Alright... yes, I got a problem but I am supposed not to tell it to anyone. They said they would break every single bone in my body. And I cannot stand pain. I hate it...

Your response: You can trust me. Pull yourself together and tell me what happened.

NPC: These... people... came to me after my shift and gave me a beating. I could barely reach the appartement of me and my ex-wife before collapsing. They said, they would come back and continue where they stopped unless I stopped working... and ... and I cannot bear the pain. Please help me...

Your response: These bastards, to beat up a defenseless man like that. Who was it, do you have any idea? Does NEXT know about it?

NPC: No, I wasn't strong enough. I am frightened. But I have heard of similar cases with other employees... Those guys were definitely Black Dragon and came from the Outzone. No doubt. But you'll never stand a chance on your own. They are very strong.

Your response: Maybe you are underestimating me. But maybe we can consult the CityMercs? They are bound to have experience with this scum.

NPC: That might just be. I know one of them is here in Neocron. Gerard is his name and he can be found in the Black Ribbon Bar in the HQ of the CityMercs at the Military Base. But please only mention my name if it is really necessary. I still want to enjoy the rest of my life.

NPC: I have more pressing matters to attend to, excuse me.

NPC: What are you doing here? This is CityMerc property.

Your response: I know, I know, I wanted to speak to Gerard.

NPC: Are you blind boy? I am Gerard. State your business soldier.

Your response: I know somebody who is currently working at NEXT and is roughed up severely by some Black Dragon scum. On top of that, he gets blackmailed by them aswell.

NPC: I am familiar with that kind of stuff, happens a lot around here. Blackmailing happens every day. Most of the time the Black Dragon have some kind of motive, though. I mean, they don't just blackmail somebody just because they feel like it. Although I heard that happened too. I have seen once how they cut out somebodies eye implant when he was fully conscious. Rough people, you better watch your step in their vicinity.

Your response: Can't you do anything against it? I am certain that the company would pay for it. The Black Dragons can be found in the Outzone.

NPC: I believe that we can do something. But we need the exact location where we can find them. The Outzone is not precise enough. Or maybe you can even talk to them, sometimes even they see reason. But there is something else. Yes, there are some rumours that ProtoPharm is supporting the Black Dragon to go against NEXT. But I don't have a clue whether that is true or not.

Your response: ProtoPharm is goading the Black Dragons on against us? It is hard to believe that they would do such a thing.

NPC: It is rumoured. Alright, we will see to your problem. But we need to know exactly where they are because we cannot search the whole Outzone for them. And you should try and talk to them, maybe they only want money. Try the Outzone Sec-5, I heard several rumours of fishy deals going on there, good luck soldier.

NPC: Look who is there. Another sissy who dares to enter our territory. Say what you want, maybe you can convince us not to kill you straightaway.

Your response: I am here because you are roughing up some employees from NEXT without any reason.

NPC: Well, those must have been real ugly ones that have begged us to do it. NEXT you say? Yes, I believe you are right. We have done ProtoPharm a little favor. An unofficial one. They were probably tired of you NEXT guys as well.

Your response: You are really going to get trouble because of this. Isn't there a possibility to arrange for this to stop? Money maybe?

NPC: Well, if you are offering enough... of course. We are after all reasonable men. What do you offer?

Your response: Personally I cannot offer you anything but NEXT...

NPC: Well you have quite a big mouth. First you promise us riches and then you put us off. As if you could promise something from NEXT. I believe you did not quite understand that you are all alone here.

Your response: I really mean it, there must be another way out of this situation.

NPC: Fine, just get the hell out of here.

NPC: Why are you still here?!

NPC: Go and find out about their exact whereabouts. Try to talk to them first.

NPC: And? Have you encountered them?

Your response: Sure, can't you see it? Those damned bastards tried to kill me!

NPC: Calm down soldier. I am not making the rules here. But since you have confirmed their position we can take action against them. Normally we send our own scout but I thought you looked tough enough for the challenge. You could do us another favor, maybe...

Your response: Forget it, either you take care of it or I am gone from this place.

NPC: Alright, alright. Of course we will take care of it. After all we are still CityMercs. Wouldn't be the first time that we fight against the Black Dragon. I just want to bring 2735 to your attention. Man, that must have been a slaughter. Our boss really whooped their asses. I think we will only need one white ribbon platoon for this one, though. Don't rack your brains over it, we're taking over and you'll be as safe as in Plaza 1.

NPC: I have already told you that we are on it. You can tell your friend that everything will be taken care of.

NPC: Any news? Did you already visit Gerard in the City Mercs HQ?

NPC: Have you spoken to the CityMercs? What did they say?

Your response: Well, after the Dragons tried to kill me first, yes. It seems the CityMercs are going to take care of the situation now.

NPC: The Mercs are taking care of it? Really?

Your response: I just said so, didn't I?

NPC: That would mean I am saved! Once the CityMercs take care of something, they do it right. Thank you Runner! I would not have thought you could help me. I thought nobody could help me. But I have been wrong. I will commence my work at once!

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: And if I can, I will try to make it up to you later on. At the moment I only have these 5000 credits left but I hope they are sufficient for the moment at least. I will support you and suggest that you be given more important tasks in the future. Goodbye and thank you, Runner! Here is a reward for serving NEXT, its a motorbike.

CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Hydrosin
• Kaboxorid

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• BLUEPRINT- 30 TB Capacity:
• Hydrosin
