entries.conversation:
NPC: Good that you arrived just now, hurry and see Mason. Something terrible happened.

NPC: Hurry, Mason is already waiting impatiently.

NPC: You arrive in the nick of time. Something terrible happened. You have already heard of our system administrator? I was informed that she has been poisoned and that she has fallen into coma. I cannot bear to think what would happen if she dies.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: She could never complete her artful programs and with her death all of her shares of the company would flow onto the open market and the whole company structure could change. Believe me, such a change would be far from welcome.

Your response: What is supposed to happen now?

NPC: The experts told me that there is a medicine that could wake her from her comatose slumber. But that medicine is only available from BioTech or ProtoPharm. Since Protopharm will certainly not hand it over to us we need to get it from BioTech. The chemicals we need are Hydrosin and Kaboxorid. What are you waiting for? You are one of the most reliable Runners, therefore it is only appropriate if you go and get it. Hurry up and find the BioTech employee either in Viarosso 1 or the Biotech HQ and get those materials!

NPC: A productive day to you, Runner. What can I do for you?

Your response: It is very important! Hurry and give me some Hydrosin and Kaboxorid.

NPC: Of course. I have been informed that somebody would come and get it. Unfortunately there is a slight problem...

Your response: That is just what we need right now! What kind of problem is it?

NPC: We've got enormous amounts of Hydrosin stored but Kaboxorid is not available any longer. A new delivery is only expected to arrive at the end of the month.

Your response: That is a catastrophe! Have you any idea who else could have Kaboxorid for sale?

NPC: I fear that apart from us only Protopharm is offering that product. Unless, wait a moment! Kaboxorid is produced by the El Farid and they are bound to have more of it. You should try it there. Do you still want the Hydrosin, though?

Your response: If there is no other possibility I will only take the Hydrosin for now. Thank you. I have to hurry back to NEXT and report this, goodbye.

NPC: You are from NEXT? Just wanted to say that ProtoPharm is buying NEXT shares like crazy... But probably you already know about that. Good luck.

NPC: Didn't you say that you have to hurry back to NEXT?

NPC: Where did you leave the medicine? Hurry up!

NPC: Runner! Where have you been? I am not going to loose our system administrator because of you. Violet Derix is an important person for us! Do you have the medicine?

Your response: I could only get Hydrosin. They told me that the only place to actually get the other stuff is Protopharm or the El Farid village.

NPC: Only Hydrosin? That is not enough. Violets situation is getting worse. She almost looks dead on the screens already. Damn it, this is too much like the death of my own family. Go and get this damned Kaboxorid!

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: You will already have a motorbike courtesy of NEXT. Try and see Almachim about it, he will hopefully be able to organise some Kaboxorid. He lives in the El Farid village.

Your response: I just wanted to pass on that Protopharm seems to buy shares like mad before I go.

NPC: That might even be the case but you should just get the missing element!! That is more important right now!

NPC: I am very busy at the moment, why don't you come back the next month?

NPC: Welcome to our village, Runner. It is rare but it seems that some city people do actually find this isolated place. Although they come with a purpose most of the time. What is your purpose then?

Your response: You have already guessed that I come with a purpose. It is very important. The life of a very important person depends on the success of my mission.

NPC: Welcome to our village, Runner. It is rare but it seems that some city people do actually find this isolated place. Although they come with a purpose most of the time. What is your purpose then?

Your response: You have already guessed that I come with a purpose. It is very important. The life of a very important person depends on the success of my mission.

NPC: You came all the way out here just to save the life of another city person? That honours you. Here take a sip of this excellent wine first. Don't worry, it is only alcohol. Many of the rules of the city do not apply out here as you would expect them to. City people get ill because of their hectic life style and yet they carry on. Their life means nothing to them and yet they cry if a person close to them dies. Can you explain that to me?

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But out here in the desert, where the sand and the wind combine to form a deadly threat, where the scorpion stalks its prey, out here there are different rules. I you want to achieve something out here you need patience. Then tell me what you exactly want.

Your response: I am in dire need of a product called Kaboxorid. I could not find it anywhere else. I was told that it is being produced out here however

NPC: Kaboxorid? I am not surprised that it is rare now. Last year the production of it was stopped. The few remaining chemicals that are still around are only the remnants. See, the chemical is extracted from a poisenous cactus and has an effect like a drug in its pure form.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: In lesser concentrations however it can be used to awaken a person from even the deepest coma. But there are some serious side effects which are the reason why the production was stopped. One of the side effects were spontaneous mutation.

Your response: Production was cancelled? That is madness! Only because of a few mutations?

NPC: I don't know how the city people think, but if you ask an El Farid to choose between death or mutation he would surely choose death. It is an unworthy life to live with a mutation. The dignity of being yourself would be destroyed, the pureness of your spirit would be poisoned.

Your response: I am not questioning your traditions, I only want that chemical.

NPC: It honours you that you respect our traditions. Indeed we do not have the substance anymore but we still possess some blueprints that we have used for the production process. I believe we could spare one in this case.

Your response: Very good, exactly what I need...

NPC: Not so fast, Runner. Nothing if given for free in this desert. But your story tells me that you will still have to pay your own price for the blueprint. You have to construct the required chemical out of the blueprint and be quick about it. The life of a person can be a very fragile thing.

Your response: Thank you, I am in your dept. But now I really have to hurry.

NPC: Then make haste back to the secure walls of your city.

NPC: You really seem to take your time in bringing the chemical to Neocron.

NPC: Don't waste time! A human life is at stake here!!

NPC: Do you have it?

Your response: Yes, I have it. Go on and take it.

NPC: We need Kaboxorid! No Blueprint or other rubbish!

NPC: Thank heavens. I don't know what could have happened but now it should not be a problem any longer. The experts have assured me that the administrator will awake from the coma with the help of these substances.

Your response: I have returned just in time it seems. But it really wasn't easy because I had to construct the substance first with the help of a Blueprint.

NPC: Really? NEXT is now really indebted to you. Thanks to you we will have our system administrator back in no time.

Your response: Good news but it was not too easy after all.

NPC: I wish there would have been such a miracle potion in existence back when my wife still lived. Well. I have followed up your report and it really seems as if ProtoPharm is trying to buy NEXT shares from every possible source. It is rather unsettling but I believe we have to wait for now. Wait and observe.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: As for your reward, you have really earned the 20000 credits now. Furthermore you have been chosen to conduct a test drive with an experimental vehicle for the next time. Don't thank me, it was Torben who bugged me until I gave in and accepted it. But remember, you have to get in good shape for this one.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Experimental Key for NExT Reveler-Chaincraft V.2.5

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Experimental Key for NExT Reveler-Chaincraft V.2.5

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• NEXT would like to offer you to test drive one of our experimental vehicle. Mason might have already mentioned it to you. You can fetch the keys for the vehicle from the technician Benji at the desert race track in sector G 11. Your task is to do extensive tests of the vehicle in the surrounding desert.

• Wasn't that the guy from the Outzone Sector 3 I saw recently?

• Good luck. The Outzone 03 is no place where I'd like to be...

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: NEXT would like to offer you to test drive one of our experimental vehicle. Mason might have already mentioned it to you. You can fetch the keys for the vehicle from the technician Benji at the desert race track in sector G 11. Your task is to do extensive tests of the vehicle in the surrounding desert.

NPC: Simply talk to the NEXT technician Benji at the desert race track. After all is done you can visit Mason here at the HQ.

NPC: You have to be the test driver then, am I right?

Your response: Yes, that's me. Now I only need the keys. Reminds me, what kind of vehicle is it anyway?

NPC: Well, it is a modified version of the standard track buggy. A new kind of alloy was developed and is now serving as armor. That alloy originally was a sideproduct of the space research. This alloy serves to make the vehicle very rigid. But about the keys... you have come too late.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: I was just waiting here for you to turn up when suddenly these unpleasent Black Dragons appeared. They threatened to shoot me if I would not give them the keys. There was no other choice for me than to hand the keys over to them.

Your response: The keys have been stolen?! How can you stay so calm? I cannot believe it.

NPC: What was I supposed to do? Oh yeah, I know, let them shoot me only that they take the keys afterwards. I don't think so. But wait... I believe one of them called the leader Richard Faust. Maybe that helps?

Your response: Wasn't that the guy from the Outzone Sector 3 I saw recently?

NPC: Maybe you can still get the keys back if you hurry. If you get them back you might just as well go back to the NEXT HQ since the test drive is cancelled anyway. Mason will surely be happy to see the keys again I believe.

Your response: Apparently I have to go after a Black Dragon guy once more. I don't have fond memories of them when I think back. And you better not get lost on the way back.

NPC: No need to fear. I know my way around this desert.

NPC: Good luck. The Outzone 03 is no place where I'd like to be...

NPC: Piss off Runner!

NPC: There are still wonders in this world. That NEXT clown is really coming to me to get his ass whooped.

Your response: You better hand over the keys to the experimental vehicle at once.

NPC: Ha ha. Very good. You better hand them over at once... that was almost good enough for the big screen. Even if I had the keys I would not hand it over to you. NEXT will not exist for much longer anyway. ProtoPharm is going to swallow NEXT whole.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Nothing will be left of NEXT, believe me. And about the keys... they are in the hands of the reliable Mr Karsten. You could find him near the Pussy Club.

Your response: Thanks for the info.

NPC: Just get the hell out of here!

NPC: Piss off.

NPC: Enjoy your time at the club.

NPC: Welcome in this swamp of corruption and worldly enjoyments. What is such a well known Runner doing out here in the lions den?

Your response: Let me come straight to the point. You have got some keys that belong to NEXT. Hand them over and we'll forget this whole thing.

NPC: It will not be that easy, Runner. Even if you saved the system administrator from sure death it will not change anything. NEXT will become a small part of ProtoPharm. And you know what is the best thing about it? There is no escape. Now to your request. Yes, I have these keys right here.

Your response: What bullshit are you talking about?! NEXT will never be swallowed by ProtoPharm...

NPC: First of all here are your keys back, after all I am not the average kind of thief. But... I simply hate NEXT! They are responsible for all the evil here in Neocron! NEXT will go down whether you like it or not!

Your response: Not as long as I can help it.

NPC: We'll see.

NPC: I have an important meeting with our superiors coming up. Try later again.

NPC: Benji has already reported that you were off chasing the Black Dragon on your own. Impressive. I would not have thought to see you again.

Your response: But that is not everything, I also have got the keys back.

NPC: You have the keys back? Then there was a fight? Who did steal the key after all?

Your response: It turned out to be a certain Dennis Karsten. He was totally insane.

NPC: Karsten? I remember that name. He worked for ProtoPharm for years. He got a little bit mad after an accident that we were partially responsible for. He had this sister whom he loved very much. After the accident we received masses of hatemail from his hand.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Well, his sister died in an accident with one the alpha version of the gliders. I think he has never forgiven NEXT for that. But people should just read the small print and they would know the risk involved in testing our products. I hope he did not injure you or anything?

Your response: It's alright. Both Karsten and Richard Faust from the Black Dragon have talked about ProtoPharm having plans to take over NEXT. I don't like the sound of that.

NPC: I will not get involved into that discussion right now. We know that ProtoPharm was very active recently. The number of shares that are still with loyal NEXT friends is decreasing as we speak. But there is no simple solution for this problem. We work on it. In case you didn't notice, you have earned 50000 credits for bringing back those keys back.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: We know that you missed your shot to do the testdrive. The technicians will certainly want to go over all settings first before a second testdrive will be considered. Once we find a way to deal with ProtoPharm we will need your loyal help again. That much I can assure you. You have made quite an impression on NEXT.

Your response: At the moment I only ever talk to you to be honest, there is no way I can see my popularity it seems.

NPC: Exactly, but I recently had a conversation with Mr. Diggers and he expressed great respect for you. He said he is already curious to see how you will fare in the future. Well, there is much to do and I have to get back to business.

CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Key for NExT Assault 4WD Chaincraft 'Reveler'

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• The plan is supposed to start soon. You need to meet Elias as soon as possible. Although I havn't got a clue why. Good luck, we count on your success. After all we do not want to loose our working places and end up in the Wastelands...

• Didn't you want to visit Elias in Tech Haven? After everything is settled see Mason back here.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: I am glad to see you back again. Mason instructed me to tell you his plans concerning the unbelievable actions from ProtoPharm. It seems now everybody knows about them, however there is a way to return everything back to normal.

Your response: That sounds promising but is it true?

NPC: Unfortunately I don't know all details of the plan. I know that a contact from the Fallen Angels is going to help us, though. A certain Elias.

Your response: Elias? Yes I know that guy, he is a little stuck up though. But let's see what he has to say once we meet again.

NPC: The plan is supposed to start soon. You need to meet Elias as soon as possible. Although I havn't got a clue why. Good luck, we count on your success. After all we do not want to loose our working places and end up in the Wastelands...

NPC: Didn't you want to visit Elias in Tech Haven? After everything is settled see Mason back here.

NPC: I have heard about the things you have done for NEXT. This doesn't happen often, but must say that I am impressed. Let us get to the point right away. The progress of ProtoPharm in the last weeks needs to be undone. I hope you have already been told how that is supposed to happen?

Your response: I have come here totally uninformed. I don't even know the details of the plan.

NPC: Oh, very well, since I was entrusted with this by Violet Derix herself I will tell you how it will happen. But only because Violet especially asked for you in this matter. We will hack the Neocron network and produce an error message. That error message will be our savior.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Violet and myself have used the time and come up with a kind of virus with the only goal to target all business data of the last few weeks. That way we will affect all files of in the whole network, containing business transaction data.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: It is the quickest and safest way. Thus the progress of ProtoPharm will be nullified and NEXT will in return know about all the next moves of the enemy. This will enable NEXT to react accordingly to the situation. Have you been able to understand all that?

Your response: Ahhh...what was the conclusion again?

NPC: The conclusion would be that all data will be reset to what it was a few weeks back.

Your response: Of course, I understood that of course. What then are we waiting for?

NPC: I have a backdoor that goes via North Star uplink just let me.... ahh shit.

Your response: What?

NPC: Something is interfering with the link. And I can't use any other route otherwise we will be discovered.

Your response: What's interfering?

NPC: Let me see... wait! There a Malfunction Warbot near a repeater station in I07 - just south of Emmerson Factory!

Your response: The Warbot is history....

NPC: Oh yes, afterwards you could do me a favor and ask a certain CityAdmin employee whether or not it worked out all right. I can't remember the name but he can be found in the CityAdmin installation. I should tell you that your Mr Mason wants to speak to you after this is done as well.

NPC: I can only start my action once the Warbot is disabled.

NPC: Alright, everything is done so far. Make sure you visit the right CityAdmin personnel and see whether or not we were successful.

NPC: I am very busy at the moment, just try it again later on.

NPC: Hello citizen, what can I do for you?

Your response: I wanted to ask how many people within Neocron have accessed their bank account yesterday... it is for a statistic I am working on.

NPC: That is no problem. Thanks to our electronical database it will only be a moment. What the... this is strange, there is no entry for yesterday. That is most definitely wrong... the day before yesterday hasn't got one either...

Your response: That's all I wanted to know. ... Goodbye.

NPC: Just a second there is data missing all over the place...

NPC: I have no time! Somebody screwed up the whole network. Much data did just vanish somehow. I must inform my superiors at once!

NPC: I have all hands full trying to stop those ProtoPharm vultures...

NPC: And you have done it again. You have saved the day. How do you feel? I am supposed to forward the thanks from Violet to you. Not only because you saved her life, mind. Even Mr. Digger has expressed his gratitude to you. Well, but the normal life will carry on soon enough. And sometime in the future even your heroic deeds will be forgotten.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Enjoy it as long as you can. NEXT has also prepared a special gift for you. Since you were refused to do the testdrive, NEXT is giving you the experimental vehicle. It does now belong to you at no extra costs.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: I believe it will get more peaceful now. If you want to support NEXT even further I would suggest to you to open your own clan. Since there will be no more special runs available for you in such quiet times I fear. But it has been a pleasure to work with you.

• Hrmph, of course I have, I am not stupid after all. The coordinates had to be routed via a satellite, since the emitter is a mobile one. It did not move in several hours, though. The location is Outzone 01. Once you arrive there you will already be able to follow the signals from your display. We suspect it's a man named Grand.

• Why do you suppose I would want to go to the Outzone?

• But the Outzone is a dangerous place.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Welcome at ProtoPharm, how can I help you?

Your response: Since I now belong to ProtoPharm, I thought I could support you a little bit.

NPC: To be precise, you have run out of money, right? Doesn't matter. But since I have no background information about you I will only be able to offer you a simple task. Michail, one of our employees has lost his assistant because of an unfortunate lab accident. Luckily his assistant was only injured. Your task could be to lend him a hand and replace his assistant. Are you interested?

Your response: Of course, that is exactly what I had in mind. Where can I find Michail? And most importantly, what do I get out of this?

NPC: You can find him right here in the HQ. And you will only get 1000 credits for the beginning. But if you stay with your tasks your payments will increase.

Your response: Very well, I am already on my way... Where do I have to go again?

NPC: It's very simple, just go to the labs adjacent to the ProtoPharm building. But take care not to touch anything, the machines are very sensitive.

NPC: If you want to take the job as Michails assistant you have to go to the lab. I am sure you will find him there.

NPC: I have to remind you that the laboratories are not meant for civilians.

Your response: I was told to replace an assistant who had an unfortunate accident.

NPC: So, you want to replace poor Marco? Well, he certainly needs a replacement now. I told him over and over again that he should be careful with the time locks on the CryoVaults. I don't know if he'll ever be the same again. And because of that my research has been put on a lower priority, The only thing left for me at the moment is to work on some documents, which I like.

Your response: And what am I supposed to do?

NPC: I already have something in my mind. I need somebody who knows how to be discreet if the need arises. The background for the task is that many if not all departments at ProtoPharm have received an unsettling email. A rather peculiar and strange email. I will have to clarify a few things from the past in order that you will be able to understand.

Your response: If it is necessary, please continue.

NPC: Maybe you already know that ProtoPharm was created by merging several medical and pharmaceutical companies. That happened 2646 and the first manager of ProtoPharm was a certain Jakob Finster. The result of his leadership saw the first iteration of the CryoVault which is one of the most important developments from ProtoPharm. At 2664 Finster decided to have himself sealed in one of his CryoVaults and gave the control of the company to his son. Since that time there have been many managers, Sandra Frasier only being the latest in a long line.

Your response: Where is the connection to the email?

NPC: The email states that Jakob Finster returned and that he is giving ProtoPharm an ultimatum to cede control over the company to him. I just want to make sure that the email is no fluke before reporting it to the superiors. At least I want to discover where it came from.

Your response: Just a moment, you are telling me that a one hundred year old manager of the company returned from the dead to take up his work again?

NPC: You can surely see that I have to verify this message first. I thought that could be your job. Gregory Parkins is a very capable scientist here in the lab and he should already have determined the origin of the email message. Visit him and report back to me later on to tell me about what you were able to determine.

NPC: I don't have time for this right now.

NPC: Michail sends you, I assume?

Your response: Yes, have you already been able to determine where the email came from?

NPC: Hrmph, of course I have, I am not stupid after all. The coordinates had to be routed via a satellite, since the emitter is a mobile one. It did not move in several hours, though. The location is Outzone 01. Once you arrive there you will already be able to follow the signals from your display. We suspect it's a man named Grand.

Your response: Why do you suppose I would want to go to the Outzone?

NPC: You don't want to then? I could imagine that Michail would really like you to. I mean, you don't have to, it's only a suggestion. Michail can be a rather complicated person. He does not always explicitly tell you what he really wants. He has got big plans for himself and therefore he tends to ignore lesser problems. He dreams a lot, most of the time he doesn't seem to even see the real world.

Your response: But the Outzone is a dangerous place.

NPC: I would go myself but I am not paid for something like that. Be sure to be careful since it would not look good if two assistants of the same section would have an accident in the same week.

NPC: There is nothing here for you. Nothing! Did I make myself clear?

NPC: Client or no client?

Your response: Neither.

NPC: Then you better be gone, I hate neither.

Your response: I am here because of an email that was sent from your machine to ProtoPharm.

NPC: Be gone... One moment, you said from my machine? I have never sent an email to ProtoPharm. You have to be mistaken, Runner.

Your response: I am certain since the signal was traced to your position.

NPC: It seems to be true. Damn, somebody succeeded to put a virus on my system. This is enough to despair already. Just two days ago I made a security check. I can't even delete it manually. Damn, damn, damn!

Your response: Did you send that email or not? If not, who sent it?

NPC: Listen, alright? I did not send your damn email but this virus possibly did. And now I can't even get rid of that thing. I would need a fairly powerful decoding software, which I don't have.

Your response: ProtoPharm is bound to have something like this. How about you find out where you got that virus from and I will get you the decoding software from Gregory?

NPC: That's a deal. I only want to get rid of this triple damned virus. My poor computer. Here is the data you will need for the decoding software.

NPC: Did you already visit the Outzone 01?

NPC: Back so soon? Did you find anything of interest?

Your response: That might well be possible but you have to give me a decoding software before I know. I should be able to get all the information Michail wants.

NPC: Very well. Be sure to use it in a responsible way, don't let it fall into the wrong hands. Give your report directly to Michail afterwards since I am not really responsible for that. I don't want to, to be honest.

NPC: I cannot give you more advice. Visit the Outzone first and then report to Michail.

NPC: Get me that software decoder! Quick! Didn't you say that some ProtoPharm guy could help you with that?

NPC: Give it to me, Runner! I need that decoder!

Your response: Not so hasty, first I want to know who sent the email in the first place.

NPC: Good, very good. The email that was sent by the virus had its origin in a ProtoPharm section. Section 13 to be precise. Now give me that software decoder.

NPC: That email came from section 13. Trust me on that.

NPC: Did you already ask Gregory about that email? This could be very important.

NPC: Then tell me about your research, I hope you have something to show for it.

Your response: Of course I have. The email was traced to a hacker in the Outzone.

NPC: Ah, so it was a hacker attack. Somebody tries to scare us then.

Your response: No, not really. The hacker only served as decoy, the email originally came from ProtoPharm. Section 13.

NPC: Section 13? That name... that is the the CryoVault hall. Nobody can send an email from there. I think I will have to forward this mail to my superiors. Very interesting, I would never have thought it possible. Here is your reward and it would be prudent to visit one of the Human Resource Directors as soon as you have improved your skills sufficiently. For now I am in no need for an assistant. You may go now. (next mission at level 20)

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Datadisc for Susan
• Michails Datacube
• Package with Spirula drugs

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Datadisc for Susan
• Michails Datacube
• Package with Spirula drugs

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• I understand, but you might be able to do me a favour, right? My research uncovered a Black Dragon contact person called Figaro. It would not do for me to meet him since I would be instantly recognized. Go and meet him in the Pepper Park 03 and then come back to me.

• Look for a certain Figaro in Pepper Park 03. He is a typical back street dealer.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: You have been involved in the investigation of this mysterious email, right? The one where they demanded to hand over ProtoPharm.

Your response: I would even go as far to say that I brought light into the mystery.

NPC: Then you are the right person for Mr George. Hurry, he already waits impatiently for you. We would have contacted you earlier but you are changing your locations too often to keep track. You can find him somewhere here in the main building.

NPC: Brandon George already awaits you. He is part of an investigation squad from ProtoPharm.

NPC: Hello Runner, my name is George. Special agent for ProtoPharm. I was assigned to this case to clarify this whole issue. According to my information you have already done some investigation and therefore you know more about it than I do. It would be best if you could work for me for the time being.

Your response: Maybe I know something. But what do I get out of this?

NPC: You are working for ProtoPharm aren't you? At least you have received an apartement from ProtoPharm. I see it as your duty to save ProtoPharm from any outside threats. If that doesn't suit you, you may have chosen the wrong faction. I, for one, would rather work with you than against you. And... there will some rewards for you in this, if I may say so.

Your response: Alright, basically I want to support ProtoPharm. I just worried about the dangers involved.

NPC: Excellent. Let us continue then. What do you think about Michail?

Your response: I don't know him very well but seems to know what he wants. He is very ambitious, though it might not be a strong enough word.

NPC: That supports my impression. What do you think about the fact that the origin of this specific email was the section that is headed by Michail? Is it a coincidence or is there more to it? Does he have something to do with it himself or is he just a puppet for a deeper plan?

Your response: I cannot possibly know that. That is all speculation.

NPC: I understand, but you might be able to do me a favour, right? My research uncovered a Black Dragon contact person called Figaro. It would not do for me to meet him since I would be instantly recognized. Go and meet him in the Pepper Park 03 and then come back to me.

NPC: Hey, hey, don't just stand there, you'll just scare away my customers.

NPC: Hey, you there, yes... get over here. I have already waited for you, what took you so long? I now have the special delivery.

Your response: What? What do you mean?

NPC: The special delivery. You know what I'm talking about.

Your response: Oh yes, of course. And I am supposed to pick it up, right?

NPC: Sure,now that this is done tell Christienne that everything seems to be prepared. The plans can commence soon. Now go away, I don't want anybody to see us together.

NPC: Runner, I have already given the delivery to you, what else are you waiting for?

NPC: Look for a certain Figaro in Pepper Park 03. He is a typical back street dealer.

NPC: I am busy at the moment... oh, it's you. And? Did you find something useful for us?

Your response: Figaro must have mistaken me for somebody else. He handed me a package and then send me on my way before I could ask anything .

NPC: Well, I hope for you that the package will at least yield something useful. I am already lurking in the dark for much too long.

Your response: Let's see... on the package it says ProtoPharm. There is also a production date. It's from two weeks ago.

NPC: Show me that. You are right! I am just wondering what it could be. Well, we will find out in a moment.

Your response: Careful, there might be explosives in there.

NPC: Don't be silly. You couldn't smuggle any explosives into this building, this building is completely secured with state of the art sensors. There is only one small envelope in here in any case... Spirula? My God, that's not possible. The production of this product was cancelled years ago.

Your response: Spirula? Didn't that drug cause mutations?

NPC: Indeed it did. Besides high quality products like Vitae, which is still selling big time, there was also Spirula, sadly enough. But who could profit from distributing this stuff?

Your response: Maybe somebody wants to blackmail ProtoPharm.

NPC: I have no evidence but I believe Michail has got something to do with this. That man has got too many secrets to be sure. In addition he is the only one who has got access for all departments in section 13. Visit him and try to find out as much as possible. I will look into how much reward you will receive.

Your response: As you wish. But that would not really explain the connection to the Black Dragon and Finster.

NPC: That is something I will worry about later. Somehow I am going to solve this puzzle. Make sure that everything you receive from Michail gets to me first.

NPC: A productive day to you. I don't have time to spare right now.

NPC: Don't disturb me, I've got more important things to take care about.

Your response: I won't be put off that easily. I have to talk to you.

NPC: But then you better make it quick.

Your response: I would like you to answer a few questions.

NPC: What kind of questions would that be?

Your response: Questions about the CryoVault, the email and about Finster. I believe you know what I am talking about.

NPC: I cannot give you these answers. As you can clearly see I've got much more important things to take care of.

Your response: Is it maybe true that you have sent the email in the first place? Or maybe that you have a connection to the Spirula drugs that are produced again?

NPC: Don't be ridiculous. I will tell you what I know but you have to prove first that I can trust you. If you reject I will know what to expect from you.

Your response: Good, if that is the price. But first I want to hear what you had in mind.

NPC: Get this data disk to a friend of mine. You can find Susan in Point Red in B_07. Once you have done that you will receive the answers you seek.

NPC: First, visit Michail and try to find out what you can. I want to see anything he gives to you first.

NPC: What?! You just gave the information from Michail to his girlfriend without consulting me in the first place? I explicitly said you were to bring anything from Michail to me first. Anything!

Your response: Damnit, I knew I forgot something. What should I do now?

NPC: Tell me, what answers could you get?

Your response: None for now. He wants me to bring a data disk to his girlfriend. But I thought we could have a look at the data first, before I do that.

NPC: Well done, I am content. Then let's have a look. The data seems to be encrypted, hmmm, I will make a copy of it. Just in case. And now hurry and get that data to Susan or Michail might get suspicious. Tell me after you have found more information.

NPC: Just get that data disk to Susan in B_07. I don't want Michail to get suspicious. But be sure to return once you know more.

NPC: I don't know you, never've seen you. It would be best if you just walk out that door and never return.

NPC: A visitor? For me? That is a surprise. What do you want?

Your response: I would have liked to tell you that I just want to visit but the truth is that Michail sends me.

NPC: Michail? How is he? I haven't seen him in three days. He always buries himself in work.

Your response: He seems to be fine. Here you have a data disk that I am supposed to give to you.

NPC: Thank you, I know what I have to do with it. Do you belong to Michails staff?

Your response: Not exactly, no. Why do you ask?

NPC: I assume Michail appears to be very strange to you, right? But don't judge him hastily. He has a goal that will serve the whole human race. It is his dream.

Your response: And what kind of dream can that be? To undermine ProtoPharm from within?

NPC: What? This suggestion is ludicrous. Michails goal is to heal all mutations once and for all. But I can see that you cannot understand something like that. You couldn't even understand why people would want to help others. Go out of my sight.

Your response: I am sorry but my loyalty lies with ProtoPharm and not Michail. A productive day to you. I will visit Michail again, nontheless.

NPC: Go, I don't want anything to do with you. Take this back to Michail, he will need it. It is a datacube from one of his friends. Don't ask me what it is about.

NPC: I told you, I don't want anything to do with this. And don't forget to bring that Cube to Michail.

NPC: Get that disk to Susan in B_07 and then we will talk again.

NPC: Now that you have finished your errand you have come back for the eagerly awaited answers. Then ask away but make it short, I am a busy man.

Your response: What do you know about this mysterious email?

NPC: It says that Jakob Finster returned to take over the company again. It also gives ProtoPharm an ultimatum. Of course ProtoPharm will not agree to it. Sandra Frasier is not one to cede control that easily. Furthermore the email seems to have its origin in section 13 and I am fully aware that this is my jurisdiction.

Your response: Then you will certainly know who has sent the email.

NPC: It could've been any employee under my supervision. But that would be a vain search since there are so many... is there anything else?

Your response: Just one thing. What do you know about Spirula?

NPC: Spirula? I... ahhh... I don't think that is my responsibility. Go now.

NPC: I don't want to talk about this any longer. Go now.

NPC: Just get this data disk to Susan. I don't want to raise any suspicions. But come back to me if you know more.

NPC: Are there any news, Runner? I hate not being able to do everything myself.

Your response: Michail surely has something to hide in connection to the Spirulina product. But he wasn't very cooperative.

NPC: Probably he already knows that you report everything to me. Hopefully that will force him to make some too quick decisions over which he might stumble. Once he makes a mistake my grand hour has come. But I can only get there with your aid. I am just decoding the information and after that I could use your help again. Here is your reward, a little more than the last time because I recognize that you have done more this time.(next mission at level 30)

NPC: There isn't anything left to do for you. Since you have failed we need to acquire this encrypted data from another source. Since you only did half the work, you only get half the money. Maybe you are more lucky next time. (next mission at level 30)

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• CryoVault section 13 documentation
• Level 3 Authorization
• Snow White

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• CryoVault section 13 documentation
• Level 3 Authorization

POSSIBLE COST
• 1,000 credits (depends on choice)

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Right. It is feared that they may dare to release the drug Spirula in large quantities into the open market. That would be a catastrophe if that would ever be traced back to ProtoPharm. You have to travel to the Tawkeen Village in C_06 yourself and take a look at the situation yourself. You have already proven the last time that you are reliable. I am counting on you. But be careful, the Wastelands are not a safe place to be.

• It is dangerous for somebody like you to be out here in the Wastelands. Take care.

• Fair is fair. Finster had many discussions with some Fallen Angels. I could not understand what they were talking about but I could recognise one of them. Elias. He is always hanging around one of the entrances to Tech Haven E_07. A shy person to be sure but his personality is alright. I cannot tell you more, I fear.

• Fair is fair. Finster had many discussions with some Fallen Angels. I could not understand what they were talking about but I could recognise one of them. Elias. He is always hanging around one of the entrances to Tech Haven. A shy person to be sure but his personality is alright. I cannot tell you more, I fear.

• I have already told you that I don't know more about it. Elias is a Fallen Angel and you can meet him at one of the entrances to the Tech Haven base E_07.

• I am working to help the whole of humanity. I only have this one vision. The vision that mutants will become a thing of the past. So that the world will belong to the people again and not the beasts and killer robots from the Wastelands. The vision, to develop medicine that actually work.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: What can I do for you?

Your response: Did George leave a message for me?

NPC: Let me have a quick look. Yes, he says that he decoded the data now and expects you at the usual location.

NPC: George is waiting at the usual meeting location for you.

NPC: I've got something important to report. We should not delay it any further. The decoded data points to a production cell under the cloak of ProtoPharm in the Tawkeen Village.

Your response: Is it a ProtoPharm production cell then?

NPC: Our files state the opposite. However the people working there are ProtoPharm employees, no doubt. But they don't work because they were ordered by ProtoPharm to do so. Now guess what this whole business is about.

Your response: It must be in connection with Spirula.

NPC: Right. It is feared that they may dare to release the drug Spirula in large quantities into the open market. That would be a catastrophe if that would ever be traced back to ProtoPharm. You have to travel to the Tawkeen Village in C_06 yourself and take a look at the situation yourself. You have already proven the last time that you are reliable. I am counting on you. But be careful, the Wastelands are not a safe place to be.

NPC: It is dangerous for somebody like you to be out here in the Wastelands. Take care.

NPC: What are you looking for? There is not enough here to interest somebody like you. You better leave immediately.

Your response: I hope I am not interrupting anything. I am looking for a ProtoPharm instalment nearby.

NPC: ProtoPharm? Yes, there were quite a lot here. A lot of technical stuff and even two tanks. But you are too late, they have all been gone since yesterday.

Your response: Damn! Did they maybe mention where they wanted to go?

NPC: Calm down. No, I haven't got the slightest idea where they wanted to go. I was never close enough to Finster to determine something more precise.

Your response: Finster? Finster was in the camp? You have really seen him?

NPC: Sure. He was always around the camp. I don't think he even slept a single day. He was always up and about. He also received many visitors.

Your response: Yes? What kind of visitors?

NPC: I am not certain. It seems that this whole business is rather important to you. I will tell you who he met with all that time.  But only if you give me something in return.

Your response: If the price is not too high we can talk about it.

NPC: Credits, Runner, rule the world. That is why my information has its price in credits. 1000 credits should be enough.

Your response: That is clearly too much for such a simple answer.

NPC: Well, you could also bring me some Snow White drinks. Let's say six of it. It's your choice.

NPC: What do you choose? To pay or to get me some drinks?

Your response: I've got six Snow White right here. Let's make a deal.

Your response: Here is your money.

NPC: First you tell me that you got something for me and then you have empty hands.

NPC: Fair is fair. Finster had many discussions with some Fallen Angels. I could not understand what they were talking about but I could recognise one of them. Elias. He is always hanging around one of the entrances to Tech Haven E_07. A shy person to be sure but his personality is alright. I cannot tell you more, I fear.

NPC: You don't have enough money. Next time try it with some more money in your pockets.

NPC: Fair is fair. Finster had many discussions with some Fallen Angels. I could not understand what they were talking about but I could recognise one of them. Elias. He is always hanging around one of the entrances to Tech Haven. A shy person to be sure but his personality is alright. I cannot tell you more, I fear.

NPC: I have already told you that I don't know more about it. Elias is a Fallen Angel and you can meet him at one of the entrances to the Tech Haven base E_07.

NPC: You will understand that I cannot just talk to everyone who is just passing by.

NPC: You are on Fallen Angel territory. What can I do for you?

Your response: You could answer some questions. I am coming from ProtoPharm to find out about Jakob Finsters plans.

NPC: What business he has with us is between Finster and the Fallen Angels, don't you think?

Your response: Since Finster has given us an ultimatum it IS of my concern and that of ProtoPharm.

NPC: Very well, but I won't tell you all the details about it. Yes, we have an agreement with Finster. We have first met him in the middle of his camp. He is cold and very calculating but he seems to know his goals. He offered us information about the reversal of mutations. How could we say no to such an offer? Such an offer would probably have earned him much more than just being able to use our laboratories. Since that was what he was asking us about.

Your response: But what are his intentions? What does he need your labs for?

NPC: Finster knew that ProtoPharm is chasing him. He often talked to us about it. Strange that all the other workers in the camp seemed to be ProtoPharm as well. He also asked us about a copy of the Ceres Disks, although we barely have any copies of those documents at all. I believe he will have reached one of his other hiding places. We did not have contact to him in days.

Your response: It seems clear that he is working on something. But what?

NPC: We are no spies, Runner. We are scientists and if somebody wishes to withhold some information from us we really have more important things to do than to spy for his intentions. Now go back to your boss. A good day to you.

NPC: I can't speak to you the whole day long.

NPC: Did you already visit the Tawkeen Village in C_06? You need to find out something about the production cell there.

NPC: There are already those that see Finster as some sort of Messiah who came to lead them into a bright new future. There really are some mad persons out there. Finster is laid on ice and he will stay there. Now what did you say was that camp all about?

Your response: Unfortunately I came too late but I could still determine two things. Finster had been there and he has taken the lead. He did also have some dealings with the Fallen Angels.

NPC: Finster was there? Impossible! Finster is in one of our CryoVaults in section 13. If he was there it has to be a double.

Your response: Furthermore he was looking for the Ceres Disks.

NPC: Something has to be done. Get the CryoVault documents from Michail, quickly. I have already given you the authorisation.

NPC: I have no time at the moment.

NPC: What now? I cannot work like this.

Your response: I have the authorisation to fetch the documents concerning Jakob Finster.

NPC: What? Ah, well, but listen to me first.

Your response: I will listen.

NPC: I am working to help the whole of humanity. I only have this one vision. The vision that mutants will become a thing of the past. So that the world will belong to the people again and not the beasts and killer robots from the Wastelands. The vision, to develop medicine that actually work.

Your response: Why do you tell me that??

NPC: I hope that you will understand me. I hope you will remember it one day. Here are the documents that you wanted.

NPC: You already have the documents. What else could you want?

NPC: I need the CryoVault documents from Michail in section 13.

NPC: Thank you. You are very reliable.

Your response: It was almost too easy.

NPC: Just a moment. Jakob Finster doesn't even appear on this list. That is not good at all. I thought there were explicit orders not to remove him from section 13. I will have to get some high level authorizations before I continue. Here is your reward. (next mission at level 35)

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• I hoped to be able to put your skills to good use again. As you might know there is some chaos about the unknown whereabouts of the missing CryoVault. Nobody has a clue on how they managed to remove Jakob Finster from sector 13 without triggering any alarms. My guess would be that Michail is involved in one or the other way.

• Yes, one of their members, NO runner. Which one is of no importance since sooner or later the wrath of Crahn will get them all. You should be able to find some members at the Tech Haven entrance in E_07.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Brandon George has asked me to tell you that he needs your assistance. You should be on your way soon. I have heard that he received full power warrants directly from Sandra Frasier. It might be a pretty important task that you are required for. Good luck whatever it'll be.

NPC: George has been looking for you all over this place. Be sure to meet him soon.

NPC: I hoped to be able to put your skills to good use again. As you might know there is some chaos about the unknown whereabouts of the missing CryoVault. Nobody has a clue on how they managed to remove Jakob Finster from sector 13 without triggering any alarms. My guess would be that Michail is involved in one or the other way.

Your response: Do you have any proof for this?

NPC: Not really but ProtoPharm could sack him on charges of disregarding his duties alone. But that is not my main concern at the moment. We need to locate Jakob Finster and try to find out whether or not he has a double. We can't even be one hundred percent certain that Finster isn't running around in person, now that his CryoVault vanished.

Your response: Maybe we should start at the beginning and look for any clues that that might yield.

NPC: That is what standard procedures are all about. I have done some research on the topic and I discovered that the initial reason for Finster to use a CryoVault in the first place might be a disease. A disease that did not have a cure at that time. There might have been other reasons but that would be pure speculation.

Your response: Is it known what kind of disease it was?

NPC: No, as far as I know many documents were lost while the management was in the hands of Jan Pixner. But everything indicates that Finster has not been defrosted every twenty years. That has been his last will and it seems now that he has been a prisoner of his own CryoVault for almost one hundred years. I assume that somebody came to pity him in the end or that somebody wanted to use him somehow. Or Finster might have included a fail safe device that would defrost him within a certain period of time.

Your response: That is what I call speculation. I suggest we inform ourselves about who is in charge of guarding the CryoVaults. If we are lucky we will get a trail that we can track.

NPC: Sounds like a plan. You are right. Talk to Gregory Parkins in the lab since he is the one who has a key to the CryoVaults. The only other keys are inside a safe. That safe has got a time lock which opens only once every ten days. I assume it is safe to assume that those have not been used. Therefore Gregory must have been involved.

NPC: What do you want? The lab is no playground. People who have absolutely no business here are crowding the lab.

Your response: Oh, I can assure you that I come with a purpose. I need to know who borrowed your keys for the CryoVault.

NPC: I have no clue what you are talking about. The keys have always been right here in my pocket. I know my duties.

Your response: Really? How is it possible then that one CryoVault is missing? A very important one I might add.

NPC: Ahem... of course, this is... Alright, I won't deny it. I am already in it over my head. Please don't report this, they have forced me to give them the keys. They blackmailed me with a certain story from my past and I just could not let that happen.

Your response: Which means that you have given the keys away?

NPC: Yes but I couldn't say how the people looked like, even if my life depended on it. They all had gas masks and wore hooded cloaks. Nobody could have identified them. I cannot tell you more about it, believe me.

Your response: The secret story they blackmailed you with, what was it?

NPC: Oh, I wish I didn't tell you. No, sorry, I can't tell you about it even if that means I get fired.

NPC: Try to pry as much information as possible from Gregory. I will await your report right here.

NPC: Ahh, there you are. Did you find a lead that we can follow?

Your response: Gregory admitted that he gave the keys to some outsiders. They obviously blackmailed him with some secret of his past. He didn't want to say any more.

NPC: Gregory? A secret? That reminds me that he had a job as medical assistant with the Crahn before he started working with us. Maybe there is a connection. There is a Crahn priest living in the ruins of the old Crest Village in C_08. He once had much influence on Crahn dealings and if there is anybody who might know about Gregory's secret it's him. Try to find out whatever you can from the priest. Once you know the dirty little secret you could visit Gregory again and confront him with what you learned.

NPC: This is no place for somebody who never experienced the glory of Crahn.

NPC: I believe you are lost since you are in an area that is far from the power of the city. Go now before some beast decides to have you as lunch.

Your response: I will not have travelled this far just to return empty handed. I need some answers from you.

NPC: You look as if you have surrendered to the corruption of the city, leaving you as a slave for Reza.

Your response: I am nobody's slave. I am looking for answers and you will give them to me.

NPC: At least you are showing a strong will. Maybe not all is lost with you. Tell me, what do you want to know?

Your response: A certain Gregory Parkins worked for you some time ago ad medical assistant. He carries a dark secret with him from that time and I need to know what secret.

NPC: The world carries many secrets and some of which should have remained hidden. But if it is really important for you to shed some light on this secret then you will have to do me a favor first.

Your response: I expected something like this. I have never heard about a Crahn who would give away any information for free.

NPC: I know that your ignorance is great and I forgive you. But I warn you, one more comment like that and the secret will remain a secret.

Your response: Alright, alright, I did not mean to insult you.

NPC: Then you should take revenge on the creatures that call themselves the Fallen Angels. They ambushed a group of innocent Crahn brothers and massacred them in the most cruel way possible. It has been a sad day for us and our revenge will not come to a halt for a long time. You will have the honour of giving the Fallen Angels a taste of Crahns retribution. Return to me as soon as you have completed the task.

Your response: I am supposed to kill a Fallen Angel?

NPC: Yes, one of their members, NO runner. Which one is of no importance since sooner or later the wrath of Crahn will get them all. You should be able to find some members at the Tech Haven entrance in E_07.

NPC: First you need to finish off a Fallen Angels Member. Then we can continue our conversation.

NPC: You have done a great job and you shall receive your just reward.

Your response: Then tell me. After all it has already cost more time than I was willing to invest.

NPC: Poor Gregory. Yes, he did work for Crahn. I admit that. He researched many important medical substances and he had a lot of dedication for his work. Until one day he crossed the thin line that should never have been crossed. Some of his experiments were conducted on mutants. Creatures that should have been killed straightaway.

Your response: But those experiments were surely permitted by you.

NPC: We only gave orders in which direction the research should progress and we gave him the means to reach his goals. But one day he did not use a mutant for his experiments, no, he used a young human boy. He injected a substance into his blood that disrupted the nerves of the child irrevocably. He tried to talk himself out of it by claiming that he thought it was a mutant. Ridiculous! Of course he was fired the very same day. And now do not pester me any longer.

NPC: I have said all there is to say.

NPC: If you don't mind I would like to continue my experiments.

NPC: What do you want from me again? I admitted everything in the first place.

Your response: Maybe you have kept something hidden. I was busy discovering your dirty little secret. The poor child.

NPC: What? What do you mean?

Your response: You have used a child as guinea pig. A CHILD. You have destroyed his nerves with a medi...

NPC: Enough! Enough! Yes, it is true and I am unbelievably sorry. But you don't know how it is like to work for the Crahn. They gave me one assignment after the other and I could only keep the pace by conducting experiments on mutants. It was horrible. After a few weeks I could not even comprehend any longer that they were living beings.

Your response: Please continue.

NPC: I really thought it was a mutant and not a healthy child. They put him on the laboratory bench all dirty and unconscious. He was so very dirty and run-down like all the other mutants. They did not even remove his face guard, otherwise I would have known he was only a little child. You have to believe me. I still have nightmares because of it.

Your response: Although I would never have thought you capable of something like this I am willing to keep your secret. But you have to tell me everything you know.

NPC: Agreed, but make sure not to tell it to anyone or my time here will be over. The CryoVault that contained Jakob Finster was collected by a double of Finster himself. They meant to store the Vault somewhere in the Industrial Area. I really don't know more about it. Please go now.

NPC: Please, I don't want to talk about it. Please go.

NPC: Visit father Morpheus in the ruined Crest Village. Afterwards go to Gregory once more and question him again.

NPC: What is your report, then?

Your response: I will spare you the details of Gregorys secret but he did say that Jakob Finster has collected his CryoVault himself.

NPC: Well, this supports my suspicions that there is a double of him working from the shadows. But that doesn't help much.

Your response: Furthermore they wanted to store the CryoVault somewhere in the Industrial Area. I am pretty certain about that.

NPC: This is the kind of news I was expecting. Now I can begin with the preparations. Here is your reward and I would be pleased if you would continue to work for me in the future. (next mission at level 40)

entries.conversation:
NPC: I have a message for you. It was submitted by Michail from sector 13. He expressed a wish to personally speak to you. You probably know where to find him, yes?

NPC: Michail from sector 13 wanted to speak to you, you can meet him in the lab

NPC: I am glad that you have come. I noticed that you followed up a few trails for Mr Brandon. It's a pity that you cannot see the magnitude of potential for our future. That's why I wanted to suggest something.

Your response: I am not sure whether or not I can trust you but I will listen.

NPC: Very good. Why don't you speak to Finster personally and ask him about his plans? That way you can find out if you are doing the right thing. You can find him near the Gabanium Mine in the Wastelands. Just give it a try. You can always change your opinion afterwards.

Your response: So you do have contact to Finster after all? Very interesting but so be it. I will give it a try. But if this is going to be a trap...

NPC: Rest assured, no tricks nor traps.

NPC: You can find Finster at the Gabanium Mine in G_08 in the Wastelands.  Talk to him and then you can judge him.

NPC: Welcome, I have been informed about your arrival. I see this as a chance to merge our interests.

Your response: I almost expected a trap.

NPC: Then let us continue. I can tell you about many of my plans and explain them to you.

Your response: What is your real goal then?

Your response: Who is the real Finster? Is it the one in the CryoVault or is it you?

Your response: What are you really?

Your response: I have heard enough.

NPC: My goal is humble. I only want to lead the company that is lawfully mine into a prosperous future.

Your response: You don't really believe that your plan will work, do you?

NPC: My plans have a chance of 62% to succeed. Of course this number varies on a daily basis and is still being optimised.

Your response: Leave it be. Your time is long since over. Leave it be before you will be the one to ruin your beloved company.

NPC: It is no use to try and restrain me from something that is my destiny. My last will has not been met. I should have been defrosted every twenty years but instead I spent all the time cold and stiff in my CryoVault. I would probably stay there until the end of days if I had not anticipated something like that. That is why I included a fail safe device. But enough of that.

Your response: Very well, let's talk about something else.

NPC: I am both. Finster is still in his CryoVault but he is standing in front of you just the same. Still, more of what really is considered the essence of Jakob Finster is still in the CryoVault. You surely understand that I had to come and collect the CryoVault so that I would be complete again. Everything has more than just one side to it and I have a dozen different facets.

Your response: Which means you are a clone?

NPC: No and yet I am in a certain way. Let us talk about something else.

Your response: Very well.

NPC: I am what I appear to be. I am a mirror of Jakob Finster, one of his creations. Although my interior appears more like a machine.

Your response: So you are a robot? But that means everything was prearranged. Finster knew that his last will would not be carried out.

NPC: No, he did not know that, I did not know that. But precautions are always the companion of every successful manager.

Your response: Thank you, I believe I have heard enough.

NPC: I assure you that I have no intention to destroy ProtoPharm. I have no intention to waste human lives if it isn't really necessary. What is your opinion? Do you want to join my side? I value your expertise.

Your response: I cannot agree to that. After all you are blackmailing ProtoPharm and furthermore I won't trust a robot who appears to be something that it is not. I will report directly to George about this.

NPC: I am sorry to hear that. You better leave now and report to George.

NPC: Sorry, but I am expecting an importan visit any moment. See you later.

NPC: I am pleased to see you. Is there something to discuss? Or is there another reason for this sudden visit?

Your response: I have met with Finster.

NPC: You did what? Why? I hope you don't plan on switching sides. Even if there are a few voices who would like to see Finster as manager of ProtoPharm again it is no reason to take such drastic measures.

Your response: Calm down, I have no intention to switch sides. Whatever Finster said he still is only a robot.

NPC: I am surprised. He really turned out to be a robot? Well, that would at least explain the double. But that must have been an enormous effort to build such a robot in the first place. It does certainly shed a new light on the whole situation.

Your response: What are you talking about? Finster still has his plans and maybe he wants to free himself from the CryoVault. At least he doesn't seem to want to resort to violence if it isn't really necessary.

NPC: There you have it. While you have been busy I have acquired more authorisations. Some of them are signed directly by Sandra Frasier. I am now entitled to decide which steps must be taken to resolve this whole issue. I say we have to end this threat called Finster immediately. It is not acceptable that one robot keeps a whole company in check.

Your response: What do you suggest then?

NPC: Since you already know the way to Finsters hideout I suggest that you get rid of him. After all it is only a machine, a piece of junk.

Your response: That won't help. If we shoot him he will stand up again in a short time. It is a robot and not easy to kill.

NPC: Exactly. That's why it won't be a weapon to kill him but a virus that will be injected into his system. But that is only possible if you shoot him first. That will give us a small window when his systems restart to inject the virus. We can inject it from a remote location utilizing the net. Be sure to talk to him first, maybe you will find out about something that escaped you in the first place. Something that will help us to locate the CryoVault.

NPC: Did you reconsider?

NPC: You again! I will destroy you once and for all. I am sorry but you being alive is too big a risk.

Your response: That is exactly why I am here. I will scrap you like the piece of junk you are.

NPC: It is a pity that it has to end like this but it won't change any of my plans. Everything has been prepared. Go on and shoot me but my plans will not be stopped.

NPC: eventually I will wear you down.

NPC: Language module... two percent functional... system shut down to minimum ... Please try again later.

NPC: Trash this Finster robot. That is of the utmost priority right now.

NPC: Trash this Finster robot. That is of the utmost priority right now.

NPC: I hope you come bearing good news.

Your response: I have finished him and the virus is injected. That is the end of the robot Finster.

NPC: Well done. You have earned this reward. I suppose it would be alright to give you some holidays. Now that there is only one thing left. We only need to stop the plans that robot already set in motion. (next mission at level 45

NPC: Sorry, but I am heavily busy now. Leave me alone!

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• ProtoPharm Resistor Chip

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• We don't have a choice if we really want to stop those drugs. I will entrust you with this mission. You haven't let me down the past missions and I am sure you won't this time around. Meet up with Max Delavare, you can find him in the Outzone Sec-5. Do what has to be done but be careful, once you have accomplished everything you can return to me. Those drugs have to vanish as soon as possible.

• You need to take a job off my hands if I am supposed to do ProtoPharm a favor. You only need to kill one Tsunami Pimp. I forgot which one but it shouldn't matter as long as you kill any pimp, NO Runner. They can be found in Pepper Park 01. Agreed?

• Visit Max Delavare in the old Outzone Sector 5. Make sure that the Spirula drug will vanish from the market.

• Visit Max Delavare in the Outzone Sec-5. Make sure that the Spirula drug will vanish from the market.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: George appeared to be rather nervous when he contacted me. He says it is urgent that the two of you meet soon. Don't ask me what this is all about, though.

NPC: Don't let Mr Brandon wait.

NPC: As soon as we found a trail we end up in a dead end. It's jinxed. I feel as if I am chasing phantoms or figments of our imagination. We did manage to find the production cell from Finster. Although many of the produced Spirula drugs have been delivered to some other place already.

Your response: How much were they able to produce?

NPC: Judging from the experts it seems to be quite a lot. We are heading towards a catastrophe if this ever becomes public. I dare not think about what might happen if there would be a wave of mutations again. ProtoPharm would be dealt a severe blow.

Your response: Then there is only one choice. We just have to find a way to remove all those Spirula drugs from the market.

NPC: Easier said than done. ProtoPharm alone cannot buy back all those drugs. We need somebody who's got the right kind of experience. I am thinking about a certain group of people. I will tell you something that is not official. ProtoPharm has contacts to the Black Dragon and we need to take advantage of that right now.

Your response: The Black Dragon? Can we trust them?

NPC: We don't have a choice if we really want to stop those drugs. I will entrust you with this mission. You haven't let me down the past missions and I am sure you won't this time around. Meet up with Max Delavare, you can find him in the Outzone Sec-5. Do what has to be done but be careful, once you have accomplished everything you can return to me. Those drugs have to vanish as soon as possible.

NPC: You tread on dangerous soil here. Back off or something nasty might happen.

NPC: You are standing on my spot there. I hope you have a good explanation.

Your response: We can exchange compliments later on. ProtoPharm has a job for you. You need to remove all versions of the Spirula drug from the market, no matter the cost.

NPC: Very well, I will mobilise those that I'll be able to reach. However, it will still take approximately a week until all drugs are gone. There is no way to speed it up and there is more...

Your response: That has to be sufficient then. What else?

NPC: I can only do this if somebody completes my current job in my stead. I cannot possibly disappoint my clients. You understand that don't you?

Your response: What do you want from me then since I assume it is something I can do.

NPC: You need to take a job off my hands if I am supposed to do ProtoPharm a favor. You only need to kill one Tsunami Pimp. I forgot which one but it shouldn't matter as long as you kill any pimp, NO Runner. They can be found in Pepper Park 01. Agreed?

Your response: If that helps I will do it. But I have my doubts to start a war with the Tsunamis.

NPC: It's not that bad. Of course they are brutal, violent and ruthless but after all so are we. You better start straightaway and in the meanwhile we will remove the Spirula drug as fast as possible. After all we do have an interest in good relations to ProtoPharm.

NPC: Remember to kill that Tsunami Pimp.

NPC: Well done, Runner, that'll teach those Tsunamis. Now, let's remove these pesky Spirula drugs, shall we?

NPC: Visit Max Delavare in the old Outzone Sector 5. Make sure that the Spirula drug will vanish from the market.

NPC: Visit Max Delavare in the Outzone Sec-5. Make sure that the Spirula drug will vanish from the market.

The Cryovault with the original Jakob Finster has been secured and brought home.

Your response: This seems to be a happy end then.

NPC: Yes, indeed. I was instructed to give you this generous reward and also one of our research implants. It works with the improved Spirula version and improves resistances. I would even go as far to suggest that you found your own clan. I hope to see you again some time since I will be unable to give you any more missions for ProtoPharm.

NPC: Sorry, but I am busy now.

• Package with Drugs

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Important Packet for NExT
• Package with Alcohol
• Package with Drugs
