entries.conversation:
NPC: Welcome Runner! We are always pleased to see a new face around here. Tangent has always been rather close to their people. Of course in a special way.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: We supply everybody with the means to create his own reality. As you might have noticed I am speaking about the weapons that Tangent produces. I mean you can imagine that they are very popular especially here within Neocron. Even I have a Tangent Assault Rifle stowed away in my appartement.

Your response: I am glad to finally belong to a faction which deals realistically with the people. No bullshit about peace and freedom.

NPC: Of course, that is one of our highest goals. Every client is very important and many campaigns are running which serve to raise consumer interest in our products.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But Tangent is mainly concerned about the different aspects of weapon production. Maybe I should tell you something about the background of the company first? Just to give you a short overview.

Your response: I was just about to ask you about that.

NPC: Tangent Technologies was founded in the year 2748 as a stand alone company. We splitted from our mother company BioTech. Tangent had grown too much to still be a mere division of BioTech.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Since then Tangent has constantly surpassed its mother company on many levels. The CityAdmin gave many lucrative commissions to Tangent because Tangent's focus was always the specialisation in weapon products.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: By selling weapons to the general public of Neocron a new and constant stream of income was secured as well. And even though BioTech uses every means at its disposal to force us from that leading position Tangent is still ever progressing and looking for higher goals.

Your response: BioTech is actively trying to encumber the efforts of Tangent?

NPC: Yes, in fact, they even resort to violence at times. Officially they will deny that of course. But they have contacts to the Tsunami and invest immense sums just so that they take actions against Tangent.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But these foolish attempts cannot prevent Tangent from reaching its goals. Speaking of which, you are certainly ready to do a task for Tangent aren't you?

Your response: Yes, of course. And I almost thought I don't need to do anything for that apartement that you gave me.

NPC: Oh, rest assured, the apartement is totally yours now. Tangent is only considering this first assignment as a favor. You will be paid a small compensation for it.

Your response: It is always pleasant to work for payment. What is the assignment about?

Your response: I don't feel up to such a challenge at the moment.

NPC: It is rather easy. For such a big company like Tangent it is important of course to maintain important relations that keep the big projects running.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: The most important partners are NEXT and Diamond Real Estate. NEXT is cooperating because after all they want to equip their vehicles with our weapon systems.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Of course, that this is in our interest is quite obvious. Diamond Real Estate on the other hand has certain contracts with us to provide their estates with security systems.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: The relation to Diamond has been long and enjoyable. It reaches back quite a while.

Your response: Yes, I have expected such kind of contracts to exist. Isn't it also true that Tangent is providing the weapons for the CopBots?

NPC: Indeed. Of course the CityAdmin has chosen Tangent to care about the equipment of the CopBots. After all Tangent is the biggest independent producer of weapons. This is not only rather lucrative but it is also a task that requires us to deal with it in a responsible way. A lot could go awry if Tangent made the wrong choices.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Tangent is especially concerned about the efficiency of their weapons. The CopBots are supposed to accomplish their tasks as smooth as possible after all. So that the citizens of Neocron can sleep well and safe.

Your response: Very impressive. But you wanted to say something more about the assignment, didn't you?

NPC: Please wait until I am finished talking. The small task for you is to visit NEXT, Diamond Real Estate and the Pepper Park. Pepper Park is quite an infamous and dirty area. Take care in those districts.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: First of all you visit the NEXT director of operations and deliver these important documents. They closely analyse how effective Tangent weapon systems are used in conjunction with the hover technology.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Afterwards please go to the Diamond HQ. You can hand over the other delivery there. But I have forgotten where the broker is who should receive the delivery. Either in the Diamond HQ, CityAdmin building or one of the Diamond stores.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: It contains an assortment of spirits. Remember that you always have to secure your relations through little gifts.

Your response: You have also mentioned the Pepper Park, what is the story behind that?

NPC: It is not that important. Visit a person named Figaro there. He will provide you with a package that you should bring back here. Is that clear so far?

Your response: But of course, I am just the curious kind of guy.

NPC: Curiosity is a blessing if it isn't overused. But too much of it can inflict great damage. Go now and don't forget to return the package that you will get to Mazzaro here in the HQ.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Otherwise he will be in a rather bad mood and we really don't want that to happen...

NPC: Then take your time. Prepare yourself and come back once you are ready.

NPC: You should really take this assignment a little bit more serious if you want to become a somebody within Tangent. Check the Diamond HQ for the broker. Go to Mazzaro once you finished all the tasks.

NPC: Yes? There is much to do and I have no time for idle talk.

NPC: Yes? Be quick about it, I am very busy.

Your response: I am supposed to deliver this package to you. I am coming from Tangent.

NPC: Very well. They informed me alright. The confirmation is out and should reach Tangent now. You are just starting off with Tangent?

Your response: Yes, I hope to get far in my career.

NPC: Good Runner. Tangent is a good choice. Excellent weapons. We always maintained a very comfortable relationship with them. A good day to you, Runner.

NPC: Haven't you got anything else to do Runner?.

NPC: You don't belong here. Better be on your way again.

NPC: You don't belong here. Better be on your way again.

NPC: Yes? I assume this is a delivery for Diamond Real Estate?

Your response: It is a small gift from Tangent that I am supposed to deliver to you...

NPC: Really? That is very nice of Tangent to be sure. The maintenance service from Tangent is excellent as I recall. Very professional. But what is this? I don't believe it...

Your response: Is something wrong?

NPC: No, not really. Or rather not at all. Within the package I found a special kind of wine. Very special. This wine, Runner, is the finest you can imagine.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: For a change this wine has not been synthesized. It is worth a fortune. Please inform Tangent about my gratitude.

NPC: Ask one of our employees. I have more pressing business to attend to.

NPC: I don't have anything for you.

NPC: Hey, Runner! It's a nice day, isn't it? But I have something here that could make it even nicer...

Your response: What a run down area this is...

NPC: Yeah, but some people would still call it paradise on earth. I am one of them. Ok then, what kind of drug do you want?

Your response: Drug? I am here for a delivery that I am supposed to get from you...

NPC: That means you are the Runner who is supposed to take over the package? Hehee. Those are pretty strong drugs in that package if you ask me. But if somebody needs it we are happy to supply it.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Especially if you are are already addicted to that kind of stuff your whole life. But I admit that Damion Jordan has a good taste.

Your response: I don't believe it. Drugs that are supposed to be for Mr. Jordan? Are we speaking about the same person here? The CEO of Tangent?

NPC: Yes, yes, exactly! You have not heard it yet? Damion has been a good client of ours for a long time.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: We could almost survive easily from the money he pays us for those drugs. It's incredible how many drugs he consumes.

Your response: How did that happen? There must be a good reason for it.

NPC: I don't know. That guy has always been keen on drugs and the Black Dragon have quite a good connection to him because of that. We even give him a special price.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: He really started with it the moment when his father gave BioTech to his younger brother Seymour. Maybe he did hope to get everything.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Who knows? But I am talking too much. The slick Runner certainly wants to get back into the safe inner city, doesn't he?

Your response: I am just here because of an assignment. Not because I choose to be here.

NPC: If you ever feel you need some drugs, you can get almost everything here in Pepper Park...

NPC: Hey, I have already given you all the drugs that I had with me. You still want more? Not today I fear.

NPC: Come back once you finished the task.

NPC: Come and have a seat if you want. You are one of our new Runners and have just completed the first special run, am I right?

Your response: Yes, here is the package with the... ahem... drugs.

NPC: Where did you loose your package?

NPC: What a pity. You must be getting the wrong impression about Tangent here. Normally the person who delivers it should not be informed about the content of the package. Usually discretion alone suggests not to enquire about the content of a package.

Your response: It certainly got me thinking. What is the purpose of these drugs?

NPC: I think I'll clue you in. Damion Jordan, the chief of Tangent, has a small drug problem. So far it is known everywhere really. At least it is rumoured in every corner of Neocron. A sad fact is that you get addicted to drugs pretty fast.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Understand? It's just that a leader of such a big company cannot afford to be seen out on the street with drugs in his hands. What would you do in such a situation? Right. You send a runner to go and get them for you. That is all there is to say about it.

Your response: Why are so many people fascinated by drugs anyway.

NPC: In any case you have done good work. The delivery is safe and sound at its destination. I asked that you be sent to me because I wanted to personally accept this package in order to create as little rumours on the way as possible. I hope I can count on you to do the same.

Your response: Sure, I know how to keep a secret.

NPC: Very good. As a small reward I have 1000 Credits for you here. You have done the first step into a great future here at Tangent.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But don't rest yet. The more people know you and the more sympathy we can extend to you the more important will be the next missions for you. Take care until the next time.

entries.title: Tangent 02
entries.description: Quest-related dialogue from the game files.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Matt Tronstett is his name. According to our latest information he lives at Point Red in the Wastelands. You know, sector B 07.

• Have you convinced Tronstett already? He lives in Point Red in the Wastelands. Once you are finished report to Mazzaro.

• I have been the greatest supporter of Tangent. The weapons that were produced served to return freedom to the hands of the people. The freedom to move safely through the Wastelands.

• You are very naive, Runner. Nowadays all I want is to meet my old friend Torben once in a while, visiting that restaurant in the Pepper Park subway station and talking about old times. Torben and I have endured a lot and he always helped and aided me with his advice.

• Even if you ask me again and again I am still not interested. I will tell Torben about this in the Pepper Park subway station.

• He certainly is. Would you recommend to him to work for Tangent once more? I have heard many good things about him. It would be a shame to let his talent go to waste out there in the Wastelands. Wouldn't it?

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: There are good news. The CityAdmin decided to commission a new kind of beam weapon. Naturally Tangent is one of the main contenders for that assignment.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Albeit we cannot understand why both BioTech and Tangent have been chosen for the final consideration. It is quite obvious that Tangent has all the necessary knowledge right here.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: I mean, Tangent's only purpose is after all the production and invention of weapons. However the CityAdmin decided to take BioTech into consideration for this project.

Your response: But BioTech should pose no problem for Tangent. Tangent has the advantage in this game.

NPC: Very true. Everybody knows that. BioTech must have used dirty tricks to be offered this kind of deal in the first place.

Your response: When will it be decided who gets the commission?

NPC: Within a limited time frame both companies are to come up with a prototype of the planned beam weapon. The better prototype gets the deal. But I would not count on a fair competition.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: If all this is arranged by BioTech I am certain they already have prepared a sneaky plan.

Your response: Doesn't Tangent have effective mechanisms to deal with such an event?

NPC: BioTech is welcome to try it. They will get what they deserve. For this project Damion Jordan himself expressed a wish that a retired beam expert should join the development team.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: The problem is that the expert already retired about half a year ago. Since you have already completed your first run and showed us that you are loyal to Tangent I thought you could try to convince that expert to come back and work for us again.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: You are supposed to present him an offer he cannot refuse. The offer to be part of the team again. You might have to use your negotiation skills for this one.

Your response: I could at least try it. Where can I find that expert?

Your response: I wish to train my negotiation skills first.

NPC: Matt Tronstett is his name. According to our latest information he lives at Point Red in the Wastelands. You know, sector B 07.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: If you were able to convince him you can see Mazzaro and report to him.

NPC: Please come back as soon as you feel ready to accept this mission.

NPC: Have you convinced Tronstett already? He lives in Point Red in the Wastelands. Once you are finished report to Mazzaro.

NPC: No, I am not buying anything! Piss of, stupid Runner!

Your response: Ahem, I am coming from Tangent. Are you Mr Tronstett?

NPC: Tangent? Yes, I do remember it rather well. Sorry that I reacted in such a harsh way. Most of the time somebody visits me here I am either supposed to buy something or get killed. You can imagine that I do not improve my social skills that way

Your response: To be honest, I want to present you with the exact opposite of what you just mentioned. Tangent sends me because your exceptional skills are wanted for another project from Tangent.

NPC: And? Am I supposed to be flattered now?

Your response: This is a once in a lifetime chance, Mr Tronstett. Right from one of the most powerful companies in Neocron. Doesn't that sound promising?

NPC: You! What do you know? I have worked years on end until my fingers bled. I had a great vision that I was working for. And I have spent every free minute working on projects for the company.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: I have been the greatest supporter of Tangent. The weapons that were produced served to return freedom to the hands of the people. The freedom to move safely through the Wastelands.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Nobody would be as vulnerable as before any longer. Nobody would have to hide in some stinkin hole. Bullshit! I have been enlightened, I have come to know the truth. And when I finally found it I quit.

Your response: What truth did you find?

NPC: Tangent has no interest in the people. No interest at all. Tangent is like a giant machine whose gigantic gears grind everything to dust. Everything that is in its way. It has become a beast.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Sometimes I believe it has developed its own will. Not even Damion Jordan can really control it. Even if Damion would be gone that beast would just grow another head and continue.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: It is like a Hydra. Severe one head and it will grow two. Unstoppable and cold as death.

Your response: It seems clear to me that you have not made a pleasent experience with Tangent. But I can assure you that this will not repeat itself.

NPC: You are very naive, Runner. Nowadays all I want is to meet my old friend Torben once in a while, visiting that restaurant in the Pepper Park subway station and talking about old times. Torben and I have endured a lot and he always helped and aided me with his advice.

Your response: Would you maybe listen to your friend if he would suggest that you work for Tangent again? Maybe I should really try and convince your friend to do the convincing for me. He will surely understand that it will be the best for you.

NPC: What? What did you just say?

Your response: I have just mouthed a thought I had. Goodbye Mr Tronstett.

NPC: Very well, goodbye Runner.

NPC: Even if you ask me again and again I am still not interested. I will tell Torben about this in the Pepper Park subway station.

NPC: Do i know you from somewhere? Leave me alone.

NPC: Hullo, Runner. Where is the problem?

Your response: I have heard that you know a certain Mr Tronstett? Matt Tronstett?

NPC: Of course I know him, he is one of my best friends. I have met him on a cooperation between NEXT and Tangent. I am working for NEXT, you know. Tronstett is a very precise and reliable person.

Your response: He certainly is. Would you recommend to him to work for Tangent once more? I have heard many good things about him. It would be a shame to let his talent go to waste out there in the Wastelands. Wouldn't it?

NPC: He is really unmotivated at the moment. I admit as much. He was very disillusioned when he quit Tangent. I think he just realized that he could not change anything as one person. But I would never advise him to anything he would not want himself.

Your response: No, no, what are you thinking? But a work place at Tangent would be safe and well paid. And your friend can occupy himself with what he likes best. Research.

NPC: You are not trying to convince me to advise my friend Matt in a certain way?

Your response: Yes, I am trying to do exactly that. Don't you see that it would be the best for him? He is not getting younger and the Wastelands might soon claim his life. But with Tangent he would be safe.

NPC: No, really, Matt should do whatever he thinks is right. If you would offer that job to me I would certainly accept it. But not like that, thank you.

Your response: As a last resort I can only try to offer you a small bonus to make the decision easier for you. To make it easier to convince your friend.

NPC: What do you think I am?! I am not selling my best friend.

Your response: Maybe 5000 credits? I could talk to one of the directors of operation from Tangent.

NPC: 5000 ?? Well... I think it might not really harm him in any way to work some more in his old days. I will recommend it to him as long as you don't forget about my bonus. Otherwise I will surely counsel him against it. Return to your company and I'll take care of the rest.

NPC: I have already accepted your dirty money, what else do you want?! My soul? Go back to your company and make sure that I get that money you promised.

NPC: Yes? I understand but only meet me once you have finished your task.

NPC: I can almost remember your name. That's a good sign. Have you been able to convince Tronstett?

Your response: It wasn't too easy. I had to convince a certain Torben to convince Tronstett in my stead. Unfortunately I had to promise him 5000 credits.

NPC: You have just promised him that money from Tangent? Without asking in the first place? That is very careless of you. But if Matt Tronstett really should work for us again it is a small price to pay.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: In that case we will gladly pay the sum. Is it certain that Torstett will work for us again?

Your response: It should all be sorted out. He told me he trusts the advice of his friend.

NPC: Well done. You really seem to be up to every trick, it seems to me. Tangent rewards you with these 2000 credits. With the help from Tronstett that Beam weapon will be developed even faster.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Keep yourself available and in good shape in case that we need your services again for a special assignment.

entries.title: Tangent 03
entries.description: Quest-related dialogue from the game files.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Powerbooze Gold

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• There is no law in the Wastelands so be careful. Don't stay too long out there or you might catch a nasty mutation. If you find out anything interesting just come back here and report to me.

• Why? After all that is the only reason why I came all this way into the Wastelands.

• That's easy to say for you... it is warm in the city, everybody has a nice appartement and you give a damn about the people here in the Wastelands.

• Very good, much better, wasn't that difficult either, don't you think?... argh, my head still hurts... Alright, I only know one BioTech employee. Don't know if he can help you... just try it... His name is Benjamin Kaine. You can find him in the Industrial Sector 02. He always says that that is his world.

• It was almost an odyssee. I had to cross the whole Wastelands just to find somebody who could provide the information.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: What a strange coincidence that you would come right when we need you. The beam weapon project is progressing in big steps. A test run has already been made to see the effects it has on various materials. It is all very convincing. Only that alone is not sufficient for Tangent.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Knowledge is required. Information on the progress of BioTech developments. For this purpose we need a reliable Runner like you to conduct some investigation into that direction.

Your response: Investigation? What kind of investigation?

NPC: Tangent has various methods to get required information. There are many contact persons who would sell their own mother for money. Enough of them to directly play into our hands.

Your response: Isn't spying illegal?

NPC: Spying? You obviously still haven't learnt that Tangent only does what every other company does as well. Which is exactly the reason why Tangent is still in business.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: You can't really be so innocent to believe that other companies don't use the same methods, right? This task is important for the company. And as far as I am concerned you are either for or against Tangent. I would not advise you to be against Tangent.

Your response: I did not want to seem insulting, sorry. It's just...

NPC: Look around and you'll see two possibilities. Either you belong to a powerful faction or... you should decrease your life expectancy accordingly. The contact person for this task can be found at the Catlock Bay.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: You can offer him up to 10000 credits if you think the information is worth it. He is a Tsunami with the name of Gruber. Be on your guard.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: There is no law in the Wastelands so be careful. Don't stay too long out there or you might catch a nasty mutation. If you find out anything interesting just come back here and report to me.

NPC: It is your choice. If you change your mind just come back here.

NPC: Come closer, I don't want to repeat myself in the case you don't understand me. Who sent you?

Your response: I am coming from Tangent. You are supposed to have information on how far the development of the BioTech Beam weapon has advanced so far.

NPC: Me? I am supposed to have that information? don't make a fool of yourself. I only have information about who could help you. But I am not certain if you really want to know that.

Your response: Why? After all that is the only reason why I came all this way into the Wastelands.

NPC: I hope you are aware that I am Tsunami?

Your response: Yes, I have been informed. Just tell me that person you spoke about. Then I can finally leave this death zone.

NPC: You might try that crazy Kev Critter at the Blackmist Garbage Dump in F_09. But speaking about death zones...

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: BioTech already anticipated that there would be many people nosing around their secrets. People that have to be stopped. That is why they paid me to eliminate this threat.

Your response: One moment. What is that supposed to mean? You have been hired to kill people?

NPC: Very good, yes. People like you to be precise.

Your response: I am certain we could manage this peacefully.

NPC: I am sorry but I am always loyal to the client. That is why I am going to kill you now.

Your response: But...

NPC: Too late...

NPC: Only one person will leave this place alive.

NPC: I see so many stars... so many... do you see them too?

NPC: Huh? Are you a ghost?

Your response: I can assure you I am very much real and not in a particular good mood.

NPC: ... I.... don't know, do I know you? The sky is so strange...

Your response: You seem to be on drugs. Bah, I can't talk to you like that.

NPC: What? Yes, I can talk... but about what? Hihihi. Quick, bring me some of this Powerbooze Gold. That helps most of the time.

Your response: Do I have a choice?... I thought so...

NPC: Everything is so strange...

NPC: Please bring me a Powerbooze Gold.

NPC: Ahhh... that's much better... this drug was shit. I think I burned too many braincells on this trip.

Your response: I would definitively say so. Are you crazy? Getting on a trip like that?

NPC: That's easy to say for you... it is warm in the city, everybody has a nice appartement and you give a damn about the people here in the Wastelands.

Your response: You can't say that...

NPC: Have a look around and count the abandoned villages... all were destroyed from mutants or even worse things.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: And the citizens of Neocron sit on their hands and swallow one Powerbooze after the other. I would much prefer to do that as well if I did not have this job here.

Your response: I am sick of it. Somebody already tried to kill me only because I wanted some information about BioTech.

NPC: Yes, every faction is guarding their secrets at all costs. Do you want to cry out your soul here or do you actually have anything useful to say?

Your response: I won't be talked to like that. I would love to smash your face for that one. Tell me how far BioTech is with the development of their Beamweapon!

NPC: You are not very polite. Think about something else... maybe a little bit more polite.

Your response: ...Alright... I did not want to get all that excited anyway. Could you please tell me something? I would like to know how far the development of the BioTech Beamweapon has come.

NPC: Very good, much better, wasn't that difficult either, don't you think?... argh, my head still hurts... Alright, I only know one BioTech employee. Don't know if he can help you... just try it... His name is Benjamin Kaine. You can find him in the Industrial Sector 02. He always says that that is his world.

NPC: Ask Benjamin in Industrial 02, I don't want to get involved.

NPC: Go away, leave me be.

NPC: Yes? What?

Your response: Do you work for BioTech? Since I have heard something like that...

NPC: Would you be a little bit more precise?

Your response: I would have liked to get some information but I need your help with it.

NPC: Do I look as if it would be fun to answer such questions to some pedestrians?

Your response: I can offer you a compensation for your trouble. For all the effort you have to put into it.

NPC: Credits? You mean credits? Well, maybe something would spring to my mind. But it could cost a little bit.

Your response: That sounds much better. Do you by any chance happen to know about the newly developed beam weapon ? BioTech should already have invested a lot of work into that project.

NPC: Funny that you should ask. I know about it and I can even offer you more. For the right price, that is. I have a blueprint of that beamweapon right here with me.

Your response: Really? That is an exceptional coincidence. How much do you want for that?

NPC: Since I believe BioTech should concentrate more on already established projects, not something like weapons, rather something like implants.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: That's why I am offering it to you at a special price. But not right now since that would just draw too much attention to me. At the moment I can offer you the information about the status of the project.

Your response: That is exactly what I need.

NPC: For you it's only 15000.

Your response: I can only offer you 10000. My superiors did not allocate more for this assignment.

NPC: Alright, if it has to be. The development of the beam weapon has progressed rather far already. A complex method to concentrate several beams has already been found and is being tested as we speak.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: At the moment there are still problems with the size of the emitters. Three persons would not be able to lift it off the ground. Since the CityAdmin has given out precise instructions the power of the weapon is about 15 percent higher than a comparable weapon that is available now.

Your response: Good, that is very revealing. Thank you. I will quite possibly contact you again because of that blueprint.

NPC: Yes, do that. But I cannot guarantee that I will still have the blueprint then.

NPC: If you are not interested at the blueprint I have no desire to further speak to you.

NPC: Don't you have something to report? The contact person is in the Catlock Bay Area.

NPC: Have you acquired any news?

Your response: It was almost an odyssee. I had to cross the whole Wastelands just to find somebody who could provide the information.

NPC: Nobody claimed that it would be easy to get these informations. But you seem to have found something if I am not mistaken.

Your response: Yes, I do know now that BioTech is already testing their weapon's power. But it would seem that they have problems with the size of the cannon.

NPC: Very interesting. your report is identical to those of some other operatives. that means we can be pretty sure that this information is right.

Your response: I have expected that other Runners would get the same assignment. But isn't it rather elaborate and costly to do that?

NPC: Yes it is but we cannot properly assess if the Runner will be successful with his mission or not. Which means we are playing safe and sending more people. You have done a good job, Runner.

Your response: Wait a moment. The contact person did even have a blueprint of the BioTech prototype.

NPC: ... If that is true we have to look into that ourselves. You can allow yourself some rest for now.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: It will take some time until we evaluated all information. Only then can we plan the next step. But for your services you have earned yourself 5000 credits.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• BioTech-Prototype-Blueprint

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• BioTech-Prototype-Blueprint

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• It is very simple. Even if we normally do not resort to such actions. You meet up with Max whom you can find in the Outzone Sector 5. He is very experienced when it comes to things like this.

• Don't worry about that and leave the moral issues for Tangent. Meet with Max in the Outzone Sec-5. He is Black Dragon, so always have an eye open. Do not trust anyone outside the company. After you have picked up the blueprint Mazzaro wants to talk to you.

• You have your mission. Go to Max in the Outzone Sec-5 and tell him to kill those Fallen Angel guys. Then you can get that Blueprint from Benjamin in Industrial 02. Report to Mazarro once you are done.

• It will be your task to kill one Fallen Angels Member. Some of them hang out at the Tech Haven Entrance in E_07. Watch out that you do not do them a favor to kill one of their lousy Runners.

• Go and do not return without the blueprint. I hope you visited Max in the Outzone Sec-5, otherwise Benjamin in Industrial 02 will probably not give you the blueprint.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: A message was sent to your contact person from BioTech in which we announced our interest in the blueprint of the prototype. We have of course tried to match his price but...

Your response: He rejected your offer? The blueprint is sold already?

NPC: Not that, no. I believe he knows that this is a big and powerful company. Tangent would have been able to match any price he could want. No, he expressed that he wanted a different method of payment.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: He said that he still has some unfinished business with the Fallen Angels. It would seem that they refused to hire him on grounds that he is not qualified enough.

Your response: That is not too uncommon. Even Tangent has a bad relationship with the Angels.

NPC: Indeed. But the Fallen Angels were not forced to hack the Tangent system in the first place. That caused quite a chaos and now they are only getting their just reward. I'll come straight to the point. We want you to match the price of the contact person.

Your response: What exactly do I have to do then?

Your response: I cannot do that at the moment. I am sorry.

NPC: It is very simple. Even if we normally do not resort to such actions. You meet up with Max whom you can find in the Outzone Sector 5. He is very experienced when it comes to things like this.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: You tell him that he is supposed to kill 10 Fallen Angels members. That was easy, wasn't it? But tell him not to kill the small ones, only choose those of approximately your status.

Your response: If it serves Tangent, I will do it. After all the Fallen Angels attacked us in the first place. But I have my doubts about killing off a random number instead of those responsible for the attack.

NPC: You won't get far with that attitude. You have to be willing to walk over some dead bodies for Tangent, now and then. Come on. What do you expect? Tangent produces weapons.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: And for what? Certainly not to blow holes into the sky. The company is worth more than a pesky few mutated Fallen Angels.

Your response: Alright. I already said I'd do it. But I don't believe that a blueprint is ever worth a human life.

NPC: Don't worry about that and leave the moral issues for Tangent. Meet with Max in the Outzone Sec-5. He is Black Dragon, so always have an eye open. Do not trust anyone outside the company. After you have picked up the blueprint Mazzaro wants to talk to you.

NPC: As you wish. but don't count on Tangent always having an assignment for you.

NPC: You have your mission. Go to Max in the Outzone Sec-5 and tell him to kill those Fallen Angel guys. Then you can get that Blueprint from Benjamin in Industrial 02. Report to Mazarro once you are done.

NPC: What is somebody like you doing here? You could die out here one of these days. And all just because of your recklessness.

Your response: I was sent by Tangent.

NPC: I thought so. What is the problem this time?

Your response: I am supposed to tell you to kill ten Fallen Angel members. It doesn't matter who...

NPC: It doesn't matter who? Very nice. I especially like these kind of missions. You can just stalk a harmless unsuspecting victim and have fun while you execute your mission.

Your response: Stop it, do you really think that is fun?!

NPC: If you ask me, yes. Life itself is only a temporary situation. With drugs you can already see what lies behind life. Have a glimpse into the afterlife.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But it is simply cool. Have you ever looked into the eyes of a dying person? You can exactly see the moment when they have drawn their terminal breath.

Your response: Stop it, I don't want to listen to this.

NPC: But you should listen. The Fallen Angels are easy targets but I have changed my mind. I will only take care of nine of them. Only nine.

Your response: But it were supposed to be ten! You can't simply change the terms of the agreement.

NPC: Well then there is only one choice. You have to do it yourself. You don't want to throw away your good relation to Tangent now, do you? The blood of a human person will stain your hands. Well and then it will show whether or not you can also wash away the blood from your dreams...

Your response: But, but I don't even know who I should kill...

NPC: We will only kill nine, the rest is your responsibility. You will have to kill one Fallen Angel Member yourself it seems. Maybe your superiors at the HQ would like to hear about it if you managed to do it.

NPC: It will be your task to kill one Fallen Angels Member. Some of them hang out at the Tech Haven Entrance in E_07. Watch out that you do not do them a favor to kill one of their lousy Runners.

Your response: And I can really flatline any Fallen Angels I want to?

NPC: No, only if your target is a Member. If you want to hurt them, you need to know where it causes pain!. Good luck.

NPC: What is taking you so long? You have an assignment, don't you?

NPC: What is taking you so long?

Your response: I simply cannot get used to having killed so many people for a blueprint.

NPC: Then it is done? Good, good, finally they pay for what they did to me.

Your response: Was it really worth the lives of ten people?

NPC: Who knows? It doesn't really interest me what a Runner is thinking. I follow my own agenda.

Your response: Stop, what about the blueprint?

NPC: Alright, alright, here you are. Now go, I don't want to give anybody too many clues on what I am doing here. Now return to your company.

NPC: I have already given the blueprint to you. Hurry and deliver it back to Tangent.

NPC: Go and do not return without the blueprint. I hope you visited Max in the Outzone Sec-5, otherwise Benjamin in Industrial 02 will probably not give you the blueprint.

NPC: And? How did you like your assignment? Bloody? Disgusting? Come on, speak up.

Your response: It doesn't feel right to exchange so many lives against one blueprint.

NPC: You can argue about how much a human life is worth. Fact is that every human dies even if we do nothing.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Death is part of every life. Death could even be described as the goal everybody is working towards .

Your response: Yes, that is true but the worth of a human is not connected to that.

NPC: You are foolish if you don't see death and deny its existence. Some people believe in preordination. If you take that into account those Fallen Angels were meant to die at that place and time.

Your response: Even then it would be cruel...

NPC: Sometimes such questions just so happen to bother us. Why does there have to be war and murder?

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But the answer is always the same, there has not! Humans have only one curse that at the same time is their greatest blessing. Humans create their own reality.

Your response: What can I say?

NPC: Just hand over that blueprint and since the task was not very easy, which I admit, you earned 10000 credits.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Take some time to rest but be sure to check back once in a while since it might be that we can use your help again.

entries.title: Tangent 05
entries.description: Quest-related dialogue from the game files.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• BioTech-Prototype Part 1

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• BioTech-Prototype Part 1
• Packet with Dossier of Andressa

POSSIBLE COST
• 5,000 credits (depends on choice)

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• You have not completed all your tasks. Kill one BioTech Employee, visit Benjamin in Industrial 02, give Figaro in Pepper Park 03 some instructions. How hard can that be?

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Something unforeseen happened last night. Our laboratory was sabotaged and some sub systems of our network have been hacked. Luckily Chester Cohor was able to scan the ID of the hackers before everything went down.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: It doesn't come as a surprise that the hackers turn out to be BioTech employees. The problem is that we do not have any evidence for this due to the fact that the relevant data blocks have been damaged by the sabotage. Our research and development was set back a couple of days as well.

Your response: That BioTech uses such methods could have been anticipated.

NPC: That may very well be but you underestimate the complexity and fragility of such systems and test rigs. Even the slightest distortion can cause maximum damage. In addition the network was still being reconfigured after the Fallen Angels hack attack. Because of that it was more vulnerable than usual.

Your response: What consequences will this have? Did Tangent already decide on a proper response? I mean, some kind of response must follow.

NPC: Yes, you are right and the consequence has already been decided. BioTech will be attacked directly by us. As a warning of course. Since you have proven your competence with these kind of missions Tangent has chosen you for this task to flatline one of them.

Your response: It's not as if I chose to do these kind of assignments. But I will do it.

Your response: I do not believe I can do this.

NPC: Something else I just remembered. The Tsunami seem to have been involved as well. You should speak to Figaro again since we will also utilize our connections to the Black Dragon in this case. If BioTech uses the help of the Tsunami we will certainly not go into this without the Black Dragon. You should decide the course of action that the Black Dragon should take against BioTech. Listen to what they can do and choose the appropriate response.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: There is more. Your contact person, Benjamin, insisted on talking only to you. He said that he prefers the devil that he already knows. It seems that he was able to nick one part of the prototype beam weapon and now he is willing to sell it to us.

Your response: Can you be a little bit more precise and tell me whom I should kill?

NPC: The word of your accomplishments spread fast. There is much to do so don't waste any time. First you should visit Figaro and after you have flatlined one BioTech member Benjamin is already waiting for you.

NPC: If you change your mind, don't hesitate to contact us.

NPC: You already have the assignment specs. Give instructions to Figaro, kill a BioTech Employee in Viarosso 1 and then visit Benjamin in the Industrial district 02. Once you are done with that talk to Mazarro.

NPC: It is your task to kill one BioTech Employee. It should NOT be Runner.

Your response: And I can really flatline any BioTech employees I want to?

NPC: No, only one single BioTech Employee. Otherwise the kill cannot be accepted.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: I haven't seen you for quite some time, Runner. But I have heard a lot about you. You seem to get around a lot.

Your response: I had all hands full in the past weeks.

NPC: Already heard about how you showed those Fallen Angels tech freaks. Not bad, not bad at all. Maybe you will get somewhere after all. But that is exactly the way it works here in the underworld. We, the Black Dragons, are constantly battling it out with the Tsunamis. Those Tsunamis always act as if they have some kind of privilege on everything.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: And then there are also occasional fights with the Anarchy Breed. It is rare that a company gets involved in this at all.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: It is more often the case that the companies hire us to do their dirty laundry. And they pay good. Now, I was told that you were sent to me to tell us what to do. Just tell me now what Tangent wants and we will execute this action against BioTech.

Your response: What options do you have? What can you do?

NPC: Let me think... sabotage, murder or extortion. That's pretty much the usual stuff we do. Ha!

Your response: It seems only reasonable to avenge sabotage with sabotage. I suggest you take out important BioTech facilities.

Your response: It is time to teach those BioTech freaks a lesson. Kill a couple of those bastards.

Your response: Blackmail some of their scientists so that they cannot gain any ground on us. Tangent will have this commission from the CityAdmin and not BioTech!

NPC: Very well, sabotage it will be. Let us see what a little bit of nitroglicerine can do in a laberatory. Have a nice day.

NPC: Very well, I think that some prominent researchers are going to find an unpleasant package soon. Have a nice day.

NPC: Very well, I know just the right targets. It is always nice to make some money out of someones misery. Have a nice day.

NPC: The action is already rolling. We will take care of it, rest assured. Didn't you say you need to visit a certain person in Industrial 02?

NPC: This isn't the right time. I expect somebody else first.

NPC: Finally! There you are! Look, I have the strong suspicion that I am being watched. So let's cut it short. The deal has already been arranged with Tangent. By accident a part of the beam weapon prototype ended up in my pocket when I left the facility and now it belongs to Tangent. Here...

Your response: Very good, thank you for this prototype part...

NPC: Now be on your way... no, wait! I've got something else that could prove to be of value for you. I have found out a few facts about Andressa. She works for BioTech. I can even prove it with a few documents I've got. Interested?

Your response: Of course I am. Everything against BioTech is welcome to Tangent.

NPC: Alright, but that will cost an additional 5000 credits.

NPC: come back when you have the 5000 credits...

NPC: Here is the deal. She is one of the scientists who developed the beam weapon and she was involved in every major stage. She has a few secrets that I am certain she would not want to get public. Maybe it's sufficient if I say that she digs mutants... you can find the details in her file.

Your response: Let me have a look... Heavens! This is disgusting... And exactly what we need! Good work.

NPC: Did you bring the 5000 credits?

Your response: Of course, although I had to scrape the money together from all over the place.

NPC: Yes, yes, but now you should better leave.

NPC: You now got everything I can offer! Now beat it!! I don't want to be seen talking to you. Go back to your company

NPC: You have not completed all your tasks. Kill one BioTech Employee, visit Benjamin in Industrial 02, give Figaro in Pepper Park 03 some instructions. How hard can that be?

NPC: You have not completed all your tasks. Kill one BioTech Employee, visit Benjamin in Industrial 02, give Figaro in Pepper Park 03 some instructions. How hard can that be?

NPC: I am still angered because of that sabotage. They really delayed our research into the beam weapon. But I am still confident. Our design is more promising in my opinion.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: After I have looked through the BioTech blueprints of their beam weapon I have come to the conclusion that we don't have to fear them. But I sure hope that our answer to their sabotage was appropriate?

Your response: Yes, BioTech will need some time to recover from this blow. Before I forget, my contact was able to provide a part of the BioTech prototype. I believe it will be very informative.

NPC: But you don't have that prototype part with you.

NPC: Excellent. You have already earned yourself a safe place here with Tangent. Only recently I have heard Damion Jordan talk about you.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: He was referring to the fight against the Fallen Angels. Albeit there are different versions about how you showed those Fallen Angels. Tell me, you didn't really fight them all at once, did you?

Your response: But of course I have and everybody who says something different is a liar, haha!

NPC: Take these 20000 credits as a small compensation for your efforts. Good luck until the next time we require your help.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Packet with Dossier of Andressa

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Prototype Tangent-Laserbeam-Cannon

entries.conversation:
NPC: You are already near to famous here at Tangent. I even heard somebody talk about you out on the streets.

Your response: Thanks, but I am only doing my job.

NPC: Modesty doesn't suit you at all. You can be proud about what you achieved. But of course that is not the reason why we need you here at the moment.

Your response: I expected as much, is there an emergency?

NPC: Not exactly. It's all about the final test run of the beam weapon. Everything is sorted out and the last readings will soon be done. But despite all our efforts BioTech somehow managed to get their weapon to a similar state in production.

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: Tangent cannot afford to loose in a direct competition. Especially with BioTech as competitor. That's why we will actively try to do something against them. As small as the chance is for them to rival our weapon.

Your response: And you assumed that I would do it? Alright, what does Tangent have in mind?

NPC: The final testrun must be disrupted at all costs. Didn't you receive some compromising material from your contact last time? If that is the case you should use it now. There is no better time.

Your response: Yes, I have certain compromising material about a scientist named Andressa. I believe she will be somewhere in the vicinity of the BioTech headquarters.

NPC: Then use that knowledge, everything that damages BioTech is good for Tangent.

NPC: Hurry, the time is running away.

NPC: Hello. Please leave me alone. I have worked through the night and I am currently having a breake. These damned headaches are killing me.

Your response: Don't worry, Andressa, this won't take long.

NPC: Where do you know my name from? Do I know you?

Your response: That is unlikely. But I know you or at least I know what you want to hide.

NPC: What do you mean by that? I don't have anything to...

Your response: Please, you can really drop that charade. I' ve got it all on this datacube. I will tell you that the content has got something to do with mutants...

NPC: What?! I, no... that's not me... I, ahh what the heck. If you already know it anyway. Why should I deny it? What is your purpose with this? If you want money I have to disappoint you, I am not very rich.

Your response: No, no, what do you think I am? I am not your usual kind of racketeer.

NPC: But I don't understand... What do you want from me then?

Your response: Oh, I just want a small favor from you. And then all this ugly information would never find its way into the Neocron City Network.

NPC: If I can do it easily, no problem. But I can't do everything...

Your response: You can certainly do this favor... delay the final testrun of the newly developed beam weapon. Just one or two days, not more...

NPC: How do you know about the weapon? This is  still top secret...

Your response: That is not an issue right now...

NPC: And what will happen to me? I can't...

Your response: It's your decision. Either you delay the testrun or you find your secrets all over the network.

NPC: You don't understand! I can't! The testrun will commence without my support! Only the director of operations could stop the test now.

Your response: Regrettable. And here I thought that I wouldn't need to publish these documents...

NPC: No! Please! I... there must be a different way.

Your response: I am listening. You better think about something...

NPC: I know! You could kill the Director of Operations! He still has a Generep but it would surely stop the testrun.

Your response: Me? Listen, it's your secrets that are at stake here.

NPC: Me?! No, I can't do this. I have known him for years... No, I would do much to keep these secrets of mine a secret but I can't do this. You will have to ruin my life then if that is what you want...

Your response: CONTINUE

NPC: But please think about it again. ... Heavens, now I recognize you! You have murdered those one BioTech Security Guard recently, didn't you? I already thought I have seen you on a surveillance monitor...

Your response: My fame is reaching far ahead of me it seems...

NPC: I still can't! Please, you have killed before, why then can't you also kill the director yourself?

NPC: I still can't! Please, you have killed before, why then can't you also kill the director yourself?

Your response: If this is necessary! It seems I will have to take it into my own hands again. I don't yet know what will happen with your secrets. What the heck, I'll give them back to you. Then they will remain your secrets.

NPC: Many, many thanks... thank you so much... You can find the director in Via Rosso Sec-1

NPC: Hurry and kill the director of operations before it is too late. He should be in Via Rosso Sec-1 at this moment

NPC: This is a critical situation, we are counting on you.

NPC: Our testrun was a mind blowing success!! I am certain that CityAdmin will now choose Tangent. How is BioTech faring then?

Your response: Their testrun was interrupted all of a sudden. I had to kill their director of operations first, though.

NPC: Runner, you are as cold as ice! You walk straight into a public restaurant and simply shoot the director of operations. I like that. I like that very much. Tangent is indebted to you. I have played with the idea of giving you one of the test versions of the new weapon. What kind of weapon would you prefer?

Your response: I'd prefer a cannon like weapon. Something really big, you know?

Your response: I'd prefer something not that obvious, how about a pistol?

Your response: I'm a fan of rifles, really. You got some of these?

NPC: I believe that you will like this cannon a lot. Additionally Tangent offers a bonus of 100,000 credits to you. After everything you have done so far it seemed only appropriate.

Your response: Thanks.

NPC: We will not have any more assignments for you that would be appropriate to your experience. But we would suggest that you open a clan and support Tangent with that Clan. Thank you for all you have done.

NPC: I believe that you will like this pistol a lot. Additionally Tangent offers a bonus of 100,000 credits to you. After everything you have done so far it seemed only appropriate.

Your response: Thanks.

NPC: We will not have any more assignments for you that would be appropriate to your experience. But we would suggest that you open a clan and support Tangent with that Clan. Thank you for all you have done.

NPC: I believe that you will like this rifle a lot. Additionally Tangent offers a bonus of 100,000 credits to you. After everything you have done so far it seemed only appropriate.

Your response: Thanks.

NPC: We will not have any more assignments for you that would be appropriate to your experience. But we would suggest that you open a clan and support Tangent with that Clan. Thank you for all you have done.

entries.conversation:
NPC: You are new here, right? Come closer over here, we need to talk.

Your response: I am all yours.

NPC: We always appreciate a new loyal member. Tsunami is a great organisation as you will find out. We offer much to our members but keep in mind that Tsunami is also a rather competitive environment. Do you feel up to a little competition?

Your response: Of course I will do my very best.

NPC: Then you surely understand that if I would trust everybody just like that, I'd be dead by now. That means, I do not trust you. I cannot trust you, not right now that is. We will have to prove your worthiness somehow.  Something that shows where your loyalties are.

Your response: I have not the slightest doubt that I am loyal to your cause.

NPC: It should be easy enough. We don't want to waste you in the process of your first assignment now, do we?  Still, if you don't even make it past this assignment you are out. It really is that simple. So keep yourself in a good shape.

Your response: Aye, I am no looser. You will realize that soon enough.

NPC: You should already know that the head of Tsunami is Veronique Duchamps. She is pulling all the strings and she is as vicious as it gets. If anything big is going on you can bet that she is already involved behind the curtains. Since she has got so many deals and relations to take care of she needs an errand boy once in a while.

Your response: I understand. So, what do I have to do?

NPC: Its a simple delivery, so do not screw it up. Bring this package to Maxime, it's for Eric Danmund himself. She is a contact who will make sure that the delivery reaches its destination. Meet her in Viarosso 2.

Your response: Come on, that's a piece of cake. Consider it done.

NPC: Expect something in return from her and bring it to Jester in Pepper Park 1, he is working for us as well. At least sometimes. He is a freelancer. Now do what you are told to do. Sometimes he hangs out in one of the various pubs.

NPC: Is it really that difficult? Go to Viarosso 2, deliver the package, get another one in return and bring it to Jester in Pepper Park 1. After that report to Taylor Gomez in the Secret Passage-2.

NPC: I am sure you can bother somebody else. Look, I am very busy.

Your response: I have a delivery for you. It is supposed to be for Mr. Danmund. I trust you can arrange a delivery?

NPC: I have only got time if it is important. I don't think it is important in this case.

NPC: You have a delivery for Mr. Danmund? Hrmph, alright, as if this would be the first time. Give me the package and I will see it delivered.

Your response: Here it is. I was told to get something in return for the delivery.

NPC: Really? I almost forgot about that. Just let me check something.

Your response: Please do that. I'll wait.

NPC: Oh, interesting. Cecil Stone has ordered that a chip should be given to you. One of the experimental X-OR chips. But that is really strange.

Your response: What do you mean?

NPC: Well, Diamond Real Estate is not usually dealing in other goods than appartements. That means it is rather strange that you should be given a microchip in return. Anyway, I am only delivering. I don't want to ask questions that could get me killed.

Your response: What is so special about this chip? Looks pretty important.

NPC: As I said, I don't do intel. Ask someone else about that.

NPC: Look, I am busy, unless you have another delivery that I should pass on do not bother me.

NPC: Keep walking, I am waiting for an important delivery.

NPC: A productive day. God, how I hate this phrase. Well, are you the one who is supposed to give me something from Tsunami? You still look rather green to me. Do you have the chip?

Your response: You better watch your mouth, I don't like being called green. Yes I got the chip, it comes straight from Cecil Stone it seems. Although I cannot fathom why he would go to this length in getting the chip delivered to us.

NPC: Excellent, I have waited long enough for that chip. That was really about time. What are you waiting for, you can leave now. Or do you have a question?

Your response: I would like to know, what exactly you are doing for Tsunami?

NPC: I am not working for Tsunami alone. To be honest, I have many clients but all of them depend on my discretion in what I do. That means I will not tell you more about what I do. But, I suppose I can tell you about the chip. It is a neural light chip. It is not only capable of storing incredible amounts of data but it can also control the very thoughts of a person. In theory, I mean.

Your response: Interesting, but why does Tsunami need it?

NPC: It is for a device that I construct for Tsunami. I can't and won't tell you more about it. Now, be on your way. Go back to Taylor Gomez in Secret Passage 2 and tell him I got the chip.

NPC: No, I already told you. I cannot tell you about my work! Otherwise I would end up dead in some dark back alley. Now report to Taylor Gomez in Secret Passage 2 already!

NPC: You have not completed your assignment yet. Better get that package to Maxime immediately. Don't forget to report back once you are finished.

NPC: What took you so long? That was an easy delivery mission. I you don't learn to concentrate your thoughts to the task ahead you don't belong here.

Your response: Come on, give me a break, it takes a while to cross the whole city.

NPC: That excuse is not acceptable. Tsunami members should always give 110 percent of what they can do. If you want to work for us then you should be a little bit more reliable.

Your response: I will try to be faster next time, although I can't see how I could possibly manage it faster. By the way, what was in the package I handed over to Maxime?

NPC: It was a simple gift to the CEO of Diamond Real Estate. A gift that was used as a decoy to avoid too much attention to the real objective of the task. That way they could give you the microchip without drawing too much attention. Cecil Stone, the system administrator at Diamond has some considerable debts with us and that is why he provided that microchip for us.

Your response: What is Jester doing with that chip then?

NPC: He is a freelancer. Sometimes he does business with us. He will construct us something special out of that chip. Your first job is done, you have proven your loyalty to us. Don't make the mistake to speak of payment. It is not you who is doing us a favor here, no. It is us doing you a favor. We will monitor your achievements and once your loyalty to us is not in question any longer we will have some more jobs for you. Goodbye. (next mission at level 20)

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Adiclovin
• Hormone Chip
• Tiberal

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Hormone Chip
• Tiberal

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Oh, yes. Its not that difficult. She can be found at the Red Pepper Bar in Pepper Park 2. That is the designated meeting place. After you have delivered the package visit Taylor Gomez in Secret Passage 2.

• You have your assignment. Get the package from Jester to Leila at the Red Pepper Bar in Pepper Park 2 and then report back to Taylor Gomez.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: This is a lucky coincidence, you arrived just when we needed somebody for a special job. We have some trouble with the Black Dragon scum. There was an open conflict in front of one of our clubs. They dared to attack with firearms. We had them running in no time but it sure was a powerful message. They attacked us on our own ground. It is time to do something about that. Are you ready to do more for Tsunami?

Your response: These Black Dragons are very bold. I would volunteer to kill some of those rats myself if that is what you want.

Your response: It does not suit me right now. I cannot help you at the moment.

NPC: No, it is not time for that just yet. Since you have proven your loyalty to us, there is another assignment that you will be entrusted with. It is important for our move to know as much as possible about the plans of the Black Dragon. But before Tsunami plans the next move we will have a small revenge on the Black Dragon.

Your response: How big is the threat?

NPC: The current situation is seeing battles between Tsunami and Black Dragon every day. They are forcefully trying to push into our market. They are threatening our clients and dancers likewise. We cannot allow this to continue. We will teach those bastards that Tsunami never yields. Not even an inch of its turf.

Your response: But what can be done other than killing them off?

NPC: We have managed to get a disguised member as a spy into the Black Dragon hierarchy. Her name is Leila. You will bring a small package to her and then she will cause some chaos from within the ranks of the Black Dragon.

Your response: And where do I get that from?

NPC: The package you are supposed to bring to her is still in the hands of Jester. Get the package from him and then give it to Leila. It should be quite a surprise for them once they find out what happened. Be sure to tell Leila that the implant is targeted at either Gecko or Trond himself, the leader of the Black Dragon. Now go.

Your response: Where can I find Leila?

NPC: Oh, yes. Its not that difficult. She can be found at the Red Pepper Bar in Pepper Park 2. That is the designated meeting place. After you have delivered the package visit Taylor Gomez in Secret Passage 2.

NPC: Tsunami is not offering you these assignments out of gratitude. That you reject such a mission tells us alot about your loyalty to Tsunami.

NPC: You have your assignment. Get the package from Jester to Leila at the Red Pepper Bar in Pepper Park 2 and then report back to Taylor Gomez.

NPC: Ah, my favorite would-be-Tsunami. I guess you are here for my little invention? It took me a while to figure out the correct amount of hormone distribution but it should work fine now. Would not want to use it myself, though. In the past I worked for ProtoPharm amongst others and now that knowledge about how chemicals can influence certain body functions helped me quite a lot in constructing this little device.

Your response: You guessed right. I am here to retrieve that device. What is it in any case?

NPC: It is a very sophisticated poison injector. For anybody else it looks like a simple implant but in truth it messes with the brain of the unfortunate person that uses it. I pity that person already, he he he. Have fun with it. But before you can have it I need some chemicals to make it work properly. Go and get me Tiberal and some Adiclovin.

NPC: I need Tiberal and Adiclovin for this to work, there is no other way.

NPC: Now I still need Adiclovin.

NPC: Excellent. Now its almost done... here we go. Now you can have it.

NPC: I have already provided you with the device. I sure hope you did not loose it. Now go and deliver it to the contact.

NPC: Maybe I could fulfill some of your dreams? What do you think?

Your response: I am here for somebody named Leila.

NPC: ... Oh no, I knew that day would come. Please I cannot speak to you, you don't know how cruel Gecko is.

Your response: Who is Gecko?

NPC: Gecko is second in command of the Black Dragon. You do not know what he did to me for lesser things than just speaking to a Tsunami.

Your response: You are supposed to have some informations about the plans of the Black Dragon for me.  Do not whine like that.

NPC: If I tell you all I know about them, will you leave me alone, please?

Your response: I still have this device for you. I was instructed to hand it over to you. I think you know what to do with it, don't you? It is for Gecko or Trond. Either one is fine.

NPC: I cannot do that, it would be my death warrant. Please, I am already experiencing hell on earth here.

Your response: You should better do like you are told or it might get worse for you. Tsunami is not known to forgive traitors.

NPC: But how can I succeed if you do not have the device?

NPC: Alright but please don't hurt me. I don't know much about their plans. Gecko keeps me on a pretty short leash. I suspect he knows that I am from Tsunami and I fear for my life every single day. The only thing I heard is that there is a major deal between Black Dragon and ProtoPharm going on. I don't know more... please go before they suspect something.

Your response: Right, here is the device. Just make sure it is delivered to the right person.

NPC: I... I will try to do as I am told...

NPC: I have to wait for the right moment! I cant just walk in there and press this poison injector onto his head. So leave me be.

NPC: I cannot waste time talking to you at the moment. Have you already completed your assignment?

NPC: Have you been able to get the required information? And have you delivered the device?

Your response: Yes, I have delivered the device though I did not find out much about the plans of the Black Dragon. The only thing I was told is that they plan a major deal with ProtoPharm.

NPC: Excellent. I will try to find out more about that deal and how it can possibly benefit us. In the meanwhile take these 5.000 credits as a reward.

Your response: Thank you. A word about Leila ... she seemed to be in trouble and said she suspected that they know about her spying activities for Tsunami.

NPC: Are you sure? I believe she is just paranoid. Lets assume just for a second that she is in danger. One whore more or less just won't cut the mustard. The truth is that she is expendable.

Your response: But she seemed really frightened. Isn't that a rather harsh way to deal with a Tsunami member?

NPC: Don't worry about that. Next time we might go into the offensive against the Black Dragon and we will certainly be needing your help. I suggest you get yourself in shape until then. (next mission at level 30)

entries.title: Tsunami 03
