entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• After that you should see Raymon in Outzone 3, he has contacts to ProtoPharm and he likes money very much which is the reason why we could convince him so easily to work with us. He should be able to make the murder look like it was done by the Black Dragon. Hand the weapon from Gil to him and then go and kill that stupid ProtoPharm Mr. Cook guy at the meeting place in the Outzone.

• Get the plan rolling. Meet the Anarchy Breed in A_08 outside the Neocron Gates and then Raymon in Outzone 3. Make sure to report back to Taylor Gomez afterwards.

• See you in one of your nice clubs in town, Runner. Didn't you say something about visiting somebody in Outzone 3?

• Alright, Mr Cook is already on his way and he has got the chemical with him. ProtoPharm has received an anonymous call that the deal would be ambushed, don't ask me where I know that from. If you still think about killing Cook, think again. He will not come unprepared into the Outzone 3, I will assure you. Now leave me and let me enjoy my meal.

• Now don't you dare to disrupt my dessert as well. If you really want to get that chemical, go to the Outzone 3 and get it off Mr Cook personally.

• Cook is in Outzone 3. If you excuse me, I am really trying to enjoy my dessert! Now leave me ALONE!

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: There is some vital information about the deal between Black Dragon and ProtoPharm. We know where it will take place and we know when it will take place. Still, disrupting the deal alone will do us no good since then the deal will just take place sometime else. We need to kill the ProtoPharm representative and make it look as if it was the Black Dragon who killed them.

Your response: Yes, but how can we do that. It is not as if Proto Pharm is that stupid not to be able to differentiate between Black Dragon and Tsunami.

Your response: I do not feel up to another challenge today.

NPC: We have some friends with the Anarchy Breed. Mainly because they like our Clubs so much. I am sure that they might still have a few weapons that were used by the Black Dragon. Those weapons can be used to trick ProtoPharm. Be sure to see Happy Gil in A_08 outside the Neocron Gates.

Your response: Don't worry, I know how to deal with that kind of people.

NPC: After that you should see Raymon in Outzone 3, he has contacts to ProtoPharm and he likes money very much which is the reason why we could convince him so easily to work with us. He should be able to make the murder look like it was done by the Black Dragon. Hand the weapon from Gil to him and then go and kill that stupid ProtoPharm Mr. Cook guy at the meeting place in the Outzone.

NPC: Its your choice but I hope you are aware that Tsunami does not appreciate slackers.

NPC: Get the plan rolling. Meet the Anarchy Breed in A_08 outside the Neocron Gates and then Raymon in Outzone 3. Make sure to report back to Taylor Gomez afterwards.

NPC: Whatsup, Runner?! Yo, you look like a stupid dumbass Tsunami courier to me. No really, just kidding.

Your response: True, and you are lucky that we can use your help. Otherwise I'd break your ugly nose.

NPC: Wohoo, the little Tsunami's got guts, ey?! I like that, really. So, whats your business with old me?

Your response: I need a weapon that was used by the Black Dragons. You got something for me?

NPC: Yes, yes, we have plenty of weapons from the dragons. They are just as good friends to us as you Tsunamis are. Hey, maybe one of these days we will screw both of you from behind. Hehee.

Your response: Don't mention Black Dragon in the same sentence with us, it hurts.

NPC: Just because you don't like em? I don't care a shit about whether or not you wanna take each other out. The Breed has always chosen their own friends. What weapon do you care to have now? Bah, forget that. I am only willing to give you this submachine gun anyway. Content?

Your response: Is that the only one you have? It looks rather broken.

NPC: Trust me. It fires alright, only tested it yesterday on a mutant. Hehee. That walking corpse was riddled with bullets... I tell you, a bloody mess was the only thing left of him.

Your response: Alright, I will take it.

NPC: Want a last word of advice? Black Dragon is up to something. They are buying weapons big scale and they are securing their alliances all over the place. Might be something to do with Tsunami. In fact, if it were not for your fine etablissements we would have sided with the Dragons. It's a shame that you don't deal in Drugs.

NPC: See you in one of your nice clubs in town, Runner. Didn't you say something about visiting somebody in Outzone 3?

NPC: I wasn't expecting you so early. It is not safe yet. Come back later...

NPC: Welcome! You should try the food here. The mutated squid is first class, although its not everybodies favorite.

Your response: Raymon? I have heard that you are a valuable member of ProtoPharm, yes?

NPC: More or less, but I know them quite a lot. So you are not here to enjoy the food I suppose?

Your response: No, I am here to make an offer to you from the Tsunami Syndicate. A valuable offer I might add.

NPC: I should have known you are Tsunami. ProtoPharm is not very interested in any contact with Tsunami. Especially now.

Your response: What do you mean?

NPC: I cannot tell you right now. It is... complicated. But what is your proposal?

Your response: I have got a weapon from a Black Dragon member here and we want...

NPC: No, don't tell me. It should look as if it was done by the Black Dragon, right? Forget it.

Your response: But, but there is a lot of money for you in that. It would be worth your while.

NPC: If I had known you wanted this, I would never have agreed to meet a Tsunami in the first place. If I draw too much attention to me now. Of all times. I'll end up like this mutated squid I just ate. And besides there really is nothing you could do to disrupt the relations between the Dragons and ProtoPharm at the moment anyway.

Your response: Maybe a lot of money would make you rethink our offer?

NPC: No. With todays deal the bond between Black Dragon and ProtoPharm will be too strong to bust with something like that. The deal is something about a new kind of chemical, I do not know the name at the moment. It is very valuable and once Mr Cook has delivered it to the Dragons, ProtoPharm will have too strong a connection to the Dragons. Even if you killed the person in question, it would not help to blame the Dragons. ProtoPharm knows very well how important they are for the Black Dragon. At the moment they really could not afford to make such a blunder. I do not know about that chemical, though, it has some kind of special meaning.

Your response: So, Mr Cook has that new chemical with him, then?

NPC: Yes, but ... why am I telling you that? Unless Tsunami is still paying me for that information.

Your response: You can be lucky if you don't wake up dead tomorrow, unless you tell me what you know.

NPC: Alright, Mr Cook is already on his way and he has got the chemical with him. ProtoPharm has received an anonymous call that the deal would be ambushed, don't ask me where I know that from. If you still think about killing Cook, think again. He will not come unprepared into the Outzone 3, I will assure you. Now leave me and let me enjoy my meal.

NPC: Now don't you dare to disrupt my dessert as well. If you really want to get that chemical, go to the Outzone 3 and get it off Mr Cook personally.

NPC: Cook is in Outzone 3. If you excuse me, I am really trying to enjoy my dessert! Now leave me ALONE!

NPC: Excuse me, but I am waiting for somebody.

NPC: I have not yet received any confirmation that you completed your assignment. I just assume you are still working on that.

NPC: I have not yet received any confirmation that you completed your assignment. I just assume you are still working on that.

NPC: I was informed about the deal and your little mission. Did it work? Did you manage to interrupt the deal between the Black Dragons and ProtoPharm?

Your response: Yes, though the Black Dragon will not be blamed for the kill. Mastersen would not accept the mission to blame the Dragons. Also I might add that ProtoPharm was informed about our plan to interrupt that special deal.

NPC: They were warned? Surely that cannot have been! Or there is a leak within Tsunami.This is troubling but it is not really that much of a surprise. There always seem to be people in any position who will gladly provide every information required. Trust me, I know the procedures.

Your response: Are you talking about a mole in our ranks?

NPC: Or it might even have been one of those Psi Monks. Some people claim, that they can read thoughts and look into the future. Reginald Axom figures that Crahn is involved in the deal that you prevented to a certain extent. He was a Psi Monk but luckily he is working for us now. But if you already knew that it would not look as if it was done by the Black Dragon, why did you do it?

Your response: That Cook guy from ProtoPharm had an unknown chemical with him. It appears to be rather important for the Black Dragon and therefore I decided to make it Tsunami property. What should I do with it?

NPC: Do I look like a scientist? You can show it to Jester when you next visit him. He might know about it. But that should wait till the next time. Be sure to hone your skills and here are 15,000 credits reward. Keep that chemical very safe until then.(next mission at Level 35)

entries.conversation:
NPC: There are more and more rumours about spies in our own ranks. The rumours are spreading and nothing we do seems to be able to prevent dissent in our own ranks. People do not trust each other, I mean, not that they did before. It was even brought to Veroniques attention and her reply was a white list for all Tsunami members that are as loyal as it gets.

Your response: What does that mean for me?

NPC: That list contains the names of the people that really can be trusted.This means that lots of small members are held at a certain distance, you included. I know, you did prove to be amongst those who did do a lot for Tsunami recently. I could get you on that list maybe, but it would require another test of loyalty. Just to be really sure about your intentions.

Your response: This is plain bullshit, I have already proven my worth more than once. I don't have to take this shit.

Your response: I have proven my worth. If I need to do it again, I will do it.

NPC: Officially that is true, but there is certainly a leak within Tsunami. Your last mission was not the only indication for insider information. I know that you put your life in danger there, but with all those genrep copies nowadays that could prove to be too small a price to be counted for your loyalty. There is the option of running an errand for a higher ranking member in order to improve your loyality even more and get onto that white list.

Your response: Just great. You really are dissing the wrong guy here.

NPC: If you are loyal, then you will persist. If not, we don't need you anyway. Go to Taylor Gomez in the Secret Passage 2. He told me earlier that he has a mission for you. It seems he is one who thinks you are loyal to Tsunami.

NPC: Not a wise choice. Tsunami is not some club you can just exit or join any time you like. Keep that in mind.

NPC: I do not know if Gomez will wait forever to give you this assignment.

NPC: I wanted to speak to you about something important. Remember when you killed that ProtoPharm guy? You said that he had been warned, right? And that does imply that some spy within Tsunami has access to important information, right? Who do you think could be the culprit? Be honest about it, I am just asking since you might have a better idea of who it was. After all you experienced his treachery first hand.

Your response: I don't know, it could be anyone. but I am sure it must be a high ranking member since nobody else could have had that kind of information.

NPC: Yes, the only other  possibility is a low profile member like you. After all, you knew about all this in the first place. I mean the ambush for example. You reported that they were prepared and you did not manage to finish the mission. Your contact did not want to blame the Black Dragon for the murder. Could it not be, that you did set up this whole scharade? You could have worked for the Black Dragon yourself.

Your response: You know damn well, that it could not have been me. It was my ass on the line! It was me who took that ProtoPharm guy out!

NPC: You are getting too emotional for my liking. I assume you know more than you want to admit. That is not a problem for me, I have always been one who is not easily deceived. I know a good man when I see one. And you certainly did a lot for Tsunami recently. So I wanted to give you an important mission even if you are not on the list that Veronique herself compiled. I am sure that suits your ego, doesn't it? And it might help you to be more easily recognized within Tsunami.

Your response: Very good, at least one person who acknowledges my worth for the syndicate.

NPC: Yes, yes, the person you are supposed to meet can be found in the Wastelands at the Catlock Bay. He will give you further instructions on how to proceed.

Your response: That is not very specific. Could you be a little bit more precise?

NPC: My patience is wearing off, go now and meet Gruber at the Catlock Bay. Otherwise your standing within the syndicate will be severely impaired.

NPC: I want to do you a favor with this! Dont be so stupid to risk all that you have already accomplished. Go to the Catlock Bay.

NPC: Be gone, I have no business with you.

NPC: You are coming from Gomez? Is that correct?

Your response: Yes, he told me that you would have further instructions for me.

NPC: Oh, what an irony. He never tells anyone enough, now, does he? So he did not tell you, why he sent you out here? Out here into the Wastelands?

Your response: No, but I suppose...

NPC: Really sad but also a rather good joke. Yes, you will receive some sort of instructions from me. That much is true. You must have noticed that Taylor Gomez knows that you are aware that there is a leak in the syndicate. You knew, didn't you?

Your response: I don't know where this leads us to...

NPC: Ha, ha, ha. Well, let me give you a hint. I believe I can tell you now since you won't be able to tell anybody else. Taylor believes that you found out about something that he wanted to cover up.

Your response: You mean, he is the spy?

NPC: That might be. Maybe. Might even be close to the truth. But whom will you tell, who will believe you? Hah, nobody! They would kill you for even mentioning such an idea. My job is to take care that you are eliminated. Do not struggle, if you kill me you would be off much worse. Tsunami would hunt you down for killing one of their members. And remember you are alone, nobody can help you - not even Leila.

Your response: That is not true! But... maybe Leila would help, damn could she be the only one I can trust... but can I really trust her?

NPC: Enough talk, more fight! Ha, ha, ha.

NPC: I will make sure that you are dead!

NPC: No, I don't want to speak to you again. You are ruining my whole life.

NPC: You again! Do you even know what Gecko did to me after we talked? This is not fair! He knows! He knows I am a spy for Tsunami! He yelled it to my face! And the horrible things he did to me. *sob*

Your response: Hey, hey, stop whining, I need your help.

NPC: Oh yes? Sure why not, you have been such a good friend to me... No, I won't help you! Not after this.

Your response: Alright, I feel sorry for you, really. But I am not responsible for what some freak does to you, now, am I?

NPC: Oh, yes? You have a choice! But I, I am dependent on those who have power and I cannot revolt against them. Even if they beat and humiliate me! I cannot flee, I cannot fight, I am practically their slave!!

Your response: I don't know how I can make it up to you, but I might be able to ease your pain. If you help me now!

NPC: What could you do? Oh, well, it cannot really get worse for me. What do you want me to do?

Your response: I have accidentially found out who is acting as a spy in the syndicate. But that person is too powerful for me to take on alone.

NPC: You have found out, who the spy is everybody is talking about? Who is it?

Your response: It is Taylor Gomez. I am sure of it. He tried to have me killed because he thought I found out.

NPC: Taylor? No way! He is so powerful. But how can I help you against a demon like him? He is almost as cruel as Gecko.

Your response: I don't know! Isn't there a way to get out of this?

NPC: Wait! I believe there is a way! But I will have to contact somebody first, please be patient for a while and keep a low profile. Come back once you feel it is safe for you.(next mission at Level 40)

CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Valadium
• X-OR chip

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Hormone Chip
• Important Datacube Info on Gomez
• Tsunami Assault Rifle TSU-3265
• Valadium
• X-OR chip

POSSIBLE COST
• 20,000 credits (depends on choice)

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• You are back, finally! I have had a lot of trouble contacting Hontoka, he is another Tsunami executive but his identity is a mystery to many. He prefers to watch everything from a distance. I know that his rank within the syndicate is at least equal to Taylor. He transmitted his location so that you can find him. I believe he spoke of the Industrial sector 02. I would try it there first...

• I might know a person. The person I mean has many talents and knows the way of the world. Visit Mark Cole in Pepper Park 3. He might know more.

• Your part will be to divert their attention. Just kill one Black Dragon Contact and there will be chaos. Enough for my friend to do his part, hopefully. I recommend you to check out the secret Black Dragon Faction Office that has hidden access from Pepper Park 3.

• It is your task to kill a Contact from the Black Dragon. They should NOT be runners. I recommend you to check out the secret Black Dragon Faction Office that has hidden access from Pepper Park 3. The Black Dragon Contacts there should be a easy target for you.

• At the moment I do not have more advice for you. Go and see Jester in Pepper Park 1, he might be able to give you some appropriate tools.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Tsunami members whose loyalty is in question are still not wanted until this whole mess is cleaned up.

Your response: That is a pity. I guess I will have to rely on Leila's offer after all.

NPC: Excuse me now. This situation requires that I have my full attention to it.

NPC: Do not force me to call the security. Go and visit that Leila you were talking about.

NPC: You are back, finally! I have had a lot of trouble contacting Hontoka, he is another Tsunami executive but his identity is a mystery to many. He prefers to watch everything from a distance. I know that his rank within the syndicate is at least equal to Taylor. He transmitted his location so that you can find him. I believe he spoke of the Industrial sector 02. I would try it there first...

Your response: Glad to hear that. Sure wasn't an easy time to keep a low profile.

NPC: You need to find more evidence against Taylor. But how? I do not know, but there are certain people here in Neocron who would do almost everything for money. But maybe you should talk to Hontoka first, he has some ideas himself.

Your response: I will do as you say. But the whole damn situation seems to slowly slip from my hands!

NPC: You have to keep calm or it will consume you. Now quick, before Gecko sees me talking to you. And... I wanted to give you this back... I could not do it... when Gecko found out that I was a spy, he gave me that implant back and said I was free to use it, whenever the pain of my existance is too great to bear...

Your response: That is the poison injector...

NPC: Yes, now please go...

NPC: Go now... Hontoka is in Industrial 02.

NPC: I was informed of your situation. Leila believes you can be trusted and I trust Leila. It looks grim. You have angered the snake and now you fear its poison.

Your response: I have come here because it seems that you are my only hope in this.

NPC: I dislike Taylor as much as I loath the swamp bugs. Always sucking blood from others, never creating something of their own. That was one of the reasons I quit the active duties with Tsunami. Make no mistake, I still have many friends within the syndicate but it is not the same now. Back then there used to be a certain honor amongst the members. Now there is none or the little that is left with Veronique.

Your response: What are you doing here in any case?

NPC: None of your business. Anyways, I do not blame Veronique for this whole situation, I blame the times we live in. Oh, as much as I would like to change all this back to the state where there was honor in every deed. If there would just be a threat great enough to unite the warring members. I want to help you, young Tsunami and that is why I will try to get evidence for the treachery of Taylor Gomez.

Your response: Thank you for that, but what can I do in the meanwhile?

NPC: The Black Dragon is gathering its forces and securing its back. The direction of their movement is clear in that it is pointed towards us. Veronique and Axom know that very well and they are concentrating their forces too. The only way to stop this confrontation might be to confront Taylor directly and kill him. Thereby uncovering his dirty secrets. But there is need for preparation. If you cannot prove his guilt it will not do you any good to kill Taylor.

Your response: Easier said than done, do you know somebody to give me that information.

NPC: I might know a person. The person I mean has many talents and knows the way of the world. Visit Mark Cole in Pepper Park 3. He might know more.

Your response: I believe I can find that on my own, thank you.

NPC: Come back to me after you have the information Cole provided you with.

NPC: I can't imagine what you might want from somebody like me.

NPC: Hey, Tsunami scum! Watch were you are going, this is my place.

Your response: Cole? I was told I could get information here.

NPC: That is great! Now, I even have a Tsunami who is asking for my help. You must be pretty stupid judging from your looks. I am not into that sort of business, unless...

Your response: Unless what?

NPC: Well, maybe. Maybe I can give you some information if you do something for me...

Your response: Well, that depends... I...

NPC: Alright, I thought you were tough but now I see that you are just another loser. Its a pity with all those privateers that don't earn a penny and a no good scum like you is earning the big money. Beat it, slacker.

Your response: Wait, I'll do it ...its ok, what is it?

NPC: That is better now. Ok, now listen. There is this guy who is constantly keeping tabs on me. I tell you, he is watching and following me almost all day long.

Your response: And where is he now? I cannot see him.

NPC: He is Black Dragon. Should be just your kind of job, because you are Tsunami. I want to divert his attention so that I can have a friend of mine sneek into his appartement and nick his stuff.

Your response: It is still unclear what you want me to do.

NPC: Your part will be to divert their attention. Just kill one Black Dragon Contact and there will be chaos. Enough for my friend to do his part, hopefully. I recommend you to check out the secret Black Dragon Faction Office that has hidden access from Pepper Park 3.

Your response: Alright, but I better get my information then.

Your response: Would it be too much for you to tell me precisely who to kill?

NPC: Information? Oh, yes, of course, your info. I have it right here in my head. Now go and return once you did your part.

NPC: It will not do. You must kill one of those Black Dragons.

NPC: You again! What is it this time??

Your response: I have fulfilled my part of the agreement, now it is your turn...

NPC: That was about high time. Serves that bastard right for keeping tabs on me. Now that my friend nicked his equipment I want to see how he is going to keep tabs on me any longer. I prize my privacy very high, you know.

Your response: Tell me what you know about Taylor Gomez?

NPC: Oh, I have lots of information about that person. After I have consulted some of my informative sources, this is what came up. I know from a reliable source that he is being paid enormous sums by the Black Dragon. He also indulges in perverted sexual desires and receives bribes from various organisations throughout Neocron. Is that enough information? Do I need to be more precise? Here is a datacube with all the relevant data.

Your response: That is really more than I hoped for. I have to take good care of this datacube. It would be a shame if I lost it somewhere.

NPC: Now beat it. Just don't be surprised if some of the info on the cube is not 100% truthful. You understand, eh?

NPC: I have no more business with you. I have given you your information, now go back to whoever sent you in the first place.

NPC: It is your task to kill a Contact from the Black Dragon. They should NOT be runners. I recommend you to check out the secret Black Dragon Faction Office that has hidden access from Pepper Park 3. The Black Dragon Contacts there should be a easy target for you.

Your response: And I can really flatline any Black Dragon employee?

NPC: No, only a Black Dragon Contact. Otherwise the kill cannot be accepted. But don't attract too much attention. If you get caught we will deny any knowledge of your existance.

NPC: Have you seen Cole already? Visit him before you come here again.

CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Important Datacube Info on Gomez

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• 5.56mm Rounds

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: We still haven't sorted this situation. You can take some vacation in the meantime.

Your response: I guess I should visit Jester again and clear the whole situation myself. If you want something done then do it yourself.

NPC: Pretty big words if you ask me, but if you can clear the situation Tsunami certainly would be grateful.

NPC: It took me quite some time to design that weapon I gave to you last time. It might help you to defeat Taylor. Here is some ammunition for it ... Good luck.

NPC: I hope the weapon is suitable for you?

NPC: You dare to approach me? Run or I shall see you killed.

NPC: You! You dare to approach me? Traitor!

Your response: Don't twist reality here. You are the traitor and I can prove it with this data cube.

NPC: What? Let me have a look. Where have you got that from? It almost looks real but I have to tell you that it is a fake. Unfortunately.

Your response: What do you mean? I got that from a reliable contact.

NPC: A contact? You don't mean Hontoka do you?

Your response: Yes, I do.

NPC: I don't believe it, Hontoka has planned this all along. He set me up as if I was a child. Believe me, it was him, he is the one who is always talking about how he misses the old times and wants to restore honor and glory. I bet he even told you that an outside threat could help to do just that, am I right?

Your response: Yes... but what about it?

NPC: He is always talking to people about that, it is so obvious!

Your response: I am not convinced! What about Gruber, you sent me to him to get killed.

NPC: No, I did not! He was instructed to give you a mission! If he wanted to kill you it was set up by Hontoka. He is the one you should kill.

Your response: No! You only want to confuse me! I still believe that you are the spy. Your foul arguments cannot deceive me. Prepare to get your just reward for your treachery.

NPC: That is a pity, now I have to kill you.

NPC: You shall not get away !!

NPC: I thought I already told you not to come back unless everything is back to normal.

NPC: Did you try talking to Taylor before you attack him?

NPC: Come back once we have  found out who the spy is.

Your response: No need. I found out that it was Taylor and eliminated him. I have all the data that points to him as a spy on this datacube.

NPC: But there is no datacube. And unless you have evidence you could also be the spy.

NPC: It is true. It is all true. To think that Taylor Gomez would commit treachery...

Your response: He was a cunny devil and I hope he does not survive this.

NPC: You have done an invaluable service for Tsunami, thank you. I forward the heartfelt thanks of Veronique herself that you were able to thwart the schemes of that treacherous spy. I am certain she would have liked to thank you herself but she is extremely busy. You have truly earned these 150.000 credits. Thank you again.

Your response: I told you that I am as loyal as it gets. One more thing. Leila is the name of a Tsunami member who is undercover at the Black Dragon HQ. Her real identity has been discovered and now she has to fear for her life every day.

NPC: We will see to that matter of course, rest assured. We would not let a Tsunami member down now would we? Why don't you found a clan and support the Tsunami even more? You seem to be very capable of holding your own. You are almost predestined to support our efforts. You should really attend to bigger matters than a few pesky missions from the Tsunami HQ. There are lesser members who can do that job now. I hope that you will make a fine addition to our faction. Good luck on your way.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Welcome. Welcome here with the Twilight Guardian. I assure you that you are not the only one who tasted enough lies and violence from that Lioon Reza bastard. Since you haven't been here for long you are not yet part of a cell, are you?

Your response: No, I only just arrived. I heard I would get a chance to pay back my dept to Reza.

NPC: Very well, you will get your chance to do just that. We need people like you. I believe Donnovan will be able to give you directions, he is a formidable warrior and survived many skirmishes. Are you content with that?

Your response: More than content. I'll be on my way immediately.

NPC: You can't miss him, he is in the Barracks level of the TG HQ.

NPC: Well? Did you forget your way? Donnovan can be found at the Barracks level of the TG HQ.

NPC: A new face? I like that. The more we are the sooner will we succeed. Succeed in dragging Rezas arse out of Neocron. You do know why we do all this?

Your response: Because Reza already had enough time to turn matters to the worst?

NPC: True to a certain extend. We do all this because Reza is putting himself above the people and because he betrayed us. We do all this because CopBots execute anybody who doesn't precisely follow the law. Reza is a dictator who is only concerned about his own welfare. The truth is that there is no safety within the walls of Neocron. There is only oppression. We are the only ones who can fight him in the name of every inhabitant of Neocron.

Your response: We are going to give Neocron back to the people?

NPC: Hagen Yager has some plans, no doubt. Once we pound Rezas government into dust, Reza will feel the rage of the people. In truth Reza is doing only as he pleases without listening at all to his members of government.

Your response: We cannot allow this to continue.

NPC: Exactly, and because of that we have to make sure that our zeal does not lessen. It is our destiny to free Neocron from the icy grasp of Rezas claws. That is why we may never tire or break our own rules like Tovall did. He is lucky that he did only break a rather unimportant rule but I need to speak to him nonetheless. Go and visit him outside the HQ in the Canyon and tell him that I expect to discuss something with him.

NPC: Sorry, I give no audiences at the moment. That means I've got no time.

NPC: Ah, what can I do for you? You are rather new to this place, aren't you? Otherwise I would surely have noticed you already.

Your response: I am just starting here. I come on behalf of Donnovan.

NPC: What does that old geezer want from me? Unbelievable, that guy is sure to ruin everyones day.

Your response: He is expecting you for a personal conversation. It seems you have crossed the law.

NPC: And I am supposed to go there voluntarily? How do I know you aren't just making fun of me? I don't trust everybody, you know?

Your response: Come on, I am not your enemy here. Isn't it enough to have Reza and his lapdogs hunting us?

NPC: Sure but what should be the benefit of such a conversation? After all I do know that I crossed a boundary I wasn't supposed to.

Your response: Well, well, here I am trying to help you. I wonder why. It's bastards like you that prevent our early victory over Reza.

Your response: Listen, I am not trying to criticise you but maybe you are only making matters worse.

NPC: What did you just say?

Your response: I said that you are a worthless bastard and that you will ruin all of us.

Your response: Forget it.

NPC: You dare to speak to me like that?

NPC: Yes, I know that its only getting worse that way but I can't help to be stubborn. Youre alright. Here, take a drink. This could have turned ugly.

Your response: Don't worry, I know how it is to be on the edge.

NPC: Well, I might visit Donnovan after all. Could you tell him about it? Oh, yes, I' ll give you a package for Jade. Donnovan will know what it is about. Thanks.

NPC: First you have to speak to Tovall. Then we will see.

NPC: Well, did you get my message to that muleheaded Tovall?

Your response: Yes, he agreed to meet you.

NPC: Good, excellent, usually he behaves like a stubborn Drom. Is there anything else?

Your response: He also handed me a package for Jade but I have no idea who that is.

NPC: Jade? ... Ahh, that is not a good story. The last message we received reported increased NCPD activity. She wrote that she did not know how long she could remain undetected and hidden. But we received this message already a week ago.

Your response: A whole week? What could have happened to her?

NPC: Our duty is to face death unblinking. Every single one of us has got nothing to loose and everything to win. But of course there will be those that will not live to see our triumph. Even if they are dead, though, they live on through our deeds and as long as we remember them. It is an honour to die for the cause that you live for. Here, take this bottle of wine to Tovall, he will know what happened.

Your response: Well, what will be my task?

NPC: First you will have to get yourself in a decent shape. That means training, training and more training. If you are ready for more you can speak to a contact person.

NPC: Give that bottle of wine to Tovall. Afterwards you can train until the preparations continue.

NPC: Do not fear, I will visit Donnovan in due time.

NPC: If you cannot deliver the package then bring it back to me at least.

NPC: What do I see? You are carrying the package and additionally a bottle of wine? That is not good.

Your response: I believe you know the meaning of this.

NPC: Of course I do but Donnovan is wrong. She is much too tough, I am certain that she is still alive. If I could just get out of here. Whatever, I will enjoy this wine nonetheless. I'll see you. (next mission at level 20)

entries.conversation:
NPC: Did you hear about our latest victory? We destroyed another weapon factory. The battle took longer than we thought. But Reza doesn't have the support of the people. He won't stand a chance in the long run.

Your response: Are there news from Donnovan? I trained and I believe I am ready for anything life can throw at  me.

NPC: Yes, I remember. He said that you should prove yourself against Heff and Tovall. A little training against real enemies can't hurt. You can find them outside in the Canyon near the HQ entrance. Donnovan awaits you after that. He is rather certain that you will succeed.

NPC: You should decide whom to fight first. I would recommend Heff.

NPC: Hey, calm down. I am supposed to fight you, then? And you are certain that you can take it? By the way, my name is Heff, I am just coming from Neocron. Worked there together with the lady Jade. But once that secret agency had our trail I lost her on the retreat. If I could get my hands on Reza then I could...

Your response: I am sure Tovall will be interested in that. But aren't we supposed to fight?

NPC: Sure, whatever you want. Let's start.

NPC: Do you want to fight again? Very well. Keep in mind that this is no training any longer.

NPC: I was already informed that I can beat up a recruit today. Alright, let's go.

NPC: Any news? I hear rumours from every side but nobody tells me anything.

Your response: Hmm, Heff did say that he lost sight of Jade when he had to retreat from Neocron.

NPC: That would mean that there is at least some hope. I was already about to assume the worst. But you are certainly not here to talk about Jade, right?

Your response: No, really. Donnovan told me to get some training with you. I won't take it easy on you.

NPC: Har, ha. Very well, then I won't have to take it easy on you either.

NPC: Haven't you had enough? This time it'll be for real.

NPC: Did you fight against Heff?

NPC: Did you fight against Tovall?

NPC: Hrmph, I had no doubt that you would succeed. After all you seem to be well prepared. But enough of that. Do you know the Fallen Angels?

Your response: Sure, a stereotypical group of scientists. They own Tech Haven.

NPC: Exactly. Once in a while we contact them because they are scientists who know what they are doing. I know, except for the Fallen Angels and Anarchy Breed, no other faction is on our side. That is no surprise since all other factions depend on Reza. It is only understandable that they cannot turn against him since they depend so much on him.

Your response: I always thought the Fallen Angels were against violence.

NPC: Of course they are and now take this package to our contact person Elias. He is waiting near the entrance to Tech Haven in E_07. But take care since it can be very dangerous out there in the Wastelands.

NPC: Where did you leave that urgent delivery from the Guardians? We really need it for our research.

NPC: It does not happen often that we see a Twilight Guardian around here. I assume you have business here?

Your response: There is a package from Donnovan. I hope you know what it means.

NPC: Could it be the material that we were expecting? This is very important. Show it to me.

Your response: Here, but I don't understand what this is all about.

NPC: Some rare metals that can only be found in a few mines. Luckily the Twilight Guardian possess those few mines.We need this delivery to be able to continue certain... ahhh... experiments. You can report to Donnovan that we will honour our part of the agreements. Thank you that you took this long journey upon you.

NPC: I will make sure that the project that the Twilight Guardian commissioned will be ready in time.

NPC: Did you already visit Elias at the entrance to Tech Haven in E_07?

NPC: You are back already? I assumed that you wanted to have a closer look at Tech Haven in E_07. After all it is a very mighty structure that they managed to build out there.

Your response: Yes, of course. Elias seemed to be very eager to get his hands on that package.

NPC: Ha, yes, those scientists. A light shines in their eyes once they talk about their science. Thank you that you made this delivery. You earned a little extra. Use it for your equipment or drink it away, whatever way you want. If you are ready for more you can see a contact person. (next mission at level 30)

entries.conversation:
NPC: The Anarchy Breed have got some trouble with the CityAdmin again. Reza seems to go pretty hard on them. They only were lucky that Reza didn't send all of his lapdog CopBots. Otherwise our friends would be in a rather dire situation.

Your response: The Anarchy Breed? Why are we friends with them at all?

NPC: Simple, basically Reza is their enemy as well. Maybe they have different plans for after the time of the dictator but that is something different.

Your response: Very well, basically I wanted to know whether or not Donnovan has got a new job for me.

NPC: Better you ask Donnovan yourself. You know where you can usually find him, right?

NPC: Donnovan should be around here somewhere. You will find him, I am sure about it. Our HQ is not as big as we might want it.

NPC: This has to stop. I have seen some of the reports and the situation is depressing. Twilight Guardian are vanishing again and again. They are trying to persuade the people of Neocron to work against Reza. It is a pity but if we want to win against this pig named Reza we need to convince the people of Rezas dark secrets.

Your response: I thought we only need our combined strength to defeat Reza.

NPC: Well, that would be nice. But we need the population to do something against Reza. That is also the reason for all those Propaganda Cubes that we produce. You still know the content of them, do you?

Your response: Sure, everything about Rezas crimes.

NPC: True, I believe a man should pay for his crimes. Reza is not only a dictator and criminal but also a coward. Think about it, who profits from Neocron? The only person that benefits from Neocron is Reza.

Your response: I am surprised that the populations just seems to accept it.

NPC: Do they have a choice? Their only chance is to confront him all at once. To revolt against him. And that is only possible if everybody knows the truth. That's why we give Neocron the truth. This time you will bring them some cubes.

Your response: Me? What is my task with this?

NPC: You have to go to Neocron and spread the cubes, two were requested and you can give the other one to somebody of your own choice. You will look for one of the secret entrances to Neocron and find your way into the Pepper Park. Look out for CopBots, those cubes would mean the death penalty if they are found in your possession.

Your response: Where are those entrances?

NPC: There is one in the sector of the main entrance. Then there are others as well. One leads to the Outzone and is not guarded. Another one leads to the church of Crahn and I cannot imagine that they would oppose anyone of us using that entrance now and again. Take care nonetheless, the Outzone is no friendly place.

Your response: Good, I will try this.

NPC: Here are your three datacubes with the information. Take one to Simmons and one to Figaro. You can find both in Pepper Park. The third datacube should be given to a runner. You should try to convince him of our cause. Look for somebody on the streets. Careful, to get back in one piece is paramount.

NPC: Get lost, I don't want to be seen with a Twilight Guardian.

NPC: Yes? What? Why don't you talk?

Your response: I've got a datacube filled to the top with the truth about Rezas government. Interested?

NPC: Of course I am. I would have already done far more for the Twilight Guardian but I value my life too much. I know somebody, however, who could do more for you.

Your response: Yes? Then tell me about it.

NPC: I know this former CityAdmin employee. He seems to be fed up with them and looks as if he would sell his own mother for his cause. If you want to I will arrange a meeting.

Your response: If all this is true it would be ideal for our cause. Make sure that he means it, though.

NPC: Good, but only if you see to it that Reza will find a soon end. I'll send the meeting coordinates directly to your HQ.

NPC: It would be better if we were not seen together. As soon as I know the meeting place, I will immediately send the coordinates to you.

NPC: I have an assortment of special drugs right here. But there are already many people waiting for them. That means you have to try again later.

NPC: Ahh, you surely want to have a look at my wares, right?

Your response: Not really but I do have a datacube with your name on it.

NPC: Finally. Do you have any idea how long I have waited for it? Now I will hopefully learn more about what the CityAdmin really does.

Your response: How come that you need information from us, after all you are sitting right at the source?

NPC: Yes, yes, but that is only partially true. The CityAdmin is good at hiding what it wants to keep hidden. I only learn about something interesting once in a while.

Your response: For example?

NPC: The NCPD raided the areas now and then. A few days ago they burned some apartements. After that they lined up six Twilight Guardian and executed them. They don't know mercy it seems.

Your response: They simply executed them? These bastards...

NPC: Don't take it too hard, there is not a single day a Neocron citizen is not executed right there on the street. Now be gone before somebody sees us together.

NPC: Did I already mention that I was almost executed once?

NPC: Just bring this information to Simmons in Pepper Park 2.

NPC: Just bring this information to Figaro in Pepper Park 3.

NPC: Are you ready? Well done, I hope there were no problems. I am always happy when I can get back to the HQ. That city carries the stench of corrupted Reza slaves.

Your response: I have given all the Propaganda Cubes away. Simmons seems to be a secret supporter of our case. He even wanted to organise a meeting with a former CityAdmin who wants to get back at Reza.

NPC: Try to convince somebody to join our side with help of the datacube. After that you can return.

NPC: Simmons? It seems the only thing that he needs is a little courage. When is this meeting supposed to be?

Your response: He wanted to let us know about it.

NPC: Good work, Hagen would be proud of you. Here is your reward but do not waste it all. Rather train a little and then speak to a contact person. (next mission at level 35)

• Exactly. Do you remember Simmons? He arranged the meeting he was talking about. You should still be careful because we don't know what the contact is up to. entries.conversation:
NPC: There are more and more rumours that tell us about the new secret police with Reza. They already seem to have killed many Twilight Guardian. And they sure seem to be a brutal and totally ruthless.

Your response: Do you know any facts?

NPC: Why do you suppose am I telling you this? I hoped that you would know a little bit more but I see that you are poking in the dark as well. Oh yes, Donnovan has got something special for you.

Your response: Good, I will visit him at once.

NPC: Do that. Maybe you will know more later. God, I am on the brink of paying anybody who can bring me some little bits and pieces  of news about this a generous sum.

NPC: I am sorry but this time I've got a lot for you to do. I would have loved to lead the operation myself but since I have broken my leg just yesterday I can't do anything like that. My new implant has to get a lot of rest until the Nano machines have finished their work.

Your response: I hope your leg will heal soon. The sooner I have made an impact, the sooner will Reza fall.

NPC: First there are some problems with our old enemies. The CityMercs are closing in on our area and they always appear in platoons. That is six Mercs each. Two battles have already been lost. It is about time to turn tables on them and hit em hard.

Your response: It would be best if we could hire them, eh?

NPC: Don't be silly, the CityMercs are neutral to everybody except to us. It is our plan to kill single CityMercs who don't have the protection of a platoon. It will be your first task to find a Guard or other official representive. You will have to fight and kill him. It is important that it is NOT a Runner since they are not worth it. We have reports of a CM Contact Person that likes to eat at Chez Sipher in Viarosso 3, check that out.

Your response: Understood.

NPC: Exactly. Do you remember Simmons? He arranged the meeting he was talking about. You should still be careful because we don't know what the contact is up to. The meeting is taking place in the Wastelands F 06. His name is Johnson. Meet him there once you have finished that CityMerc and don't forget to give me a precise report.

NPC: I assume you are the Twilight Guardian contact person?

Your response: If you are Mr Johnson then yes. I hope our trust will not be unjustified.

NPC: Good, good. Of course I will do my very best, after all I want to pay back Reza as well.

Your response: That is what we have in mind, too. Tell me, what do you have for us?

NPC: I would like you to show a little bit respect. After all I am risking a lot here.

Your response: Oh very well then. Could you please tell me what you know?

NPC: Listen, Reza has got a new secret police squad. It is called the Neokorps. The current commander is probably only known to Reza himself. I cannot tell you more than that their operations are radical and ruthless. But I know something else.

Your response: That would explain those last raids.

NPC: I haven't finished yet. There will be a secret meeting between the leader of the Neokorps and the officers. That will be an excellent possibility to deal Neokorps a killing blow.

Your response: That sounds tempting but what do you gain from this? You are risking a lot to provide us with this information.

NPC: Don't worry, my reward will be to see Rezas government go down the drain. I will give you additional information about the location of the secret meeting. Go now or you will risk that somebody will see us.

NPC: I have already agreed to provide the information about the secret meeting.

NPC: Try to contact Donnovan.

NPC: It is good to see you. And? Were you able to find something interesting?

Your response: Sure, after all I can't just let you die because of lack of information, can I?

NPC: Thanks, you are a real philanthropist. Here, I'll give you 2000 credits for that piece of info.

Your response: Philan... what? Anyway, Reza does have a new secret police squad which is called the Neokorps. We already had a meeting with a CityAdmin traitor who wants to betray the commander of that new police force.

NPC: Thanks again. I am always open for this kind of news.

NPC: If you find out more be sure to tell me about it.

NPC: You know that you are supposed to kill a CityMerc Runner and meet with Johnson in F 06, right?

NPC: You know that you are supposed to kill a CityMerc Runner and meet with Johnson in F 06, right?

NPC: Did you already visit Johnson?

Your response: Why don't you ask me about the CityMerc I was supposed to eliminate first?

NPC: Ha, I am sure that you wouldn't stand here in front of me if you didn't succeed. Tell me more about Johnson.

Your response: Well, he reported a so called Neokorp secret police squad. Apparently it came right out of the mind of Reza.

NPC: That must be the reason why so many of our people are ambushed so brutally. Is that all? That would not be much.

Your response: No, he promised us that he would present to us an opportunity to get our hands on the commander of the Neokorps.

NPC: Really? That person seems to be very knowledgeable. But can we dare to just let this opportunity pass unnoticed? Tell me when and how this is going to be.

Your response: I have no idea. He said that he would give us the exact time and place.

NPC: Good work, you are quickly becoming one of the major players against Reza. Since you did my job as well, I'll give you my reward also. You earned that much. I think you know whom to contact once you have trained some more. Good luck. (next mission at level 40)

• Donnovan informed me about the location of the Neokorps meeting. It is somewhere in sector A 06 at the coast. Sorry, I can't remember numbers very well. It is your job to walk the leader of the Neokorps to the afterlife. After you have been there you can get a small payment to the contact person. You know better where to find that guy. entries.conversation:
NPC: Donnovan informed me about the location of the Neokorps meeting. It is somewhere in sector A 06 at the coast. Sorry, I can't remember numbers very well. It is your job to walk the leader of the Neokorps to the afterlife. After you have been there you can get a small payment to the contact person. You know better where to find that guy. Apart from that Tovall wanted to speak to you alone after you have accomplished all this. Understood?

Your response: I think so...

NPC: Very well, take a good shot at that Neokorps commander. Give em hell. Try one of the few broadcasting stations in that area. Maybe there is somebody who can tell you more.

NPC: The target is in A06 and the contact person is still expecting the cashcube. After this Tovall wants to speak to you. Remember, duty comes first.

NPC: Are you looking for somebody?

Your response: Hmm, to be honest, I am looking for a group of people who are supposed to meet around here somewhere.

NPC: Ahh, then you are the one I am expecting. You walked straight into our little trap. Now I will have to kill you myself. I hope you have already prepared for your death.

Your response: I don't understand...

NPC: ...

NPC: ...

NPC: You already have the money? I suggest you visit sector A 06 first and kill the Neokorps leader.

NPC: You? You survived the trap? But everything was planned so very meticulous! I don't understand.

Your response: Then you are a traitor after all. You have been suspicious to me all the time, you pig.

NPC: Damn you, I won't suffer any more insults from the likes of you scum. You Twiligh Guardian deserve nothing less than death. And death is what you will get.

Your response: I didn't expect anything less from a slave of Reza. Let me free you from that burden!

NPC: ...

NPC: ...

NPC: First I have to do something else, sorry.

NPC: Hey, haven't seen you in a while. Remember that I told you that there still was hope, Jade lives and she is well considering the circumstances.

Your response: Great but at the moment I am more worried that we stepped right into a trap of Reza. One of his agents engineered it and lead me right into it.

NPC: Then you did not succeed in eliminating the Neokorps commander? Don't look at me like that, Donnovan told me everything about the plan. It's ok, I am authorized to know about it.

Your response: Yes, I mean no, I did not succeed since I encountered a killer in his stead.

NPC: I understand the situation, it seems it is time for plan B. It came as a surprise for us that Jade still lived but it was even more so a surprise since she seems to be close to unravelling a secret. That is the reason why she did not return in the first place. Donnovan already wanted to send somebody to her aid but I guess we already have a volunteer right here in front of me.

Your response: Very well but it should better be important. That Neokorps bastard should just wait and see what happens when I meet him for real.

NPC: You can find her in the Outzone but I don't know where. She changes places every now and then to remain undetected. Outzone sector 4 should be sufficient, though. Good luck and maybe you could take this package to her now? Thank you.

NPC: She is supposed to be somewhere in the Outzone. I don't know the exact location, though. Her last known location is Sector 04.

NPC: I don't know you, leave me alone.

NPC: Finally, you are Twilight Guardian, right?

Your response: Yes, I come directly from the canyons. I even bring a present.

NPC: A package from Tovall? It seems he just cannot leave me alone. You have to know that he fell in love with me, such a fool. He wouldn't even admit it. But we have more pressing matters now.

Your response: Good, that's why I am here, right?

NPC: I have information that you are tracking Neokorps as well. I hope you know what I am talking about at least.

Your response: Sure thing but unfortunately my investigation ended in a trap. The contact was a traitor sent by Reza.

NPC: Anyway, ever since the Neokorps first started hunting us inside the city gates of Neocron I have been following their tracks very closely. Now there are only a few possibilities left to check out. That means I will hopefully soon be able to find that Neokorps commander. I only need a little help with that. Are you ready? May I remind you that there is a huge bounty on the commanders head?

Your response: Agreed. You have a way with people that is just irresistable.

NPC: Great, just let me finish a few preparations before we start. Just talk to a contact person once you are ready for the final blow. If you want to you can retrieve a Fallen Angels special commission from Tovall now. Until later.

NPC: Visit Tovall. He has got something useful for you.

NPC: She is supposed to be somewhere in the Outzone. I don't know the exact location, though. Her last known location is Sector 04.

NPC: The development of the project with the Fallen Angels will soon be finished. But until then there is still much to do. Here is a sample of what the Fallen Angels will give us.(next mission at level 45)

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• You'll go with my blessing then. Jade already awaits you in the Outzone sector 4. Show em, and show em good.

• I know you can do it. All previous missions seemed to be a piece of cake for you. Outzone sector 4, right?

• Welcome if everything proceeds as planned we can escape this shithole called Outzone very soon. I hope you have prepared yourself appropriately. This is not going to be a picnic.

• Ha, good joke, it could have already cost my life just to come all the way out here. I haven't been that far in the Wastelands too often.

• No, sorry, but I am going to try it first. I still need you though to organise a distraction from me. It should be enough if you kill one CityAdmin employee. No runner, as noone would even notice. Apparently, there's a CityAdmin employee who likes to hang out in front of the Pussy Club in Pepper Park 3, you should start there. I will use the subsequent chaos to eliminate Blight.

• Jade in Outzone Sector 4 has all the necessary informations.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: I have heard that you are on the best way to show those Neokorpses the way. Is that true?

Your response: That's the plan.

NPC: You'll go with my blessing then. Jade already awaits you in the Outzone sector 4. Show em, and show em good.

NPC: I know you can do it. All previous missions seemed to be a piece of cake for you. Outzone sector 4, right?

NPC: Welcome if everything proceeds as planned we can escape this shithole called Outzone very soon. I hope you have prepared yourself appropriately. This is not going to be a picnic.

Your response: I know, otherwise I wouldn't be here now, Jade.

NPC: Good, I have worked long and hard for this so don't screw it up, understood? There is a contact person located at the ancient Loba Village, he isn't the type of person you should trust but so far every information he has given me was true. I've got a deal with him. He gives us the how and where of the Neokorps commander and we give him a whole lot of credits.

Your response: No problem. Where is the money?

NPC: It's not that simple. You have to get the 10000 credits we need from someplace else. I don't have enough cash with me and it seems like a small enough price to pay. Think about it, we are going to cross the plans of Reza himself.

Your response: Hrmph, good, but only because I cannot stand Reza.

NPC: The contact person is in the Ancient Loba Village. We will define our final plan once we have sufficient information. The contacts name is Beckert.

NPC: Shht, I'm just trying to... damn, now I lost the frequency. The third time on this day alone. Oh alright, what do you want?

Your response: I believe you know Jade? There was a deal.

NPC: Oh, of course. I get some credits and you get a little something out of my personal collection. You got the money?

Your response: Here you are, count it, if you don't trust me. 10,000 credits as promised.

NPC: Beautiful but I warn you, the information is very dangerous. It could cost you your life.

Your response: Ha, good joke, it could have already cost my life just to come all the way out here. I haven't been that far in the Wastelands too often.

NPC: Maybe but this location has one unbeatable advantage. It is far from the claws of Neocron. Do you want to hear what I have to say, now?

Your response: Sure, fire away.

NPC: I have been eavesdropping on some conversations and I came across the location where the commander of Neokorps like to pass some time. And I know how keen you Twilight Guardian are on getting your hands on him.

Your response: Where is it? Tell me, where?

NPC: Alright, alright, you can find him directly outside the main city gate of Neocron. There are a few shops in there where he likes to buy the stuff he needs for daily life. His name is Blight, don't know more, though. I'm always pleased to have business with you guys. Now go back and tell Jade about it.

NPC: Try the main city gate of Neocron. Right on the inside you will find some shops where the target person likes to pass some time. Jade is already waiting for the information.

NPC: There is somebody in the ancient Loba Village who will be able to help us.

NPC: Did he have our information?

Your response: Yes, we know now where the commander of the Neokorps likes to shop. Does that even help us? Can we trust this information at all?

NPC: Nowadays you gotta risk something now and then. Apart from that it is our only lead. Are you alright? Ready to move?

Your response: Sure, just leave that pig to me. I'll take care of him.

NPC: No, sorry, but I am going to try it first. I still need you though to organise a distraction from me. It should be enough if you kill one CityAdmin employee. No runner, as noone would even notice. Apparently, there's a CityAdmin employee who likes to hang out in front of the Pussy Club in Pepper Park 3, you should start there. I will use the subsequent chaos to eliminate Blight.

Your response: If that is your wish you can find him on the outside of the Neocorn main city gates.

NPC: Thanks, I won't forget what you did for me. We'll meet here again once it is over and done, yes? Let's do this.

NPC: Take out one CityAdmin. Make sure to kill an employee. Runners are not important enough. Hopefully that will be enough as a diversion.

NPC: I am sorry, I couldn't kill him. I didn't even manage it past the STORM-Bots.

Your response: Are you hurt?

NPC: No, its only a flesh wound but I have been unsuccessful.

Your response: Then I will just have to try it myself.

NPC: That is insane, he is warned now. You will only run into your own doom.

Your response: Sometimes you gotta take a risk or two in this world. Don't worry, I'll come back.

NPC: If it really is your wish then at least be careful. It really is dangerous.

NPC: I thought you wanted to try and eliminate the commander of the neokorps right on the outside of the Neocron main city gates?

NPC: You really did it? You killed him?

Your response: It was a tough fight but in the end he made one mistake. He underestimated the power that our cause gives me.

NPC: Incredible, you have just eliminated one of our main problems. Nobody will forget that easily. But we shouldn't rest for too long since I am certain that all hell will break loose here soon. We might see each other again. Donnovan can give you your reward.

NPC: You can get your reward from Donnovan.

NPC: Yes, there is a bounty on the head of the Neokorps leader. Take it seriously.

NPC: Jade in Outzone Sector 4 has all the necessary informations.

NPC: You are an exceptional role model for all of us. You started all the way at the beginning and you survived all that was thrown at you. Impressing. But all that has been topped by the death of Blight. I would say you are even ready to lead your own clan.

Your response: That would be an idea. But I heard that a reward was mentioned.

NPC: Indeed. Here are 80,000 credits. Now you see how much all this was worth. Feel free to take some time off and then you can think about founding your own clan to support the war against Reza. Unfortunately I cannot give you any further missions or advice. Good luck and feel free to become a living nightmare for Reza.

Your response: You can bet on that. Well, then I'll just continue my work.

NPC: Before you go, do you remember the mission with the Fallen Angels? They completed our assignment and the product is a highly explosive grenade called Freedom Strike. You can have as many of them as you want. Although the Angels deliver very slowly, you can come back any time and get more. Just talk to Heff, he is the one who will give out the grenades.

NPC: Sorry, but I am busy now. Leave me alone!

NPC: You're lucky that I am currently off duty. Otherwise I would have you executed for interrupting my every morning shopping tour.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Faction Office Assistant

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Goodbye then.

NPC: I think you had better leave while you can still walk.

NPC: You had *better* have a good reason to be here, gwai loh!

Your response: The best reason of all.  I wish to cast off my current affiliation and become a Dragon!

Your response: Sorry, I think I'm lost.

NPC: Then you came to the wrong place, idiot.  Only the best may join the Triads and I doubt you are good enough.  It is not for me to decide though so go to heart of the enemies of Neocron and visit our headquarters in the Dome.  I may talk with you further if you are accepted.

NPC: Shall I kill you and then cut your hands off, or cut your hands off and then kill you?  Hmm, decisions decisions...

NPC: What are you doing here?.

Your response: I had heard about a secret base and wanted to see it for myself.  What can you tell me about this place?

Your response: I have come to find out more about the counsil.

Your response: I do not have to explain myself to you, my friend.

NPC: Our faction office is located here.  There is also a supply depot and a regeneration area.  Remember that the location of this base is a closely guarded secret and even I shudder when I think of what we do to anyone we even *suspect* of telling others of its location.  I hope I make myself clear.

Your response: Please can you tell me about the supply depot?

Your response: What can you tell me about the faction office?

Your response: Can you tell me about the regeneration area?

Your response: Do not worry, I value my life!  Thanks for your help.

NPC: The supply depot is run by the Resource Supply Manager and provides many weapons to strike at the heart of our enemies.  You get a 10 percent discount on all goods - use it wisely.

Your response: What can you tell me about the faction office?

Your response: Can you tell me about the regeneration area?

Your response: Thanks for your help.

NPC: The faction office is where the counsil of the Black Dragon resides.  It is the centre for all operations within enemy territory.

Your response: What is the faction counsil?

Your response: Can you tell me about the supply depot you mentioned earlier?

Your response: Can you tell me about the regeneration area?

Your response: Thanks.  That's all I needed to know.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Crahn with us.

NPC: I feel sorry for people who do not let the light of Crahn into their lives.  Please leave now.

NPC: Have you come to receive the wisdom of Crahn?

Your response: Yes!  I wish to cast off my present beliefs and join the brotherhood.

Your response: I think I'm already wise enough, thanks.

NPC: This place in which we stand is but a shadow of its former glory and is not worthy of you.  You must make a pilgrimage to our great church within the Dome.  Only there may you be properly received into the faith.

NPC: May Crahn have mercy on your soul - because I certainly do not.

NPC: Why are you here, my child?

Your response: I felt that I must come here to this place to see it for myself.  Please tell me about what you do here.

Your response: I have come to find out more about the counsil.

Your response: Thank you for your time.

NPC: Our faction office is located here.  There is also a supply depot and a regeneration area.  Remember to keep this place a closely guarded secret.  May Crahn strike you down if you reveal the location of this hidden congregation to our enemies.

Your response: Please can you tell me about the supply depot?

Your response: What can you tell me about the faction office?

Your response: Can you tell me about the regeneration area?

Your response: I will die before I betray Crahn!

NPC: The Resource Supply Manager runs the Supply Depot and provides all a good follower of Crahn will ever need.  You get a 10 percent discount on all goods - use it wisely.

Your response: What can you tell me about the faction office?

Your response: Can you tell me about the regeneration area?

Your response: Thanks for your help.

NPC: The faction office is where the Crahn counsil meets to plan our return from the cold.  We *will* rule Neocron once again.

Your response: What is the faction counsil?

Your response: Can you tell me about the supply depot you mentioned earlier?

Your response: Can you tell me about the regeneration area?

Your response: Thanks.  That's all I needed to know.

NPC: The regeneration area can be used should you require physical healing.  Also remember that we are always here should you require spiritual help and advice.

Your response: Can you tell me about the supply depot please?

Your response: What can you tell me about the faction office?

Your response: What is the faction counsil all about then?

Your response: Thanks for all your information.

NPC: The counsil, under the guidance of Crahn, is working towards removing the City Administration and their puppets from power and reinstating ourselves as the rightful and proper leaders of Neocron.  It is made up of selected members drawn from all clans of the sect.

Your response: Who gets to sit on the counsil?

Your response: What else can you tell me about?

Your response: Thanks for all your help.

NPC: Every Crahn clan has earned the right to nominate a member to sit on the counsil.  A vote is then taken amongst all followers to determine who is subsequently chosen.

Your response: What else can you tell me about?

Your response: Thanks for all your help.

Your response: What is the faction counsil?

Your response: Can you tell me about the supply depot please?

Your response: What else can you tell me about?

Your response: Thanks for all your help.

NPC: Go in freedom.

NPC: Come back when you have the guts to stand up for your beliefs.  You make me sick!

NPC: Who told you about this place?  Why are you here?

Your response: I wish to join the Twilight Guardian and help destroy the corruption within Neocron!

Your response: I wanted to see what you bozos were up to.  Frankly I am not impressed and would not join you if you paid me.

NPC: You have a fucking nerve coming here?  You like repression?  I'm going to repress your ability to breathe...

NPC: Welcome.  How can I help you?

Your response: What can you tell me about this place?

Your response: What can you tell me about the faction counsil?

Your response: Ah, never mind.  Thanks for your time.

Your response: Can you tell me about the supply depot?

Your response: What can you tell me about the faction office?

Your response: The main office sounds important.  What can you tell me about that?

Your response: Can you tell me about the regeneration area?

Your response: Great.  Thanks for the information.

NPC: The supply depot is run by the Resource Supply Manager and sells virtually everything that you will need.  You also qualify for a 10 percent discount.

Your response: What can you tell me about the faction office?

Your response: The main office sounds important.  What can you tell me about that?

Your response: Can you tell me about the regeneration area?

Your response: Thanks for the information.

NPC: The faction office is where you can find the central counsil chamber.  It's where the counsil gather to strategise how to remove the City Admin from power.

Your response: What is the faction counsil?

Your response: Can you tell me about the supply depot you mentioned earlier?

Your response: The main office you mentioned sounds important.  What can you tell me about that?

Your response: Can you tell me about the regeneration area?

Your response: Thanks.  That's all I needed to know.

NPC: The main office is where people who have become tired with the constant abuse, harassment and torture perpetrated by this government come to help put a stop to it.  Prospective new members of the Twilight guardian may talk to recruiters there.

Your response: What is the faction counsil?

Your response: Can you tell me about the supply depot you mentioned earlier?

Your response: Can you tell me about the regeneration area?

Your response: Thanks.  I have no more questions.

NPC: The regeneration area provides medical treatment to our brave soldiers.  A wide variety of medical drugs are also on offer here.

Your response: Can you tell me about the supply depot please?

Your response: What can you tell me about the faction office?

Your response: The main office sounds important.  What can you tell me about that?

Your response: What is the faction counsil all about then?

Your response: Thanks for all your information.

NPC: The Twilight Guardian counsil are the policy makers and commanders of all TG runners and clans.  In order to be effective against the City Admin scum we must communicate and co-ordinate and *that* is the job of the counsil.

Your response: Who gets to sit on the counsil?

Your response: What else can you tell me about?

Your response: Thanks for all your help.

NPC: Each Twilight Guardian clan can choose a member to be elected to the counsil.  All Twilight Guardian runners are then elligible to vote and the winners are duly elected.

Your response: What else can you tell me about?

Your response: Thanks for all your help.
