NPC: Great! I need a helping hand! How does a little action sound?

Your response: Not at the moment...

Your response: Action sounds fun... What is it?

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: We located the mole... He is just a small fish though, and I want you to interrogate, then terminate him. Will you do that?

Your response: Do pigs honk?.. What's the name of the guy and where do I find him?

NPC: I knew you are the right person for the job! Did you off him? What did he say?

Your response: No, he's still alive. He's not the mole.

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: What? But who is it then?

Your response: Bartlett is the mole. And because he wasn't able to find the guy himself, he put up a wrong trail for us.

Your response: Yes, I guess he thought we would just kill him.

NPC: Come back later - I need to think. Until then, you can keep training on your Tech-Combat skills. You will soon have use for your abilities - rest assured of that!

NPC: Who are you and what do you want from me? I don't know you!

Your response: Shut your face! I'm the one asking questions here.

NPC: But I...

Your response: Tell me why you little maggot rat out our smuggling routes! On whose payroll are you?

NPC: W... what? Me? Are you pulling my leg? Who said that? Bartlett, that jerkface? But he's the one who's snitching on everyone just to get a little profit from it. I found out about that mess and that's why he wants to see me dead since weeks. Or what did you think why I am hiding out here where he can't find me?

Your response: So Bartlett is the traitor? And he got Jones to send a bounty hunter after you, because he couldn't find you? A likely story...

NPC: But it's the truth, man!!! Do I look like I am under the protection of some third party who wants to buy my infos?

Your response: Allright already. I believe you. I couldn't stand that ugly bastard anyway.

NPC: Please take care of him. I want to leave this dump, but with him out there, I can't.

Your response: Yeah well, I'm gonna report everything to Jones and we will see what's gonna happen. See you soon...

NPC: Okay, hurry.

NPC: Back already? You can hardly wait to put the lights of that bastard out, right?

Your response: I have to do something else first...

Your response: You can say that again...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Is that blood on your jacket?

Your response: Could be...

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: So the diplomatic way didn't work out, huh?

Your response: You could say that, yes.

NPC: It's okay. That mess needed to be cleaned up. You did a very good job. I wanna give you something as a reward.

Your response: Thanks... I would have killed him for free, though.

NPC: You have proven to be invaluable. That should not go unrewarded. Take this stealth tool... it will surely be of great service to you. Here, take it.

Your response: Wow... thanks, I'm surely gonna have use for that...

entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: You know where to find me.

NPC: Good to see you... Feeling at home yet? I hope you like it. There is a small problem I have to handle and I thought it would be good if I could put your abilities to use here. Can you spare some time?

Your response: At the moment, I am forced to decline.

Your response: Of course I can.

Your response: I don't need your help Mr. Jones, I'm doing fine on my own. Thanks for the offer though!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great... Let me tell you about the problem. Lately, there have been a lot of incursions by a radical society and they are gaining power. We already have the psychos, drug freaks, syndicates, Gentanks, sects and religious fanatics... we can't tolerate radicals right now.

Your response: You want me to wipe them out?

NPC: That is our final goal. We need to find out where they hide first, though.

Your response: And how am I gonna find out?

NPC: A few of your believing friends caught a prostitute from the red light district, who has been trafficking with these radicals. You should interrogate her a little... by force if necessary.

Your response: Okay, I can do that. What next?

NPC: Well... she knows of us and she could talk... make sure that she can not.

Your response: Yeah, I can do that, too. Where to I find the believers who found her?

NPC: There you are. Were you successful?

Your response: Of course.

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: And? What can you report?

Your response: She used to have a punter named Zoid, who has connections to the radicals.

NPC: Hmmm... that's a street name... no normal mother calls her child Zoid. I'll try and find out who's behind that identity. You did a good job. I will have use for you soon again. Until then, you should train your Aggressive Psi-Use abilities... you will surely need those later.

NPC: Argh... who the hell are you sick bastards? What do you want from me... I didn't do nothing wrong...

Your response: I'm asking the questions here. Who we are is none of your business.

NPC: Let me down. Whoever you are, you got the wrong girl!

Your response: I guess we will see about that... I want to ask you some questions.

NPC: Piss off, you sick fuck!

Your response: Tsk tsk tsk... we won't get far that way. You do not mind me giving you a little electric shock to soften that tongue of yours now do you...

NPC: No no, I will tell you everything! I'll do anything you want!

Your response: Much better... what do you know about the radicals, who have been increasing in numbers lately?

NPC: What? Who? I know nothing... I don't know who you mean.

Your response: You're pretty much asking me to hurt you...

NPC: Shit! Please... if... if I tell you... something. They... they will kill me....

Your response: And what do you think I will do if you don't?

NPC: Allright... ...I... there is this guy ...who... he stops by from time to time... has much... much money... and wants really sick... stuff for it... please... please let me go...

Your response: One thing after another... What's his name?

NPC: I can't tell you that... I don't know his name...

Your response: Sorry, but I do not believe you... do I have to... ?

NPC: Allright ...Zoid... people... they... they call him... Zoid... I don't... know anything else, honest...

Your response: See, that wasn't so hard... why make it hard for yourself. Thank you.

NPC: Hey... wait... wait up... I wanna go... let go of me...

Your response: Oh yeah... I entirely forgot... I will tell one of these fine folks to let you down...

NPC: Yeah right... fuck off, you sick motherfucker!

Your response: Goodbye... though I doubt that...

NPC: ... ... ...

NPC: Let me go!!!

NPC: I already awaited you. There is more work. Are you ready?

Your response: Not at the moment...

Your response: Sure thing...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

Your response: Just ask him?

NPC: It wouldn't be bad to start wiping out the group with him first... Come back to me when everything is finished.

Your response: Yes, he was there.

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: And what did he have to tell?

NPC: Very good... now we can finally wipe them all out, knowing where they are.

Your response: Should I do that?

NPC: No, not yet. Let me get some information about their strength first. Until then you should keep training your Aggressive Psi-Use... you should report back in due time.

NPC: Yes? Can I help you somehow?

Your response: Yes, by telling me about the organisation you work for.

NPC: W...what? Who sent you?

Your response: Who sent me is of secondary importance. Primarily, you should be worried about your health and well-being, and tell me immediately where this radical organisation is located.

NPC: Sh... Shit... I... I... didn't do... anything. What do you want?

Your response: Answers... I want answers.

Your response: See, that wasn't that hard.

NPC: G... good... May I go now?

Your response: Oh yes... no, I cannot have you leave, sorry...

NPC: ARGH!

NPC: I told you everything!

NPC: Great. You always appear at the right moment. Can you handle something of smaller scale for me?

Your response: Not right now, sorry.

Your response: I can handle bigger-scaled things, too.

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

Your response: So what should I do?

NPC: You should go in, and go in hard. Kill at least five of them. This, and the previous death of their accountant, should show them who's the boss and that they should pull back on their actions a little.

NPC: You go and do that.

NPC: You look a little beat. I hope you made the corks pop.

Your response: Oh yes... I sure did.

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Great... I hope we will not hear from these suckers for some time. You did a fantastic job. Not that I awaited anything else. Take this APU-Module with my thanks... It will be of good service to you.

Your response: Thanks a lot...

NPC: I now have other matters to attend and wish you good luck. You did a great job for your faction and we will surely meet again...
Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself.
Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Mr. Jones

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at most 25; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• As you wish. Here, take the module. You should keep going for that direction then, to maximize your abilities. I will now leave you to yourself and wish you the best of luck on your way. We will surely meet again.
Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

• Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself.
Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: You know where to find me.

NPC: There you are. You're coming just at the right moment. Do you have the time to do something for me?

Your response: I have other things to do at the moment.

Your response: Yes, I do.

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great. Here's the deal: One of our scientists went missing some time ago. Yesterday, we got a notice by a group who apparently has taken him captive. He is an essential part of our research division and we cannot afford any delays on the current projects.

Your response: And what am I supposed to do?

NPC: The kidnappers didn't ask for horrendous amounts, so we decided to give them what they want. Your job is the delivery of this briefcase.

Your response: And where should I take this briefcase?

NPC: Did you find the contact person and give him the briefcase?

Your response: Yes, I have... he seemed satisfied and said he would let our scientist go.

NPC: Come back when you finished your job!

NPC: What? Wasn't he there and came with you?

Your response: Ahm... no... I just gave him the briefcase. Nobody else was there.

NPC: Damn... we agreed to something different. But let's hope for the best, that they will let our man go anyway.

Your response: I'm sorry, but you didn't tell me that.

NPC: I'ts okay. You didn't know. I'll surely have more to do for you soon. Until then, you should train your Aggressive PSI-Use skills a little. Come back to me later.

NPC: If you don't have something important to say, buzz off.

Your response: Jones sent me to deliver this briefcase.

NPC: Oh... that's why you're here. Very good - Jones made the right decision. Give me the briefcase and his scientist will soon be home free again.

Your response: Here, take it.

NPC: Ah... exactly what we wanted to have. You did your job very good...

Your response: I'm gonna go back to Jones and tell him you received your delivery.

NPC: You do that...

NPC: I guess Jones is waiting..

NPC: Good thing you're back. We have a little situation and I need your help.

Your response: I don't have the time to help at the moment.

Your response: What can I help you with?

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

Your response: And I'm supposed to go in there and get our guy out?

Your response: I think that should be enough. Do I get there with the Nav-Ray too?

Your response: Still there... his leg is broken and he can't move. I'm supposed to tell you, that Zoomer is the kidnapper.

NPC: Come back when you finished your job!

NPC: Lost your key, bastard? So you need to climb over the fence? I told you guys a hundred times now, that I am not gonna break this code - you can break my other leg, it won't help. So piss off!

Your response: Psssst... Jones sent me. I'm here to free you...

NPC: What? Oh son of a - finally! ... SHIT! They saw you... behind you!

NPC: Whew... that was close... I would like to help you, but my leg is broken. The bastards shattered it. So I won't be able to get outta here. Leave me behind and tell Jones, that Zoomer is the head of these kidnappers. He knows who that is. I can't get out here and I think it's better that I still play the prisoner.

NPC: It is time for a swift kick in the ass of some choice people. Are you ready?

Your response: Not yet...

Your response: Sure!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

Your response: He told me that he didn't help them...

NPC: True... that's why he wanted a decoder from us in exchange for our man, he knew of his importance for us. The decoder we gave him can't even handle that much data, which he surely must have noticed by now...

Your response: But then everything's good, right?

Your response: And you want me to do that...

NPC: You look a little shaken... what happened?

NPC: Come back when you finished your job!

NPC: So you killed him. What did he say?

Your response: Besides 'hahaha' and 'hehehe' not much...

NPC: That's too bad... but cannot be changed I guess. You did your job well... we can get our scientist back without a problem and the danger of our data falling into the wrong hands is banished, too.

Your response: Thanks, it was hard work...

NPC: I really have to thank you a lot. You were of great service to your faction and that shouldn't go unrewarded. entries.details:
CONTACT
Inquisitor Kaine

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at least 55; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Armorparts you say? Hmmm, maybe you should visit this guy they call Ol' Dirty Conster, somewhere down in Tech Haven Sec-1. He normally doesn't speak to strangers, but when you mention the password 'Whiskey in the Jar', he will know I sent you. You must excuse me now. The alliance council will want a thorough report on this operation as soon as possible.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Crahn be with you!!

Your response: And with you, my brother!

Your response: Who? What? Where?

NPC: DIE STINKING REZA FILTH!!

NPC: Damn kids... Come back when you've grown up!

NPC: You are not ready yet. Crahn will lead you back here, when you are. Go now.

NPC: Life constantly challenges us. It makes the evolution of our minds an everlasting process. Are you ready for one of these challenges?

Your response: No, I've got more important stuff to do!!

Your response: I am ready, whenever Crahn needs me.

NPC: To believe one could avoid challenges will only lead to a life of lies. Mark my words! May Crahn give you guidance.

NPC: You should better prepare well for this mission and, when in doubt, take brothers and sisters with you. This will be no weekend trip!

Your response: Maybe this isn't my thing afterall.

Your response: I am not afraid and I know enough sons and daughters of Crahn that will be willing to help me!

NPC: You are not ready yet. Crahn will lead you back here, when you are. Go now.

NPC: Every word I speak now was never spoken. If the mission should fail, we will deny you.

Your response: The usual procedure, continue!

NPC: You have doubtlessly heard of a poor lost soul named Regant. In his mindless frenzy he created dreadfully distorted mutants and is now striving to create a new world order. Needless to say that he has to be stopped by any means necessary.

Your response: Regant? Yes, I have heard about him. Only Crahn may decide on the destiny of the world. Regant and his mutants must fall!

NPC: Regant was considered to be dead for ages, until a naive Hacker found his DNA in the Hacknet. We took the chance to revive Regant, hoping to gain access to his immense knowledge and to subdue it for Crahn's use. Finishing his genotoxic experiments could have provided us with everlasting life and health, we had to try it!

Your response: It sounds like things did not turn out the way they were meant to.

NPC: *cough* No, unfortunately not. His body was highly instable, so we conserved him in a special Powersuit. Regant, this insidious rat, secretly took control over this Powersuit and reconfigured it, gaining unseen powers. It seemed like he was giving in and that we had managed to force him to continue his genotoxic experiments for us. We had no idea... right to that day. It was awful... just awful. A massacre! Those that refused to kneel down to him were slaughtered by his mutants with no mercy!

Your response: He killed all of them?

NPC: A handful managed to hide from the mutants, most have fled. They never placed a foot in that laboratory again.

Your response: I understand. And this lab is where Crahn shall lead me to now?

NPC: Exactly! For Crahn and for the whole alliance!

Your response: I see. I will accept this challenge. Where do I start?

NPC: We sent an agent to investigate the current situation in the laboratory, Agent Horatius. But fate is against us. We have not heard from him for over 24 hours. He was meant to meet a contact person, a scientific assistant that claims to have survived the massacre.

Your response: I am therefore ordered to form a group, infiltrate the complex and find Agent Horatius?

NPC: Correct! We desperately need Regant's scientific data. Millions of lives depend on it. If our agent is dead - Crahn bless his soul - you must at least retrieve his datapad and find out what happend!

Your response: Understood, I am on my way.

NPC: One more thing... It might be possible that the military secret service of the CityAdmin is aware of our operations.

Your response: Nice, so we might also get a chance to teach them a lesson. For the Dome!

NPC: For the Dome!

NPC: **The dead, cold body of Agent Horatius**

Your response: - Search body

NPC: **You find an item: Datapad of Agent Horatius**

NPC: **The remains of Agent Horatius**

NPC: Ah, you have returned!

Your response: Yes, but I bring bad news with me. Agent Horatius is dead. There were mutants everywhere. This laboratory is hell on earth.

NPC: What are you still doing here?

NPC: May Crahn have mercy with his soul. Have you found anything else of interest?

Your response: Yes, his datapad.

NPC: Excellent. Maybe his death was not in vain. I will need some time to go through this. Come back later. I will know then how you must proceed.

Your response: I must proceed?

NPC: So where is the datapad then? Don't fail us now, get the datapad!

NPC: Yes, this is far from over!

NPC: There you are again. I have analysed Agent Horatius' datapad. He was about to meet his contact, a scientific assistant named James Denari, but it never got to this meeting. For apparent reasons.

Your response: Obviously.

NPC: We have to find this James Denari and retrieve whatever information we can get. I have no other choice but to ask you to once again return to hell and find Denari in this cursed laboratory.

Your response: I am afraid your right. It has to be done, I am on my way.

NPC: In times like these, Runners like you are the only comfort we have. Good luck, and may Crahn be with you!

NPC: **The body of James Denari**

Your response: - Search body

NPC: **You find an item: Personal Records of James Denari**

NPC: **The remains of James Denari**

NPC: By Crahn, you have returned. Were you successful?

Your response: Depends... I found this James Denari. He was in the same ravaged state as Agent Horatius. But I found his personal records.

NPC: What are you still doing here?

NPC: So many lives terminated, where shall this lead to? May Crahn have mercy with his soul. Let us see through these records and hope that they can tell us where Regant keeps his scientific data.

Your response: Yes, that would be very helpful.

NPC: Where are the records? Stop fooling around and bring them here at once!

NPC: Okay... It will take some time to go through this. Come back later, please.

NPC: Greetings. I have searched the personal records of James Denari and found something that might help us.

Your response: Great, what is it?

NPC: James Denari mentions a laboratory director called Hoffman. If Denari is right, Regant passed his data over to Hoffman, and If we can find this Hoffman, we should be able to ... persuade him to hand the data over to us.

Your response: That should be no problem. Where can I find this laboratory director?

NPC: Denari mentions somehting he calls the prison wing. You and your team will have to search the laboratory and find out what he meant.

Your response: We will!

NPC: May Crahn guard your way. Good luck!

NPC: What? How? OH MY GOD!

Your response: Calm down, Mr. Hoffman. We have no bad intentions.

NPC: I... he... he will find us! All of us!

Your response: Now calm down! We promise to keep you safe if you give us his scientific data!

NPC: Scientific data?? Which scientific data? I have no scientific data! He will kill us all! Or worse...

Your response: Shut up and listen. We know that Regant gave you his data, so stop wasting our time...

NPC: Regant never gave me any fucking data! Never! That's... he's spreading this false information to distract everyone!

Your response: This smells like a trap!

NPC: OH MY GOD! IT'S HIM!!

NPC: Get out of here, Regant is coming. RUN!

Your response: What? Regant is dead!

NPC: You have no idea. Regant's DNA is saved in GeneReplicators - forever! Every time he dies, he comes back just seconds later! He might be caught in here, but he will return soon!

NPC: Finally, where is the data!

Your response: Here it is.

NPC: Brilliant! I am extremely satisfied with your work. Now, what happened?

Your response: Hoffman was a perfidious trap. Regant must have manipulated the records himself to distract us from something. He appeared and attacked us just minutes after we found Hoffman.

NPC: I can't find the scientific data! You must bring it to me!

NPC: But you have returned, does that mean you actually killed Regant?

Your response: Yes and no. We killed him alright, but this Hoffman said that Regant's DNA is stored in an internal GeneReplicator system. Every time he dies, he is resurrected somewhere in the prison wing. He is kind of imprisoned there - in many ways.

NPC: I guess that is good news. Millions of people can be saved thanks to your courage. I will forward this data to our own scientists immediately! You have done your alliance an indescribable service!

Your response: Don't ask what your alliance can do for you. Ask what you can do for your alliance!

NPC: That's right. If only more Runners were like you. I know you are not here for the money, but please, take these 500.000 Credits to cover your expenses.

Your response: Thank you. May I ask one more question?

NPC: Of course!

Your response: I found several unknown Armorparts in the remains of Regant and I have no clue what to do with them.

NPC: Armorparts you say? Hmmm, maybe you should visit this guy they call Ol' Dirty Conster, somewhere down in Tech Haven Sec-1. He normally doesn't speak to strangers, but when you mention the password 'Whiskey in the Jar', he will know I sent you. You must excuse me now. The alliance council will want a thorough report on this operation as soon as possible.

Your response: This unholy paperwork is just never ending, isn't it? Good luck.

NPC: May Crahn be your guiding light, brave Runner.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: You know where to find me.

NPC: Ah, good to see you. How are you? Looked around a little? I have a little job that needs to be done and I do not have the time to take care of the matter myself. Could you do that for me?

Your response: Not right now, sorry...

Your response: What is it, then?

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great... It's about this. We found a hefty lot of old technology below the city and... well... started to dig everything out.

Your response: You're digging below the city for old stuff?

Your response: And now I'm supposed to get it for you?

Your response: Yes, but where is that and how do I get there?

NPC: Just use your Nav-Ray... It will show you the direct way. But be careful down there. There are some creatures who like the warmth and the humidity, but not intruders down there.

Your response: I'll take care. Bye...

NPC: Come back soon!

NPC: You're filthy... was it that bad down there?

Your response: Just some critters. No problem... I have your relic.

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Great, show me... ...hmmm... it's sort of crusty... can't see anything.

NPC: Oh... then I guess I'll hand it down to our lab, they should analyze it.

Your response: Do that... it's probably safer.

NPC: I thank you for your time. I'll surely have more stuff for you to do later. Until then, you should train your Research skills. Then you can soon be of real value for our research division. You have the potential, I think.

Your response: Thanks for the tip... bye.

NPC: Goodbye...

NPC: Who are you? I'm busy. If it isn't important, then buzz off. This area is restricted.

Your response: Jones sent me... I'm supposed to get something for him.

NPC: Jones? What does he want?

Your response: You wanted to give him something, but didn't. Now I'm supposed to get it.

NPC: Oh shit... yes... I entirely forgot. The little relic I found a few days ago. Here, take it. I don't know if it might be dangerous. That's why I didn't touch it yet.

Your response: Thank you. I'll take it to Mr. Jones.

NPC: Okay... Sorry again for the work but we have a lot to do down here and everyone but me called in sick again. You just forget some things over that...

Your response: No worries... Goodbye.

NPC: Goodbye.

NPC: Why are you still here? You have the relic already...

NPC: Good thing you're back. I have something important for you to do.

Your response: I have important stuff to do myself right now.

Your response: Just tell me what it is.

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: It's about the relic you fetched for me. You remember that, right? Well, I wanted to give it to our lab, but they are overworked already, plus they have a vermin problem.

Your response: And what can I do?

NPC: Well, you could make use of your abilities for me and analyze the thing yourself.

Your response: Okay, but how do I do that?

NPC: You need multiple things for that. First, your research tool of course and an empty datacube ... plus you need the item you want to analyze of course. The relic in this case. Then, for higher quality items you need some research substance. You should have a tool and a datacube, and you get the relic from me. You can buy the research substance from any tech trader in the city.

Your response: Okay. And when I have everything, what do I do?

NPC: Then you put first the relic, then the research tool into your processor window and start the process. When it's done, you should get a blueprint from the item.

Your response: I see... and what do I do with that?

NPC: I'm sure you'll manage!

NPC: Hey, there you are. That was quick. Got everything done?

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Great. I really wonder what it could be. You're making yourself really useful. I will surely have use for you again. Keep concentrating on your research abilities, but remember that you also need to be able to defend yourself in the rough world out there. A little training of your combat skills might be in order, too. You should learn how to handle a handgun.

Your response: I'm no big fan of violence, but I'll heed your advice. Thanks.

NPC: You're welcome...

NPC: Welcome and a good day. What makes you come to our little zoo?

Your response: Uhm... I bring you the blueprint of the relic, that...

NPC: Which blueprint do you mean? Do your work first, and then disturb me again!

NPC: ...Ah yes... sure! Jones told me he would send somebody. Give it to me. I'm fed up to take care of these uglies from my colleague over there. If he has no time for them, he should hold less study objects.

Your response: What kind of research do you do he...

NPC: ...Oh! Lots of things. Most of it is critter related... but I don't like them. I rather have lifeless objects... of course you could turn those critters into lifeless ones too, but I think that would break his heart... hehehe...

Your response: Okay, I will go back to...

NPC: ...Yes! Go ahead and do that... with my greetings to Jones. I will give him a call, as soon as I have run the blueprint through our database.

Your response: Then good luck and enjoy...

NPC: Thanks!

NPC: Sorry but I'm busy.

NPC: Great... here you are again. You're just in time. Are you free at the moment?

Your response: Not really...

Your response: Of course...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: I have a report from the blueprint analysation. The relic doesn't seem to be dangerous. It used to draw its energy from a battery, but it is drained since quite some time. So all we need to do is research the battery and see what it does.

Your response: I understand... give it to me and I'll have it researched.

Your response: No problem... what's the worst that could happen?

NPC: Just pay attention and you'll be fine!

NPC: The glow on your face tells me you got it to run.

Your response: If my face is glowing, it's from your reactor. The thing is garbage.

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Why? Show me... what does it do?

Your response: It beeps and the 2D-display says 'feed me'... great, huh?

NPC: Where is the relic? I need that!

NPC: Hmmm... too bad... Who builds such things?

Your response: How should I know? It seems to be worthless, though.

NPC: Yes, I agree... You can keep it. We get a lot of this stuff from our digging sites. You still did a great job. It could have been something special. I don't want to let you go unrewarded and give you this advanced Research Tool... it will surely be of good use to you. If you keep concentrating on your Research skills, you will be able to do a lot with that.

Your response: Thanks, I could never have afforded that.

NPC: No problem. You're welcome - You did a great service to your faction. I now have other matters to attend and wish you the best of luck on your future. We will surely meet again.

Your response: Yes, I hope so. Goodbye!

NPC: Goodbye!
Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: You know where to find me.

NPC: There you are. Does this place feel like home yet? I have a little something that needs to be done and I had you in mind for that. Can you help me out?

Your response: Not at the moment...

Your response: Sure, no problem...

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great... It is about a... well... not entirely legal shipment I am expecting. Nothing special, you shouldn't worry about that. The shipment didn't arrive yet, even though it should have, though. I don't want to wait any longer. Usually, the guy is reliable.

Your response: And what am I supposed to do about that?

Your response: And where do I find him?

Your response: Allright... but how do I get there?

NPC: Use your Nav-Ray system. It will show you the right way. And take a flashlight with you. It is damn dark out there.

Your response: Okay... I will check things out. Bye...

NPC: I am depending on you!

NPC: Man, you're dirty. I hope you didn't get lost down there?

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: The guys down there are all a little nuts. Never mind them. The new route, huh? Hmmm... not many people know it. I will have that checked. Thank you. I will get back at you later. Until then, you should train your Barter skill, so you can get real good prices at haggling later.

Your response: Thanks for the tip... see you.

NPC: See you too.

NPC: Yo hey... whassup, man?

Your response: Um... Jones sent me...

NPC: Word... what's he want?

Your response: He's looking for a shipment which should have reached him by now, but didn't. He said you could know where it is?

NPC: Shit man, no go. My buddy took the new route and not the old one as always, but he been disappearing. Jones should know where that is. Always the same... let him look after the guy himself.

Your response: You being his buddy he sure doesn't seem to be much of your concern, huh?

NPC: Piss off and deal with your own probs! Kiss my ass, man!

NPC: Great - you came at the right moment. Can you spare some time?

Your response: Not right now...

Your response: Of course...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

Your response: ...That I should go to to look for him...

NPC: Could you find anything out?

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Oh crap... I will do that immediately. Did you talk to him?

Your response: Yes, I did... he said, his boss mugged him and took the shipment.

NPC: His boss, yes? Hmmm... I guess I need to think some things over. Come back later, and I will have further jobs for you. Since you might have noticed that it can be essential to be able to defend yourself, you should train your combat abilities a little.

NPC: *cough* *cough* ... who... who are you? Did you... come to finish the job? *cough*

Your response: Finish? No... Jones sent me... he's been looking for you since quite some time.

NPC: He is a little *cough* too late for that. I'm dying here and I *cough*... don't think anything can stop that...

Your response: But what... what the hell happened?

NPC: My boss... the dirty maggot... *cough* he mugged me and... *cough* took everything... *cough*... he could never stand me... but... but I didn't think it would go *cough* ...this far...

Your response: Jones mugged you here?!?

NPC: *cough* ... Bull! Not Jones... he is... allright *cough* ...I meant the boss of the smugglers...

Your response: And he has the shipment for Jones now, yes?

NPC: If... if... he didn't... sell them... to someone, he should still *cough* ...have them...

Your response: And what should I do now?

NPC: Shit, how should I know *cough* ... go to... Jones and tell him... he will know *cough* what... what to do. Now... *cough* piss off... and let me... die in peace... nothing ... *cough* will help me now... anyway...

Your response: One could come to believe you want to die. I'll go to Jones, he will send you help.

NPC: Argh... yes, man! Do whatever you want...

NPC: It's payback time. Are you ready for that?

Your response: Not yet...

Your response: Yes, I am...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

Your response: Allright... I'll be more than happy to 'handle' the situation...

NPC: I'm trusting you!

NPC: You look a little beat... had some problems?

Your response: I guess you could say that... I had to kill the bastard and half of his ugly crew, to get your delivery back.

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Hmmm... serves the bastard right. Unfortunately, my buyer for the goods took off.

Your response: What's that supposed to mean? I did all this for naught?

NPC: Uh... no... of course not. You showed your faction your value and your abilities. I don't want to leave that unrewarded. Just keep the delivery and sell it yourself. Plus, I want to give you this bartering implant. It increases your Barter skills...

Your response: Yay... thank you... that's a nice recompensation for the trouble.

NPC: I hope so. You can get that implant put in by a runner, just ask around. It shouldn't be hard to find somebody who can do that. You should also keep training your barter and combat skills. You saw how rough the world out there can be.

Your response: I'll do that...

NPC: I have to say goodbye for now. Other people await me. We will surely meet again though.
Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

NPC: *belch* ... who are you supposed to be and what do you want?

Your response: A shipment you have in your possession...

NPC: What kind of shipment? Not doing anything at the moment...

Your response: And what about the shipment you took from your man yourself which was destined for Mr. Jones?

NPC: Hehehe... oh THAT shipment. No problem *smack* ... here, take it, and say hello from me... hehehe...

Your response: Uh... well... thanks...

NPC: You're welcome... hehehe...

Your response: I'll uh... go back to Jones then. And tell him you said hello...

NPC: You're not supposed to say hello to Jones from me...

Your response: What? Who else then?

NPC: Hehehe... to the devil, you stupid naive little brat! Did you really think I would just let you waltz in and outta here?!? GO BOYS!!! There's a bug to squat here!

NPC: Get lost! You have no business here!

NPC: What next?

NPC: Get help for me, damn!

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: You know where to find me.

NPC: Ah, there you are. Got a feeling for your new home yet? I have a little problem you could help me solve.

Your response: I don't have the time right now.

Your response: Then tell me what it is.

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: A strange killer is on the loose lately. He takes girls from the streets and soon after they are found dead in the canals. Things cooled down for a bit, but now new corpses were found and many girls are missing.

Your response: And what should I do about that?

Your response: Will do, but how do I get there?

NPC: Just use your Nav-Ray system. It should show you a direct way. But be careful when you go down there. Many things are nesting there that don't dare to enter the streets.

Your response: I'll get by...

NPC: I'm relying on you!

NPC: You stink like you have been down there very long. Did you find anything?

Your response: As a matter of fact, I did... I found a womans body and she had a note with the word 'Starlet' on it in her hand. Know anything about that?

NPC: You did not finish your mission!

NPC: I have no idea, but I will do some research. You did a good job and I will soon have use for you again. Until then, you should train your Heavy Weapon skills. You have seen how important it can be, to be able to defend yourself.

Your response: Okay, thanks for the tip... I'll do that.

NPC: Very good.

NPC: (You search the body and find a note with the word 'Starlet' on it.)

Your response: Hmmm... maybe Jones knows something about that...

NPC: Just in the right moment. I have more stuff for you to do.

Your response: Not now...

Your response: What is it?

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: It's about the word you found on the note from the womans body. 'Starlet' is the name of a prostitute from the city. I want you to visit her and question her. She will know more.

Your response: Where do I find her?

NPC: That was quick. Did you find Starlet?

Your response: Yes, that and much more.

NPC: You did not finish your mission!

NPC: Then don't make me drag it outta your nose and tell me already.

Your response: It's not one single killer but an entire group. They are the Inquisitors, who pull girls from the streets. They have some kind of central here.

NPC: Yes, I heard of those. Dangerous people... I'll see if I can find out where they are. In the meantime, you should keep training your Heavy Weapons skills... come back later.

NPC: Hey Baby, how can I do you?

Your response: At the moment, you could tell me why a dead prostitute in the sewers had a note with your name on it in her hand.

NPC: What? But... how... you found Claudia? She's dead, too? Oh fuck... shit...

Your response: Yes, she is, I'm sorry. But please tell me what you know so this stops!

NPC: I... I can't... they will kill me...

Your response: Who will kill you, Starlet? Tell me, please...

NPC: These religious nutcases... they catch us, ask us questions about some bullshit and then they kill most of us... or worse...

Your response: What religious nutcases?

NPC: The Inquisition nutcases... oh... shit... now see what you did... here they come... they watched us... they will surely kill us... Damn!!!

Your response: We'll see who will kill who...

NPC: Get 'em!!

NPC: Damn... that was close... you're pretty strong...

Your response: Just doing my job. So these were the Inquisitors?

NPC: There are still some alive!!! Help me!!!

NPC: Yes, they have a central somewhere here... where they gather and take their prisoners and stuff...

Your response: I'll go to Jones, he will find something out. Thanks for the help and... good luck...

NPC: You're so strong!!! Thanks!

NPC: I told you everything!

NPC: Are you ready to kick some asses?

Your response: Maybe later...

Your response: That sounds like fun...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

Your response: And now I am supposed to go there?

NPC: Exactly... go there and kill some of these sons of bitches. That should show them who is the boss, and after that, they will hopefully leave the girls alone. I doesn't look good when bloated bodys swim around everywhere.

Your response: It will be my pleasure to massacrate the bastards.

NPC: Then go there and do it!

NPC: Ah, there you are. Did you do as I told you?

Your response: Yes, I offed the wankers.

NPC: You did not finish your mission!

NPC: Very good... I didn't expect anything but good work from you. You really paid off. I thank you... Your work shouldn't go unrewarded. Your response: Wow... that's like birthday... thank you.

Your response: Thanks for everyone and goodbye.

NPC: Good bye, and take care.
Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

NPC: END

entries.details:
CONTACT
Electric Vibes Club Manager

POSSIBLE COST
• 500 credits (depends on choice)

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at least 40; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Good, we understand each other! Well. There's this guy who keeps bothering our girls after work. They say he cuts them off somehwere in the sector and feels them up. Unfortunately, our guys couldn't find that little rat yet. Maybe you'll get lucky.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Hey, Chummer. Nice to see you again. Unfortunately I don't have anything left for you to do. And please remember, thanks to your VIP pass you will get a free beer at the bar!

NPC: What do you want? Heh, you're still green behind the ears! Come back when you got some skills, Chummer!

NPC: Hey Chummer, how you doing?

Your response: What do you want from me? Leave me alone!

Your response: Aight. Sup?

NPC: Hey, hey. Relax...

NPC: Party all night long, as you can see. How do you like our new dance club?

Your response: Pretty sweet. Was about time the Red Pepper Entertainment finally got off their asses and established this nice club.

NPC: Well you know these bureaucratic asswipes with their agreements and deals. Nowhere safe from them!

Your response: Hell yeah! But let me ask you something. Got a job for me?

NPC: Hmmm, yeah now that I'm thinking of it, I have something you could do for me. You'd have to get your hands dirty, in case you have a problem with that.

Your response: Dirty hands like 'beat the guy up' or 'send him over the Jordan'?

NPC: Heh the Jordan thing is good, I'll have to remember that one. But yeah, that's what I'm talking about.

Your response: Nah thanks. I'm fine with beating somebody up, but killing someone... find somebody else.

Your response: Hey, that sounds like my thing. Tell me more!

NPC: Hmm, okay. As you wish. In this case I don't have anything for you. Check again later, I may need your help someday. But I gotta get back to work now, cya Chummer!

NPC: Ok, but you know the rules. In case they catch you, I don't know you and have never seen you before. Just to be clear!

Your response: Hey, man. I'm a pro! Go on.

NPC: Good, we understand each other! Well. There's this guy who keeps bothering our girls after work. They say he cuts them off somehwere in the sector and feels them up. Unfortunately, our guys couldn't find that little rat yet. Maybe you'll get lucky.

Your response: Yep, a nice job for me. Any idea what this guy is called?

NPC: His name is Jock Hardwood. A real slimy bastard. Our girls say he always waits until they are out of sight of the club to jump them. I'd say it's best you hide somewhere around the backdoor of the club and try to spot him. If you manage to find him... make short work of the pig. We don't discuss with bastards of his kinds. If you mess with our girls you bite the dust!

Your response: Gotcha. I'm off to hunt.

NPC: Oh yeah, bring me his DogTag as proof you really killed him. You can find me here. Good hunting!

NPC: Ah, there you are. Catch that rat?

Your response: Nope, not yet.

Your response: Yeah, was pretty easy. That guy was a whimp. Looks like he needed to pick on women to feel like a big dog. Either way, he's history now.

NPC: What the hell are you doing here? Get out of here and kill the damn guy already!

NPC: That's what I thought. Do you have his dogtag as proof?

Your response: Yep I have it. Here you go. Careful, there's still some of his blood on it!

NPC: Nice work, chummer. I'm very pleased.

Your response: Well I am a pro! So what do you have for me?

NPC: Umm you don't have the dogtag on you? Are you trying to make a fool outta me? Come back when you have the dogtag!!

NPC: Good work should be paid well. Here's 10000nc. I have another job for you, if you have the time!

Your response: No, not at the moment.

Your response: Hmm, I've got nothing to do at the moment. What's up?

NPC: The whole thing is kinda tricky and needs some sensitivity.

Your response: There's nothing I can't fix. Tell me more!

NPC: Hey Chummer! Good to see you. Got some time? I have another job for you.

Your response: Sure, what do you need?

Your response: I'm busy at the moment.

NPC: We have this dancer that refuses to do her job. Problem is, she's kinda irreplaceable. Guys totally dig her! We need someone to talk her into getting back on stage.

Your response: Well, that shouldn't be a problem. What's her name and where can I find her?

NPC: She's called Sin and she should be hiding out in the back in the changing room. Make sure you're extra sensitive! We can't afford to lose her. I trust you get this done. Come back when you convinced her to get back to work.

NPC: WHAT DO YOU WANT FROM ME? GET LOST! I'M ANGRY!!!

Your response: Hey lady, calm down. I don't bite!

Your response: Ey! Don't yell at me like that, damnit!!!!

NPC: I SAID LEAVE ME THE HELL ALONE!!!

NPC: Ok ok!! One may be angry once in a while! *sniff*

Your response: Ah look at that, she can talk normally. So what happened to you?

NPC: *sniff* It's this damn pig! He keeps grabbing me and my boss won't even take me seriously and do something against it!!

Your response: Who keeps touching you?

NPC: Well this disgusting, fat guy! He lurks in the streets around the club and assaults us when we go home after work!

Your response: Err, any chance the guy's name is Jock Hardwood?

NPC: YES! That's him!! The pig!! *sniff*

Your response: Hey, I can assure you that guy won't ever be molesting dancers again!

NPC: How? Why? I bet he's already waiting for me!

Your response: No, he's not. Your boss hired me to take care of the guy. He's done assaulting women!

NPC: So you uh, killed him? I can't believe it!

Your response: Well if I tell you, you can believe it. I waited for him to show up and ended his pathetic life when he did!

NPC: Ohhh. That's wonderful! This pig has really been getting to us. We were almost too scared to go outside! So our boss hired you to do this?

Your response: Yes he did. He was worried that you were unable to focus on your work because of this bastard. But that topic's closed now!

NPC: Right! Wow, I'm so happy this guy is finally gone! I feel much better now! Thanks for everything!! I'll get right to work. Excuse me for now, I've got to change!

NPC: Ah, there you are. Sin let me know that you motivated her to dance again. But I still don't know why she was that upset?

Your response: The bastard that was harassing your dancer got to Sin. But she seemed to do much better once I told her that pig won't ever bother her again.

NPC: Hey, Sin still doesn't want to work! Come back when you've convinced her!

NPC: You that's what I thought. Well, seems to be in order now. I'm very satisfied with you.

Your response: Thanks. So what about a reward?

NPC: Sure! You're worth every NC! Here's another 5000nc. I even have another job for you, if you have the time.

Your response: I have to take care of a few things first. I'll get back to you.

Your response: Thanks. So what do you need done?

NPC: As you wish. I'll be here when you're ready.

NPC: Hey, Chummer! Good to see you back! I have something that you could take care of! Got some time?

Your response: Sure, what's up?

Your response: I don't have time at the moment.

NPC: There's this one guy that hasn't paid his tab yet. Could you take care of it?

Your response: Sounds easy. Want me to blow his brains out?

NPC: Nono, no killing this time. Just convince him it would be much better for his health if he takes care of his tab as soon as possible.

Your response: Alright, where do I find this guy and what's he called?

NPC: His name is Gerry Claymore, he should be somewhere in the club. But like I said, I don't want any trouble inside the club. So please be cautious. Come back when he's paid up.

NPC: Huh? What do ya want? *hicks*

Your response: You had a few drinks too many, eh?

NPC: WHAT DO YOU CARE? *hicks*

Your response: Stay calm. What made you drink like this?

NPC: Bah, you don't wanna know! Nobody wants to know crap like that!

Your response: I wouldn't be asking if I didn't want to know. Besides, drinking isn't your only problem. These guys are getting impatient because you still haven't paid your tab.

NPC: My tab... oh damn. I'M COMPLETELY BROKE!! Why do you think I'm getting wasted like this?? *hicks*

Your response: Hmm well that's not good. Why are you broke?

NPC: Oh, that's a ling story. *hicks*

Your response: Tell me. Maybe I can help you get out of this situation.

NPC: You wanna know what my problem is? WOMEN!! My wife packed her bags and left for Neocron City with some prettyboy! Of course she cleaned out my accounts and took any items of value with her. I'm so poor! Damn bitch!!

Your response: That is in fact a problem. Anyways, I just wanted to let you know that you'll leave the club with a few bumps if you don't pay your tab.

NPC: Oh damn. But what am I supposed to do? *hicks*

Your response: Well, looks like today is your luck day. I'll give you the money. I can't take watching your misery any longer.

NPC: You'd really do that for me? You don't even know me! I won't be able to pay you back either! Nobody could be that selfless! *hicks*

Your response: Do you want to help me or not?

NPC: Yes! Yes please. I'll shut up! I'd be really thankful if you would do this for me.

Your response: How much do you owe?

NPC: Err, should be about 500nc. Yeah. It's 500nc. *hicks*

Your response: Man, getting wasted for 500nc. I don't wanna know what your blood alcohol is at. Good, here's your'e 500nc. I'll tell my boss that you'll be paying the bill as soon as possible. Don't dare to spend it on more drinks. I'll come back and break your bones!

NPC: I swear! I'll pay my tab when I leave!! Thanks so much! I owe you a favor!

Your response: Yeah, sober up first. Well I gotta get going. Got more stuff to do. Take care!

NPC: Aight, take care!

NPC: *hicks*

NPC: Hey, you're back. So, did you take care of everything?

Your response: Hi, yes it's done. The guy is completely wasted. That's why I gave him the money for his tab. I couldn't watch his misery any longer.

NPC: Come back when you're taken care of it!

NPC: You gave him the money for his bill? Respect, you managed to avoid a potentially explosive situation in the club. I'm completely satisfied with your performance.

Your response: Thanks. Always doing my best.

NPC: Here's another 5000nc as reward for all your efforts. I'm also pleased to give you this 'Electric Vibes Club V.I.P. Pass'. You'd usually have to pay a bundle for this, but in your case it's the least I can do.

Your response: Hey, awesome. I really like your club too. I think I'll come by pretty often.

NPC: That's what we like to hear. Don't think I want to get rid of you now, but I still got a whole lot of stuff to do. Stick around for a while and enjoy the atmosphere. Take care, Chummer.

NPC: Alright. Come back when you can.

Your response: Nope...

Your response: Don't know much about that...

Your response: *click*

Your response: *click*

Your response: *click*

NPC: NO! I like them, except their poo... They are majestic, wonderful creatures! You have to clean the Sector.

Your response: Reward sounds amazing!

NPC: It's not a big deal, %PLAYER_NAME(), but it's all I can give...

Eli

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Delivery Bag
• Glass
• Metalplate
• Milky Ren
• Processor
• Sin Soda
• Small Hydraulic Parts
• Wood

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Delivery Bag
• Milky Ren
• Sin Soda

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Chloe, the Store manager at Crytons in Plaza 1 needs 10 Milky Ren and 10 Sin Soda!
Nikol at Snack-a-Tack (Plaza Sector 1) has prepared it for you, talk to her!

• Laura, the store manager of Flowers & Pottery (Plaza Sec 3) needs our help.

• You know Tech Haven?

• Ages ago scientists, who worked practically as slaves for the PSI Monk government, escaped their laboratories and into the wastelands.

• There, Tech Haven was built. An ever-growing underground complex for the technocrats to freely and independently research new ways of making life under the harsh conditions of this post-apocalyptic world easier for everyone.

• In 2633 a number of 62 men and women left Neocron and are led by Thomas Cooper, who founded the Fallen Angels in the Wastelands.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: We have no more work for you but I hear your faction needs a runner to complete some tasks for them. Once you've helped your faction you could also go and speak to Peter on the 3rd Floor here.

NPC: Talk to Jonathan first!

NPC: Before you can work for me, you have to work for Alesha!

NPC: Hi Runner! Want a job?

Your response: Fuck you!

Your response: If you pay... Yes!

NPC: Wanker...

NPC: Then you're right here.

Your response: Great. Tell me something about your Job-offer.

NPC: Let's start with easy things... You're prepared and ready to go?

Your response: Sure!

Your response: Never mind. Maybe it's better for me to hunt the Roaches down in the sewers...

NPC: Bye.

NPC: Very Good. One of the Store managers called me, they need some stock for their store and their staff.

Your response: Ya...?

NPC: Chloe, the Store manager at Crytons in Plaza 1 needs 10 Milky Ren and 10 Sin Soda!
Nikol at Snack-a-Tack (Plaza Sector 1) has prepared it for you, talk to her!

Your response: Chloe needs Food and Drinks? You're kidding me?

NPC: No! Get it and take it to Chloe!

NPC: You're %PLAYER_NAME()? I've been waiting a long time...

Your response: Yeah, now I'm here...

NPC: Where is the food? Where are the drinks? You should talk to Nikol at the Snack-a-Tack shop!

NPC: Okay, chop chop, I need my order!

Your response: - Give 10 Milky Ren -

NPC: I need at least 10 Milky Ren!

NPC: The Soda?

Your response: - Give 10 Sin Soda -

NPC: I need at least 10 Sin Soda!

NPC: You saved the day, %PLAYER_NAME()! It's so important to feed our staff...

Your response: Ya, sure...

NPC: Again, thank you! Talk to Eli for your reward!

NPC: Eli is waiting!

NPC: Hey, you're here for the Snack Delivery, right?

Your response: Yes, Eli sent me!

NPC: Okay, I prepared it for you. Just give me the money and it's yours.

Your response: Okay... How much?

NPC: 1.000 credits, just for you!

Your response: That is way to expensive! I could buy it by myself for less money!

Your response: Sure, sounds like a great deal!

NPC: Then over here with the money!

Your response: *** Give Money ***

NPC: Without credits, nothing happens here!

NPC: Great, take your stuff and make Chloe happy!

NPC: Well, it was worth a try... 600 credits and it's yours, this is my last offer!

Your response: Deal!

NPC: Then over here with the money!

Your response: *** Give Money ***

NPC: Without credits, nothing happens here!

NPC: Chloe is waiting!

NPC: You're done?

Your response: Yes! Easy peasy job!

NPC: Chloe is waiting!

NPC: Awesome news, %PLAYER_NAME()! Come back in a few moments, there is much more to do!

NPC: Ready for another job?

Your response: I'm in!

NPC: Good to hear! Let's start...

Your response: Go ahead!

NPC: Laura, the store manager of Flowers & Pottery (Plaza Sec 3) needs our help.

Your response: You mean my help? What is it?

NPC: Laura needs 10 Wood, 3 Glass and 10 Metalplates!
You can find those stuff in wooden crates & metal boxes!

NPC: Heyho! You got my order?

Your response: Of course!
- Give 10 Wood -

NPC: I need at least 10 Wood!

NPC: The Glass, please!

Your response: - Give 3 Glass -

NPC: I need 3 Glass!

NPC: Finally, the Metalplates please!

Your response: - Give 10 Metalplates -

NPC: I need 10 Metalplates!

NPC: Good Job, %PLAYER_NAME()!

Your response: You're welcome! But please tell me, what do you want with Metalplates, Glass and Wood?

NPC: Take a look around! We're Flowers & Pottery. Everything is handmade: Pot plants, the crystal decorations, everything! And of course, we need material for that!

Your response: That explains a lot!

NPC: You can customize your apartment with these beautiful flowers! You can also add cabinets and other furniture as well!

Your response: Hey, cool! Then I can replace my shitty table!

NPC: Only if you placed the shitty table! Everything in your starting apartment is fixed, so you can't move it! But you can buy another apartment and customize it or add furniture to your starter apartment!

Your response: *click*

NPC: There are several offers from furnished to unfurnished apartments you can buy! Unfurnished apartments start with only a GeneReplicator in them, nothing else!

Your response: *click*

NPC: And you can decide which size and location you want - of course it depends on your money!

Your response: I don't have that much...

NPC: You will earn some money! Speaking of which, you have to return to Eli for payment!

NPC: Time is money! Return to Eli!

NPC: Ah, you're back - right on time!

Your response: Indeed, Eli! Can I get my reward now?

NPC: Laura is waiting!

NPC: A job well done, %PLAYER_NAME()! I heard Jonathan needs some help, maybe you want to check...

NPC: Ahh, you're back! Ready for the last part of the job?

Your response: That's why I'm here!

NPC: Great!

Your response: Okay, what do I have to do?

NPC: You know Tech Haven?

Your response: Not very well...

NPC: Ages ago scientists, who worked practically as slaves for the PSI Monk government, escaped their laboratories and into the wastelands.

Your response: *click*

NPC: There, Tech Haven was built. An ever-growing underground complex for the technocrats to freely and independently research new ways of making life under the harsh conditions of this post-apocalyptic world easier for everyone.

Your response: Tell me more!

NPC: In 2633 a number of 62 men and women left Neocron and are led by Thomas Cooper, who founded the Fallen Angels in the Wastelands.

Your response: *click*

NPC: In the mountains north of the city they began to establish their new home, Tech Haven.

Your response: *click*

NPC: To protect themselves from radiation, they built the city underground.

Your response: *click*

NPC: An impressive building built by man! If your faction is not hostile to the Fallen Angels you should visit and discover Tech Haven!

Your response: Sounds amazing!

NPC: Indeed! Okay, back to business! Time is money, %PLAYER_NAME()!

Your response: Okay, what I have to do?

NPC: In Tech Haven you can find Tech Stores, they're out of stock. They need some materials.

Your response: Okay...

NPC: I will give you a package for them. Go to Tech Haven Sec 2, find Guinan and give her the package - It's urgent!
Sneak in using the North Entrance (F_07) if you want to avoid getting spotted by the guards.

NPC: You're here - Right in time!

Your response: - Give Delivery Bag -

NPC: %PLAYER_NAME(), we need the materials, we're out of stock!

NPC: Oh my gosh! This is not enough!

Your response: That's the bag Eli...

NPC: I'm telling you: It's not enough! I need more!

Your response: Calm down... What do you need?

NPC: Calm down? You're new to this business, %PLAYER_NAME()? It's all about money and items!

Your response: Sorry... Tell me what do you need...

NPC: Okay... I need 2 Small Hydraulic Parts and 5 Processor!

Your response: Erm, ya... Where I can get it?

NPC: Tech Haven has several Energy Cores, kill mechanical monsters, loot them and bring me the right stuff!

NPC: Go, go, it's urgent! The Hydraulic Parts, please!

Your response: - Give 2 Small Hydraulic Parts -

NPC: You need a dictionary to understand the word 'urgent'? I need 2 Small Hydraulic Parts!

NPC: Go, go, it's urgent! The Processors, please!

Your response: - Give 5 Processor -

NPC: You need a dictionary to understand the word 'urgent'? I need 5 Processor!

NPC: Finally, you did it! You can tell Eli he's an idiot - no more mistakes!

Your response: I will...

NPC: I don't want to bother you, %PLAYER_NAME() but I have refill the shops now! You should return to Eli!

NPC: Chop chop, %PLAYER_NAME()!

NPC: Hey %PLAYER_NAME() you're back! Great building, he?

Your response: I have no words to express the pride I feel for the people who built this!

NPC: Guinan needs the package!

NPC: I told you...

Your response: Ya, you did! By the way, Guinan is pissed - there was not enough in the package! I had to kill some mechs, so I could give her everything she needs!

NPC: That explains her evil Mail... Never mind! It's time to reward you!

Your response: Those are the words I've been waiting to hear!

NPC: The Store managers were thrilled with your work! They gave me something extra for you! Have fun with this amazing stuff, %PLAYER_NAME()! May we meet again!

Your response: Glad to hear!

NPC: We have no more work for you but I hear your faction needs a runner to complete some important tasks for them. Once you've helped your faction you could also go and speak to Peter on the 3rd Floor here.

entries.conversation:
NPC: I'm pretty busy right now, sorry. Please leave me alone.

NPC: Before you can work for me, you have to work for Quinn (Job Center).

NPC: Hey, it's you... You restored our communication systems, well done! Looking for some more action?

Your response: Ya, I need something to do.

Your response: Sorry, just passing by. Cya.

NPC: Have a productive day!

NPC: You helped us a lot by restoring our communication systems, we're now able to communicate again with our away teams.

Your response: Yeah, heard so.

NPC: We've lost someone out there...

Your response: Oh my... My condolences!

NPC: Thanks, but I hope we'll get him back, with your help.

Your response: Excuse me?

NPC: No worries, I don't need a field medic. I need something more specific.

Your response: *click*

NPC: His GenRep pattern is saved somewhere in the system, we need that to 'revive' him.

Your response: So you want me to hack the GenRep system?

NPC: Don't be silly, it's the most secured system, you'd have no chance.
The security would kill you instantly before you'd have hacked the first layer at all.

Your response: Okay... What than?

NPC: As you may know, you can use the GenRep system to travel very fast, of course it costs you credits and your brain is suffering from it.

Your response: My brain???

NPC: Yes, you will have synaptic impairment after using the GR for a while, nothing to worry about.

Your response: *click*

NPC: The only exception is, when you uuse the GR to an outpost your clan is holding.

Your response: Why only there?

NPC: I assume it's a security thing, that you can't ambush innocent runners in no time, but who knows...

Your response: So we just have to accept it?

NPC: Yes.
But let's talk about your assignement.

Your response: Sure, go ahead.

NPC: Like I said: We've lost Bryce. We need him back! He's the key to our success.

Your response: Okay, but how?

NPC: There is one hacker, who was able to hack the system. You have to convince him to help us!

Your response: For me it's impossible to hack the system, but not for him? You're going to underestimate me!

NPC: Just trust me, I know what I'm talking about. Find the hacker and convince him to help us - Are you in?

Your response: Ya, sure, why not... Where can I find this hacker?

NPC: He's at the Eastgate Factory. Find him and bring us the pattern!

NPC: WHAT?

Your response: Calm down... Jessica sent me!

NPC: Who? Ahhh, I don't care!

Your response: Hey, wait. We need your help - badly!

NPC: That's where you live at the end of the world and people are still bugging you... What is it you want?

Your response: Sorry to bother you, but it's really important!
We've lost a colleague, Bryce, we need him back, well his GR pattern...

NPC: Oh boy... Once I did that and now people asking me for this crap... Why should I help you?

Your response: We're going to purge the world. We want to erase the evil!

NPC: I'm pretty happy here...

Your response: Maybe we can find something you would like to have?

NPC: The only stuff I would like to have: hookers, money, drugs and rareparts.

Your response: Bringing a hookers here could be very difficult...

NPC: I can take care of my needs myself. Let's talk about rareparts, a ton of.

Your response: A ton? C'mon... Let's be fair! It's an easy job for you, and a big deal for us.

NPC: Like you said... You need it, not me.

Your response: Okay, how many parts we're talking about?

NPC: 100.

Your response: Are you insane? I could torture you to do what I want - for free! Re-consider your offer!

NPC: No need to threaten me... 50.

Your response: Trust me... I've all the stuff on me to hurt you.

A knife to cut your throat at the end, a bucket to water-board you...
And that's only the soft stuff.

I don't think I have much more patience.

NPC: Okay, let's say 3 Parts, 2 L and 1 E, just because you seem to be very poor!

Your response: That sounds a bit more fair.

NPC: Come back when you have those.

NPC: Fast. I like it.
Hand me over the L Parts, please.

Your response: - Give 2 L Parts -

NPC: I want 2 L and 1 E Parts!

NPC: Now my E Parts.

Your response: - Give 1 E Part -

NPC: I want 1 E Part!

NPC: There you go. Take the pattern and don't bother me again. Bye!

NPC: I said: DO NOT BOTHER ME EVER AGAIN !

NPC: Finally, you're back! You got it?

Your response: You're still underestimating me... Sure!
- Give pattern -

NPC: Don't come back without the pattern! Without this our project is doomed to fail!

NPC: I have no words... I'm just impressed! You did it!

Your response: Thanks...

NPC: We're a big step further to achieving our goal, thanks to you! Maybe we'll meet again! Bye!

NPC: We produced enough LoM Pills, I don't need you now. Maybe Tamara in the Job Center has some work for you.

NPC: Before you can work for me, you have to work for Eli (Job Center).

NPC: You're new here? What's your name?

Your response: Yeah. Just came back from Area MC5. My name is %PLAYER_NAME().

Your response: That's not your business!

NPC: Calm down, idiot..

NPC: So, you're looking for a job, %PLAYER_NAME()?

Your response: Yeah..

NPC: Good to hear! We need some materials for a new type of LoM Pills.

Your response: LoM Pills?

NPC: Loss of Memory Pills. You don't know them?

Your response: No...

entries.details:
CONTACT
Julian

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Package with Drugs

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Key for NExT 2WD Chaincraft 'Ranger'
• Package with Drugs

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: more than 29; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• I'm looking for a more experienced runner for this job. Complete Normal missions from a Citycom in Pepper Park and come back when you reach rank /30.

• In the Outzone Sec 1 shopping area. Kill that bastard 'Smokey Clumpy' and bring me his stuff!

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: I'm looking for a more experienced runner for this job. Complete Normal missions from a Citycom in Pepper Park and come back when you reach rank /30.

NPC: You again? Good job last time, but there is nothing you can do for me at the moment. Maybe Eli in the Job Center has some work for you.

NPC: Before you can work for me, you have to work for good old Peps (Job Center).

NPC: You have a creepy face..

Your response: You need a mirror?

Your response: Fuck off!

NPC: You're welcome, honey!

NPC: Snappy. I like that! You need a job?

Your response: Indeed. Peps send me.

NPC: Ahhh, good old Peps!

Your response: Oh ya...

NPC: Okay, back to business. I have a problem with some guys. They owe me money.

Your response: Okay...

NPC: Look. They owe me money, but they don't want to pay it back. They need to be taught a lesson!

Your response: Meaning?

NPC: Snappy, but not smart, fine.

Your response: Hey!

NPC: Calm down... they're drug dealers.

Your response: Guess I don't want to know the details...

NPC: You're right. Can you keep a secret?

Your response: Sure!

NPC: Me, too!

Your response: What the hell?

NPC: It's easier to tell the truth to the CopBots, you just have to know that I want their stuff!

Your response: Their stuff?

NPC: Yes. Their stuff. Their drugs.

Your response: And how can I help you with that?

NPC: You're really not that smart... You have to steal it!

Your response: Okay - where?

NPC: In the Outzone Sec 1 shopping area. Kill that bastard 'Smokey Clumpy' and bring me his stuff!

NPC: Before you try to talk: kill Smokey Clumpy!

NPC: Fuck off!

Your response: I just want to...

NPC: Shut up and DIE!

NPC: You killed Smokey Clumpy?

Your response: What do you think? Of course I did!

NPC: MC5 totally erased your brain? Kill Smokey Clumpy and take his drugs, I want them all!

NPC: Gimme the drugs!

Your response: - Give drugs -

NPC: My drugs...?

NPC: Good work.. I'm a little bit impressed...

Your response: A little bit...?

NPC: Never mind. You did it, great job! You should talk to Eli for another job, I think he needs an errand running out in the wastes, this old vehicle key should help.

Pierre

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Before you can work for me, you have to work for Peter (Job Center).

NPC: Hey there! Peter told me you would come some day - Happy to see you now!

Your response: Just passing by, sorry, no time!

Your response: I assume you have a job for me?

NPC: Bye...

NPC: Well, the building is called 'Job Center', of course I have a job-offer for you!

Your response: Enlighten me.

NPC: Peter already told you we have to purge the world, let's continue the plan!

Your response: Okay, what do I have to kill now?

NPC: I need you to get stuff from someone - Call it a delivery job.

Your response: Oh? Thought I would've to kill!

NPC: Nobody said you have to think... Are you in or not?

Your response: Sure, what is it you need?

Your response: That's far away!

NPC: Get out in the wastes and get my package or get lost, decide yourself!

Your response: Sure thing, I'm doing it!

Your response: I'm not ready for it... Maybe later!

NPC: Good for you - And for me of course... Go and get my package!

NPC: You're %PLAYER_NAME()? I've been waiting a long time...

Your response: Yeah, now I'm here...

NPC: You want the package, right?

Your response: Yeah, my boss is waiting for it, so hurry up!

NPC: You have the payment?

Your response: Payment?

NPC: Sure! Your boss still has to pay for it - 1 million credits!

Your response: No way, are you insane?

NPC: No, I'm a business man, you got the cash or not? No money, no package - easy as it is!

Your response: Of course not! But I could punch your face?

NPC: Try and my security systems will hunt you down in less than 2 seconds.

Your response: Okay... Maybe you need something else? I do not have a million credits laying around!

NPC: There is one thing...

Your response: Yes?

NPC: Like I said: I'm a business man, and those Warbots around are disturbing my business here by killing innocent customers...

Your response: And?

NPC: If you kill a few, I'll hand you over the package!

Your response: Sounds fair, how many corpsed do you want?

NPC: Kill 20 Legacy Warbots and we're even!

NPC: Ahhh, you're back, nice!

Your response: Sure. Not a big deal for me to kill some crappy Warbots!

NPC: You know what to do! Kill 20 Legacy Warbots!

NPC: There you go, here's your package. Maybe we meet again some day. Bye!

NPC: You got your package, now leave me alone!

NPC: Finally, you're back!

Your response: If you paid your bills it would've been faster...

NPC: Don't come back without my package!

NPC: Oh... I missed that... Sorry!

Your response: Ya, sure... Let's talk about my payment, or have you missed that as well?

NPC: On the contrary, I've prepared your payment! With this you can decorate your apartment, explore the wastelands... Whatever you like!

Your response: So, hand it over...
