entries.title: Wasteland Scenario - The Missing Scientist
entries.description: Quest-related dialogue from the game files.
entries.details:
CONTACT
Dr. Hartmut Grottenheimer

POSSIBLE COST
• 20,000 credits (depends on choice)

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at least 40; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Well, well. To start with I would try Lillian Lundqvist, she is an old friend from the NEXT academy. I can not tell you her exact whereabouts, but she used to run a survival camp in sector E_03, near Regants Legacy. Don't know why but she likes nature. With a bit of luck she will have a NEXT Prototype Advanced Navigation System v2.03 beta, without which I don't even have to start working.

• In sector E_12, a junk dealer that goes by the name of Isaac Ramsey. I am absolutely positive that he has the parts, but I doubt he will give them away for free. I guess he will want a couple of credits.

• Knuckles has done his best to organize a NEXT Prototype Advanced Sensor System v1.05 beta. He made a deal with a former NEXT colleague of mine, who promised to place the ASS in a spare part box in the Wastelands. Can you find it for me?

• The Wastelands are pretty big, you got some co-ordinates?

• Oh, of course, sorry. Blackmist Garbage Dump in sector F_09. Might be tricky to find it under all that smelly dirty trash... But you're a pro, aren't you?

• There is a lot of gossip, probably because Tangent is trying to confuse people until they find him. The only confirmed news I got is that he was sighted by a surveillance drone in sector J_04, near the Battledome.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Hi, nice to see you again. I hope you are having fun with your Assault Quad. Unfortunately I am seriously busy. Bye.

NPC: Hi kid, school work done? *laughs* Serious now, come back when you've grown up.

NPC: That multifractional compensationmatrix is fluctuating far stronger than it should. Hmm? Guess I will have to optimize the coherent hybdridsiliconcell. Now that might just solve the problem? *muttering*

Your response: Pardon me?

Your response: Got some business to take care of, please excuse me.

NPC: Oh, what are you doing here? KNUCKLES!! We have an infiltrator!

Your response: Calm down Doctor. Knuckles let me in, no reason to panic.

NPC: Well, if you say so. But I hope you have not been talking about this lab!

Your response: Me? No way, I know what top secret means. Besides, I am a customer of yours.

NPC: A customer you say? So you fell in love with her too? No wonder, my baby is so gorgeous!

Your response: Baby? If you are referring to the Quad, then YES. I am very interested in buying one of your babies.

NPC: Normally no problem at all. It's just...

Your response: What?

NPC: Well, I have run out of several parts to produce new vehicle keys. At the moment I only have one copy of the prototype. The NEXT prototype itself I had to destroy.

Your response: So you weren't taken hostage or something?

NPC: Bright little kid! Of course my leaving had to look like I was taken Hostage or vanished due to family affairs. NEXT would have never let me go, greedy as they are. All those years of hard work, and then they wanted to keep 95 percent of the profit!

Your response: I guess I would have done the same. Or maybe not? Whatever, is there any way to get those parts for you?

NPC: You would do that for me? Well, I could ask a couple of friends. There are a couple of hobby-engineers that may have what I need.

Your response: How does this sound for you: I get the parts, you make a key for me. Deal?

NPC: Hmm, the sooner I get the production running again, the more I can improve the production cycle. Ok, we have a deal!

Your response: Sweet. Where can I find your contacts?

NPC: Well, well. To start with I would try Lillian Lundqvist, she is an old friend from the NEXT academy. I can not tell you her exact whereabouts, but she used to run a survival camp in sector E_03, near Regants Legacy. Don't know why but she likes nature. With a bit of luck she will have a NEXT Prototype Advanced Navigation System v2.03 beta, without which I don't even have to start working.

Your response: Ok then, I'm on my way.

NPC: Well, well. Good luck kid.

NPC: Hey Chummer! What do you think you're doing here?

Your response: I think I'm looking for you!

NPC: Then I hope you're not looking for trouble, too!

Your response: Not at all. Does the name Dr. Grottenheimer ring a bell?

NPC: Sure! Hartmut, old numbercrack. Those were the days... Why, is he ok?

Your response: Fit as a fiddle, but he needs your help. He sent me to fetch a NEXT Prototype Advanced Navigation System v2.03 beta, hoping you have one handy.

NPC: A NEXT Prototype Advanced Navigation System v2.03 beta? Now that's a bit of luck. I have a couple of those in my storeroom for a project of mine. For a couple of credits it's yours.

Your response: Please define 'a couple of credits'

NPC: Well, it's priceless in the open market, but since it's for Hartmut I could give it to you for 20.000nc!

Your response: That's quite a load of 'a couple of credits'. I hope it's worth it...

NPC: Sure. Ready to transfer?

Your response: Here you are.

NPC: Thank you very much. And here is your ANS.

Your response: Excellent. Been a pleasure, Lady.

NPC: You are no good with numbers, are you? Come back when you have the 20.000 Credits!

NPC: The pleasure was all mine. Please send my love to Hartmut, if he wants to drink to the good old days he is welcome any time!

Your response: I will, take care.

NPC: Take care, Chummer

NPC: Sorry, I am pretty busy right now. Don't let Hartmut wait too long!

NPC: Ah, he has returned! And, have you found Lillian?

Your response: No, not yet I'm afraid. But I will give it another try.

Your response: Of course. She was very pleased to hear from you.

NPC: Oh well, you know where to find me.

NPC: I am very glad to hear that. Have you got the part, too?

Your response: Sure. One ANS, as ordered

NPC: Outstanding! That should keep me busy for a while.

Your response: Where do I find the next part?

NPC: Where? Don't tell me you lost it! I can't do anything until you bring me that part!

NPC: Next is a NEXT Prototype Advanced Hybrid Engine and a NEXT Prototype Advanced Hybrid Energy Capacitor X-15. Luckily I know a discreet source for both.

Your response: And where would that be?

NPC: In sector E_12, a junk dealer that goes by the name of Isaac Ramsey. I am absolutely positive that he has the parts, but I doubt he will give them away for free. I guess he will want a couple of credits.

Your response: A couple of credits, great. I'm off then.

NPC: Nice, and I will immediately start with the Navigation System.

NPC: Customer! A customer! Come here, come come! Not many customers come out this far. What can I do for you?

Your response: I am looking for a couple of vehicle parts and I was told that you might have them on sale.

NPC: Really? And exactly who recommended me?

Your response: Dr. Grottenheimer

NPC: Oh, the old Doc himself! I thought had vanished mysteriously...

Your response: That he did. Let's put it this way, he preferred to become self-employed and is setting up his own business now.

NPC: Really? Mr. Mysterious, well I never... So what do you need?

Your response: Like I said, I need two special vehicle parts.

NPC: There is nothing old Ramsey hasn't got! *shows off*

Your response: Even a NEXT Prototype Advanced Hybrid Engine, a NEXT Prototype Advanced Hybrid Energy Capacitor X-15 and both without questions?

NPC: The last bit is no problem, you can have that for free! The other two... hmm... let's see... *searching here and there* There they are! Just where I put them. They are the last two, lucky you. Well then, let's talk numbers.

Your response: Let me guess, you are happy with a couple of credits each?

NPC: Don't worry. I can tell by the way you're dressed that you haven't got much. For a friend of the doc... let's say 60k for the engine and 45k for the capacitor.

Your response: WHAT? That's a bloody fortune! No room for bargaining?

NPC: That is as low as I can go, sorry. I could easily make twice as much on the black mar... who's that? OH NO! Not them lot again!!

Your response: What? Who?

NPC: Shit, them bloody sewer rats have been after poor Ramsey for weeks. Please help me! I'll pay you with the parts you wanted!!

NPC: Puh, that was close. They nearly had me then, I tell you!

Your response: Who the hell were they?

NPC: Them bandits are sent by... oh no! There's more of them, quick!!

NPC: Them bastards are henchmen from a rival junk dealer! Jack Widows, this old son of a bitch! He's been ganging up with some outlaws or something. But they were no match for you, I'm impressed!

Your response: Nothing a skilled runner can't handle. So what's with the parts?

NPC: Right! You've really deserved them, they are yours! For 50k.

Your response: I beg your pardon? You said I would get them as a payment for cleaning up here!

NPC: I did? No way, that I would surely remember...

Your response: Well you'd better, before I get Jack Widows to refresh your memory!

NPC: You wouldn't dare to!

Your response: You have no idea what I dare to.

NPC: *Sighs* All right, damn it. Here they are. For FREE! But don't tell anyone, that would ruin my reputation as an honest business man!

Your response: Nothing to fear there... I'm discreet by nature! *coughs*

NPC: Where have I heard that before? Damn memory... Now get lost, I have plenty of other things to do. Next time Jack Widows shows up, I'm prepared!

NPC: Go away, I have better things to do!!

NPC: The kid is back, great. Any luck with the parts?

Your response: Indeed. Got my fingers dirty getting them though.

NPC: Yes, Isaacs place is pretty dirty.

Your response: Poor Ramsey has a dirty neighbourhood, too. Had to take care of three local henchmen that were after him.

NPC: I am glad you were there to help him, not many honest businessmen like him around. You are tougher than you look. Now, can I have the parts?

Your response: Sure, here they are.

NPC: Outstanding! I will get straight to work, why don't you take a break?

NPC: It appears you only have one of the parts. I need both to continue my work.

NPC: No, that's not them. Come back once you found them.

NPC: Just in time! Just in time, kid. I have finished all modifications, now we can get to the actual construction process of Combat Quad Keys. I nearly have everything for that here...

Your response: ... what do you need?

NPC: Knuckles has done his best to organize a NEXT Prototype Advanced Sensor System v1.05 beta. He made a deal with a former NEXT colleague of mine, who promised to place the ASS in a spare part box in the Wastelands. Can you find it for me?

Your response: The Wastelands are pretty big, you got some co-ordinates?

NPC: Oh, of course, sorry. Blackmist Garbage Dump in sector F_09. Might be tricky to find it under all that smelly dirty trash... But you're a pro, aren't you?

NPC: That was quick. And, found it?

Your response: No, not yet. I am still working on it.

Your response: Yes, here it is.

NPC: Would you please hurry up a bit! I have other things to do, too

NPC: Outstanding! That was one major step to building the key.

Your response: Was that it, or do you need anything else?

NPC: That's not it! Come back once you found it!

NPC: For the weapon system we need a Tangent Technologies Prototype Vehicle Weapon BIOS v1.003 beta and a Tangent Technologies Prototype Targeting System v2.55 beta. Tough to get, but not impossible.

Your response: I'm listening.

NPC: One of Knuckles informants found out that a Tangent Technologies supplier is missing. He was supposed to deliver parts for a weapons testing program...

Your response: So he might have had some prototype systems with him?

NPC: Absolutely, they couldn't test anything without those parts. It is just a matter of finding him before anyone else does.

Your response: Let's not waste time then, where is he?

NPC: Knuckles is in touch with the informants, he has all the details.

Your response: This Knuckles seems to have good sources.

NPC: Indeed, he is the man for special operations. He used to work for NEXT, too. Convincing other scientists and engineers to change their employer. Plus the whole process of getting them a new identity, you know how ungrateful Corporations can be.

Your response: Sure do. Ok then, I am on my way again.

NPC: Good luck!

NPC: Oh hi, you're coming and going, aren't you?

Your response: Yea, trying to get some parts together for the doc. What can you tell me about the missing Tangent supplier?

NPC: Excuse me, I am really busy right now.

NPC: There is a lot of gossip, probably because Tangent is trying to confuse people until they find him. The only confirmed news I got is that he was sighted by a surveillance drone in sector J_04, near the Battledome.

Your response: I'll start there then, thanks.

NPC: No problem, take care mate!

NPC: **A Tangent Technologies Supplier body, dead and cold**

Your response: **Search body**

NPC: **You find two vehicle parts**

NPC: **Nothing**

NPC: You've made it, great!

Your response: No, sorry. Coulnd't find him yet, I'm afraid

Your response: I found the parts, and maybe the guys that ambushed the transport. Pretty well equipped for bandits...

NPC: Oh no, I hope the parts are ok.

NPC: Puh, they look fine. I guess the driver would be glad to hear that, poor soul. Well then, I have everything to construct the Quad keys now.

Your response: Sweet. When can I test drive it?

NPC: Didn't you say you found the parts? Where are they? Come on kid, I need those two parts!

NPC: I'm pretty busy right now!

NPC: Good bye!

NPC: **A regular spare part box**

NPC: **You find a vehicle part**

entries.details:
CONTACT
Knuckles

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: This is a private property. You've got 30 seconds to get the hell out of here, or I'll give you hell.

Your response: I must have taken a wrong turn, please excuse me.

Your response: Calm down, I got to see Dr. Grottenheimer!

NPC: Ehh, you again! It was a pleasure to work with you. What can I do for you, Chummer?

Your response: You won't believe it but I broke that lovely quad already *looksashamed*

NPC: 29... 28... 27...!

NPC: There ain't no such Dr. Grotten... whatever! 20 seconds...

Your response: Stop fooling around, I know he's here

NPC: For the last time kid, that Doctor isn't here! 10 seconds...

Your response: So that's the way you want it... How about I go pay NEXT Systems a visit, tell them about this nice little private property of yours.

NPC: Uh... Ok, whatever. Seems like you two have some business of your own to take care of. The passage to the lab is right behind the wooden panels, they're only holograms. But I warn you! One word about this and I will personally break every single bone in your body.

NPC: You did what? Jeeez, I always say don't drink and drive!

Your response: I know, I know! But is there a way to get another key? I love this Quad and need a new one quickly!!

NPC: Well, the Doc is too busy to build a new one for you right now. But maybe I am able to help you out. The Doc gave me some keys for later use. I could hand over a new key to you if you bring me the needed parts. Though a problem will be to get your hands on this parts.

Your response: But I guess you already have a solution for this?

NPC: Well, not a real solution. Rumors say that NEXT already used the parts for the Quad in the past. You won't believe for what.

Your response: I have no clue!

NPC: Hoverbombers.

Your response: Hoverbombers? You're kidding me!

NPC: Do I look like I have a sense of humour? Yes, Hoverbombers. I am not sure how NEXT is involved in the construction of these tech beasts but you could give it a try. Shoot some from the sky and see if they have any of the needed parts.

Your response: That won't be that easy but I will give it a try. I'm desperate for a new quad! What parts do you need for a new key?

NPC: You will need to find a Advanced Navigation System v2.03, a Advanced Hybrid Engine, a Advanced Hybrid Energy Capacitor X-15, a Advanced Sensor System v1.05, a Weapon BIOS v1.003 and a Targeting System v2.55. Come back to me when you got all parts. And do not forget to bring me your old Quad key. I'll be waiting here for you. Don't let me wait too long.

NPC: Ehh, there you are. Do you have all parts?

Your response: No, not yet. I'll be back in a few.

Your response: Aye, here you go.

NPC: Ok, but hurry up a bit. I got things to do..

NPC: Ahh, very good. You seem to have all needed parts. Lemme see, where are all my keys. Ahh, here you go.

Your response: Awesome, dude. Can't wait to get my quad back!

NPC: You don't seem to have all needed parts. Remember, you need a Advanced Navigation System v2.03, a Advanced Hybrid Engine, a Advanced Hybrid Energy Capacitor X-15, a Advanced Sensor System v1.05, a Weapon BIOS v1.003 and a Targeting System v2.55. Come back to me when you got all parts.

NPC: You're welcome. Now leave me alone. I got things to do!

• This job will be slightly more dangerous as it will involve going to Pepper Park. I need you to go to Club Veronique in Pepper Park 1 and speak with Mr. Lomax, he will tell you more.

• No questions! Take this package to Brute in Pepper Park 3.

entries.conversation:
NPC: You again? Good job last time, but there is nothing you can do for me at the moment.

NPC: Hey there, are you here about the job vacancy?

Your response: Erm... yes, that's why I am here, could you let me know what I need to do?

Your response: No, I am not here for a job.

NPC: Fine then. Piss off.

NPC: Excellent. So, if you read the job description, you'll know we are looking for a runner to help transport cash from our stores to our deposit box inside the NCPD HQ.

Your response: Okay, sounds easy enough, what do I need to do?

NPC: Okay. So, first of all I want you to go to the seafood store in Plaza 2 and speak with Frank, he will pass you the cash box, you will need to give him this data cube.
Note the cash box is a secure unit so do not try and open it or it will explode.

Your response: So then I take the box to the NCPD HQ?

NPC: Yes. If you take the lift upstairs you'll find the deposit box. Make the drop then come see me for payment.

Your response: Okay, I'll be off then.

NPC: Great! Go for it!

NPC: Who are you and what do you want?

Your response: Hi Frank, I am here to pick up the cash.

NPC: Hey, keep it down, the walls have ears you know... pass me that Datacube...

Your response: - Give Datacube -

NPC: You don't have the Datacube with you! Come back when you have it!

NPC: Okay, everything seems to be in order. Take this to the NCPD HQ.
Make sure you don't speak to anyone on the way. There's a lot of cash in that box and a lot of greedy bastards out there who'd love to take it!

Your response: Okay Frank, you can trust me.

NPC: Hurry up!

NPC: Take the cash box to the NCPD HQ - NOW!

NPC: Thank you for your deposit. Please take this receipt.

NPC: *** ERROR ***
Cash box required to proceed!

NPC: *** SESSION TIMEOUT ***

NPC: You're back...

Your response: I have taken the cash box to the NCPD as requested - here is proof.
- Give receipt -

NPC: You didn't bring the receipt? Are you kidding me?

NPC: You should visit the deposit box!

NPC: Excellent, please take these credits as payment. Come back to me if you want another job.

NPC: Ah, I see you are ready for your next job. Excellent. Now listen carefully.

Your response: I'm listening!

NPC: This job will be slightly more dangerous as it will involve going to Pepper Park. I need you to go to Club Veronique in Pepper Park 1 and speak with Mr. Lomax, he will tell you more.

Your response: Can't you tell me more about the job at hand?

NPC: No, I cannot risk other Runners overhearing our conversation.
If you are concerned for your own safety we should part ways now. There are plenty of other runners who need cash and are willing to take risks.

Your response: Calm down, I never said I didn't want the job. I will go and meet with Mr. Lomax.

NPC: Very good!
Go find Mr. Lomax!

NPC: Yes?

Your response: I am here for the job, Robert sent me.

NPC: About time. Listen carefully...as there has been an...incident I need you to go to the Bum Asylum and speak with Wolfgang. When he speaks to you, respond with the phrase 'Our business is your pleasure'.
Speak to him only and no-one else and don't go snooping around in there. The Tsunami won't like it and you will get yourself shot. Once you obtain what I want you're to bring it straight to me.

Your response: Understood, will do.

NPC: Hurry up! Wolfgang - Bum Asylum!

NPC: I repeat: Wolfgang - Bum Asylum!

NPC: What do you want, scumbag?

Your response: Wherever you go, go NExT!

Your response: My pleasure is your pleasure!

Your response: Our business is your pleasure!

NPC: You should talk to Mr. Lomax first!

NPC: Get the hell outta here! NOW!!!

NPC: Get the hell outta here! NOW!!!

NPC: No questions! Take this package to Brute in Pepper Park 3.

NPC: Enough talking! Take the package to Brute in Pepper Park 3!

NPC: Excellent, the package! Fine, take that damn box. Those Tsunami pricks have no idea who they are messing with.
Say... you don't look like much to me - how about you give me that deposit box back and I don't cut your throat!

Your response: No way!

NPC: You have no appointment with me, go away!

NPC: DIE!

NPC: Okay, okay... Go back to Mr. Lomax...

NPC: Okay I see you got some balls on you, not bad. Those Black Dragon pricks managed to kill the Runner who was supposed to deliver it the first time around, so we intercepted their drug delivery. Fair's fair, right? Now - take this to Robert.

Your response: I almost got killed for this box...

NPC: You know what to do... Meet Wolfgang in the Bum Asylum!

NPC: Yeah? Well, shit happens. Tell that fat bastard Robert to make sure he pays you well.

NPC: Robert is waiting!

NPC: Nice work, yes, very nice work! Now don't worry I don't expect you to take this to the NCPD. This money needs to go in with the laundry first; it has Tsunami stink all over it.

Your response: Wait, you're telling me this is dirty money?

NPC: You know what to do... Meet Mr. Lomax!

NPC: What did you think, Einstein? Stop being such a pussy and take your reward.
Come back if you are man enough for more work.

NPC: Back for more?

Your response: That's why I'm here, what do you need me to do?

NPC: Okay, I need you to go to Outzone sector 1 and take care of some business for me.

Your response: What type of business?

NPC: Speak to Martin, you will find him on the basement level near the shopping area, he will tell you more.

Your response: What is the best way to get to Outzone sector 1?

NPC: Take the subway to Outzone station and when you go to the ramp take a right, you can't miss it.

NPC: 'Sup dude?

Your response: Are you Martin? I am here for the job.

NPC: Right. I need you to locate the Yo's store manager Roy and find out why he's not been paying his weekly protection fees. Speak to him first and if he's not compliant use this baseball bat.
First work on his fingers, then his toes and then... well... use your imagination - I want at least one month's protection money from this prick.

Your response: Consider it done.

NPC: Do not bother returning to me without his cash box.
Give him this ID, so he knows you're my guy!

NPC: What can I do for you Sir?

Your response: Well, first of all you can answer a simple question. Why have you not been paying your protection money to Martin?

NPC: You have no appointment with me, go away!

NPC: Oh shit... Guards! Come deal with this fool.

NPC: Oh my...

Your response: So you thought you could hire the Black Dragon to take care of things? How about you give me two months protection up front for my trouble - or me and Mr Bat here will show you the error of your ways.

NPC: GUARD - Take that prick down!

NPC: Okay! Okay! I'm sorry! Jeez take it all just don't hurt me.

NPC: Please don't hurt me!

NPC: So did you deal with the issue?

Your response: Yes, Roy hired Black Dragon to look after this store, I dealt with them and they won't be coming back.

NPC: What's wrong with you? Find Roy and bring me my cash!

NPC: Excellent, I hope you took extra protection money from that prick...

Your response: I only took what was asked, here's what you asked for.

Your response: Yes, here is two months' worth.

NPC: Bah, I suppose it will have to do. Go speak to Robert for your reward.

NPC: Where is my cash box?

NPC: Great! Hand it over... now go see Robert for your reward.

NPC: Where is my cash box?

NPC: See Robert for your reward!

NPC: Martin told me you did a great job dealing with those Black Dragon wankers!

Your response: Thank you!

NPC: You know what to do. Go to Martin!

NPC: Take this reward for the job. Well done.

NPC: Take this reward for the job. Well done.

NPC: Black Dragon are causing more issues with our shop keepers and I think I know who their ring leader is.
He is called Jerome and he is working his way up the Black Dragon ranks.

Your response: Okay...

NPC: I want you to go to Pepper 2 and find a hooker named Gabbie, I want you to go to town on her with a baseball bat - that will get his attention, those two are an item you see.

Your response: Okay, though don't you think that's a little harsh? She's probably just as scared as the shop keepers were.

NPC: Fine, fine, okay... Go speak to her, threaten her, give her drugs whatever you like. Just find out where Jerome is staying and then kill him. Either way; get the job done! Mr. Lomax will pay you!

NPC: What do you want?

Your response: I hear you know where Jerome is staying?

NPC: Hey sweetheart...

Your response: I hear you know where Jerome is staying?

NPC: Maybe I do, what's it to you?

Your response: Listen bitch, I am not here to mess around. Tell me where he is or I will shove this bat so far up your ass you will be shitting splinters for a week.

Your response: I hear you like White Flash. How about I get you some and you tell me what I want to know?

Your response: How about a few thousand credits for the info?

NPC: *** Gabbie whistles ***

NPC: Please don't hurt me. Jerome is at the food place in the Pepper Park subway. Please leave me be.

NPC: Okay, get me at least 5 vials - and not the cheap stuff either! Go and get it!

NPC: Jerome is at the food place in the Pepper Park Subway

NPC: 5 vials or no information!

NPC: Jerome is at the food place in the Pepper Park Subway!

NPC: I want at least five thousand credits! Go and get it!

NPC: Jerome is at the food place in the Pepper Park Subway!

NPC: I want five thousand credits!

NPC: Jerome is at the food place in the Pepper Park Subway!

NPC: Who's disturbing?

Your response: Okay Jerome, before I kill you I just wanted to let you know that Robert sent me!

NPC: You have no appointment with me, go away!

NPC: Oh did he now? I can see you mean business and I could do with a man like you on the team. Tell you what... how about a counter offer?

Your response: Go on...

NPC: How about I pay you twice... no, three times as much as Robert is offering if you go back to Robert and shoot him in the face...

Your response: What, in front of the cops? You gotta be kidding right?

NPC: I never said it would be easy, but it will be worth it... plus I can set you up with some good quality drugs, not like the shit the shop keepers sell. Whaddya say... buddy...

Your response: No, fuck off and die!

Your response: Okay we have a deal. I will kill Robert; but it better be worth one hell of a fucking cash bonus.

NPC: Your choice! DIE!!!

NPC: GO AWAY!!!

NPC: Oh trust me it will be...
Go kill that bastard! And bring me evidence!

NPC: You did it?

Your response: Sure! What did you think?

NPC: So is it done, did you kill him?

Your response: No, he's very much alive - unlike you.

NPC: Go, kill Jerome!

NPC: You have evidence?

Your response: Sure! There you go!

NPC: Where is my evidence of killing Jerome? I want his DogTag!

NPC: Great! Go, find Mr. Lomax for your reward!
Give him this pad, so he knows you deserve the reward!

NPC: Mr. Lomax is waiting!

NPC: Son of a bitch...

NPC: GO AWAY!

NPC: Is it done?

Your response: Yes of course, now where is my reward?

NPC: Go! Finish Robert and bring me his DogTag!

NPC: Mr. Lomax will pay you, I have a deal with him...
Give him this pad, so he knows you're my guy!

NPC: Find Mr. Lomax for your reward!

NPC: You killed Jerome? Impressive!

Your response: Sure! What did you think?

NPC: You've killed Robert? Interesting!

Your response: Well... Money wins...

NPC: You've not finished your task, yet!

NPC: You deserve this reward, Robert told me!
Have a nice day!

NPC: Sure...
Here, take this, plus this bundle of drugs as a bonus!
Jerome told me you deserve it!

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

• Enh. 7.62mm Sniper Rounds

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at most 25; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• I'm sure about that. We will surely meet again sometime. Keep training your Rifle Combat Skill, and soon, you will be one of the best. Till then: good luck.
Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

• Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: You know where to find me.

NPC: Ah... nice to see you. Great. Could you spare a moment? I have something that might interest you. And it is a little urgent, if you catch my drift.

Your response: I'm very sorry. I don't have time for you right now.

Your response: What do you want, Mr. Jones?

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Well, this is my concern: I am appointed to do a little job for our faction and I require the proper... tools for the job. You're supposed to help me acquire these tools, since I have other matters to attend.

Your response: And what exactly are we talking about here?

NPC: Just tell him that I sent you and that the canaries sang too much again. He will know what's the deal and hand you the tools I need.

NPC: Good luck.

NPC: Back I see - that was quick. I knew we decided on the right person. Did you fetch me what I need?

Your response: Yes, I have the gun right here in this briefcase...

NPC: You do not have the kit with you. Come back when you have completed your task successfully.

NPC: Great, great. Um... but how do you know there's a gun in the briefcase?

NPC: Apparently. It seems to be the time to look for somebody else I can trust better.

Your response: Oh yes. He said, that things would get too big for him and he wants double his usual fee next time.

NPC: Bastard. The list of people I need to... deal with just seems to get longer and longer.

Your response: Maybe I could help you out?

NPC: I'm sure you could. If I may say so, though: train your Rifle Combat skill - you will surely need it later.

NPC: Who are you and what do you want from me?

Your response: My name is of no importance. Jones sent me. I'm supposed to tell you that the canaries sang too much again.

NPC: Allright then. Tell him that things are getting way too big for me. I don't want to get involved into this any further. If Jones needs an unmarked gun again, tell him he should either look for someone else or pay me much more moolah.

Your response: A gun..? ...uh... yes... sure. - I'll tell him

NPC: Good. And now, get lost.

NPC: Didn't I tell you to get lost?

NPC: Back again, I see. Marvelous. As if you could read my mind. I have work for you. You're supposed to do some laundry. Unfortunately, this time, it's a bit dirty. Understand?

Your response: At the moment, all my time is consumed by my own laundry.

Your response: Yes, I do understand. So who is this about?

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great. You remember the gun you fetched for me? I will give it back to you. Just for your own protection, of course. There is a tiny problem I wanted to solve. Unfortunately, some problems cause other bigger problems. As in this case.

Your response: Get to the point...

NPC: We had to get rid of a former co-worker of our faction. Unfortunately, there has been a witness - his name is Mike Carson. And witnesses have this unfortunate habit to talk. So we need to make sure that he will not be able to talk anymore. The man is hiding now though, and we have not yet been able to seek him out.

Your response: And how am I supposed to find him?

NPC: If you would just let me finish. Money can open many doors, and we have lots of money. Luckily for us, people are corrupt. One of Mike Carsons Bodyguards has agreed to give us his current location, if we pay him enough for it.

Your response: And now I am supposed to get that information, right?

NPC: Exactly. And about that payment... use your discretion... hehehe...

Your response: Got that. Where do I find him?

NPC: Nice to see you again. Is that blood on your jacket? Hmmm... I hope you were thorough, at least.

Your response: As thorough as the situation warranted.

NPC: Come back when you are finished.

NPC: Come back when you are finished.

NPC: Great - that's how I like it. So, where is Carson hiding?

Your response: I don't know. My contact only knew the codename that he uses now.

NPC: Then you did the right thing by eliminating him. I loathe people who fail to keep meet end of a bargain. Whatever - just tell me what Carsons codename is.

NPC: Thanks, it shouldn't take me too long to find out where he is. Now, if you would be so kind to give me back the gun I gave you. Only for your own protection - of course.

Your response: Too bad, I just started to get used to this baby.

NPC: Can I help you?

Your response: But the deal was that you tell me his location, not his codename.

NPC: It doesn't matter. I just don't know his location. But his codename never changes, and your employer will have the necessary resources to find out where he is located.

Your response: I certainly hope that, because he will not be able to send me to you ask you again.

NPC: What... why are you carrying a gun... the deal included... son of a bitch!!!

NPC: There you are again. Sooner than expected, but not too soon. Are you ready to help out your faction a little?

Your response: At the moment, I have a few other matters to attend.

Your response: I think I already know what this could be. I'm ready.

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

Your response: Of course. Where do I find him?

Your response: No problem.

NPC: I'm really starting to like you. You might soon go all the way to the top. Trust me. Here, better take that sniper rifle again. It served you well the last time, didn't it? Good luck.

Your response: It was easy pickings...

NPC: Come back when you are finished.

NPC: No need to be humble. You did a great job. Unfortunately, other matters call for my attention. You were worth everything, and I do not want to leave that unrewarded. Here - take the gun. I cleared it for permanent usage and you can keep it.

Your response: Thanks, I will put it to good use.

NPC: I'm sure about that. We will surely meet again sometime. Keep training your Rifle Combat Skill, and soon, you will be one of the best. Till then: good luck.
Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

NPC: Now you die!

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself.
Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: You know where to find me.

NPC: Nice to see you. Can you spare some time and do a little work for me? It would be very important to me, and time is short. And even if you are pretty new to our faction, you seem to be the right person for the job.

Your response: Right now, I have other matters to attend.

Your response: Sure, just tell me what you want, and I'll do it.

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great. Okay, this is the problem. And old friend of mine got me something that is not easy to acquire. I am a little worried about him though. It is not something you can get the legal way and I have lost contact to him days ago.

Your response: And you want me to check if everything is okay?

NPC: Yes, that would be great. I've known him for a long time, and he has always been reliable. I'm afraid he could be in trouble.

Your response: Okay, I will see what I can do.

Your response: He's fine. He hopes that you will be able to visit him soon.

NPC: Your job is not done yet.

NPC: Great. But what was that delay about? Did he even have what I wanted from him?

Your response: He gave me a sword for you. And the reason for the delay was, that some other people wanted to have it too, but I took care of those.

NPC: I figured as much. Where is it? ...but... but it is broken..!

Your response: Yes, I believe he is sorry about that, but there is little to be done about it now.

NPC: Yes... nothing can be done about it... thanks. I guess I will have to look around if I can find someone, who can fix this baby. I will get back to you, you did your job very well. Until then, you should keep training your Melee Combat skill. Nothing went wrong this time, but when you face stronger opponents, you should be ready.

Your response: Thanks for the tip... I'll keep that in mind.

NPC: Good, see you later.

NPC: Are you with them? Look, I told you, you cannot have it!

Your response: Jones sent me.

NPC: Ah, that's one reliable guy. I was able to find the Tsurugaoka-Sword, but its blade is broken. Like that stops the bastards trying to take it from me... they have been trailing me for days now.

Your response: You are being followed?

NPC: Followed my ass. These guys aren't playing. I am a trader, not a fighter. Not my domain, know what I'm saying? ...oh shit... Over there. Looks like they'll never give up! You better help me, or the sword will be gone and Jones can scratch one friend!

NPC: I think Jones sent the right guy... hahaha... We sure showed them!

Your response: That was easy...

NPC: There are more of them!!! Help me!!!

NPC: Maybe for you. But this is getting too big for me. Please take the Tsurugaoka-Sword. You're going back to Jones anyway and I don't want to keep taking this risk for a walk.

Your response: I can understand that. I will give it to him.

NPC: Thanks, one huge stone off my chest. It is much safer with you. Send Jones my best greetings and tell him that I still owe him a Sake or two.

NPC: Why are you still here? I already gave you the sword!

NPC: Ah, right time, right place. I like that. Can you spare some time and do another little job for me?

Your response: Not at the moment, sorry.

Your response: I have enough free time. Shoot.

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great. Remember the sword you fetched for me?

Your response: Yes, the broken blade.

NPC: Exactly... and I aim to change that. I found a blacksmith with the necessary skills to repair such a blade. But believe me - such people are rare now and ask for loads of money.

Your response: Okay... Am I supposed to do errands now to get some money?

NPC: Oh whatever gave you that idea? No, of course not. We already agreed on a price and I paid him. All you need to do is bring him the sword, get it back and bring it to me. Simple as that.

Your response: If it is necessary. Who is this blacksmith and where do I find him?

NPC: Great, here you are again. What took you so long?

Your response: Oh, maybe that I needed to crawl to some slobbering bum in his dark cave to find the necessary metal for the repair. Or that I needed to off your crazy-ass blacksmith because he was sure keen on keeping that blade after he was done with it.

NPC: Your job isn't done yet!

NPC: Your job isn't done yet!

NPC: Oh...

Your response: Yup! Oh!

NPC: I'm sorry that this job took you that much work. But you do have the sword, right?

Your response: Of course I do. Here - take it.

NPC: Hmmm... marvelous. Unfortunately you can see where it broke. Inevitable I guess. I still owe you my gratitude. You did your job very well. You will surely have learned a lot. Remember to keep training your Melee Combat skill, and you will be very strong in no time.

Your response: What did you think I am doing all the time. Still, thanks.

NPC: No, you don't. Go back and get it. He must've hidden it in his apartment.

NPC: I will soon have another job for you. Until then, good luck out there.

NPC: Jones sent you. You bring the Tsurugaoka-Sword.

Your response: Um... yes, that's right. But how do you know that?

NPC: I know many things. And I see many things others cannot see.

Your response: Then I'm sure you see that I'm short on time, right?

NPC: I see impatience. But I will not provoke you. Show me the blade.

Your response: There you go - this is it.

NPC: Oh... indeed. Beautiful. But it isn't just broken, it is splinted. I have to replace some parts.

Your response: Go ahead...

NPC: It's not that easy. I need Shin-Metal. You need to fetch me some.

Your response: It keeps getting better. Where should I get something I have never heard of before?

Your response: I guess I will be on my way then, so we can get this over with.

NPC: Hurry up. I have other things to do.

NPC: You have the Shin-Metal.

Your response: Ever thought about the fact that people who know that you know what they are gonna say do not give two shits about your smart-ass comments?

NPC: I knew you would say that. Now give it to me.

Your response: Well, if you ask THAT politely...

NPC: Good. Go - Come back when I'm done.

NPC: The blade is finished.

Your response: Good, I want this to be finally over. Now if you would kindly hand it to me...

NPC: The blade isn't finished yet. Come back later.

NPC: I'm afraid I can't do that.

Your response: W... what? What's that supposed to mean?

NPC: That's supposed to mean that I will not give it to you. This blade is way too nice of a piece. I will not give it away again.

Your response: Have you lost your marbles? Give me the blade, or you will be in a lot of trouble with Jones!

NPC: No, I will not be in trouble with Jones. I will tell him that you took the Tsurugaoka-Sword and took off. He will come to think that you ran away with it.

Your response: Since you always have the answer to anything, explain to me how you plan on stopping me from telling him the real story of your double-cross?

NPC: I will stop you by killing you...

NPC: Washap?

NPC: Shin-Mefal? Whussat s'posed tah be?

Your response: How am I supposed to know? You are the seller!

NPC: Whaddaya knee id for?

Your response: To repair a blade.

NPC: Oh I shee... that inshane Blackshmish! Uhkay now I know whayou wonz. Shat guy ish jush buying ol' scrap jung of meh.

Your response: Yes, whatever, do you have some now?

NPC: Of coursh... I alwaysh do. Jush Jung. Here, take. 'Sh yoursh, why would ah needid.

Your response: Wow... thanks, I guess.

NPC: Whut more you wonz? I haff notheng mor'.

NPC: Cabinet open. You have taken the sword.

NPC: Cabinet closed.

NPC: The cabinet is empty.

NPC: Oh thank god, you're here. I think these bastards followed me.

Your response: Who followed you?

NPC: I don't know. I was with my old friend who gave you the broken blade. Do you remember..?

Your response: Vividly, so? Why are you being followed now?

NPC: He brought me a new Tsurugaoka-Sword. I couldn't get close to the one with the break marks. But now the same goons who have been trying to take the other sword from him seem to follow me now.

Your response: And now you brought these people right here?!? How about collecting something less dangerous? Explosives, poisonous animals or rare viruses maybe?

NPC: Do not mock me. Oh god... I think I heard footsteps. Protect me, I beg you!

NPC: Whew... that was close... I owe you my life. I will never forget that.

Your response: These guys weren't so tough...

NPC: They aren't dead yet!! Attack, dammit!!

NPC: No, you really did great. Take this sword - I have another one now. You seem to know perfectly well how to handle it.

Your response: Wow... thank you... so the entire effort DID pay off for me in the end.

NPC: I'm sorry I cannot give you anything else right now. I gotta take my leave now and go somewhere, where those goons cannot find me. I need to think on how to wipe out this gang.

Your response: Best of luck in that.

NPC: And best of luck to you. I am sure we will meet again.
Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself.
Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: You're a dangerous enemy. I'll make sure to stay on my toes with you!

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself.
Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

• I'm sure of that. Anyway - I'm gonna have to leave now. Other matters require my attention. Maybe we will meet again sometime. Best of luck until then. I'm not needed anymore. Watch yourself.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: You know where to find me.

NPC: Good to see you. Feel at home yet? Yes? Well, it's good that you're here. We have a small problem, that you could help us solve...

Your response: No thanks, not at the moment.

Your response: Tell me what it is.

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Well, I want you to start a construction plant for vehicles again. The machine was sabotaged, is broken, was mistreated... whatever. I just want to see it running again so production is no longer delayed.

Your response: And how am I supposed to do that?

NPC: Ah, there you are again... Very good - I got to know that everything runs smoothly now. I am very happy that our faction has members that are as highly skilled as you are.

Your response: Thanks, but it wasn't really that hard.

NPC: The machine isn't repaired yet. Come back when you finished your job.

NPC: No need to be humble. You're doing great. I advise you to use your gained knowledge to train your Vehicle Usage skill. After all, that's what you want to do, right?

Your response: Yes, thanks for the advice.

NPC: My pleasure. If you can spare some time, please talk to me, I will surely have more jobs for you.

NPC: Yes, what is it? My day is fuckin' packed, so talk already.

Your response: Nothing. Wrong guy.

Your response: Jones sent me. I'm supposed to get a replacement part for a machine.

NPC: Sure. I have too much work anyway.

NPC: What the hell?! You're a godsend! That POS is causing problems since weeks and now it finally broke completely. I didn't think, that Jones would send help that quickly. All the better - here it is. Put that part in and check if everything works fine again. Then you should go right back to Jones.

Your response: Uh, sure. But where is that broken machine anyway?

NPC: Hmm? What do you want? You have the replacement part already.

NPC: S Y S T E M   D I S O P E R A T I O N A L

NPC: P A R T   N O T   F O U N D   P L E A S E   R E P E A T

NPC: S Y S T E M   O P E R A T I O N S   R E S T O R E D

NPC: Oh, hello. Great timing that you ask me now. Nice appartment, by the way. Well, I have another small job for you. Interested?

Your response: No, I don't have time at the moment.

Your response: Of course. What is it?

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

Your response: And what am I supposed to do? Get that mini-prototype for you?

NPC: There you are. What took you so long?

Your response: I had to play the vermin exterminator, because you didn't send one...

NPC: You do not have the prototype? Well, come back when you do.

NPC: A vermin exterminator..? ...oh... oh yes... right. I'm very sorry about that. I completely forgot about that with all that work I have to do. But it's nice to see you doing the work for your faction so enthusiastically.

Your response: Yeah... but I would still rather drive something than playing the vermin exterminator and carry around toy cars. By the way, here it is.

NPC: Wonderful. But be patient. This 'toy car' is way more than that. I think I can further involve you into this matter and, of course, reward you properly. So if you want to drive something bigger, you should keep training your Vehicle Usage skill.

Your response: Yes, thank you. I'll be sure to remember that.

NPC: Good. I have further jobs to finish. Come back to me when you are ready.

NPC: Ah!!! What?!? Who's there?!? My goodness... never sneak up on me like that again, understand? You never know if it isn't one of these ugly little beasts.

Your response: Uh, yes... sorry. Won't happen again.

NPC: Yes yes, it's okay. I'm just a little nervous about the spiders. So, what do you want from me?

Your response: Mr. Jones sent me. I'm supposed to get some mini-buggy-prototype-thingamabob.

NPC: Jones, eh? Well, screw him. He always wants, wants, wants. I asked for a cleansing 6 weeks ago, and he still didn't send it. I live in a frickin' spiders nest. Stupid things are crawling all over the place. And I HATE spiders. But Jones doesn't care. As soon as he wants something from me though, he is fast as hell.

Your response: Will you give me that thing or not?

NPC: No! I've finally had enough. I cannot work under these conditions. Go to Jones, and tell him that he should first send the vermin exterminators. When they are done, he can have the mini-prototype. Not a second earlier.

Your response: And what if I kill those spiders? Will you give it to me then?

NPC: Do you have a vermin exterminators license level 4 or above?

Your response: You need a license for that now? No, I don't think I do.

NPC: Then I'm sorry but I can't let you do that. You might get hurt.

Your response: Hurt? By these little scrabblers? Trust me, I'll wipe all of them out without a problem.

NPC: Well okay... But don't say I didn't warn you. When you wiped out this brood, you will get the mini-prototype for Jones. Get going already! These spiders!!

NPC: Good grief. You know your handywork. I am very satisfied. The biting and pinching will finally stop. These bastards crawl everywhere I tell ya, you wouldn't believe how much such an eight-legged freak can hurt when he crawls up your...

Your response: ...I do not need to hear these things. Will you give me the prototype already?

NPC: These SPIDERS! KILL THEM ALREADY!!!

NPC: Oh yes, of course. Here you go. But be careful. It is an exact micromodel with all functions. You can generate a complete blueprint from it. Do not break it, or the customers might wonder where the steering wheel went... hahaha!

NPC: Hmm? What else do you want? You already have the blueprint! Do not waste my precious time!

NPC: Ah, back again I see. Listen, Would you sell me that chair over there, bychance? I used to have one of these, but unfortunately it broke, when my ex-wife...

Your response: I don't really have time for you right now.

Your response: Come on, Jones. What do I need to do for you now?

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great. I like a straight shooter. I'll get straight to the point then. You will remember the mini-prototype you brought to me. It is time to start the production. Usually I would only give this job to someone, who has been a member of our faction for a long time, but I like you and I trust you.

Your response: Are you really asking me to construct a vehicle now?

Your response: I'm supposed to bring a car up here?!? How am I supposed to do that?

NPC: No, no. You will see. Not a car. I will explain everything to you, when you are back. In the meantime, get going.

NPC: There you are... Do you have what I want?

Your response: If it is this key, then yes!

NPC: Your job isn't finished yet. Come back when you are done!

NPC: Yes, that's what I mean. This is wonderful... You really did pay off. We can now start producing the 4 Wheeler Buggy and you did a really big part in that. Like I promised, you shall not go unrewarded.

Your response: Does that mean you will finally pay me for my work?

NPC: Even better. You can keep the key. The 4 Wheeler is yours!

Your response: WOW!!! Now this is great. But... where is it and how can I drive it?

NPC: It's like this: You can only use vehicles outside the city, otherwise the city would be all clogged up. You will find a big terminal next to most city exits to the wastelands. So called 'Carports'. There you can get your vehicle, if you have the proper key.

Your response: Sounds great. I think I might try that right now.

NPC: You go ahead and do that... But if I may advise you: Do not just train driving, do something for your body, too. You should be ready to defend yourself, when you go out there. The beings that you could meet out there can be bigger and badder than everything you have seen until now.

Your response: I see...

NPC: And if you get raided, it won't help if you're a master of controlling your vehicle, but everyone can take it from you by force. So you should also concentrate on your fighting abilities.

Your response: Thanks. I think I would have done that anyway, though.

NPC: I'm sure of that. Anyway - I'm gonna have to leave now. Other matters require my attention. Maybe we will meet again sometime. Best of luck until then. I'm not needed anymore. Watch yourself.
Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

NPC: Yes? What is it?

NPC: That depends on who's asking.

Your response: Jones sent me.

NPC: Oh... okay... about the blueprint, right?

Your response: Exactly. Here's the prototype.

NPC: Very good... oh, that's simple. Wait a second... ... ... ... ... ...

Your response: ... ... ... ... ... *pfffff* ... ...

NPC: You don't have it? Come back when you do! My time is precious.

NPC: ... compensate a little... *mumble* ... ... from the other side... ... *grumble* ... ...

Your response: ... ... ... Excuse me! Will this take much longer?

NPC: Ah! No! It's getting done. Here you go, take it. I will handle the disposal of the prototype. And tell your Mr. Jones, that payment better not take as long as it took last time, please.

Your response: Will do. Do you happen to know where the production pipeline is? Jones was a little confused and forgot to tell me.

CONTACT

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• You are welcome. You served your faction very well. Now I have other matters to attend, but we will meet sometime later. entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: You know where to find me.

NPC: Good to see you! Did you get settled in yet? The apartment is no palace of course, but if you make yourself useful, things could change. Speaking of which - I have a problem that will require a dependable person to handle it...

Your response: I'm out of time at the moment.

Your response: Oh, I am a very dependable person!

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great! That's what I like to hear. We have a problem with one of our construction facilities - details later. At the moment, I need a replacement part for a cooling liquid pump. The problem is, that I cannot find one of these parts anywhere and time is short.

Your response: And now I am supposed to search for that part myself?

NPC: Not exactly. You're not supposed to search for it, you're supposed to construct one. I will give you this blueprint and you will construct it... you know how that works.

Your response: To be honest... not really.

NPC: Then I will explain. If you look at the properties of the blueprint, you will see what you need to construct the part. If you have all construction parts together, put your construction tool and the blueprint into your processor window and start the process. This might take a while, since you are not very experienced yet.

Your response: Okay... I think I'll manage. But I do not have any construction parts...

NPC: Then you need to buy or find them. It's a very simple machine, so the parts should be easy to find. You should go out and look for a tech shop. You can get almost anything in those. To make your search easier for one, you should use your Nav-Ray to find a shop and back here. Look in the Trader Categories for chemicals.

Your response: Whoa, information overflow. But I think I'll make it.

NPC: Of course you will. You just need to hurry up a little, I need that part as soon as possible.

NPC: Are you done? Oh, I see you managed to construct the part. I am so thankful.

Your response: Man, do my feet hurt...

NPC: Come back when you finished your job!

NPC: Come back when you finished your job!

NPC: I will make it worth your while later. In the meantime, you should train your Construction skills, so you will be able to handle more complex gadgets later.

Your response: Thanks for the tip. I will keep that in mind.

NPC: No need to thank me. Come back later and I will have more stuff for you to do.

NPC: Thank god you're here! Say, are you free to do something for me at the moment?

Your response: Not at the moment, sorry...

Your response: I have time...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great. I have a problem... You remember the part you constructed for me. Well, the technician who was supposed to take it and plug it in has not shown up yet and the problem keeps getting bigger.

Your response: What is the problem, then?

NPC: The replacement part you constructed is for a cooling liquid pump, as I told you. In one of our construction facilities, a reactor was sabotaged and is in danger of overheating. Usually, this shouldn't be a problem. We had numerous cases of sabotage in the past, but this time, it is a problem.

Your response: Let me guess: The cooling mechanism went offline, and the thing is in danger of lighting up like a five year old christmas tree.

NPC: It's not that bad. The cooling mechanism is okay, but it is out of cooling plasma. And the only machine that can produce cooling plasma that is close enough is disfunctional, as you know. You constructed the replacement part yourself. But still, the damn technician didn't show up to plug the replacement part in and get the plasma production going again.

Your response: Well, I do not have such equipment either, as you might notice...

Your response: Good, I just give him the blood and come back here, right?

NPC: Ah, back again. Did everything work out? Do you have the analysis?

Your response: Yes, it worked out, more or less. Here, take it.

NPC: You did not finish your mission!

NPC: If I am supposed to analyze this right now, you need to give my three loved ones their daily injections. They're late as it is.

Your response: What kind of injections?

NPC: Over there are the three cages. And I am gonna give you three needles, to give the little ones all they need. Remember: Norbert gets the red needle, Skippy gets the green one and Alina gets the blue one. Just remember that. Here, take them and shake a leg.

Your response: Yeah well but how do I know which one of your pets...

NPC: ...You're still here? Chop chop, the little ones are waiting! My goodness, does everyone else just dawdle?

NPC: Ah, there you are. What took you so long? Did you at least do it?

Your response: Uh... yeah... I guess you could say that I did it, yes...

NPC: You didn't give their injections to my loved ones. Do that already!

NPC: You didn't give their injections to my loved ones. Do that already!

NPC: You didn't give their injections to my loved ones. Do that already!

NPC: And, how are my loved ones? I hope Alina wasn't too much of a pain, you know how these little mischiefs can be... hehehe...

Your response: Superb... hehe... yeah.... They're all splendid...mhm...

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at most 25; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• I have other matters to attend now and leave you to yourself. If you keep training hard, you can get hired by a clan community. They always need good hackers. Good luck in your further way. We will surely meet again.
Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

• Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself.
Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: You know where to find me.

NPC: Oh, nice to see you. Got accommodated yet? I have a little something that needs to be done. Are you interested in helping me and your faction out a little?

Your response: I have no time right now.

Your response: Of course.

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great... This is the deal: We need some data from a database, and a direct access would be too risky. That's why I want you go 'go in' and get that data for me. You need to get the password from... an informed person, though.

Your response: I basically just arrived, I can hardly find my shoes right now. How am I gonna find all this?

Your response: Yes, but how do I find him? I don't know the way...

NPC: Use your Nav-Ray. It should be easy to find the guy with that.

Your response: Okay... and when I have the data, I come back here to you, right?

NPC: Exactly - good luck.

NPC: You're back. Did everything work out?

Your response: Yes, it did. I have your data...

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Hmmm... this data is encoded. Another problem that needs solving... First, thanks a lot.

Your response: No problem, glad I could help.

NPC: Good, because I might soon have another job for you. Until then, you should train your Hacking skills so you'll be able to crack even better security systems.

NPC: Who are you? I don't know you.

Your response: Jones sent me for a password.

NPC: Ah, the netrunner, Jones wanted to send to me. You're late...

Your response: Sorry, I was trying to hurry up.

NPC: Hey, it's allright - I just don't have much time because I have other matters to attend. Anyway, the password is 'Silverfuture06# ...good luck.

Your response: Wait! Jones told me you could tell me where the database is.

NPC: D A T A S E R V E R   ´ S I L - P 5´
PASSWORD:

Your response: SILVERFUTURE06

NPC: PASSWORD ACCEPTED

Your response: (Start Download...)

NPC: DOWNLOAD COMPLETE

NPC: ACCESS DENIED

NPC: There you are. As if I called you... great. Do you have the free ressources to help me a little?

Your response: My ressources are limited right now, sorry.

Your response: At your service...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: It's about the data you downloaded for me. They need to be decoded by our mainframe. Then you need to upload the data onto the account 'Silverdivision' from a different terminal.

Your response: First things first... where do I decode the data and where do I upload it?

Your response: Good, and then?

NPC: That was quick... did you send the data?

Your response: Yes, I did... easy as ever.

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Nice to see that you enjoy browsing through the net. But remember that there is a real world out here, where you might not be as strong as you are in there. You should also train some basic combat skills, to be able to defend yourself in the real world. You will never be as strong as a real fighter, but it is important not to ignore your body.

Your response: Thanks for the tip, I will get to training right away.

NPC: Very good. Come back later, I will have more stuff for you to do.

NPC: PLEASE SELECT DESIRED FUNCTIONALITY

Your response: (Decode data)

NPC: PLEASE INSERT DATA FOR DECODING

Your response: (Enter Data)

NPC: DATA DECODING STARTED
PROGRESS: 24 PERCENT

Your response: ... Hmmm ...

NPC: PROGRESS: 62 PERCENT

Your response: ... this is taking forever ...

NPC: PROGRESS: 87 PERCENT

Your response: ... oh man ...

NPC: PROGRESS: 100 PERCENT
DECODING FINISHED

NPC: DECODING NOT ACCESSIBLE. SYSTEM RECALIBRATION IN PROGRESS

NPC: SUPERNODE X363KST02 - 2
PLEASE SELECT DESIRED FUNCTIONALITY

Your response: (Upload data to net account)

NPC: SESSION TERMINATED : DATA NOT ENCODED!

NPC: SUPERNODE X363KST02 - 2
PLEASE ENTER ACCOUNTNAME

Your response: Silverdivision

NPC: SUPERNODE X363KST02 - 2
UPLOAD COMPLETE - SESSION TERMINATED

NPC: SESSION TERMINATED

NPC: Hello... you look like you want to help me out a little again.

Your response: Not at the moment.

Your response: Sure, shoot.

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

Your response: And what is the password?

NPC: The password is 'Quicksilver7' ...keep it well. If it wasn't so important, we could have sent it through the net.

NPC: You look a little beaten... where have you been? What's wrong?

Your response: I was just delivering the password and then I had to off your stupid contact person! That's wrong!

NPC: You didn't finish your mission. Come back when you did.

NPC: What the fried f..! Why?! Have you lost your mind? Our clients will hold me responsible and have my ass!

Your response: Calm down... whoever those clients were - they wanted to screw us over! He was a double agent and worked for the other side. Whoever that other side is...

NPC: Oh shits... and you finished him before he could get his hands on the data? You did a great service to us. If this material in its decoded form had fallen into the wrong hands, many people would have had problems. Really, you helped us a lot.

Your response: I didn't have much of a choice... the man tried to kill me!

NPC: Take this TL90 Hacktool as a token of my appreciation and the appreciation of our faction - it will surely be of as much help to you as you were to our faction. Furthermore, you should keep training your Hacking skill. But as you saw, it is essential to be able to also defend yourself in the real world.

Your response: Thank you...

NPC: I have other matters to attend now and leave you to yourself. If you keep training hard, you can get hired by a clan community. They always need good hackers. Good luck in your further way. We will surely meet again.
Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

NPC: Ah, the youngblood again... what's up?

Your response: I'm supposed to give you the password for the server with the decoded data.

NPC: Oooohh... yess... of course... gimme, gimme!

Your response: Well... the password is 'Quicksilver7'...

NPC: Hehehehe... thanks, youngblood - nice doggie.

Your response: Uh... yes... you're welcome... Jones told me, you have something for him?

NPC: Oh yes, I almost forgot... I do have something for him. Your body in a bag, you stupid idiot.

Your response: Uh... Excuse me? What...

NPC: Shut it - you played your part nicely and Jones didn't notice a thing. It never even occured to him, that I could be a double agent. Yeah well... he is surely gonna notice when he finds his newest pet chopped up into parts in his mail... Hehehe...

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: You know where to find me.

NPC: Ah, hello! How are you feeling in your new home? I have a small problem at the moment, and I cannot handle it myself right now. Could you help me with it?

Your response: Not right now, sorry.

Your response: Sure, I'll do that.

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Here's what it's about: The routes of our... not entirely legal transports have been checked too often lately. That got our attention. But now we heard from an external source, that we have a mole in our middle who has been mouthing off about things he is not even supposed to know.

Your response: And how am I supposed to find him?

Your response: It's a little smelly down at the smugglers...

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: I'll try and find out the mole's position. Until then, you should train your Tech-Combat skills. It's a rough world out there and nobody is gonna wrap you in silk. Come back later - I will have more stuff for you to do.

Your response: Jones sent me... it's about the... mole.

Your response: Sounds like a swell fella. Where do I find him?

NPC: Who are you? If you want shit, I'm all out of it and waiting for the next delivery.

NPC: Yes, I know... Shit - sure I know who's behind that.

Your response: Would you be willing to tell me?

NPC: Hehehe... sure!... course... um... you don't have some booze for me, do ya?

Your response: No, I don't, and now please tell me who's the mole or Mr. Jones might be very disappointed.

NPC: Aw crap... why didn't you say that Jones wants to know... hehehe... stupid old f...! I'm gonna send Jones a message over the net with the name. Got a couple of questions about that last payment for him anyway...

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

Your response: Bartlett is the mole. And because he wasn't able to find the guy himself, he put up a wrong trail for us.

Your response: Yes, I guess he thought we would just kill him.

NPC: Who are you and what do you want from me? I don't know you!

Your response: Shut your face! I'm the one asking questions here.

NPC: But I...

Your response: Tell me why you little maggot rat out our smuggling routes! On whose payroll are you?

NPC: W... what? Me? Are you pulling my leg? Who said that? Bartlett, that jerkface? But he's the one who's snitching on everyone just to get a little profit from it. Your response: Thanks... I would have killed him for free, though.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: You know where to find me.

NPC: Good to see you... Feeling at home yet? I hope you like it. There is a small problem I have to handle and I thought it would be good if I could put your abilities to use here. Can you spare some time?

Your response: At the moment, I am forced to decline.

Your response: Of course I can.

Your response: I don't need your help Mr. Jones, I'm doing fine on my own. Thanks for the offer though!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great... Let me tell you about the problem. Lately, there have been a lot of incursions by a radical society and they are gaining power. We already have the psychos, drug freaks, syndicates, Gentanks, sects and religious fanatics... we can't tolerate radicals right now.

Your response: You want me to wipe them out?

NPC: That is our final goal. We need to find out where they hide first, though.

Your response: And how am I gonna find out?

NPC: A few of your believing friends caught a prostitute from the red light district, who has been trafficking with these radicals. You should interrogate her a little... by force if necessary.

Your response: Okay, I can do that. What next?

NPC: Well... she knows of us and she could talk... make sure that she can not.

Your response: Yeah, I can do that, too. Where to I find the believers who found her?

NPC: There you are. Were you successful?

Your response: Of course.

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: And? What can you report?

Your response: She used to have a punter named Zoid, who has connections to the radicals.

NPC: Hmmm... that's a street name... no normal mother calls her child Zoid. I'll try and find out who's behind that identity. You did a good job. I will have use for you soon again. Until then, you should train your Aggressive Psi-Use abilities... you will surely need those later.

NPC: Argh... who the hell are you sick bastards? What do you want from me... I didn't do nothing wrong...

Your response: I'm asking the questions here. Who we are is none of your business.

NPC: Let me down. Whoever you are, you got the wrong girl!

Your response: I guess we will see about that... I want to ask you some questions.

NPC: Piss off, you sick fuck!

Your response: Tsk tsk tsk... we won't get far that way. You do not mind me giving you a little electric shock to soften that tongue of yours now do you...

NPC: No no, I will tell you everything! I'll do anything you want!

Your response: Much better... what do you know about the radicals, who have been increasing in numbers lately?

NPC: What? Who? I know nothing... I don't know who you mean.

Your response: You're pretty much asking me to hurt you...

NPC: Shit! Please... if... if I tell you... something. They... they will kill me....

Your response: And what do you think I will do if you don't?

NPC: Allright... ...I... there is this guy ...who... he stops by from time to time... has much... much money... and wants really sick... stuff for it... please... please let me go...

Your response: One thing after another... What's his name?

NPC: I can't tell you that... I don't know his name...

Your response: Sorry, but I do not believe you... do I have to... ?

NPC: Allright ...Zoid... people... they... they call him... Zoid... I don't... know anything else, honest...

Your response: See, that wasn't so hard... why make it hard for yourself. Thank you.

NPC: Hey... wait... wait up... I wanna go... let go of me...

Your response: Oh yeah... I entirely forgot... I will tell one of these fine folks to let you down...

NPC: Yeah right... fuck off, you sick motherfucker!

Your response: Goodbye... though I doubt that...

NPC: ... ... ...

NPC: Let me go!!!

NPC: I already awaited you. There is more work. Are you ready?

Your response: Not at the moment...

Your response: Sure thing...

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

Your response: Just ask him?

NPC: It wouldn't be bad to start wiping out the group with him first... Come back to me when everything is finished.

Your response: Yes, he was there.

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: And what did he have to tell?

NPC: Very good... now we can finally wipe them all out, knowing where they are.

Your response: Should I do that?

NPC: No, not yet. Let me get some information about their strength first. Until then you should keep training your Aggressive Psi-Use... you should report back in due time.

NPC: Yes? Can I help you somehow?

Your response: Yes, by telling me about the organisation you work for.

NPC: W...what? Who sent you?

Your response: Who sent me is of secondary importance. Primarily, you should be worried about your health and well-being, and tell me immediately where this radical organisation is located.

NPC: Sh... Shit... I... I... didn't do... anything. What do you want?

Your response: Answers... I want answers.

Your response: See, that wasn't that hard.

NPC: G... good... May I go now?

Your response: Oh yes... no, I cannot have you leave, sorry...

NPC: ARGH!

NPC: I told you everything!

NPC: Great. You always appear at the right moment. Can you handle something of smaller scale for me?

Your response: Not right now, sorry.

Your response: I can handle bigger-scaled things, too.

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

Your response: So what should I do?

NPC: You should go in, and go in hard. Kill at least five of them. This, and the previous death of their accountant, should show them who's the boss and that they should pull back on their actions a little.

NPC: You go and do that.

NPC: You look a little beat. I hope you made the corks pop.

Your response: Oh yes... I sure did.

NPC: You did not finish your mission. Come back when everything is done.

NPC: Great... I hope we will not hear from these suckers for some time. You did a fantastic job. Not that I awaited anything else. Take this APU-Module with my thanks... It will be of good service to you.

Your response: Thanks a lot...

NPC: I now have other matters to attend and wish you good luck. You did a great job for your faction and we will surely meet again...
Oh, and: Visit the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job!

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself.
Anyway, I highly suggest you to have a look at the Job Center (Plaza Sector 2) for a job.
