NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: You know where to find me.

NPC: There you are. You're coming just at the right moment. Do you have the time to do something for me?

Your response: I have other things to do at the moment.

Your response: Yes, I do.

Your response: I don't need you, Mr. Jones. I can take care of myself! Thanks for your offer!

NPC: As you wish. Come back when you are free. I will wait here for you.

NPC: Great. Here's the deal: One of our scientists went missing some time ago. Yesterday, we got a notice by a group who apparently has taken him captive. He is an essential part of our research division and we cannot afford any delays on the current projects.

Your response: And what am I supposed to do?

NPC: The kidnappers didn't ask for horrendous amounts, so we decided to give them what they want. Your job is the delivery of this briefcase.

Your response: And where should I take this briefcase?

NPC: Did you find the contact person and give him the briefcase?

Your response: Yes, I have... he seemed satisfied and said he would let our scientist go.

NPC: Come back when you finished your job!

NPC: What? Wasn't he there and came with you?

Your response: Ahm... no... I just gave him the briefcase. Nobody else was there.

NPC: Damn... we agreed to something different. But let's hope for the best, that they will let our man go anyway.

Your response: I'm sorry, but you didn't tell me that.

NPC: I'ts okay. You didn't know. I'll surely have more to do for you soon. Until then, you should train your Aggressive PSI-Use skills a little. Come back to me later.

NPC: If you don't have something important to say, buzz off.

Your response: Jones sent me to deliver this briefcase.

NPC: Oh... that's why you're here. Very good - Jones made the right decision. Give me the briefcase and his scientist will soon be home free again.

Your response: Here, take it.

NPC: Ah... exactly what we wanted to have. You did your job very good...

Your response: I'm gonna go back to Jones and tell him you received your delivery.

NPC: You do that...

NPC: I guess Jones is waiting..

NPC: Good thing you're back. We have a little situation and I need your help.

Your response: I don't have the time to help at the moment.

Your response: What can I help you with?

Your response: And I'm supposed to go in there and get our guy out?

Your response: I think that should be enough. Do I get there with the Nav-Ray too?

Your response: Still there... his leg is broken and he can't move. I'm supposed to tell you, that Zoomer is the kidnapper.

NPC: Come back when you finished your job!

NPC: Lost your key, bastard? So you need to climb over the fence? I told you guys a hundred times now, that I am not gonna break this code - you can break my other leg, it won't help. So piss off!

Your response: Psssst... Jones sent me. I'm here to free you...

NPC: What? Oh son of a - finally! ... SHIT! They saw you... behind you!

NPC: Whew... that was close... I would like to help you, but my leg is broken. The bastards shattered it. So I won't be able to get outta here. NPC: It is time for a swift kick in the ass of some choice people. Are you ready?

Your response: Not yet...

Your response: Sure!

Your response: He told me that he didn't help them...

NPC: True... that's why he wanted a decoder from us in exchange for our man, he knew of his importance for us. The decoder we gave him can't even handle that much data, which he surely must have noticed by now...

Your response: But then everything's good, right?

Your response: And you want me to do that...

NPC: You look a little shaken... what happened?

NPC: Come back when you finished your job!

NPC: So you killed him. What did he say?

Your response: Besides 'hahaha' and 'hehehe' not much...

NPC: That's too bad... but cannot be changed I guess. You did your job well... we can get our scientist back without a problem and the danger of our data falling into the wrong hands is banished, too.

Your response: Thanks, it was hard work...

entries.details:
CONTACT
Special Agent Riviera

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at least 55; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Armor parts you say? Hmmm, perhaps you should talk to this guy called Ol' Dirty Conster in Tech Haven Sec-1. The crazy bastard usually doesn't talk to people, but if you mention 'Whiskey in the Jar', he'll know that I sent you. Please excuse me now. Command has requested an extensive report for this operation.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: For Reza!!

Your response: For Reza! How can I help you?

Your response: For Reza?

NPC: DIE FILTHY DOY SCUM!!

NPC: Damn kids... Come back when you've grown up!

NPC: Your time has not come yet, but Reza will have patience with you!

NPC: Reza, Neocron and the people of Neocron, they all demand a lot of their citizens. Are you ready to fulfill one of these demands?

Your response: Not really, I am pretty busy at the moment!

Your response: In Reza's name, I am ready for all that might come.

NPC: Reza sees everything. Don't expect your reluctancy to be ignored!

NPC: We must act immediately, as the enemy is about to secure a dreadful weapon. The consequences of which could cost the lives of millions of loyal citizens! You will need daring and skilled Runners at your side.

Your response: Maybe this mission doesn't suit me afterall.

Your response: I know enough professionals to accompany me. Please, continue.

NPC: You are obviously not ready yet. Come back, when you feel fit.

NPC: Every word I speak now was never spoken. If the mission should fail, we will deny you.

Your response: The usual procedure, I understand.

NPC: The enemy has discovered an unexplored laboratory complex underneath the Gaia Mines. According to intercepted communications, some kind of unknown technology was found in this complex. If the information is right, this might have to do with Regant's legacy.

Your response: Regant? That name rings a bell!

NPC: For a long time, everyone believed he was dead, until a naive hacker found his DNA in the Hacknet. The Brotherhood of Crahn resurrected Regant, intending to force him to share his special knowledge with them. The genotoxic technology grants eternal life and impeccable health.

Your response: These bloody traitors weren't successful, were they?

NPC: *cough* No, thank Reza! The Brotherhood of Crahn amateurs tried to control Regant. However, as Regant's DNA was so heavily damaged, they had to put him in a special suit to guarantee his survival. Due to their incredible simple-mindedness, they did not notice that he was improving the suit on his own and gained unthinkable powers with it. At first, they were very confident. Regant finished the last genotoxic experiments and the Brotherhood of Crahn was already celebrating the new possibilities this technology would offer them. But they weren't prepared for Regant. According to our reports, it was an incredibly bloody massacre. Regant's mutants quickly exterminated the complete lab personnel and took control of the lab.

Your response: He killed them all??

NPC: Some of them managed to hide from the mutants, other could flee. Since then, noone set foot into the lab.

Your response: I see, what are we doing about it then?

NPC: I think I don't need to mention that this technology is of the utmost importance for Neocron and that we need to do everything we can to get our hands on it.

Your response: I'm aware of that. I will volunteer for this challenge! What exactly do you want me to do?

NPC: The Brotherhood of Crahn has sent an agent called Horatius to the lab to check the situation. We learned that this agent has disappeared for more than 24 hours from an intercepted communication.

Your response: So you want me to gather some other fighters to go to the lab and find this agent Horatius?

NPC: Correct! We have to get Regant's research data. The lives of millions of loyal Neocron citizens are on the line! If this agent is no longer alive, we need any information he has on him to find out what happened!

Your response: Got it! I'll head out right awy!

NPC: One more thing... Take note that the Brotherhood of Crahn will also be sending teams to the lab to find out what happened to their agent.

Your response: So it's possible that we will run into hostile forces? We will teach them a lesson! For Reza, for Neocron, for the people!

NPC: For Reza!

NPC: **Agent Horatius' corpse**

Your response: - Search the corpse

NPC: **You find an object: Datapad of Agent Horatius**

NPC: **The remains of Agent Horatius**

NPC: You're back!

Your response: Yes and I have good news. This Agent Horatius is dead and the place is crawling with mutants. This lab... if there is Hell on Earth, it's in that lab!

NPC: What are you doing here? Don't you have a mission to complete??

NPC: One filthy traitor less! I assume you found something on his remains?

Your response: We did. Here is his datapad.

NPC: Excellent. I'll need some time to analyze the data. Come back in a few minutes, I'll tell you how to proceed!

Your response: So what's the plan??

NPC: You don't seem to have the datapad! Come back when you have it on you!

NPC: Yes, this thing isn't over yet!

NPC: Ah, there you are again. I've analyzed Agent Horatius' datapad. He was about to meet with his contact, a research assistant called James Denari. We both know this meeting didn't take place.

Your response: Obviously, yes.

NPC: We have to find this James Denari to find out what information he has. You'll have to go back to this lab and find him!

Your response: What has to be done has to be done. I'll be on my way.

NPC: It is comforting to know that we can count on runners like you! Good luck!

NPC: **James Denari's corpse**

Your response: - Search the corpse

NPC: **You find the object: Personal Records of James Denari**

NPC: **The remains of James Denari**

NPC: For Reza! Was your mission successful?

Your response: I guess. I found James Denari. Unfortunately, he was unable to talk, like Agent Horatius. The mutants messed him up pretty good. But I found his personal records.

NPC: What are you doing here? Don't you have a mission to complete??

NPC: This is getting quite messy! Where will it end... Let's take a look at his records. We have to find out where Regant keeps his records!

Your response: That would be helpful, yes.

NPC: You don't have the personal records! Come back when you have them on you!

NPC: I'll need some time to check the records. Come back in a few minutes.

NPC: You're back! I've analayzed James Denari's personal records and found something that will help us.

Your response: I'm all ears!

NPC: James Denari refers to a lab director called Hoffman in his records. According to Denari, Regant entrusted him with the research data. So now we have to find this Hoffman and convince him that the data would be best in our hands.

Your response: I can take care of that! Are there any clues about this lab director's whereabouts?

NPC: Denari mentions a prison block. You should grab your team and check the lab once more.

Your response: I'll get right on it!

NPC: Good luck!

NPC: What? HOW? Oh my God!!

Your response: Calm down, Mr. Hoffman! We don't intend to hurt you!!

NPC: I... if he finds us here...

Your response: Please calm down. We'll protect you if you hand over Regant's research data!

NPC: Research data?? What research data? I don't have any data! He'll kill us all!!

Your response: We know from reliable sources that Regant has entrusted you his research data! Don't waste our valuable time!

NPC: Regant has given me his data?? Never! He spread this misinformation to turn your attention away from him!

Your response: This smells like a damn trap!

NPC: OH MY GOD! THERE HE IS!!

NPC: You better get out of here! Regant will show up soon!! RUN!

Your response: What? Regant is dead! No worries!

NPC: You really have no idea. Regant's DNA is forever saved in this GeneReplicator! He resurrects here every time he dies. He's trapped down here forever! He'll be back soon!!

NPC: Finally! So? Where is the research data?

Your response: I've got it here.

NPC: Very good! I'm very pleased with your performance. What exactly happened?

Your response: The thing with Hoffman was a sneaky trap. Regant planted the information to divert attention from him. As soon as we spoke to Hoffman, Regant showed up and attacked us!

NPC: You don't have the research data! Come back when you have it on you!

NPC: So this means that Regant has finally been eliminated??

Your response: Well, not quite. We killed him, but this Hoffman says that Regant's DNA is saved in the prison block's GeneReplicator. He'll be resurrected there every time he dies. He's basically trapped there forever!

NPC: That's excellent news! And thanks to your help we can now save millions of lives! I'll immediately forward this research data to our scientists! You provided a great service for our society!

NPC: Very commendable. If only we had more runners of your caliber! Here are 500,000 credits to cover your expenses.

Your response: Thank you! But I have one more question.

NPC: Shoot!

Your response: I found some unknown armor parts on Regant's remains and I don't have a clue what to do with them.

NPC: Armor parts you say? Hmmm, perhaps you should talk to this guy called Ol' Dirty Conster in Tech Haven Sec-1. The crazy bastard usually doesn't talk to people, but if you mention 'Whiskey in the Jar', he'll know that I sent you. Please excuse me now. Command has requested an extensive report for this operation.

Your response: Paperwork, I understand. Good luck!!

NPC: For Reza, for Neocron, for the people!

entries.details:

Agent Jones

• Yeah. Anyway this scum bag operates in a warehouse in Industrial sector 1. Pose as a fellow trafficker trying to get some clientele. Be creative and try and get a data cube with some names, anything really.

• We still need to hack Tangent's servers and it's probably best it's not done at the NCPD, we can't risk getting traced, especially after this recent security breach. We have a terminal in Outzone Sector 3 that we can use.

• No, not really. Okay try and get her to talk. If you are successful then go after Hogarth. Our surveillance drones suggest he can be found in Pepper Park Sector 3 by the apartments.

• Okay.....er my sister Eve and I...we lived in Tech Haven....out in the Wastelands. One day we were fixing our hover tech bikes outside...and...

• Talk to Sarah Kocher and visit Edward Hogarth in Pepper Park 3 afterwards.

entries.conversation:
NPC: You again? Good job last time, but there is nothing you can do for me at the moment.

NPC: You look wet behind the ears come see me when you've got some experience.

NPC: Hey you! You've got the exact profile we're looking for. How'd you like to do some undercover work for the NCPD?

Your response: NCPD needs my help? Sure count me in.

Your response: No way! I'm not getting involved. You'll probably get me killed.

NPC: Yeah probably. If you change your mind and get a new spine then come find me, chummer.

NPC: Excellent attitude. Our last undercover agent...retired and we need some new blood. That's where you come in. Don't you feel special.

Your response: I'm starting to feel expendable. What do you need me to do?

NPC: I work with a branch of NCPD's intelligence service the Neocron Security Agency...

Your response: Neocron Security Agency? The...NSA?

NPC: SSSSHHHH! You don't know who's listening! Stop asking questions and listen!

Your response: Alright, sorry.

NPC: I don't know if you've heard the rumours but there's been a lot of people disappearing and we suspect there is a huge human trafficking ring operating within Neocron.

Your response: I haven't heard anything about this.

NPC: Well, the City Admin has tried to keep it under wraps but what makes it difficult is we suspect the traffickers are not related to street gangs but high ranking members of Neocron's corporations.

Your response: Really? Like who?

NPC: Board members of NExT, BioTech Scientists and other major players in all the big corporations. Corporations the City Admin has ties to. That makes things difficult in terms of corporate relations and politics if we start pointing fingers without substantial evidence.

Your response: So, what's the plan?

NPC: We got a lead, a trafficker and street thug by the name of Stabby McFace. We suspect he's supplying human slaves to Neocrons elites. We need to get a list of his contacts. You are going to get it for us.

Your response: And if I decide I don't want to be involved?

NPC: Nothing. Nothing at all. But maybe your browsing history from your Home Terminal gets accidentally leaked.

Your response: Oh.

NPC: Yeah. Anyway this scum bag operates in a warehouse in Industrial sector 1. Pose as a fellow trafficker trying to get some clientele. Be creative and try and get a data cube with some names, anything really.

Your response: Can I count on the NCPD giving me backup if things go wrong?

NPC: Er...yeah. We're listening in on your comms, so we'll be able to hear your conversation. Now go, runner, for Neocron for the people blah blah blah....

NPC: Waaaaaaagggggggggghhhh! Who are you?

Your response: Mr. Stabby is it? I was told you're a man who can get certain items.

NPC: What? Who said that? Maybe. Maybe I do. You after guns? Drugs?

Your response: I'm interested in acquiring people.

NPC: Ok first off if you're working with the NCPD I will stab you. If you try and screw me over I will stab you. If you look at me funny you know what I'm going to do?

Your response: I don't know. Stab me?

NPC: You must be some kind of genius! Alright let's do business. How much human life you want?

Your response: I'm not interested in buying. I want to sell. I got a shipping container full of Dome of York refugees. What I don't have is the contacts.

NPC: Oh I see. You want me to hook you up with some guys and maybe we sell your goods. I assume I get a cut of course. I better.

Your response: Of course. Wouldn't want to screw over a man of your...integrity.

NPC: Hell yeah. Ok let me get my little list of...wait a minute.

Your response: hhhmm?

NPC: I'm getting a feed to my R.P.O.S. You little shit! You're with the NCPD!

Your response: What?! No that's some...er player hating on me...yo. Ah shit.

NPC: You're dead! Prepare to face my army of wee crabs!

NPC: My army of wee crabs is still attacking you! I don't think you have the time to talk to me right now.

NPC: *stares at the dead bodies of the crabs*

Your response: Really? Wee crabs? Did that seem scarier in your head?

NPC: X-beast is a hell of a drug. Time for snitches to get stitches!

NPC: Well that went terrible.

Your response: I could have been killed by that maniac! Here's your list.

NPC: You know what to do. I need Stabbys list of contacts.

NPC: I'm thinking this isn't barbeque sauce on this. Let's have a look what depraved stuff the rich and famous have been up to.

Your response: Better be good...

NPC: I need Stabbys list!

NPC: Oh it is. This thing lists clients and their tastes. Some CEOs on here with drug problems, one guy likes his girls stiff and another has a fetish for droms. Good work.

Your response: I feel sick.

NPC: The main client seems to be a high ranking member of Tangent Technologies, Mr Edward Hogarth. He apparently hosts some crazy sex parties for the elites of Neocron. Everything is on the menu, including killing for sport.

Your response: Neocron is more corrupt than I thought. It's been an enlightening day.

NPC: There's a lot of evidence to go over here. I'm going to need some time to get through it all.

Your response: Whatever. I'm going.

NPC: Come see me later. May have use for you.

NPC: Ah my favourite expendable! Okay we need to get more evidence on this Edward Hogarth character.

Your response: By 'we' you mean me.

NPC: You catch on fast. The NCPD thinks that the Tangent Technologies servers may contain evidence that will help our case against this guy. We just need to hack into them.

Your response: So hack into them. I'm sure you have people who can do that.

NPC: That we do but right now our intelligence analysts are preoccupied trying to stop recent hacking attempts on our servers.

Your response: What?

NPC: Yes. Seems someone has been doing cyber attacks on City Admin's computer systems. They may have compromised a lot of encrypted data.

Your response: How do I fit into this?

NPC: We still need to hack Tangent's servers and it's probably best it's not done at the NCPD, we can't risk getting traced, especially after this recent security breach. We have a terminal in Outzone Sector 3 that we can use.

Your response: Alright. What's the plan?

NPC: We have a freelance detective working for us who is out there now trying to hack into Tangents servers, but he needs help and we are short on man power.

Your response: Fine, I'll go help out.

Your response: No thanks. I don't think I want to help someone hack into the computer systems of one of Neocrons largest companies.

NPC: Alright, see you next time.

NPC: Good citizen. If you two are successful then bring back whatever data you can get.

NPC: Are you kidding me? You're my backup? I was expecting at least a copbot or a few mercs.

Your response: Hey! I'm not exactly thrilled to be here either! Jake Hard? What kind of name is that? Might as well call yourself Dick McSteel or something stupid like that.

NPC: You know my cousin Dick? Anyway it doesn't matter. Just watch my back while I hack this thing.

Your response: How long is this going to take?

NPC: I don't know. I got to boot up this piece of crap and it doesn't help that the City Admin gave me a hack tool that's missing three buttons.

Your response: Great.

NPC: Okay let's do this. Keep an eye out, we're in mutant territory and I like my internal organs in their current position.

Your response: Then let's try and get this done quickly.

NPC: Hold on! We got company!

NPC: That was close! See that one muties face?! Stuff of nightmares...

Your response: I know. I was there killing them, remember?

NPC: Yeah, thanks. I got this thing booted up and...what is this operating system? It's so old. What is Windows Vista? Oh it's so clunky and horrible!

Your response: Shit.

NPC: What? What is...huh? This paper clip thing has popped up! GO AWAY!

Your response: Hurry!

NPC: Hiiiiiiiiiiigggghhhhwaaaaaaaaaay toooooooo theeeeee DANGER ZONE!

Your response: CONCENTRATE!

NPC: Oh sorry. I need to just breach this firewall and grab as many files as I can.

Your response: Good. The sooner we're out of here the better.

NPC: Gimme a sec. Wait! You hear that?

Your response: I got this.

NPC: More incoming! Cover me!

NPC: I can't concentrate while those mutants are still attacking us. Kill them!

NPC: I got a load of files off the server. Here, I put them on this data cube.

Your response: Good work, especially considering the circumstances.

NPC: Yeah and this was my first time hacking.

Your response: What?!

NPC: Well thanks for saving my ass. Hope those files help you get those scummy bastards. Say hi to Mrs Jones for me.

NPC: Agent Jones is waiting for you.

NPC: I don't think you have done what I've asked you to. Come back once you have the files from the Tangent servers.

NPC: I was listening in on your little adventure. Sounded fun.

Your response: Real fun babysitting a moron from hordes of mutants. Here's your data cube. This better has been worth it.

NPC: Wow. I'm impressed. The data you got has lists of a few accomplices and there's some victims on here that correlate with NCPD's list of missing people.

Your response: Good. Maybe we can put a stop to all this awful business.

NPC: I need the files from the Tangent servers!

NPC: Taking down a high ranking board member of Tangent will be tough but with this evidence we can build up a solid case against him and a few others.

Your response: What now?

NPC: Need to get some warrants and need to collect a lot of data. Catch me later. Never know who I might need you to babysit. Heh.

NPC: May have some undercover work for you. So put your business face on. Need you to pretend to be Hogarth's new supplier of human misery.

Your response: Let's hope this goes better than last time.

NPC: We need to get an audio confession from him. The more evidence we get against him the better. We'll tap into your comms.

Your response: When do I start?

NPC: Soon. At the moment we're trying to get some evidence from one of Hogarth's victims who escaped from captivity.

Your response: You have one of his slaves?

NPC: Yes. She's in witness protection at NCPD Head Quarters. She's really shook up and we can't get anything from her.

Your response: Maybe...I could speak to her. It's got to be worth a shot.

NPC: Fine. Saves me water boarding her.

Your response: Not exactly a people person are you?

NPC: No, not really. Okay try and get her to talk. If you are successful then go after Hogarth. Our surveillance drones suggest he can be found in Pepper Park Sector 3 by the apartments.

NPC: Huh? Hey...what do you want?

Your response: Sarah, is it? My R.P.O.S. says that's your name.

NPC: Yeah... Please make it stop...

Your response: What's wrong?

NPC: I need fix..a...I need destrosol...destrosol forte...

Your response: Drugs? I don't think I can get you drugs. We're surrounded by cops.

NPC: Please...it hurts so bad....I feel so sick...destrosol forte...

Your response: Okay. I'll try...

NPC: Have you got...some stuff to help me?

Your response: Here it is. Take it out my hand quick. I could get into a lot of trouble for this.

NPC: Please. I'm begging you. Destrosol forte!!!

NPC: Ooooohhhh thank you! I'm so sorry. It's...I...I never used to be an addict but the guy who kidnapped me got me hooked on this stuff. He got us all on it.

Your response: It's alright. You're safe now. I'm working with the NCPD and I'm trying to stop the guy that hurt you. If you can tell me about what you went through it would really help.

NPC: Okay.....er my sister Eve and I...we lived in Tech Haven....out in the Wastelands. One day we were fixing our hover tech bikes outside...and...

Your response: What happened, Sarah?

NPC: We...heard a sound of electricity and....we suddenly got hit by something...we felt paralyzed...and I saw a man in a suit looking over us...

Your response: Then what happened?

NPC: Some guys picked us up and put us in a...transport carrier...I kept falling asleep. Didn't see much or where we went...

Your response: You're being extremely helpful. Just keep trying to remember. Okay?

NPC: S-sure...my sister and I...we woke up in a really nice apartment...we heard music and voices. We were dressed in pretty clothes and had really nice make up...

Your response: Okay...

NPC: They did things to uu-s...

Your response: Hey just try and get it all out. Get through this bad memory.

NPC: Men in suits. Laughing. Touching us. They drugged me and Eve...Other girls there...crying....errrr...one man choked Eve. He kept choking her AND LAUGHING!

Your response: ....

NPC: STOP! I screamed. They killed her...I got hit by a guy...maybe two. They beat me and...things. I got out. I escaped one day.

Your response: How?

NPC: Man who worked with NExT tried to attack me. I bit his nose...ran to the elevator...ran as fast I could. Got out. Woke up here.

Your response: You're safe now.

NPC: Please I don't want to remember any more!

Your response: You don't have to. My comms are being monitored. What you said will be used as testimony in court.

NPC: Oh. Will you stop the guy who did this?

Your response: Yeah. Something like that....

NPC: Thank you.

NPC: Please I don't want to talk about it any more.

NPC: I have no idea why you are talking to me.

NPC: Hello there. What can I do for you?

Your response: Hello, Edward Hogarth is it?

NPC: Yes, that's right. What do you want? My time is quite precious at the moment.

Your response: I represent your business partner...ahem...Mr. McFace. I'm his new supplier of wares, if you catch my meaning.

NPC: No.

Your response: Hhhhmmm? Excuse me?

NPC: No. You are a lapdog for the NCPD. I've had my eye on your and the NCPD's recent actions.

Your response: I'll drop the act then. Just come with me. No point in making this difficult.

NPC: The NCPD must be feeling the power slipping from their fingers. I mean they have hired some lowly runner off the streets to do their bidding.

Your response: The same lowly runner who has helped get enough incriminating evidence against you and your pals to get you locked away for good.

NPC: You have nothing. Hell, I have a few members of the NCPD on my pay roll. And who do you think supplies the NCPD with their guns? Corporations rule Neocron. Not the City Admin.

Your response: I will stop you. I'm putting an end to your despicable business.

NPC: I have infiltrated City Admin's servers. I can make Copbots do my bidding at the click of my fingers. I have ties to all the major corporations too. Now that is power.

Your response: Last chance. Come quietly.

NPC: I will put you down. Then I will continue selling human life to privileged citizens and I will sell cheap. I might even keep you alive and have you passed around a depraved orgy.

Your response: Protocol be damned. I'm taking you out. NCPD if you're hearing this: I quit.

NPC: You're brave but foolish. Now let me show you what real power is...

Your response: This is for Eve.

NPC: Haha!

NPC: Talk to Sarah Kocher and visit Edward Hogarth in Pepper Park 3 afterwards.

NPC: You did good out there. Didn't go to plan, but still good.

Your response: Well yeah, thanks.

NPC: Commissioner Merrick was quite impressed with your performance.

Your response: Commissioner Merrick? Who's that?

NPC: He is the Commanding Officer of one of our Special Forces. He should be at the NCPD Headquarters at the moment.

Your response: I might visit him in a while.

NPC: You don't have to. He wants to talk to you via my personal communicator.

Your response: Alright. Let's hear.

NPC: Merrick: Greetings citizen. Firstly let me start by apologizing for putting you into such dangerous situations. The NCPD want you to know that this is not how we normally operate, but we face difficult times and our resources are stretched.

Your response: What is going on? Feel like I've been going on suicide missions.

NPC: Merrick: City Admin and NCPD derive a lot of the strength from the illusion of power and security we erect around ourselves. The truth is we are struggling.

Your response: How come?

NPC: Merrick: Not too hard to see why. We need to protect our citizens, stop street gangs in Pepper Park, protect Neocron from terrorists and, as you have seen, keep an eye on Neocron's corporations.

Your response: I guess you have your hands full.

NPC: Merrick: Indeed. So it is no surprise when someone occasionally gets through our blind spot in surveillance or we don't have enough people to react to injustice.

Your response: Sounds like the City Admin isn't as powerful as people think.

NPC: Merrick: The City Admin will function just fine as long as there are runners like you who will help in times of need. You have done a great service not just for the NCPD but for Neocron.

Your response: What will you do with all the evidence?

NPC: Merrick: The City Admin will hold onto the evidence and keep the corporations in check.

Your response: Blackmail then.

NPC: Merrick: I suppose you could use that terminology. We do what we must. I'm afraid I cannot offer much for your services. As stated we are struggling with resources. Regardless here is 20,000 nc and the NCPD's gratitude.

Your response: Thanks.

NPC: Merrick: One more thing: our operative Agent Jones would like to talk to you again before your services are terminated. Merrick out.

Your response: Thanks again and cya.

NPC: You proved to be quite the bad ass. Hate to admit it but you made me proud. Good job.

Your response: Hopefully we can help out some of the victims and their families.

NPC: Thanks to your actions we've found a lot of missing people. Quite a few of them have suffered severe mental trauma, but nothing a trip to MC5 can't fix.

Your response: MC5?

NPC: Hhhmmm? What? Anyway it's been a pleasure working with you.

Your response: Yeah. Guess this is it then.

NPC: Guess so. By the way our last undercover agent took a shotgun blast to the head. The NCPD is bio reprocessing his body today. He had some serious hardware implanted into him, be a shame for it to go to waste.

Your response: You're giving me a dead guy's implants?

NPC: No need to thank me. You know the City Admin is thinking of starting up a black ops initiative soon. We'll keep you in mind, agent.....

entries.details:
CONTACT
Jay Florish / Special Agent

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Briefcase

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Briefcase
• Core Vest

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at least 25; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Our data analysts at the NCPD HQ are the best in their field! According to the NCPD HQ there is only one place where you need Antidote VII. Search for Steve Core! He is hiding in a sewer in Viarosso Sector 3, deep inside!

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: You again? Good job last time, but there is nothing you can do for me at the moment.

NPC: You look wet behind the ears come see me when you've got some experience.

NPC: Hey Runner! Is there anything you want to know?

Your response: What does the NCPD actually do?

NPC: The NCPD is omnipresent. We maintain law and order in Neocron. We ensure that Neocron is safe and all the scum disappears. In our NCPD headquarters, located in Viarosso Sec 3, we do mostly administrative work.

Your response: Administrative work?

NPC: Sure. From here we coordinate our CopBot and S.T.O.R.M.-Bot units that guarantee the safety of all law-abiding citizens.
And a violation of our laws has only one answer...

Your response: What can the NCPD and the city do for me?

NPC: Do not ask what your city can do for you, ask what you can do for your city.

Your response: Does not sound very tempting. Good bye!

Your response: Okay! What can I do for you?

NPC: Are you sure? It can be quite tricky and dangerous!

Your response: Yeah, I'm sure! Let's start, Sir!

NPC: Sign up to Officer Jenna, she will give you further instructions. You can find Officer Jenna in the NCPD Headquarters.

Your response: Aye, Aye Sir!

NPC: Egoist! Bye!

NPC: You're still here? Get moving!

NPC: You need an escort service to find Officer Jenna?

NPC: Hey Runner, good to see you! Special Agent Jay Florish told me that you would come here. All you hear now is top secret!

Your response: Of course! You can trust me, Officer Jenna!

Your response: Erm, no. Thanks.

NPC: Don't waste my time! Come see me when you've got some experience, bye!

NPC: We have you already checked and increased your security level. Secret information have come to public, we need to find the spy and stop his transmissions! Other publications would be catastrophic! 
 The NCPD stands for: Honesty, law and order. Such a serious offense we must not tolerate! Our CopBots are working day and night in order to protect the honest citizens. These criminals attempt to destroy our work again and again! We can not tolerate that!

Your response: A Spy?

NPC: We were able to intercept a secret transmission. The Spy is believed to be right outside our front door, we have to find him. The transmission could not be fully deciphered. We know only this:
 A guy named 'Bud Corn' should have passed on the information, but we could not locate him - Find and interrogate him. When you're done, come back to me!

NPC: What are you doing here? Piss off!

Your response: Calm down! I only want some information!

NPC: You know what to do. Go to Jenna!

NPC: Do I look like I would tell you anything? Probably not...

Your response: Either you talk to me or I call the NCPD - Let's see what CopBots do with a spy!

NPC: Spy? Me? Are you kidding?

Your response: I'm not kidding! You have published secret information - You're under arrest now!

NPC: NO! 
 Someone fooled me! I am innocent!

Your response: But you know something about that? Tell me - Who is the real spy?

NPC: I have heard a few rumors...
For a few credits I'll tell you!

entries.conversation:
NPC: Greetings! You are arriving right in time!

Your response: Sorry, no time for gossiping. Bye!

Your response: For what?

NPC: I don't think that the Mysterious Maze would be a challenge for you anymore. Better look somewhere else.

NPC: I don't think you are ready for our challenge. Come back when you are a bit more experienced.

NPC: As you wish. Just come back when you feel like having some action and thrill.

NPC: For some mutant hunting, of course! You really like someone who wants to spice up his life a bit.

Your response: Hunting mutants? Are you crazy!? The poor mutants!

Your response: Hmm, sounds good. What's the price?

NPC: You get this wrong. The mutants in our Pepper Maze are realistic holograms which can even cause real damage to you! Of course the use of the Maze is at your own risk and responsibility. You can't assert any claims against us concerning any costs you get in succession.

Your response: Hmm, and why should I do it then?

NPC: Because it is fun! Imagine the thrill while fighting your enemy! And you can proove your skills to yourself and your friends!

Your response: Hmm, sounds good. What's the price?

NPC: The price for one turn Pepper Maze is just 100nc. But you can win a prize of 1000nc if you successfully complete the task!

Your response: Sounds great! But what is that task?

NPC: Great! You won't regret this. There are three mutant bosses inside the Maze. Just kill them all! Of course you have to fight your way past their bodyguards. But be careful! These bosses are tough guys! Come back to me when you have completed the task and I will pay you 1000nc!

Your response: Hmm, nice. But not now. Bye!

Your response: Ok, I am ready.

NPC: As you wish. Just come back when you feel like having some action and thrill.

NPC: Have fun and good luck!

NPC: Great job! You've got them all! I knew you would do it!

Your response: Easy! You should see me when I am really in action!

NPC: You haven't killed all bosses yet!

NPC: You haven't killed all bosses yet!

NPC: You haven't killed all bosses yet!

NPC: Of course! Here, your prize: 100nc! You've really earned it! If you want to try it again and get rid of some frustrations just come back. You can visit the Maze 24/7.

Your response: I am sure I will. Thank you and good bye!

NPC: Have an enjoyable and productive day!

entries.details:
CONTACT
Dixon Grace

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• *Unidentified* Expensive Tech Part
• *Unidentified* Lowtech Part
• *Unidentified* Tech Part

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at least 50; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• I did everything I can for you, you should find and solve the next riddle to proceed! You should try to find Ye Lim in the wastelands.

• Fun sounds good. Always! I suggest the Pepper Park for fun, but maybe I can help you with the stuff part...

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: I did everything I can for you, you should find and solve the next riddle to proceed! You should try to find Ye Lim in the wastelands.

NPC: Come back as soon as you gained some experience! '(/50)'

NPC: Hey... You! Ya, you! Why are you lurking around here?

Your response: Me? I'm looking for fun, for nice stuff.

Your response: Fuck off! It's none of your business!

NPC: What the...

NPC: Fun sounds good. Always! I suggest the Pepper Park for fun, but maybe I can help you with the stuff part...

Your response: Go ahead.

NPC: If you do something for me I could give you a part of the riddle.

Your response: Dude, I dont have time for this shit! What's the point? Which riddle?

NPC: The 'RAPTURE' riddle of course... It's a journey you will never forget.

Your response: Sounds like work... I'm out!

Your response: Oh boy... Go ahead.

NPC: ...

NPC: So, you're interested?

Your response: Yeah, sure, why not... What is it you want? Credits?

NPC: I don't need your Credits... Nobody in the wastes does. I only accept rare parts for my knowledge and stuff... a lot of them...

Your response: Oh dear... How many?

NPC: I want 45 rare parts. Give them to me and in return I will give you my knowledge about the 'Rapture'.
Yes, the Rapture, that's the mysterious thing everyone wants these days.

Your response: 45 rare parts? Are you nuts?

NPC: You can try it somewhere... suit yourself... *smiles*

Your response: Maybe we can negotiate the amount?

NPC: Nope! 45 rare parts or leave me alone!

Your response: Fine... any specific type?

NPC: I want 15 *Unidentified* Expensive Tech Parts, 15 *Unidentified* Tech Parts and 15 *Unidentified* Lowtech Parts!

Your response: I'm sorry I've asked...

NPC: Less talking!

NPC: I did everything I can for you, you should find and solve the next riddle to proceed!

NPC: Come back a soon as you gained some experience! '(/50)'

NPC: Hello runner!

Your response: What are you doing here, out in the wastes?

Your response: Fuck off!

NPC: ...

NPC: Protecting my territory!

Your response: The wastes are yours?

NPC: Yes, sure...

Your response: Aha, okay...

NPC: What's your excuse for being here?

Your response: Dixon Grace sent me to find you. He told me you could help to proceed with a riddle he gave me.

NPC: Dixon Grace you say? This stupid Idiot! What was that riddle about?

Your response: It was the 'RAPTURE' riddle. He gave me a 'Reinforced Barrel' and said: 'Go, find Ye Lim'!

NPC: OK. Thats interesting. I have heard something about these 'Components'.

Your response: WAAAAIT! WHAT?! You know about it?

NPC: Sure I do... I even have a part of it here, well to be exact I do have a 'Targeting Computing Module' laying around here...

Your response: What do you want for it?

NPC: I have everything I need... You can't pay me!

Your response: Let's give it a try! What do you need?

NPC: Well... There might be something...

Your response: Yes? Spit it out! I'll do anything!

NPC: Anything? Interesting!
Like I said this is my territory and I have to protect it! You could help me with it.

Your response: Sure, what do you need? Some fences?

NPC: Not fences, no. I need you to kill those annoying fire creatures (Doomreaper, Terror Leaper, Terror Raptor, Grim Chaser or Grim Persecutor). 100 to be precise.
It's either that or nothing!

NPC: There you are! How are you? Have you finished your job?

Your response: I thought that was going to be easier than it was...

NPC: What part of kill 100 fire creatures didn't you get?

NPC: There you go - Take the 'Targeting Computing Module' and have fun!
And no, I don't know where to find more of that weapon, find it our yourself... Cya!

entries.details:
CONTACT
Maison Donovan

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at least 50; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

entries.conversation:
NPC: I did everything I can for you, you should find and solve the next riddle to proceed!

NPC: Come back as soon as you gained some experience! '(/50)'

NPC: All those Robots... We have to defeat them!

Your response: Excuse me?

Your response: Erm ya... Bye!

NPC: Bye!

NPC: You don't see it? Robots all over the place! Coming from the laboratory! They're threatening us! We have to act! NOW!

Your response: Wohoo, easy bro! What happened?

NPC: Really? Don't you see it? They're killing our people! They're destroying our homes! Our beloved wastelands...

Your response: Yes... beloved wastelands, sure. You've been here quite a while, eh?

NPC: Instead of laughing you should help me!

Your response: Only if you pay me!

NPC: I can't offer you rare parts or credits, the stuff everyone wants nowadays. The rarest thing I have is a 'Slipstream Matrix' for the 'Rapture'.

Your response: Do you? I've been looking for it for ages!

Your response: I just want credits or rare parts - Good luck though, bye!

NPC: Don't say you have not been warned! Bye!

NPC: I do. If you want it, I need you to kill some Robots!

Your response: Shoot!

Your response: Sure, I have.

NPC: Good job! Thank you very much, another step was made here!

Your response: Ya... My 'Slipstream Matrix', please?

NPC: There you go - Have a nice, productive day!

Your response: Erm ya... Bye!

Your response: I have! Now my reward!

NPC: If you want it, prepare yourself better and try again! Talk to me, when you're ready.

NPC: There you go - Have a nice, productive day!

NPC: I am not available for you. Move out!

NPC: I don't think you are experienced enough to work for me. Get some training and come back when you can stand on your own feet!

NPC: Goddamn! Who has allowed you to disturb me while I am on duty?! STAND STILL WHEN I TALK TO YOU, SOLDIER!!

Your response: Err, sorry, that was the wrong door I guess. I'll leave ya.

Your response: Sorry?

Your response: Sir, yes, sir!

NPC: Ah, you again. I hope you are still at your best as you were on your last mission. We CityMercs should be happy to have you on our side. Move out!

NPC: Then do it!

NPC: That should be 'Sir, yes, sir'!! I see, we have a deadbeat civilian here! STAND STILL, I SAID! Did you ever use a weapon? And no, I am not talking about these kid's guns!

Your response: Oh yes, I did! Hunting rats with a nailgun in the sewers was really fun, I tell ya!

NPC: I have a hint for you.

Your response: Yes?

NPC: TURN AROUND AND MOVE OUT NOW! .... Hunting rats in the sewers... Why me?

NPC: Okay, soldier. Let's get back to business. Our Wasteland Patrols reported about an increased warbot population in the sectors next to our base. Our task is to reduce that population. Several important trade routes are in danger and have to be safeguarded. Your mission, soldier: Destroy 45 of these Warbots out there. That should be enough for now. When you are done, come back to me and report!

Your response: 45 Warbots? You're nuts, that will be my death! I think I better leave you alone now...

Your response: Sir, yes, sir! I will complete this mission to your utter satisfaction. It is an honour to serve the CityMercs!

NPC: YOU LOUSY DEADBEAT! GET OUT OFF MY EYES!!

NPC: Okay, let's see if you can handle this. If you are successfull I already have a new mission for you. So don't disappoint me, soldier! Move out!

NPC: You report, soldier!

Your response: Sir, 45 Warbots were destroyed as you ordered, sir!

NPC: WHAT THE HELL ARE YOU DOING HERE??? GET OUT AND COMPLETE YOUR MISSION NOW, SOLDIER!! MOVE OUT!!

NPC: Good job, soldier! Seems like you are ready for a new mission.

Your response: Sir, thanks, Sir. I am ready for a new mission, sir!

NPC: One of our secret messengers is M.I.A. He was on his way to military base. His last known position was inside the Tunnel T of the Dome of York tunnel network.

Your response: Sir, what's so important about this messenger, sir?

NPC: I am the one who asks the questions, soldier! I can't tell you any more about this. All you need to know is that the messenger carries data fragments of the utmost importance. We have to get them as soon as possible.

Your response: Sir, sounds like a mission for me, sir!

NPC: That's what I thought as well. Find this messenger - or what's left of him - inside the DoY tunels and get me the data fragments. So much is depending on them.

Your response: Sir, you can count on me, sir!

NPC: Great. Move out!!

NPC: **This seems to be the corpse of the messenger**

Your response: - Examine corpse

NPC: **Found data fragments**

NPC: **You don't find anything useful here**

NPC: Your report, soldier!

Your response: Sir, I found the messenger as you ordered, sir!

NPC: WHAT THE HELL ARE YOU DOING HERE??? GET OUT AND COMPLETE YOUR MISSION NOW, SOLDIER!! MOVE OUT!!

NPC: And? Where is he?

Your response: Sir, the messenger is dead, sir

NPC: That's a pity. I hope you at least found the data fragments I need?

Your response: Sir, yes, sir!

NPC: I am surprised. We don't have many soldiers as capable as you.

Your response: Sir, thanks, sir! Is there more I can do?

NPC: Are you kidding me? There are no data fragments! MOVE OUT!! HURRY!

NPC: First we need to analyse these data fragments. As soon as I have the report I might have some new instructions for you. Come back in about ten minutes. Move out!

NPC: Stand comfortable! I have some worrying news.

Your response: Sir, you have my full attention, sir!

NPC: The fragments are not analysed yet. Don't be so impatient, soldier. Move out!

NPC: The cover of one of our spies who was infiltrating the Twilight Guardian is about to be blown by someone. This someone should be eliminated immediately. Move to Neocron City and look for Arnsgar Johannson in Pepper Park Sec-2. Johannson is our undercover agent in the City. He will give you more instructions. Move out!

NPC: Finally you are here. This bum almost blew my cover. Just because I had some fun with his wife!

Your response: Interesting. And how did he find out about your real affiliation to the CityMercs?

NPC: Err... well... *cough* I think I was a bit drunk and stoned when I had fun with his wife. Maybe I have said some things I shouldn't have said - and wouldn't have said normally!

Your response: I am at loss for words... I don't want to critisize you, but that is the silliest thing you can do as a spy in enemy territory. Perhaps I should leave you to these guys punishment!

NPC: What?? You.. You can't do this man! They will hang me right in front of their office and dance around my dead body!!

Your response: Interesting idea... I will help you, but just because it's my job!

NPC: That puts me at ease! The main thing is you kill this guy!

Your response: What's the targets name and where can I find him?

NPC: You can find Hogan Dunfield in Pepper Park Sec-3. Be careful, that is enemy territory. I am sure you will manage this.

Your response: Sounds like fun... Don't move till I'm back!

NPC: As long as that guy's running loose, I'm not leaving this spot! And as soon as I get verified that he is dead I will get out of the line of fire for some days. Report directly to Master Sergeant Harrison as soon as you have done your job.

NPC: You saved my life! I will never forget about that! Hurry! Master Sergeant Harrison is already waiting for you and it is not a good idea to let him wait.

NPC: That guy is still alive! Eliminate him and report to Master Sergeant Harrison!

NPC: Stand comfortable! Your report?

Your response: Sir, target eliminated, %NPC_NAME(0) is alive. He is hiding for a while till time has poured some oil on troubled water.

NPC: WHAT THE HELL ARE YOU DOING HERE??? GET OUT AND COMPLETE YOUR MISSION NOW, SOLDIER!! MOVE OUT!!

NPC: That's music in my ears! You are doing a damn good job, soldier! Your efforts will be awarded. For your loyal services I hereby decorate you with the 'City Mercs Elite Merecenary Cross'.

Your response: Sir, I feel honored, sir!

Your response: Sir, I am proud to be a CityMerc!

entries.details:
CONTACT
Commissioner Lightfield

POSSIBLE COST
• 1,400 credits (depends on choice)

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at least 55; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• The activities of the 'Dragons Wrath' thief gang in the outzone are alarming. Just recently our suspicion was  confirmed that criminal groups from the dome are hiding behind this name. They are trying to damage our economy by flooding our market with stolen ware.

• You got it. His name is 'Johnny Five' and he was last seen in industrial sector 1. We believe he is still hiding there, maybe you have to ask some people. Find him and kill this bastard without getting to much attention! When you have completed this task, come back and report to me! Ahh, and maybe you shouldn't go alone, this can be dangerous!

• Great job! Let's see, perhaps you are really a worthy aspirant. I already have a new mission for you. NEXT Systems is missing one of their field workers. This employee was last seen doing some measuring in Outzone Sec-1. That's why we expected him to be dead now. Find his remains and bring us his Dogtag as evidence. I have a feeling that the 'Dragons Wrath' has something to with this. Be careful!

• I knew it! So these criminals are more active than we thought. It is time to set a sign. Our informants have send some reports about a dangerous boss of the Dragon's Wrath. His name is Pavel 'The Tulip' Kowalski and we know that he want to marry a whore inside the old church in the outzone today. You know the place in Outzone sector 5. Dishonor the wedding celebrations and kill that scum! But be carefull, I am sure Pavel has lots of bodyguards around him. But don't kill that bitch! If Pavel doesn't show up himself she might be able to help you to get him. I want a report as soon as you have accomplished this mission.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Cypher

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: You again? I don't think people should see us talk. Keep moving!

NPC: What's up?

Your response: Judging from the way you are sitting around here you seem to be searching for someone to take over a job.
 And as it happens I'm free right now, and really could use some credits.

NPC: Do I look like the Job Center? Get lost!

Your response: If I wanted to kill vermin I'd be asking them. But I'm no amateur! I'm good at what I'm doing, discreet and
 completely loyal to my employer. Meanwhile YOU are sitting here, in one of the cities most frequented
 places with a high-end tablet while having UBER-HAXOR written all over your face! And you want to tell
 me you are not looking for a contractor?

NPC: Well... yeah. Is it really that obvious? Okay. At least you seem to be observant. If you are still interested, talk to Johnny Matrix at the Electric Vibes Club.

Your response: See? Wasn't that hard. They always have to act coy...

NPC: You are still here?! Get moving!

NPC: Johnny Matrix, Electric Vibes Club. Do you need an entry into your little quest-log before you move or what?!

NPC: Ah, Detective Wannabe. Cypher told me you was on the way. Want a drink?

Your response: Let's cut the smalltalk and get to business. What job could a bunch of hackers have for me?

NPC: Hackers? What Hacker?

Your response: Come on. I already had that discussion with the nerd at the Garriots. Look in the mirror! And then your
 nicknames... Cypher, Matrix... I guess the next one in line will be Trinity.

NPC: Trini... err yeah. Let's assume we are an organisation of hackers that have a job to offer and let's further assume that I'm the person on the front line, to test potential candidates for their loyalty and discretion. What could you offer to me?

Your response: Do I have to kill someone so you got something on me? Or some security services? Spit it out, dude!

NPC: Well, you ARE clever. Some personal security. Exactly that!

Your response: And what did you have in mind exactly?

NPC: Well, usually our contractors just need to provide us with their GenrepID-code to enjoy our complete trust.

Your response: MY ... GENREPID? You want...no, I'm not stupid enough! Have you any idea what people can do with that information?

NPC: Well, obviously we do, that's why we want them of course. Trust requires trust, doesn't it?

Your response: No reward could be big enough that I give you guys my ID. I'll pass.

NPC: You really have no other choice, we are hackers. The best! From the moment Cypher send you over here we gathered everything about you that we need. Your done. Every little job you can take helps you and what we have to offer is BIG! It could really change the world. And I offer you the opportunity to be a part of it. That's an offer you can't refuse.

Your response: Hm. No risk no fun, eh? Okay, it's stupid but I'll do it. My GenrepID-Code : 0815X1337AI

NPC: Welcome to the club, you won't regret your decision. With your ID we can send you through the Genrep system. Anything further will be discussed in our local activity hub here in the city. Ready?

Your response: Local activity... hub?! So you hacked the Genreps? That's mad skill, actually. Guess I'm with the right people
 after all. Ready!

NPC: Energy!

NPC: Was there an error? Energy!

NPC: Finally. Sit down, I'll just have to finish something here..

Your response: TRINITY !?... muhahaha I called it. I CALLED IT! I'm brilliant!

NPC: I have no idea what you are doing here. Get the hell out and talk to Johnny Matrix first!

NPC: Calm down and shut up for a moment. Or you are gone faster than you can realize.

Your response: Okay, okay, it's just... alright, I'm silent now.

NPC: So, let's talk real.

Your response: *mumble* I don't believe it, she's really called Trinity.. ehrm sorry, again?

NPC: As you already guessed, we are hackers. The fact that we took complete control over the Genrep system should tell you what we are capable of.

Your response: Yeah, pretty cool.

NPC: One of our top priority targets for many years now is the MC5-facility of the City Admin and we are SO close to get access to it.

Your response: Wait a moment, this ominous MC5 conspiracy theory is for real? This brain washing stuff too?

NPC: Of course it's real. People like you that doubt it's existence are the reason why we try to uncover the truth about the City Admins operations.

Your response: Now it's getting interesting, keep on talking!

NPC: As a matter of fact we already penetrated their systems quite far. A few weeks ago we hit the jackpot. We found a data storage that is incredibly safeguarded and almost impossible to break into.

Your response: -go on-

NPC: At first it seemed like they really had a hermetically isolated encryption method. But we managed to pull some single data strings from the storage.

Your response: -go on-

NPC: However we haven't been able to make much sense of it yet. There are some phrases that keep getting repeated, like -NST- -NCC- or -Reakktor-. Except for the poor spelling on -Reactor- we have no idea yet what we got here.

Your response: -go on-

NPC: Anyway, because of the frequency in it's use we managed to decipher another keyword: -ZOLTAN-. But that was a dead end too. The only records we could find were some old videos where people in self-made plastic dresses worshipped some kind of idol

Your response: Alright, sorry, but for that bullshit I had to give you my ID??

NPC: Don't interrupt me! I'm getting to the core now.

Your response: Okay, sorry.

NPC: We send an operative of our field team straight into the MC5. And before you ask, yes, our influence is THAT big, we can use the Genrep system even for that.

Your response: Wow

NPC: He managed to jack our mobile transmitter into a terminal of their facility. He could log in and send over the first data batches. Then... we lost contact. We have to assume that he was killed.

Your response: That's... sad. What kind of data did you get his time? More words? Maybe -SNOWCRASH-?

NPC: Yes, more words. But again, we have no clue what all those are about. They are names of planets. Mars, Mercury, Terra...

Your response: PLANETNAMES? WOW, now I know the names of the planets of our solar system.
 JUST had to give away my Genrep-ID...

NPC: Ugh, well, we have two theories. It's either connected to the colonization mission to Irata III or it could be some kind of interplanetary defense system. Even if it's not connected to any of these theories, it might just be the proof of what is really going on in MC5.

Your response: Seriously? Okay, that sounds more interesting.

NPC: We need more data. ALL data, and for that we have to resume transmission from the terminal in the MC5 facility. That's going to be your job. As a reward we settled on sharing all data that we find in the storage. Are you in?

Your response: Well, that sounds pretty nice and all, but how do I get there? I don't even know where to go.

NPC: Don't worry your little head about that. Report to Scotty in his little workshop in the back. He will take care of the transport.

NPC: Scotty is really an impatient guy. Get going!

NPC: Yo! Ready for a field trip?

Your response: Wouldn't call that just a field trip. Anything you can tell me would help.

NPC: Until you talk to Trinity I won't lift a finger.

NPC: Okay, the terminal with the transmitter is located directly in the MC5 Command-Unit. We deactivated any security protocols, you shouldn't meet any obstructions. You go in, activate the transmitter and move out again.

Your response: Sounds easy enough, but how the hell do I get there?

NPC: That's my job. My little baby here will get you right in there.

Your response: Your... BABY?

NPC: My newest invention. To put it simple, I crossed the technology of the Venture Warp with that of the Genrep. The result makes it possible to send you wherever I want, without needing a Genrep as destination. I call the system ENTERPRISE-Warp10.

Your response: Unbelievable! Okay, I'm ready!

NPC: Be careful and hurry up! If City Admin detects that we have deactivated their security protocols, they might just shut down all their servers. If this happens, I won't be able to warp you back!

Your response: Got it!

NPC: Remember to activate the data-transmitter at the MC5 Terminal sec 10.1a as soon as you arrive. Once the transmitter is online I should be able to contact you via the terminal.

Your response: Come on, just push the button!

NPC: Energise!

NPC: Was there an error? Energise!

NPC: CITY ADMINISTRATION-DATASTORAGE MC5

Your response: ACTIVATE TRANSMITTER

NPC: Scotty: Security protocols are still active! Talk to me in the apartment first and get outta there immediately!

NPC: Phoenix NC OS V2.2.198
 Loading...

 NCAPS...OK
 Com-Bridge...OK
 P.K.E.R.S...OK
 Vedeena...OK
 Luna...OK
 Balance...OK
 Wintermute...OK
 Uplink - Northstar...OK
 Uplink - Tescom...OK
 Uplink - Sieger...OK
 Uplink - Tristar...OK
 Uplink - Hawkins...OK
 Uplink - Cajun...OK
 Uplink - Crest...OK
 Uplink - Foster...OK

Your response: -continue-

NPC: Searching for databases to mount...
 Found 3 databases to mount.

 Mounting Terra database to /mnt/data/terra...OK
 Mounting Mercury database to /mnt/data/mercury...OK
 Mounting Mars database to /mnt/data/mars...OK

 CharT.........

 CITYADMIN FIREWALL: INTRUDER DETECTED
 SERVERSHUTDOWN INITIATED

Your response: NOOO!

NPC: Scotty: How did they track us? This is bad, really bad! I could not fetch ANY of the data, it's all lost! Get outta there before they find you. But hurry up, I can not keep the warpgate open any longer!

Your response: Don't leave me behind! GET ME OUT OF HERE!

NPC: Scotty: Activate the terminal again, we might have ONE TRY to warp you out!

entries.details:
CONTACT
Not identified in the client NPC definitions.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: You've got exactly 10 seconds to get the hell out of here before things get really uncomfortable for you!

Your response: HOLD ON! I've been looking for you.

NPC: ...9!

Your response: Relax! I need your help!

Your response: Okay, fine then.

NPC: ...8!

Your response: I'm willing to pay for it!

NPC: You think I can be bought? ...3!

Your response: If you help me, I'll do you any favor you want!

NPC: ... ANY favor? Fine, you've got another 10 seconds. This time to explain why you're here and what you want from me.

Your response: I found an item out in the swamps and heard you're the only one who can help me with it.

NPC: What kind of item? I doubt there's anything out here that could be interesting or even valuable.

Your response: Here, see for yourself.

Your response: Then I'd rather keep it.

NPC: Holy shit! This thing is completely contaminated with shaman toxin! Here, take it back. Found it, you say? You don't just 'find' something like this. Where did you get it?

Your response: Well, 'found' might be an understatement. I...

NPC: You've got nothing? Nothing at all? Was that all a lie? This time the countdown starts at 5... 4...

NPC: ...gutted a Swamp Shaman after killing it?

Your response: I... I... it's not what it looks like!

NPC: I damn well hope it's EXACTLY what it looks like!

Your response: I'm sorry... wait, what did you just say?

NPC: That I hope you nailed one of those filthy beasts. What do you think I'm doing out here? I research these swamp creatures. Their toxins, their poison glands, their antidotes, everything.

Your response: Yeah, but...

NPC: They're hardly going to hand over their bodies voluntarily, are they? I kill them and cut them open so I can study them.

Your response: Oh okay, that explains the rumor that you're the expert on my... item.

NPC: I'm the only one who can decontaminate that thing for you. It won't be easy though. Every shaman has its own unique toxin signature, but it's doable.

Your response: So you'll help me?

NPC: Remember your promise to do me ANY favor? I certainly hope so, because one hand washes the other, right?

Your response: Uh yeah, so what is this favor about?

NPC: My work here doesn't exactly make me friends with the creatures inhabiting these swamps. I hunt and kill them, and they fear and hate me. Lately, they seem to be organizing and planning something against me.

Your response: -continue-

NPC: Their leaders, the Kri'nakh Shamans, hide in the underground caves throughout the swamps and rule over all swamp creatures from there.

Your response: -continue-

NPC: If I'm going to stay here, we need to put a stop to their schemes and attacks against me. One of their leaders has to die!

Your response: We are supposed to kill a Kri'nakh Shaman? Have you gone insane?

NPC: No, not we, YOU! That's the deal. I decontaminate your item, and in return, you get rid of my little shaman problem.

Your response: I don't think I can do that.

NPC: Then you better learn fast! You can find the Kri'nakh in any Swamp Cave around these swamp sectors. How you do it is up to you, but you should probably bring someone along to help.

Your response: Okay, I'll try.

Your response: No, count me out. Before you start counting again: I'm already leaving!

NPC: Kill a Kri'nakh Shaman. If you loot any 'Kri'nakh Poison Glands' from the creatures in the cave, keep them! We'll likely need them for the decontamination later.

Your response: OK.

NPC: Before you go, leave the remains with me. I'll examine them and prepare them for decontamination. Just remember, once you do this, there's no turning back!

Your response: Alright, a deal's a deal!

Your response: I'm supposed to trust you with this thing without knowing if I can even kill the shaman? Forget it!

NPC: Get moving, or do I need to start counting again?

NPC: If you don't want to give me the item, get lost! 5... 4...

NPC: Get lost!

NPC: Not bad at all, %PLAYER_NAME(). The death of one of their leaders clearly shocked the swamp creatures, and they've called off their attacks on me for now.

Your response: So I fulfilled my end of the deal!

NPC: Not a single Kri'nakh Shaman is dead! Don't try to double cross me! You'll find them strictly inside the underground Swamp Caves.

NPC: Yes, you did. In the meantime, I took a closer look at the shaman remains. I'm going to need a few materials for the decontamination process!

Your response: What exactly do you need? I'll see what I can do!

NPC: It's crucial that you listen carefully now and remember what I need. One wrong ingredient and the chance to decontaminate these remains is gone. First, we need 5x Kri'nakh Poison Glands, which hopefully you already gathered during your trip to the Swamp Caves.

Your response: 5x Kri'nakh Poison Glands, okay.

NPC: To weaken the effects of the toxin during the process, I need 1x Immunosuppressive Toxins. You'll have to kill carnivorous swamp plants for those.

Your response: 1x Immunosuppressive Toxins from the plants.

NPC: You can find all the other ingredients on the plants in these swamp sectors as well: 10x Plant Fibres, 1x Fucoxanthim, and 1x Gibberllin.

Your response: Okay, let me double check everything: 5x Kri'nakh Poison Glands, 1x Immunosuppressive Toxins, 10x Plant Fibres, 1x Fucoxanthim, and 1x Gibberllin.

NPC: Well, you're smarter than I thought. That's correct, but don't come back until you have all the ingredients. Hurry up! If the shaman's remains start rotting here, there's nothing more I can do for you.

Your response: I'm on my way!

NPC: 5x Kri'nakh Poison Glands, 1x Immunosuppressive Toxins, 10x Plant Fibres, 1x Fucoxanthim, and 1x Gibberllin.

NPC: About damn time. The carcass is starting to rot and stink up the place! Do you have what I asked for? Let's start with the Kri'nakh Poison Glands.

Your response: I couldn't move any faster! Yes, here they are.

NPC: Okay, these look good.

Your response: What do you need next?

NPC: 5x Kri'nakh Poison Glands.It can't be that hard. Try again...

NPC: How about the Immunosuppressive Toxins? They're one of the most critical parts of the decontamination.

Your response: Who would've thought plants could be so dangerous? It wasn't easy, but I've got what you need.

NPC: Okay, good work.

Your response: What do you need next?

NPC: 1x Immunosuppressive Toxins. They're just plants! It can't be that hard. Try again...

NPC: Let's get to the easiest part. Plain plant fibers shouldn't have been a problem.

Your response: You'd think so... but when the plants fight back and attack you, it's a whole different story.

NPC: Stop whining! At least you managed to gather enough fibers.

Your response: What do you need next?

NPC: 10x Plant Fibres. It can't be that hard. Try again...

NPC: Just 2 more chemicals and you've actually gathered everything. Let's start with Fucoxanthim.

Your response: No problem.

NPC: Looks right. Good work.

Your response: Now there's only one thing left, right?

NPC: 1x Fucoxanthim. It can't be that hard. Try again...

NPC: Yeah, the last ingredient I need is Gibberllin. Do you have that too?

Your response: Here it is. I really hope that's everything now.

NPC: I really didn't think you'd manage to gather everything. Maybe I underestimated you.

Your response: Where do we go from here?

NPC: Seriously? Failing right before the finish line? You're missing 1x Gibberllin.

NPC: Now I'll combine everything and extract a solution to soak the shaman's remains in. That should neutralize its toxin.

Your response: -continue-

NPC: Alright, looking good. Now we just wait a moment for the toxin to dissipate from the cells.

Your response: -continue-

NPC: Done. That worked better and faster than expected. I might even be able to use the result for my research to develop a general antidote against shaman toxins.

Your response: Who would've thought. Maybe you should reconsider your whole countdown routine with visitors. One or two of them might actually turn out useful to you...

NPC: You're walking on thin ice! Do you want your shaman carcass back now or what?

Your response: Yes, absolutely.

NPC: Here, take it. Do whatever you want with it. Nail it to a piece of wood and put it on display somewhere...I couldn't care less. Just get out of my face!
