entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job.

NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Ah, runner. Welcome to Tech Haven - your new home. I hear you're interested in using Drones. We've set up a tutorial for you if you'd like to take part?

Your response: I'm interested.

Your response: I'm sorry, I don't have time right now. Another time?

Your response: I'm not interested in your tasks - please leave.

NPC: Very well, I will remain here for a while. (Return before level /25 to resume.)

NPC: The drone can take a little bit of getting used to - some riggers feel sick when they first interface with the drone's cameras. Other feel a dizziness when breaking the connection. We hope to reduce the discomfort.

Your response: *click*

NPC: We've set up a little introduction at the Drone Race Track. Head down there and speak with Jackie Gnu. She'll guide you through the basics.

NPC: Hello %PLAYER_NAME(), I am Jackie - the Drone Instructor. Do you have any questions before we start?

Your response: What do I need to know about drone movement?

Your response: What do I need to know about attacking and defending?

Your response: No, I just want to practice flying.

Your response: I think I know it all, can I skip the flying lessons? (Skip tutorial)

NPC: Okay - so I gather you've already learned how to launch and fly the drone. So a refresher - you adjust your vertical elevation using [space] and [ctrl] by default. Your pitch and yaw are controlled via your mouse.

Your response: *click*

NPC: You control your forward and backwards movement with [W] and [S] by default. If you fly into things like the ceiling or the floor, your drone might bounce if you're going too quickly.
Generally, this won't damage the drone, but it could lead it to taking extra damage from any enemies in the area due to your momentary loss of control.

Your response: *click*

NPC: I think that covers the basis - do you have any other questions?

Your response: Yeah, could you go over the movement basics again?

Your response: Let's move onto combat

Your response: Let me just practice flying here.

Your response: I'm done, I don't need to practice.

NPC: Combat with Drones is pretty straight forward. [Left Click] attacks your enemy, and depletes the ammo counter. Different types of drones attack in different ways - so feel free to experiment.

Your response: *click*

NPC: [Right click] uses ammo to repair the drone's shields. Always make sure you leave enough ammo for repairs, if the combat is heavy. You regain all your drone's health and shields when you re-launch them.

Your response: *click*

NPC: You also have a readout of your own health - so you can see if you're being attacked. Note that you are able to injure and kill yourself with your own drone if you aren't careful.

Your response: *click*

NPC: I think that covers the basis - do you have any other questions?

Your response: Yeah, could you go over the movement basics?

Your response: Could you repeat what you just said about combat?

Your response: Let me just practice flying here.

Your response: I'm done, I don't need to practice.

NPC: Okay, %PLAYER_NAME(), here's a Scout Drone to practice with. Take all the time you need. Speak with Mrs. Jones back at your apartment when you're done.

NPC: That's fine! Probably an administration error - sending you out to me, eh? Go back to your apartment and speak to Jones. Take a scout drone anyway - I have a bunch of them.

NPC: Mrs. Jones ist waiting!

NPC: Ah, welcome back. Did you enjoy your training session?

Your response: Not really, it wasn't relevant.

Your response: Meh...

Your response: Yeah, it was good!

NPC: Go and speak with Jackie Gnu at the drone track for your training session.

NPC: Oh... I see there was a mix-up, you were meant to head straight onto part two. Apologies for that...

Your response: It's okay... I probably needed to exercise anyway.

NPC: Enthusiasm. That's what I like to see. Now, on to part two...

Your response: *click*

NPC: I'm in the process of arranging a little something for you to begin your droning career with. Speak with me again in a moment.

NPC: Am I right to assume you wish to continue with your induction?

NPC: It's time to continue your training!

Your response: Let's do this!

Your response: I'll come back to you.

NPC: Very well, you know where to find me

NPC: As I mentioned, we're in the process of arranging something a little better than your last drone, to help you with your training.

Your response: *click*

NPC: Head to Tech Haven Sector 3 and speak with Giles Henry, who will be near the City Com terminal. He has some blueprints I need to look over - bring them to me.

NPC: Hello %PLAYER_NAME(), I am Giles Henry, Drone designer and former Drone Racing champion.

Your response: That's... nice. Mrs. Jones said you had something to give to me?

NPC: Yes, she asked me to develop a small, lightweight drone that could be used for training and such. I think will fit his requirements. 
Head back to your apartment and give them to Jones.

NPC: Mrs. Jones is waiting!

NPC: Do you have the plans for me?

Your response: Yes, I have them right here. *hand over plans*

NPC: Come back to me with the drone plans.

NPC: Giles Henry is waiting!

NPC: *Mr Jones skims over the schematics*  
Yes, these look like they'll do nicely.

Your response: What's next?

NPC: Speak with me in a moment, and I will tell you how to proceed.

NPC: Are you ready for your last task?

Your response: Sure, might as well finish this

Your response: I'll come back to you

NPC: Very well, I shall wait here for you.

NPC: Glad to hear it %PLAYER_NAME() - this is a straight forward task, you're going to build the drone.

Your response: Wait? What? I don't have any construction experience.

NPC: Clumsy choice of words. We have a fabricator unit which is programmed with the schematics you brought to me. I need you to go and pick up the finished drone. 
You'll find the fabricator inside the Fallen Angels HQ - speak with Jessica Watson when you get there.

NPC: *Jessica jumps when you talk to her* Oh! Hello there! Are you %PLAYER_NAME()?

Your response: Yeah - Jones sent me to pick up the drone?

NPC: Wow... a drone pilot. I always wanted to be one... but the motion makes me sick. I'm so envious!

Your response: Oh, well... that sucks, I guess.

NPC: Yeah, I mean - being able to fly, man! That's pretty cool. And the drone races! I love them!

Your response: Yeah - so, about the drone?

NPC: Oh, right... sorry. Yeah - here you go... Enjoy being able to fly your drone...

NPC: Mrs. Jones is waiting!

NPC: Did you speak to Jessica?

Your response: Yeah - she reeeeally likes drones...

NPC: Come back once you have spoken with Jessica, %PLAYER_NAME().

NPC: Indeed she does! You should see what happens when she gets near Giles Henry - he has a 'please rescue me' look on his face...

Your response: *click*

NPC: Oh well, here's your drone %PLAYER_NAME(), have fun with it. I'm sure we'll meet again at some point.

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself.

NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Hello Runner, I am Mrs. Jones. I represent the Administration of Tech Haven. I understand that you are a Scientist. Would you be interested in some work?

Your response: I'm not interested in your tasks - please leave.

Your response: I'm sorry, I don't have time right now. Another time?

Your response: I'm interested, how can I help?

NPC: Very well, I will remain here for a while. (Return before level /25 to resume.)

NPC: Tech Haven is the last true bastion of human intellect in the world. We are united by a single goal - the survival of human kind. To achieve that goal, sometimes we need to take less orthodox measures.

Your response: What do you mean?

NPC: We've received reports of Mutants in the wastelands which appear to be communicating rapidly over long distances. We don't believe they have the technology to build normal communication equipment. We're concerned they may have developed another way to communicate.

Your response: Do you mean something like telepathy?

NPC: We don't know at the moment. Our Scouts have recovered a few mutants from the wastes. Their bodies are currently in a lab at the Tech Haven Administration area - being dissected by Doctor Maisee Wong. Go and see if you can be of assistance to their efforts.

NPC: Ah, you must be the Runner that Jones sent - she just contacted me to say that you were coming.

Your response: Jones mentioned that you might need assistance with an autopsy?

NPC: No, not exactly. We've done the majority of it already - but we did find something you might be able to assist with.

Your response: Yeah, of course - how can I help?

NPC: We pulled similar-looking implants out of a number of the mutants. They're too badly damaged for us to send them straight to the technical engineers for testing. So I think we're going to have to involve a researcher to see if they can figure it out. Take it back to Mrs. Jones. I'm sure she'll know someone suitable for the job.

NPC: Mrs. Jones is waiting!

NPC: Ah Runner, that was quick. Did Doctor Wong have any work for you?

Your response: She needs a researcher to investigate an implant pulled from the mutants.

NPC: You need to speak with Dr Wong.

NPC: I need this package!

NPC: Alright, I'll see who's available. Speak with me again in a moment.

NPC: Alright, are you ready to proceed?

Your response: Of course - what's next?

Your response: Not right now, I will be back though.

NPC: Very well, you know where to find me.

NPC: Well, it appears the usual research team I use is unavailable, but I know a suitable alternative. You're going to do it.

Your response: Oh, okay. What do I need to do?

NPC: It's simple enough, make a blueprint of the Mutant Implant, and speak with me when you're done.

NPC: Good work. I didn't doubt you were capable.

Your response: Thanks, what now?

NPC: Come back once you've researched the chip.

NPC: I'm just waiting for confirmation of which technicians need the blueprint. Speak with me again in a minute.

NPC: Alright Runner, I just need you to transport these schematics now.

Your response: Sure, I've got time.

Your response: I have other things to do. I will be back though.

NPC: Very well, you know where to find me.

NPC: I've taken the liberty of encrypting the schematics to this datacube, to ensure the data remains secretive. Take it to Tech Haven Sec-2 and give it to Rees Jamison - he's usually found near the Gene Replicators there.

NPC: Ah great, you've got the schematics?

Your response: Sure, Mrs. Jones encrypted them and stored them on this datacube for you.

NPC: Sorry. Can't talk. Waiting for some important research data.

NPC: Yeah, she's always so careful - especially with things like this. I'll take it from here. You head back to your apartment and speak with Mr Jones again.

NPC: Go speak with Mrs. Jones, at your apartment.

NPC: I take it you already delivered the data?

Your response: Yeah, of course. What's next?

NPC: Take the schematics to Rees Jamison at Tech Haven Sec-2.

NPC: At the moment, nothing from me - but I think we'll be seeing each other again in the future. Until then, take this as a token of gratitude from Techhaven.

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Sorry, but you are definitely over-qualified for this job. Do you want me to leave?

Your response: Yes, please!

NPC: Sorry, but I am not available for you.

NPC: Ah, there you are. Welcome to Tech Haven. I've been reading your notes, and it appears that you are quite handy in a fight. I have something for you, if you're interested?

Your response: I'm interested, how can I help?

Your response: I'm sorry, I don't have time right now. Another time?

Your response: I'm not interested in your tasks - please leave.

NPC: Very well, I will remain here for a while. (Return before level /25 to resume.)

NPC: Good. Now, you've been in MC5 for some time, and I want to make sure none of your motor-functions are impaired. We've set up some training bots in the Drone Racetrack - go and kill 5 of them.

Your response: Are you sure I shouldn't start on sewer rats or something?

NPC: Very funny. Get going.

NPC: Welcome back runner. That was better than a sewer, wasn't it.

Your response: Marginally. What's next?

NPC: Go and finish off the drones, and then we'll talk!

NPC: Well, your biometrics appear fine - so we'll try you with something a little more challenging. Speak with me again in a moment.

NPC: Alright, are you ready to proceed?

Your response: Of course - what's next?

Your response: Not right now, I will be back though.

NPC: Very well, you know where to find me.

NPC: I've had a report that's come in - apparently one of our prototype droids has gone on a rampage and killed a technical team. I don't have an available security team, so I'm sending you in instead.

Your response: Alone?

NPC: Yes - I wouldn't send you if I didn't think you could take care of the matter. Head to Energy Core 2 and put down the Malfunctioning Droid, then return to me.

NPC: Well done - I told you that you could handle it.

Your response: It was nothing, really.

NPC: Destroy the Malfunctioning Droid and return to me.

NPC: I've got a feeling that the droid attacking the engineer team wasn't an accident, so I've asked for the logs to be checked. Speak with me again in a moment.

NPC: Alright, are you ready to proceed?

Your response: Of course - what's next?

Your response: Not right now, I will be back though.

NPC: Very well, you know where to find me.

NPC: It appears that my gut instinct was correct. The logs show that the routines controlling the Droid's targeting matrix were altered just prior to the attack.

Your response: What? Who would do that?

NPC: One of the members of the technical team, Jeorj Sorik, managed to escape the attack unharmed. He's currently at Tech Haven Sec-3 - near the Runner Housing blocks. I'd start with him.

NPC: Something I can help you with?

Your response: Jeorj Sorik? I'm investigating the Droid attack which killed your colleagues.

NPC: Uh, yeah... tragic that... just sorta comes out of nowhere, you know?

Your response: Yeah - any idea what caused it?

NPC: Nah, no idea who reprogrammed them.

Your response: Funny... how did you know they had been reprogrammed? That information isn't public knowledge...

NPC: Ah well... You see - the thing is... Oh fuck it. This is what you get for sticking your nose in!

NPC: ...

NPC: Well, did you get anywhere with Jeorj?

Your response: Yes and no. I started questioning him, but he attacked me before I got anything useful.

NPC: Don't come back until you have spoken with Jeorj Sorik.

NPC: Hmm, well, if nothing else we know we were on the correct track.

Your response: What happens now?

NPC: I'll get this assigned to an investigation team - so they can look into it properly. You've been a great help today, and I have a little weapon to help you on your way.

Your response: Seriously? Fantastic!

NPC: Well, giving you this benefits Tech Haven as a whole. Make good use of it, Runner!

NPC: Are you sure about that?

Your response: Yes, I am!

Your response: Actually, no. I'll give it a try.

NPC: Think about it. I will not come back if you decide not to use my services.

Your response: I did think about it. Now please leave me alone.

Your response: Uh, ahm, oh well, I think I just reconsidered.

NPC: Okay, as you wish. I will go. Take care of yourself.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Elias Verne

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at least 20; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• As you can see on your world map, Neocron has 3 main entrances. Being a Fallen Angel, you can move freely in the city, making the main gate in Sector A08 your best bet. The other two gates, as well as other hidden entry points, will only drop you into more dangerous sectors of Neocron, so steer clear of them for now.

• For starters, just being a loyal member of the Fallen Angels is enough. You'll get the details from Dr. Lia Voss. She's one of the leading scientists here in Tech Haven and wants to speak to you personally first.

• She's waiting for you in the Fallen Angels Tech Core, our headquarters here in Tech Haven.

• Take a right around the corner, through the door, and then straight through the main hall. Behind the next door, some ladders lead down to the lowest level of Tech Haven. At the end of the corridor, you'll find the entrance to our HQ.

• We can. The City Administration isn't the issue here. When our founder, Thomas Cooper, left Neocron with other scientists to create Tech Haven as a sanctuary for free and independent science, Neocron was ruled and suppressed by the PSI Monks.

• Uh, alone? Through the Wastelands all the way to Neocron? I'm not suicidal.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: You again? You did a good job last time, but I don't have anything else for you right now.

NPC: I don't think you're ready for this job yet. (Baserank 20)

NPC: Knowledge is freedom! You are not one of us.

NPC: Hey Runner, come over here, I've got something to discuss with you.

Your response: Uh, yeah?

NPC: You're new around here, right? Looking for a way to earn some credits and improve your skills?

Your response: Hm, maybe. Depends on who's asking and what it's about.

Your response: No thanks, I've got enough on my plate right now.

NPC: Can't ever be too careful, huh? Relax, I work for our faction and I've got a job for you, but it's gonna require you to step out of your comfort zone.

Your response: Let's say I'm ready for that kind of adventure. What would be expected of me?

Your response: I don't think I'm ready for that kind of trouble yet.

NPC: For starters, just being a loyal member of the Fallen Angels is enough. You'll get the details from Dr. Lia Voss. She's one of the leading scientists here in Tech Haven and wants to speak to you personally first.

Your response: Alright, where can I find her?

NPC: She's waiting for you in the Fallen Angels Tech Core, our headquarters here in Tech Haven.

Your response: Got it, I'll head over there then.

NPC: Take a right around the corner, through the door, and then straight through the main hall. Behind the next door, some ladders lead down to the lowest level of Tech Haven. At the end of the corridor, you'll find the entrance to our HQ.

Your response: Thanks, I'll find it.

NPC: Good luck!

NPC: Dr. Voss is expecting you in the Fallen Angels Tech Core!

NPC: Alright, just come back if you change your mind.

NPC: Welcome to the Fallen Angels Headquarters, %PLAYER_NAME(). So you're the Runner Elias sent over for the assignment?

Your response: Yeah, but I have no idea what this is about yet.

NPC: Well, to put it bluntly, we need a loyal but still unknown young Fallen Angels Runner for a highly sensitive operation. Someone who can travel to Neocron City completely unnoticed and under the radar. Someone the enemy agents don't know yet.

Your response: Me? The faction needs ME? I'm supposed to go to Neocron City as an operative for a mission?

NPC: Elias Verne is one of our best recruiters, and if he thinks you're up for it, then you are.

Your response: Alright, but why 'enemy agents'? The City Administration in Neocron might not be our closest ally, but we should be able to move freely through the city.

NPC: We can. The City Administration isn't the issue here. When our founder, Thomas Cooper, left Neocron with other scientists to create Tech Haven as a sanctuary for free and independent science, Neocron was ruled and suppressed by the PSI Monks.

Your response: -continue-

NPC: Ever since the City Administration put an end to the Monks' tyranny and took control of Neocron, we Fallen Angels can actually move relatively freely and safely in the city as a neutral faction. Still, we have enemies there.

Your response: Tangent?

NPC: Exactly! Tangent Technologies call themselves scientists too. And they do research. But while we focus our research on improving humanity's living conditions with new technologies, Tangent's research has only one thing in mind: WEAPONS.

Your response: I get it. So this job probably has something to do with Tangent's weapon research.

NPC: Safe to assume, huh? But we're not there yet. First, we need to get you into the city to secure access to Neocron Genrep system, so you can easily return for future assignments whenever needed.

Your response: That sounds anything but simple.

NPC: And it isn't. Tangent doesn't know you yet, and we need to keep it that way, which is why having one of our agents tag along is out of the question. You'll have to make the trip alone.

Your response: Uh, alone? Through the Wastelands all the way to Neocron? I'm not suicidal.

NPC: Just because you're going alone doesn't mean you won't have backing. Meet up with Quantum Veil, one of our agents in Tech Haven Sector 2. He's usually hanging out at the Medicare there and will supply you with all the necessary gear and info.

Your response: Alright, I guess I can check out what he's got to offer.

NPC: Don't forget to activate the Genreplicator here in the Tech Core before you leave. That way, you can come back here instantly at any time.

Your response: Got it, thanks for the tip. I'll be on my way.

NPC: Knowledge is freedom, %PLAYER_NAME().

NPC: Quantum Veil is waiting for you at the Medicare in Tech Haven Sector 2.

NPC: Ah, %PLAYER_NAME(), so you're the rookie I'm supposed to prep for the trip to the big city, huh?

Your response: Looks like it.

NPC: Who are you and what do you want here?

NPC: Alright, let's start with the basics. The area outside the cities and settlements is what we call the Wastelands. Even though the high radiation makes it uninhabitable for humans in the long run, there are heavily contested outposts everywhere, like factories, research labs, mines, or military fortresses.

Your response: -continue-

NPC: The only residents out there are mutants and machines. Over centuries, the radiation has triggered countless mutations, turning humans and animals alike into extremely lethal creatures.

Your response: -continue-

NPC: Only the most experienced Runners can survive out there for long. Plus, you never know when Runners from hostile factions or simple thugs might be waiting for you.

Your response: Sounds just great... what the hell did I sign up for?

NPC: Don't sweat it, with the right preparation we'll get you to Neocron in one piece.

Your response: Why does that not make me feel any better? What do I need to do?

NPC: Tech Haven is located deep underground, as you know, and only has 2 exits to the surface. Since Neocron lies to the south, you should leave Tech Haven through the southern exit in Sector 1.

Your response: -continue-

NPC: As soon as you step outside Tech Haven, open up your map (F9-Worldmap) and plot your route! Stick to the marked paths as much as possible! Straying off the roads increases your chances of getting jumped significantly.

Your response: -continue-

NPC: If you get lost, use the sector map in your RPOS (F9-Sectormap) to reorient yourself. It's also smart to project a small minimap directly onto your RPOS using 'Alt+m'.

Your response: -continue-

NPC: If you get hit and don't have the skills or weapons to fight back yet, just run! All outposts are linked to the Genreplicator network. There are also Genrep stations in small settlements along your route, like Point Red or Crest Village. Activate those Genreps along the way so you can jump right back there later!

Your response: -continue-

NPC: Keep in mind that there is no fully functioning, automatic navigation system (F9-Navray) in the Wastelands like the one guiding you here in Tech Haven or inside Neocron City. At best, you can use it out there to lock onto the nearest Genreplicator or GoGuardian.

Your response: Man, that's a lot of information. Where exactly do I need to go? How do I get into the city?

NPC: As you can see on your world map, Neocron has 3 main entrances. Being a Fallen Angel, you can move freely in the city, making the main gate in Sector A08 your best bet. The other two gates, as well as other hidden entry points, will only drop you into more dangerous sectors of Neocron, so steer clear of them for now.

Your response: Got it, so just straight through the main entrance.

NPC: Exactly. Once you pass the large main gate, head straight towards the Genreplicator of the Neocron Outzone Subway station. Take a right at the Genrep and enter the Electric Vibes Club. Agent Seraph Nyx is waiting for you inside.

Your response: Right at the Genrep, Electric Vibes Club, Seraph Nyx, got it!

NPC: Before you leave Tech Haven, make a quick detour to the 'Main Retail Area' in Sector 3. Alaric Phase has some useful gear for your trip. Do not go to Neocron without talking to Alaric first.

Your response: Alright, thanks.

NPC: Watch your back, %PLAYER_NAME(), and have a safe trip!

NPC: Alaric Phase is waiting for you in Sector 3, Main Retail Area. After that, head to Neocron, go to the Electric Vibes Club, and talk to Seraph Nyx.

NPC: I don't care who you are, and I don't care what your mission is!

Your response: What a warm welcome!

NPC: Who are you and what do you want here?

NPC: I'm not here for small talk, I just want to get back to my research project ASAP.

Your response: Research? Look, I'm just here to pick up equipment for my...

NPC: STOP! I DON'T WANT TO KNOW ANYTHING ABOUT YOUR MISSION! And yes, technically I'm researching new tech for our field operatives' gear.

Your response: I don't mean to bother you, I just want to grab my stuff.

NPC: Yeah, yeah, here, take it. I've got some Stamina Boosters for you. Use them if you need to run far and fast. There are also a few medpacks to patch you up if you take damage.

Your response: Alright, that helps. Thanks.

NPC: Knowledge is freedom!

NPC: I'm heading back to my research. We're done here. If you forgot what you're supposed to do, go ask Quantum Veil again.

NPC: About damn time! I was almost giving up hope.

Your response: Do you have any idea what it's like out there? I'm just glad I made it through alive.

NPC: Who are you and what do you want here?

NPC: Yeah, actually, I've been out there more times than I'd care to admit. Still, good to see you made it! And it looks like you haven't raised any suspicion with our enemies so far.

Your response: What's next?

NPC: For now, it's enough that you made it to Neocron without drawing attention. To keep it that way, you should activate the Genreplicator right outside the door and use it to head back to Tech Haven.

Your response: What about Dr. Voss's assignment?

NPC: Once you're back in Tech Haven, talk to Elias Verne near the Genreps again as soon as you're ready for the actual job. You can then use the Genrep to sync right back here instantly.

Your response: Can't I look around the city a bit first?

NPC: Sure, go ahead. Just don't draw any attention to yourself! Just act natural, like someone visiting the city for the first time. Best way is to grab the subway right outside the door to head into the inner sectors.

Your response: Alright.

NPC: Don't forget to talk to Elias Verne in Tech Haven when you're ready to handle Dr. Voss's assignment!

NPC: Welcome back to Tech Haven, %PLAYER_NAME(). How was your trip?

Your response: TRIP? It was a hellish ride! But I made it to Neocron and secured access via the Genrep system!

NPC: Yeah, good job! Looks like Tangent still doesn't have you on their radar. Ready for the real deal?

Your response: Wouldn't be here otherwise.

Your response: No, not really.

NPC: Good. Like Dr. Voss explained, Tangent Technologies is researching new weapon systems. Intel reports indicate a new, high-performance weapon line that Tangent is developing as the new standard-issue gear for all their faction members.

Your response: That doesn't sound good.

NPC: It isn't. If these weapons hit mass production looking anything like the blueprints we intercepted, and every loyal Tangent runner starts packing them, it's gonna be a disaster for us!

Your response: How close is Tangent to finishing production?

NPC: Faction members are already being sent on special ops to prove their loyalty and to receive one of the new weapons. It's one minute to midnight, Runner! We need to move.

Your response: But how are we supposed to stop this now?

NPC: Stop it? We can't. But we can manipulate the research and manufacturing data. The new weapon line will still be produced and distributed, but the guns will be nothing more than basic standard-tier without the range, firepower, and rate of fire of Tangent's original design.

Your response: Now that sounds like a plan! How can I help?

NPC: Go meet Seraph Nyx again at the Electric Vibes Club. He'll help you navigate Neocron City and give you the rest of the operational briefing. This time, you can just genrep straight to the Outzone Subway Station.

Your response: Got it, genrep to the Outzone Station, then hit up Seraph Nyx at the Electric Vibes Club for the next steps.

NPC: Good luck out there!

NPC: Alright, just come back if you change your mind.

NPC: %PLAYER_NAME(). Glad you're back, but we don't have time for small talk. We gotta move. Tangent's new weapon production is about to go live.

Your response: Couldn't get here any faster! But I'm ready for whatever!

NPC: Excellent. Our operatives have already set the stage. Agent ZeroByte, even I don't know his real name, compiled a data disc containing the modified production specs. Your job is to inject this new data into Tangent's mainframe.

Your response: Why me? I'm no netrunner, I have no clue how to hack a mainframe.

NPC: Don't forget, you're still a ghost in the city. You can move freely without triggering Tangent's alarms. ZeroByte will feed you the exact details and instructions. Meet him at 'Chez Sypher' in Viarosso 3.

Your response: 'Chez Sypher in Viarosso 3'? What the hell is that? I've never been to the city before.

NPC: The Viarosso sectors are the high-rent districts, full of luxury apartments, and 'Chez Sypher' is probably the trendiest restaurant around. It has a terrace overlooking the sea, the perfect spot for an inconspicuous meet-up.

Your response: And how do I get there?

NPC: All city sectors are hooked into the NavRay system (F9). The key locations are mapped out, and the system will guide you right to them. Plus, the urban sectors are all connected by the subway system, which is convenient and free to use. Even the red-light district 'Pepperpark' and the city outskirts (Outzone sectors) can be reached via subway.

Your response: Alright, guess I'll just let the NavRay guide me to Viarosso Sector 3 then.

NPC: Yeah, that's definitely the easiest way for a newcomer. Set your target to the Neocron Police Department; it's in the same sector.

Your response: Got it, what about security?

NPC: The inner city sectors like Plaza and Viarosso are tightly monitored, either by systems that prevent anyone from drawing weapons, or by patrolling CopBots, making them highly secure. When entering a city sector, check your RPOS alerts for local security protocols. In Pepperpark or the Outzone, you better keep your eyes peeled. You can get shot at there at any second.

Your response: Alright, I'll head out to Chez Sypher in Viarosso 3 then.

NPC: Hurry up, ZeroByte has been waiting for a while.

NPC: ZeroByte is waiting at 'Chez Sypher' in Viarosso Sector 3. Hurry up!

NPC: Leave me alone and get lost!

Your response: Seraph Nyx sent me.

NPC: Who are you and what do you want here?

NPC: Keep it down! Nobody needs to know what we're talking about. Take a seat and act like a normal customer.

Your response: You are the one wearing sunglasses and everything about you screams 'secret agent', but I'm the one who needs to blend in?

NPC: Uh, yeah.... We don't have time for this. Tangent's research is finalized, and the production specs have already been fed into their internal network. It's only a matter of time before they spin up the assembly lines.

Your response: So we're too late?

NPC: No, we still have a small window to overwrite the data before it gets pushed to the manufacturing division.

Your response: Tell me what to do.

NPC: We prepared a data disc. Once injected into Tangent's local network terminal, it will automatically overwrite the weapon blueprints.

Your response: And how am I supposed to get access to Tangent's network?

NPC: Tangent Headquarters is located in Viarosso Sector 2. You can use your NavRay (F9) to find the way. But do not enter the building! The guards will flatline you on sight.

Your response: If I can't go inside, how am I going to access the network?

NPC: Right outside the HQ, Tangent installed a terminal for faction members to access the local network. One of our runners hijacked it, and it's currently sitting on a forced reboot screen.

Your response: And that's where I come in?

NPC: Exactly. This data disc contains a custom boot sequence for the terminal, along with the modified manufacturing specs for the weapon line. Approach the terminal casually and insert the disc. The boot process will trigger automatically.

Your response: And the production data?

NPC: Once the terminal is back online, search for 'wep_prod_epicv1.1' and overwrite the file with the data from the disc.

Your response: That's it?

NPC: Yes. After the transfer completes, pull the disc out of the terminal and report back to Elias Verne in Tech Haven. He'll monitor if everything went according to plan.

Your response: Alright: insert disc, reboot terminal, overwrite the file, and bring the disc back to Elias Verne in Tech Haven.

NPC: Spot on! Remember, you're just a tourist checking out the city sights. Act the part! Good luck out there!

NPC: You'll find the Tangent CityCom Terminal in Viarosso Sector 2, right by Tangent HQ. Once the upload is done, report to Elias Verne in Tech Haven Sector 2.

NPC: Head back to Neocron, go to the Electric Vibes Club, and talk to Seraph Nyx again.

NPC: Damn right it is! Our faction is highly grateful for your services. Even Dr. Voss is impressed.

NPC: Dr. Voss is a brilliant scientist and part of our faction's high command. She knows exactly how critical your mission was for us and explicitly praised your performance. You've proven yourself to be a loyal and valuable asset to the Fallen Angels.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Devlin Jones

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Empty Datacube

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Advanced Autonome Gyroscope System v 0.1.9
• Cron 55 Beer
• Electronical Triggerdevice v 0.1.1
• Subliminal Targeting System v 0.2.5

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at least 55; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Okay, %NPC_NAME(0) in this sector. Let me see what I can do.

• Yep, the 'Juggernaut Facility' in this sector. That is the - once secret - Twilight Guardian production facility for Bots. Years ago they've done some experiments with modified Warbots in there. Sadly something went wrong and the Bots went berserk. Nobody survived it. They have closed up the facility after that till half a year ago a NEXT Exploration Team found it.

• Tech Haven! Great! Haven't been there for quite a while. And you want me to convince her to come back and dance again?

• Hey! What do you want here? You are such a dusty person... You were in the wastelands, right?

• Well there is this barkeeper at the wasteland Twisters in sector I_09. Do you know that Twisters?

• NEVER BEFORE somebody said such things about me!! As if I were just another piece of flesh. An object, ready to use and chuck away. I feeled so mortified and it didn't need a good deal of thought till I decided to quit my job and never visit the Twister again. Since then I live here in Tech Haven.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Hey, a greenhorn! What are you doing out here? Well, whatever... You better go home to your mommy and come back when you are allowed to play with the big boys!

NPC: Heya! It's great to meet you! Not the usual face you see around here. how about a drink?

Your response: Good day! An ice cold drink is exactly what I am looking for. What do you have here?

Your response: No thanks! I am looking for some action.

NPC: Well, look here...

NPC: Looking for some action? Hmm... I guess I have something for you. but I am not sure if you are tough enough for that. It's no walk in the park.

Your response: Of course I am! I am an experienced runner and I have done quite a lot of missions already.

Your response: Just tell me what I have to do, and I will do it. There is nothing else to say.

NPC: If you really were such a professional runner you would be a little more discrete. I think I should find someone else for that mission, but it was still nice to meet you.

NPC: Ah, you know about confidentiality. I think we will find a way to get along... Ready for some action or do you need some more time to prepare yourself?

Your response: Nope, I will get what I need and come back to you. Talk to you later.

Your response: I have everything I need.

NPC: Okay. I will wait right here.

NPC: Well, well. There are some people I know and I owe them a favor. If you help me to clear the debts I will tell you how to get the legendary 'Ion Crossbow'.

Your response: Sounds good. What do you want me to do?

NPC: The first person you should meet is %NPC_NAME(0). %NPC_NAME(0) is one of the local smugglers and I still owe him one. Meet and helo him, if he has any tasks for you, so I can clear my debts.

Your response: Okay, %NPC_NAME(0) in this sector. Let me see what I can do.

NPC: Excellent! I will wait right here.

NPC: Errrr, what do you want?

Your response: Hello Mister! Isn't it a fantastic day today?

Your response: I heard you maybe could need a helping hand. Someone sent me to clear his debts.

NPC: If you say so... Now, what do you really want from me? Don't waste my time!

Your response: Hmm, okay... But... Damn! What was it again?

NPC: Come back when you can remember, crazy fool! *to himself* Sometimes I get the feeling it's open day at the asylum...

NPC: There are many people who owe me one. And I really don't know what you could be useful for, Chummer!

Your response: Maybe you remind a 'Devlin Jones'? Oh, and I'm an allrounder. I'm sure we will find something.

NPC: Ahh, Devlin Jones. Yes, I have repaired his junker.. err.. Hoverbike. But Devlin has wasted all his creds on drinks so he couldn't pay me. Hmm... I really don't know what you could do for me to pay the bill.

Your response: I'm sure there are some things you are missing in your assortment. And I would also be the right person to get you these things!

NPC: Right, there is something. My stock of 'Advanced Autonome Gyroscope System v 0.1.9' is low. Maybe you could bring me some?

Your response: Sounds good. Where can I find it?

NPC: Juggernaut Facility. There are these Juggernaut Warbots. If you deactivate them, you might find the parts inside them.

Your response: Juggernaut Facility?

NPC: Yep, the 'Juggernaut Facility' in this sector. That is the - once secret - Twilight Guardian production facility for Bots. Years ago they've done some experiments with modified Warbots in there. Sadly something went wrong and the Bots went berserk. Nobody survived it. They have closed up the facility after that till half a year ago a NEXT Exploration Team found it.

Your response: Stop! Don't say it! The NEXT people got blown up as well?

NPC: Exactly. Didn't expect anything else. But these NEXT guys have to nose into eerything. But back to your mission. Get in, deactivate some Juggernaut Warbots an don't come back until you have 15 parts of 'Advanced Autonome Gyroscope System v 0.1.9'. When you have done that, Devlin has cleared his debt.

Your response: Okay, I will see what these Bots are doing then.

NPC: Before you go: Better find a team. Otherwise I wouldn't get my parts... Good luck!

NPC: Ah, you did it! I'm impressed!

Your response: That was easy! I've taught the bots to dance.

NPC: You still don't have enough items. Come back when you're done.

NPC: Tell Mister Devlin Jones that I am even with him now. I will mail him soon. I enjoyed working with a real pro! See you later!

NPC: What do you want? I am busy!

NPC: Hey! I just got a mail from %NPC_NAME(0). I think now I am even with him. Thanks! Before we go on take this beer and relax a moment.

Your response: Don't mention it! Better tell me how to go on, I have not too much time. And thanks for the beer...

NPC: You haven't finished your job yet.

NPC: That's how I like it! I really enjoy working with a professional. The next person you should meet is %NPC_NAME(1). Her sister Kaytlin was member of the NEXT exploration team that discovered the 'Juggernaut Facility'. The bots went berserk and killed all of them - including Kaytlin. %NPC_NAME(1) is looking for someone to get the diary of her sister out of that hell. Maybe you are the one.

Your response: Okay, I will talk to her. Let's see what I can do for her.

NPC: Fine. I will wait here till you're back!

NPC: Leave me alone! I don't wanna talk to you!

Your response: But I have to talk to you!!!

Your response: Sincere condolences, mam. I heard you lost your beloved sister. If you need any help...

NPC: I SAID LEAVE ME ALONE!!! YOU HEAR ME?! A L O N E !!!

NPC: Oh, you know about it? Thanks for your compassionate words. I am so angry I could scream that you can hear it in the whole wasstelands!!

Your response: I can understand this. You have the feeling that your sisters death was without a meaning. You think that NEXT is so inconsiderate and sends its employees on suicide missions.

NPC: Oh yes! That is exactly how I feel! Why do you know this?

Your response: Let's say I have a good knowledge of human nature. Perhaps I can help to ease you pain?

NPC: Hmm, indeed, you can. I need my sisters diary. Till now nobody managed to get out of this damned 'JUggernaut Facility' alive again. What do you think? Will you give it a try?

Your response: I think I could.

NPC: That's great! I really appreciate that! I just need my sisters diary! It's the only thing I have of her.

Your response: I will see what I can do. Shouldn't take long till I am back.

NPC: Be careful! It isn't that easy! But I will wait right here for you.

NPC: **Corpse of Kaytlin Morrison. She was battered heavily**

Your response: - Examine corpse

NPC: **You find Dr. Kaytlin Morrison's diary**

NPC: **There is nothing useful**

NPC: Ah, you are back! And? Do you have the diary?

Your response: Yes, I have found it. Here, it's yours.

NPC: Fantastic! That's really the diary of my sister! You are great! Sooooo great! I really don't know what I should say.

Your response: You're welcome! I think now Devlin Jones has cleared his debt he had towards you. He told me to help you.

NPC: You're kidding, right? I can't find any diary!

NPC: DEVLIN JONES!!! That son of a bitch! Get even, hmm? He had fun with my sister while we - him and me - were a copule at the same time! That Swine!!!

Your response: But he helped you to get your sisters diary back in some way...

NPC: Hmm... Indeed... I will think about it and leave him a message later. Thanks for your help and now leave me alone please...

NPC: Great! You are back! All done?

Your response: Ah, the philanderer! Affairs with both twins at the same time...

NPC: I don't think you have finished your task yet. Come back when you are ready!

NPC: *gough* She told you that? *grml*

Your response: Yep, she did. This woman is like an open book. Anyways... You should be even with her again. She needs some time to think about it though.

NPC: Oh, good. I'm relieved to hear that. So... what about a new job?

Your response: Of course!

NPC: There is a dancer. She once worked for the Twister club. She really was the best dancer I've ever seen. Every man was after her... till I have done something she didn't like. I can't remember what it was... Must have been really drunk. But fact is: We need her back for our business.

Your response: You and the women... Well, where can I find her?

NPC: Women, yes. Mankinds last mystery. But back to topic. Her name is Ginger and I heard she moved to TechHaven. Perhaps you should start your investigations there.

Your response: Tech Haven! Great! Haven't been there for quite a while. And you want me to convince her to come back and dance again?

NPC: You got it. If Ginger will dance for us again this club will reawake to new live very fast. She is a real eye candy and the way she can move her body... oh, I dote on her again.

Your response: Okay, okay! That's enough. I better go and find her now.

NPC: Great! I will wait right here till you're back.

NPC: Hey! What do you want here? You are such a dusty person... You were in the wastelands, right?

Your response: Hi, Ginger. Yes, I am just coming from right there. Had to do some stuff there.

NPC: Hey, why... who told you my name?

Your response: Errr, Devlin Jones told me to find you. He wants you to work for him again in the Twister in I_09.

Your response: I just know it. Believe me you are not in danger. An old friend who has regrets about something he has done to you in the past wanted me to take care about you.

NPC: DEVLIN JONES!!! THIS SON OF A BITCH!!! GET OUT HERE! GET OUT OF MY EYES!!! I DON'T WANT TO HAVE ANYTHING TO DO WITH HIM ANYMORE!!!s

NPC: Ohh, there are many guys who have disappointed me in my live. Especially this one... well, that doesn't matter now.

Your response: Please tell me more about it. You've got my full attention.

NPC: But I don't know you! Why should I tell you about my very inner feelings and thoughts?

Your response: Because I am an professional runner. And I am the right person for your secrets, believe me.

NPC: Oh! A real professional runner? One who is carrying out super secret tasks and gets other people out of the way?

Your response: As I said I try to stay confidential while moving around. But to make it short: Yes, I am a professional runner.

NPC: That's damn sexy!! Not as boring as dancing in front of some dirty old guys in the middle of nowhere...

Your response: I heard that you are one of the best dancers all over the world. Nobody else can shake her hips like you do.

NPC: Oh thanks, I lke to hear that!

Your response: But now back to your problems. What happened to you?

NPC: Well there is this barkeeper at the wasteland Twisters in sector I_09. Do you know that Twisters?

Your response: Nope, never heard... Perhaps I should have a look some time. *cough*

NPC: Anyways. I worked as dancer there and every man loved to see me there. One of them was Devlin Jones, the barkeeper I already mentioned. We had a great time and much fun together. At least till one evening...

Your response: What happened that evening?

NPC: After his work was done Devlin drank too much again and showed off together with his friends. When I came around the corner I accidently heard how he really thinks about me.

Your response: Ouch! I think I know what will come now...

NPC: NEVER BEFORE somebody said such things about me!! As if I were just another piece of flesh. An object, ready to use and chuck away. I feeled so mortified and it didn't need a good deal of thought till I decided to quit my job and never visit the Twister again. Since then I live here in Tech Haven.

Your response: Not very kind of... err... Devlin?

NPC: Devlin Jones, yes! Scumbag! And I really loved him... *cries*

Your response: Hey, hey, don't cry... Everything will come up roses, you will see. Maybe he feels very sorry for that, did you ever think about that? I mean, if he really was drunk he maybe doesn't even know what he said that evening.

NPC: Yes I have thought about that...

Your response: See? Perhaps you should talk to this Devlin about that situation. I am sure he feels sorry for that and is already looking for you *cough*

NPC: Perhaps you are right. I should contact him and talk to him. In fact I have not much credits left so the job in the Twisters would be good money for me.

Your response: See? I already see it come up roses.

NPC: You're really insightfull. That's surprising me. And I really think that's sexy!!

Your response: Thanks for the compliment. I do what I can. And you will talk to this.. Devlin as soon as you can, right?

NPC: Yes, I will. In fact I will just call him in a minute. Thanks for your time and help. I really needed someone to talk. But now I have to go. Take care, Runner!

NPC: Sorry, but I have to call Devlin now.

NPC: Hey, man! Great to see you are back! I just got a call from Ginger! I don't know how you've done it, but she will visit me here in a few days to talk to each other. It is really an honor to work with a professional runner like you.

Your response: If it comes to women you don't have a very lucky hand, right? Maybe you shouldn't drink that much anymore. YOu really hurt her...

NPC: I don't think you've finished your task yet. Come back when you are done!

NPC: I know, I know. And I feel really bad. But I hope that after this meeting with Ginger everything will be alright again. Without her I am nothing! You have made it that I will have a second chance.

Your response: Use it. There is no other women like Ginger out there. But now I have finished all your jobs so let's come to the story about the Ion Crossbow.

NPC: Ah, the Crossbow, right. I am sorry but before we can go into details here I have to finish some things. Please come back later and then I will tell you everything you need to know to get this Corssbow

Your response: Okay, but don't trick me! Believe me you wouldn't enjoy that for long!

NPC: Nah, I don't. I really owe you one and as you know I will pay for it. Just contact me later again and we will start. See ya!

NPC: Ah, you're back. Ready for new adventures?

Your response: Not yet. I will come back as soon as I am.

Your response: Of course. Fire away! I really want this Crossbow, you know?

NPC: Okay, you know where to find me when you want to go on. Bye!

Your response: I feared that. But I already survived it one time and I will survive it a second time as well. How many parts do we need?

NPC: We need two 'Electronical Triggerdevice v 0.1.1', three 'Subliminal Targeting System v 0.2.5' and one 'Advanced Autonome Gyroscope System v 0.1.9' for the Ion Crossbow.

Your response: Shouldn't be a problem to find that. I am already on my way.

NPC: Okay, I will wait here as always.

NPC: Finally you are back. Seems you got all parts. Congratulations!

Your response: That was easy. And now?

NPC: There are still some part missing. Talk to me when you have found all of them!

NPC: Now we have that parts. I will keep them here for you, not that you loose them somewhere. But we are still missing is a blueprint of the Crossbow.

Your response: What a surprise! And where can I get one?

NPC: An old friend of mine who is into hacking stuff told me about a data terminal you can use to get access to the secret Phoenix NC database network. There you can find the blueprint.

Your response: I hope I don't have to get into the hacknet?

Your response: Sounds good. Where can I find the data terminal?

NPC: It's hidden deep inside Gaya Mine 1. Where exactly I don't know anymore, but I think it shouldn't be a problem for you to find it. When you have found it you can activate it with the password 'Je34kkE'. Look for the database entry and download it to a normal datacube. As soon as you are done you should come back to me.

Your response: Okay, I am on my way. And just a normal datacube is all I need?

NPC: We need somebody to construct the crossbow. And I already have someone in mind. She is exactly the person we need!

Your response: SHE? You and your women... I hope I don't have to play the headshrinker for her as well.

NPC: Nah, Tinkerbell ist a good friend of mine. She does some work for me from time to time.

Your response: Tinkerbell, ah well... And where can I find her?

NPC: Where you can find the other tech freaks as well: Tech Haven. Never saw her anywhere else. Find her and tell her that I send you. She will construct the crossbow for you then.

Your response: Okay, I hope there won't be any problems. See you later!

NPC: Okay, I will wait here as always. Wait! Don't forget the parts! Come back with the corssbow so I can activate it for you.

NPC: Hey, Chummer. How are you?

Your response: Excellent, thanks. Devlin sent me. He has a job for you.

NPC: Ah, good old Devlin. What is it?

Your response: I have a blueprint of an ion crossbow and the needed parts. Now I need someone to construct it.

NPC: Don't worry, you just found your constructor. Give me the parts please and I will start working.

Your response: Of course. How long does it take till you are finished?

NPC: I think not more than 10 minutes. Just hang around here for a while. Tech Haven is a fantastic place, you know?

NPC: You don't have all the needed parts. Come back when you have them in your inventory!

  53  -- will take 4(or less) items with their item counts. if one fails all items are given back
  54  function TAKEMULTIPLEITEMS(id1,count1,id2,count2,id3,count3,id4,count4)
  55  	if (state==node) then
  56  	  -- we yet didnt take any item
  57  		taken1 = 0 ;
  58  		taken2 = 0 ;
  59  		taken3 = 0 ;
  60  		taken4 = 0 ;
  61  		-- start taking
  62  	  for i=1,count1,1 do
  63  			TAKEITEM(id1) 
  64  			if (result==1) then
  65  			  -- we took one item of id1 so count it
  66  			  taken1 = taken1 + 1
  67  			end
  68  		end
  69  	  for i=1,count2,1 do
  70  			TAKEITEM(id2) 
  71  			if (result==1) then
  72  			  -- we took one item of id2 so count it
  73  			  taken2 = taken2 + 1
  74  			end
  75  		end
  76  	  for i=1,count3,1 do
  77  			TAKEITEM(id3) 
  78  			if (result==1) then
  79  			  -- we took one item of id3 so count it
  80  			  taken3 = taken3 + 1
  81  			end
  82  		end
  83  	  for i=1,count4,1 do
  84  			TAKEITEM(id4) 
  85  			if (result==1) then
  86  			  -- we took one item of id4 so count it
  87  			  taken4 = taken4 + 1
  88  			end
  89  		end
  90  		-- now test if we got all Items
  91  		if (count1==taken1) and (count2==taken2) and (count3==taken3) and (count4==taken4) then
  92  		  -- we successfull took everything, so set the result and exit
  93  		  result = 1

  96  		  for i=1,taken1,1 do

entries.details:
CONTACT
Chuck's Master

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Crahn Fire Beam

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at least 40; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Awesome! Our last trip lead us to the Escador Oasis in Sector K-15. I believe Chuck lost his Tiki there. That's where you should look for clues. Maybe somebody found Chuck's Tiki.

• Umm well. He lost his Tiki on our last trip to the Wastelands and since I haven't really made any effort to search for it, he's been behaving like a baby. *sighs*

• One of the last great mysteries of Neocron, but anyways... I need someone to look for it in the Wastelands and bring it back to me. It's really annyoing to have Chuck behave like this because of such a minor thing.

• Yes, here it is. A cocktail umbrella from the Tiki Tornado Club in Pepper Park.

• Well, on our last trip to the Wastelands Chuck ran into some cave and came out with some strange item parts. I have no use for them, but maybe you can figure out what to do with them. Here, keep them

• There you go. Enjoy. Well, I have to get back to my business. Chuck will want to head to the Wastelands again soon. Thanks again and take care.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Hey, Chummer! Thanks again for getting Chuck to talk. He can't shut up now, but that's still better than saying nothing at all!

NPC: Sorry but you can't help me. Go drink some milk or something!

NPC: Hey, Chummer! Can you do me favor?

Your response: Nope, no time. Bye.

Your response: That depends. What do you need?

NPC: Oh well, nevermind...

NPC: My pet Chuck is offended and has been talking in his Hurler language that nobody understands for days now, only to piss me off.

Your response: So so, your pet Chuck. What's his problem?

NPC: Umm well. He lost his Tiki on our last trip to the Wastelands and since I haven't really made any effort to search for it, he's been behaving like a baby. *sighs*

Your response: He lost what???

NPC: His Tiki! Any child knows what a Tiki is.

Your response: Err, I guess I missed that in my childhood. What the hell is a Tiki?

NPC: One of the last great mysteries of Neocron, but anyways... I need someone to look for it in the Wastelands and bring it back to me. It's really annyoing to have Chuck behave like this because of such a minor thing.

Your response: Umm, sorry but that sounds too weird. I've got better things to do, cya!

Your response: You're both nuts! But I have some time to help you out. What do you need me to do?

NPC: Pff suit yourself...

NPC: Awesome! Our last trip lead us to the Escador Oasis in Sector K-15. I believe Chuck lost his Tiki there. That's where you should look for clues. Maybe somebody found Chuck's Tiki.

Your response: Hm, Escador Oasis. I should be able to find it. I'll go check it out.

NPC: Thanks a lot. I'll see that your efforts will be rewarded. Maybe Chuck will even show you some love! *grins*

NPC: Hey! What do you want here? Get lost!!

Your response: Relax buddy. What are you doing out here between all these dangerous monsters?

NPC: What do you care? Get outta here!

Your response: I see, you're a tough one. I'll make it short. I'm looking for a specific item someone lost around here. You didn't happen to find a so-called Tiki?

NPC: A Tiki?? Are you frigging crazy? What the hell is a Tiki supposed to be?

Your response: Umm, I'm not really sure myself. Ok let's try this another way. Did you find any strange objects around the oasis in the past days?

NPC: Hmm let me think... well it could... no, that'd be too absurd...

Your response: What? Spill it!

NPC: Hmm, well I found this little cocktail umbrella a couple days ago. Let me check. *searches*

Your response: A cocktail umbrella... oh boy...

NPC: Yes, here it is. A cocktail umbrella from the Tiki Tornado Club in Pepper Park.

Your response: I don't believe it... Chuck's Tiki...

NPC: Who's Chuck?

Your response: Doesn't matter. I really need this umbrella. I know someone who's very attached to it *cough*

NPC: Uhuh. I don't even want to know more. But you're not getting it that easily! After all I found it, and you seem to care about it quite a lot. *laughs*

Your response: *grrr* What do I need to do to get it? Tell me.

NPC: Well, one of those damn mobs ambushed me and ate my last medpacks. I'll never be able to make it out of here without those medpacks. If you bring me back the medpacks, I'll give you the funny little cocktail umbrella. *grins*

Your response: Looks like I don't have much of a choice. *grrr* Which monsters do I need to kill?

NPC: There's a lot of those 'Scary Terrormauler' in the area. One of those thingies ate my medpacks.

Your response: Ok, I'll show them who's boss. Cya in a bit. And don't you dare leave here!

NPC: No worries. I'm not gonna move one bit.

NPC: There you are again. Did you find my medpacks?

Your response: Yep, here you go.

NPC: Ah, nice. Finally I can get out of here.

Your response: Hey hey wait a moment. First you're handing over that frigging cocktail umbrella!

NPC: Hey, you don't have my medpacks! Come back when you have them!

NPC: Stay calm! Here it is. I don't even wanna know why you make such a big deal over a stupid cocktail umbrella. *grins*

Your response: And that's what's best for you *grrr*. Well I gotta run. See ya round, or maybe not...

NPC: Yep, cya.

NPC: What do you still want from me? Leave me alone!

NPC: Ahh, you're back. And, did you find Chuck's Tiki?

Your response: Yes I did! And I hope you have a decent reward, considering I risked my life FOR A GODDAMN SHITTY COCKTAIL UMBRELAA!!

NPC: It does not look like you have already found Chuck's Tiki. Come back when you have found it.

NPC: Well, you wouldn't have gone looking for it if I told you that Chuck's Tiki was a cocktail umbrella, would you? *grins*

Your response: Not another word! I'm really pissed!!

NPC: Yea yeah, calm down. I'll shut up. Just give the Tiki to Chuck and come back for your reward..

NPC: Tiki! unga roarr!!

Your response: Yaya, alright. Here's your Tiki!

NPC: Ohhh, Tiki!!!! Chuck like you! Unga!

Your response: Hey! No hugging! Stop that!!

NPC: Tiki?? Tiki unga roarr!!

NPC: You Chuck' friend! Tiki! Chuck not forget!! Unga!

NPC: Ahh, Chuck's friend! Unga!

NPC: Well, will he talk to me again?

Your response: Looks like it. He was so happy he almost hugged me to death...

NPC: You have to talk to Chuck and give him his Tiki!

NPC: That sounds good! Man, I'm really in your debt. Let's see how I can repay you?

Your response: Maybe some nice cash reward or some valuable items?

NPC: Well here's 20.000nc for starters. I think that should cover your expenses.

NPC: There you go. Enjoy. Well, I have to get back to my business. Chuck will want to head to the Wastelands again soon. Thanks again and take care.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Come back when you've gained some experience (/45)!

NPC: Joe? Is it you? What took you so long? You wanted that Powerarmour, not me!

Your response: Erm, no... It's %PLAYER_NAME(), not Joe... What Powerarmour, anyway?

Your response: Nevermind.

NPC: Bye.

NPC: Oh, damn it, you're not Joe...
Joe ordered a special Powerarmour to enhance his trade skill.

Your response: Sounds interesting, tell me more!

NPC: Like I said, Joe ordered a special Powerarmour to enhance...

Your response: Yaya... his trade skill, yes, you already said that, I'm more interested to get one of those...

NPC: Don't you think it's rude to interupt me?

Your response: Sorry...

NPC: Nevermind.
Joe already accomplished a lot to get it done, but he's vanished somehow, maybe killed in the wastelands, who knows?


Alright, I have a Powerarmour to share, if you're willing to work for it, interested?

Your response: Hell, yeah!

NPC: Alright, we need some stuff to finish the armour, which you have to collect.

Your response: Tell me what you need.

Your response: No, seems to be clear now.

NPC: Good job, exactly what I needed. Come back if you're ready to proceed!

NPC: Ah, you're back - Faster than expected!

Your response: I really want that Powerarmour!

NPC: So, let us not waste time anymore.

Your response: What do you need?

NPC: As you may have guessed, we need more to built a Powerarmour, more materials and all that shiny stuff.
Lucky you, I do have the material we need, but it's not for free, so you have to pay for it.

Your response: *click*

NPC: And with 'pay' I mean you have to do things for me... Nasty and ugly things...

Your response: Oh boy, I do have a bad feeling now... What is it?

NPC: I'm having a bet with a pal, and I don't want to lose it.

Your response: Okay...?

Your response: Not that difficult... Well, highly depends on the amount you'd have to kill...

NPC: I can see that you're not a killer, but maybe you know someone who is able to kill...

Your response: Actually I do!

NPC: I need a poof, though. Bring me their heads - 30!

NPC: You accomplished it?

NPC: You used the heads as a facial mask or why is it that dirty?

Nevermind, maybe you want to wash your face, before we proceed. Come back if you're ready.

NPC: 10, you have to kill 10 Cops!
I also need a proof for it... Their heads!

Your response: I had this feeling, and as always I was right...

NPC: Go kill those Cops - You can find a bunch in the Gaia Mines.
Don't forget to bring me those heads!

NPC: Is that blood on your face?
You did what I've asked you for?

NPC: Alright, maybe you want to wash your face, before we proceed. Come back if you're ready.

NPC: Well, not really a clean face, but it's up to you. Ready to proceed?

Your response: What do you think why I'm here? Of course I'm ready - In fact, I was born ready!

NPC: Yeah, sure... Nevermind. It's the final stage now, just a few adjustments and we're done.

Your response: Very well. What do you need?

NPC: Nothing special this time, just regular stuff I assume.

Your response: *click*

Your response: What's the name and where can I find your friend?

Your response: Sounds too easy...

NPC: Because it is easy. Chop, chop!

NPC: You're %PLAYER_NAME()? I'm waiting all day long for you!

Your response: Yeah, Snacky sent me to pick up a package from you.

NPC: Indeed. Good you came along, I already wanted to sell it to someone else... I hate it when I have to wait all day long!

Your response: Yeah, sorry, had to do some other stuff as well. But now I'm here!

NPC: There you go! Send Snacky my regards.

NPC: Snacky is waiting!

NPC: You got my package?

Your response: Sure thing, there you go!

NPC: Good job, really! Well done! Now let me finish the work we've started. Come back in 5 minutes!

NPC: It's done! Your plain Powerarmour is finished!

Your response: Erm, plain? You said it's a special armour!

NPC: I'm not done yet! Let me work in peace!!!
