entries.conversation:
NPC: You look wet behind the ears. Come see me when you've got some experience!

NPC: Hey... you... I sense some sort of aura around you. One I haven't felt for a long time. Your aura is strong; and, Crahn be my judge, I think you have the strength to help me in a difficult task. Are you interested?

Your response: Me?

Your response: Leave me alone, lunatic!

NPC: I sense your soul is almost lost..

NPC: Yes, you, %PLAYER_NAME()! It took me a very long time to find someone like you. I really need your help!

Your response: Alright, what is this all about?

Your response: I'm not interested, just leave me alone, k?

NPC: You may remember, my friend, for some time the home of the Brotherhood was inside the Dome of York. There was a huge cathedral, which reflected the glory of Crahn. It was my home.

Your response: Yeah, I remember that but why is this important?

NPC: Please be patient, you will understand everything soon. The cathedral was not only our home, it was also our headquarters, and we stored our most sacred treasures deep inside its catacombs. No-one had laid eyes on them for decades.

Your response: Treasures? Now this becomes interesting!

NPC: But then, a young novice found an old parchment, with an inscription from our Elders. Something so important that I dare not put it into words. Her name was Nina Mendora and she vanished when the Dome fell.

Your response: But what happened to the parchment?

NPC: Nina Mendora contacted her mentor, Padre Steiner, and gave the parchment to him. The last thing we know is that the padre summoned a meeting of the High Council.

Your response: That's all ? Where is the parchment now?

NPC: Well, my friend, when the Dome was lost, so were our treasures. It is of the utmost importance that we get them back. I can not go there. I am too old for such a task. But I sense from your aura that you are able to find which has been lost for so long.

Your response: Crahn is the light, brother. I would be honoured if I got the chance to help you find this parchment.

NPC: Well, my friend, when the Dome was lost, so were our treasures. It is of the utmost importance that we get them back. I can not go there. I am too old for such a task. But I sense from your aura that you are able to find which has been lost for so long.

Your response: Why should I do that? Our factions are hostile to each other and I'd never help a member of the Crahn Sect.

NPC: I could start arguing about honour and salvation now, or try to threaten you with Crahns vengeance, but... let me just tell you that if we succeed, I will share the treasure with you.

Your response: Why didn't you say that in the first place? Count me in!

Your response: No way. I don't trust you religious weirdos.

NPC: When I saw you the first time I already knew that you would accept this challenge. May Crahn bless you!

Your response: Thank you, brother!

NPC: I sense your soul is almost lost...

NPC: Alright. Please go into the catacombs of the Crahn Cathedral - find the parchment. Keep in mind that if there are any security measures, only members of the High Council will be allowed to enter. I will tell you more when you return.

NPC: THE BROTHERHOOD OF CRAHN - THE BLACK CIRCLE - ACCESS RESTRICTED

 Codex Crahnae V2.1.666 Security System loading...
 .
 .
 .
 SYSTEM ONLINE

Your response: -continue-

NPC: Enter username:

Your response: %PLAYER_NAME()

Your response: Steiner

NPC: *** Can not complete login due to an incorrect username. ***

NPC: *** Login system unlocked. ***

Your response: -proceed-

NPC: *** Login system locked. Try again later. ***

NPC: Welcome back, Padre Steiner

Your response: -proceed-

NPC: Advanced security check initialised: What is the name of the novice who found the item in this box and handed it over to you many years before?

Your response: Naomi Madeira

Your response: Nina Mendora

NPC: ***INTRUDER ALERT*** Automatic Defense System activated... neutralizing thread...

NPC: Access granted

Your response: - open box and take parchment -

NPC: *** SYSTEM SHUTDOWN ***

NPC: *** SYSTEM SHUTDOWN COMPLETE ***

NPC: Do you have the parchment?

Your response: - Give parchment -

NPC: You have to find the parchment!

NPC: You have to find the parchment!

NPC: You have done well, my friend. It's time now to tell you more about this parchment. Soon you will understand its importance.

Your response: *click*

NPC: I guess you tried to read this parchment and couldn't understand what it is?

Your response: Yeah. To be honest, it does not look like it's actually valuable.

NPC: Oh no, it is valuable, very valuable. I will tell you the secret.

Your response: Okay..

NPC: It contains instructions on how to build a PSI Glove. But not an ordinary glove, this one was created by Crahn himself.

Your response: By Crahn himself? Holy shit!

NPC: Yes! This is the blueprint of the very first PSI Glove that ever existed! Please let me look at it and feel the aura around this treasure for a moment. I will tell you more in a moment.

NPC: These are really the instructions! You know what this means? We're actually able to re-create the very first PSI Glove!

Your response: Holy Crahn... Are you really sure?

NPC: It's up to you now, my friend.  We will see whether this is possible! We may need some help, because reading these old inscriptions is beyond my abilities.

Your response: Who can read this?

NPC: It's very old technology, so you may find some help from someone who worked on this technology his whole life.

Your response: But I don't know anybody like this.

NPC: But I do. It's been a long time since I have seen Kev Critter. He is... different... but when it comes to old tech a real genius.

Your response: Kev Critter? Where can I find him?

NPC: He should still be at Blakkmist Garbage Dump, but let me tell you that you should not mention my name to him. When we last met he tried to kill me with an old rusty knife from the dump.

NPC: Find Kev Critter at Blakkmist Garbage Dump and make him cooperate!

NPC: Who's that, come to disturb me?

Your response: Are you Kev Critter? I really need your help!

NPC: I'm retired.

Your response: I really need your help! I heard that you're the only one who can read and understand very old technology.

NPC: You heard that... WHAT? Old technology? Did you say old technology?

Your response: Yes! I found an old parchment with the instructions on how to build the first glove ever... Crahn's Glove!

NPC: Who cares?

Your response: We're talking about the glory of Crahn!

NPC: Can I buy food or anything else with Crahn's glory? Can Crahn help me with my problems?

Your response: But... but... the glove... the... Okay, your problems. How can I help you?

NPC: Take a look around! I'm using all this garbage stuff to invent and build high technology items. What I can't find here are Tech Parts. If you really want me to take a look at your parchment, bring me 10 '*Unidentified* Tech Parts' and I'll see what I can do.

NPC: You have them?

Your response: Sure! Now it's your turn!

NPC: 10 T Parts or you have to learn how to read that rag for yourself!

NPC: The parchment, please!

Your response: - Give parchment -

NPC: I need the parchment, if you want me to read it.

NPC: Well, well. This construction plan is really old. I was only an apprentice myself back then, but I remember rumours about such a glove.

Your response: *click*

NPC: Back then, the followers of Crahn conducted many experiments... you don't want to know the details, believe me.
Really ugly stuff.

Fact is, there is stuff written about it, that is far beyond my understanding, but you may have luck with someone else.

Your response: Another specialist? Who is it?

NPC: He is a scientist and may know more about the science behind it. It will be tricky to talk to him about this because he is a member of the Fallen Angels.

Your response: Oh dear. Do you really think a scientist from the Fallen Angels will help me build Crahns PSI glove?

NPC: As far as it goes for me, this guy may have the knowledge. He doesn't like big crowds though, so you may need to look for him somewhere quiet in Tech Haven.

Your response: Alright, I'll give it a try. What's his name?

NPC: His name is Marcus Bellin.

Your response: Okay, Marcus Bellin at a quiet place in Tech Haven. On my way.

NPC: Good luck.

NPC: Find Marcus Bellin in Tech Haven Sector 2!

NPC: WHAT?

Your response: Relax.. Kev Critter sends me!

NPC: Before you talk to me, you should talk with Kev Critter!

NPC: Kev? The old bastard... I thought he retired.

Your response: He did, but for a few credits...

NPC: Yes... that's Kev! Okay, what do you want?

Your response: I need your help. I have a really old construction plan. I'm told that nobody can decrypt it, except you.

NPC: Let me see it.

Your response: - Give parchment -

NPC: You should show me the construction plan, if you want my help.

NPC: You're right... it's very old!

Your response: But you can help me?

NPC: Yes. The mechanical parts of this are pretty complicated, but I have seen some of it before

Your response: *click*

NPC: Some of these components remind me of the computer cores used in Warbots. Not the little ones you still see nowadays in the Wastelands, but an even larger model.

Your response: Larger? All Warbots are pretty large..

NPC: This was some kind of Juggernaut Warbot - built to lay seige to cities rather than fighting people. I would be very interested in one of those Warbot cores.
I feel it would help me to analyze these schematics.

Your response: *click*

NPC: You bring me one of those cores, nah forget it, it's better if you get me one of those trigger devices, and I will use it to decrypt the schematics.
Maybe you can find it somewhere in the Juggernaut Facility, or... well... pull it out of a Juggernaut Warbot.

Your response: Sounds hard...

NPC: Nothing is free, little one! Bring me one 'Electronical Triggerdevice v 0.1.1'

NPC: Do you have it?

Your response: - Give Electronical Triggerdevice v 0.1.1 -

NPC: I need the Triggerdevice to decrypt the schematics!

NPC: You should know what to do!

NPC: Perfect! Gimme a few minutes, so that I can examine this thing.

NPC: Wow! This looks like the schematic for a very old PSI glove.

Your response: Yeah I was hoping exactely that. It is even supposed to be the schematic for the first PSI glove ever
 - invented by Crahn himself.

NPC: I'm not done yet! Let me work in peace!!!

NPC: Crahn never existed my friend. Did you really think that a member of the Fallen Angels would help you with something you think is Crahns legacy?

Your response: Well, I... I don't know what to say.

NPC: Today is your lucky day! I don't care about religion and the conflict between my faction and the Brotherhood. I care about preserving old technology and ancient artefacts.

Your response: Does that mean you are going to help me?

NPC: I already did! I created a blueprint for you. But be aware that only a High Priest of the Brotherhood has the knowledge and the skills to actually build the glove.

Your response: Thank you very much. I think I should talk to Brother Cyrus about this.

NPC: Do whatever you like.

NPC: I sense you have some great news, %PLAYER_NAME() ..

Your response: Yes, Brother. I was able to find a scientist-he crafted a blueprint-we should be able to construct the glove now.

NPC: Great news!

Your response: Marcus Bellin told me that only a High Priest of the Brotherhood has the knowledge and skills to create the glove.

NPC: Yes, that's what I already thought as well. I know the right person... But it's difficult.

Your response: Difficult?

NPC: There is only one High Priest left who can do it... But he was disowned by the High Council of the Brotherhood years ago.

Your response: Disowned?

NPC: He was exiled as a traitor.

Your response: He collaborated with the enemy?

NPC: Yes, he did. The specifics are strictly confidential. Only the High Council can access the details.

Your response: Okay... what can we do? We need him, right?

NPC: Indeed. Maybe you can persuade him. Talk to him!

Your response: Where can I find him?

NPC: Last time I heard about High Priest Persec, he lived somewhere in Tawkeen Village, not in the Ministry of course...

NPC: Piss off, wanker!

Your response: Calm down. High Priest, I need your help.

NPC: I know what you're looking for. I'm a High Priest, I can read your mind, %PLAYER_NAME()!
They told you I was a traitor, didn't they? I was falsely disowned by my own people, at the behest of the High Council!

Your response: Falsely?

NPC: They thought I willingly helped the enemy. I didn't! Someone fooled me.

Your response: Who?

NPC: That's not your business.

Your response: Okay, sorry...

NPC: You came all this way just to talk about my history?

Your response: No. I need your help. I found the forgotten parchment...

NPC: The forgotten parchment?

Your response: Yes. It's about the very first PSI glove - crafted by Crahn himself.

NPC: And now you need a High Priest to craft it? I guess I'm the only one left who can do it, right?

Your response: Yes. Can you help me?

NPC: Of course, %PLAYER_NAME()! We're talking about the very first glove Crahn created!

Your response: That is amazing, you want money for this or something else? I mean... you're alone here in the wastes...

NPC: It's years ago since I was disowned by the Brotherhood, I'm fine. I don't want to go back. And I don't need money!

Your response: Okay... I don't want to bug you with it anymore!

NPC: If you want me to help you, I need the blueprint to build the glove.

Your response: - Give Blueprint -

NPC: If you want me to craft the glove, I need the blueprint!

NPC: It's almost done!

Your response: I'm so excited!

NPC: It's a wonderful glove. Invented by Crahn himself... You can feel all his glory, his power, his passion...

Your response: *click*

NPC: It's too strong for you, I can't give it back to you, it's just too beautiful!

Your response: Erm... WHAT?

NPC: We're talking about the very first glove! I always wanted to have it and now I got it! Piss of, wanker!

Your response: This is not going to happen! Give it back to me, NOW !

NPC: If you want to have it back you will have to fight for it, little one!

Your response: If this is your last word...

NPC: DIE!

NPC: Your journey was successful, %PLAYER_NAME(), congratulations!

Your response: Thank you, Brother Cyrus. The High Priest wanted to fool me, I had to kill him...

NPC: Find the High Priest Persec!

NPC: You know what do you, do you? You have to find High Priest Persec!

NPC: Unbelievable! Glad to hear you're fine!
You got the glove?

Your response: Sure! - Give glove -

NPC: I need the un-consecrated glove to consecrate it!

NPC: I'm almost done... But there is one important question left...

Your response: What is it?

NPC: I can customize the glove for you, what do you wish to have?

Your response: I want a glove for passive PSI use (PPU), please!

Your response: I want a glove for aggressive PSI use (APU), please!

NPC: Your wish is my command, are you sure you want the PPU version?

Your response: Yes, I'm sure!

Your response: No, let me pick the APU version, please!

NPC: Your wish is my command, are you sure you want the APU version?

Your response: Yes, I'm sure!

Your response: No, let me pick the PPU version, please!

NPC: You really deserve it, %PLAYER_NAME()! Take the glove and spread the word of Crahn! May Crahn bless you!

entries.details:
CONTACT
Lucious Lovin

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Computer Core Reg. #1FFC00

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Infiltration Assault Rifle IAR-47
• S.W.A.T. Assault Rifle
• S.W.A.T. Backup Gun

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Hehe, ok! These computer boards need to be recycled from computer components which have been looted from a tech convoy in the Wastelands by this scum that hangs around in the Side Streets, Sewer Systems, Storages and Water Treatment Facilities. This convoy was one of the last leaving the Dome and this scum took the chance to get whatever is not nailed on the ground.

• Ok! In each dungeon inside the sectors 1,3,5,7, and 9 you should find one of the components. Four parts from each sector will bring up one computer board. So overall you will need 20 components to recyle them to the five needed computer boards. And from these five boards you recycle the finale computer core. Can you follow?

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Hey! Sup?

Your response: Nothing! Feck off!!

Your response: Yo! Whatcha doin here?

NPC: Haha! Get the fuck out of here, loser!

NPC: Not much. Well, you seem to be capable of doing things!

Your response: Doing things like?

NPC: I got a lil problem here and could need some help

Your response: Others problems are my biz! What you need help for?

NPC: I need someone to recover some computer components. Those things need to be recycled to computer boards and then these boards need to be recycled to a computer core.

Your response: Ummmm, recycling? I am good at beating the shit out of people but recycling? I really don't know..

NPC: Beating shit out of people is already a good start. Well, you could ask someone about the recycling part. Maybe you know some of these scientific nerds who could do the boring part for you?

Your response: That sounds like a plan! I am on it! Tell me more!

NPC: Great! This job will take some time and won't be easy. So you better gear up well before you move out!

Your response: I will be ready, don't worry!

NPC: Ok, to get the final Computer Core Reg. #1FFC00 you will need to get the five computer boards, which are Computer Board Reg. #1C0DA, Computer Board Reg. #1C0DB, Computer Board Reg. #1C0DC, Computer Board Reg. #1C0DD and  Computer Board Reg. #1C0DE. Got me?

Your response: Yeah! Just lemme write down all this registration numbers, Jesus...Just go on!

NPC: Hehe, ok! These computer boards need to be recycled from computer components which have been looted from a tech convoy in the Wastelands by this scum that hangs around in the Side Streets, Sewer Systems, Storages and Water Treatment Facilities. This convoy was one of the last leaving the Dome and this scum took the chance to get whatever is not nailed on the ground.

Your response: I like to beat the shit out of scum! Go on!

NPC: Ok! In each dungeon inside the sectors 1,3,5,7, and 9 you should find one of the components. Four parts from each sector will bring up one computer board. So overall you will need 20 components to recyle them to the five needed computer boards. And from these five boards you recycle the finale computer core. Can you follow?

Your response: Ummmm, I think I can manage that! But what do I get for all this effort? I am not going to do that for a candy!

NPC: Oh, well. I can offer you one of these fine Wisdom of Ceres weapons. Let me see what I have. I got an Infiltration Assault Rifle IAR-47, a S.W.A.T. Assault Rifle and a S.W.A.T. Backup Gun.

Your response: Sweet! And I can choose from one of them once I brought you that computer core?

NPC: Indeed! But you should move out now! My time is limited and you got lots to do! Get back to me when you have the computer core!

NPC: Hey! Finally! You got the computer core?

Your response: Not yet...I'll be back!

Your response: Aye! Was a hell of work but finally I got this damn thing! Here you go!

NPC: Oh c'mon! I said my time is limited! Hurry up!

NPC: Lovely! That's it! Good job!

Your response: Thanks! Now about this WoC weapons you possess!

NPC: You don't have that core with you! Come back when you have obtained it!

NPC: Right! Which one do you want to have?

Your response: I'll take the Infiltration Assault Rifle IAR-47

Your response: I'll take the S.W.A.T. Assault Rifle

Your response: I'll take the S.W.A.T. Backup Gun

NPC: Here you go! Have fun with it! I'll need to go now! Take care!

NPC: I have no more tasks for you! If you haven't already assist our Commander at J05, afterwards head to F04.

NPC: I've had shits tougher then you, come back when you know your Launcher Cyclops from your Butchee! (At least rank /40)

NPC: Yes? Can you not see I'm busy here?!

Your response: I was directed here by an officer of yours. How I can help?

Your response: I assisted the Pathfinders at J05. How I can help?

Your response: But...

NPC: Get lost!

NPC: Good, we're in deep shit here. My company are dealing with more than we bargained for. Whilst we expected hostility from the local wildlife, we did not expect to get in the middle of a war between mutants and those who have been outcast from Neocron city.

Your response: Tell me more.

NPC: The mutants are relentless and never ending, we haven't been able to identify where they are coming from.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: The Outcasts, in response to the mutant's aggression, have begun to take opportunistic raids on us to steal our heavy weapons and vehicles. They have even set up a base nearby to monitor and harass us from.

Your response: And you are getting hit by both sides, right?

NPC: Yes, lucky for us the Outcasts are not very organised and only have light weaponry, every so often they are successful and manage to steal some of our equipment though so before too long they will be a force to be reckoned with.

Your response: What can I do to help?

NPC: Intelligence suggests that the local band of Outcasts harassing us is lead by a man called Miles Sanchez and that NCPD have been running an investigation as part of their organised crime response. He allegedly is a prolific smuggler of goods into the City.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: Rumour has it that a newbie Copbot had a lead but was destroyed when following it up. If we are lucky the Copbot will have been tossed out and that information may still be intact within its memory banks - if we can find the body.

Your response: Getting hold of a copbot sounds more difficult than a smuggler?

NPC: There is much mystery surrounding Copbots yes, but we have heard that once destroyed they are disposed of in the wastelands, I've had my scouts try to locate this dump site but have struggled for manpower with the conflicts in the area.

Your response: Any leads to help narrow my search?

NPC: I would start with the exits to Neocron City. I've got scouts checking A07 & A08, I need you to check A09.

Your response: I'll head to A09 right away.

NPC: Good. Get going Private Eye, when you arrive search for the dump site, retrieve the data from its corpse and return to me.

NPC: Good. Get going Spy, when you arrive search for the dump site, retrieve the data from its corpse and return to me.

NPC: Good. Get going GenTank, when you arrive search for the dump site, retrieve the data from its corpse and return to me.

NPC: Good. Get going Monk, when you arrive search for the dump site, retrieve the data from its corpse and return to me.

NPC: *A corpse of a Copbot, looks heavily damaged but intact*

Your response: *Download memory bank*

NPC: *Download of memory bank complete*

NPC: There is nothing more of value to be found.

NPC: Good, you found the data. I'll have our Intelligence Officers search for any information that could help us.

Your response: Yes, I found the dump site but it had survived and headed towards an outcast camp. It never made it there though.

NPC: We need that data to progress - did you lose it?

NPC: We need that data to progress

NPC: Lucky for us, they would have finished the job! I hope I can rely on your help to follow up on this lead if we find it. Come back and speak to me soon.

NPC: Good, you're back. I need you for a special assignment right away.

Your response: The data I got was useful?

Your response: I don't have time right now.

NPC: Well make time and get back here asap!

NPC: Yes, the lead was good. It contains critical information on Miles Sanchez and his operations. I should turn this over to the NCPD but with all their red tape it would take too long for them to deal with. They would also be unlikely to take action that would benefit us out here.

Your response: You 'should'? What are you actually going to do?

NPC: Not me, you! I need you to track him down and eliminate him and anyone with him. This should send a message and make them less likely to mount a full attack on us.

Your response: Is that standard procedure?

NPC: It's not common for us, but the situation calls for it. I'm losing good men to these Outcasts every day and he's wreaking havoc through Neocron's streets.

Your response: Where can I find him?

NPC: He frequents three of their footholds from what we can tell. An abandoned building in B06, a small set of ruins in B09 and Sherman Bay in B10.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: Intelligence shows that in B06 they are searching for old Cere labs, in B09 they are trying to domesticate the local wolf population to use as weapons and in B10 we are locked in a battle for control of the forward base there.

Your response: Okay, I'm on it.

NPC: Remember I need you to eliminate Miles Sanchez and any 40 of his Outcast followers before returning to me. Look out for Outcast Enforcers, Outcast Soldiers and Outcast Lieutenants to eliminate. You'll find his followers attacking us North of here.

Your response: Got it, Miles Sanchez and 40 of his Outcast followers (Enforcers, Soldiers, Lieutenants).

entries.details:
CONTACT
Pathfinder Canyon Commander

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Key for NExT Quad 'Crocodile'

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Well, I'd be careful to label it an alliance. We want no part in the political or military wars. Our goal remains to make the Wastelands a safer place and establish safer routes between settlements

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: We are waiting on reports from our J10 operation, go and see the commander there!

NPC: I have no more tasks for you! If you haven't already assist our Commander at K15.

NPC: Yes? Can you not see I'm busy here?!

Your response: I was directed here by the Desert Commander. I was told to report here?

Your response: But...

NPC: Get lost!

NPC: Oh %PLAYER_NAME(). Your assistance helped save the treaty, thank you. If you had not intervened we would have had to fall back and abandon this base.

Your response: You're welcome.

NPC: Twilight Guardian has recommitted to the treaty and the signing is happening as we speak. This means we continue pushing through the canyons, with Twilight Guardian support.

Your response: What is the purpose of the base here? Doesn't Twilight Guardian already have a base in the canyons we could use?

NPC: If the rumours are true, yes. That location is need to know though - have you forgotten that Neocron blew up Dome of York?

Your response: Yes, such devastation!

NPC: I don't need that intel anyway. As long as their local knowledge and advanced weaponry keep coming I don't care where they call home.

Your response: So the alliance is working out well?

NPC: Well, I'd be careful to label it an alliance. We want no part in the political or military wars. Our goal remains to make the Wastelands a safer place and establish safer routes between settlements

Your response: Right, okay.

NPC: There is pressure from all sides and we must remain neutral at all costs. This is simply a transaction, like we have with other factions who support our goal in their own ways.

Your response: Got it.

NPC: Let's get down to business. We have been briefed on the existence of cave systems located around the canyon which hold dangerous creatures. We need you to enter one of these cave systems and thin the numbers of these creatures.

Your response: Sounds easy enough.

NPC: The closest cave to us is opposite the bottom of the ladders behind you, we've got soldiers guarding the entrance. We've been told there are more cave systems in nearby sectors too.

Your response: Understood.

NPC: Don't underestimate these caves. It is rumoured that there are matriarchal creatures that can breed at extraordinary rates, and you could quickly become overrun. I suggest you take an Area of Effect (AoE) weapon and find cover. Teaming with other runners would also be highly advised.

Your response: Understood.

NPC: Good. Get going Private Eye, kill 50 creatures in there before returning.

NPC: Good. Get going Spy, kill 50 creatures in there before returning.

NPC: Good. Get going GenTank, kill 50 creatures in there before returning.

NPC: Good. Get going Monk, kill 50 creatures in there before returning.

NPC: Excellent work soldier! Your experience gained in there will be invaluable to us.

Your response: There were lots of crawlers in there.

NPC: You haven't completed your mission yet.

NPC: Speak to our Ordnance Officer left of the Medical Tent for access to our new grenades. You'll still need to know how to throw a grenade to use them though!

NPC: Thank you for returning, your work in the caves is not yet finished.

Your response: Not finished?

Your response: I don't have time right now.

NPC: Well make time and get back here!

NPC: Unfortunately not, it appears the rumours of extraordinary breeding rates were correct. The creatures you killed have already been replaced. We need you to kill a Queen.

Your response: Replaced already?!

NPC: Yes, that quickly. Eliminate the Queen to reduce their numbers.

Your response: Understood.

NPC: Remember, take an area of effect weapon, stock up on medical supplies and ensure you are wearing appropriate armour. You'll likely have to venture deep into the caves.

Your response: Consider it done.

NPC: Don't forget you have access to our new grenades too, as I said before you'll need to be familiar with grenades to use them though.

Your response: Understood.

NPC: Watch your back out there Private Eye.

NPC: Watch your back out there Spy.

NPC: Watch your back out there GenTank.

NPC: Watch your back out there Monk.

NPC: The Queen is dead? Good work.

Your response: Thank you.

NPC: Don't come back till you have killed the Queen!

NPC: You've done great work here. Our intelligence has located several more locations where groups of hostiles are gathering inside of caves or structures. We call these 'dungeons'.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: It seems every region has their own threats. Shamans in the swamps, bats in the mountains, scorpions in the desert, just to name a few. If you want to find out more, talk to our Reconnaissance Officer located by the medical tents.

Your response: Okay, thanks for the information.

NPC: Before you go, I want to offer you one of our Pathfinder Quads. It's a more sturdy version of the other quads you might see around the wastes. It should help you get through the Canyons a little faster.

Your response: Thank you.

NPC: Please travel to K15 and find the Commander.

CONTACT
Pathfinder Swamp Commander, Young Shaman / Swamp Nation

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Advanced Antidote
• Antidote
• Concentrated Antidote
• Resist Potion: Poison

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Advanced Antidote
• Antidote
• Concentrated Antidote
• PSI Booster 4
• Resist Potion: Energy
• Resist Potion: Fire
• Resist Potion: Force
• Resist Potion: Piercing
• Resist Potion: Poison
• Resist Potion: X-Ray
• Stamina Booster 4
• Survival Kit v2

entries.conversation:
NPC: Our Grassland base in C08 needs assistance, go and see the commander there!

NPC: Our Wasteland base in J05 needs assistance, go and see the commander there!

NPC: I have no more tasks for you! If you haven't already assist our Commander at H08.

NPC: Finally some backup, I need your help. My soldiers' lives depend on it.

Your response: I'm ready, what do you need?

Your response: This mission isn't right for me right now then.

NPC: Get out of my sight then, I have soldiers to save here!

NPC: This area is infested with native swamp creatures of all types, hippos, flying jellies, plants and swamp mages.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: The toxins they use here are far stronger than we have ever encountered. Poison armour is required, but it's that potent that our medics are struggling to combat its effects with our existing antidotes.

Your response: Got it, I should make sure I equip poison armour.

NPC: Whilst the native Swamp Mages have greeted us with hostility, local traders have informed us there is an individual who could potentially be persuaded to help us.

Your response: So they can be reasoned with?

NPC: It seems so. The mages seem to have an understanding with the traders and they will, generally, be left alone. The traders feel safe, but there is a tension in the air.

Your response: Do we have any intelligence on where to find this individual who may help?

NPC: Nothing concrete, the traders don't dare stray far from their settlements so couldn't give us specifics. All we have is that the mage travels North / North-West when he leaves the nearby traders.

Your response: I'll head out right away.

NPC: Good. Get going Private Eye, search the area for the mage but be cautious!

NPC: Good. Get going Spy, search the area for the mage but be cautious!

NPC: Good. Get going GenTank, search the area for the mage but be cautious!

NPC: Good. Get going Monk, search the area for the mage but be cautious!

NPC: You not attack? You friendly?

Your response: Yes I am, I'm looking for help in creating an antidote.

NPC: An-ti-dote?

Your response: Yes, to make my people feel better...

NPC: Yes, I help, I help. Drugs first.

Your response: You want drugs?

NPC: Yes, trader no give. Need more. 5 of each. Then help.

Your response: Okay, which drugs and where do I get them?

NPC: More Traders? Traders at a... vil, vill-age?

Your response: Okay, let me see what you need.

NPC: More drugs.

NPC: Drugs?

Your response: Here!
- Give 5 Antidotes -

NPC: Need 5 Antidotes!

NPC: Drugs?

Your response: Here!
- Give 5 Advanced Antidotes -

NPC: Need 5 Advanced Antidotes!

NPC: Drugs?

Your response: Here!
- Give 5 Concentrated Antidotes -

NPC: Need 5 Concentrated Antidotes!

NPC: Drugs?

Your response: Here!
- Give 5 Resist Potion: Poison -

NPC: Need 5 Resist Potion: Poison!

NPC: Thank you. Here, an-ti-dote.

NPC: You have antidote now.

NPC: Tell me, were you successful?

Your response: Yes, I found the friendly Swamp Mage and swapped him some of our antidotes for some of his.

NPC: Did you lose the antidote?!

NPC: Find that Swamp Mage and get us that antidote!

NPC: Just in time, I'll get the medics to administer this antidote. It better work!

NPC: Good, you are back. We are still waiting for the antidote you retrieved to take effect but I have a task in the meantime, if you are up to it?

Your response: Reporting for duty.

Your response: I don't have time right now.

NPC: Well make time and get back here!

NPC: I need your help to take some pressure off us here and hunt some threats around these Swamps. The threats are numerous and nearby.

Your response: What threats should I target?

NPC: First of all, the 'Swamp Hippos'. These are the matured hulking green monstrosities that spit, stomp, club and even get mounted by little Shamans. They are powerful and not to be taken lightly.

Your response: I can't miss them right?

NPC: Correct. Look for the Swamp Warrior, Big Swamp Warrior, Marsh Hippo Bull, Big Marsh Hippo Bull, Big Marsh Saurus Bull, and Big Swamprider. Kill 15 of any of these.

Your response: Got it.

NPC: Second is the plant life. These 'Herbalis Swamp Plants' are growing near to our base here, but also throughout the Swamps. They shoot a deadly poison from their heads.

Your response: I'll clear the zones around the base.

Pathfinder Mountain Commander

• A&W Marksman Assault Drone RF-4

• Cryton HT-TL120 Hacktool
• NCPD 'TriDe' Fusion Cannon

entries.conversation:
NPC: Our swamp base in F04 needs assistance, go and see the commander there!

NPC: I have no more tasks for you! If you haven't already assist our Commander at J10.

NPC: Yes? Can you not see I'm busy here?!

Your response: I was directed here by your Swamp Commander. How can I help?

Your response: But...

NPC: Get lost!

NPC: Great an extra pair of hands, we need someone to run reconnaissance.

Your response: Tell me more.

NPC: The mountains are crawling with lethal robotics and the terrain is making it difficult for us to pass through. These scouts and I are all that remains of the initial platoon.

Your response: How did this happen?

NPC: The steep slopes and winding roads limit your ability to avoid combat or ideally position yourself for engaging enemies.

Your response: Did you lose many men?

NPC: Yes. We need to make the area safer before we can establish logistic routes and forward bases in the region.

Your response: What is your plan?

NPC: Intelligence have identified an unusually high number of signals in the region. They are working to decipher each in order to find which are relating to the high robotic presence.

Your response: What can I do to help?

NPC: We have already used Hovercarriers to drop scanners at various high altitude locations across the mountains. However, our network is facing persistent cyber-attacks and we cannot access the data they are gathering.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: I need you to visit each scanner and manually download the data from source.

Your response: Roger that.

NPC: The sectors we dropped scanners in are J07, G06 and E10.

Your response: *Click*.

NPC: Get the data drive from each and return to me.

Your response: *Click*.

NPC: Good. Get going Private Eye, I hope you know how to configure a scanner.

NPC: Good. Get going Spy, I expect you know your way around a scanner.

NPC: Good. Get going GenTank, Try not to break them!

NPC: Good. Get going Monk, set up the scanners and get back here.

NPC: Good job, we'll use these drives to get the data we need.

Your response: Great, when will we have results?

NPC: Where is the data drive for the E10 scanner?

NPC: Where is the data drive for the G06 scanner?

NPC: Where is the data drive for the J07 scanner?

NPC: Soon. Our analysts will review the data and try to triangulate a source.

NPC: Good, you're back. We have findings from the scanners.

Your response: Great, what have you found?

Your response: I don't have time right now.

NPC: Well make time and get back here!

NPC: We have triangulated a likely source location nearby in the mountains. We don't know the who or why, but we can start with the where.

Your response: Okay, where is this location?

NPC: I want you to head to sector E09 and disable the source. It's likely to be located nearby some powerful transmitting equipment such as satellite dishes and antennas.

Your response: Got it, E09 and disable the source.

NPC: Watch your back out there Private Eye.

NPC: Watch your back out there Spy.

NPC: Watch your back out there GenTank.

NPC: Watch your back out there Monk.

NPC: *You hear the whirl of fans and the humming of electricity*

Your response: *Deactivate device*

NPC: *ERROR: CREDENTIAL CORRUPTION DETECTED. TAMPER PROTECTION ACTIVATED.*

Your response: *Click*

NPC: *BEGINNING SECURITY PROCEDURE*

Your response: *Begin hack*

NPC: *BEGINNING SECURITY PROCEDURE*

Your response: *Click*

NPC: Please enter nearest Uplink facility

Your response: Northstar

Your response: Tristar

Your response: Hawkins

Your response: Crest

NPC: Please enter maximum lethality Hoverbot deployed to region:

Your response: Big Hoverstation

Your response: Big Hoverbot

Your response: Hoverbomber

Your response: Giant Hovereye

NPC: Please enter maximum lethality Sentinel deployed to region:

Your response: Mk I

Your response: Mk II

Your response: Mk III

Your response: Mk Prime

NPC: Please enter maximum lethality robotic Beetle deployed to region:

Your response: Shabby Cyberbeetle Swarm

Your response: Disrupted Mechbeetle

NPC: *ERROR : INCORRECT RESPONSE : DEPLOYING COUNTER MEASURES : TEMPORARY LOCKING WORKSTATION*

NPC: *WORKSTATION LOCK LIFTED : SYSTEM OPERATIONS RESTORED*

NPC: *WORKSTATION TEMPORARILY LOCKED : 3 MINUTE LOCK STILL IN EFFECT*

NPC: *SECURITY PROCEDURE OVERRIDE*

Your response: *Deactivate device*

NPC: *Device deactivated*

NPC: *The device has been deactivated*

NPC: The number of active signals has lowered and their movements are no longer as coordinated. Looks like you were successful.

Your response: Yes, the device has been disabled.

NPC: Find the source and disable it!

NPC: Great, continue destroying any robots you find. Take this hack tool, it will enable you to hack robotic enemies and loot their items once you have destroyed them.

Your response: Thank you, could you tell me more about hacking?

Your response: Great, I know about hacking already.

NPC: Many robotic enemies will be locked once destroyed and you will be unable to loot them.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: Having skill in hacking and a hacktool will allow you to hack the enemy remains and gain access to the loot. The more hacking skill you have, the easier the hacks will become.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: To successfully complete a hack you need to have at least 11 nodes activated when the timer runs to 0. You have limited actions so take time to view the branches before acting, and focus on those which result in multiple node activations.

Your response: *Click*

entries.details:
CONTACT
Pathfinder Canyon Commander

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Explorers Knowledge CPU

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• First of all, welcome to our final Forward Operating Base. From this stronghold we will hold back the dangers of the Wastelands.

• By fortifying this position we can help guard settlements, trade routes and support the rebuilding of our civilisation. All from the most inhospitable region of the Wastelands.

• It has, this is a great achievement! Our mission to reach across the Wastelands and secure footholds is just the start though. We will need time and support to truly drive back the threats of world.

• No, we have reached across the Wastelands and have achieved our initial goal. We have no more tasks to offer you right now.

• It's a new brain implant we've been working on called the Explorers Knowledge CPU. It's tailored towards moving swiftly, may it aid your exploration of the Wastelands!

• When you feel ready, remove your Law Enforcer (LE) implant and join a clan to participant in Player VS Player Outpost fights. Your clan can fight other clans to take ownership of Outposts around the Wastelands and reap the glory and rewards.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Give me a moment, I'm still waiting on your file from HQ.

NPC: I don't have time to assign you a mission now, help at K15 and then come back!

NPC: You've done all you can to help us. I suggest your next steps should be: 
- Farming unidentified tech parts to get gear 
- Attaining Wisdom of Ceres experience & discs to unlock more possibilities
- Exploring every dungeon for unique loot 
- Collecting every trophy and master trophy to enhance your apartment 
- Removing your LE and joining a clan to PvP and fight for outposts

NPC: Good to see you again, ready for another task?

Your response: I'm ready, what is needed?

Your response: Not yet.

NPC: Hurry back, we've much to do in order to secure this location!

NPC: First of all, welcome to our final Forward Operating Base. From this stronghold we will hold back the dangers of the Wastelands.

Your response: This will be a useful location.

NPC: By fortifying this position we can help guard settlements, trade routes and support the rebuilding of our civilisation. All from the most inhospitable region of the Wastelands.

Your response: It's been quite the journey!

NPC: It has, this is a great achievement! Our mission to reach across the Wastelands and secure footholds is just the start though. We will need time and support to truly drive back the threats of world.

Your response: What do you mean?

NPC: Take this base for instance. You'll be able to return here to group with other runners, resupply and run terminal missions if you wish. The area however, is unlikely to be 'safe' for many years, if ever.

Your response: I look forward to doing my part in this region.

NPC: Let's discuss how we strengthen this position.

Your response: I'm ready.

NPC: We are dealing with repeated attacks from the Cyborgs of this area. They are aggressive, well armed and many in number.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: The Cyborgs are drawn to our new power generator and wish to seize its power for themselves. Their attacks are causing intermittent power cuts, leaving us vulnerable.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: Please go to our power generator and lend aid to our Head Technician whilst he finishes his work.

Your response: I'm on it.

NPC: Good. Get going Private Eye, secure that generator.

NPC: Good. Get going Spy, secure that generator.

NPC: Good. Get going GenTank, secure that generator.

NPC: Good. Get going Monk, secure that generator.

NPC: Generator's holding thanks to you. Go tell the Commander.

NPC: Techie or fighter?

Your response: Excuse me?

Your response: I hear something in the distance...

NPC: Sensors are picking up Cyborgs within the perimeter!

NPC: Stay sharp, I expect another attack is on the way!

NPC: The next wave is larger, take cover!

NPC: Stay sharp, I expect another attack is on the way!

NPC: I see a commander, focus on him!

NPC: Stay sharp, I expect another attack is on the way!

NPC: It's over, good job! Inform our Commander that the attack is over and the generator is ready.

NPC: Give me 1 minute, I'm not finished yet.

NPC: Status update from the power facility?

Your response: We repelled the attack. Our generator is secure.

NPC: Hold on, comms are still catching up. Ask me again in a moment.

NPC: Go help secure our power supply!

NPC: Great, his improvements should stabilise our power grid and improve our chances of survival here.

NPC: Are you ready to continue?

Your response: Yes

Your response: Not right now.

NPC: I'll be waiting!

NPC: We have electromagnetic stations around the base in order to deter Cyborgs aggression against us. I'm told the Cyborgs will struggle to coordinate within its perimeter and should therefore avoid entering.

Your response: That's useful tech, why not spread them everywhere?

NPC: Well, that leads nicely to our next problem.

Your response: Oh really?

NPC: Lack of exotic resources. Be it war, faction politics, corporate greed or the inhospitable world - there is little production of the exotic components. What there is, gets hoarded by corporations.

Your response: So how do you run your operations?

NPC: By scavenging and trading like everyone else. We scavenge what we can from existing sources but it's inefficient - lots of components are wasted and we need bulk to find pieces we need.

Your response: That's where unidentified tech parts come in?

NPC: Yes, as you are aware these can come from a variety of sources but you never know exactly what you'll get.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: Runners use them for weapons & tools but we can strip these down to the bare components and use them to build new or repair existing equipment.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: That's where you can help.

Your response: You need unidentified tech parts?

NPC: Yes. To fight a war against these Cyborgs we will need more advanced equipment. This will require unidentified tech parts.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: Bring us 15 unidentified L parts , 15 unidentified T parts and 15 unidentified E parts. With these we can assemble what we need to fortify this stronghold and maintain it until we can become self sufficient.

Your response: Any suggestions on the best sources?

NPC: Generally, the higher the rank of the enemy the more likely it will drop tech parts. They start appearing at approximately rank 80 upwards, but don't expect to find them on every enemy.

Your response: Okay, anything else useful?

NPC: If they require hacking to loot, they are even more likely to drop them. The Cyborgs in this region have the highest drop rates in the world. But other hackable enemies include Hoverbots, DoY Bots, Warbots and Sentinels also have high drop rates.

Your response: Highest rank & hackable are best, got it.

NPC: That's not all though, if you don't hack you can still kill other high ranked mobs such as Firemobs, Sandcrawlers, some Swamp creatures and others. They just won't drop as many as a similar ranked hackable foe.

Your response: Could you repeat that part please?

Your response: Okay. High rank is best, hackable is a bonus. Got it!

NPC: Watch your back out there Private Eye.

NPC: Watch your back out there Spy.

NPC: Watch your back out there GenTank.

NPC: Watch your back out there Monk.

NPC: You got L Parts?

Your response: Here!
- give 15 L Parts -

NPC: You got T Parts?

Your response: Here!
- give 15 T Parts -

NPC: I need those 15 T Parts!

NPC: You got E Parts?

- give 15 E Parts -

Your response: I hope you find a good use for them, that was hard work!

NPC: We will, they will be used to secure this base & humanities future.

Your response: Is there anything else?

NPC: No, we have reached across the Wastelands and have achieved our initial goal. We have no more tasks to offer you right now.

Your response: It's been a pleasure working with you.

NPC: You've been a great asset, we'll be in touch if we have any further assignments. But for now let me give you one last item that I think will aid you.

Your response: What is it?

NPC: It's a new brain implant we've been working on called the Explorers Knowledge CPU. It's tailored towards moving swiftly, may it aid your exploration of the Wastelands!

Your response: Thank you.

- Farming unidentified tech parts
- Attaining Wisdom of Ceres experience & discs
- Exploring any dungeons that you haven't already
- Collecting every trophy and master trophy
- Removing your LE and joining a clan

Your response: Please tell me more.

NPC: Gain more experience so you can attain Wisdom of Ceres from the Ceres Temple in the Swamp. This will unlock more equipment that you can use. You'll need to farm Wisdom of Ceres Discs, available from the various Ceres Labs dungeons.

Your response: Farm experience & Wisdom of Ceres discs, got it.

NPC: Complete other dungeons around the world for more experience and unique equipment from each. Remember to talk to our Reconnaissance Officer at E12 he may have some dungeon assignments.

Your response: Talk to the Reconnaissance Officer in E12 and complete dungeons for unique loot, got it.

NPC: Collect trophies and combine them into master trophies to decorate and enhance your apartments. Talk to the Master Hunter in Viarosso 3 for more information.

Your response: Collect trophies to enhance my apartments.

NPC: When you feel ready, remove your Law Enforcer (LE) implant and join a clan to participant in Player VS Player Outpost fights. Your clan can fight other clans to take ownership of Outposts around the Wastelands and reap the glory and rewards.

Your response: Remove my LE implant and join a clan to takeover the Wasteland Outposts, got it.

NPC: Do you understand my advice?

Your response: Could you repeat your suggestions?

Your response: I do, thank you.

NPC: Take care, and return to me for a reminder on what your next steps could be.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Pathfinder Wasteland Commander

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Crahn Blessed Creature Focus CAG 3
• Crahn Blessed Toxic Beam
• Crahn Holy DamageBoost
• Crahn Holy Fire Ball
• Fusion Pistol
• HEW Missle Assault Drone MR-3
• HEW Raygun Battle Drone RG-3
• Long Laserblade
• Plasma Cannon
• Plasma Rifle
• R-AS331 Raygun
• RayGun Pistol
• Ryker 'Vulcano' Grenade Launcher
• Tangent High-Voltage Shocker

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at least 40; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• We have eyes on an old settlement in sector I06 where the mutants are heavily concentrated and we suspect is being used for these dead drops.

• So you know what our goal is yes? To take back the wastelands in the name of humanity and secure safe routes between the remnants of humanity that survive!

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.

NPC: Hold on, I'm still waiting on your file from HQ. Speak to me again in a moment.

Your response: *Click*

Your response: So we are in a better situation here then they are in the south?

NPC: Your experience from the grasslands should be valuable here, I'm sure you must have encountered the mutants they are in conflict with and intelligence suggests those are from the group attacking us.

Your response: They do look the same, have you received any reports from the south?

NPC: No, the mutant force is much larger here then in the south and they are more aggressive. They are killing scouts, destroying convoys and attacking settlements which we establish, you will find many bunkers we have had to abandon due to the pressure they are applying.

Your response: What can I do to help?

NPC: Luckily for us the mutants aren't very subtle and scouts have spotted what they suspect are dead drops, but we haven't been able to intercept and confirm... till now. I want you to investigate a location which we have believe is being used.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: We have eyes on an old settlement in sector I06 where the mutants are heavily concentrated and we suspect is being used for these dead drops.

NPC: Good, you found the something. Let me see it.

Your response: Here, there is a problem. It's an encrypted document, I have no idea what it relates to.

NPC: Have you intercepted a dead drop yet? I don't need to see you until you have.

NPC: Shit, we didn't think they would be using tactics this advanced. It's clear they must be planning something.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: Right. Head to K01, we have a makeshift jail there which we are using to interrogate prisoners. It's not been going well but I want you to interrogate our most recent prisoner and make it can decode this document for us! Maybe a stranger not in uniform will have more success.

Your response: I'll head to K01.

NPC: I'll send message ahead to authorise your entry.

NPC: *Looks blankly at you*

Your response: I need your help to decode this.

NPC: *Fuck off!*

NPC: What's in it for me?

Your response: A swift, clean, painless death. No torture.

Your response: A good word with these soldiers, they may give you some food. You could save lives

Your response: I'll let you go free

Your response: 10,000 credits. If you ever get out of here you'll need it for betraying your kind.

NPC: I'd rather die by my own hand then that of a flithy human! Death to the oppressors!

NPC: Save human lives? Where has humanities compassion been? Death to the oppressors!

NPC: Hah, you must think I'm stupid! You have neither the will or authority to release me. Death to the oppressors!

NPC: Hmmmm credits. Okay, I'll help. Give it here

Your response: * Give Money *

NPC: No money, no answers.

NPC: These are plans for an attack, there will be an attack on the J05 base shortly. You better get back there.

NPC: Your credits are gone. No money, no answers.

NPC: Hey guards, come here. I need to speak to you!

NPC: Tell me, were you successful?

entries.details:
CONTACT
Pathfinder Desert Commander

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Crahn Fire Beam

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Our mountain camp in H08 needs assistance, go and see the commander there!

NPC: I have no more tasks for you! If you haven't already assist our Commander at E12.

NPC: Yes? Can you not see I'm busy here?!

Your response: I was directed here by your Mountain Commander. How can I help?

Your response: But...

NPC: Get lost!

NPC: The situation seems to be under control right now. We have secured the site and are waiting for a contact from Twilight Guardian to arrive.

Your response: This is an unusual location for a meeting?

NPC: Not under the circumstances, this settlement is neutral ground for all. Also, relatively safe - for the area. It's well located as a staging ground to supply the advance deeper into the Desert and into the Canyons.

Your response: Why are you meeting with Twilight Guardian?

NPC: Twilight Guardian have traditionally secured the Canyons and surrounding area. It's no secret that between their fight against Neocron City and the dangers of the Canyons, their forces are stretched.

Your response: I see.

NPC: We have been negotiating a treaty which would see us take over securing the Canyon region and surrounding area.

Your response: What about Twilight Guardian's enemies? Are they happy with this arrangement?

NPC: Not exactly. Their enemies won't be pleased that Twilight Guardian soldiers are freed up to fight elsewhere, but they will accept they benefit from lesser Twilight Guardian presence around the wider Canyon area.

Your response: Why would Twilight Guardian agree to remove their soldiers?

NPC: Twilight Guardian can refocus their forces elsewhere. In return they share their local knowledge and access to their equipment.

Your response: Okay, so Twilight Guardian effectively gain more manpower, their enemies gain more freedom of movement, you gain equipment and local knowledge?

NPC: Yes that's right. We need to convince our TG contact that it's in the best interest of all involved parties.

Your response: When is the contact expected to arrive?

NPC: I expected him before you arrived, he should be here by now...

Your response: *Click*

NPC: Could you travel the road towards the Tristar Uplink and look for signs of their convoy? Take this road Eastward and follow it as it heads South to search for him.

Your response: Sure, I'll go search.

NPC: Good. Get going Private Eye, he needs to arrive here safely.

NPC: Good. Get going Spy, he needs to arrive here safely.

NPC: Good. Get going GenTank, he needs to arrive here safely.

NPC: Good. Get going Monk, he needs to arrive here safely.

NPC: *An abandoned vehicle, likely part of the convoy to El Farid*

Your response: *Search vehicle*

NPC: *Interior panels and fixtures show signs of corrosion damage, whilst the exterior panels show scorch marks and shrapnel*

NPC: Leave vehicle.

NPC: *An abandoned vehicle, likely part of the convoy to El Farid*

Your response: *Search vehicle*

NPC: *Data pad found within, the Commander would find this useful*

NPC: *Take data pad back to the Commander*

NPC: You found a data pad in the damaged vehicles, but no survivors?

Your response: That's correct.

NPC: You must have missed something, go back and search again.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Pathfinder Desert Commander

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Grim Chaser Trophy

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• In the meantime, you can help us. These are the last steps to spreading fully across the wastelands.

• We are a long way from where we started. These are the most dangerous zones in the wastelands, and we need every advantage we can get.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: E12 forward base haven't reported in, go and see the commander there!

NPC: I have no more tasks for you! If you haven't already, assist our Commander at I16.

NPC: Good to see you again, ready for another task?

Your response: I'm ready, what is needed?

Your response: Not yet.

NPC: Well what are you doing here?!

NPC: Good job in the Canyons. They are mapping the area and working on logistics before they push deeper.

Your response: Thanks

NPC: In the meantime, you can help us. These are the last steps to spreading fully across the wastelands.

Your response: I look forward to seeing that day.

NPC: We are a long way from where we started. These are the most dangerous zones in the wastelands, and we need every advantage we can get.

Your response: Understood, what are those dangers?

NPC: The main threats in this region are Firemobs, Sandcrawlers, and DoY defenders. The DoY defenders do not stray far from DoY or their tunnels, so the Firemobs and Sandcrawlers are our priority right now.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: Whilst the supplies from Twilight Guardian mean we are better equipped with Raygun weaponry, we still know little about these creatures. What we do know is they both deal fire damage. We would like to better understand this.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: I have people ready to collect specific samples, but the area is very hostile for their delicate work. I need you to make it safer by killing any Firemobs and Sandcrawlers you come across.

Your response: Okay, which creatures specifically?

NPC: Kill 15 Firemobs. These include of Terror Leapers, Terror Raptors, Grim Chasers & Grim Persecutors. I recommend travelling East.

Your response: And the Sandcrawlers?

NPC: Kill 15 Sandcrawlers. Any size of the Sandcrawlers will do. I recommend travelling West.

Your response: Okay, and the samples?

NPC: Leave those to us, it is very delicate work. They will stay out of your way; you will not even know they are there.

Your response: Got it.

NPC: Before you head off, I would suggest making sure you are wearing armour which provides fire protection. The most effective armour against fire is Inquisition, most vendors sell some variety, but rumour is that the best variety is being smuggled within Twilight Guardian's Canyon Facility.

Your response: Got it.

NPC: Good. Get going Private Eye, kill 15 Firemobs, 15 Sandcrawlers. Return to me once complete.

NPC: Good. Get going Spy, kill 15 Firemobs, 15 Sandcrawlers. Return to me once complete.

NPC: Good. Get going GenTank, kill 15 Firemobs, 15 Sandcrawlers. Return to me once complete.

NPC: Good. Get going Monk, kill 15 Firemobs, 15 Sandcrawlers. Return to me once complete.

NPC: Good job making the area safer. We will have the samples in no time.

Your response: Thank you.

NPC: You haven't eliminated enough Sandcrawlers.

NPC: You haven't eliminated enough Firemobs.

NPC: Speak to me again shortly for your next assignment.

NPC: Are you ready to continue?

Your response: Yes

Your response: Not right now.

NPC: Well make time and get back here!

NPC: Good work on killing those mobs. We were able to get the samples we needed and are waiting on the lab to deliver the results.

Your response: What do you hope to find?

NPC: Anything that could aid us, weaknesses hopefully.

Your response: Understood.

NPC: In the meantime I've got another task.

Your response: What do you need?

NPC: We want a trophy of these motherfuckers.

Your response: A trophy?

NPC: Trophies are objects that can be placed in an apartment to show off your hunting skills, for instance a mounted Drom head. They look great, and some collectors will pay well for them.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: Look out for a Carcass, Carapace or Remains when looting an enemy. A runner with high recycle skill can turn them into a trophy - along with some additional junk like wood and metal plates.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: Unfortunately our carcasses are damaged from our sample collection, so another runner would not touch it. I know a guy though, he can help.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: Find Pierre Murdock at Desert Racetrack and give him this damaged carcass. He will likely be watching the track from the balconies.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: Watch your back out there Private Eye.

NPC: Watch your back out there Spy.

NPC: Watch your back out there GenTank.

NPC: Watch your back out there Monk.

NPC: Yes? You are?

Your response: A Pathfinder Commander directed me here, I need a trophy.

NPC: Oh, the Commander leading the desert operation, I've had several dealings with him. He sent you to the right person. I'm a famed trophy hunter and producer myself.

Your response: I'm looking for a Terror Raptor trophy. I have a carcass but it's damaged.

NPC: I'll have a look.

Your response: Here it is.

NPC: I need the carcass to see how damaged it is.

NPC: This is really beat up, what the hell have you done to this thing?

Your response: Can you work with it or not?

NPC: Not in this state I can't, I need some materials to reconstruct it.

Your response: Okay, what materials?

NPC: I'm going to need some Bones, Animal Skin and Large Animal Limbs - 3 of each.

Your response: Where am I going to find those?

NPC: Terror Raptors, obviously. Sandcrawlers drop everything I need, they will be easier to find too. Otherwise, ask around, someone may trade for them.

Your response: Okay, anything else?

NPC: Yeah, credits. 50,000 to cover my time and mounting materials.

Your response: 50,000 for some wood? You are joking?!

NPC: No, 50,000 for my expertise. Good luck finding another guy to reconstruct this fucking mess of a meat bag you've brought to me.

Your response: Fine, I'll get what you need.

NPC: Remember, 50k, 3 Bone, 3 Animal Skin and 3 Large Animal Limbs.

NPC: You got the bones?

Your response: Here!
- Give 3 bones -

NPC: I need those 3 bones!

NPC: You got the Animal Skin?

Your response: Here!
- Give 3 Animal Skin -

NPC: I need those 3 Animal Skin!

NPC: You got the Large Animal Limbs?

Your response: Here!
- Give 3 Large Animal Limbs -

NPC: I need those 3 Large Animal Limbs!

NPC: Payment upfront, the 50k?

Your response: * Give Money *

NPC: Without the creds I aren't starting the work.

NPC: I'll get to work, I'll send word to the Commander once it's ready for them to collect. You should go tell him.

NPC: Your creds came up short. Come back when you have the 50k.

NPC: I'll start soon, go back to your Commander.

NPC: Pierre Murdock has been in touch, I've sent a vehicle to collect our trophy.

Your response: Great.

NPC: Go see Pierre Murdock at Desert Racetrack.

NPC: The lab has also contacted us regarding the samples.

Your response: I'm all ears

NPC: Each type of enemy we encounter has resistances. Enemies of the same type often share the same resistances, for example robotic types taking reduced poison damage or mutants taking reduced xray damage.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: These resistances wear off as you deal damage though. The more powerful the enemy, the higher the resistance and the more damage it will take to break that resistance.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: Using the right weapon versus an enemy can give you a small advantage.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: Generally robots are least resistant to energy-based weaponry and everything else is least resistance to piercing based weaponry. Remember, resistance breaks down though so you can still use whatever you like and be effective.

Your response: *Click*

NPC: You'll want to experiment as there are exceptions and some enemies will have full immunities to certain damage types. You won't see any damage come off those.

Your response: Thank you for the information.

NPC: Thank you for helping with the samples. I want to give you a trophy from our stock, take this Grim Chaser trophy you can place it in your apartment.

Your response: Thanks.

NPC: Create more trophies from any carcass, carapace or remains you find. Talk to the Trophy Master in Viarosso 3 for help creating Master Hunter Trophies for the ultimate apartment decorations.

Your response: I'll look out for more trophy materials.

NPC: Please travel to I16 and connect with the Commander in charge of securing our last remaining position.

NPC: Speak. Are you here for the delivery?

NPC: Are you just standing there or are you here for the job?

NPC: What is it you want with the CityMercs?

NPC: Hey. Are you the delivery man?

NPC: Hello, there is a job to do if you are interested.

Your response: I heard that the CityMercs need something delivered? If that's the case I'm your Runner.

Your response: I am here for the delivery job that is posted on job Term.

Your response: There is a delivery to be made, right? Then I am your man.

Your response: Obviously you are not the one I was looking for.

Your response: I don't think I should be here. Bye.

NPC: Make your way to %NPC_WORLD(1) and look out for %NPC_NAME(1). He needs the new armor since his one was shredded in the last fire-fight. We have a full schedule and cannot send somebody else so be quick about it.

NPC: This stuff needs to be delivered to %NPC_NAME(1). He is currently working at %NPC_WORLD(1) on a tricky job. It might not be completely safe for you, but then everything comes with a price, right? After that return to me for a reward.

NPC: Runner, do us a favour and deliver this package to our man at %NPC_WORLD(1). His name is %NPC_NAME(1) and I would hurry if I were you. Come back for the reward afterwards.

NPC: Glad to see a Runner who is not looking down his nose on a simple delivery job. Get this package to %NPC_NAME(1) at %NPC_WORLD(1). I will have your reward ready for when you return.

NPC: His name is %NPC_NAME(1) and he is at %NPC_WORLD(1). Go there and deliver the package, it is easy enough.

NPC: I don't want to hear excuses. %NPC_NAME(1) needs the package, hurry.

NPC: Runner, I thought you understood the importance of this delivery. Now go and do your job or I will loose my faith in your abilities.

NPC: The question is, why do you still carry the package around with you? Come back once you delivered it.

NPC: %NPC_NAME(1) seems to be content with your delivery. Here is your reward, %REWARD_MONEY() credits, you will find it shortly in your account.

NPC: Nice job, Runner. The CityMercs would like to thank you and we are looking forward to future collaborations. Your %REWARD_MONEY() credits have been forwarded to your account.

NPC: Well done. Now our employee will be able to commence his job. The CityMercs have awarded %REWARD_MONEY() credits for this job which are now yours.

NPC: Although you took your time with the delivery, I was informed that the package is at its destination. Here are your %REWARD_MONEY() credits.

NPC: Back so soon, Runner? Good, very good. Our plans can proceed at once, then. You shall have your just reward, %REWARD_MONEY() credits should suffice I think. Now be gone, I am very busy.

NPC: Section 3 of the CityMercs informed me that the package was well received. Our employees there should have everything now. The %REWARD_MONEY() credits have been transferred to your account, congratulations

NPC: This must be a joke, I really need that package now. Hurry and get it as quick as possible

NPC: Yeah, right. You lost it? I have heard that too often now, go and get me the delivery.

NPC: I cannot continue my work until I receive the new parts. I don't like this at all. Be quick to get it in time for me.

NPC: I cannot say that you are very reliable as a delivery man if you arrive without the delivery. I am slowly losing my patience. Return when you have the package.

NPC: It's about time I got the stuff from the CityMercs. I almost thought they forgot me. I am sure %NPC_NAME(0) will have a handy reward for you.

NPC: Just another package. One package comes and then another one. Every time more work. %NPC_NAME(0) will have your credits ready. You better hurry, life is short.

NPC: Sweet. This is it. I have waited for days now. Finally I have everything together. Ah, yes. %NPC_NAME(0) should have your money.

NPC: See %NPC_NAME(0) for your reward. Now that I have the package I am sure that more and more work is waiting for me. Heavens.

NPC: I would invite you to a drink but I will not dish out money senselessly. Thanks for the delivery. %NPC_NAME(0) should have the money for you. Hey, you could come back and invite me for a drink. No, just kidding.

NPC: Yeah, good riddance, I say. Don't bother me any longer, Runner.

NPC: Right, watch your steps unless you want to loose it all. Come back when you have business with the CityMercs.

NPC: Oh, I see. So now you are leaving. Don't worry, I think others are better suited for the job.

NPC: What the hell do you want here? I got the packet, now go back to %NPC_NAME(0) to receive your reward.

NPC: Thanks for delivering this package. Now go back to %NPC_NAME(0) to receive your reward.

NPC: Greetings, Runner, here for the delivery job?

NPC: What? There is a delivery to be done. Interested?

NPC: The CityMercs have a delivery for you if you are the right man.

NPC: Hey, Runner! We are in need for a delivery man.

NPC: I am already waiting for hours for the right man to come by.

Your response: The terms say you got a job, something about a delivery. I am interested.

Your response: I am the delivery man you are waiting for.

Your response: I have all the skill you might need for the delivery job.

Your response: This place sucks, I'm gone

Your response: You do not look familiar, goodbye.

NPC: We need this package delivered to %NPC_NAME(1). His current location is at %NPC_WORLD(1). Move, Runner!

NPC: An urgent package, this one. Delivery to %NPC_NAME(1) at %NPC_WORLD(1). Then return to me. You have your orders, dismissed.

NPC: Section 2 is preparing battle strategies. They require our assistance. You will initiate contact with %NPC_NAME(1) at %NPC_WORLD(1) and provide the package that CityMerc is giving into your responsibility. Come back afterwards.

NPC: CityMerc is offering you an opportunity. Move this delivery to the appropriate person , %NPC_NAME(1), at %NPC_WORLD(1) and you shall receive a reward for your services if you return after delivery.

NPC: You have your orders! Move out and do your duty!

NPC: Any questions? I suggest you do what you were asked to do.

NPC: This is no game and we don't play. Do your job or forget your reward.

NPC: I thought you were listening to the mission briefing the first time. Delivery to %NPC_NAME(1) at %NPC_WORLD(1) and come back when you completed your job.

NPC: My orders are to reward you %REWARD_MONEY() credits for your services. That is all, Runner, dismissed.

NPC: I heard of the completion of your mission. Well done, Soldier. Here are your %REWARD_MONEY() credits. The CityMercs do not require your assistance any longer, goodbye.

NPC: Aye, your reward, right? %REWARD credits have been transmitted to your account. If you are prepared for more, visit the job Term.

NPC: Your skills are exceptional. The package has safely reached the destination and is now secured. %REWARD_MONEY() credits have been moved to your account for your services.

NPC: Well done. Your delivery has served CityMerc well since we now can continue with several operations. Because of your major involvement we will give you %REWARD_MONEY() credits.

NPC: Because of your successful delivery we will be able to settle some issues that were bothering us for some time now. Good luck with your future career. Here are your %REWARD credits.

NPC: Speak. Are you here for the delivery?

NPC: Are you just standing there or are you here for the job?

NPC: What is it you want with the CityMercs?

NPC: Hey. Are you the delivery man?

NPC: Hello, there is a job to do if you are interested.

Your response: I heard that the CityMercs need something delivered? If that's the case I'm your Runner.

Your response: I am here for the delivery job that is posted on job Term.

Your response: There is a delivery to be made, right? Then I am your man.

Your response: Obviously you are not the one I was looking for.

Your response: I don't think I should be here. Bye.

NPC: Make your way to %NPC_WORLD(1) and look out for %NPC_NAME(1). He needs the new armour since his one was shredded in the last fire-fight. We have a full schedule and cannot send somebody else so be quick about it.

NPC: This stuff needs to be delivered to %NPC_NAME(1). He is currently working at %NPC_WORLD(1) on a tricky job. It might not be completely safe for you, but then everything comes with a price, right? After that return to me for a reward.

NPC: Runner, do us a favour and deliver this package to our man at %NPC_WORLD(1). His name is %NPC_NAME(1) and I would hurry if I were you. Come back for the reward afterwards.

NPC: Glad to see a Runner who is not looking down his nose on a simple delivery job. Get this package to %NPC_NAME(1) at %NPC_WORLD(1). I will have your reward ready for when you return.

NPC: His name is %NPC_NAME(1) and he is at %NPC_WORLD(1). Go there and deliver the package, it is easy enough.

NPC: I don't want to hear excuses. %NPC_NAME(1) needs the package, hurry.

NPC: Runner, I thought you understood the importance of this delivery. Now go and do your job or I will loose my faith in your abilities.

NPC: The question is, why do you still carry the package around with you? Come back once you delivered it.

NPC: %NPC_NAME(1) seems to be content with your delivery. Here is your reward, %REWARD_MONEY() credits, you will find it shortly in your account.

NPC: Nice job, Runner. The CityMercs would like to thank you and we are looking forward to future collaborations. Your %REWARD_MONEY() credits have been forwarded to your account.

NPC: Well done. Now our employee will be able to commence his job. The CityMercs have awarded %REWARD_MONEY() credits for this job which are now yours.

NPC: Although you took your time with the delivery, I was informed that the package is at its destination. Here are your %REWARD_MONEY() credits.

NPC: Back so soon, Runner? Good, very good. Our plans can proceed at once, then. You shall have your just reward, %REWARD_MONEY() credits should suffice I think. Now be gone, I am very busy.

NPC: Section 3 of the CityMercs informed me that the package was well received. Our employees there should have everything now. The %REWARD_MONEY() credits have been transferred to your account, congratulations

NPC: This must be a joke, I really need that package now. Hurry and get it as quick as possible

NPC: Yeah, right. You lost it? I have heard that too often now, go and get me the delivery.

NPC: I cannot continue my work until I receive the new parts. I don't like this at all. Be quick to get it in time for me.

NPC: I cannot say that you are very reliable as a delivery man if you arrive without the delivery. I am slowly losing my patience. Return when you have the package.

NPC: It's about time I got the stuff from the CityMercs. I almost thought they forgot me. I am sure %NPC_NAME(0) will have a handy reward for you.

NPC: Just another package. One package comes and then another one. Every time more work. %NPC_NAME(0) will have your credits ready. You better hurry, life is short.

NPC: Sweet. This is it. I have waited for days now. Finally I have everything together. Ah, yes. %NPC_NAME(0) should have your money.

NPC: See %NPC_NAME(0) for your reward. Now that I have the package I am sure that more and more work is waiting for me. Heavens.

NPC: I would invite you to a drink but I will not dish out money senselessly. Thanks for the delivery. %NPC_NAME(0) should have the money for you. Hey, you could come back and invite me for a drink. No, just kidding.

NPC: Yeah, good riddance, I say. Don't bother me any longer, Runner.

NPC: Right, watch your steps unless you want to loose it all. Come back when you have business with the CityMercs.

NPC: Oh, I see. So now you are leaving. Don't worry, I think others are better suited for the job.

NPC: What the hell do you want here? I got the packet, now go back to %NPC_NAME(0) to receive your reward.

NPC: Thanks for delivering this package. Now go back to %NPC_NAME(0) to receive your reward.
