NPC: Delivering or picking up?

NPC: Greetings and welcome to Diamond Real-Estate. How may I be of assistance?

NPC: Hello there. Come about the delivery job?

NPC: Welcome to Diamond Real-Estate. How can I help you?

NPC: Hey. Are you here about the delivery job?

NPC: Hello there. I have an assignment for you, if you are interested.

Your response: Yes, I am here regarding the delivery job.

Your response: Yeah, I heard you needed a drop done. Just give me the information and the package...

Your response: I'm here about the delivery job. Just give me the where and when and I will drop it off.

Your response: Sorry, I am not the messanger you are waiting for.

Your response: Find someone else, I don`t have the time.

Your response: Look buddy, do I look like some kind of servant? I don't do deliveries.

NPC: I need this package urgently delivered to %NPC_NAME(1) in %NPC_WORLD(1). The package should have been there yesterday, so you better be wearing your running shoes. Now, get going!

NPC: Hello Runner. I have an urgent delivery for you. A tenant named %NPC_NAME(1) is waiting for this package. You will find him in %NPC_WORLD(1). Get this to him as fast as you can and then return to me.

NPC: Ah yes, I'm glad you came. %NPC_NAME(1), one of our tenants, needs this package urgently. He is currently at %NPC_WORLD(1). Please hurry and then return to me for your reward.

NPC: What are you doing here? You must deliver the package in order to get the reward. So hop to it.

NPC: Runner, I just got a call from %NPC_NAME(1) stating that the package hadn't been delivered yet. You better hurry up.

NPC: Look, %NPC_NAME(1) is still waiting. Stop mucking about and get the job done!

NPC: What the blazes are you doing here? Don't try and tell me you have already delivered because I know you haven't. So get to it!

NPC: Well done. The %REWARD_MONEY() credits have been moved to your account. Diamond Real-Estate is thankful for your assistance.

NPC: Thank you. That tenant has been calling us by the half-hour about that package. Here, have %REWARD_MONEY() credits for the delivery.

NPC: Hello again. I have recieved confirmation about the delivery and %REWARD_MONEY() credits have been moved to your account. Have a nice day.

NPC: Welcome back. The tenant called and confirmed the drop. %REWARD_MONEY() credits have been moved to your account. We are thankful for your assistance.

NPC: You sure took your own sweet time. Like we have nothing better to do here... %REWARD_MONEY() credits have been moved to your account. That is all, you may leave.

NPC: I knew it! Those buggers at the Diamond admin are morons. They can't do anything right. Go get my package!!

NPC: Look, %NPC_NAME(0) said the package should be delivered yesterday! Do you plan to deliver a package or not?!

NPC: This figures. First they screw me on the phone and now they screw me with the delivery. Either you get my package or I am reporting you for theft! I know my rights!!

NPC: Thank you, thank you, thank you! Glad to see Diamond has at least a couple of competent people working for them. %NPC_NAME(0) will pay you for the delivery.

NPC: About time. They promised me I'd have it yesterday! %NPC_NAME(0) probably has some credits waiting for you.

NPC: Is that the package from %NPC_NAME(0), that should have been delivered yesterday? Morons and idiots the lot. They will have to pay you for this, cause I sure as hell won't.

NPC: Be happy I didn't shoot you for being so late. Hand it over! That idiot %NPC_NAME(0) is going to have to pay you because I sure won't.

NPC: The deliveryman! Thank you for getting this out of the dreadful Diamond offices. I am sure %NPC_NAME(0) has a reward for you.

NPC: Took you long enough to get it delivered. %NPC_NAME(0) probably has credits for you.

NPC: Look, I have to work for a living. Unless you do too, I suggest you get out of here. Have a nice day.

NPC: Well, if you change your mind then I`ll be waiting right here.

NPC: All right, fine, whatever. Now go before I have you thrown out. Have a nice day.

NPC: What the hell do you want here? I got the packet, now go back to %NPC_NAME(0) to recieve your reward.

NPC: Thanks for delivering this package. Now go back to %NPC_NAME(0) to recieve your reward.

NPC: Your hope. Your strength. Your cure. ProtoPharm, can I be of assistance?

NPC: Welcome to ProtoPharm. How may I be of assistance?

NPC: Hey. Come about the delivery job?

NPC: How can I help you?

NPC: Greetings. Are you the deliveryman?

NPC: Hello there. We have a job for you, if you are interested.

Your response: Hello, I am here about the delivery job.

Your response: Yeah, I can deliver. Just give me the information and the package...

Your response: I'm here about the delivery job, sure enough. Just give me the where and when and I will see to it.

Your response: Sorry, not my cup of tea.

Your response: Find someone else, I don't have the time.

Your response: Look buddy, I don't do deliveries, OK?

NPC: I need these drugs delivered to %NPC_NAME(1) in %NPC_WORLD(1). Be careful with it. Its still experimental and any leaks might be hazardous. Return here when you are done.

NPC: Hello, Runner. A labcoat named %NPC_NAME(1) is waiting for these drugs. He works at %NPC_WORLD(1). Be careful so the container doesn't break. Get this to him and then return to me.

NPC: Ah yes, I'm glad to see you. %NPC_NAME(1), one of our labcoats, is working on a new project and needs this experimental toxin over at %NPC_WORLD(1). Deliver and return here for your reward.

NPC: Finally, a Runner. Take this...uhmm... package to %NPC_NAME(1), he needs to do some tests on it over at %NPC_WORLD(1). Once you handed it over, return here for the reward.

NPC: OK, those drugs you have there can like save the world or something. So hurry up and deliver them to %NPC_NAME(1)!

NPC: Runner, I just got a call from %NPC_NAME(1) stating that the package hadn't been delivered yet. Get to it.

NPC: Hello there! I am glad to see that you apparently run so fast that you can idle around whilst on the job... get to it!

NPC: I have seen worn down junkies work faster than you. Are you going to deliver or not?

NPC: Thank you for the drop. The %REWARD_MONEY() credits have been moved to your account. Have a nice day.

NPC: Well done. The labcoat really needed those drugs. Here, have %REWARD_MONEY() as a token of our appreciation.

NPC: Hey there. The delivery has been confirmed and %REWARD_MONEY() credits have been moved to your account. Good day to you.

NPC: Welcome back. The labcoat has called and confirmed. %REWARD_MONEY() credits will be moved to your account. Thank you for your help.

NPC: Oh, it's you. Well done. %REWARD_MONEY() credits has been moved to your account. A pleasure doing business with you!

NPC: Catch the sights on the way? Sure took you long enough. Anyway, %REWARD_MONEY() credits have been moved to your account. You are dismissed.

NPC: Have you got it? The package, you got it? No? Then go get it! Friggin workers...

NPC: ...divided by seven, no eight and.. Oh, do you have the package? No? Then I suggest you go get it, drone.

NPC: Yeah, I need that package pretty urgently. So please go and get it.

NPC: Look here, I could create a drug that cures all illnesses if you morons only learned to actually deliver the packages! Get me that package!

NPC: Ah, nice. The package from the office. %NPC_NAME(0) will pay you for the delivery.

NPC: Delivery? Ah, the SROXUS 1.11 the office promised me. Thanks. %NPC_NAME(0) will pay you for the delivery.

NPC: Is that the SROXUS %NPC_NAME(0) sent me? Yeah, it is. The office will pay you for the delivery.

NPC: You sure took your time. Hand it over! %NPC_NAME(0) probably has your reward.

NPC: The deliveryman! And you have the SROXUS 1.11. Sweet. I am sure %NPC_NAME(0) has a reward for you.

NPC: Look, I have to work for a living. Unless you do too, I suggest you get out of here. Have a nice day.

NPC: Well, if you change your mind then I'll be waiting right here.

NPC: Ok. I am sure there are others that need the creds. If you don't have business here I suggest you leave. Have a nice day.

NPC: What the hell do you want here? I got the packet, now go back to %NPC_NAME(0) to recieve your reward.

NPC: Thanks for delivering this package. Now go back to %NPC_NAME(0) to recieve your reward.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Runner, do you need something?

NPC: How may I help you, Runner?

NPC: Do you need help Runner?

NPC: Yes sir, Do you have a dilemma?

NPC: Welcome sir, please ask if you have any questions.

NPC: Yes Runner, how can Tangent help you?

NPC: Welcome Runner, how can I help you?

NPC: Yes Runner? How can I be of assistance to you?

NPC: Ma'am, do you require something?

NPC: Yes ma'am? How can I help you in your endeavours?

Your response: I had a good look through the job Term and you have a delivery job to be done it seems.

Your response: Your company has a delivery job that needs to be done, right? Then I am the right person for you.

Your response: I am rather interested in your delivery job.

Your response: Tangent? I am sorry but I am not into this.

Your response: Oh, yes, and goodbye...

NPC: These Weapon parts need to be delivered to Mr %NPC_NAME(1). He is involved in a secret weapon test and needs some rare weapon parts to continue. You can find him at %NPC_WORLD(). Return to me for your reward.

NPC: Some special clients of ours are expecting spare parts for some outdated weaponry. They have a lot of influence so please hurry. The contact person is %NPC_NAME(1) and he can be found at %NPC_WORLD(1). Come back afterwards for your reward.

NPC: This special delivery is intended for our department at %NPC_WORLD(1). The department leader, %NPC_NAME(1), is already eagerly awaiting these new blueprints for production. Return for your reward.

NPC: Unbelievably, one of our employees lost a vital part of machinery that is needed for further production of our newer articles. Present the package to Mr. %NPC_NAME(1) at %NPC_WORLD(1) and return for your reward.

NPC: Ahh, I am sorry, but we would be pleased if you would just complete your assignment.

NPC: Tangent Industries would appreciate your cooperation in completing the delivery.

NPC: Yes? Are you confused about your mission goals? If not, just continue with your delivery.

NPC: Please return only once you completed your assignment.

NPC: Good work, Runner. As promised you shall be provided with %REWARD_MONEY() credits as a small compensation for your invaluable deeds.

NPC: The package has been received without incurring any damage. It has been a pleasure doing businness with you. The promised %REWARD_MONEY() credits have been transferred to your account.

NPC: Ahh, we expected your return. Congratulations, thanks to your help our efforts will be greatly enhanced. Here is your payment of %REWARD_MONEY() credits.

NPC: We are content with your services. We would like to offer you the opportunity to visit job Term and work for us again. Oh, and here are your %REWARD_MONEY() credits payment.

NPC: Tangent Industries is very pleased with your display of reliability. I was permitted to hand out %REWARD_MONEY() credits as a reward.

NPC: Your delivery job has been completed successfully as I see from our company screens. Please enjoy your %REWARD_MONEY() credits of payment.

NPC: What about our agreement? If you are still interested in the reward, I suggest you complete the assignment.

NPC: Tangent Industries is not pleased with how you are handling the job, please get the package for me immediately.

NPC: The package is of great importance and value to us. Come back when you have it.

NPC: Please do not call on me until you have the package.

NPC: Tangent is in your debt. Please visit %NPC_NAME(0) and ask him about your reward. Your services have been greatly appreciated.

NPC: Ahh, the package, finally. Thank you, I am sure you will be pleased with the reward that %NPC_NAME(0)will hand over to you.

NPC: Please do the delivery a tad faster next time. Thank you, anyway. Please see %NPC_NAME(0) for your payment.

NPC: Mr %NPC_NAME(0) will have your reward presently if you return to him now. I am pleased with your service.

NPC: Your services have been somewhat disappointing due to your lack of dedication but I am sure %NPC_NAME(0) will still want to pay you.

NPC: Please feel free to visit again.

NPC: Goodbye and do not forget to visit the job Term if you are interested.

NPC: Goodbye citizen.

NPC: What the hell do you want here? I got the packet, now go back to %NPC_NAME(0) to recieve your reward

NPC: Thanks for delivering this package. Now go back to %NPC_NAME(0) to recieve your reward.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Well, you look like a fast enough Runner; ya here about the delivery job?.

NPC: About damn time. You the Runner?

NPC: Look kid, my to-do file is bigger than Reza`s ego, so scram. Oh! Unless you`re here about the delivery job?

NPC: Hello, you wouldn`t happen to be the Runner would ya?

NPC: Hi, you had better be the Runner or my boss is gonna have my ass.

NPC: You look the typical pop n drop type, ya here about the job?

Your response: Yeah, I`m the Runner. Just give me the package and delivery point and I`m gone.

Your response: Bingo. Drop the cargo and flash me the details.

Your response: Yes, I`m here for the job. Just give me the package and the place.

Your response: Sorry, wrong chumba for you.

Your response: Find someone else, I don`t have the time.

Your response: Look, I don`t deliver.

NPC: Groove. Here`s your cargo; drop it by %NPC_NAME(1) in %NPC_WORLD(1) real superfly like. After that, tail it back to here and you`ll get yer pay. And chumba, if you skip with this the Guardian ain`t gonna forget yer face.

NPC: Ha! As soon as you new Runners get tanked up ya'll think you can run around acting like a FragDuke4.0. Let me tell you something - run a cocky tude like that and the one thing you`ll get is a g rep trip, one way. I been fighting for Neocron since you were still soygop, so cut the netshow flash... got it? Luckily, even you shouldn`t have a problem with this job. Grab this package, take it to %NPC_NAME(1) in %NPC_WORLD(1), then trace back to here and collect your money. Easy enough?

NPC: This is an easy one. %NPC_NAME(1) is waiting for you in %NPC_WORLD(1). All you need to do is take this package, drop it off, and then come see me for yer cash. And don`t even think of selling that, Reza may own the streets, but there ain`t a copbot on every corner.

NPC: The Guardian needs more people as willing to help as you. Okay, there is someone by the name of %NPC_NAME(1), works in %NPC_WORLD(1). I need you to take this package there and drop it off. The creds will be waiting here with me when you`re done.

NPC: Okay, the addy on the pack reads %NPC_NAME(1). Look around %NPC_WORLD(1), find em and deliver the package, then come back and see me for your credits. And if this package ain`t there in an hour, yer name is gonna be in the next list of Guardian members our double agent turns over to CityAdmin.

NPC: This is a hot one. Get your ass over to %NPC_WORLD(1) like a warbot is after you, then find %NPC_NAME(1) and drop the package off. Remember, real crucial stuff, 10-4? After you`ve relieved yourself of the package, I`m sure that the Guardian will be grateful. Come see me and I`ll hook you up with some compensation.

NPC: Look, last time I checked that package didn`t have legs of its own, so get going!

NPC: What the hell are you still doing here? We need that package delivered, now go do your job!

NPC: Club Veronique can wait until later! Go deliver that damn package!

NPC: Phew, that`s a load off me. Take %REWARD_MONEY() credits for your troubles. Thanks for helping the Guardian out chumba.

NPC: Finally I can get my boss to stop yelling at me! Here, have %REWARD_MONEY() credits for the delivery. Now, I would love to chat but I`ve got work to do.

NPC: Well, there`s one more done. %REWARD_MONEY() creds more in your account too, now let me get back to work. The revolution won`t start itself.

NPC: Great, maybe my superiors will stop bitching at me now. Oh yeah, here are %REWARD_MONEY() credits for the work. Freedom to the people!

NPC: Like I promised, here are %REWARD_MONEY() credits. And thanks for helping out the Guardian, you should sleep better knowing that you`re working against that monster Lioon.

NPC: About damn time, I could have gotten it there faster by hiring a paraplegic dwarf. But a deal is a deal - %REWARD_MONEY() credits in your account. Now get outta my sight!!

NPC: Where the hell is the damn packet? Don`t bother me unless you`ve got it.

NPC: Look, I need that package, now go run and get it before I make another hole in your face!

NPC: I don`t know what kind of game you are playing, but this ain`t NeoFrag, now go get the damn package before I get pissed!

NPC: Score! I`ve been waiting for this. Thanks for delivering it, friend, and I`m sure %NPC_NAME(0) has some money for your help.

NPC: Perfect. I needed that to finish up, thanks for the delivery. %NPC_NAME(0) probably has some credits waiting for you.

NPC: Ah, that must be the package from %NPC_NAME(0). Thanks for helping out, now I have to get back to work; there always seems to be more. Oh, and I assume that there are some credits waiting for you with that old scoundrel.

NPC: Hello, who are you? Oh, the package. Wow, you made pretty good time. Anyways, I am sure you have more important things to do than talk to me. %NPC_NAME(0) should have a reward for you.

NPC: The deliveryman! You can`t understand how long I`ve been waiting for this package, so you`ll have to excuse me if I don`t stop to chat. Anyway, I am sure that you`re more interested in going to see %NPC_NAME(0) and picking up your pay.

NPC: Took you guys long enough to get it delivered. But at least it got here, even though I have seen turtles in the zoo that move faster - and four legged ones at that. %NPC_NAME(0) probably has credits for you or something.

NPC: Great, people stop by and bother me every minute of the day, but none of them want to help out.

NPC: Well, if you change your mind then I`ll be waiting.

NPC: Fine, but you had better hurry and get outta my sight before I remember where I put my pistol.

NPC: What the hell do you want here? I got the packet, now go back to %NPC_NAME(0) to recieve your reward

NPC: Thanks for delivering this package. Now go back to %NPC_NAME(0) to recieve your reward.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Hey, are you the Runner for the delivery?

NPC: You here for the delivery job?

NPC: This package is burning my hands, tell me you're the connection for the delivery.

NPC: If you aren't the Runner for the delivery job then I ain't got nothing to say to you.

NPC: The only thing I want to hear is you asking me where this package needs to go. Please tell me that is what you're here for.

NPC: I got a message earlier about a delivery. That your mission?

Your response: You win! I am here for the delivery job. Just tell me what I need to do.

Your response: Bingo. If you want a delivery, then I got it covered.

Your response: You need a package somewhere else? Just drop it off and hit me with the cords.

Your response: 'Fraid you got yourself the wrong person.

Your response: Sorry, those non-com runs are a total scam.

Your response: Sorry pal, I only do the hot ones.

NPC: You do not know how happy I am to see you. This package really needs to be delivered majorly fast, get it? The destination is a contact named %NPC_NAME(1), should be hanging around %NPC_WORLD(1). You get the package there, drop it off, then buzz back here to get hooked up with your creds, rez?

NPC: %NPC_NAME(1), remember that name. This package needs to be there now. You get it there quick and then trace yourself back here and your bank account will have enough for a new toy. Oh, almost forgot! %NPC_NAME(1) usually hangs around %NPC_WORLD(1). Now get going Runner.

NPC: You ever seen one of those totally rad-scarred mutants in the wastes? Well, if not then I am sure you can imagine. You know they were once people right? Oh yeah! The radiation just does weird things to your body when you get exposed too long. Well, I personally guarantee that you are gonna be stumbling around the wastes naked if this package isn't delivered in five. This delivery goes to %NPC_NAME(1), who is waiting for you in %NPC_WORLD(1). Now, if I were you, I would be running already.

NPC: The Guardian has a package they need moved. Problem not, but all the members that would normally do a job like this are busy right now. So we have to go outside to find a Runner. This is where you come in. Take this package to %NPC_NAME(1) in %NPC_WORLD(1). No questions asked, no answers wanted. You do this right, there will be a nice stack of credits waiting for you back here.

NPC: Good, I've burned too much time waiting here already. This package needs to go to %NPC_NAME(1). The notice I got listed %NPC_WORLD(1) as the place, so look for them there. Once the package is safely delivered, come back here and the Guardian will gladly pay you for your services.

NPC: Barely made it chumba, I was just about to call the netRunners and tell them to find a Runner who keeps a R.P.O.S. clock on. Hi, the name is %NPC_NAME(0). Your package lists %NPC_NAME(1) as the recipient and %NPC_WORLD(1) as the place to start looking. Now get going and try to make up some time in transit. If you get it there in time I'll have some creds waiting here too.

NPC: I already gave you the name and destination, so go get the job done! %NPC_NAME(1) in %NPC_WORLD(1) if you forgot.

NPC: %NPC_NAME(1) hasn't buzzed me with a nice 'Thanks for the package' message, so you can't be done yet. Get going!

NPC: What the hell are you hanging around here for? Go find your target in %NPC_WORLD(1)!

NPC: I mark em off the list, and the new ones pop up. Sometimes I feel like a full replic AI that got stuck on figuring out a kid's algebra homework. But listen to me bitch, you are probably more interested in your money. Here you go, %REWARD_MONEY() credits. Remember to check with the Guardian first if you want another job.

NPC: Well, there's one more scratched off the list. There are also %REWARD_MONEY() more credits in your account for the work. Thanks for helping the Guardian out, friend!

NPC: No matter how good our computers get, it always seems to boil down to face time. Not that I am complaining! With all those hotshot netRunners flying around, I wouldn't trust a fully integrated job system any more than CityAdmin official's press releases. But look at you, you probably have work to get done. Here are %REWARD_MONEY() credits for the delivery, and be sure to check with the Guardian if you need more jobs.

NPC: Hunh?! Oh! Sorry... drifted off there. This damn job is making me too soft! If I'd pulled that in a hot comzone then I would be carrying half my guts home in a backpack, assuming there was anything left. Some of those damn new weapons... Well, here are %REWARD_MONEY() credits for the work, and remember to keep your ears open. The revolution will come!

NPC: Good, I just got the confirmation message from %NPC_NAME(1). As for your money... there. I just transferred %REWARD_MONEY() credits into your account. Thanks for helping out the Guardian friend, we need more people with a sense of morals like you.

NPC: Which one were you? %NPC_NAME(1) in %NPC_WORLD(1)? Okay, good then. I got a confirmation from the other end a few minutes ago. Here are your credits, %REWARD_MONEY() to be exact. Now you will have to excuse me, there is always more work.

NPC: Don't tell me you forgot my package!

NPC: If I don't see that package real quick-like, you're going to be seeing right through your stomach.

NPC: If you dropped my package then what the hell are you doing here? Go out and get it!

NPC: Is that the package from the Guardian? Great! They told me no one was free for a delivery, but I guess you took the job. Thanks again, and I feel bad I don't have any credits for you. I guess your contact should have money for you though, so I will let you get back there and get paid.

NPC: Phew... when they told me no one could deliver it, I thought I would be waiting for weeks. Thanks for speeding things up, and I am sure your contact has some creds waiting for you.

NPC: Good, the package. Is %NPC_NAME(0) still coordinating the deliveries for the Guardian? Ha! Oh, we go back a ways... but you prolly have some credits to pick up, so don't let me slow you down with my stories.

NPC: Thank you. Chatting would be the polite thing to do, but I am a bit busy at the moment. And if I remember anything from my freelance days, you will be wanting to get back and pick up your credits anyway. I just sent a message to %NPC_NAME(0) when I saw you walking up, so your credits should be waiting for you.

NPC: Right on! You will have to excuse me if I'm a bit brief, but I have some very delicate work that requires constant attention. Don't worry about your pay either. I promise I will send a message to %NPC_NAME(0) with the confirmation tag. Your credits should be waiting for you when you get there.

NPC: Ah! A freelance Runner. Guess all the Guardian were busy with something. Anyway, I'll send %NPC_NAME(0) the confirmation number on your way back, so the credits for this one should be waiting.

NPC: Mighty sorry to hear that. Be sure to register and come by if you change your mind though.

NPC: Those netRunners told me they had someone lined up. I sure hope whoever it is pops up soon though. Sorry for mistaking you.

NPC: Well, if you are not the registered Runner then I am gonna have to say bye. Gotta keep my eyes peeled so I don't miss the the real one.

NPC: What the hell do you want here? I got the packet, now go back to %NPC_NAME(0) to recieve your reward.

NPC: Thanks for delivering this package but go now back to %NPC_NAME(0) to recieve your reward.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Well, you look like a fast enough Runner. Ya here about the delivery job?

NPC: About damn time. You the Runner?

NPC: Look kid, my to-do file is bigger than Reza's ego, so scram. Oh! Unless you're here about the delivery job?

NPC: Hello, you wouldn't happen to be the Runner would ya?

NPC: Hi, you'd better be the damn Runner or my boss is gonna have my ass.

NPC: You look the typical pop-n-drop type. Ya here about the job?

Your response: Yeah, I'm the Runner. Just give me the package and delivery point and I'm gone.

Your response: Bingo. Drop the cargo and flash me the details.

Your response: Yes, I'm here for the job. Just give me the package and the where.

Your response: Sorry, wrong person for you.

Your response: Find someone else, I don't have the time.

Your response: Look, I don't deliver.

NPC: Groove. Here's your cargo. Drop it by %NPC_NAME(1) in %NPC_WORLD(1) real superfly like. After that, tail it back to here and you'll get yer pay. And look, if you skip with this, the Guardian ain't gonna forget yer face.

NPC: Ha! As soon as you new Runners get tanked up ya'll think you can run around acting like fricken FragDuke4.0. Let me tell you something... run a cocky tude like that and the one thing you'll get is a g rep trip, one way. I been fighting for Neocron since you were still soygop, so cut the netshow flash... got it? Luckily, even you shouldn't have a problem with this job. Grab this package, take it to %NPC_NAME(1) in %NPC_WORLD(1), then trace back to here and collect your money. Easy enough?

NPC: This is an easy one. %NPC_NAME(1) is waiting for you in %NPC_WORLD(1). All you need to do is take this package, drop it off, and then come see me for yer cash. And don't even think of selling it, Reza may own the streets, but there ain't a copbot on every corner.

NPC: The Guardian needs more people as willing to help as you. Okay, there is someone by the name of %NPC_NAME(1), works in %NPC_WORLD(1). I need you to take this package there and drop it off. The creds will be waiting here with me when you're done.

NPC: Okay, the addy on the pack reads %NPC_NAME(1). Look around %NPC_WORLD(1), find em and deliver the package, then come back and see me for your credits. And if this package ain't there pronto, yer name is gonna be in the next list of Guardian members our double agent turns over to CityAdmin.

NPC: This is a hot one. Get your ass over to %NPC_WORLD(1) like a warbot is after you, then find %NPC_NAME(1) and drop the package off. Remember, real crucial stuff, 10 4? After you've relieved yourself of the package, I'm sure that the Guardian will be grateful. Come see me and I'll hook you up with some compensation.

NPC: Look, last time I checked that package didn't have legs of its own, so get going!

NPC: What the hell are you still doing here? We need that package delivered, now go do your job!

NPC: Club Veronique can wait until later! Go deliver that damn package!

NPC: Phew, that's a load off me. Take %REWARD_MONEY() credits for your troubles. Thanks for helping the Guardian out.

NPC: Finally I can get my boss to stop yelling at me! Here, have %REWARD_MONEY() credits for the delivery. Now I would love to chat but I've got work to do.

NPC: Well, there's one more done. %REWARD_MONEY() creds more in your account too, now let me get back to work. The revolution won't start itself.

NPC: Great, maybe my superiors will stop bitching at me now. Oh yeah, here are %REWARD_MONEY() credits for the work. Freedom to the people!

NPC: Like I promised, here are %REWARD_MONEY() credits. And thanks for helping out the Guardian, you should sleep better knowing that you're working against that monster Lioon.

NPC: About damn time, I could have gotten it there faster by hiring a paraplegic dwarf. But a deal is a deal... %REWARD_MONEY() credits in your account. Now get outta my sight!!

NPC: Where the hell is the damn packet? Don't bother me unless you've got it.

NPC: Look, I need that package, now go run and get it fore I make another hole in your face!

NPC: I don't know what kind of game you are playing, but this ain't NeoFrag, now go get the damn package before I get pissed!

NPC: Score! I've been waiting for this. Thanks for delivering it friend, and I'm sure %NPC_NAME(0) has some money for your help.

NPC: Perfect. I needed that to finish up, thanks for the delivery. %NPC_NAME(0) probably has some credits waiting for you.

NPC: Ah, that must be the package from %NPC_NAME(0). Thanks for helping out, now I have to get back to work... there always seems to be more. Oh, and I assume that there are some credits waiting for you with that old scoundrel.

NPC: Hello, who are you? Oh, the package. Wow, you made pretty good time. Anyways, I am sure you have more important things to do than talk to me. %NPC_NAME(0) should have a reward for you.

NPC: The deliveryman! You can't understand how long I've been waiting for this package, so you'll have to excuse me if I don't stop to chat. Anyway, I am sure that you're more interested in going to see %NPC_NAME(0) and picking up your pay.

NPC: Took you guys long enough to get it delivered. But at least it got here, even though I have seen turtles in the zoo that move faster - and four legged ones at that. %NPC_NAME(0) probably has credits for you or something.

NPC: Great, people stop by and bother me every minute of the day, but none of them want to help out.

NPC: Well, if you change your mind I'll be waiting.

NPC: Fine, but you'd better hurry and get outta my sight before I remember where I put my pistol.

NPC: What the hell do you want here? I got the packet, now go back to %NPC_NAME(0) to recieve your reward

NPC: Thanks for delivering this package. Now go back to %NPC_NAME(0) to recieve your reward.

entries.conversation:
NPC: Hey, are you the Runner for the delivery?

NPC: You here for the delivery job?

NPC: This package is burning my hands, tell me you're the connection for the delivery.

NPC: If you aren't the Runner for the delivery job then I ain't got nothing to say to you.

NPC: The only thing I want to hear is you asking me where this package needs to go. Please tell me that is what you're here for.

NPC: I got a message earlier about a delivery. That your mission?

Your response: You win! I am here for the delivery job. Just tell me what I need to do.

Your response: Bingo. If you want a delivery, then I got it covered.

Your response: You need a package somewhere else? Just drop it off and hit me with the cords.

Your response: 'Fraid you got yourself the wrong person.

Your response: Sorry, those non-com runs are a total scam.

Your response: Sorry pal, I only do the hot ones.

NPC: You do not know how happy I am to see you. This package really needs to be delivered majorly fast, get it? The destination is a contact named %NPC_NAME(1), should be hanging around %NPC_WORLD(1). You get the package there, drop it off, then buzz back here to get hooked up with your creds, rez?

NPC: %NPC_NAME(1), remember that name. This package needs to be there now. You get it there quick and then trace yourself back here and your bank account will have enough for a new toy. Oh, almost forgot! %NPC_NAME(1) usually hangs around %NPC_WORLD(1). Now get going Runner.

NPC: You ever seen one of those totally rad-scarred mutants in the wastes? Well, if not then I am sure you can imagine. You know they were once people right? Oh yeah! The radiation just does weird things to your body when you get exposed too long. Well, I personally guarantee that you are gonna be stumbling around the wastes naked if this package isn't delivered in five. This delivery goes to %NPC_NAME(1), who is waiting for you in %NPC_WORLD(1). Now, if I were you, I would be running already.

NPC: The Guardian has a package they need moved. Problem not, but all the members that would normally do a job like this are busy right now. So we have to go outside to find a Runner. This is where you come in. Take this package to %NPC_NAME(1) in %NPC_WORLD(1). No questions asked, no answers wanted. You do this right, there will be a nice stack of credits waiting for you back here.

NPC: Good, I've burned too much time waiting here already. This package needs to go to %NPC_NAME(1). The notice I got listed %NPC_WORLD(1) as the place, so look for them there. Once the package is safely delivered, come back here and the Guardian will gladly pay you for your services.

NPC: Barely made it chumba, I was just about to call the netRunners and tell them to find a Runner who keeps a R.P.O.S. clock on. Hi, the name is %NPC_NAME(0). Your package lists %NPC_NAME(1) as the recipient and %NPC_WORLD(1) as the place to start looking. Now get going and try to make up some time in transit. If you get it there in time I'll have some creds waiting here too.

NPC: I already gave you the name and destination, so go get the job done! %NPC_NAME(1) in %NPC_WORLD(1) if you forgot.

NPC: %NPC_NAME(1) hasn't buzzed me with a nice 'Thanks for the package' message, so you can't be done yet. Get going!

NPC: What the hell are you hanging around here for? Go find your target in %NPC_WORLD(1)!

NPC: I mark em off the list, and the new ones pop up. Sometimes I feel like a full replic AI that got stuck on figuring out a kid's algebra homework. But listen to me bitch, you are probably more interested in your money. Here you go, %REWARD_MONEY() credits. Remember to check with the Guardian first if you want another job.

NPC: Well, there's one more scratched off the list. There are also %REWARD_MONEY() more credits in your account for the work. Thanks for helping the Guardian out, friend!

NPC: No matter how good our computers get, it always seems to boil down to face time. Not that I am complaining! With all those hotshot netRunners flying around, I wouldn't trust a fully integrated job system any more than CityAdmin official's press releases. But look at you, you probably have work to get done. Here are %REWARD_MONEY() credits for the delivery, and be sure to check with the Guardian if you need more jobs.

NPC: Hunh?! Oh! Sorry... drifted off there. This damn job is making me too soft! If I'd pulled that in a hot comzone then I would be carrying half my guts home in a backpack, assuming there was anything left. Some of those damn new weapons... Well, here are %REWARD_MONEY() credits for the work, and remember to keep your ears open. The revolution will come!

NPC: Good, I just got the confirmation message from %NPC_NAME(1). As for your money... there. I just transferred %REWARD_MONEY() credits into your account. Thanks for helping out the Guardian friend, we need more people with a sense of morals like you.

NPC: Which one were you? %NPC_NAME(1) in %NPC_WORLD(1)? Okay, good then. I got a confirmation from the other end a few minutes ago. Here are your credits, %REWARD_MONEY() to be exact. Now you will have to excuse me, there is always more work.

NPC: Don't tell me you forgot my package!

NPC: If I don't see that package real quick-like, you're going to be seeing right through your stomach.

NPC: If you dropped my package then what the hell are you doing here? Go out and get it!

NPC: Is that the package from the Guardian? Great! They told me no one was free for a delivery, but I guess you took the job. Thanks again, and I feel bad I don't have any credits for you. I guess your contact should have money for you though, so I will let you get back there and get paid.

NPC: Phew... when they told me no one could deliver it, I thought I would be waiting for weeks. Thanks for speeding things up, and I am sure your contact has some creds waiting for you.

NPC: Good, the package. Is %NPC_NAME(0) still coordinating the deliveries for the Guardian? Ha! Oh, we go back a ways... but you prolly have some credits to pick up, so don't let me slow you down with my stories.

NPC: Thank you. Chatting would be the polite thing to do, but I am a bit busy at the moment. And if I remember anything from my freelance days, you will be wanting to get back and pick up your credits anyway. entries.conversation:
NPC: See my colleague Dr Gates, he has a job that would be better suited for you.

NPC: Hey there. Do you have a minute?

Your response: Sure, what's up?

Your response: Listen, don't waste my time, or do you have a death wish?

NPC: I just saw you passing by, and honestly I had an eye on you for a while. You don't seem to really belong with these bad guys, am I right?

Your response: Well, bad things happen, now I am here. That's the story. So what's the deal?

Your response: Obviously you mistake me for someone else. You better stop bothering me, or it will be the last thing you do.

NPC: See, I am member of a little community, which recently became part of the city. Its name is NeoCare. We provide help to those who don't get help from the city.

Your response: It's good to know the poor are not totally lost here. But if your intention is to make me a member, then I have to refuse I'm afraid.

Your response: Are you for real? Next you ask me to donate to the poor? Sorry bro, not my business.

NPC: No worries, I am not asking you to become a member. Rather that I need help in a medical emergency. And before you ask, no, I am not looking for a doctor. I need someone who is able to deal with several kinds of dangers in the wastelands. Someone like you.

Your response: Well, I've had one or two fights in my time. So who do you want me to flat line?

NPC: If I just wanted some money from you I would have asked you directly. The problem is more delicate, that's why we are talking now. I need someone who is able to deal with several kinds of dangers in the wastelands. Someone like you.

Your response: So you want someone dead? Sounds more like my business after all.

Your response: That may cost you a lot if you want to hire me. I'm not for free business bro.

NPC: I am not looking for a killer. Let me explain more details.

Your response: Sure, go on. I will listen.

Your response: No need bro. Keep the details. Just tell me what you want me to do.

NPC: Well as I said already, we are a community. If we had money we would just deal with it in other ways. We can not pay you, at least not with Credits. But we could work on your reputation, meaning your soul light. You help the poor in the way you can, and we pray for you and make sure, your help will affect your soul light significantly in a positive way.

Your response: Okay, you got me now. Tell me what's going on here.

Your response: Yeah, yeah it's fine now. It's okay I will help. But lets keep it short. What do you need me for?

Your response: You know what? Forget it. I'm done here.

NPC: Okay, I will start. As I said at the beginning, our community helps the poor. Our main focus actually lays at the Bum Asylum in Pepper Park 3. The inhabitants recently got infected by a deadly disease, and our options are limited. Since we are low on money, Proto Pharm refused to help. They won't make any donations, and the price for such medics are just too damn high for us to pay.

Your response: So the usual. Your life is just as good as your wallet. So what are the options now?

Your response: ZZZzzz... (his monotone speech makes you doze off ...)

NPC: Well, the big corporations won't be a lot of help here. Either they get incredible amounts of money, or they won't even listen to us. However there is an alternative. One of our members knows of a way to produce a potion required for the curative serum. The problem is, that this knowledge is held by the swamp shamans. Their knowledge is given from generation to generation by only the wisest of them.

Your response: Okay, I see killing them won't help here. So you think they will help us?

Your response: ZZZzzz... (you really kept awake long, but at the end, you doze off ...)

NPC: Well, usually they are not that friendly with strangers and stay away from us or even attack if they feel invaded, but one of our members was able to talk with one shaman who was willing to help. Since the swamps are barely mapped, we only know a rough location where to find him, that's why we need someone used to dangerous areas.

Your response: So the objective is to go to the swamps and find that shaman that is willing to help. That's all?

Your response: ZZZzzz... (wow, you fought a lot to stay awake and listen ... but now you lost)

NPC: To be honest, not really. That potion may contain hazardous ingredients, so to be sure you need a special canister to transport it without any danger for you or anyone else. The Scientists of the Fallen Angels have plenty of these, but as you can imagine, of course not for free.

Your response: So we again are at a dead end?

Your response: ZZZzzz... (only Crahn knows how you stayed awake that long)

NPC: Luckily not. We found a contact who noticed our work. He can't officially help us, but he said he could strike a deal with us, unofficially. You may negotiate with him, as he didn't want to give us too much via official channels.

Your response: I see ...so I have to first go to Tech Haven and meet that guy for the canister, afterwards I go to the swamps and find that shaman to get that potion. That's it?

NPC: ... so in conclusion, that's why you first need to meet that guy to get the canister in Tech Haven, and then the shaman in the swamps after that. Got it? HEY, AM I KEEPING YOU UP?

Your response: Ah, no. Got it. Tech Haven, get the canister, swamps, talk to shaman for the potion. (phew!)

Your response: Sorry bro, don't take it personally ... could you please explain again?

NPC: Yes. Go to Tech Haven first and find Leroy Hawking. He will tell you his conditions to get that canister you need. Afterwards try to find the wise old shaman in the swamps. He will hand you the potion. Return to me afterwards please.

Your response: Okay, got it. I'd best get started.

Your response: Uff...now I think about it... forget it bro. That's too much of my time wasted.

NPC: How could I be so mistaken. I thought you were one of the good guys. Go to hell!

NPC: Good luck. I will pray for you.

NPC: So you are the guy who wants one of our special canisters?

Your response: Err...how do you know that?

Your response: I have no idea what you are talking about!

NPC: Dude, why would somebody like you come down here at this certain time? I am a scientist after all, I don't believe in coincidences.

Your response: Well, I was just surprised. Anyway, do you have that special canister?

NPC: Sure you don't. And I am not the guy you are looking for. You want to continue wasting my time?

Your response: Yeah fine, you are the guy I am obviously looking for. And yeah, I want your special canister. So how about it then?

Your response: You know what? Fuck this, I'm done here. Look for someone else who is stupid enough. I just wasted my time!

NPC: This is the deal: You want my canister, I want your money. Let's say ... 1,000,000 nc. Deal?

Your response: Holy Shit! Are you insane !? I just wanted your stupid canister, not the whole of Tech Haven!

Your response: Hey, I almost laughed. Good one, bro. Now seriously, how much?

NPC: Did you see me laugh? 1.000.000 nc if you want my special canister.

Your response: C'mon, you can't be real about this. This is insane.

NPC: See, the administration of Tech Haven have cut my budget. Do you think I do this for fun? The deal is easy: I need to continue my research and you need to continue your...whatever you need that canister for, I don't care. So...do we have a deal?

Your response: That's just too much, sorry dude. I need that thing to safe some people's lives, so it's important to get that canister. But donating 1 million NC is a tough one. You feel me?

Your response: What about I just kill you and take your canister for free? Really, I am loosing patience!

NPC: Oh I see. Next you tell me you are a saint, eh? But yeah, now you mention it, I heard about the situation in Neocron. Okay, fine. I will make an exception. 250.000, okay? This is a really special price. You may understand me, it's too dangerous for me to just give this special canister away. The Administration would kill me instantly if they found out.

Your response: 250.000? Still tough, but that's better than before. Fine, I will pay. I hope it's worth it

Your response: Still too much, sorry. Maybe I will come back later, maybe not. I need to think about this.

NPC: Dude, do you think I have the canister here? If you kill me, you get nothing. But I see you want a special special price eh? 500.000 nc. That's my last price. You won't get it cheaper!

Your response: 500.000 nc? Dude, I've killed people for less. Hell, just give me that damn canister! Here are your 500.000, I hope you choke on it!

Your response: I just wasted my time here. Go to hell, and better don't ever cross my path again

NPC: Okay, here you go. This special canister is one of the finest developments of Tech Haven Science. Just make sure to not damage it. Good luck with the disease.

Your response: -Pay 250.000nc-

NPC: Always nice to deal with you. Here you are. And better take some tranquilizers next time you stop by.

Your response: -Pay 500.000nc-

NPC: Okay. Just come back to me if you still need the canister

NPC: You don't have enough money. Come back when you have my 250.000nc

NPC: Thank you.

NPC: You don't have enough money. Come back when you have my 500.000nc

NPC: Thank you.

NPC: You just bought my last canister. Go on with your mission and leave me alone, please

NPC: Yeah you wasted mine too. Better you never come back, asshole!

NPC: Hello, stranger. I have been waiting for you. Waiting, yes. Time runs slowly when waiting. But time is irrelevant, isn't it? Oh yes, I know, for you it is relevant. Time is short, lives need to be rescued.

Your response: Wise shaman, I respectfully ask you to help me in my deed. We need your knowledge to create a specific potion.

Your response: Hey granny, how is it? Heard, you'd be able to give me a potion. And yeah, my time is short.

NPC: You haven't completed your first mission yet. Come back when you have talked to Leroy Hawking.

NPC: Yes, wisdom and knowledge. The ingredients for this potion have been passed down from generation to generation. Unfortunately I can't tell you the recipe. You may understand this is very traditional. The wisdom and knowledge that we protect is of the highest importance to our order. I can't share this knowledge with just anyone, much less to a stranger.

Your response: This is an unfortunate situation then. But you agreed to talk with me. So there is another way?

NPC: Our tribe is peaceful. We know you people hunt our kind often. Your people are not trusted. My tribe fears reprisals and threats. You may prove your worth before you can be trusted.

Your response: I am sorry to hear your tribe was attacked by others. I can assure you it wasn't me or one of the people I work for. How can I prove my worth to you?

Your response: Okay wait. Are you kidding me? Did I just come out to here to be lectured!?

NPC: Our tribe has other fears too. There is a way you can do both, stranger. Helping our tribe will also help yourself with your needs. Kri'Nakh Slimeworms crawl out of the swamp caves and attack our tribe frequently, and we need help to defend ourselves. Please thin out their herds. Try to kill 10 of them. This will stop them growing up and becoming a problem in the future. When you have killed them, please get me their poison glands. I need 10 Kri'Nakh poison glands to extract the ingredients for your potion.

Your response: You just need 10 poison glands? That's easily done.

NPC: Don't take too long with this, stranger. Make sure you take glands fresh from their throats. Getting old ones from elsewhere is of no use to us. The potion depends on utilising the fresh liquids in the poison glands. Otherwise it will be worthless for you.

Your response: Okay ... so I guess I better hurry back after killing them to make sure they are really fresh, right?

Your response: Really ... do I have to go out there and kill these? Here, I have 10 poison glands right here with me.

NPC: Do you remember I asked you to proof your worth, stranger? Besides that your dried out poison glands won't help you any bit, I wanted you to show my tribe that you seriously are worth our trust and knowledge. So you better go and do as I asked you.

Your response: Please excuse my impatient tongue, wise Shaman. You are right, I will do as you asked.

Your response: You know what? I listened to your stupidness long enough now. Either take them or leave it.

NPC: So go out and save our tribe, stranger. Our help for your people will be ensured when you are back.

NPC: You should think about your words, stranger. It all starts with respect. Keep in mind, you want something from me. Think about it, then talk to me again.

NPC: There you are again, stranger, did you get what I asked you for?

Your response: Yes, wise shaman. Here are 10 fresh poison glands. Let's hope they will be good enough

NPC: We will see.

Your response: -Give poison glands-

NPC: I can not produce the antidote without the Kri'Nakh poison glands. Come back if you got what I asked for.

NPC: Some of my people saw you fighting brave. Yes, this ones look fresh and good. I will extract their liquids and create the tincture for your potion. Please wait a moment.

NPC: I can sniff that these are all but fresh. Are you trying to fool me!? Now, leave this place and only come back if you learned respect and got what I asked you for!

NPC: Thank you for waiting patiently, stranger. I can assure you, my tribe was happily helping to prepare your potion. But how do you want to carry that potion?

Your response: I got a special canister to transport that potion. Will this be of any help?

NPC: Yes, this will do. Let me fill in your potion, then hurry back to that Dr. John McIntyre. The potion will leave its strength over time, so better be fast.

Your response: Thank you, wise shaman. Your help will be not forgotten.

NPC: Well, where is that special canister you mentioned? This potion is highly poisonous, you surely don't want to carry it with bare hands, do you?

Your response: Damn, I forgot it somewhere. Let me get it quick.

NPC: You better hurry up!

NPC: Be careful and return to the Jailhouse as fast as possible.

NPC: Deliver the Potion to Dr. John McIntyre in the Jailhouse

NPC: So I see you have returned then? And you have seen the Shaman already?

Your response: I have seen the Shaman and I have done as I was instructed. Here is the potion that he concocted for me. What should I do now? Shall we make the Antidote here?

NPC: Well, where is the potion? I can't find it in your bag.

NPC: Are you sure you have done what I asked you for?

NPC: Ah you are very perceptive Runner but no your job is not complete just yet. Talk to me once again when you are ready for the last part of this mission.

NPC: Good to see you again. Ready for the last part of our mission?

Your response: Yes of course, lets go!

Your response: No, I'm busy.

NPC: Hmm okay, bye

NPC: Unfortunately I lack the necessary equipment here to complete the process myself. This Jailhouse has only the most basic laboratory equipment. You will now need to see a colleague of mine in the Laboratory in Via Rosso.

Your response: Great. More running around!

NPC: What was that? Oh never mind, make sure to search out Peter Bosch, the Scientist in the Laboratory in Via Rosso 3. My good friend Peter will instruct you on what is required of you next.

NPC: Peter Bosch is waiting for you in the laboratory in Viarosso3. Please hurry up!

NPC: Good day Runner, I have been expecting you.

Your response: I need an antidote please

NPC: Yes yes, very direct aren't you. Dr McIntyre told me to expect as much. He passed details of your visit already. Do you have the potion I wonder?

Your response: Yes here it is. Will this take long? I have already trekked across half the wastelands for this thing!

NPC: Relax dear friend please. I am here to help you. This antidote will be a wonderful creation. It will help a great many people. Some of those poor unfortunate men and women in the Bum Asylum have fallen on the hardest times. The City Administration has all but forgotten about them, Protopharma refuses to give them medical care and the Black Dragons only peddle their pharmaceuticals if there is a profit in it. So no, what you are doing is quite admirable actually. I wish there were more runners who could help in this way but alas I think that many do not have the inclination or the means.

Your response: Well then thank you for saying that, I would just like to get this over with now.

NPC: I can't produce the Antidote without the potion!

NPC: But of course, the process is complete. Here is your antidote, now please with all haste, get it to the Bum Asylum. Your contact there is Dr Ted Wilson of Neocare.

NPC: Dr. Wilson in the Bum Asylum is waiting for you!

NPC: Good day runner what brings you to the Bum Asylum?

Your response: Dr. Wilson I hope? I am here to bring you an antidote for your patients.

NPC: Visit Peter Bosch in the laboratory first!

NPC: Ahah! An antidote -  so the rumours are true. We had heard of this deed but some of my patients didn't yet dare to put faith in it. We lost two more just yesterday and still there are over a dozen in the final stages of the infection. Please you must give us the antidote, Runner!

Your response: Well here it is. It cost me a small fortune though...

NPC: My good fellow, you are saving countless lives of some of Neocron's poorest citizens! Surely the righteous virtuosity would be enough for you? You deem financial gain to be of greater importance? How shamelessly mercenary of you! These people's lives are at stake.

Your response: Well hey I mean I was only asking...

NPC: Please don't cheat on me and my patients! Come back when you have an antidote.

NPC: I am sorry my good friend, the only reward I can offer you is the solace and satisfaction of knowing you have probably saved dozens of lives. If that small reward is not enough then I can only bid you a good day and ask you to go on your way.

  92  NODE(10)
  93  	SAY("Hey there. Do you have a minute?")
  94  	ANSWER("Sure, what's up?",11) 
  95  	ANSWER("Listen, don't waste my time, or do you have a death wish?",38)
  96  
  97  NODE(11)
  98  	SAY("I just saw you passing by, and honestly I had an eye on you for a while. You don't seem to really belong with these bad guys, am I right?")
  99  	ANSWER("Well, bad things happen, now I am here. That's the story. So what's the deal?",12)
 100  	ANSWER("Obviously you mistake me for someone else. You better stop bothering me, or it will be the last thing you do.",38)
 101  	
 102  NODE(12)
 103  	SAY("See, I am member of a little community, which recently became part of the city. Its name is NeoCare. We provide help to those who don't get help from the city.")
 104  	ANSWER("It's good to know the poor are not totally lost here. But if your intention is to make me a member, then I have to refuse I'm afraid.",13)
 105  	ANSWER("Are you for real? Next you ask me to donate to the poor? Sorry bro, not my business.",14)
 106  	
 107  NODE(13)
 108  	SAY("No worries, I am not asking you to become a member. Rather that I need help in a medical emergency. And before you ask, no, I am not looking for a doctor. I need someone who is able to deal with several kinds of dangers in the wastelands. Someone like you.")
 109  	ANSWER("Well, I've had one or two fights in my time. So who do you want me to flat line?",15)
 110  
 111  NODE(14)
 112  	SAY("If I just wanted some money from you I would have asked you directly. The problem is more delicate, that's why we are talking now. I need someone who is able to deal with several kinds of dangers in the wastelands. Someone like you.")
 113  	ANSWER("So you want someone dead? Sounds more like my business after all.",15)
 114  	ANSWER("That may cost you a lot if you want to hire me. I'm not for free business bro.",16)
 115  
 116  NODE(15)
 117  	SAY("I am not looking for a killer. Let me explain more details.")
 118  	ANSWER("Sure, go on. I will listen.",17)
 119  	ANSWER("No need bro. Keep the details. Just tell me what you want me to do.",30)
 120  	
 121  NODE(16)
 122  	SAY("Well as I said already, we are a community. If we had money we would just deal with it in other ways. We can not pay you, at least not with Credits. But we could work on your reputation, meaning your soul light. You help the poor in the way you can, and we pray for you and make sure, your help will affect your soul light significantly in a positive way.")
 123  	ANSWER("Okay, you got me now. Tell me what's going on here.",17)
 124  	ANSWER("Yeah, yeah it's fine now. It's okay I will help. But lets keep it short. What do you need me for?",30)
 125  	ANSWER("You know what? Forget it. I'm done here.",38)
 126  
 127  NODE(17)
 128  	SAY("Okay, I will start. As I said at the beginning, our community helps the poor. Our main focus actually lays at the Bum Asylum in Pepper Park 3. The inhabitants recently got infected by a deadly disease, and our options are limited. Since we are low on money, Proto Pharm refused to help. They won't make any donations, and the price for such medics are just too damn high for us to pay.")
 129  	ANSWER("So the usual. Your life is just as good as your wallet. So what are the options now?",18)
 130  	ANSWER("ZZZzzz... (his monotone speech makes you doze off ...)",29)
 131  
 132  NODE(18)	
 133  	SAY("Well, the big corporations won't be a lot of help here. Either they get incredible amounts of money, or they won't even listen to us. However there is an alternative. One of our members knows of a way to produce a potion required for the curative serum. The problem is, that this knowledge is held by the swamp shamans. Their knowledge is given from generation to generation by only the wisest of them.")
 134  	ANSWER("Okay, I see killing them won't help here. So you think they will help us?",19)
 135  	ANSWER("ZZZzzz... (you really kept awake long, but at the end, you doze off ...)",29)
 136  	
 137  NODE(19)
 138  	SAY("Well, usually they are not that friendly with strangers and stay away from us or even attack if they feel invaded, but one of our members was able to talk with one shaman who was willing to help. Since the swamps are barely mapped, we only know a rough location where to find him, that's why we need someone used to dangerous areas.")
 139  	ANSWER("So the objective is to go to the swamps and find that shaman that is willing to help. That's all?",20)
 140  	ANSWER("ZZZzzz... (wow, you fought a lot to stay awake and listen ... but now you lost)",29)
 141  
 142  NODE(20)
 143  	SAY("To be honest, not really. That potion may contain hazardous ingredients, so to be sure you need a special canister to transport it without any danger for you or anyone else. The Scientists of the Fallen Angels have plenty of these, but as you can imagine, of course not for free.")
 144  	ANSWER("So we again are at a dead end?",21)
 145  	ANSWER("ZZZzzz... (only Crahn knows how you stayed awake that long)",29)
 146  
 147  NODE(21)
 148  	SAY("Luckily not. We found a contact who noticed our work. He can't officially help us, but he said he could strike a deal with us, unofficially. You may negotiate with him, as he didn't want to give us too much via official channels.")
 149  	ANSWER("I see ...so I have to first go to Tech Haven and meet that guy for the canister, afterwards I go to the swamps and find that shaman to get that potion. That's it?",30)
 150  
 151  NODE(29)
 152  	SAY("... so in conclusion, that's why you first need to meet that guy to get the canister in Tech Haven, and then the shaman in the swamps after that. Got it? HEY, AM I KEEPING YOU UP?")
 153  	ANSWER("Ah, no. Got it. Tech Haven, get the canister, swamps, talk to shaman for the potion. (phew!)",30)
 154  	ANSWER("Sorry bro, don't take it personally ... could you please explain again?",17)
 155  
 156  NODE(30)
 157  	SAY("Yes. Go to Tech Haven first and find Leroy Hawking. He will tell you his conditions to get that canister you need. Afterwards try to find the wise old shaman in the swamps. He will hand you the potion. Return to me afterwards please.")
 158  	ANSWER("Okay, got it. I'd best get started.",39)
 159  	ANSWER("Uff...now I think about it... forget it bro. That's too much of my time wasted.",38)
 160

 162  	SAY("How could I be so mistaken. I thought you were one of the good guys. Go to hell!")

 198  	SAY("See, the administration of Tech Haven have cut my budget. Do you think I do this for fun? The deal is easy: I need to continue my research and you need to continue your...whatever you need that canister for, I don't care. So...do we have a deal?")

 204  	ANSWER("250.000? Still tough, but that's better than before. Fine, I will pay. I hope it's worth it",48) 
 205  	ANSWER("Still too much, sorry. Maybe I will come back later, maybe not. I need to think about this.",50 )
 206  	
 207  NODE(47)
 208  	SAY("Dude, do you think I have the canister here? If you kill me, you get nothing. But I see you want a special special price eh? 500.000 nc. That's my last price. You won't get it cheaper!") 
 209  	ANSWER("500.000 nc? Dude, I've killed people for less. Hell, just give me that damn canister! Here are your 500.000, I hope you choke on it!",49)
 210  	ANSWER("I just wasted my time here. Go to hell, and better don't ever cross my path again",55)

 213  	SAY("Okay, here you go. This special canister is one of the finest developments of Tech Haven Science. Just make sure to not damage it. Good luck with the disease.")
 214  	ANSWER("-Pay 250.000nc-",51)
