entries.conversation:
NPC: See my colleague Dr. McIntyre, he has a job that would be better suited for you.

NPC: Hey there. Do you have a minute?

Your response: Sure, what's up?

Your response: Listen, don't waste my time, or do you have a death wish?

NPC: I just saw you passing by, and honestly I had an eye on you for a while. You don't seem to really belong with these bad guys, am I right?

Your response: Well, bad things happen, now I am here. That's the story. So what's the deal?

Your response: Obviously you mistake me for someone else. You better stop bothering me, or it will be the last thing you do.

NPC: See, I am member of a little community, which recently became part of the city. Its name is NeoCare. We provide help to those who don't get help from the city.

Your response: It's good to know the poor are not totally lost here. But if your intention is to make me a member, then I have to refuse I'm afraid.

Your response: Are you for real? Next you ask me to donate to the poor? Sorry bro, not my business.

NPC: No worries, I am not asking you to become a member. Rather that I need help in a medical emergency. And before you ask, no, I am not looking for a doctor. I need someone who is able to deal with several kinds of dangers in the wastelands. Someone like you.

Your response: Well, I've had one or two fights in my time. So who do you want me to flat line?

NPC: If I just wanted some money from you I would have asked you directly. The problem is more delicate, that's why we are talking now. I need someone who is able to deal with several kinds of dangers in the wastelands. Someone like you.

Your response: So you want someone dead? Sounds more like my business after all.

Your response: That may cost you a lot if you want to hire me. I'm not for free business bro.

NPC: I am not looking for a killer. Let me explain more details.

Your response: Sure, go on. I will listen.

Your response: No need bro. Keep the details. Just tell me what you want me to do.

NPC: Well as I said already, we are a community. If we had money we would just deal with it in other ways. We can not pay you, at least not with Credits. But we could work on your reputation, meaning your soul light. You help the poor in the way you can, and we pray for you and make sure, your help will affect your soul light significantly in a positive way.

Your response: Okay, you got me now. Tell me what's going on here.

Your response: Yeah, yeah it's fine now. It's okay I will help. But lets keep it short. What do you need me for?

Your response: You know what? Forget it. I'm done here.

NPC: Okay, I will start. As I said at the beginning, our community helps the poor. Our main focus actually lays at the Bum Asylum in Pepper Park 3. The inhabitants recently got infected by a deadly disease, and our options are limited. Since we are low on money, Proto Pharm refused to help. They won't make any donations, and the price for such medics are just too damn high for us to pay.

Your response: So the usual. Your life is just as good as your wallet. So what are the options now?

Your response: ZZZzzz... (his monotone speech makes you doze off ...)

NPC: Well, the big corporations won't be a lot of help here. Either they get incredible amounts of money, or they won't even listen to us. However there is an alternative. One of our members knows of a way to produce a potion required for the curative serum. The problem is, that this knowledge is held by the swamp shamans. Their knowledge is given from generation to generation by only the wisest of them.

Your response: Okay, I see killing them won't help here. So you think they will help us?

Your response: ZZZzzz... (you really kept awake long, but at the end, you doze off ...)

NPC: Well, usually they are not that friendly with strangers and stay away from us or even attack if they feel invaded, but one of our members was able to talk with one shaman who was willing to help. Since the swamps are barely mapped, we only know a rough location where to find him, that's why we need someone used to dangerous areas.

Your response: So the objective is to go to the swamps and find that shaman that is willing to help. That's all?

Your response: ZZZzzz... (wow, you fought a lot to stay awake and listen ... but now you lost)

NPC: To be honest, not really. That potion may contain hazardous ingredients, so to be sure you need a special canister to transport it without any danger for you or anyone else. The Scientists of the Fallen Angels have plenty of these, but as you can imagine, of course not for free.

Your response: So we again are at a dead end?

Your response: ZZZzzz... (only Crahn knows how you stayed awake that long)

NPC: Luckily not. We found a contact who noticed our work. He can't officially help us, but he said he could strike a deal with us, unofficially. You may negotiate with him, as he didn't want to give us too much via official channels.

Your response: I see ...so I have to first go to Tech Haven and meet that guy for the canister, afterwards I go to the swamps and find that shaman to get that potion. That's it?

NPC: ... so in conclusion, that's why you first need to meet that guy to get the canister in Tech Haven, and then the shaman in the swamps after that. Got it? HEY, AM I KEEPING YOU UP?

Your response: Ah, no. Got it. Tech Haven, get the canister, swamps, talk to shaman for the potion. (phew!)

Your response: Sorry bro, don't take it personally ... could you please explain again?

NPC: Yes. Go to Tech Haven first and find Leroy Hawking. He will tell you his conditions to get that canister you need. Afterwards try to find the wise old shaman in the swamps. He will hand you the potion. Return to me afterwards please.

Your response: Okay, got it. I'd best get started.

Your response: Uff...now I think about it... forget it bro. That's too much of my time wasted.

NPC: How could I be so mistaken. I thought you were one of the good guys. Go to hell!

NPC: Good luck. I will pray for you.

NPC: So you are the guy who wants one of our special canisters?

Your response: Err...how do you know that?

Your response: I have no idea what you are talking about!

NPC: Dude, why would somebody like you come down here at this certain time? I am a scientist after all, I don't believe in coincidences.

Your response: Well, I was just surprised. Anyway, do you have that special canister?

NPC: Sure you don't. And I am not the guy you are looking for. You want to continue wasting my time?

Your response: Yeah fine, you are the guy I am obviously looking for. And yeah, I want your special canister. So how about it then?

Your response: You know what? Fuck this, I'm done here. Look for someone else who is stupid enough. I just wasted my time!

NPC: This is the deal: You want my canister, I want your money. Let's say ... 1,000,000 nc. Deal?

Your response: Holy Shit! Are you insane !? I just wanted your stupid canister, not the whole of Tech Haven!

Your response: Hey, I almost laughed. Good one, bro. Now seriously, how much?

NPC: Did you see me laugh? 1.000.000 nc if you want my special canister.

Your response: C'mon, you can't be real about this. This is insane.

NPC: See, the administration of Tech Haven have cut my budget. Do you think I do this for fun? The deal is easy: I need to continue my research and you need to continue your...whatever you need that canister for, I don't care. So...do we have a deal?

Your response: That's just too much, sorry dude. I need that thing to safe some people's lives, so it's important to get that canister. But donating 1 million NC is a tough one. You feel me?

Your response: What about I just kill you and take your canister for free? Really, I am loosing patience!

NPC: Oh I see. Next you tell me you are a saint, eh? But yeah, now you mention it, I heard about the situation in Neocron. Okay, fine. I will make an exception. 250.000, okay? This is a really special price. You may understand me, it's too dangerous for me to just give this special canister away. The Administration would kill me instantly if they found out.

Your response: 250.000? Still tough, but that's better than before. Fine, I will pay. I hope it's worth it

Your response: Still too much, sorry. Maybe I will come back later, maybe not. I need to think about this.

NPC: Dude, do you think I have the canister here? If you kill me, you get nothing. But I see you want a special special price eh? 500.000 nc. That's my last price. You won't get it cheaper!

Your response: 500.000 nc? Dude, I've killed people for less. Hell, just give me that damn canister! Here are your 500.000, I hope you choke on it!

Your response: I just wasted my time here. Go to hell, and better don't ever cross my path again

NPC: Okay, here you go. This special canister is one of the finest developments of Tech Haven Science. Just make sure to not damage it. Good luck with the disease.

Your response: -Pay 250.000nc-

NPC: Always nice to deal with you. Here you are. And better take some tranquilizers next time you stop by.

Your response: -Pay 500.000nc-

NPC: Okay. Just come back to me if you still need the canister

NPC: You don't have enough money. Come back when you have my 250.000nc

NPC: Thank you.

NPC: You don't have enough money. Come back when you have my 500.000nc

NPC: Thank you.

NPC: You just bought my last canister. Go on with your mission and leave me alone, please

NPC: Yeah you wasted mine too. Better you never come back, asshole!

NPC: Hello, stranger. I have been waiting for you. Waiting, yes. Time runs slowly when waiting. But time is irrelevant, isn't it? Oh yes, I know, for you it is relevant. Time is short, lives need to be rescued.

Your response: Wise shaman, I respectfully ask you to help me in my deed. We need your knowledge to create a specific potion.

Your response: Hey granny, how is it? Heard, you'd be able to give me a potion. And yeah, my time is short.

NPC: You haven't completed your first mission yet. Come back when you have talked to Leroy Hawking.

NPC: Yes, wisdom and knowledge. The ingredients for this potion have been passed down from generation to generation. Unfortunately I can't tell you the recipe. You may understand this is very traditional. The wisdom and knowledge that we protect is of the highest importance to our order. I can't share this knowledge with just anyone, much less to a stranger.

Your response: This is an unfortunate situation then. But you agreed to talk with me. So there is another way?

NPC: Our tribe is peaceful. We know you people hunt our kind often. Your people are not trusted. My tribe fears reprisals and threats. You may prove your worth before you can be trusted.

Your response: I am sorry to hear your tribe was attacked by others. I can assure you it wasn't me or one of the people I work for. How can I prove my worth to you?

Your response: Okay wait. Are you kidding me? Did I just come out to here to be lectured!?

NPC: Our tribe has other fears too. There is a way you can do both, stranger. Helping our tribe will also help yourself with your needs. Young Swamp Warriors attack our tribe frequently, and we need help to defend ourselves. Please thin out their herds. Try to kill 10 of them. This will stop them growing up and becoming a problem in the future. When you have killed them, please get me their poison glands. I need 10 poison glands to extract the ingredients for your potion.

Your response: You just need 10 poison glands? That's easily done.

NPC: Don't take too long with this, stranger. Make sure you take glands fresh from their throats. Getting old ones from elsewhere is of no use to us. The potion depends on utilising the fresh liquids in the poison glands. Otherwise it will be worthless for you.

Your response: Okay ... so I guess I better hurry back after killing them to make sure they are really fresh, right?

Your response: Really ... do I have to go out there and kill these? Here, I have 10 poison glands right here with me.

NPC: Do you remember I asked you to proof your worth, stranger? Besides that your dried out poison glands won't help you any bit, I wanted you to show my tribe that you seriously are worth our trust and knowledge. So you better go and do as I asked you.

Your response: Please excuse my impatient tongue, wise Shaman. You are right, I will do as you asked.

Your response: You know what? I listened to your stupidness long enough now. Either take them or leave it.

NPC: So go out and save our tribe, stranger. Our help for your people will be ensured when you are back.

NPC: You should think about your words, stranger. It all starts with respect. Keep in mind, you want something from me. Think about it, then talk to me again.

NPC: There you are again, stranger, did you get what I asked you for?

Your response: Yes, wise shaman. Here are 10 fresh poison glands. Let's hope they will be good enough

NPC: We will see.

Your response: -Give poison glands-

NPC: I can not produce the antidote without the Kri'Nakh poison glands. Come back if you got what I asked for.

NPC: Some of my people saw you fighting brave. Yes, this ones look fresh and good. I will extract their liquids and create the tincture for your potion. Please wait a moment.

NPC: I can sniff that these are all but fresh. Are you trying to fool me!? Now, leave this place and only come back if you learned respect and got what I asked you for!

NPC: Thank you for waiting patiently, stranger. I can assure you, my tribe was happily helping to prepare your potion. But how do you want to carry that potion?

Your response: I got a special canister to transport that potion. Will this be of any help?

NPC: Yes, this will do. Let me fill in your potion, then hurry back to that Dr. Alonzo Gates. The potion will leave its strength over time, so better be fast.

Your response: Thank you, wise shaman. Your help will be not forgotten.

NPC: Well, where is that special canister you mentioned? This potion is highly poisonous, you surely don't want to carry it with bare hands, do you?

Your response: Damn, I forgot it somewhere. Let me get it quick.

NPC: You better hurry up!

NPC: Be careful and return to the Jailhouse as fast as possible.

NPC: Deliver the Potion to Dr. John McIntyre in the Jailhouse

NPC: So I see you have returned then? And you have seen the Shaman already?

Your response: I have seen the Shaman and I have done as I was instructed. Here is the potion that he concocted for me. What should I do now? Shall we make the Antidote here?

NPC: Well, where is the potion? I can't find it in your bag.

NPC: Are you sure you have done what I asked you for?

NPC: Ah you are very perceptive Runner but no your job is not complete just yet. Talk to me once again when you are ready for the last part of this mission.

NPC: Good to see you again. Ready for the last part of our mission?

Your response: Yes of course, lets go!

Your response: No, I'm busy.

NPC: Hmm okay, bye

NPC: Unfortunately I lack the necessary equipment here to complete the process myself. This Jailhouse has only the most basic laboratory equipment. You will now need to see a colleague of mine in the Laboratory in Via Rosso.

Your response: Great. More running around!

NPC: What was that? Oh never mind, make sure to search out Peter Bosch, the Scientist in the Laboratory in Via Rosso 3. My good friend Peter will instruct you on what is required of you next.

NPC: Peter Bosch is waiting for you in the laboratory in Viarosso3. Please hurry up!

NPC: Good day Runner, I have been expecting you.

Your response: I need an antidote please

NPC: Yes yes, very direct aren't you. Dr McIntyre told me to expect as much. He passed details of your visit already. Do you have the potion I wonder?

Your response: Yes here it is. Will this take long? I have already trekked across half the wastelands for this thing!

NPC: Relax dear friend please. I am here to help you. This antidote will be a wonderful creation. It will help a great many people. Some of those poor unfortunate men and women in the Bum Asylum have fallen on the hardest times. The City Administration has all but forgotten about them, Protopharma refuses to give them medical care and the Black Dragons only peddle their pharmaceuticals if there is a profit in it. So no, what you are doing is quite admirable actually. I wish there were more runners who could help in this way but alas I think that many do not have the inclination or the means.

Your response: Well then thank you for saying that, I would just like to get this over with now.

NPC: I can't produce the Antidote without the potion!

NPC: But of course, the process is complete. Here is your antidote, now please with all haste, get it to the Bum Asylum. Your contact there is Dr Ted Wilson of Neocare.

NPC: Dr. Wilson in the Bum Asylum is waiting for you!

NPC: Good day runner what brings you to the Bum Asylum?

Your response: Dr. Wilson I hope? I am here to bring you an antidote for your patients.

NPC: Visit Peter Bosch in the laboratory first!

NPC: Ahah! An antidote -  so the rumours are true. We had heard of this deed but some of my patients didn't yet dare to put faith in it. We lost two more just yesterday and still there are over a dozen in the final stages of the infection. Please you must give us the antidote, Runner!

Your response: Well here it is. It cost me a small fortune though...

NPC: My good fellow, you are saving countless lives of some of Neocron's poorest citizens! Surely the righteous virtuosity would be enough for you? You deem financial gain to be of greater importance? How shamelessly mercenary of you! These people's lives are at stake.

Your response: Well hey I mean I was only asking...

NPC: Please don't cheat on me and my patients! Come back when you have an antidote.

NPC: I am sorry my good friend, the only reward I can offer you is the solace and satisfaction of knowing you have probably saved dozens of lives. If that small reward is not enough then I can only bid you a good day and ask you to go on your way.

  92  -- StartNPC: ID8159 Dr. Alonzo Gates - NeoCare / Outzone 8 Jailhouse, medical area  
  93  NODE(10)
  94  	SAY("Hey there. Do you have a minute?")
  95  	ANSWER("Sure, what's up?",11) 
  96  	ANSWER("Listen, don't waste my time, or do you have a death wish?",38)
  97  
  98  NODE(11)
  99  	SAY("I just saw you passing by, and honestly I had an eye on you for a while. You don't seem to really belong with these bad guys, am I right?")
 100  	ANSWER("Well, bad things happen, now I am here. That's the story. So what's the deal?",12)
 101  	ANSWER("Obviously you mistake me for someone else. You better stop bothering me, or it will be the last thing you do.",38)
 102  	
 103  NODE(12)
 104  	SAY("See, I am member of a little community, which recently became part of the city. Its name is NeoCare. We provide help to those who don't get help from the city.")
 105  	ANSWER("It's good to know the poor are not totally lost here. But if your intention is to make me a member, then I have to refuse I'm afraid.",13)
 106  	ANSWER("Are you for real? Next you ask me to donate to the poor? Sorry bro, not my business.",14)
 107  	
 108  NODE(13)
 109  	SAY("No worries, I am not asking you to become a member. Rather that I need help in a medical emergency. And before you ask, no, I am not looking for a doctor. I need someone who is able to deal with several kinds of dangers in the wastelands. Someone like you.")
 110  	ANSWER("Well, I've had one or two fights in my time. So who do you want me to flat line?",15)
 111  
 112  NODE(14)
 113  	SAY("If I just wanted some money from you I would have asked you directly. The problem is more delicate, that's why we are talking now. I need someone who is able to deal with several kinds of dangers in the wastelands. Someone like you.")
 114  	ANSWER("So you want someone dead? Sounds more like my business after all.",15)
 115  	ANSWER("That may cost you a lot if you want to hire me. I'm not for free business bro.",16)
 116  
 117  NODE(15)
 118  	SAY("I am not looking for a killer. Let me explain more details.")
 119  	ANSWER("Sure, go on. I will listen.",17)
 120  	ANSWER("No need bro. Keep the details. Just tell me what you want me to do.",30)
 121  	
 122  NODE(16)
 123  	SAY("Well as I said already, we are a community. If we had money we would just deal with it in other ways. We can not pay you, at least not with Credits. But we could work on your reputation, meaning your soul light. You help the poor in the way you can, and we pray for you and make sure, your help will affect your soul light significantly in a positive way.")
 124  	ANSWER("Okay, you got me now. Tell me what's going on here.",17)
 125  	ANSWER("Yeah, yeah it's fine now. It's okay I will help. But lets keep it short. What do you need me for?",30)
 126  	ANSWER("You know what? Forget it. I'm done here.",38)
 127  
 128  NODE(17)
 129  	SAY("Okay, I will start. As I said at the beginning, our community helps the poor. Our main focus actually lays at the Bum Asylum in Pepper Park 3. The inhabitants recently got infected by a deadly disease, and our options are limited. Since we are low on money, Proto Pharm refused to help. They won't make any donations, and the price for such medics are just too damn high for us to pay.")
 130  	ANSWER("So the usual. Your life is just as good as your wallet. So what are the options now?",18)
 131  	ANSWER("ZZZzzz... (his monotone speech makes you doze off ...)",29)
 132  
 133  NODE(18)	
 134  	SAY("Well, the big corporations won't be a lot of help here. Either they get incredible amounts of money, or they won't even listen to us. However there is an alternative. One of our members knows of a way to produce a potion required for the curative serum. The problem is, that this knowledge is held by the swamp shamans. Their knowledge is given from generation to generation by only the wisest of them.")
 135  	ANSWER("Okay, I see killing them won't help here. So you think they will help us?",19)
 136  	ANSWER("ZZZzzz... (you really kept awake long, but at the end, you doze off ...)",29)
 137  	
 138  NODE(19)
 139  	SAY("Well, usually they are not that friendly with strangers and stay away from us or even attack if they feel invaded, but one of our members was able to talk with one shaman who was willing to help. Since the swamps are barely mapped, we only know a rough location where to find him, that's why we need someone used to dangerous areas.")
 140  	ANSWER("So the objective is to go to the swamps and find that shaman that is willing to help. That's all?",20)
 141  	ANSWER("ZZZzzz... (wow, you fought a lot to stay awake and listen ... but now you lost)",29)
 142  
 143  NODE(20)
 144  	SAY("To be honest, not really. That potion may contain hazardous ingredients, so to be sure you need a special canister to transport it without any danger for you or anyone else. The Scientists of the Fallen Angels have plenty of these, but as you can imagine, of course not for free.")
 145  	ANSWER("So we again are at a dead end?",21)
 146  	ANSWER("ZZZzzz... (only Crahn knows how you stayed awake that long)",29)
 147  
 148  NODE(21)
 149  	SAY("Luckily not. We found a contact who noticed our work. He can't officially help us, but he said he could strike a deal with us, unofficially. You may negotiate with him, as he didn't want to give us too much via official channels.")
 150  	ANSWER("I see ...so I have to first go to Tech Haven and meet that guy for the canister, afterwards I go to the swamps and find that shaman to get that potion. That's it?",30)
 151  
 152  NODE(29)
 153  	SAY("... so in conclusion, that's why you first need to meet that guy to get the canister in Tech Haven, and then the shaman in the swamps after that. Got it? HEY, AM I KEEPING YOU UP?")
 154  	ANSWER("Ah, no. Got it. Tech Haven, get the canister, swamps, talk to shaman for the potion. (phew!)",30)
 155  	ANSWER("Sorry bro, don't take it personally ... could you please explain again?",17)
 156  
 157  NODE(30)
 158  	SAY("Yes. Go to Tech Haven first and find Leroy Hawking. He will tell you his conditions to get that canister you need. Afterwards try to find the wise old shaman in the swamps. He will hand you the potion. Return to me afterwards please.")
 159  	ANSWER("Okay, got it. I'd best get started.",39)
 160  	ANSWER("Uff...now I think about it... forget it bro. That's too much of my time wasted.",38)
 161  
 162  NODE(38)
 163  	SAY("How could I be so mistaken. I thought you were one of the good guys. Go to hell!")
 164  	ENDDIALOG()
 165

 167      STARTMISSION(mission01)
 168  	SAY("Good luck. I will pray for you.")

 174  -- mission1   NPC0: ID8153 Leroy Hawking - Fallen Angels / TechHaven Sec3 Energy Core 6 
 175  NODE(40)
 176  	SAY("So you are the guy who wants one of our special canisters?")
 177  	ANSWER("Err...how do you know that?",41)
 178  	ANSWER("I have no idea what you are talking about!",42)
 179  
 180  NODE(41)
 181  	SAY("Dude, why would somebody like you come down here at this certain time? I am a scientist after all, I don't believe in coincidences.")
 182  	ANSWER("Well, I was just surprised. Anyway, do you have that special canister?",43)
 183  
 184  NODE(42)
 185  	SAY("Sure you don't. And I am not the guy you are looking for. You want to continue wasting my time?")
 186  	ANSWER("Yeah fine, you are the guy I am obviously looking for. And yeah, I want your special canister. So how about it then?",43)
 187  	ANSWER("You know what? Fuck this, I'm done here. Look for someone else who is stupid enough. I just wasted my time!",55)
 188  	
 189  NODE(43)
 190  	SAY("This is the deal: You want my canister, I want your money. Let's say ... 1,000,000 nc. Deal?") 
 191  	ANSWER("Holy Shit! Are you insane !? I just wanted your stupid canister, not the whole of Tech Haven!",45) 
 192  	ANSWER("Hey, I almost laughed. Good one, bro. Now seriously, how much?",44)
 193  
 194  NODE(44) 
 195  	SAY("Did you see me laugh? 1.000.000 nc if you want my special canister.")
 196  	ANSWER("C'mon, you can't be real about this. This is insane.",45)
 197  	
 198  NODE(45)	
 199  	SAY("See, the administration of Tech Haven have cut my budget. Do you think I do this for fun? The deal is easy: I need to continue my research and you need to continue your...whatever you need that canister for, I don't care. So...do we have a deal?")
 200  	ANSWER("That's just too much, sorry dude. I need that thing to safe some people's lives, so it's important to get that canister. But donating 1 million NC is a tough one. You feel me?",46) 
 201  	ANSWER("What about I just kill you and take your canister for free? Really, I am loosing patience!",47)
 202  
 203  NODE(46)
 204  	SAY("Oh I see. Next you tell me you are a saint, eh? But yeah, now you mention it, I heard about the situation in Neocron. Okay, fine. I will make an exception. 250.000, okay? This is a really special price. You may understand me, it's too dangerous for me to just give this special canister away. The Administration would kill me instantly if they found out.") 
 205  	ANSWER("250.000? Still tough, but that's better than before. Fine, I will pay. I hope it's worth it",48) 
 206  	ANSWER("Still too much, sorry. Maybe I will come back later, maybe not. I need to think about this.",50 )
 207  	
 208  NODE(47)
 209  	SAY("Dude, do you think I have the canister here? If you kill me, you get nothing. But I see you want a special special price eh? 500.000 nc. That's my last price. You won't get it cheaper!")
 210  	ANSWER("500.000 nc? Dude, I've killed people for less. Hell, just give me that damn canister! Here are your 500.000, I hope you choke on it!",49)
 211  	ANSWER("I just wasted my time here. Go to hell, and better don't ever cross my path again",55)
 212  	
 213  NODE(48) --end cheap version (250.000)
 214  	SAY("Okay, here you go. This special canister is one of the finest developments of Tech Haven Science. Just make sure to not damage it. Good luck with the disease.")
 215  	ANSWER("-Pay 250.000nc-",51)	
 216  
 217  NODE(49) --end expensive version for the "killer" (500.000)
 218  	SAY("Always nice to deal with you. Here you are. And better take some tranquilizers next time you stop by.")
 219  	ANSWER("-Pay 500.000nc-",52)
 220  
 221  NODE(50) 
 222  	SAY("Okay. Just come back to me if you still need the canister")
 223  	SETNEXTDIALOGSTATE(43)
 224  
 225  NODE(51) --payment for cheap version and give out canister 
 226  	TAKEMONEY(250000)
 227  		if(result==0)then
 228  			SAY("You don't have enough money. Come back when you have my 250.000nc")
 229  			SETNEXTDIALOGSTATE(48)
 230  			ENDDIALOG()
 231  		else
 232  			GIVEITEM(qitem02) --special canister
 233  			SAY("Thank you.")
 234  			ACTIVATEDIALOGTRIGGER(0)
 235  			SETNEXTDIALOGSTATE(53)
 236  			ENDDIALOG()
 237  		end
 238  
 239  NODE(52)  --payment for expensive killerversion and give out canister
 240  	TAKEMONEY(500000)
 241  		if(result==0)then
 242  			SAY("You don't have enough money. Come back when you have my 500.000nc")
 243  			SETNEXTDIALOGSTATE(49)
 244  			ENDDIALOG()
 245  		else
 246  			GIVEITEM(qitem02) --special canister
 247  			SAY("Thank you.")
 248  			ACTIVATEDIALOGTRIGGER(0)
 249  			SETNEXTDIALOGSTATE(53)
 250  			ENDDIALOG()
 251  		end
 252  		
 253  NODE(53)
 254  	SAY("You just bought my last canister. Go on with your mission and leave me alone, please")
 255  	ENDDIALOG()
 256  	
 257  NODE(55)
 258  	SAY("Yeah you wasted mine too. Better you never come back, asshole!")
 259  	ENDDIALOG()
 260  -- set target1 /dialogtrigger1 to Wise old Shaman (NPC1)
 261  
 262  
 263  --mission1   NPC1: ID8154 Wise old Shaman - Swamp Nation / Swamp Sector G03     
 264  NODE(60)
 265  	ISMISSIONTARGETACCOMPLISHED(0) --dialogtrigger0 Leroy Hawking(NPC0)
 266  		if(result==1) then
 267              SAY("Hello, stranger. I have been waiting for you. Waiting, yes. Time runs slowly when waiting. But time is irrelevant, isn't it? Oh yes, I know, for you it is relevant. Time is short, lives need to be rescued.")
 268              ANSWER("Wise shaman, I respectfully ask you to help me in my deed. We need your knowledge to create a specific potion.",61)
 269  			ANSWER("Hey granny, how is it? Heard, you'd be able to give me a potion. And yeah, my time is short.",69 )
 270          else
 271              SAY("You haven't completed your first mission yet. Come back when you have talked to Leroy Hawking.")
 272              SETNEXTDIALOGSTATE(60)
 273  			ENDDIALOG()
 274          end
 275  		
 276  -- mission1   target2 briefing (kill 10 level 55 Young Swamp Warriors(ID1262))
 277  NODE(61)
 278  	SAY("Yes, wisdom and knowledge. The ingredients for this potion have been passed down from generation to generation. Unfortunately I can't tell you the recipe. You may understand this is very traditional. The wisdom and knowledge that we protect is of the highest importance to our order. I can't share this knowledge with just anyone, much less to a stranger.")
 279  	ANSWER("This is an unfortunate situation then. But you agreed to talk with me. So there is another way?",62)
 280  	
 281  NODE(62)
 282  	SAY("Our tribe is peaceful. We know you people hunt our kind often. Your people are not trusted. My tribe fears reprisals and threats. You may prove your worth before you can be trusted.")
 283  	ANSWER("I am sorry to hear your tribe was attacked by others. I can assure you it wasn't me or one of the people I work for. How can I prove my worth to you?",63)
 284  	ANSWER("Okay wait. Are you kidding me? Did I just come out to here to be lectured!?",69)
 285  	
 286  NODE(63)
 287  	SAY("Our tribe has other fears too. There is a way you can do both, stranger. Helping our tribe will also help yourself with your needs. Young Swamp Warriors attack our tribe frequently, and we need help to defend ourselves. Please thin out their herds. Try to kill 10 of them. This will stop them growing up and becoming a problem in the future. When you have killed them, please get me their poison glands. I need 10 poison glands to extract the ingredients for your potion.")
 288  	ANSWER("You just need 10 poison glands? That's easily done.",64)
 289  	
 290  NODE(64)
 291  	SAY("Don't take too long with this, stranger. Make sure you take glands fresh from their throats. Getting old ones from elsewhere is of no use to us. The potion depends on utilising the fresh liquids in the poison glands. Otherwise it will be worthless for you.")
 292  	ANSWER("Okay ... so I guess I better hurry back after killing them to make sure they are really fresh, right?",66)
 293  	ANSWER("Really ... do I have to go out there and kill these? Here, I have 10 poison glands right here with me.",65)
 294  
 295  NODE(65)
 296  	SAY("Do you remember I asked you to proof your worth, stranger? Besides that your dried out poison glands won't help you any bit, I wanted you to show my tribe that you seriously are worth our trust and knowledge. So you better go and do as I asked you.")
 297  	ANSWER("Please excuse my impatient tongue, wise Shaman. You are right, I will do as you asked.",66)
 298  	ANSWER("You know what? I listened to your stupidness long enough now. Either take them or leave it.",69 )
 299  	
 300  NODE(66)	
 301  	SAY("So go out and save our tribe, stranger. Our help for your people will be ensured when you are back.")
 302  	SETNEXTDIALOGSTATE(70)
 303  	ACTIVATEDIALOGTRIGGER(1)
 304  	ENDDIALOG()
 305  
 306  NODE(69)
 307  	SAY("You should think about your words, stranger. It all starts with respect. Keep in mind, you want something from me. Think about it, then talk to me again.")
 308  	SETNEXTDIALOGSTATE(60)
 309  	ENDDIALOG()
 310  
 311  	
 312  --mission1   target2 accomplished

entries.conversation:
NPC: Hey runner come here, I want to talk to you. I know you, I know that look in your eye... I see the problems you have had here.

Your response: Excuse me?

NPC: I don't think you are experienced enough to work for me.

NPC: You don't fit in down here, you and I we are alike. I don't fit in here either.

Your response: What do you mean?

Your response: Hey fuck you man, I am as tough as the next guy down here, say that again and I will gut you like a fish.

NPC: How could I be so mistaken. I thought you were one of the good guys. Go to hell!

NPC: I am not one of these bloodthirsty psychopaths. I want to go back to my old life, just like you. I can see it in your eyes. You aren't cut out for this!

Your response: Oh well yeah ok I see what you are getting at. But how can I clear my name?

NPC: I mean sure I messed up a while back but hey I know how we can get out. I have friends who can help us to increase your reputation; you just need to prove you're good enough. Reliable trustworthy, one of the good guys, you know.

Your response: Well in a place like this I can see why they wouldn't think I was trustworthy but ok I want to prove I am capable of being trusted again!

NPC: Great. You will most certainly have noticed all the Anarchy Breed scum in the Jailhouse. Those people are the real bad guys. We can not attack them here, but some very powerful groups of them are out there in the wastelands. Killing 10 'Anarchy Breed Harasser' would most certainly make my friends put in a good word for you. Come back to see me once you've completed this task.

Your response: Where is this scum hiding?

NPC: Great. You will most certainly have noticed all the Anarchy Breed scum in the Jailhouse. Those people are the real bad guys. We can not attack them here, but some very powerful groups of them are out there in the wastelands. Killing 10 'Anarchy Breed Aggressor' would most certainly make my friends put in a good word for you. Come back to see me once you've completed this task.

Your response: Where is this scum hiding?

NPC: My informants said that there are several Anarchy Breed Camps in the more dangerous areas in the middle of the map.

NPC: Excellent! I knew you are one of the good people out there. My friends are really pleased. Keep up the good work and you will become a loyal member of Neocron Citys society very soon.

NPC: You know what to do. Come back once you've completed your mission.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Murphy

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at least 55; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• In sector B11 I once downed a Warbot. Go find its wreck and scratch some particles off its armour!

• And all of them are useless! The wastelands are crowded with metal monsters!
I've worked on this construction plan since the beginning of time, and now it's finally going to be a reality!

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Come back when you've gained some experience!

NPC: WHO ARE YOU? WHAT DO YOU WANT?

Your response: Uh, ok, I'm leaving...

Your response: RELAX! I only wanted to offer you my help.

NPC: Finally!

NPC: Help? Why do you think I need help?

Your response: Well, to be honest, when I saw this large dead Warbot over there and found you standing right next to it, it looked like you were trying to examine the robot and I just wanted to be nice and offer my help.

NPC: Examine the robot? Yes of course. Examine it and then find a way to kill them! These vermin must be exterminated! No Warbot should be seen on this earth ever again!

Your response: Calm down, it's only a warbot.

NPC: Are you insane? These robots are the world's greatest danger!/n They were designed by Ceres, using the information held within the Ceres disc and they defended the Dome of York against Neocron's army in 2578.

Your response: Yes I know, but that's history. Ceres is dead and nobody controls the warbots these days.

NPC: Wrong! You are wrong my friend! I've been studying Warbot technology for my whole life now and guess what I found out recently? Somebody is trying to gain control over the warbots and build a new robot army!

Your response: You must be kidding. Who would do that?

NPC: I don't know yet. But somebody is definitely trying to send high frequency signals to the control units of the warbots.

Your response: This is fucking scary! What can we do?

NPC: I'm afraid I do not have the capabilities and power to find out where the signals are coming from or who is sending them, but if we just destroy all the remaining Warbots there'd be nothing left from which someone could build a new army.

Your response: Count me in. Those tin monsters broke my bones quite a few times. Time for some payback!

NPC: That's the spirit! Let's go!

Your response: What do you want me to do?

NPC: Exterminate 10 Legacy Warbots... uh, and 5 of the larger type, Titans. You probably know what I'm talking about. If we succeed, the world will be safe again and I might also have a great reward for you.

NPC: There you are! How are you?

Your response: That wasn't an easy task, but I eventually knocked off all those killer robots.

NPC: You forgot to kill the 5 Legacy Warbot Titans, didn't you?

NPC: What did you not understand in: Kill 10 Legacy Warbots and 5 Titans?

NPC: Right on! Come back to me when you're ready to see the final chapter of this story.

NPC: Yes, I see, you're back. Very well! Let's move on, shall we? Besides the Warbots you already destroyed, there are even bigger ones. They have to be destroyed as well.

Your response: Alright, go on. Anything I can do to help?

NPC: This time it's going to be a tiny bit more difficult. We also need a few materials that are not easy to get. Those Warbot I was talking about are the so-called Juggernaut Warbots. The good thing is, that the materials that I need are from those Juggernauts. This will take time, effort and power!

Your response: No problem, if the reward is worthwhile.

NPC: Oh, don't worry. It will definitely be worthwhile

Your response: If not...

NPC: Don't worry! Are you ready to move on, or would you rather carry on chatting?

Your response: Let's hurry! What do you need? And, for hell's sake, what do you need it for?

NPC: I need 5 x Advanced Autonome Gyroscope System v 0.1.9, 5 x Energy Generator and 5 x *Unidentified* Expensive Tech Parts.

Your response: That doesn't sound simple, but well, I'll get going right away!

Your response: Where can I get an 'Advanced Autonome Gyroscope System v 0.1.9' from?

Your response: Where can I get the generators?

Your response: Where can I get '*Unidentified* Expensive Tech Parts'?

NPC: In that so-called Juggernaut Facility. Don't ask me where that place is.
All I know is there are giant warbots, and that there's an entrance to it somewhere in the wastes.

Your response: Okay, thanks, I'm on my way.  That's all I need to know.

Your response: What exactly are you asking for?

NPC: You killed all those Warbots and still don't know what's inside? Go knock them off and remove their gears!

Your response: Okay, thanks, I'm on my way.  That's all I need to know.

Your response: What exactly are you asking for?

NPC: You will get the parts from those robo-creatures. Warbots will have them sometimes. That's all I know, sorry.

Your response: Okay, thanks, I'm on my way.  That's all I need to know.

Your response: What exactly are you asking for?

NPC: Don't forget, I need:
5 x Advanced Autonome Gyroscope System v 0.1.9, 5 x Energy Generator, 5 x *Unidentified* Expensive Tech Parts.

Good luck, %PLAYER_NAME()!

NPC: You got those auto gyros?

Your response: Sure, take them!

NPC: Without 'Advanced Autonome Gyroscope System v 0.1.9' we can't go on. We still need 5 pieces!

NPC: Have you got the generators?

Your response: Sure thing, here they are!

NPC: We can't move on without 5 'Energy Generators'!

NPC: Now all we need is those E-Parts!

Your response: Already here!

NPC: Without '*Unidentified* Expensive Tech Part' we'll fail. We need 5 parts!

NPC: I promise this will be my masterpiece! You know, what I'm talking about!

Your response: Erm, not really? What the hell?

NPC: Didn't I mention already... I'm creating a weapon to fight warbots!

Your response: Aren't there enough weapons around already?

NPC: And all of them are useless! The wastelands are crowded with metal monsters!
I've worked on this construction plan since the beginning of time, and now it's finally going to be a reality!

Your response: *click*

NPC: I'm going to make a giant light sword to cut through a warbot like a Milky Ren! Do you think I need all that stuff just for a smoke? Really?

Your response: Of course...

NPC: Don't worry, I won't forget you.

Your response: I'm glad to hear this!

NPC: Okay, I need to prepare a few things. Come join me later on for the final strike!

NPC: Right on time, I've just finished my work!

Your response: Ah, cool! Let me have a look!

NPC: We're not there yet, unfortunately. I still need two more things.

Your response: Let me guess: You want me to take care of this?

NPC: Exactly! Ready?

Your response: Always! Just tell me!

NPC: I need an Energy Soulblade and warbot particles!

Your response: Where do I get that Soulblade?

Your response: Where do I get those particles?

Your response: Ok, I know what to do. See you soon!

NPC: Deep down in the worm tunnels lives the 'APPARITION' who sometimes carries that blade and drops it after death.

Your response: Okay, thanks, that's all I need to know.  I'm on my way!

Your response: What exactly are you asking for?

NPC: In sector B11 I once downed a Warbot. Go find its wreck and scratch some particles off its armour!

Your response: Okay, will do!

Your response: What exactly are you asking for?

NPC: Good luck, and don't forget I need an Energy Soulblade and some warbots particles!

NPC: You have found a very, very old and dead warbot. This is supposedly the right one.

Your response: - scratch off particles -

Your response: *cry into your pillow until you fall asleep*

NPC: zzzZZZzzz

NPC: Scratching off those particles is more difficult than you thought.
You need to use a lot of physical force. Suddenly there is a hum, getting louder and louder...

Your response: *scratch off more particles enthusiastically*

NPC: A small warbot patrol approaches, on to the fighting!

NPC: You got all the particles you need.

NPC: You found the wreck, did you?

Your response: Of course. I'm not a fool!

NPC: Get that warbot wreck and stop hauling in junk!

NPC: You got the warbot particles?

Your response: Sure!
- give particles -

NPC: I need those particles!

NPC: The sword?

Your response: Wasn't all that easy, but here it is!
- give sword -

NPC: I need that sword!

NPC: That's perfect! Really! I will be able to create a work of genius from it, so all the Warbots will want to do is destroy themselves out of sheer fear.
It will be a curse to them! *muahahah*

Your response: Yeah? Cool!

NPC: Sure! But we will have to have it constructed. Which I'm afraid I can't. I'm more of a scientist than an engineer.

Your response: Uhm, okay. So who's going to do that?

NPC: At the Old Greycore Outpost you'll find 'Nick Premzy'. He's supposed to be able to actually make the sword. Hand him this briefcase and let him do his job!

NPC: 'Nick Premzy' is waiting for you. All he needs for the construction is here in this case. Now hurry, war isn't going to wait for you!

NPC: About time you showed up. I've been waiting ages, now.

Your response: Well, here I am...

NPC: Without official permission I'm not going to talk to you!

NPC: Have you brought the briefcase??

Your response: Sure!
- give briefcase -

NPC: I need the briefcase containing the materials for constructing the weapon!

NPC: Looks promising! We're nearly ready to start!

Your response: Why just nearly? Don't you have everything you need?

NPC: You don't really think I'm working for free? I want cash!

Your response: Well, I didn't know that...

NPC: Now you know! Finally. I want 150,000 credits or you need to find someone else to do the job. But you won't find anyone suitable, I promise.

Your response: It's not as if I have a choice, so...

Your response: I don't see real value in this. Goodbye!

NPC: Bye! Take your shit back and go away!

NPC: Good decision. You will not regret it!

Your response: I really hope so!
- give credits -

NPC: All about the moolah!!

NPC: Well, well, well. Now it's construction time. Give me five minutes and then come back!

NPC: Your patience and credits paid out well, I believe! It's... just... breath-taking!

Your response: I can't wait to hold it in my hands!

NPC: Did I say five minutes or five seconds! Patience is a virtue!

NPC: Hunt down Warbots, drive them from our fields! This sword will be the Warbot's panacea from now on!

CONTACT
Commander Harris

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• MLC-777x
• MLMS-5532
• MLTS-X3240
• MLUB-7732b
• Parcel for Juri Netschajev
• Wanted Poster of Dixie Flatline

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• 150mm Rockets
• MIRL-600 Warhammer
• MLTS-X3240
• MLUB-7732b
• Parcel for Juri Netschajev
• Wanted Poster of Dixie Flatline

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at least 55; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• Our engineers discovered that they can use some parts from the old Juggernaut Warbots for the rocket launcher. Therefore your first task is to infiltrate the old Juggernaut Facility in Sektor I-09 and search the storage crates there for a part with the designation 'MTS-X3240'. It also wouldn't hurt if you had some experience with hacking or brought along someone who does. Return without delay as soon as you find the part! Dismissed!

• Exactly, you know... those chain propelled scout robots. The prototypes were equipped with a rocket launcher, but the design was completely reworked for mass production, as they couldn't fix the problems with the targeting system. Some of these prototypes can still be found in the Wastelands. Find one and take it apart. One of our patrols located several in sector E-09. Try that area first and don't forget your hack tool.

• Very good! Take this package, find Juri Netschajev in Sector I-09 and get him to give us the part designated 'MLUB-7732b'.

• Now on to the next task. You won't even have to march through half the Wastelands. The next part is closeby.

• This isn't a simple pick-up mission. Deeps inside the Tech Haven Energy Cores they experimented on the very first Warbot Prototypes back in the days. Unfortunately, these early versions were faulty and cost some of our engineers their lives. Despite all this, we need a part from this warbot prototype.

• Go down to Tech Haven Energy Core 1 and search for a security terminal with the designation '#6544-F' and activate it. That should reactivate one of these Warbot Prototypes, which you need to take out. Remember that you'll need a hack tool to crack it open. We need the part with the designation 'MLMS-5532'. Bring it to me and we'll be one step closer! Dismissed!!

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.

NPC: What the hell?

Your response: Dixie Flatline?

NPC: Who wants to know?

Your response: Just take a look at this, you'll know!

NPC: Holy shit!

NPC: Are you kidding me? What do you want to show me?

NPC: I... I guess I don't have another choice... fucking hell!

NPC: You're messing with me!

Your response: We need a part with the designation 'MLUB-7732b'.

Your response: I'm not done yet!

Your response: Depends, Sir.

NPC: I'm not sure I understand? TALK DAMNIT!

Your response: Sir? I don't follow?

entries.conversation:
NPC: You again? Good job last time, but there is nothing you can do for me at the moment.
If you need a new drone, remember to visit the Machineroom to get one!

NPC: Come back when you've gained some more experience!

NPC: Touch it, and you will die!

NPC: They see me droning, they hatin'...

Your response: Excuse me? What's wrong with you?

Your response: Crackhead... Go to hell!

NPC: So do you. Bye.

NPC: Nothing is wrong, just happy!

Your response: Why so? Found a hidden box of happy-maker in the Pepper Park?

NPC: Oh no, of course not!
Had a breakthrough with my new drone!

Your response: You were able to start it?

NPC: You're such negative...
I've combined some drones and testing the result now, and it's astonishing, but still not done.

Your response: How so?

NPC: I think some stuff is missing. The view is blurry and the targeting matrix is not working as intended.

Your response: So you failed?

NPC: Instead of shit talking, you can lend me a hand to accomplish my target!

Your response: I could, yes, but not for free, you know?

NPC: I will compensate your efforts of course... Maybe you could need that drone as well?

Your response: Hmmm... Sounds good to me... But if it's not working I want cash or rareparts, understood?

NPC: It will work! Trust me!

Your response: Maybe... But in case you fail, I don't want a crippling drone. Deal?

NPC: Deal.
Now let us go to work!

Your response: Okay, what is it do you need?

NPC: The targeting matrix needs an update. I need something good - really good. You know those discarded, crazy, Cops in the Gaia Mines? They never miss a shot... I need their 'CopBot Targeting Matrix CPU'.

Your response: They're discarded for a reason I assume...

NPC: Sure, they're, but their CPU should be fully functional, and I'm sure you don't want to fuck off a Cop on duty, don't you?
Now go and get it for me.

Your response: If you say so... One CPU, no problem!

NPC: Better bring 5, yes... Bring me 5 CPUs!

NPC: You got the CPUs?

Your response: Sure!
- Give 'CopBot Targeting Matrix CPU' -

NPC: I need the 5 'CopBot Targeting Matrix CPU', don't come back without!

NPC: That should improve the targeting! Give me some minutes to put it together.

NPC: Good, you're back, just in time.
The CPU worked perfectly!

Your response: Good to hear.

NPC: Now we have take care of the blurry vision, it's like you're on drugs or on heavy fire.

Your response: Maybe you're on drugs?

NPC: Certainly not.

Your response: Okay, what do you need to fix the blurry vision?

NPC: I already tried it with some weapon parts.
Basically I dismantled some weapons, and it was better, but still not good enough.

Your response: *click*

NPC: I think it's related to the weapon quality I've used.

Your response: What have you used? A Stiletto?

NPC: No, I've used one of this area of effect weapons.

Your response: To fix the blurry vision?

NPC: Yes, you're right... That's it!

Your response: Erm, okay?

NPC: I need a different weapon! A better one! I heard that this 'STEINER FP 1.0' weapon is pretty nice.

Your response: And pretty expensive...

NPC: It's worth the effort!

Your response: Sure, if you say so, it must be true!

NPC: It is.\And I need more.

Your response: Oh boy... More? What else?

NPC: The Drone-case needs more power, more stability. Something light...

Your response: I thought you were combining drones? Sholdn't this be a no-brainer?

NPC: Yes, but I also want to improve it! And for that I need a special case material, and I know someone who has it.

Your response: Go ahead.

NPC: 'Quentin Os' has it, hate that dude... Make sure he's dead, he's 'living' near the Northstar Outpost.

Your response: Oh wow... Now I'm going to be a killer?

NPC: You have a problem with it? I can search for someone else who is capable of doing it.

Your response: Never said I have a problem with it... I'll do it.

NPC: Perfect. Go and get the stuff and make sure Quentin is dead!

NPC: You're back, I assume Quentin is history by now and you got what I've asked for?

Your response: Yes, he's history.
-Give 'Special case-material' -

NPC: Without the special case-material we can't proceed!

NPC: Make sure 'Quentin Os' is dead!

NPC: And the weapon?

Your response: Sure!
- Give 'STEINER FP 1.0' -

NPC: Without the weapon: 'STEINER FP 1.0' we can't proceed! Don't come back without!

NPC: Very well, let me implement it. Come back in a few, it needs some time now.

NPC: It is working!

Your response: It is? Nice one!

NPC: Yes, it is just perfect!

Your response: So I can have my drone now?

NPC: Almost!

Your response: You said it's working, why I have to wait now?

NPC: It's pretty hard to build those drones, you know? And I'm on it to implement the last piece of improvement now.

Your response: Don't fool me! I will hunt you down, also your loved ones, even your shitty pet!

NPC: Whoa, relax! I'm not going to fool you!
I'm working on a method which allows me to produce those drone automatically, by a machine!

Your response: Oh, okay...

NPC: Yes... 'Oh...' - We're almost done, promise. We just need to finish the machine, well, not the machine itself, more the OS which handles the constructions.

Your response: How can I help?

NPC: Currently the machine can only produce one drone per week, I want it to produce at least one per day, for this I need to update the server structure, so the machine can calculate much faster.

Your response: *click*

NPC: For this I need a much stronger OS.

Your response: How do we get one?

NPC: We don't just need one, we need some more. 10 should be enough.

Your response: And where do we get this? And, really? 10? Should a system not only have one OS?

NPC: Normal systems for sure, but this is special!
Those DoY Units in the nothern wastelands are pretty fast, when it comes to calculations...

Your response: *click*

NPC: They can evaluate the risk of beeing destroyed by enemies within seconds, that is what we need!
Bring me 10 'Bio-Based -SUPERIOR- OS'!

NPC: You got it?

Your response: Sure! What else?!

NPC: I need 10 'Bio-Based -SUPERIOR- OS'!

NPC: Well, well, well. Now it's construction time. Give me three minutes and then come back!

NPC: Your patience and credits paid out well, I believe! It's... just... breath-taking!

Your response: I can't wait to hold those drones in my hands!

NPC: Did I say three minutes or three seconds? Patience is a virtue!

NPC: The machine seems to accept my commands and is now fully functional - Thanks to the new OS and you of course.

Your response: Cool! Do I get the drone now?

NPC: Yes, for sure!
The new OS also accepts my modifications, really exicting!

Your response: Sounds great!

NPC: It is, here is your drone!
And I've granted you access to the machine in the 'Machine Room', so you can get a new drone if you like.
Remember... The machine can produce one each day, so you can have one per day.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Bail Bondsman - Eric Peters

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• 9mm Clip - 'Amazon' converter mod
• 9mm Clip - Assassin
• HVAP-100 Freeman Pistol

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at least 55; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• There are three eye witnesses that could identify him. The first witness is a certain Nelly Barrett. She's an archeologitst and is doing some research at the Ancient Loba Village in sector J-13. Find her and try to get some clues from her. I'll wait for you.

• Very well. The second witness is a roaming Wastelands trader called Edwardo Morin. He is currently located in Tawkeen Village in Sector C-06. Hurry up so that she doesn't get to him first!

• The third and last witness is a mechanic called Marcus Stewart. He works at the Desert Racetrack in sector G-11. Meet him as soon as possible!

entries.conversation:
NPC: Boy, you're way too green behind the ears! Come back when you're stronger!

NPC: Hey you! Yes, you!

Your response: No time, cya!

Your response: What's up?

NPC: Whatever!

NPC: I have an interesting offer for you! I have a bounty to collect and I'm looking for capable bounty hunters.

Your response: Nah, not interested!

Your response: Sounds good! What is this about?

NPC: Whatever!

NPC: It's about a feared contract killer who kills his victims with a golden pistol. So far, noone has managed to get this guy. But I'm sure you can do it!

Your response: Sounds interesting! Where can I find this killer?

NPC: There are three eye witnesses that could identify him. The first witness is a certain Nelly Barrett. She's an archeologitst and is doing some research at the Ancient Loba Village in sector J-13. Find her and try to get some clues from her. I'll wait for you.

NPC: Hello! What a nice day, can I help you?

Your response: Hello Miss Barrett. I am the lead investigator in the case of a loose contract killer.

NPC: Oh! Yes! I remember that. Bad story. I still can't sleep peacefully because of the horrible things that happened.

Your response: I understand, mam. Regardless, I need all the information you remember. Any detail may be important.

NPC: I'm trying to remember. OH MY GOD! THERE SHE IS! THE KILLER!!!

NPC: That wasn't the killer! Only a woman that looked like her! What's going on here?

Your response: Very smart, a double. But what is she up to?

NPC: OH MY GOD! SHE'S NOT DEAD YET!!

NPC: I don't care! I don't want anything to do with this! GO AWAY!

NPC: I told you to leave me alone!!!

NPC: So? Did you find the witness and did she tell you anything?

Your response: I found her. The killer's double tried to kill us both, but I took care of this pretend killer lady. Unfortunately the witness is very scared now and doesn't say a word.

NPC: Come back when you questioned the witness!

NPC: Smart bitch! Nice move with the double! We have to find the second witness immediately! Go resupply and find me again. I'll tell you how to continue.

NPC: Are you ready to continue?

Your response: Nope, not yet.

Your response: Yes, I'm ready.

NPC: Hurry up. We don't have all day!

NPC: Very well. The second witness is a roaming Wastelands trader called Edwardo Morin. He is currently located in Tawkeen Village in Sector C-06. Hurry up so that she doesn't get to him first!

NPC: Good day to you! Can I offer you something from my exquisite assortment?

Your response: No, thank you. I am on duty, investigating a contract killer.

NPC: Ah, I see. This is about Mandy!

Your response: You know her?

NPC: She used to trade with me in the past. Was completely inconspicuous. I'd never thought she could be a cold-blooded contract killer.

Your response: So you could identify her without a doubt?

NPC: Certainly! You don't forget such a pretty face easily. Hey, wait a second! That's her! What the hell! SHE WANTS TO KILL US! HELP!

NPC: Holy shit! That wasn't Mandy! She looked a lot like her though.

Your response: It's another double. This lady likes to play!

NPC: SHE'S NOT DEAD YET! BACK THERE!!

NPC: I don't want anything else to do with this! It's bad for business! I'd appreciate it if you left now!

NPC: I asked you to leave!

NPC: Let me guess, another double?

Your response: I'm sorry, Sir. This guy doesn't want to talk anymore, just like witness number one.

NPC: Come back when you questioned the witness!

NPC: This slut is starting to get on my nerves. Well, there's only one witness left. Get your gear and meet me in a few minutes.

NPC: Ready?

Your response: No, not yet.

Your response: Yep.

NPC: Hurry up. We don't have all day!

NPC: The third and last witness is a mechanic called Marcus Stewart. He works at the Desert Racetrack in sector G-11. Meet him as soon as possible!

NPC: Welcome to the Desert Racetrack! My name is Marcus Stewart! What can I do for you?

Your response: Take cover! She's certainly close by!

NPC: Who? What? How? Where?

Your response: Trust me! Take cover!

NPC: I don't understand! WHAT IS THAT WOMAN WITH THE GUN DOING HERE?

NPC: What the hell is going on here? What is this contract killer doing here? I thought she would be behind bars by now!

Your response: This time we got the right one. About time! This beast did enough damage as it is.

NPC: SHE WANTS TO KILL ME! HELP!

NPC: You got the real one? What's that supposed to mean?

Your response: When I talked to the first two witnesses, Mandy's doubles showed up. This time it was herself.

NPC: And how do you know that?

Your response: She had her golden pistol on her.

NPC: I don't feel good about this. At least this bitch is dead now! You better leave! When my boss finds out about this!

NPC: Look what you did! My boss is already on his way here!

NPC: Good work! I just received confirmation that Miss Mandy Hollows is dead.

Your response: Miss Hollows will no longer cause problems, Sir.

NPC: Come back when you have questioned the last witness!

NPC: My cleanup crew found the golden pistol by Mandy's body. I think you should have it, considering what you have done for us.

Your response: Sir, I don't know what to say!

NPC: Just say thanks. Here's a bit of ammo for the gun. We also found a special ammo converter on her. Maybe you can use it. I'll remember your name. It has been a while since I worked with someone capable! Now please excuse me, I have things to take care of.

entries.details:
CONTACT
General Carter

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• *Unidentified* Lowtech Part
• Electronical Triggerdevice v 0.1.1
• Synthetic Wine Plus

POSSIBLE COST
• 125,000 credits (depends on choice)
• 250,000 credits (depends on choice)

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at least 55; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• We have sent a scientist to the Wasteland sector I03 to study the disappearance of soldiers there. He has been sending reports for some days but now, nothing. He should have reported back by now!

• Find Dr. Lennard in sector I03!

• I have scanned the sector already, but achieved no new results... Maybe you could help me?

• There's an insane, but excellent scientist. His name is Jupiter. Find him and let him analyze the blood! He was last seen in the Outzone Sec 2!

• There are ancient reports about a group of psychopaths who once performed experiments in the Wastelands on creatures living there...

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: You look wet behind the ears. Come see me when you've got some experience!

NPC: Attention, Runner!

Your response: Sir, yes, Sir!

Your response: I'm not one of your soldiers! Screw you!

NPC: Then get out of my sight, you horrible shower!

NPC: I have an order for you. It's urgent!

Your response: Of course, Sir! What can I do?

NPC: We have sent a scientist to the Wasteland sector I03 to study the disappearance of soldiers there. He has been sending reports for some days but now, nothing. He should have reported back by now!

Your response: *click*

NPC: We fear the worst. Locate the scientist 'Dr. Lennard', get the latest intel and report back to me!

NPC: What, what, what? Who disturbs me at my work?

Your response: General Carter sent me! We feared the worst because we haven't received your report for days!

NPC: For days? Nonsense!! I have only just... Oh, you're right! I was so engrossed in my work...

Your response: The main thing is that you're doing well! Were you able to obtain any new insights into the question of the missing soldiers?

NPC: I have scanned the sector already, but achieved no new results... Maybe you could help me?

Your response: This is about my comrades, you can count on me! What do you want me to do?

NPC: I fear the soldiers are no longer alive, because otherwise my scans would have found something! The scanner will only respond to living organisms, tagged to their DNA. You must search the area for me!

NPC: *** Lieutenant Cortez' dead body ***

Your response: - Search body -

NPC: *** Take DogTag of Lieutenant Cortez ***

NPC: *** The remains of Lieutenant Cortez ***

NPC: *** Private Lance's dead body ***

Your response: - Search body -

NPC: *** Take DogTag of Private Lance ***

NPC: *** The remains of Private Lance ***

NPC: You're back! What have you found?

Your response: I fear you are right... they're dead!

NPC: What happened to Lieutenant Cortez and Private Lance?

NPC: Find the missing soldiers!

NPC: Oh no, they are really dead! Who did this?

Your response: I don't know, but it didn't look very appetizing... the bodies were covered in cuts, as if an animal had ripped them apart... everything was covered in blood... but I recovered their dogtags!

NPC: Give me the dogtag of Lieutenant Cortez!

Your response: *** Give dogtag of Lieutenant Cortez ***

NPC: I thought you brought the dogtag? Where's Lieutenant Cortez' dogtag?

NPC: Give me the dogtag of Private Lance!

Your response: *** Give dogtag of Private Lance ***

NPC: I thought you brought the dogtag? Where's Private Lance's dogtag?

NPC: The dogtags are covered in blood... I have to analyze it! I have copied my recent results to a data pad, take it immediately to General Carter!

NPC: General Carter is waiting!

NPC: At ease, Soldier! News from the front?

Your response: Dr. Lennard is still alive. Found him, absorbed in his work... he has given me a data pad for you, Sir!
*** Give Datapad ***

NPC: I need Dr. Lennard's results!

NPC: Find Dr. Lennard in sector I03!

NPC: That's alarming news! I have to inform the high command. Come back in a few minutes!

NPC: You're back, %PLAYER_NAME()! You have to assist Dr. Lennard!

NPC: Dr. Lennard needs your help!

NPC: Good that you are back! I have alarming results!

Your response: What is it?

NPC: I told you that I found blood on the dogtags, yes? There were also traces of non-human DNA on them!

Your response: *click*

NPC: The DNA was... from a lizard... sort of...

Your response: A lizard?

NPC: I can't explain it... A lizard is not that big and strong that it could kill seasoned soldiers... there must be more behind it!

Your response: Mysterious...

NPC: Yes, we need to play safe! We need to consult a specialist!

Your response: I don't know anybody in this field... You?

NPC: There's an insane, but excellent scientist. His name is Jupiter. Find him and let him analyze the blood! He was last seen in the Outzone Sec 2!

NPC: Who's disturbing me? *hicks*

Your response: Jupiter?

NPC: I'm *hicks* busy... *hicks*

NPC: Who wants to know?

Your response: Dr. Lennard sent me... I have a blood sample that needs to be analyzed!

NPC: What do I get out of it?

Your response: It's about the lives of soldiers! Is that not a good enough reason for you?

NPC: I don't give a shit about that!

Your response: Okay... What do you want?

NPC: I think an allowance in the amount of 250,000 credits and a couple of bottles of wine should be enough! But the good wine! Synthetic Wine Plus!

Your response: Not cheap, but what else I can I do? It's okay then, I think...

Your response: You're insane! Wine, okay... But I will never give you 250,000 credits!

NPC: Then over here with the money!

Your response: *** Give Money ***

NPC: Without credits you're on your own!

NPC: All right, then forget it!

Your response: What does this mean? Will you help me or not?

NPC: Only if you pay me!

Your response: I will give you that wine and 125k, that's my final offer! Accept it or I'll torture you until you've done what I want, and then I will kill you!

NPC: Then over here with the money!

Your response: *** Give Money ***

NPC: Without credits you're on your own!

NPC: The wine?

Your response: *** Give 2 Synthetic Wine Plus ***

NPC: I want 2 Synthetic Wine Plus!

NPC: Now the blood sample please!

Your response: *** Give Bloodsample ***

NPC: Without a blood sample I can't analyze anything...

NPC: This will take a moment. Come back in a few minutes.

NPC: I can't believe it... I even tested the sample twice! Where did you say you found it?

Your response: From the dead soldiers... What is it? Tell me!

NPC: It's a blood test, not a snap of my fingers! Let me work undisturbed and come back later!

NPC: I didn't find human DNA in the sample. Instead it's from a kind of lizard...

Your response: We had already suspected that. You're really sure?

NPC: Yes, I'm sure! However, it's not a normal lizard, it's mutated, it's scary!

Your response: That sounds... not good.

NPC: I strongly advise you:

Stay away from this creature! Otherwise it could have fatal consequences! I think you should go back to Dr. Lennard and report the news to him!
Give Dr. Lennard my report!

NPC: Dr. Lennard is waiting!

NPC: Well, finally - there you are again. This has taken half an eternity!

Your response: Besides the fact that I had to pay Jupiter, it was a long journey! I want my money back!

NPC: Has Jupiter analyzed the bloodsample?

NPC: Nothing is for free, %PLAYER_NAME(), you should know that!

Your response: Well done...

NPC: The results of Jupiter's analysis?

Your response: Take a look at them yourself!
*** Give Report ***

NPC: I need the results of the blood sample!

NPC: That's not good at all! We need to do something!

Your response: You have already noticed that Jupiter strongly recommend to avoid that creature?

NPC: Shall we just watch this creature destroy everything and everyone? We have to stop it!

Your response: How?

NPC: As I'm looking at the results of the blood test, I'm recalling something...

Your response: *click*

NPC: There are ancient reports about a group of psychopaths who once performed experiments in the Wastelands on creatures living there...

Your response: *click*

NPC: I always thought these were rumors, but now it makes sense...

Your response: YOU KNEW ABOUT THIS? ARE YOU TOTALLY INSANE?

NPC: I could not have known! But it doesn't matter now, we need to stop that creature!

Your response: *click*

NPC: For heaven's sake, it was probably those crazy Fallen Angels experimenting again or the lunatics from the Brotherhood of Crahn trying to create the GenTank 2.0 ...

Your response: Unbelievable! What we do now?

NPC: While we were talking, I called up the old reports on my interface. Yes, there is probably something that the creature responds to. So we can attract, and destroy it!

Your response: Let's hear...

NPC: You have to bring me something. It will be difficult, but we should be able to summon the creature. How exactly we're going to do that I still need to discover, but in the meantime you can collect the materials required.

Your response: Come on... what do I have to get?

NPC: The creature responds to electromagnetic stimuli. We need parts from the Warbot factory. The big one! I don't know exactly where it is, but I think it's called the 'Juggernaut Factory'. We will need 10 Electronical Triggerdevice v 0.1.1!

NPC: You got them?

Your response: Sure!
*** Give 10 Electronical Triggerdevice v 0.1.1***

NPC: To continue I need 10x Electronical Triggerdevice v 0.1.1!

NPC: I need some time to build the stuff. Give me a few minutes. To proceed we have to ask General Carter, so go ask him!

NPC: Soldier, use all necessary force to eliminate the mutated Lizard! Assist Dr. Lennard - NOW!

NPC: Your timing is perfect, I'm still missing something that is needed to finish the device.

Your response: What is it you need?

NPC: I need two '*unidentified* lowtech parts' to make the device really work!

NPC: The parts, please!

Your response: *** Give two *unidentified* lowtech parts ***

NPC: We can't continue without the parts!

NPC: Perfect! Now we can run up to the grand finale!

Your response: What's our next step?

NPC: I'm quite sure you'd remember the place you found the soldiers' bodies? Somewhere around there must be a kind of terminal, an interface...

Your response: *click*

NPC: I don't know what it is exactly, but I'm sure you will know it when you've found it! Put the device I've built into it to attract the mutated Lizard.

Your response: Sounds simple...

NPC: We will see. Maybe it will take a while before the device is operating at full capacity.

Your response: *click*

NPC: So it's quite possible that you have to stay there for a while. But don't sleep there!

Your response: Sleeping there? I am a soldier not a suicidal maniac!

NPC: Sure, soldier...

Your response: But... Tell me, how is it possible to summon a creature with a terminal?

NPC: It's difficult to explain, but the short version is: The terminal sends vibrations into the ground, and somehow - don't ask me how - the creature reacts to it.

Your response: *click*

NPC: The creature is not really summoned by the terminal, the terminal just manipulates nature!

Your response: Ah, okay...

NPC: Okay, one last thing...

Your response: Yes?

NPC: I will of course also need proof of your daring deed. Bring me a claw of this bastard creature!

NPC: *** S Y S T E M  O F F L I N E ***

Your response: *** A C T I V A T E  S Y S T E M ***

NPC: *** A C C E S S  D E N I E D ***

NPC: *** S Y S T E M  O N L I N E ***

Your response: *** I N S E R T  D E V I C E ***

NPC: *** N O  C O M P A T I B L E  D E V I C E  F O U N D ***

NPC: *** R E B O O T I N G ***
*** I N I T I A T E  P R O T O C O L  O M E G A ***
*** P L E A S E  R E T R Y  A G A I N ***

NPC: *** S Y S T E M  S T A T U S  :  1 0 0  P E R C E N T ***
*** P R O C E E D***

Your response: *** P R O C E E D ***

NPC: *** P L E A S E  W A I T ***
*** S Y S T E M  S T A T U S  :  O P E R A T I N G ***

NPC: *** I N I T I A T E  C A L L  O M E G A - A L P H A ***

NPC: %PLAYER_NAME(), you're back!

Your response: Indeed...

NPC: Find the old terminal so you can kill the mutated lizard!

NPC: You're still alive... Either you killed the creature or you have not even tried.

Your response: Here, take the claw. Is that proof enough?

NPC: Have you tried to kill the creature? Where is the claw?

NPC: Indeed! Amazing performance! Very good, soldier %PLAYER_NAME()!

Your response: Hopefully there was only one creature...

NPC: We have to assume that. Let's hope it really was just this one terrible creature! General Carter is also delighted with the positive message, you should immediately report back to him!

NPC: General Carter is waiting!

NPC: Welcome back, soldier! Good work!
Dr. Lennard speaks of you in the highest regards and I can only agree with!

Your response: Thank you, Sir!

NPC: Support Dr. Lennard, soldier!

NPC: We have studied the claw you captured and we can make sensational discoveries!

Your response: Happy to hear that, Sir!

NPC: We could use the gene mutations of that creature to develop a new weapon from the claw. And you will get a copy of it! Take advantage of the weapon wisely!

Your response: WOW! Thank you, Sir!

NPC: Thank you, soldier %PLAYER_NAME()! You are dismissed, soldier! Your job is done!

CONTACT
First Lieutenant Mclane

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Datacube with military coordinates
• Dogtag - Staff Sergeant van Dyk
• M.I.O.N. Accesscard - Level 3

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• Datacube with military coordinates
• FAR-6000 Reaper Assault Rifle
• M.I.O.N. Accesscard - Level 3

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at least 55; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• We have lost one of our scouts, Staff Sergeant van Dyk. He left this morning on a mission to monitor the mutant movement near Regant's Legacy. We lost contact more than eight hours ago. Your first mission goal is to interrogate Kitty Galore, Sergeant van Dyk's sister, just to make sure he hasn't deserted. The last known residence of Mrs. Galore is the Twisters in Sector I-09. Return here after the successful interrogation. Dismissed!

• **Current Assignment: Surveillance of Sector F-06 with Staff Sergeant van Dyk. Mutant movement analysis. EoF

• The datacube was quite valuable. No we know where this traitor is hiding. Van Dyk thought he could just sneak out and hide in the Secret Passage that you can enter from Sector A-08. Find this wussy-boy and arrest him!

• First Sergeant Guarnere is on an undercover mission and I have no authority over covert operations. But I won't be stopped by those formalities. There's a stolen M.I.O.N. Terminal in Energycore 3, down in Tech Haven. With this access card here you should be able to hack the terminal and find out where Guarnere is deployed. Squeeze him out, get van Dyk's location and return here. Dismissed!

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.

entries.details:
CONTACT
Wisdom of Ceres Savant - PSI

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: What is your covet, stranger?

Your response: I am seeking the knowledge of the Wisdom of Ceres.

Your response: Nevermind, I think I am wrong here. Bye

NPC: You don't meet the requirements for recieving the Knowledge of Ceres. You have to finish at least one Epic Run before I can train you! So come back when you are ready to recieve the great honor.

NPC: What is your covet, stranger?

NPC: What is your covet, Stranger?

NPC: My senses tell me that you are ready to recieve the Wisdom of Ceres? Is that correct?

Your response: Yes, honorable Savant of Ceres. I am prepared to recieve this great honor.

Your response: Errrr....Nevermind...

NPC: Come back when you are prepared to recieve the Wisdom of Ceres. Now go away and leave us in our meditation.

NPC: Congratulations! You have just recieved the Wisdom of Ceres. I hope you are aware about this great unique honor.

NPC: Come back when you have enough money!

NPC: You don't have the Wisdom of Ceres Disc. Without this item you won't be able to recieve the Wisdom of Ceres. Come back when you have the disc.

NPC: Your knowledge is not meeting the requirements for Wisdom of Ceres. Come back when you are ready to recieve this great honor!

NPC: I am not able to train you. Ask my fellow Savants if they can assist you with your needs.
