1  --************************
   2  --name   : woc_psi.lua
   3  --ver    : 0.0
   4  --author : Farril
   5  --date   : 07.09.2004
   6  --lang   : en+de
   7  --desc   : Template / Skelett für WoC Skill-Vergabe
   8  --npc    : - none yet -
   9  --************************
  10  --changelog:
  11  -- 07.09.2004 - Create
  12  --************************  
  13  
  14  
  15  --************************
  16  -- Presets:
  17  	WOC_SKILL = 5
  18  --************************
  19  
  20  
  21  function SKILLNAME(skill)
  22  	if (skill==0) then return "none" end
  23  	if (skill==1) then return "Strength" end
  24  	if (skill==2) then return "Dexterity" end
  25  	if (skill==3) then return "Constitution" end
  26  	if (skill==4) then return "Intelligence" end
  27  	if (skill==5) then return "PSI" end
  28  end
  29  
  30  -- GETFACTION functions
  31  function GETFACTIONID()
  32  	CANDOEPICRUN(1,0)
  33  	if (result~=-1) then
  34  		result = 1
  35  		return
  36  	end
  37  	CANDOEPICRUN(2,0)
  38  	if (result~=-1) then
  39  		result = 2
  40  		return
  41  	end	
  42  	CANDOEPICRUN(3,0)
  43  	if (result~=-1) then
  44  		result = 3
  45  		return
  46  	end
  47  	CANDOEPICRUN(4,0)
  48  	if (result~=-1) then
  49  		result = 4
  50  		return
  51  	end
  52  	CANDOEPICRUN(5,0)
  53  	if (result~=-1) then
  54  		result = 5
  55  		return
  56  	end
  57  	CANDOEPICRUN(6,0)
  58  	if (result~=-1) then
  59  		result = 6
  60  		return
  61  	end
  62  	CANDOEPICRUN(8,0)
  63  	if (result~=-1) then
  64  		result = 8
  65  		return
  66  	end
  67  	CANDOEPICRUN(9,0)
  68  	if (result~=-1) then
  69  		result = 9
  70  		return
  71  	end
  72  	CANDOEPICRUN(10,0)
  73  	if (result~=-1) then
  74  		result = 10
  75  		return
  76  	end
  77  	CANDOEPICRUN(11,0)
  78  	if (result~=-1) then
  79  		result = 11
  80  		return
  81  	end
  82  	CANDOEPICRUN(14,0)
  83  	if (result~=-1) then
  84  		result = 14
  85  		return
  86  	end
  87  	CANDOEPICRUN(15,0)
  88  	if (result~=-1) then
  89  		result = 15
  90  		return
  91  	end
  92  end
  93  
  94  
  95  function DIALOG()
  96  	-- preamble
  97  	NODE(0) 
  98  		SAY("What is your covet, stranger?")
  99  		ANSWER("I am seeking the knowledge of the Wisdom of Ceres.",10)
 100  		ANSWER("Nevermind, I think I am wrong here. Bye",21) 
 101  		
 102  		
 103  	-- now get to the checks
 104  	NODE(10)
 105  		GetWOCSkill()
 106  		if (WOC_SKILL~=result) and (result~=0) then
 107  			-- another skill already trained
 108  			SAY("My senses are telling me that you are not seeking the Wisdom of Ceres "..SKILLNAME(WOC_SKILL)..". Talk to the other Savants. They may assist you with your needs.")
 109  			ENDDIALOG()
 110  		else
 111  			if (result==0) then
 112  				-- not trained any woc yet => Test for epic (master flag)
 113  				GETFACTIONID()
 114  				runnerfaction = result ;
 115  				CANDOEPICRUN(runnerfaction,0)
 116  				if (result~=-2) then
 117  					-- runner hat die epic seiner fraktion noch nicht abgeschlossen
 118  					SAY("You don't meet the requirements for recieving the Knowledge of Ceres. You have to finish at least one Epic Run before I can train you! So come back when you are ready to recieve the great honor.") 
 119  					ENDDIALOG()
 120  				else
 121  					-- runner hat die vorrausetzung epic
 122  					SAY("What is your covet, stranger?")
 123  					ANSWER("I want to recieve my Wisdom of Ceres "..SKILLNAME(WOC_SKILL).." skill. Can you train me, honorable Savant?",20)
 124  				end
 125  			else
 126  				-- trained the right WOC skill for this npc already
 127  				SAY("What is your covet, Stranger?")
 128  				ANSWER("I want to extend my Wisdom of Ceres "..SKILLNAME(result).."? Please train me, honorable Savant of Ceres.",20)
 129  			end
 130  		end
 131  		
 132  		
 133  	-- add the skill
 134  	NODE(20)
 135  		SAY("My senses tell me that you are ready to recieve the Wisdom of Ceres? Is that correct?") 
 136  		ANSWER("Yes, honorable Savant of Ceres. I am prepared to recieve this great honor.",22) 
 137  		ANSWER("Errrr....Nevermind...",21) 
 138  	NODE(21)
 139  		SAY("Come back when you are prepared to recieve the Wisdom of Ceres. Now go away and leave us in our meditation.") 
 140  		ENDDIALOG()
 141  	NODE(22)
 142  		AddWOCLevel(WOC_SKILL)
 143  		if (result==0) then
 144  			SAY("Congratulations! You have just recieved the Wisdom of Ceres. I hope you are aware about this great unique honor.") ;
 145  			ENDDIALOG()
 146  		elseif (result==1) then
 147  			-- no money
 148  			SAY("Come back when you have enough money!") ;
 149  			ENDDIALOG()
 150  		elseif (result==2) then
 151  			-- no item (1450) (or not skill * item)
 152  			SAY("You don't have the Wisdom of Ceres Disc. Without this item you won't be able to recieve the Wisdom of Ceres. Come back when you have the disc.") ;
 153  			ENDDIALOG()
 154  		elseif (result==3) then
 155  			-- no exp
 156  			SAY("Your knowledge is not meeting the requirements for Wisdom of Ceres. Come back when you are ready to recieve this great honor!") ;
 157  			ENDDIALOG()
 158  		elseif (result==4) then
 159  			-- wrong skill
 160  			SAY("I am not able to train you. Ask my fellow Savants if they can assist you with your needs.") ;
 161  			ENDDIALOG()
 162  		end		
 163  end

entries.details:
CONTACT
The Jackal

ITEMS THE NPC MAY ASK FOR
• Briefcase
• Drug Package
• Special Ammunition
• Special Ammunition: purified

ITEMS THE NPC MAY GIVE
• 7.62mm Ronin Rounds
• Briefcase
• Drug Package
• HVSR-90 Ronin Sniper Rifle
• Special Ammunition: purified

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at least 55; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• I like that! First you'll have to meet with Mr. Davidson at the race track in the Wastelands. He will give you a package, which you'll have to bring to Easy in Outzone sector-3. Easy will also give you something for me. As I said: no questions!!

• The target is called Sharpman and carries something I want. Unfortunately the target refuses to hand it over. You'll have to convince him. His last known location is the Twisters in the Wastelands sector I_09. Make it quick and be discrete! Bring the object on the target person to Edgar in Tech Haven Sec-1. He will explain the rest to you.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.

NPC: Boy, you're way too green behind the ears! Come back when you're stronger!

NPC: Hey, Runner. Interested in a job? You look like you could get things done!

Your response: No thanks, I'm busy!

Your response: You bet! I'm up for it, what is it about?

NPC: It's possible that you're gonna get your hands dirty.

Your response: What? No way! Not my thing!

Your response: No problem! Tell me more!

NPC: As you wish. I'll just ask someone else!

NPC: Ok, no questions! The less you know, the better for everyone.

Your response: Naturally! We're all pros here!

NPC: I like that! First you'll have to meet with Mr. Davidson at the race track in the Wastelands. He will give you a package, which you'll have to bring to Easy in Outzone sector-3. Easy will also give you something for me. As I said: no questions!!

Your response: Discretion is everything in this line of work. I'll be on my way.

NPC: Do it!

NPC: Damn! About time! I don't have all day!

Your response: I got held up...

NPC: Yeah yeah! Always the same thing! I have to get my bike ready for the race! Now get out of here!

NPC: What do you want from me? You have everything you need! Get lost!

NPC: Woohoooo! Easy is the name! What can I do for you, Runner?!

Your response: I have a package for you.

NPC: Do I know you??

NPC: Ahhh, right! The sniper rifle for Jackal! Where did I put it. Hold on a moment!

Your response: Hurry up, I don't have all day!

NPC: You don't have my package! Are you screwing with me?

NPC: Yeah yeah! I'm hurrying! Just look around for a couple minutes!

NPC: Ohhh yeah! Here it is! This baby is from the mutant attack on the CityMercs convoy. They just left a lot of stuff lying around. Ran off screaming like schoolgirls, those wanna-be mercenaries! *laughs*

Your response: Do I look like I'm interested in what you say? Give me the package so I can keep going!

NPC: I'm still looking, damn! Where did I put it...

NPC: Hey! Relax! I rarely get any visitors here! Some smalltalk doesn't hurt!

Your response: A pro separates profession and private life. Now give it to me!

NPC: Yeah yeah, you pros, you! So funny! Here, take it! And greet Jackal from me. Always a pleasure!

NPC: What? I thought you were in a hurry?

NPC: Back already. That was fast. Is everything taken care of?

Your response: Yes, here is your delivery.

NPC: Very good. Show me!

Your response: Here.

NPC: Excellent! Good work!

Your response: Was a piece of cacke. So when do I get a real job?

NPC: Don't try to screw me! Where is the delivery?

NPC: Very determined. I like it. Well, I have to take care of something. Come back in a few minutes.

NPC: Can we continue?

Your response: No, not yet.

Your response: Yes, I'm ready.

NPC: I'll wait here. Get going!

NPC: Very well. The next job is somewhat more delicate.

Your response: Got it. What do I need to do?

NPC: The target is called Sharpman and carries something I want. Unfortunately the target refuses to hand it over. You'll have to convince him. His last known location is the Twisters in the Wastelands sector I_09. Make it quick and be discrete! Bring the object on the target person to Edgar in Tech Haven Sec-1. He will explain the rest to you.

Your response: Alright, shouldn't be a problem. I'll be on my way.

NPC: Do it!

NPC: There you are. What took so long?

Your response: Here, take this!

NPC: Ah, very good. This will take some time, come back in a few minutes!

NPC: What am I supposed to take?

NPC: I'm done. Here, take this.

Your response: Thanks.

NPC: I'm not done yet!

NPC: Send my regards to Jakal. I'm always at his disposal.

NPC: What do you want??

NPC: Everything is done?

Your response: No, not yet. I'll hurry!

Your response: Yes, everything should be as you wished.

NPC: I'm waiting here. Go ahead!

NPC: So you have something for me.

Your response: Correct, here it is.

NPC: Excellent! Good work!

Your response: Thank you. Anything else you need done?

NPC: Where is the package?

NPC: I have to put something together. Talk to me in a minute.

NPC: A real beauty!

Your response: What do you mean?

NPC: This sniper rifle. You can take the wings off a dragonfly from a 1000 meters with this!

Your response: I see. I already suspected it was a rifle. But this one seems to be special.

NPC: That it is. DAMN! What is this douche doing here? QUICK!!! HELP ME TAKE OUT THIS AGENT!!!

NPC: Damn, that was close. This Agent Shadowstalker has been after me for a while. I have to thank you! You saved my life!!!

Your response: No problem. Was easy enough.

NPC: The agent isn't dead yet!

NPC: I owe you one! Here, take this sniper rifle and some ammo. You earned it!

Your response: Oh! I can't accept this.

NPC: Sure you can! I have another model in my collection. I have to take care of the new talent! Now take it before I change my mind!

Your response: Thank you!

NPC: Now stop thanking me! I'll remember your name. You're a capable runner, no question! Now please excuse me, work calls!

CONTACT
Dag

CONDITIONS FOUND
• Checks base rank: at least 55; outcome depends on the dialogue branch.

POSSIBLE LOCATION CLUES IN DIALOGUE
• There is the 'Technical Workshop' in Plaza Sector 4 - Mike Garninger is there, an old friend of mine.
He has a part of the engine I need to build the vehicle, you have to get it from him.

• Mike Garninger, Plaza Sector 4, roger!

• Meet Mike Garninger at the Technical Workshop in Plaza Sector 4.

• Galahan Spangler in Viarosso Sector 1.

This script can include several missions and alternative outcomes. Read the dialogue for context; items listed may apply only to particular choices.
entries.conversation:
NPC: Come back when you've gained some experience!

NPC: Do we have an appointment?

Your response: Erm, no... What are you doing here, though?

Your response: Nevermind.

NPC: Bye.

NPC: Research work.
I'm working on a new ground vehicle.

Your response: Ah, you're a NexT scientist?

NPC: No, not really. I'm working on my own, since I've found some old vehicle plans.

Your response: Old vehicle plans?

NPC: Ya, you know... You find an old building, go inside and have a look what's going on there and suddendly you find some stuff you could need or work with...

Your response: Yeah, sure, doing that all the time...

NPC: Ya, you know how it works, right? But this time I made a huge finding, found that old plan from an old NExT scientist and here we are!

And you? What is your desire here?

Your response: Now it's the vehicle you're talking about!

NPC: I see.
But its mine, I only have this prototype.

Your response: I assume you could change that?

NPC: I could, yes, but only if you take care of the stuff for it.
If you do some dirty and boring work for me, I'll build you one. Deal?

Your response: I do have the feeling I'll regret my decision somehow, but yes. It's a deal!

NPC: There is the 'Technical Workshop' in Plaza Sector 4 - Mike Garninger is there, an old friend of mine.
He has a part of the engine I need to build the vehicle, you have to get it from him.

Your response: Mike Garninger, Plaza Sector 4, roger!

NPC: Hurry up!

NPC: Make it quick, I'm extremly busy!
